data.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Owns moderately complex components within platform services ; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use. 
 - Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans. 
 - Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

IoT Software Developer

Do you want to work on software applications that connect industrial machines, edge devices, and cloud platforms?

As an IoT Edge Software Developer within the Device Engineering Team (DET), you will contribute to the development, maintenance, and support of software running on edge devices that collect machine data, communicate securely with cloud platforms, and enable remote management at scale. You will work with Windows-based edge devices, cloud-connected applications, and device lifecycle management processes that support customers worldwide. 

This role is ideal for a developer who enjoys hands-on software development, troubleshooting complex device and connectivity issues, and working at the intersection of industrial systems, edge computing, and cloud technologies. 

If you want to build software where industrial IoT, edge computing, and cloud technologies converge, the Device Engineering Team is where it happens. 

Responsibilities

Technical Implementation

- Implement software components and features based on provided designs, specifications, and guidance. 
 - Contribute to the development of reliable, maintainable, and secure code within the assigned scope. 
 - Apply agreed coding standards, patterns, and best practices in daily development work. 
 - Make basic technical decisions within assigned tasks, escalating questions or uncertainties when needed. 

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Translate assigned requirements and tasks into working software. 
 - Complete development work in alignment with sprint goals and delivery commitments. 
 - Contribute to task breakdowns and effort estimates for assigned work. 
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, or implementation issues to the team. 

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable code and contribute to unit and integration tests. 
 - Participate in code reviews, incorporating feedback and learning from peers. 
 - Ensure individual contributions meet Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD) criteria. 
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality practices. 

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects and issues in development and production environments. 
 - Support corrective (bug fixes) and evolutive (enhancements) maintenance of existing solutions. 

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate effectively with other developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads. 
 - Seek feedback and guidance to continuously improve technical skills. 
 - Actively learn the systems, tools, and technologies used by the team. 
 - Contribute positively to team culture and shared ownership of outcomes. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
 - Proficiency in C# and the . NET platform
 - Working knowledge of Python or other scripting languages
 - Strong understanding of Test-Driven Development (TDD)
 - Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, Git repositories, and CI/CD pipelines
 - Familiarity with DevSecOps concepts
 - Familiarity with device communication protocols such as MQTT, OPC-UA, or similar technologies
 - Experience using AI assisted coding tools (e. g. GitHub Copilot) responsibly, with full accountability for code quality, security, and compliance. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Fluency in English, both written and spoken

Assets

- Hands-on experience with IoT, industrial automation, edge computing, or device lifecycle management
 - Experience with Azure IoTHub, DPS, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, or Azure Data Explorer
 - Experience supporting Windows based machines
 - Familiarity with OTA software and firmware update mechanisms
 - Knowledge of cybersecurity and data privacy controls for IoT environments

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.description:
We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer for the ongoing development and evolution of a high-performance distributed file system. The ideal candidate will possess deep system software development expertise, strong technical leadership capabilities, excellent communication skills, and a proven ability to drive complex projects independently. This role requires close collaboration with globally distributed teams to quickly learn DDN products, technologies, deployment architectures, and operational workflows. The candidate will also contribute to the integration of monitoring, health-check, observability, and alerting capabilities across the product ecosystem. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and optimize the core I/O infrastructure that underpins the distributed file system, including memory management, threading models, task scheduling, resource allocation, and execution frameworks. 
 - Architect and implement scalable concurrency and synchronization mechanisms to support extreme performance, low latency, and high throughput under demanding production workloads. 
 - Design and enhance Quality of Service (QoS), fairness, prioritization, and resource management capabilities to ensure predictable performance across diverse workloads and tenants. 
 - Integrate and optimize SPDK (Storage Performance Development Kit) within the I/O Core to leverage direct hardware access, minimize software overhead, and maximize storage efficiency. 
 - Design and implement distributed locking mechanisms and concurrency models to ensure consistency, fault tolerance, and scalability across distributed system components. 
 - Design and develop system software in C/C++ under tight deadlines with minimal supervision. 
 - Lead the design and implementation of scalable, high-performance storage and file system infrastructure. 
 - Define, document, and communicate technical architectures, design decisions, and implementation strategies. 
 - Own the full software development lifecycle from design and development through testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Drive technical reviews and provide architectural guidance throughout the development process. 
 - Architect, troubleshoot, and optimize system-level components, particularly runtime systems, file systems, storage subsystems, and performance-critical infrastructure. 
 - Conduct research-driven technical investigations, document findings, evaluate alternatives, and develop production-ready solutions. 
 - Mentor and guide engineers across the organization, promoting engineering excellence and best practices. 
 - Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure successful product deployment and timely resolution of production issues. 
 - Influence technical strategy, roadmap planning, and long-term architectural direction. 

Requirements

- Accountable, highly motivated, and capable of leading through influence and technical expertise. 
 - 10+ years of experience in system software development and complex problem resolution. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in C/C++. 
 - Extensive Linux development and deployment experience, including file system development. 
 - Deep understanding of operating system principles, kernel architecture, and system internals. 
 - Strong experience with open-source development toolchains including GCC, GDB, G++, and Git. 
 - Experience designing and developing parallel and concurrent software systems. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. 
 - Experience with user-space I/O frameworks such as SPDK. 
 - Experience developing high-performance storage systems with a focus on latency, throughput, scalability, and resource efficiency. 
 - Proven ability to lead technical initiatives and mentor engineering teams. 

Nice to Have

- Strong understanding of RDMA networking concepts, including libfabric, verbs, zero-copy technologies, and high-performance interconnects. 
 - Experience with performance analysis, profiling, benchmarking, and optimization. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments. 
 - Experience with complex network programming, including TCP/IP and RDMA-based communication. 
 - Experience building large-scale distributed storage, distributed file systems, or data management systems. 
 - Experience with distributed coordination, locking, consensus, or metadata management systems. 
 - Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure, observability frameworks, and large-scale production deployments.

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

We have an opportunity to impact your career and provide an adventure where you can push the limits of what's possible. 

As a Lead Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the Consumer and community banking technology team, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. As a core technical contributor, you are responsible for conducting critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives. 

Job Responsibilities

- Lead Live Site Management and cloud production management practices, including production readiness, change governance, incident response, problem management, and operational risk reduction. 
 - Define and improve SRE practices, including service-level indicators, service-level objectives, error budgets, capacity planning, and reliability engineering. 
 - Advance observability across applications and infrastructure through effective logging, metrics, distributed tracing, dashboards, alerting, and automated anomaly detection. 
 - Drive major incident response, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and the systematic elimination of recurring production issues. 
 - Establish production health, availability, performance, and resiliency measures that provide actionable insight to engineering and business leadership. 
 - Promote team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering practices within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes, while establishing consistent validation standards and promoting reuse of effective patterns across the team. 
 - Apply knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized through automation. 
 - Shape the end-to-end AWS cloud architecture strategy across all product components. 
 - Strengthen cloud cost strategy and optimization across the product. 

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience
 - Deep, broad AWS expertise across compute, data, networking, security, and observability, with proven production architecture experience. 
 - Systems thinking, including the ability to reason about trade-offs, failure modes, and dependencies across an entire product. 
 - Strategic command of cost, scalability, automation, reliability, and AI integration as connected levers. 
 - Hands-on depth to validate and prototype ideas, not just advise. 
 - Proven experience managing cloud-hosted production services and leading Live Site Management practices in complex, business-critical environments. 
 - Strong SRE and observability expertise, including SLI/SLO definition, error budgets, telemetry, distributed tracing, alert design, capacity management, and performance engineering. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead high-severity incident response, perform root-cause analysis, and drive durable remediation across multiple engineering teams. 
 - Experience establishing production readiness standards, operational controls, runbooks, dashboards, and measurable service health objectives. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading effective use of approved AI-assisted software development tools, with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security. 
 - Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity, secure handling of inputs and outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching engineers on safe, compliant adoption within delivery practices.

 - Consult with clients on design and functionality to ensure goals and objectives are met

Gurgaon, India

data.description:
Join us as a Software Engineer, at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions. 

To be successful as a Software Engineer, you should have experience with: 

- Strong Python development and scripting capability. 
 - Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, configuration files, and automation frameworks. 
 - Understanding of CI/CD, Git-based development, automated deployment, and environment promotion. 
 - Experience supporting enterprise BI platforms, preferably Tableau and/or Power BI. 
 - Knowledge of Linux, job scheduling, authentication, credentials, and operational monitoring. 

Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include

- Tableau Server administration or Tableau CI/CD experience. 
 - Power BI platform or Power BI REST API knowledge. 
 - AWS automation and platform-service integration. 
 - ServiceNow, Jira and enterprise change-management experience. 

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills. 

The role is based out of Pune. 

Purpose of the role

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues. 

Accountabilities

- Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance. 
 - Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives. 
 - Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing. 
 - Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth. 
 - Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions. 
 - Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability. 

Analyst Expectations

- To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement. 
 - Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
 - Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
 - They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources. 
 - If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L - Listen and be authentic, E - Energise and inspire, A - Align across the enterprise, D - Develop others. 
 - OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate. 
 - Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area. 
 - Partner with other functions and business areas. 
 - Takes responsibility for end results of a team's operational processing and activities. 
 - Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately. 
 - Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation. 
 - Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise. 
 - Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct. 
 - Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function. 
 - Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function. 
 - Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail. 
 - Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents. 
 - Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information. 
 - Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation. 

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship - our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset - to Empower, Challenge and Drive - the operating manual for how we behave.

Job title: Senior Software Engineer

  

About SailPoint: 

SailPoint is the leader in identity security for the cloud enterprise. Our identity security solutions secure and enable thousands of companies worldwide, giving our customers unmatched visibility into the entirety of their digital workforce, ensuring workers have the right access to do their job - no more, no less. 

About the role: 

Want to be on a team that full of results-driven individuals who are constantly seeking to innovate? Want to make an impact? At SailPoint, our Engineering team does just that. Our engineering is where high-quality professional engineering meets individual impact. Our team creates products are built on a mature, cloud-native event-driven microservices architecture hosted in AWS. 

SailPoint is seeking a Backend Software Engineer with a strong API(REST/GraphQL) development/design background with a flair for programming in java (and Go desired) with a demonstrated history of learning, passionate about building and delivering reliable, scalable, observable microservices for enterprise-grade, multi-tenant SaaS products. The position will be part of Identity Security Cloud Business Services group that develops governance features - Access Certifications, Access Request & Approvals, Password Management, Separation of Duties, Identity/Account Refresh and Provisioning to connect and centrally control access to every application. As part of this team, we are defining the API management strategy for the range of SaaS products, and bring uniformity to the API creation across all teams, adopting diverse cloud-native technologies (persistence, messaging, analytical processing - to name a few) and enabling the product to scale seamlessly while providing a performant user experience. You'll work with teams that are passionate about continuous improvement and agility in a fast-paced environment. 

Responsibilities  

- Drive the planning, design, construction, and reviewing the construction of APIs. 
 - Drive the design, implementation, and deployment of efficient, maintainable, robust microservices to deliver medium-to-high complexity features. 
 - As a member of the API strategy team, you will collaborate with the services team and help your stakeholders follow the organization's strategy for designing, building, and maintaining APIs. 
 - Produce designs and rough estimates, and implement features based on product requirements. 
 - Collaborate with peers on designs, code reviews, and testing. 
 - Produce unit and end-to-end tests to improve code quality and maximize code coverage for new and existing features. 
Requirements  

- 6+ years of experience in Java-based backend development. 
 - Strong knowledge in developing server-side, Object-Oriented Programming and Spring Boot framework
 - Experience in designing, implementing RESTful/GraphQL APIs for an API-first application architecture. 
 - Experience using cloud-native technologies from AWS/other cloud providers. 
 - Experience developing microservices in multi-tenant SaaS application. 
 - Experience using SQL/NoSQL, EKS, Kafka, Redis

By 90 days: 

- Proactively implement different enhancements, defect fixes by interacting independently with different (sometimes  many) stakeholders, architects and members of your team. 
 - Take a committed approach to contributing to different projects development alongside less experienced engineers on your team-there's no room for ivory towers here. 
 - Is able to provide 12x7 on-call support during their day. 

By 6 months: 

- Collaborates with Product Management and Engineering Manager to estimate and develop small to medium complexity features more independently. 
 - Lead projects with small group of 3-4 members. Participate in resource planning, backlog refinement activity. 
 - Occasionally serve as an analysis expert during escalations of systems issues that have evaded the ability of less experienced engineers to solve in a timely manner. 
 - Share support of critical team systems by participating in calls with customers, learning the characteristics of currently running systems, and participating in improvements.

Nestled in the heart of Pune, a bustling hub of technology and culture, the office exemplifies SailPoint's commitment to excellence. Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever-evolving challenges in identity security. With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals.

data.description:
Description

Amazon's Relay Operations Center (ROC) is the execution backbone of North America's middle-mile transportation network-managing tens of millions of loads annually across a vast asset base. As we deploy an ambitious automation program that will fundamentally transform how carriers and drivers interact with our network, we need a results-driven Program Manager to ensure that speed never comes at the cost of experience. 

You will lead quality improvement cycles, drive customer experience (CX) metric adoption, and partner with operations, technology, and training teams to deliver measurable improvements in carrier and driver experience across NA ROC operations. This role requires you to think big, dive deep, and balance strategic planning with hands-on program execution. 

As Program Manager, ROC Quality & Customer Experience, you will serve as a strategic advisor to internal and external stakeholders while driving the adoption and engagement of ROC's quality and CX programs. You will be responsible for developing long-term OP planning inputs, contributing to the three-year vision, and building strategic roadmaps for quality and training. In addition to long-term strategic planning, you will partner closely with operations, workforce planning, learning partners, and technology teams to operationalize and deliver improvement initiatives at mid-term horizons. 

You will lead a diverse team across various levels and capabilities-program managers, quality analysts, and business analysts-to drive results for NA Transportation Operations. You will set and drive a culture of defect reduction through continuous improvement cycles, maintaining accountability across multiple business units to deliver large-scale, high-visibility projects. It is an exciting role where you will interact with Sr. Leaders (Directors and VPs) from different organizations across NA. 

Key job responsibilities

CX Metrics & Quality Improvement

- Own execution and continuous improvement of core CX metrics - TTR, PRR, FCR, and Repeat Rate - across automated and human-handled interactions
 - Drive quality defect reduction through closed-loop cycles: defect detection → root cause analysis → SOP update → training content → effectiveness validation
 - Support deployment of AI-powered quality monitoring (Contact Lens) to expand audit coverage and identify tone, clarity, and soft-skill gaps across voice transactions

Training & Operational Effectiveness

- Partner with L&D and workforce planning teams to operationalize training plans addressing quality gaps and automation readiness
 - Develop strategic roadmaps for quality and training, including OP planning inputs and three-year vision contributions
 - Lead continuous improvement initiatives that reduce defect rates through structured coaching frameworks and SOP standardization

Voice of Customer & Carrier Advocacy

Drive the Anecdotes Program - intake, 5-why investigation, closed-loop resolution, and systemic prevention of recurring carrier issues

- Partner with Relay Product, TTS, and Middle Mile teams to translate carrier feedback into actionable program improvements and roadmap priorities

Automation CX Readiness

- Conduct pre-launch CX impact assessments and 30/60/90-day post-launch audits for automation deployments, ensuring quality parity between automated and manual processes
 - Own case transfer governance and routing optimization, reducing unnecessary handoffs and improving first-contact resolution

Stakeholder Management & Reporting

- Present quality and CX insights in WBRs, MBRs, and QBRs to Director and Sr. leadership audiences, translating data into prioritized action plans
 - Lead a diverse team of program managers, quality analysts, and business analysts; partner cross-functionally with TTS Engineering, Relay Product, WFM, L&D, and PXT

A day in the life

You start your morning reviewing CX metrics dashboards and preparing a narrative update for a leadership review. By mid-morning, you are in a working session with Relay Product and Middle Mile partners, aligning on carrier feedback themes and roadmap priorities. After lunch, you hold a one-on-one with a direct report to discuss their development goals and review a quality audit proposal they have drafted. Later, you facilitate a post-launch CX readiness review for a recent automation deployment, diving into the details to ensure quality parity. You close the day by reviewing defect reduction trends across your portfolio and adjusting training plans with your Learning and Development partners. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
 - 2+ years of team management experience
 - 3+ years of program or project management experience
 - 
 - Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
 - 
 - Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
 - 
 - Experience working cross-functionally with tech and non-tech teams

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
 - 2+ years of cross functional project delivery experience
 - 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
 - 
 - 2+ years of supply chain or transportation operations experience
 - 
 - Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
 - 
 - Experience preparing quality metrics and effectively engaging with stakeholders to set and drive quality goals
 - 
 - Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design, or related field

Job Description - API Test Architect & Test Solution Lead

API Modernization | Microservices | Healthcare | Quality Engineering

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced API Test Architect & Solution Lead to lead the quality engineering strategy, architecture, and implementation for large-scale API modernization and microservices transformation programs within the healthcare domain. 

The role will be responsible for defining the end-to-end API testing architecture and modernization validation strategy for enterprise services being transformed from legacy/monolithic platforms into modern RESTful APIs and microservices. 

This is a customer-facing technical leadership role requiring strong expertise in API testing, test automation architecture, microservices, legacy-to-modern API parity validation, CI/CD integration, healthcare data validation, and AI-assisted Quality Engineering. 

The Solution Lead will work closely with enterprise architects, API developers, product owners, business teams, DevOps teams, and QA engineering teams to ensure modernized services meet functional, integration, data integrity, performance, security, and release-readiness requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

API Test Architecture & Solutioning

- Define the enterprise API Quality Engineering architecture, strategy, standards, and implementation roadmap for API modernization programs. 
 - Design scalable and reusable API automation frameworks supporting hundreds of APIs and thousands of test scenarios. 
 - Establish standardized testing approaches using Cucumber, TestNG, REST Assured, Gradle, Git/Bitbucket, Jenkins/Udeploy, and automated reporting. 
 - Define framework architecture with clear separation of: 
 - Test data
 - Test logic
 - Configuration
 - Validation utilities
 - Reporting
 - Environment management
 - Build reusable automation components, utilities, libraries, and common validation capabilities that can be adopted across multiple projects. 
 - Establish traceability across requirements → feature files → test data → automated execution → defects → results. 

API Modernization & Microservices Validation

- Lead testing strategy for migration of legacy enterprise services to REST APIs and microservices architecture. 
 - Define legacy-versus-modernized service parity testing to ensure business functionality and data behavior remain consistent during modernization. 
 - Establish baseline request/response datasets from legacy services and compare them against modernized API responses. 
 - Design automated comparison capabilities for: 
 - Request/response validation
 - JSON/XML payload comparison
 - Schema validation
 - Field-level comparison
 - Business-rule validation
 - Data transformation validation
 - Database/backend validation
 - Error and exception handling
 - Validate service decomposition and interactions across distributed microservices. 
 - Develop testing approaches for synchronous and asynchronous service integrations. 
 - Define regression strategies that allow modernization teams to continuously verify functional parity during incremental migration. 

API Functional & Integration Testing

- Define comprehensive API testing coverage including: 
 - Functional testing
 - Integration testing
 - Contract testing
 - Schema validation
 - Positive and negative testing
 - Boundary testing
 - Authentication and authorization validation
 - Error handling
 - Data integrity validation
 - Regression testing
 - End-to-end service validation
 - Establish API test scenarios based on OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, GraphQL schemas, interface contracts, business requirements, and legacy system documentation. 
 - Define reusable test-data strategies using Excel, generated datasets, synthetic data, and approved production-like samples. 
 - Drive automation-first testing while identifying scenarios requiring specialized or exploratory validation. 

Healthcare Domain Validation

- Provide Quality Engineering leadership for healthcare enterprise services supporting areas such as: 
 - Member and eligibility
 - Provider
 - Claims
 - Benefits
 - Enrollment
 - Accumulators
 - Authorization
 - Payments
 - Clinical and administrative integrations
 - Ensure modernization testing validates critical healthcare business rules and cross-system data integrity. 
 - Support testing of healthcare interoperability and data exchange services where applicable, including FHIR/HL7-based APIs and healthcare integration patterns. 
 - Ensure appropriate handling of sensitive healthcare test data and alignment with organizational security, privacy, and compliance requirements. 

Automation Framework Engineering

- Architect and enhance BDD-based API automation frameworks using: 
 - Cucumber
 - TestNG
 - REST Assured
 - Java
 - Gradle
 - Define reusable feature files, step definitions, API clients, assertion libraries, data utilities, and comparison utilities. 
 - Develop configurable validation mechanisms capable of supporting different APIs without extensive custom coding. 
 - Establish coding standards, framework governance, peer reviews, and reusable engineering patterns. 
 - Optimize automation suites for parallel execution, maintainability, stability, and faster regression cycles. 

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate API automation into Jenkins/Udeploy CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Define automated quality gates for builds and deployments. 
 - Enable API regression suites to execute across development, QA, integration, staging, and release environments. 
 - Establish mechanisms for: 
 - Pipeline-triggered execution
 - Environment configuration
 - Test-data management
 - Parallel execution
 - Failure diagnostics
 - Automated reporting
 - Partner with DevOps and engineering teams to enable continuous testing and shift-left quality engineering. 

Reporting & Quality Metrics

- Define enterprise-level API Quality Engineering reporting using: 
 - Cucumber Reports
 - JSON Reports
 - HTML Reports
 - Execution Logs
 - CI/CD dashboards
 - Establish metrics for: 
 - API automation coverage
 - Functional coverage
 - Regression coverage
 - Pass/fail trends
 - Defect leakage
 - Modernization parity
 - Execution stability
 - Release readiness
 - Provide technical insights and quality recommendations to engineering leadership and customer stakeholders. 

AI-Assisted Quality Engineering

- Drive adoption of GitHub Copilot and GenAI-assisted engineering across the API testing lifecycle. 
 - Use AI assistance for: 
 - Requirement and API specification analysis
 - Test scenario generation
 - Test case generation
 - Gherkin/feature-file generation
 - REST Assured automation development
 - Code refactoring
 - Test-data generation
 - Coverage-gap identification
 - Failure analysis
 - Leverage OpenAPI specifications, GraphQL schemas, legacy documentation, and existing test assets as inputs for AI-assisted test design. 
 - Define appropriate human review and governance practices for AI-generated test assets. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through intelligent automation and reusable accelerators. 

Technical Leadership & Customer Engagement

- Act as the technical solution lead and architecture point of contact for API Quality Engineering. 
 - Engage with customer stakeholders to understand modernization objectives, current-state architecture, quality risks, and target-state requirements. 
 - Translate business and technical requirements into testing architecture, solution approach, implementation roadmap, effort estimates, and delivery plans. 
 - Conduct architecture reviews and technical solution presentations with customers and engineering leadership. 
 - Lead technical discussions across development, architecture, DevOps, business, and QA teams. 
 - Mentor automation engineers and QA leads and provide technical direction across distributed teams. 
 - Identify testing risks, dependencies, technical constraints, and mitigation strategies early in the modernization lifecycle. 

Required Technical Skills

API & Microservices: REST APIs, RESTful services, Microservices Architecture, JSON, XML, OpenAPI/Swagger, GraphQL, API contracts, service integration patterns

API Automation: REST Assured, Cucumber BDD, TestNG, Java, Gradle

Framework Architecture: Reusable automation framework design, modular architecture, custom assertion utilities, schema validation, response comparison, test-data management

DevOps: Jenkins, Udeploy, Git, Bitbucket, CI/CD integration, continuous testing

Testing: API functional testing, integration testing, contract testing, regression testing, legacy-to-modern API parity testing, data validation, negative testing

Reporting: Cucumber Reports, JSON/HTML reporting, execution logs and CI/CD quality reporting

AI-Assisted Engineering: GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted test analysis, scenario generation, Gherkin generation, automation development and coverage analysis

Healthcare: Strong understanding of healthcare enterprise systems and preferably experience with claims, member, provider, eligibility, benefits, authorization, payments, or healthcare interoperability services. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience leading enterprise API modernization or monolith-to-microservices transformation programs. 
 - Experience architecting API automation frameworks used across multiple applications or programs. 
 - Experience with legacy-to-modern service comparison/parity validation. 
 - Knowledge of cloud-native architectures, containers, Kubernetes, API gateways, and service discovery is desirable. 
 - Exposure to service virtualization, mocking, contract testing, and API performance testing. 
 - Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards such as FHIR and HL7 is advantageous. 
 - Experience implementing AI/GenAI-assisted Quality Engineering practices. 
 - Strong customer-facing solutioning, architecture presentation, estimation, and stakeholder-management capabilities. 

Experience

- 13+ years of overall experience in Quality Engineering, testing, software engineering, or related disciplines. 
 - 7+ years of strong API testing and automation experience. 
 - 5+ years in a Test Architect, Solution Architect, QE Architect, Technical Lead, or equivalent technical leadership role. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading complex API modernization, microservices, integration, or digital transformation programs. 
 - Prior experience in healthcare or health insurance programs is strongly preferred. 

Expected Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be able to take an enterprise modernization requirement such as: 

Legacy Enterprise Services → Modern APIs → Microservices

and independently define the corresponding: 

Current-State Assessment → Test Strategy → API Test Architecture → Legacy Baseline → Modern API Validation → Automated Parity Testing → CI/CD Integration → Regression Strategy → Quality Gates → Production Readiness

The candidate should combine hands-on API automation architecture expertise with solutioning and customer-facing leadership, rather than functioning only as a test manager or delivery manager.

Selling Partner Identity Verification (SPIV) ensures that Amazon is a safe and trustworthy place to shop and an amazing place to build a successful business selling products. Our mission is to build trust with our Customers and Selling Partners as we scale through technology, analytics, and science. We're committed to service as a center of excellence for Amazon. 

As part of SPIV, Seller Verification owns variety of products which enables us to collect data from WW Sellers in order to let them sell on Amazon marketplace. Registration Systems receive ~1. 5M hits per week and strive towards providing a seamless experience that cannot be exploited by bad actors. Our team works on cutting-edge challenges across distributed systems, search relevance, and AI-driven retrieval-combining traditional IR techniques with modern LLM-based approaches. - Accountable for executing and driving results on large-scale efforts or multiple smaller efforts and serving as a development lead for most medium and large projects.  - Accountable for exhibiting a strong understanding of client core business functions. 
 - Required to support situations in which end user consultation is required to identify system function specifications and incorporate them into overall system design and delivery.  - Participate in micro services and NGA code reviews. 
 - Empower SDEs and their teams by mentoring and coaching. 
 - Have a comprehensive understanding of the business domain, the systems, and the products in your space. Understand their accountabilities, boundaries, limitations, scale factors and the reasons behind architectural decisions. 
 - Provide a long-term perspective for business and technology choices; using technical judgment to vet architecture as required. 
 - Able to direct teams on how to develop and deliver systems that are efficient with resource usage such as hardware, runtime, performance, load, and memory requirements. 
 - Responsible for broader design decisions and development of long-term strategies that significantly influence the development process and standards. 
 - Accountable for Design Reviews of Agile and Plan of Record (POR) projects as well as accountable for Code Reviews of Next Gen Architecture (NGA) projects and are expected to elaborate, promote and communicate Design Patterns applicable to NGA architectures and solutions. 
 - Accountable for providing architectural guidance to the SDE's based on best practices and in alignment with CTO guidelines and platform. 
 - Drive clarity and work with complete independence as business and or technical strategy is not defined. 
 - Provide the corresponding architectural guidance, and conduct design reviews and code reviews based on the projects assigned to your LOB. The product definition and technical planning is out of scope. 
 - Accountable for the overall strategy and for driving the teams inside and outside of your organization to deliver expected results. Drive mindful discussion with business and technical stakeholders that lead to timely decisions. Participate in discussions to drive smart trade-off decisions that balance efforts, delivery timelines, features, and technical constraints. Identify and remove blockers and always find the path forward in challenging situations. 
 - Create plans that have a clear path to delivery. Solve for dependencies between agile and waterfall delivery efforts. Help your teams organize for delivery while maximizing resources for the greater good of the Digital organization. Understand engineering best practices and apply best practices to the software development lifecycle (SDLC)
 - Accountable for Design Reviews for Citi Agile and POR projects as well as Code Reviews for the NGA projects. Accountable for providing architectural guidance to the SDE's based on best practices and in alignment with CTO guidelines and platform. Elaborate, promote and communicate Design Patterns applicable to NGA architectures and solutions. 
 - Elaborate, bring and communicate clear metrics on Design Reviews, Code Reviews, CI/CD and Design Patterns adoption. 
 - Communicate progress, anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, identify, assess, track and mitigate issues/risks at multiple levels. Recognize discordant views and take part in constructive dialog to resolve them. 
 - Demonstrate the ability to implement continuous improvement and the induction of new technology. Demonstrate examples of influence in scrum teams beyond your own area of focus.

with Java Microservices, Rest API, Mongo DB, Oracle, Distributed computing using OpenShift, Kafka integration and Pega (Preferred)

data.title: Lead Software Engineer – Oracle Cloud Applications
data.description:
Job Description

About Williams-Sonoma, Inc. 

https: //www. williams-sonoma. com/

Founded in 1956 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500, digital first, multi-channel specialty retailer. Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play. We bring the latest home furnishing trends to life for customers through the individual lenses of our ten distinct brands, each serving different life stages and rooms of the home and beyond. Our brands include Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark & Graham, GreenRow, and Dormify. We are committed to sustainability, continuously working to protect our planet, while building an open and collaborative culture across our organization. 

With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide. 

Engineers at the Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center build and scale digital commerce platforms that power these global brands, serving millions of customers worldwide. 

Role Overview

Lead Software Engineer - Oracle Cloud Applications

We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative Lead Software Engineer - Oracle Cloud Applications to drive the design, development, integration, and optimization of our Oracle Cloud ERP ecosystem. This role is ideal for a technology leader who combines deep Oracle Financials expertise with strong engineering capabilities to deliver scalable, high-impact business solutions. 

As a strategic partner to Finance, Accounting, and Technology teams, you will bridge the gap between complex financial business processes and advanced technical execution. You will lead enterprise-scale Oracle Cloud initiatives, architect integrations, optimize end-to-end workflows, and help shape the future of intelligent ERP automation through emerging AI and Agentic technologies. 

This is an opportunity to influence enterprise architecture, mentor engineering teams, and drive digital transformation initiatives that directly impact business performance. 

Impact of the Role

- Drive enterprise-wide Oracle Cloud ERP transformation initiatives that improve operational efficiency and business performance. 
 - Influence enterprise architecture, integration strategy, and financial systems modernization. 
 - Enable intelligent automation through AI-powered workflows and Agentic technologies. 
 - Improve financial process efficiency, data accuracy, compliance, and user experience across ERP ecosystems. 
 - Mentor engineering teams and establish technical excellence across Oracle Cloud platforms. 
 - Partner with business and technology leaders to deliver scalable, secure, and innovative financial solutions. 

Technology Platforms You Will Work On

- Oracle Cloud ERP Financials. 
 - Accounts Payable (AP), General Ledger (GL), Accounts Receivable (AR), and Fixed Assets (FA). 
 - Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC). 
 - REST APIs and SOAP Web Services. 
 - File-Based Data Import (FBDI). 
 - BI Publisher (BIP). 
 - Oracle Database technologies including SQL and PL/SQL. 
 - Oracle EPM (Enterprise Performance Management) modules. 
 - Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). 
 - AI-powered enterprise automation platforms. 
 - Agentic AI architectures and LLM-based autonomous agents. 
 - Enterprise integration frameworks and cloud-native development platforms. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design, development, implementation, and support of Oracle Cloud ERP Financial solutions across multiple business functions. 
 - Serve as the technical lead for Oracle Cloud Financials initiatives, ensuring scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions. 
 - Partner with Finance, Accounting, and business stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into technical designs and actionable solutions. 
 - Provide architectural guidance and establish best practices for Oracle Cloud development, integrations, and data management. 
 - Drive enhancements and continuous improvement initiatives across Oracle Cloud Financial modules including Accounts Payable (AP), General Ledger (GL), Accounts Receivable (AR), and Fixed Assets (FA). 
 - Analyze, optimize, and streamline end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C) business processes. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, data accuracy, automation, and user experience across financial workflows. 
 - Architect and develop robust integrations between Oracle Cloud ERP and external enterprise applications. 
 - Design scalable integration frameworks utilizing Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, SOAP Web Services, FBDI, and BI Publisher (BIP). 
 - Integrate Oracle Cloud with third-party systems such as banking platforms, tax engines, payment providers, and legacy applications. 
 - Ensure integration reliability, performance, security, monitoring, and supportability. 
 - Design, develop, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL and PL/SQL solutions. 
 - Create and maintain database objects, stored procedures, packages, views, and performance-tuned queries. 
 - Perform root cause analysis and resolve complex production issues across Oracle Cloud and integrated environments. 
 - Drive technical excellence through code reviews, performance optimization, and adherence to engineering standards. 
 - Evaluate and implement emerging technologies that enhance ERP automation and operational efficiency. 
 - Contribute to the design and deployment of Agentic Workflows and LLM-powered autonomous agents for financial process automation. 
 - Identify opportunities to leverage AI-driven decision support, workflow orchestration, exception handling, and intelligent process optimization within Oracle ERP ecosystems. 
 - Lead cross-functional technical initiatives from concept through production deployment. 
 - Mentor engineers, conduct code reviews, and foster a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement. 

Qualifications

- 8+ years of enterprise application development experience with significant hands-on experience in Oracle Cloud ERP. 
 - Deep functional and technical expertise in Oracle Cloud Financials, including Accounts Payable (AP), General Ledger (GL), Accounts Receivable (AR), and Fixed Assets (FA). 
 - Strong understanding of financial accounting concepts, controls, and compliance requirements. 
 - Proven expertise in end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C) business processes. 
 - Ability to translate complex financial business requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in SQL, PL/SQL, database design, performance tuning, package development, debugging, query optimization, and troubleshooting. 
 - Strong experience with Oracle database objects and enterprise data architecture principles. 
 - Demonstrated success designing and implementing Oracle Cloud integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, SOAP Web Services, FBDI, and BI Publisher (BIP). 
 - Experience integrating Oracle Cloud with external applications, financial institutions, tax systems, and enterprise platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise application architecture, integration patterns, security principles, and cloud-based solution design. 
 - Experience leading technical delivery across multiple concurrent projects and initiatives. 
 - Experience with Oracle EPM (Enterprise Performance Management) modules. 
 - Hands-on experience developing AI-powered enterprise automation solutions. 
 - Knowledge of Agentic AI architectures and LLM-based autonomous agents. 
 - Experience implementing intelligent workflow orchestration, process mining, or ERP automation initiatives. 
 - Familiarity with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) services and cloud-native development patterns. 
 - Experience working in large-scale retail, manufacturing, distribution, or financial services environments. 
 - Oracle Cloud certifications in ERP, Integration Cloud, or related technologies. 
 - Exceptional communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with executives, finance leaders, business stakeholders, and technical teams. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities. 
 - Demonstrated success mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence. 
 - Ability to influence architectural decisions and drive consensus across diverse teams. 
 - Strategic thinker with a passion for innovation, continuous improvement, and emerging technologies. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive, ownership-driven mindset. 
 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment while managing multiple priorities and deadlines. 

Scope & Learnings

You'll have the opportunity to lead transformative Oracle Cloud initiatives, shape enterprise architecture strategy, and pioneer the adoption of AI-driven automation within critical financial business processes. If you're passionate about combining deep Oracle expertise with innovative technologies to solve complex business challenges, we'd love to hear from you. 

Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center

- Our people first and performance driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family. 
 - Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership culture that empowers engineers to make real impact. 
 - Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale. 
 - Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges. 
 - Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement. 

About Us

Williams-Sonoma India Pvt. Ltd. 

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Today, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is one of the United States' largest e-commerce retailers with some of the best known and most beloved brands in home furnishings. Our family of brands are Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teens, West Elm, Williams-Sonoma Home, Rejuvenation, and Mark and Graham. We currently operate retail stores globally. Our products are also available to customers through our catalogs and online worldwide. 

Williams-Sonoma India sourcing office was established in 2013. We are based in Gurugram, India. We are sourcing premium products across all categories of Home Furnishing and recorded double digit year-on-year growth. We have a dynamic team of over 100 members handling versatile vendors across India, Nepal & Bangladesh. We are looking to onboard talented people and create successful professional journey.

data.title: DevOps Engineering Manager
data.description:
Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here: 

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you're trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That's why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry. 

Job Description: 

What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes. 

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development. 

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence. 

Role Summary

The Manager, DevOps Engineering is the lead hands-on engineer responsible for the India-based DevOps capability supporting enterprise applications, integrations, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure. The role combines technical leadership with direct engineering accountability across Azure infrastructure, networking, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, security, environment management, observability, and production readiness. 

This is not a process-focused or administrative management role. The manager is expected to personally design, build, review, and troubleshoot infrastructure, deployment pipelines, network configurations, access controls, monitoring, and automation. The role will also establish engineering standards, mentor DevOps engineers, review technical work, and serve as the escalation point for complex infrastructure and deployment issues. 

The manager will work closely with enterprise architects, application teams, integration engineers, data engineers, networking, security, and delivery leadership to ensure environments and deployment processes are secure, repeatable, scalable, and operationally supportable. The role is accountable for improving delivery discipline, reducing manual processes, resolving environment bottlenecks, and ensuring infrastructure and releases are ready for production. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor DevOps engineers while remaining hands-on in delivery. 
 - Design and support Azure infrastructure, networking, identity, monitoring, and platform services. 
 - Manage virtual networks, subnets, private endpoints, DNS, routing, firewalls, and IP capacity. 
 - Build and maintain reusable Infrastructure as Code using Bicep or Terraform. 
 - Design and support Azure DevOps YAML pipelines and reusable deployment templates. 
 - Automate environment provisioning, configuration, testing, release, rollback, and recovery. 
 - Implement Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, service principals, RBAC, Key Vault, and least-privilege controls. 
 - Establish monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and operational runbooks. 
 - Review infrastructure code, pipeline code, scripts, and security changes. 
 - Lead troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, incident response, and production-readiness reviews. 
 - Enforce DevOps, security, release, and operational engineering standards. 
 - Partner with architecture, application, integration, data, networking, and security teams. 

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years of DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or related experience. 
 - 4+ years of hands-on Microsoft Azure engineering experience. 
 - 2+ years in a lead engineer or technical management role. 
 - Strong Azure networking and IP-address planning experience. 
 - Strong Infrastructure as Code experience using Bicep, Terraform, or both. 
 - Strong Azure DevOps and YAML pipeline experience. 
 - Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, service principals, and Key Vault. 
 - Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights. 
 - Strong scripting skills using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Bash, or Python. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead engineers while remaining technically hands-on. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hubs, and microservices. 
 - Experience with D365 Finance and Operations, Power Platform, or Dataverse. 
 - Experience with Azure Policy, security scanning, disaster recovery, and cost optimization. 
 - Experience with containers, AKS, or site reliability engineering practices. 

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe's values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times. 

Our Benefits: 

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!

How You Can Grow: 

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

More about Crowe: 

Crowe Capability Center - India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U. S. A. ), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world. 

Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge. 

We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role's responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

We are seeking a Software Engineer to join our core engineering team to design and develop a high-throughput, mission-critical active-active microservice framework responsible for dynamically routing and balancing traffic across multi-site deployments based on real-time health, capacity, and geolocation metrics. 

Job Description

Key Responsibilities: 

- Develop the core Load Distribution engine using Finite State Machines (FSM) to manage dynamic homing, execute Weighted Average Score (WAS) algorithms, and implement hysteresis. 
 - Architect high-throughput API and messaging layers using gRPC for metrics ingestion and RabbitMQ (RMQ) for event-driven communication. 
 - Implement distributed leader election and consensus mechanisms utilizing Consul Raft and LockAuthority across active-active deployments. 
 - Ensure system scalability to handle 3, 000+ assignments per second while integrating Apache Ignite/GridGain for stateless caching and data recovery. 

Required Skills & Experience

- Deep hands-on experience in Golang (preferred) and proficiency in C, C++, or Java. 
 - Strong computer science fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms. 
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems, multi-threading, concurrency control, and Finite State Machines (FSM). 
 - Hands-on expertise with networking and messaging protocols including gRPC, Protobuf v3, and RabbitMQ. 
 - Strong background with distributed databases like Apache Ignite and GridGain, and consensus tools like Consul Raft and LockAuthority. 
 - Practical knowledge of persistence and caching solutions such as PostgreSQL, Redis, and ElasticSearch. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and explaining complex ideas. 
 - Industry Experience - 1 to 10 years. 

Basic Requirements

- Proven ability to design active-active multi-site architectures handling network partitions, majority/minority quorums, and site-isolation scenarios. 
 - Experience with large-volume transaction systems, data migration workflows, and end-to-end observability frameworks like OpenTelemetry and Kibana. 
 - Familiarity with enterprise security tooling such as Vault and mTLS. 
 - Background in automated deployments using Docker and CI/CD pipelines.

Experienced

Yes
