data.title: Engineer - Stack Testing
data.description:
Job Description

- Prepare test plans, test protocols and procedures for performance characterization, durability, accelerated stress and dynamic cycling tests. 
 - Support commissioning of the test system, including verification of sensors, interlocks and safety logic through to final tester acceptance. 
 - Manage routine calibration and verification of test instruments to ensure measurement accuracy. 
 - Execute testing and data analysis of PEM electrolyser stacks. 
 - Adapt quickly to different test types, tester designs and functionalities. 
 - Guide test technicians with clear instructions for continuous monitoring of stack and system operation and performance. 
 - Process and analyse large multi-channel datasets from operating stacks, including individual cell voltages, stack voltage/current, temperatures, pressures, flow rates, etc. 
 - Define, calculate and track key performance indicators such as cell voltage spread, energy consumption, efficiency, degradation rate and gas crossover. 
 - Perform cell-to-cell and stack-to-stack statistical analysis and correlate test results with stack build data to identify root causes of variation. 
 - Perform gas chromatography (GC) analysis and data evaluation to support performance characterisation and identify anomalies and key trends. 
 - Apply electrochemical characterisation methods for performance evaluation and diagnostics of electrochemical systems. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to analyse and correlate stack and system performance. 
 - Lead root cause analysis (RCA) of system failure modes and oversee troubleshooting and maintenance of the testers. 
 - Record and manage test deviations, non-conformances and corrective actions and provide feedback to stack design and materials teams. 
 - Prepare test reports, technical summaries and presentations for internal reviews and project updates. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance testing efficiency, quality and reliability. 
 - Ensure compliance with all health, safety and environmental regulations. 

Ohmium Cultural Values

At Ohmium, you are expected to embody and champion our core cultural values: 

Accountability: I own my tasks and execute on time. 

Demonstrate strong accountability by owning deliverables and decisions, ensuring timely and consistent results. 

Teamwork: I will not let other teams fail. 

Takes ownership beyond own team to support cross-team success and prevent failures, thereby fostering a collaborative work environment. 

Learning Mindset: I drive change and learn from mistakes. 

Exhibits a strong growth mindset by proactively leading meaningful change and consistently learning from experience. 

Winning Attitude: I compete to win. 

Showing up every day with a strong perspective, to drive results and be the BEST in Green Energy. 

Education And Experience Required

B Tech in Electrochemical or Chemical or Mechanical Engineering or related field. 

1-3 Years of experience in Testing is desirable. 

Previous experience in the renewable energy sector including Batteries, Fuel cells, Electrolyser is preferred. 

Looking for a highly skilled Testing Engineer with a strong background in electrochemical engineering. Responsible for testing, validation, trouble shooting and data analysis for PEM stacks. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise in testing and understanding on electrochemical systems such as batteries, fuel cells, electrolyzers etc. This role also covers tester commissioning, test execution, validation, and analysis of large multi-channel stack and system datasets. 

Ohmium is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

data.title: Quality Automation - Manager
data.description:
The Opportunity

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You'll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services-solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We'll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference-every day. 

We Are

A Quality Engineering practice that helps clients move from late-stage testing to continuous quality, efficiency, and resilience. We embed with product, engineering, and architecture teams, apply modern automation and AI-enabled testing, and take quality work from experiment into operational delivery at enterprise scale. 

You Are

A hands-on SDET and quality leader with 12+ years in test automation and software quality engineering. You write and review automation, set and execute the quality strategy for your program, and coach a team while remaining technically engaged. You are comfortable in global, collaborative delivery environments and you care about embedding quality across the full software development lifecycle - not only at the end of a sprint. 

The Work

You will lead quality for complex application delivery: partnering with product, development, and architecture teams; defining and executing a modern test strategy; and applying AI-enabled approaches where they deliver measurable value. You will take accountability for your team's delivery outcomes, technical direction, and continuous improvement, acting as both a technical lead and a client-facing quality partner. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Strategy & Leadership

- Define and lead end-to-end quality for your program, including early validation, risk-based testing, and continuous testing. 
 - Own quality strategy, test planning, estimation, execution governance, defect management, and release-readiness assessment across your workstreams. 
 - Establish the appropriate balance of unit, API, UI, integration, regression, and exploratory testing based on product risk and architecture. 

SDET & Custom Application Quality

- Lead the design, development, and enhancement of automation frameworks and validation components - not test cases alone. 
 - Design, implement, and scale maintainable automation frameworks for web applications and services, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and performance. 
 - Build UI, API, and where required mobile automation using Playwright and comparable tools such as Appium and REST Assured. 
 - Partner with developers to improve unit-test coverage, testability, coding standards, and shift-left quality practices. 

AI-Enabled Testing & Innovation

- Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and agentic test automation solutions to accelerate test design, implementation, maintenance, and analysis responsibly. 
 - Apply GenAI tooling (for example GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini) to improve test design, code generation, debugging, and root cause analysis. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI-enabled testing tools through controlled proofs of concept and recommend adoption based on measurable value, security, accuracy, and maintainability. 

DevSecOps & CI/CD Integration

- Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and define quality gates that provide fast, reliable feedback. 
 - Embed automated testing into delivery pipelines such as GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, covering version control and artifact management. 

Cross-Platform Quality Delivery

- Lead testing across web, API, and mobile (iOS/Android) layers as the engagement requires. 
 - Apply contract testing, test-data management, service virtualization or mocking, and observability practices. 

Client Engagement & Advisory

- Partner with client and business stakeholders to shape quality strategy and support transformation initiatives. 
 - Facilitate workshops and deliver pragmatic quality solutions in ambiguous or evolving delivery environments. 

Team Leadership & Delivery Accountability

- Manage, mentor, and develop a high-performing quality engineering team, local or distributed, while remaining technically engaged. 
 - Own your team's delivery outcomes and guide day-to-day technical decisions. 
 - Coach team members, set technical direction, review automation code, and promote continuous learning and engineering discipline. 

Cross-Team Collaboration

- Collaborate across product, development, architecture, DevOps, security, and business teams to resolve dependencies and embed quality throughout the delivery lifecycle. 

Continuous Improvement & Capability Building

- Improve test coverage, automation maturity, and delivery efficiency over time. 
 - Champion quality engineering best practices, reusable standards, automation patterns, and shared assets that build team capability. 

Reporting & Insights

- Produce clear test outcome reports covering execution status, coverage, defect trends, residual risk, release recommendations, and improvement actions. 
 - Track meaningful quality metrics and deliver dashboards that identify systemic issues, improve predictability, and reduce escaped defects. 

Security, Accessibility & Compliance

- Embed secure, accessible, and compliant quality practices into delivery, including in regulated environments such as financial services, public sector, and healthcare. 

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related discipline. 
 - 12+ years of experience in test automation, SDET, or software quality engineering roles, with demonstrated ownership of complex automation programs. 
 - Proven experience leading quality engineering teams, managing priorities, mentoring engineers, and influencing delivery outcomes. 
 - Hands-on coding proficiency in at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, Python, or Java, with experience building automation frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, clean-code principles, reusable framework design, version control, and code reviews. 
 - Practical experience with Playwright or a comparable modern UI automation framework. 
 - Strong API testing and automation knowledge, including REST services, authentication, data validation, error handling, and service-level test design. 
 - Strong grounding in functional testing techniques, including requirements analysis, test design, boundary and negative testing, risk-based testing, regression testing, and defect lifecycle management. 
 - Experience with unit-testing frameworks and close collaboration with development teams to improve unit and component test coverage. 
 - Proven experience integrating testing into DevSecOps pipelines, including CI/CD, automated quality gates, reporting, source control, and artifact management. 
 - Strong experience in test strategy, test-data management, mocking, and observability. 
 - Ability to create effective test strategies and communicate concise, evidence-based test outcome reports to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, stakeholder-management, written communication, and cross-team collaboration skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in SAFe Agile or other scaled Agile environments. 
 - Strong understanding of GenAI in the SDLC, including prompting techniques and AI-augmented testing approaches. 
 - Experience with contract testing and advanced observability frameworks. 
 - Background in cross-platform application testing across web and mobile. 
 - Experience in compliance-heavy or regulated industries such as financial services, public sector, or healthcare. 
 - Experience contributing to quality engineering transformation or digital testing programs. 
 - Experience leading quality engineering across multiple products, platforms, or distributed teams. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy automation suites or transitioning to Playwright and AI-enabled testing approaches. 
 - Familiarity with non-functional quality areas such as performance, security, accessibility, reliability, and observability. 
 - Relevant testing, cloud, Agile, DevOps, or engineering certifications are an advantage. 

Leadership Competencies

- Lead with accountability, sound judgment, and a strong customer-focused quality mindset. 
 - Communicate quality risks, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to engineering leaders and business stakeholders. 
 - Build alignment across teams without relying solely on authority, and facilitate timely resolution of quality issues. 
 - Create an inclusive, collaborative environment that supports coaching, knowledge sharing, and sustainable delivery. 
 - Continuously improve processes while balancing speed, reliability, maintainability, and business value.

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

Position Description
We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join the Advanced Integration Builder team within Okta. This team builds and maintains the backend services, provisioning frameworks, authentication connectors, and next-generation Entitlement Management engines that let Okta customers secure, integrate, and govern access to thousands of third-party enterprise applications - from modern cloud platforms (Microsoft Office 365, Workday, Salesforce, AWS, ServiceNow) and AI agentic systems to legacy on-prem systems. As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design and implementation of integration components end-to-end: REST/SOAP API clients, OAuth2/SAML authentication flows, user and group provisioning/sync jobs, and the retry and rate-limiting logic required to operate reliably against dozens of idiosyncratic third-party vendor APIs at scale. This is a backend-intensive role - the large majority of your time will be spent in Java/Spring Boot services - but you'll also need decent frontend experience in React and JSP to build and extend the screens that surface integration configuration to customers

Job Duties and Responsibilities
- Feature Execution: Drive technical design and implementation of integration features - new app connectors, provisioning/sync capabilities, authentication flows - primarily in backend Java services, extending into React/JSP configuration screens. 
- Build and maintain REST/SOAP API clients, OAuth2/SAML authentication handlers , and vendor-specific exception/error-mapping layers for third-party SaaS and enterprise applications. 
- Implement and extend user/group provisioning adapters built on shared contracts and scheduled sync/import jobs that keep identity data consistent between Okta and external systems. 
- Resilience at Scale: Apply retry/backoff, rate-limiting, and pagination strategies to handle vendor API quirks, throttling, and intermittent failures gracefully across the dozens of concurrently supported integrations. 
- Security & Compliance: Ensure credential/secret handling, token exchange, and audit logging for provisioning operations meet Okta's security and compliance standards. 
- Product & Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with PMs, support, and technical leads to prioritize new app integrations, resolve customer-reported connectivity issues, and participate in technical interviews/recruiting. 
- Operational Excellence: Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues in integration pipelines, drive root-cause analyses, and improve observability/alerting for sync and provisioning jobs. 
- Code Quality & Technical Standards: Participate in code reviews, write thorough unit and functional tests, and maintain clear technical documentation. 
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
- Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience building and operating reliable, production-grade backend services. 
- Backend Expertise: Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot; comfortable owning services end-to-end from design through production support. 
- Distributed Systems: Experience with asynchronous job processing, scheduled/batch sync jobs, and event-driven patterns. 
- Data Management: Proficiency with relational databases (MySQL) and caching layers (Redis or similar). 
- Resilient Systems Design: Practical experience with retry/backoff strategies, rate-limiting, and handling pagination/throttling quirks from third-party APIs. 
- API Design: Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, including clients for third-party vendor systems with varying levels of API quality and documentation. 
- Problem Solving & Ownership: Ability to break down ambiguous integration requirements and independently drive a feature from design to production. 
- Decent Frontend Experience: While the role is backend-dominant, you should be comfortable building and modifying UI in React and JSP - well enough to independently deliver the frontend without relying on a dedicated frontend engineer. 
Nice to Haves
- Experience with identity/IAM standards (SCIM, SAML, OAuth, OIDC) or directory services (AD, LDAP). 
-Integration & Auth Protocols: Working knowledge of REST/SOAP API integration patterns and authentication standards such as OAuth2, SAML, or WS-Federation. 
- Exposure to legacy protocol support (SOAP-based provisioning services) alongside modern REST/OAuth integrations. 
- Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architectures or specialized compliance environments (e. g. , FedRAMP/GCC-High). 
- Experience with message brokers/queueing systems (Kafka) for asynchronous processing. 
- Exposure to HTTP mocking/test-server frameworks (e. g. , WireMock or equivalent internal mock-server tooling) for API-level testing.

DEVOPS Engineer (Observability Migration (Splunk → Datadog))

Remote

Notice Period: 30 Days

Key Responsibilities

Observability Migration (Splunk → Datadog)

- Execute discovery across the Splunk estate: data sources, ingestion paths (Universal/Heavy Forwarders, HEC, Firehose, syslog), volumes, props/transforms logic, content usage, and downstream consumers
 - Deploy and manage Datadog Agents at scale (EKS/Kubernetes via Helm, EC2/on-prem via config management) alongside existing Splunk forwarders in a dual-run model
 - Configure Datadog Observability Pipelines where required (in-network masking via Sensitive Data Scanner, filtering, routing)
 - Design and enforce the tagging taxonomy, RBAC/Teams model, log index tiers (hot/Flex/Archive), and cost guardrails
 - Migrate content: dashboards, monitors, and SIEM detections - using conversion accelerators, rebuilding complex SPL as Datadog queries/log-based metrics, deploying everything as Terraform (Datadog provider)
 - Build validation tooling comparing platforms (volume, quality, alert behavior) and run evidence-gated, per-account cutovers with tested rollbackAzure DevOps Migration (instance → instance)

- Inventory and migrate ADO projects across organizations/instances: repos, boards/work items (with history), pipelines, artifacts, service connections, variable groups, and permissions
 - Use and evaluate migration tooling (Azure DevOps Data Migration Tool, ADO REST APIs, third-party utilities); script gap-filling migrations via PowerShell/Python against the ADO API
 - Re-establish pipeline integrity post-migration: service connections, agent pools, secrets (Key Vault integration), and approvals/policies
 - Plan cutover with freeze windows, validation checklists, and rollback for in-flight workGitHub & GitOps

- Migrate repositories to GitHub (Enterprise/Cloud) preserving history, branches, tags, and where feasible PR metadata; map ADO/legacy permissions to GitHub teams and CODEOWNERS
 - Stand up GitHub Actions CI/CD (or integrate with existing pipelines), reusable workflows, environments, and OIDC-based cloud authentication
 - Implement GitOps delivery patterns: infrastructure and platform configuration as code (Terraform), PR-based change management, drift detection, and automated deployment via Actions/Argo CD/Flux (as applicable)
 - Define branch protection, secret scanning, and repository governance standardsRequired Skills & Experience

- 6+ years in DevOps/Platform/SRE roles with at least one large-scale platform migration delivered end-to-end
 - Observability: hands-on Splunk administration (SPL, forwarder architecture, props/transforms, HEC) and Datadog (Agent, log pipelines, monitors, APM basics); understanding of OpenTelemetry
 - IaC: strong Terraform (modules, state management, provider ecosystems - Datadog provider a plus)
 - Azure DevOps: deep familiarity with projects, boards, YAML pipelines, and the ADO REST API; prior org-to-org migration experience strongly preferred
 - GitHub: Actions, branch protection, GitHub API/CLI, enterprise administration; GitOps tooling (Argo CD/Flux) experience valued
 - Automation: proficient in Python and/or PowerShell for API-driven tooling; Bash; config management (Ansible/Chef/Helm)
 - Cloud: AWS (EKS, EC2, Kinesis Firehose, S3, IAM) - Azure familiarity a plus
 - Comfortable with change management, evidence-based cutover practices, and writing runbooks/rollback procedures

data.title: QA Automation Lead
data.description:
We're looking for a QA Automation Lead who enjoys owning product quality end-to-end and building a full testing platform, not just browser automation. 

You'll lead quality engineering across frontend, backend, APIs and integrations: test strategy, automation frameworks, CI gates and release confidence. This role is for someone who wants to do more than write UI scripts or file bugs after the fact. You'll design the quality system across every layer, raise engineering standards, and have real ownership over how we know a release is safe. 

What you'll do 🛠️

- Own quality strategy from risk assessment through automation, CI enforcement and release readiness. 
 - Design a layered test strategy across unit, component, API, contract, integration, smoke, sanity, regression and end-to-end testing, plus accessibility, performance and visual checks where valuable. 
 - Build and scale reliable automation for UI, API and service layers (Playwright, API frameworks, unit/component runners). 
 - Decide which layer owns which risk: keep E2E thin and push most coverage down to unit, API and contract tests. 
 - Set up CI/CD quality gates: PR checks, post-deploy smoke, nightly regression, and a clear process for fixing flaky tests. 
 - Own test data, environments, fixtures and mocks so automation is reproducible from local to staging. 
 - Partner with product and engineering on acceptance criteria, edge cases and risk-based test plans before features ship. 
 - Drive release confidence with smoke, sanity, E2E and regression signals that engineers trust for go/no-go decisions. 
 - Reduce flakiness ruthlessly and keep CI green. 
 - Track meaningful quality metrics (escape rate, flake rate, suite runtime, critical-path coverage), not vanity dashboards. 
 - Join architecture and design reviews to flag testability, failure modes and contract boundaries early. 
 - Mentor QA and engineers on testable code and shared ownership of quality, and help hire and grow the QA/SDET team. 

What we're looking for 🔎

- 5+ years in QA automation or SDET roles, including leading or owning an automation or quality platform. 
 - Hands-on experience across multiple test types, not only browser E2E. 
 - Strong grasp of the test pyramid and when E2E is the wrong tool. 
 - A track record of making flaky suites reliable and keeping CI trustworthy. 
 - Strong debugging skills across UI, network, APIs, services, auth, data and environments. 
 - Good understanding of web and backend architecture: REST APIs, auth/sessions, async jobs and service boundaries. 
 - Ability to risk-rank what to test, at which layer, and what can wait. 
 - Clear written communication: bug reports, test plans and failure analysis engineers can act on. 
 - Experience mentoring others and raising quality standards across engineering. 
 - Comfort with ambiguity, and an ownership mindset that chases failures to root cause. 

Nice to have ✨

- Deep Playwright experience (fixtures, tracing, parallelization, auth setups)
 - Unit/component testing: Vitest, Jest, React Testing Library, pytest, JUnit
 - API testing: Postman/Newman, REST Assured, Supertest, k6
 - Contract testing: Pact, OpenAPI/JSON Schema validation
 - Integration testing against PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka or similar
 - Visual regression, accessibility and performance testing
 - CI/CD with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, Docker and ephemeral test environments
 - Reporting with Allure, Playwright or JUnit reports
 - TypeScript, JavaScript, Python or Go for automation frameworks
 - Familiarity with React/Next. js frontends and REST/event-driven backends
 - Testing complex B2B SaaS workflows (multi-tenant, roles/permissions, long-running jobs)
 - Security-minded testing (authorization gaps, IDOR, secrets in logs)
 - Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup

What we value 🧭

- Quality ownership over QA handoffs: we fix the root cause and prevent the class of failure. 
 - Full-stack quality over browser-only automation: E2E is one tool, not the strategy. 
 - Signal over suite size: fifty reliable tests beat a thousand flaky ones. 
 - Shift-left over late discovery: the cheapest bug is the one that never ships. 
 - Risk-based testing over exhaustive theater: protect critical journeys, push the rest down the pyramid. 
 - Determinism over "just rerun it": flaky tests are defects, and we fix them. 
 - Release confidence over test count: the goal is shipping valuable software safely. This is a high-ownership leadership role with real influence over release quality, automation platforms and engineering culture. 

Probably skip 🚫

- You want a manual-only or browser-only automation role with no interest in API, unit or contract testing. 
 - You measure success by test cases written rather than bugs prevented and CI trust. 
 - You accept flaky tests as normal and tell people to "just rerun. "
 - You only test happy paths and ignore auth, permissions, edge cases and failure modes. 
 - You're uncomfortable reading logs, network traces, API responses or code. 
 - You want to be a gatekeeper who blocks releases without helping fix quality. 
 - You rely on AI-generated selectors and scripts without understanding why they flake. 
 - You're uncomfortable with ambiguity, changing priorities or early-stage startup constraints. 

How to apply? 🧑🏻💻

Send your resume and a short note on why you're a great fit to careers@phinite. ai with the subject line "QA Automation Lead - [Your Name]"

data.title: Lead DevOps Engineer (AI & GPU)
data.description:
Zimperium is a global leader in AI-empowered mobile security, delivering purpose-built protection for mobile applications and devices against advanced threats such as mobile phishing, malware, app vulnerabilities, tampering, device compromise, and zero-day attacks. As cybercriminals increasingly adopt a mobile-first attack strategy, Zimperium enables organizations to detect and stop mobile threats while gaining clear visibility into mobile risk. The company's autonomous security solutions help safeguard critical mobile infrastructures and the sensitive data of organizations and their customers. 

As part of our fast-growing pace, we are seeking an AI Systems Engineer to own the delivery, model-serving, routing, and observability layer of AI-native platform. These are the systems that ship, run, and make fully visible every AI workload. Within the Hybrid AI Multi-Environment Runtime, this role owns how AI services and agents are built and deployed, how models execute, how requests are routed to them, how AI assets are catalogued and governed, how consumption is measured and bounded, and how the entire platform is observed across cloud, on-prem, edge, and air-gapped environments. 

This role owns the delivery and runtime surface, including the CI/CD/CV pipelines that ship AI workloads, secure model execution, semantic routing, and model/prompt selection, together with the governance, discovery, cost, and telemetry systems that keep AI workloads shippable, economical, discoverable, and transparent. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who is equally comfortable building automated delivery pipelines, operating high-performance inference (GPUs, model servers, sandboxed execution), and building deep observability and cost visibility; who understands that in regulated contexts every AI workload must be delivered repeatedly and every AI request must be economically bounded, attributable, and traceable end-to-end. 

Responsibilities: 

- Own DevOps and delivery for AI workloads: build and operate the CI/CD/CV pipelines that ship AI services, agents, and runtime components, including automated build, test, continuous verification, release, and rollback, so AI workloads are delivered repeatedly and safely into every environment. 
 - Own governance and discovery for AI assets, including service catalog/registry (Artifactory/Nexus, Harbor), experiment tracking and model metadata (MLflow), upstream registries/mirrors (HuggingFace/NGC), CVE/SBOM scanning (Trivy), lineage contracts (OpenLineage), and license management. 
 - Own resource and cost management, including quotas and rate limits, cost attribution and utilization (Apptio/OpenCost/Kubecost), so AI execution stays economically bounded and controllable per tenant and engagement. 
 - Own the full observability stack, including metrics (Prometheus/Mimir), logs (Loki), traces (Tempo/Jaeger), dashboards (Grafana), LLM debugging and evaluation (LangSmith/Langfuse), and SLA/alert notifications. 
 - Own the OpenTelemetry collection layer, including multi-tenant receiver, exporters and queues (Kafka sink), DCGM exporter for GPU telemetry, processor batching, and dynamic filtering, so every signal is captured and routed reliably. 
 - Automate GitOps-based delivery and continuous verification; embedding quality, integrity, and cost gates into pipelines so releases are policy-compliant by default rather than by manual review. 
 - Close the loop between delivery and observability by using telemetry, evaluation, and cost signals to drive deployment decisions, progressive rollout, and automated rollback of AI workloads. 
 - Ensure cost and telemetry are identity-stamped and per-tenant, so consumption and behavior are attributable end-to-end, keeping FinOps and observability tied to the workloads that generate the load. 

Requirements: 

- Strong DevOps expertise: CI/CD/CV pipeline design, GitOps, continuous verification, and progressive/automated release and rollback for production workloads. 
 - Deep expertise operating model-serving and inference systems (Ray, vLLM/Triton/NIM) on GPUs at production scale. 
 - Deep observability skills: metrics, logs, traces, and OpenTelemetry. 
 - FinOps mindset: able to attribute, bound, and optimize AI consumption cost per tenant and workload. 
 - Familiarity with model/artifact governance, registries, CVE scanning, and license/lineage tracking. 
 - Comfortable operating across cloud, on-prem, edge, and air-gapped environments with consistent runtime and telemetry semantics. 
 - Strong communicator able to explain runtime, cost, and observability tradeoffs to engineers, architects, and leadership. 

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related technical field. 
 - 8+ years in DevOps, MLOps, platform, or observability engineering, with hands-on production ownership of AI or high-throughput services. 
 - Strong hands-on DevOps experience, including CI/CD/CV pipelines and GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Helm, GitHub Actions/GitLab CI, or equivalents) for automated build, test, release, and rollback. 
 - Hands-on expertise operating inference/model-serving frameworks (Ray Serve, vLLM, Triton, or NIM) on GPU infrastructure. 
 - Strong experience with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo/Jaeger) and OpenTelemetry. 
 - Experience with API gateways and request routing (Envoy or equivalent), including streaming responses. 
 - Experience with cost management / FinOps tooling (OpenCost, Kubecost, or equivalent) and quota/rate-limit enforcement. 
 - Familiarity with model/artifact registries and supply-chain scanning (Harbor, MLflow, Trivy/SBOM). 
 - Proven track record operating AI or service infrastructure under compliance, security, or regulatory constraints. 
 - Ability to define clean ownership boundaries and consumption contracts with platform, trust, and data teams. 

Nice to Have: 

- Experience with LLM evaluation and debugging tooling (LangSmith, Langfuse) and prompt/response quality measurement. 
 - Experience with sandboxed/secure execution (gVisor, Firecracker, or microVM isolation) for untrusted or multi-tenant workloads. 
 - Familiarity with GPU telemetry (DCGM) and GPU utilization optimization. 
 - Experience with lineage and governance contracts (OpenLineage) and AI license management. 
 - Exposure to multi-tenant cost attribution and per-tenant SLA/alerting. 
 - Exposure to regulated delivery environments (financial services, tax, healthcare, risk). 

Zimperium is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

data.title: Lead QA Engineer
data.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

Qualys is looking for a Lead QA Engineer to own quality for products in the Cybersecurity and Compliance domain used by thousands of enterprise customers. 

You will act as a senior individual contributor and technical mentor for QA and automation engineers. You will define the test strategy across UI, backend, and data pipelines, and drive the move toward AI-assisted, self-healing automation. This is a hands-on technical role: you set quality direction, influence release decisions, and actively write and review framework code. Candidates who have built or meaningfully enhanced AI-based self-healing automation tools will stand out. 

Responsibilities

QA Mentorship & Strategy

- Mentor and guide QA and automation engineers through technical coaching, code reviews, and knowledge sharing. 
 - Define and own the end-to-end test strategy for legacy components by improving automation coverage, while ensuring all new components are fully automated from the start. 
 - Act as the quality voice in sprint planning, design reviews, and release readiness; make data-backed go/no-go recommendations. 
 - Establish scalable QA processes: defect triage, severity/priority standards, regression tiers, test case management, and root-cause analysis for escaped defects. 
 - Track and report quality metrics (defect leakage, automation coverage, flaky-test rate, mean time to detect, release cycle time) to engineering and product leadership. 
 - Partner closely with Development, Product, Support, and Sustenance teams to shift quality left and reduce customer-reported issues. 

Test Automation (Hands-On)

- Architect and evolve automation frameworks across React/TypeScript front ends, Java/Spring Boot microservices, REST APIs, and Kafka-based pipelines. 
 - Own API and contract testing (REST Assured, Pact, Postman/Newman) covering OAuth2, JWT, token, and Basic auth flows, pagination, throttling, and vendor error handling. 
 - Own CI/CD quality gates in Jenkins or GitHub Actions with fast PR-level feedback and tiered regression runs. 

AI-Driven & Self-Healing Automation

- Lead the design and rollout of self-healing automation: automatic locator recovery, DOM-similarity scoring, element fingerprinting, and confidence-based fallback that keeps suites green through UI changes. 
 - Apply LLMs across the QA lifecycle - generating test cases from requirements and API specs, converting manual tests to automated scripts, summarizing failures, and suggesting root causes from logs. 
 - Build intelligent flaky-test detection, failure classification, and auto-quarantine to separate real regressions from environmental noise. 
 - Set guardrails for AI use in QA - validating AI-generated tests, measuring healing accuracy, and preventing false passes. 

Qualifications

Experience

- 8-10+ years in QA / test engineering, with at least 2 years leading or mentoring a QA team. 
 - Proven track record of building automation frameworks from scratch and owning release quality for a SaaS product. 
 - Hands-on experience building, extending, or productionizing an AI-based or self-healing automation solution, with the ability to explain how you measured its impact. 

Skills

Automation & Testing

- Robot, Playwright and/or Selenium 4; TestNG or JUnit 5; Cypress, Jest, or Vitest
 - API automation: REST Assured, Postman/Newman, schema validation
 - Contract testing (Pact), service virtualization, and mocking (WireMock or similar)
 - Performance testing with JMeter, k6, or Gatling
 - Visual regression and accessibility testing

Programming & Backend

- Python, Java(17+) and JavaScript/TypeScript
 - SQL and data validation on Oracle or similar
 - Familiarity with microservices, Spring Boot, and Kafka (or other event streaming systems)

AI in QA

- Self-healing locator strategies and intelligent element matching
 - LLM integration: prompt design, structured outputs, and embedding model calls into test tooling
 - AI-assisted test generation, failure clustering, and log/trace summarization
 - Familiarity with RAG or vector search over test artifacts is a plus
 - Working knowledge of AI testing platforms (Healenium, Applitools, mabl, Testim)

DevOps & Tooling

- CI/CD with Jenkins or GitHub Actions
 - Docker and Kubernetes fundamentals
 - Test management (Jira/Xray, TestRail, or Zephyr)
 - Observability tools (Grafana, Prometheus, ELK) for test and pipeline diagnostics

Technical Mentorship

- Strong ability to mentor engineers through technical guidance and code reviews
 - Clear communication with engineering, product, and leadership stakeholders
 - Data-driven decision-making on quality and release readiness

Preferred

- Background in cybersecurity - vulnerability management, Policy Compliance
 - Experience testing multi-tenant SaaS at large data volumes. 
 - Open-source contributions to testing or automation projects.

data.title: Software Engineering PMTS (Apache, Kafka, Terraform)
data.description:
Description

You will be a Principal Engineer (PMTS) leading the Monitoring Cloud Events team in Hyderabad, India. Our team builds systems that handle huge amounts of data for Salesforce. We make sure everything in our cloud runs the way it should. In this role, your job is to guide the team, build great software, and own the services we create from start to finish. 

What You'll Actually Be Doing

- Day-to-day work: You will build and maintain an Observability stack using in-house, open source and cloud managed services and run data pipelines (ETL) and use big data tools. You will check system health and fix problems quickly so our services stay online. 
 - Leading the way: You will teach and mentor other engineers to help them grow and do their best work. 
 - Working together: You will talk to partners and customers all over the world to make sure they get what they need. 
 - Long-term goals & impact: You will make our cloud faster, safer, and easier to use for millions of people. You will learn how to run big, global systems and become a top leader in the tech world. 

Tech Stack

- Cloud & Compute: AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) for stateless, scalable multi-cloud orchestration. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Terraform for resilient, automated platform provisioning across environments. 
 - Edge Ingestion: OpenTelemetry (OTel) for standardized instrumentation, and Vector/Fluent Bit for high-throughput log routing. 
 - Message Buffering: Apache Kafka to ingest billions of telemetry events, ensuring durable, decoupled data pipelines. 
 - Stream Processing: Apache Flink for real-time log parsing, rolling aggregations, and anomaly detection before storage. 
 - Backend Languages: Java for building heavy stream-processing applications, supplemented by Go and Python for operators and tooling. 
 - Ad-Hoc OLAP Analytics: Apache Druid to power sub-second, interactive dashboard queries over massive historical datasets. 
 - Log & Trace Storage: ClickHouse for fast columnar event storage, natively tiered to AWS S3 / GCP Cloud Storage for cost-effective cold storage. 
 - Time-Series Metrics: VictoriaMetrics, M3DB, or Prometheus to ingest and compress millions of high-cardinality metric rollups. 
 - Visualization & Alerting: Grafana and Apache Superset for single-pane-of-glass UI, paired with Prometheus Alertmanager for incident routing. 

You're Our Person If. . . 

- You have deep experience building software and leading engineering teams. 
 - You know how to move, store, and work with very large amounts of data. 
 - You are highly skilled at building ETL data pipelines. 
 - You have hands-on experience with open-source tools like Kafka, Flink, and Apache Druid. 
 - You are a kind and helpful mentor to other engineers. 
 - You are a great "service owner, " meaning you care deeply about keeping systems online and running smoothly. 

Even Better If. . . 

- You have worked on an Observability stack before (tools that monitor system health and logs). 
 - You have experience working with global teams across different countries and time zones. 
 - You enjoy talking directly to customers to understand and solve their problems. 

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

data.title: Software Development Mgmt 5
data.description:
About The Team / Role

As a Director, Data Platform Engineering, you will be the primary leader and visionary for the core data infrastructure that powers the entire enterprise. This is a "platform-as-a-product" role; your mission is to lead the team building the internal foundation-creating the high-performance engines, abstraction layers, and self-service frameworks that enable hundreds of other engineers to move faster. You will manage a team operating at the intersection of Systems Programming and Data Engineering, solving "hard-tech" problems like automated schema evolution, multi-engine compute optimization, and global data discovery. As a top-level technical leader, you will bridge the gap between long-term business strategy and engineering execution, ensuring WEX's data platform remains a competitive advantage. 

Is this role for you?

- YES, if: You are an Engineering Manager or Lead Backend/Software Engineer who loves leading teams that solve "Big Data" problems, build APIs for data discovery, and optimize distributed systems. 
 - NO, if: Your primary expertise is managing teams that write SQL queries, build Tableau dashboards, or manage ETL workflows without deep experience in Java or Python system architecture. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Strategic Roadmap & Sovereignty: Define and execute the 3-5 year technical roadmap for the Data Lakehouse. You will guide your team in deciding how storage, compute, and metadata layers (e. g. , Apache Polaris, Unity Catalog or Datahub Catalog) interact at an elemental level. 
 - Platform-as-a-Product Delivery: Lead the development of internal SDKs, CLI tools, and automated orchestration frameworks. Your goal is to ensure your team abstracts away cloud complexity via Control Planes and Custom Operators, allowing Data Engineers to focus on business logic rather than infrastructure boilerplate. 
 - Internal R&D Management: Champion and resource prototyping and benchmarking of emerging technologies (e. g. , specialized Spark extensions) to keep the platform at the bleeding edge of performance and cost-efficiency. 
 - Global Governance & Security: Oversee the architecture of "compliance-by-design" systems. Ensure the team automates data lineage, PII masking, and fine-grained access control across petabyte-scale environments without sacrificing developer velocity. 
 - AI Governance Lake: Facilitate real-time data ingestion by implementing streaming support for Open Telemetry data from AI Agents into the Data Lake, drive the development of advanced AI evaluation metrics and reporting. 
 - Engineering Excellence & Delivery: Set the gold standard for code quality and system design across the company. You will oversee Cross-Functional Architecture Reviews and ensure your team effectively resolves the most complex system outages or performance bottlenecks. 
 - Team Leadership & Mentorship: Hire, mentor, and grow a world-class engineering team. Foster an "Engineering Community, " influencing the hiring bar and professional development paths for the entire data engineering organization. 

Experience You Will Bring

- Experience: 15+ years in software engineering and distributed systems, with at least 4 years of experience managing high-performing engineering teams delivering platform-scale initiatives. 
 - Core Technical Competencies (Software Engineering Focus): 
 - Strong Software Foundations: Deep understanding of software engineering, system architecture, and scalable production applications (Algorithms, Data Structures, and System Design). Experience in the Java/J2EE ecosystem (Spring Boot, Microservices) and Python. We are looking for a leader who ensures their team writes clean, testable, and high-performance code, not just scripts. 
 - Data as a Product: Experience managing or building the platforms / framework engines and APIs that power data movement, rather than just building the ETL/ELT pipelines themselves. 
 - Data Lakehouse Mastery: 
 - Deep understanding of Apache Iceberg, Hudi, or Delta Lake (metadata management, manifest files, and compaction strategies). 
 - Experience managing teams contributing to or deeply customizing open-source data projects (e. g. , Spark, dbt). 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: 
 - Extensive experience with cloud architecture and services, including AWS (S3, EMR, Kubernetes, Lambda) and Azure. 
 - Deep understanding of CI/CD automation, modern development tools, Git Actions, Terraform and frameworks. 
 - AI-Driven Development & Productivity: 
 - AI Native Development: Experience leveraging AI Code Gen platforms into the software development lifecycle (SDLC) to automate code generation, reviews, generate unit tests, and perform root-cause analysis of system failures. 
 - LLM-Ops for Platform: Ability to guide the architecture of infrastructure required to support AI Agent development by enabling vector database integration. 
 - Leadership & Vision: 
 - Proven track record of driving adoption of new technologies across multiple autonomous teams. 
 - Ability to communicate complex architectural trade-offs (e. g. , "Latency vs. Consistency" or "Build vs. Buy") to C-suite executives and engineering teams alike. 
 - Education: 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science (Distributed Systems focus) preferred, or equivalent deep industry experience.

data.title: Software Engineering PMTS - Cloud Infra & Security
data.description:
Description

Come join our growing Hyperforce Enterprise Security organization. We are chartered with architecting, implementing, and operating security solutions that protect Salesforce's complex, multi-cloud technology landscape at scale. 

As a Principal Member of Technical Staff, you will provide technical leadership in building the next generation of infrastructure security and developer security guardrails. You will work across the software development and deployment lifecycle to identify security risks early, build scalable controls, and enable secure-by-default engineering practices without compromising developer velocity. 

Our team operates at the intersection of cloud security, application security, infrastructure security, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and runtime security. We build and operate security guardrails that identify and prevent high-risk security issues from source code and Infrastructure as Code through CI/CD and into runtime environments. 

You will be expected to operate at both strategic and hands-on technical levels, defining architecture and technical direction while also diving deeply into complex engineering problems, writing production-quality code, and driving solutions from concept through deployment and operation. 

This role is an opportunity to shape security capabilities that operate at significant scale across Salesforce infrastructure and to influence how security is embedded throughout the engineering lifecycle. 

Responsibilities

- Act as a technical leader and subject matter expert for infrastructure security and security guardrails, providing architectural direction across teams. 
 - Design and build scalable shift-left security capabilities that identify security risks in source code, Infrastructure as Code, containerized workloads, and deployment configurations before they reach production. 
 - Architect and build shift-left security controls that identify security risks early while providing developers with actionable findings and straightforward remediation paths. 
 - Design scalable policy-as-code and security enforcement frameworks for consistent security controls across multiple gates and environments. 
 - Drive risk-based security engineering by identifying exploitable, high-impact, and meaningful security risks rather than treating all scanner findings equally. 
 - Design mechanisms for security finding correlation, prioritization, deduplication, and enforcement when signals originate from multiple security systems. 
 - Lead architecture and implementation of Kubernetes admission control and workload security capabilities. 
 - Define technical strategies for reliability, scalability, performance, observability, fault tolerance, and operational readiness of security services. 
 - Establish and evolve SLIs, SLOs, telemetry, rollout strategies, and operational practices for critical security services. 
 - Own technical outcomes across the complete lifecycle - requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, production readiness, rollout, and ongoing operations. 
 - Continuously identify opportunities to improve security coverage, automation, detection quality, enforcement, and developer experience. 
 - Establish engineering standards and best practices for reliability, scalability, observability, testing, and operational readiness of security services. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar across the organization. 
 - Influence technical strategy and roadmap decisions across teams and drive initiatives from concept through production. 
 - Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow by pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high-quality code. 
 - Design and orchestrate complex systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale. 
 - Contribute to building and maintaining the shared system context, an explicit repository of system designs, constraints, and standards that enables AI to operate accurately and reliably. 
 - Critically evaluate code (human or AI-generated) for correctness, quality, security, and performance. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field involving software/systems engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 15+ years of software engineering, systems engineering, security engineering with significant experience designing and delivering large-scale production systems. 
 - Strong programming experience in one or more languages such as Go, Java, or Python, with the ability to design, implement, debug, and review production-quality systems. 
 - Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure and cloud security, including experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native infrastructure. 
 - Strong understanding of CI/CD architecture and DevSecOps, including deployment pipelines, security gates, policy enforcement, and automation. 
 - Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, Helm, CloudFormation, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience designing distributed, highly scalable, reliable, and secure systems. 
 - Strong understanding of security engineering concepts including vulnerability management, configuration security, policy enforcement, workload security, identity/access controls, and risk assessment. 
 - Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous security problems, identify the core technical challenge, and drive an architecture and implementation to completion. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex architectures and trade-offs to senior technical and business audiences. 
 - Preferred Qualifications
 - Deep experience in cloud-native security, DevSecOps, infrastructure security, or application security. 
 - Experience building security platforms/services or guardrails that operate at large enterprise scale. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes Admission Controllers, admission policies, OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, or similar policy enforcement technologies. 
 - Experience with policy-as-code and security-as-code frameworks. 
 - Experience with IaC security and tools such as Checkov, OPA, Terraform security scanning, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of container and workload security, including Seccomp, Linux security mechanisms, container isolation, and runtime security. 
 - Experience building systems that correlate security signals from multiple sources and prioritize findings based on risk, exploitability, exposure, and business impact. 
 - Experience with vulnerability management, cloud security posture management, container security, or automated security remediation. 
 - Experience designing developer-facing security products with a strong focus on actionable findings, low friction remediation, and developer experience. 
 - Experience designing security controls across the complete lifecycle: source → IaC → CI/CD → deployment → admission → runtime. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud networking, identity, workload architecture, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience driving technical strategy across multiple engineering organizations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to identify new security opportunities and turn them into scalable engineering solutions. 
 - Experience mentoring senior engineers and serving as a technical leader for complex, multi-team initiatives. 
 - A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering - using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty. 
 - Experience using AI tools (e. g. , Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc. ) in development workflows. 
 - Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will be expected to: 

- Raise the technical bar for infrastructure and developer security engineering. 
 - Build security controls that are effective, scalable, reliable, and developer-friendly. 
 - Move security closer to the point where risks are introduced through strong shift-left and automated enforcement. 
 - Improve the ability to distinguish noise from meaningful and exploitable risk. 
 - Establish consistent security coverage and enforcement across the software delivery lifecycle. 
 - Drive complex initiatives from architecture and design through implementation, production deployment, and operational maturity. 
 - Identify gaps in the current security landscape and proactively develop innovative solutions to address them.

As a Principal Engineering Manager on the GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES) Release team, you will lead the team responsible for critical parts of the GHES release pipeline. This includes OS and container builds across the platform, infrastructure, and application layers; package generation and certification; integration test environments; and distribution of release artifacts through Azure, AWS, and GCP. 

In this role, you will define technical and operational priorities for the team, drive execution across a complex release surface, and partner across engineering organizations to ensure GHES ships as a high-quality, secure, and dependable appliance for enterprise customers. 

Responsibilities

- Lead, grow, and develop a team of engineers responsible for GHES release systems, validation environments, and package delivery workflows. 
 - Own the engineering roadmap for GHES release systems, balancing reliability, velocity, operational health, and long-term platform investments. 
 - Drive execution across build, package generation, validation, certification, and customer delivery workflows for GHES releases. 
 - Ensure the team delivers reliable, representative, and scalable integration test environments that support continuous validation of GHES releases. 
 - Drive improvements in CI quality, signal reliability, issue detection, and triage, partnering across teams to improve release readiness and reduce time to resolution. 
 - Partner with engineering leaders across platform, infrastructure, application, and release teams to improve release readiness, debugging, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Establish and drive standards for release reliability, observability, compliance, and operational excellence across build, release, and certification workflows. 
 - Set investment priorities for the GHES Release team, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term improvements in reliability, efficiency, and engineering velocity. 
 - Build an inclusive, high-performing team culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous improvement. 
 - Ensure strong operational ownership of release infrastructure, including clear accountability, effective incident response, and continuous improvement following critical issues. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- 9+ years' experience in software engineering, computer science, or related technical discipline 
 - Proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, Go, Ruby, Rust, Python, JavaScript, C, C++, C#, Java, 
 - 3+ years' experience leading engineering teams delivering complex infrastructure, platform, release, or validation systems. 
 - Experience setting technical direction and driving execution across multiple engineers or teams in a complex cross-functional environment. 
 - Proven ability to hire, coach, and develop engineers while maintaining high standards for technical quality and operational excellence. 
 - Proven ability to partner across organizations, align stakeholders, and improve reliability, delivery predictability, and engineering effectiveness for business-critical systems. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, or related field

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience managing teams responsible for release engineering, build systems, CI/CD, or validation infrastructure. 
 - Experience leading teams that support enterprise, on-prem, or appliance-based software delivery. 
 - Experience driving strategy and execution across multiple dependent engineering teams. 
 - Experience building organizational capability through coaching, hiring, and team design. 
 - Experience partnering across platform, infrastructure, application, and release organizations in a highly cross-functional environment. 
 - Experience improving operational health, reliability, and delivery predictability for business-critical engineering systems. 
 - Experience establishing strong operating rhythms, prioritization processes, and execution mechanisms for complex engineering areas. 
 - Experience leading teams through ambiguity and driving alignment across stakeholders with differing priorities.

data.title: Lead Software Engineer, Python/Flask
data.description:
Description

We support 800+ engineers, so every tool, script, and deployment you create can affect hundreds of developers. We are looking for someone who thrives in large-scale engineering environments and can own automation end-to-end with minimal supervision. 

You'll be part of a team that builds and maintains internal applications and data platforms that help sales, engineering, operations, and leadership teams work more effectively. 

Your work will have a direct impact on how teams access information, plan resources, and make business decisions. You will: 

- Build reliable business applications that ensure important sales and operational data is captured, maintained, and easily accessible. 
 - Improve workforce and resource planning by developing tools that help teams manage requests, assignments, staffing, and operational activities. 
 - Work with large-scale data and integrations, connecting information across multiple systems and making it available through useful applications and dashboards. 
 - Automate and simplify business processes by replacing manual or disconnected workflows with scalable, user-friendly solutions. 
 - Enable better decision-making by providing leaders and teams with accurate, timely data for forecasting, planning, and reporting. 
 - Develop intelligent capabilities such as recommendations, data matching, notifications, and AI-assisted workflows that improve productivity and data quality. 

What You'll Actually Be Doing

- Design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade platforms supporting hundreds of engineers. 
 - Own Infrastructure as Code across AWS, Azure, and GCP via containerization. 
 - Build scalable Python microservices and internal platforms using Flask. 
 - Develop and maintain production-quality self service apps within the platform. 
 - Design secure REST APIs with authentication, authorization, observability, and monitoring. 
 - Integrate enterprise applications using Informatica IICS (CDI, CAI) and rapidly adopt additional integration modules. 
 - Build highly available containerized services using Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Troubleshoot production issues across networking, cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD pipelines, APIs, and enterprise integrations. 
 - Partner with architects and engineering leadership to improve platform reliability and developer productivity. 
 - Mentor engineers and establish engineering best practices. 

You're Our Person If. . . 

- 10+ years of Total experience
 - 5+ years of Flask development (Python)
 - Certified in at least one of the hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake) and 3+ years of relevant experience
 - Preferred experience of 3+ years in DevOps / Cloud Operations / Application Maintenance

Even Better If. . . 

- Exposure to DevSecOps practices, including secrets management, IAM policy configuration, vulnerability remediation, and policy automation
 - Experience using and driving AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot)

Job Summary

A Quality Engineer (QE) is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining quality standards, procedures, and systems to ensure products or services meet customer, safety, and regulatory requirements. data.title: Team Lead - Fund Accounting
data.description:
About Us

WHY LINEDATA ?

Join us in shaping the fintech of tomorrow. 

With more than 1, 350 colleagues across 20 locations worldwide, you'll help build cutting-edge platforms and tailored services that power the daily operations of 700 leading financial institutions. As a global, multicultural company with over 45 nationalities represented and just as many languages spoken, we thrive on diverse perspectives and collaboration. Together, we tackle future-focused topics like Al and the digitalization of finance, delivering smart solutions for our customers. 

Whether you're just beginning your career or are an experienced professional, Linedata offers exposure to large-scale client projects, internal mobility and opportunities to develop your skills alongside leading experts. 

Position Responsibilities

The role will involve the following critical activities: 

- Supervise preparation and review of fund financial statements, loan schedules, NAVs, and investor capital account summaries. 
 - Review journal entries, loan-level accruals, amortization schedules, and general ledger maintenance. 
 - Ensure compliance with GAAP/IFRS and Private Credit-specific accounting policies. 
 - Oversee calculation of management fees, performance fees, carried interest, and fund operating expenses. 
 - Review monthly/quarterly valuation of loans, including interest PIK accruals, OID amortization, prepayment calculations, and impairment assessments. 
 - Oversee daily/periodic loan servicing activities such as interest accruals, cash movements, repayments, drawdowns, and roll-forwards. 
 - Review credit facility accounting (revolvers, term loans, subscription lines, and leverage facilities). 
 - Monitor covenant compliance tracking and SOFR/LIBOR updates for floating-rate loans. 
 - Ensure accurate setup and maintenance of loan investment data, pricing, and valuation inputs. 
 - Lead preparation and review of investor statements, capital account allocations, and performance reporting. 
 - Oversee capital calls, distributions, equalizations, and allocation of income, fees, and expenses. 
 - Maintain and review investor capital accounts, waterfall models, and performance calculations. 
 - Liaise with investor relations teams and respond to investor queries. 
 - Manage, guide, and mentor a team of analysts and senior associates. 
 - Delegate tasks effectively, set priorities, and track delivery against KPIs. 
 - Conduct training and development sessions to enhance team capabilities. 
 - Drive process automation, standardization, and efficiency improvements. 
 - Ensure strong internal controls and issue remediation plans. 
 - Coordinate with auditors, fund administrators, and internal control teams during audits. 
 - Ensure all documentation, checklists, and reconciliations meet compliance requirements. 
 - Identify and mitigate operational risks proactively. 

Looking For

Must Have: 

- Qualified Accountant or equivalent. 
 - CA with 4+ years' experience in Fund Accounting OR MBA (Finance) with 6+ years' experience. 
 - Strong understanding of fund accounting principles including NAV calculation, income accruals, loan valuation, amortization (OID/Premium/Discount), and pricing. 
 - Experience in Private Credit / Direct Lending / Loan Accounting (Term Loans, Mezzanine, Senior Secured Loans, Revolvers). 
 - Ability to compute and review interest accruals, PIK interest, commitment fees, prepayment penalties, and amortization schedules. 
 - Experience with accounting tools, general ledger systems, loan servicing platforms. 
 - Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills. 
 - Strong MS Office skills. 
 - Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. 

Good To Have

- Experience with WSO, eFront, Investran, Geneva, or similar systems. 
 - Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, formulas, basic macros). 
 - Strong analytical, leadership, and organizational abilities. 
 - Experience managing multiple deliverables in a deadline-driven environment.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Robotics Lead Validation Engineer

About The Role

Join AMD's PAVS team as a Robotics Developer experience Usecases Validation Engineer where you will Validate and Execute diverse Robotics platforms, variants and customer usecases for advanced robotics systems across software, hardware, and integrated platforms. Your work will ensure safety, reliability, and performance through rigorous testing in simulation, Gazebo, Isaac sim, SIL/HIL environments, and real-world deployments. 

Key Responsibilities

- Validation Strategy & Usecases : Define Usecases and execute validation plans for robotics software stacks (perception, planning, control) and hardware subsystems. 
 - Automation & Frameworks: Develop automated test suites for ROS2 nodes, navigation stack (Nav2), and fleet APIs using Python/C++, pytest, gtest/gmock. 
 - Simulation & Scenario Testing: Build simulation environments (Gazebo/Ignition, Isaac Sim) for warehouse layouts; author scenarios for obstacle avoidance, dynamic traffic, and multi-robot coordination.

 - Safety & Compliance: Execute safety protocols for AMRs (emergency stop, zone monitoring, speed limits) aligned with ISO 3691-4, ISO 13849, ANSI/RIA R15. 06. 
 - Performance & Reliability: Measure latency, throughput, and stability under high-load scenarios; validate battery management and docking behaviors. 
 - CI/CD Integration: Embed automated tests into pipelines for continuous validation; monitor KPIs like defect escape rate and scenario coverage. 
 - Leadership: Act as a strong individual contributor and mentor for robotics validation teams; collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure customer experience is prioritized. 

Required Qualifications

- 6-12 years in QA/Validation, with 7+ years in robotics or AMR systems. 
 - Strong Python for automation and C++ for ROS2 integration. 
 - Hands-on experience with ROS2, Nav2 stack, colcon, and simulation tools (Gazebo/Ignition, Isaac Sim).

 - CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Jenkins; Docker-based test environments. 
 - Knowledge of functional safety standards for mobile robots (ISO 3691-4, ISO 13849). 

Preferred Skills

 - Warehouse automation workflows, WMS integration, and OPC-UA.

 - Reduction in field defect escape rate.

General Summary

JOB OVERVIEW

This position is part of the Qualcomm Customer Engineering Group, which collaborates closely with automotive partners and customers - from concept through commercialization - across Qualcomm's broad Snapdragon Automotive platform portfolio. The team supports all aspects of embedded software including hardware and software architecture, feature bring-up, platform integration, software customization, system validation, and complex debugging efforts that are critical to product launch. 

This is a Staff-level Software Applications Engineering position focused on Build & Integration (B&I) and Release Engineering for Qualcomm Snapdragon Automotive platforms. The primary mission of this role is to own, drive, and continuously improve build systems, integration pipelines, and release processes that enable automotive software delivery across IVI, ADAS, and FLEX segments for global automotive customers. The role spans multiple OS environments including Linux, Android, QNX (HQX), and HGY (Gunyah Hypervisor) with multi-OS virtualized stacks. 

The successful candidate will serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Build & Integration engineering within the BDC CE team, driving cross-functional collaboration between Customer Engineering, Dev/Platform SW teams, and global automotive OEM/Tier-1 partners. As a Staff Engineer, this individual will provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, define build and release methodologies, and contribute to the continuous improvement of automation frameworks and engineering productivity tooling. 

Key Responsibilities

Build, Integration & Release Management

- Own and manage end-to-end build, integration, and release activities for complex Snapdragon Automotive software products spanning multiple OS platforms. 
 - Design, implement, and maintain scalable and reliable build infrastructures and CI/CD pipelines tailored for embedded and HLOS automotive software stacks. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of build systems, toolchains, automation frameworks, and release processes across program milestones. 
 - Establish release governance, versioning, branching, tagging, and artifact management strategies for multi-OS automotive software deliveries. 
 - Monitor build health, integration quality, and release readiness across multiple product streams and chipset generations. 
 - Collaborate with development, quality engineering, and platform teams to ensure successful integration and deployment. 
 - Identify bottlenecks and implement measures to improve build performance, reliability, and delivery efficiency. 
 - Define and maintain build and release KPIs, dashboards, and operational metrics to track program health. 
 - Ensure compliance with software development standards, security policies, and release governance processes. 
 - Lead investigations and root-cause analysis for build failures, integration issues, and release blockers. 

Triage & Engineering Support

- Serve as the primary escalation point for build and integration-related issues across the Customer Engineering (CE) team. 
 - Provide timely triage, troubleshooting, and resolution support for development, integration, and release issues. 
 - Analyze build logs, compiler errors, dependency conflicts, toolchain issues, and deployment failures. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for recurring engineering issues; own Change Requests (CRs) end-to-end from triage through patch validation. 
 - Partner with product, platform, and infrastructure teams to resolve cross-functional technical challenges. 
 - Develop self-service tools, documentation, and best practices to improve engineering productivity across the BDC CE team. 
 - Track and manage technical debt associated with build environments, toolchains, and integration workflows. 

Customer Engagement & Technical Support

- Serve as a key technical interface for build and integration queries from automotive OEM and Tier-1 customers across regions. 
 - Support Automotive RFI (AutoRFI) assessments for B&I-related NRE scoping, communicating technical complexity and resource requirements. 
 - Engage with customers during bring-up, pre-CS, and post-CS phases to proactively identify and mitigate build and integration risks. 
 - Provide on-site customer support as required during critical program milestones. 
 - Collaborate with NA, EU, and India CE teams to ensure global follow-the-sun build and integration support. 

Automation, Tools & Engineering Productivity

- Drive development and validation of build and release automation frameworks for multi-OS automotive software platforms. 
 - Design and maintain automated build health monitors, integration quality dashboards, and triage tooling to reduce mean time to resolution. 
 - Partner with platform and APT (Automated Platform Test) teams to define and integrate build qualification checks across CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Create and maintain build guides, integration runbooks, and reusable diagnostic artifacts for build and release issues across platforms. 
 - Track and analyze build and integration trends across program stages (Bringup → ES → L0-L4 → FC → CS) and communicate risk to program and customer teams. 
 - Contribute to secure software supply chain and DevSecOps practices within the automotive software delivery pipeline. 

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

- Serve as the B&I SME for the BDC CE team, providing architectural guidance on build system design, integration strategy, and release engineering. 
 - Lead cross-functional B&I reviews with Dev, QA, DevOps, and CE teams; drive root-cause analysis delivery to enable process improvements. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on build system concepts, CI/CD best practices, scripting, and customer engagement. 
 - Influence feature design and architecture decisions to proactively prevent build and integration failures in future Snapdragon Automotive SPs. 
 - Scale technical knowledge through reusable documentation, training materials, and knowledge-base contributions. 

Minimum Qualifications

Education & Experience

- One of the following: 
 - B. E. / B. Tech in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, or related field with 8+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Embedded Systems, or related experience. 
 - M. Tech / M. S. in relevant field with 6+ years of experience. 
 - Ph. D. in relevant field with 4+ years of experience. 

Required Technical Skills

- 5+ years of hands-on experience in build, integration, and release engineering for large-scale software products. 
 - Strong expertise in CI/CD pipeline design, implementation, and optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience with build automation systems (Make, CMake, Bazel, Ninja, Gradle, or similar). 
 - Proficiency in scripting languages: Python, Shell/Bash for build and automation workflows. 
 - Strong expertise in source control management and branching strategies (GitFlow, Trunk-Based Development). 
 - Experience with artifact repository management and release artifact governance. 
 - Experience with Linux/Unix build environments and containerized build infrastructure. 
 - 3+ years of customer-facing or cross-functional technical support experience. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to document RCAs and communicate technical findings to cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Staff-level experience owning build and integration engineering for production automotive programs (IVI / ADAS / FLEX) from bringup through SOP. 
 - Experience with multi-OS build environments spanning Linux, Android, QNX (HQX), and HGY (Gunyah Hypervisor). 
 - Familiarity with Qualcomm Snapdragon Automotive chipsets across Gen3 / Gen4 / Gen4. 5 / Gen5 software delivery pipelines. 
 - Experience with DevSecOps practices and secure software supply chain management. 
 - Knowledge of containerization (Docker) and cloud-native build pipelines for embedded software. 
 - Familiarity with ASPICE process compliance, ASIL functional safety considerations, and automotive program delivery cycles. 
 - Experience with AutoRFI processes, NRE scoping, and CDEV (Chipset Development) activities within CE programs. 
 - Knowledge of build and release KPI frameworks, dashboards, and workload-based productivity trend analysis.
