data.title: DevOps Engineer
data.description:
ACI powers the payments ecosystem - globally, and you power ACI. You'll innovate, collaborate, and grow - in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers - in all roles and levels - are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments. 
As a DevOps Engineer in Pune, India, you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world's payments ecosystem!
A typical day at ACI for a DevOps Engineer is: 
• Responsible for designing, developing and delivering high quality Development Operations tools. 
• Analyzes reports of customer or development reported problems and provides long term solutions and improvements. 
• Maintains detailed knowledge of the hardware platform, network and application layers. Manages the dependencies for use in designing proper solutions. 
• Provides guidance and subject matter expertise to the development organization. 
• Actively contributes to CI/CD automation streams and DevOps initiatives supporting business scalability and operational excellence. 
• Perform other duties as assigned. 
• Understand and adhere to all corporate policies to include but not limited to the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics. 
Knowledge, Skills and Experience needed to succeed in this role: 
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent software development experience. 
• 3 to 6 years DevOps / SRE or infrastructure setup experience including development/system administration. 
• Experience with Linux/Unix and scripting languages. 
• Strong understanding of hardware platforms, networking concepts and application layers. 
• Experience supporting automation, continuous integration and continuous delivery practices. 
Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Experience needed for this role: 
• DevOps, Containerization and native Cloud (Azure) experience would be preferred. 
• Linux System Engineer experience would be a plus. 
• Experience with Configuration Management tools such as Ansible, Puppet or Terraform. 
• Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins. 
• Experience with Source Code Management tools such as Git, Bitbucket, Gerrit or Gitea. 
• Experience with scripting languages including Bash, Python or Groovy. 
• Experience with Build tools such as Gradle. 
• Experience with Artifactory solutions such as JFrog or Nexus. 
• Experience with HashiCorp Vault and Consul. 
• Experience with Virtualization and Containerization technologies including VMware, Docker and Kubernetes. 
• Experience with Reporting, Statistics and Analytics tools such as Nagios, Dynatrace, Prometheus and Grafana. 
• Experience with Apache Tomcat and OpenSSL. 
Core Capabilities: 
We seek colleagues who embody our core capabilities - these shape our culture and enable us to make a meaningful impact together: 
• Ensure Accountability: holding self and others accountable to meet commitments. 
• Drives Results: consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances. 
• Customer Focus: building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions. 
• Cultivate Innovation: creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful. 
• Collaborates: building partnerships and working collaboratively with others.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in India on a full-time basis. This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visa status or work permit now or in the future. 
In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package-all within an innovative and collaborative work environment. 
Our benefits are the "Best in Industry" such as: 
• Health Insurance for Employee and Family with periodic health checkups. 
• Paid time off and sick time off.

ACI Worldwide is an AA/EEO employer in the United States, which includes providing equal opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities, and an EEO employer globally. Important Notice About Recruitment Scams

data.title: Site Reliability Engineering Manager
data.description:
SITE RELIABILITY ENGINEERING (SRE) MANAGER

Job Description | AWS & Azure | Banking & Fintech

Location: Bangalore

Experience: Typically 6+ years in infrastructure, cloud engineering, DevOps, or SRE, including 3+ years leading technical teams

Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on SRE Manager to lead the reliability, availability, performance, and security of platforms serving major banks and fintech companies. 

This role combines technical delivery, people management, and client engagement. You will design and operate production infrastructure across AWS and Microsoft Azure, lead a team of SRE engineers, and work directly with client technology, security, and operations teams. You should be comfortable troubleshooting a production incident, reviewing infrastructure code, developing your team, and explaining technical risks to senior client stakeholders. 

Key Responsibilities

Hands-on technical leadership

Design, build, and operate highly available, scalable, and resilient infrastructure across AWS and Azure. 

Lead architecture reviews covering availability, capacity, security, operability, and disaster recovery. 

Remain actively involved in infrastructure automation, code reviews, troubleshooting, and complex production issues. 

Establish service-level indicators and objectives (SLIs/SLOs), define error budgets, and use them to guide reliability improvements. 

Reduce operational toil through automation, self-service tooling, and repeatable engineering practices. 

Own capacity planning, performance tuning, cloud cost optimization, and production readiness reviews. 

Cloud infrastructure and platform engineering

Manage AWS services such as EC2, EKS, VPC, IAM, RDS/Aurora, S3, CloudWatch, Route 53, and load balancing. 

Manage Azure services such as Virtual Machines, AKS, Virtual Networks, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure SQL, Storage, Azure Monitor, and Application Gateway. 

Build and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform or equivalent tools, with appropriate testing, review, and change controls. 

Operate Kubernetes and container platforms, including deployments, upgrades, scaling, networking, access controls, and troubleshooting. 

Engineer secure connectivity across cloud environments and client networks, including private endpoints, VPNs, AWS Direct Connect, and Azure ExpressRoute. 

Develop reliable CI/CD workflows with deployment safeguards, rollback strategies, configuration management, and secrets management. 

Reliability and production operations

Establish observability across metrics, logs, traces, synthetic checks, and actionable alerting. 

Lead incident response for critical services, including incident coordination, technical troubleshooting, stakeholder updates, and recovery. 

Own on-call practices, escalation paths, operational runbooks, and incident readiness. 

Drive blameless post-incident reviews and ensure corrective actions are completed. 

Define and validate backup, restoration, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures against agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives (RTO/RPO). 

Improve resilience through failure testing, dependency analysis, and controlled recovery exercises. 

Security and financial services requirements

Partner with security and compliance teams to implement least-privilege access, encryption, key management, vulnerability remediation, and audit logging. 

Operate within client requirements for data protection, data residency, segregation of duties, and controlled production access. 

Support security reviews, audits, and evidence collection for applicable standards and regulatory requirements, such as PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and relevant banking regulations. 

Ensure production changes are traceable, reviewed, tested, and aligned with client change-management processes. 

Design and operate infrastructure supporting sensitive financial workloads and critical transaction services. 

Team leadership and management

Hire, mentor, and manage a team of SRE engineers, setting clear expectations and supporting career development. 

Own team priorities, delivery planning, performance reviews, and skills development. 

Balance hands-on engineering with delegation and development of technical ownership within the team. 

Build a sustainable on-call model and manage workload, coverage, and operational health. 

Establish engineering standards and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 

Work closely with application engineering, architecture, security, delivery, and support teams. 

Client engagement

Serve as the primary SRE contact for major banking and fintech clients. 

Translate client requirements and contractual service commitments into technical designs and operational plans. 

Lead service reviews, reliability discussions, incident reviews, and infrastructure planning sessions. 

Communicate incidents, risks, dependencies, and remediation plans clearly to both technical and business stakeholders. 

Manage client escalations and coordinate internal teams to deliver timely resolution. 

Present service performance, reliability trends, capacity forecasts, and improvement roadmaps. 

Required Skills and Experience

Strong production engineering experience across both AWS and Azure, including architecture, networking, security, and operations. 

Demonstrated experience managing an SRE, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, or platform engineering team. 

Recent hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and CI/CD platforms. 

Strong Linux administration, networking, and troubleshooting skills, including DNS, TLS, HTTP, routing, firewalls, and load balancing. 

Proficiency in at least one automation language, such as Python, Go, or PowerShell, along with shell scripting. 

Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Open Telemetry, LGTM Stack, Splunk, or cloud-native monitoring services. 

Practical understanding of SLOs, error budgets, incident management, distributed systems, and resilience engineering. 

Experience operating databases, caches, and messaging systems, with an understanding of replication, failover, backup, and recovery. 

Proven ability to lead major production incidents and deliver lasting improvements. 

Strong client-facing communication skills, including experience handling escalations and explaining technical tradeoffs. 

Experience supporting banking, fintech, payments, or other highly regulated production environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

AWS Solutions Architect Professional, AWS DevOps Engineer Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, or relevant Kubernetes certifications. 

Experience with payment platforms, digital banking, transaction processing, or financial APIs. 

Experience with hybrid cloud, multi-region architectures, and private connectivity to enterprise environments. 

Familiarity with ITIL processes and enterprise service management tools such as ServiceNow or Jira Service Management. 

What Success Looks Like

Services consistently meet agreed reliability and performance objectives. 

Major incidents are managed effectively, with clear client communication and measurable reductions in repeat failures. 

Infrastructure is secure, automated, recoverable, and cost-efficient. 

The team grows in capability and operates with sustainable workloads. 

Banking and fintech clients have confidence in service operations and the reliability improvement roadmap.

 - Support major incidents and participate in out-of-hours and on-call work where required.

Knowledge, Skills, Experience & Educational Qualification

 - Certifications such as AZ-900 (or similar cloud fundamentals certification) are required. Red Hat OpenShift Administrator or similar Kubernetes certifications are advantageous. 
 - Strong knowledge of Kubernetes, containerisation concepts, Operators, Ingress, Networking, Storage and cluster lifecycle, including Machine set, cluster autoscaling, safe drain/cordon, RHCOS patch cycles, worker pools, quotas and configuring limits and requests.

 - Experience administering Azure components: RBAC, Entra ID, PIM, Policies, Networking, Firewalls, DNS, Log Analytics, Azure Monitor. 
 - Skilled with CLI tools: oc, kubectl, az. 
 - Experience with CI/CD tooling (Azure DevOps, Git), Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform), YAML pipelines. 
 - Strong knowledge of observability tooling (Cluster Logging/Log Forwarder, Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic, Splunk, Log Analytics, ServiceNow). 
 - Demonstrable experience supporting production platforms and diagnosing complex, multi-layered issues. 
 - Knowledge of Private ARO networking ( VNet peering, UDRs, NAT Gateway/Azure Firewall egress, Private DNS). 

You need to be this kind of person

- Passionate about leading a highly motivated team to drive business outcomes
 - Able to work and learn quickly in a fast paced, fun and dynamic environment
 - Curious to learn and develop your own technical skills
 - Able to both collaborate and move as a team but also be self-motivated and deliver results independently when required. 
 - Able to take ownership of issues, tasks and solutions managing them from inception to conclusion. Whilst working within the audit and governance frameworks. 
 - Ability to challenge and speak up in discussions with colleagues of all levels

Educational Qualification: 

- Graduate/Masters in any discipline
 - Cloud certifications would be an added advantage

M&G Behaviours relevant to all roles: 

Tell it like it is: Respectfully speaking up to create better ways forward - both direct and empathetic

Own it now: Putting your name on things with confidence to drive progress and results quickly

Move it forward together: Forming cross functional teams to seize the right opportunities and solve real problems

- . . . . . . . . . . . . With CARE and INTEGRITY. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 

We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. data.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28, 000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. 

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that's you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

The Quality Assurance supervisor develops, implements, and maintains technical quality assurance and control systems to ensure product reliability and compliance with company standards. This role defines inspection methods, testing procedures, and quality benchmarks, while contributing to engineering design reviews and supporting product data analysis. You will lead a team of professionals to achieve operational excellence in quality systems. 

Will support and meet the objectives and goals of Quality Engineering and the Oragadam Facility. Provide training and leadership for Corrective Action Teams and Work Groups. Maintain IMS Quality Systems and requirements. Provide the liaison between Quality Engineering and other departments in support of quality and manufacturing initiatives. This is a leadership position to include resolution of ETO panel quality issues, data support, correction and corrective action. Ensure Good through familiarity with policies and procedures relating to standards of business conduct. 

You will report to QUALITY AND PROJECT TRANSFER MANAGER. 

You will work in Onsite work mode based in our Chennai plant in Kancheepuram, India

Your Responsibilities

- Establish and maintain quality assurance systems, standards, and procedures. 
 - Define inspection and testing methods to evaluate precision, accuracy, and reliability of products. 
 - Review engineering designs to integrate quality requirements and considerations. 
 - Support product teams by gathering and analysing production & quality-related challenges. 
 - Supervise and develop personnel to ensure efficient operation of the quality function.

data.description:
Role Summary: 

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented ETL Senior Tester to join our growing data team. The successful candidate will be responsible for validating the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of data as it flows through our enterprise-grade Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) and Extract, Load, Transform (ELT) processes and data pipelines. This role is crucial for ensuring the reliability of our data for analytics, reporting, and critical business operations. 

The ETL Tester will play a key role in designing and executing comprehensive test plans, scenarios, and cases for complex data transformations, data migrations, and data warehousing solutions. They will collaborate closely with data engineers, developers, business analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure that our data solutions meet business requirements

Essential Responsibilities

· Test Strategy & Planning: Analyze business, functional, and technical requirements to identify testable scenarios and clarify ambiguities in user stories and specifications. Design comprehensive test plans, test scenarios, and test cases for ETL workflows, data platforms, and reporting solutions. 

· ETL Testing Execution: Execute manual and automated testing for ETL processes, data transformations, data validation, and data pipelines. 

· Data Validation & Integrity: Perform thorough data validation, data comparison, and backend testing to ensure the accuracy of data transformations and mappings. Validate data mapping, transformations, aggregations, and business rules across source systems, staging layers, data warehouses, and reporting layers. Conduct data integrity checks, reconciliations, and consistency validations using advanced SQL and other data validation techniques. 

· SQL Proficiency: Write and execute complex SQL queries for data validation, reconciliation, integrity checks, and to verify data transformations and business rules. 

· Defect Management: Identify, log, track, and manage defects using tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps, and collaborate with developers and data engineers to resolve issues and verify fixes. 

· Performance Testing: Support ETL performance testing and validate load performance against benchmarks. Analyze pipeline runtime, throughput, latency, and resource utilization. 

· Documentation & Reporting: Document test execution results, defect reports, test evidence, and sign-off artifacts to support quality assurance, audits, and compliance. Communicate test results, risks, quality metrics, and recommendations clearly to cross-functional stakeholders. 

· Agile Collaboration: Actively participate in Agile delivery processes, including Program Increment planning, stand-ups, sprint planning, grooming, and retrospectives, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. 

· Continuous Improvement: Incorporate learnings and best practices to improve the ETL testing process over time and contribute to continuous QA process improvements

Required Experience

· Bachelor's degree or higher from a reputed university

· 6 to 10 years of experience in manual and automated testing, with a strong focus on ETL, data transformation, and data validation. 

· Strong understanding of ETL processes, data warehousing concepts (facts, dimensions, star/snowflake schema), relational databases and PySpark scripting. 

· Advanced SQL skills, including writing complex queries for data validation, reconciliation, and integrity checks (joins, aggregations, subqueries, window functions). 

· Hands-on experience creating test cases, test scenarios, and executing test plans

· Experience with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform or Azure, AWS, Dataproc or Databricks

· Experience with defect tracking tools such as Jira or Agility etc. 

· Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

· Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an Agile environment

· Experience with scripting languages like Python for test automation

Good to have

· Healthcare industry experience

· Familiarity with healthcare data models (claims, clinical, eligibility, provider data, etc. )

· Understanding of data governance and data quality standard

data.title: Software Engineer, Senior B Performance Engineering
data.description:
Senior Software Performance Engineer

6+ Years Experience | PAX India

About The Role

Help scale the performance engineering discipline across Blackbaud - building the tooling, practices, and expertise that let dev and ops teams do their own performance analysis, while staying hands-on enough to solve the hardest problems yourself and mentor others. 

Our core stack is Kubernetes/Azure-based microservices, though you'll occasionally support older, more monolithic systems too - the core skills (profiling, load testing, root-cause analysis) transfer directly. 

This is a hands-on coding role: most of your time goes to building and maintaining our load/synthetic test tooling (including AI-assisted testing) and integrating it into our SDLC. The rest is split between observability tooling and ad hoc performance analysis, with strong ownership of latency, throughput, and resource efficiency. 

What You'll Do

Load & Synthetic Test Tooling

- Build and maintain our synthetic/load-testing framework - test development (Playwright/Gatling), execution, and reporting. 
 - Apply AI capabilities to improve test development - AI-assisted authoring, scenario generation, result analysis. 
 - Integrate performance and synthetic tests into CI/CD pipelines so checks run continuously, not just ad hoc. 

Observability & Ad Hoc Performance Analysis

- Improve observability tooling (Splunk, Grafana, Honeycomb, App Insights, AppDynamics, New Relic): dashboards, alerting, SLIs/SLOs, instrumentation. 
 - Run load, stress, and soak tests to catch bottlenecks before production; profile CPU, memory, GC, I/O, and network in C#/. NET and/or Java services. 
 - Troubleshoot production performance issues (latency regressions, resource exhaustion, throttling) and tune resource usage in Kubernetes/AKS (requests/limits, autoscaling, kubectl diagnostics). 

Ongoing

- Build self-serve performance capabilities (dashboards, guardrails, docs) so teams can diagnose issues without escalating. 
 - Design and maintain C#/. NET and/or Java microservices with a focus on performance and scalability. 
 - Collaborate via Agile/GitHub workflows and mentor junior engineers on profiling and troubleshooting. 

What You'll Bring

- 6+ years of software engineering experience with meaningful exposure to performance, scalability, or reliability engineering. 
 - Strong C#/. NET and/or Java skills, plus strong Azure experience. 
 - Solid grasp of how compute resources (CPU, memory, I/O, network) drive performance/scalability, including tuning in containerized environments. 
 - Hands-on experience with a load-testing tool (k6, JMeter, Locust, Gatling) and a browser-automation tool for synthetic/end-to-end testing (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright). 
 - Experience with profiling tools (dotnet-trace, PerfView, App Insights profiler) and observability/APM tooling (Splunk, Grafana, Honeycomb, AppDynamics, New Relic). 
 - Some experience applying AI/LLM tools to dev workflows (AI-assisted coding, test generation, analysis). 
 - Experience integrating tooling/tests into CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) and troubleshooting production performance issues. 
 - Working knowledge of Linux fundamentals and networking basics (DNS, TLS, routing) as they relate to performance. 
 - Experience with Agile/GitHub, strong documentation and communication skills, and comfort working across time zones. 

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

- Are self-motivated and comfortable driving your own investigations without step-by-step direction. 
 - Have systemic curiosity - you want to understand how a system behaves end-to-end, and think across layers from application code down through infrastructure and database. 
 - Question assumptions and keep digging until you find the actual root cause, not just the first plausible explanation. 

Nice to Have

- Gatling or Playwright experience specifically. 
 - AKS experience (cluster ops, node pools, scaling) with a performance/capacity lens. 
 - Front-end development experience using Angular/TypeScript. 
 - Database-layer performance troubleshooting (query plans, indexing, stored procedure tuning). 
 - Familiarity with distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), capacity planning and cost/performance trade-off analysis. 

Quick Summary

"Backend-heavy engineer who codes daily, hunts down and fixes performance bottlenecks, and operates production systems; strong in C#/. NET and/or Java, Azure, compute/resource performance fundamentals, load testing, and observability. "

data.description:
Xuman. Ai is live on both app stores. Real people are using it. 

What is Xuman. Ai

Xuman is building a network for on-demand human connection. 

Billions of people have knowledge, skills, and experience that could be valuable to someone else. Making that accessible is a coordination problem. 

What you want to do, who's up for it, and when you're both available. 

Xuman brings those things into one system. You discover the person, book their time, and connect. If they're available now, that can happen immediately. You can also make your own capabilities available through the same network. 

The goal is to make finding and connecting with the right human as easy as finding information. 

Think about how much more people could learn, build, and accomplish if that worked globally. 

The stage

What's the rarest stage to join a startup?

Building from zero? Everywhere. 

Joining after scale? Everywhere too. 

The stage in between is where it gets interesting. 

The product is built. It's live. People are using it. 

Now it's about syncing what they feel with what we build. 

Ship. Watch. Learn. Fix. Improve. Repeat. 

What you'll own

- The app on iOS and Android for your side of the product, end to end. 

- Push, deep links, permissions and location, and the quality of each. 

- The release to both stores: builds, review, rollout, and the fixes in between. 

- Performance and crash rate on the handsets real people actually carry. 

- The mobile experience as a whole, with the standing to argue for it. 

How we work

The founder sets what the product does and how it should feel. When you spot a gap, a bug or a better way, you bring it up before you build it. Once it's agreed, the technical approach is all yours. That is how we stay fast without breaking what people already use. 

What you bring

- iOS and Android experience, shipped to both stores. 

- React Native in production. Ours is Expo. 

- TypeScript. 

- App Store and Play review survived, including a rejection you fixed yourself. 

- Push notifications end-to-end: tokens, delivery, taps, and the deep link after. 

- Permissions and location done properly, foreground and background. 

- Over-the-air updates and build channels. Ours is EAS. 

- Native work when JavaScript is not enough. You can read Swift or Kotlin. 

- Crash reporting and release health as your job, not QA's. 

- Offline, flaky networks and low-end devices treated as normal conditions. 

- You already build with Claude, Copilot, or ChatGPT every day. 

What helps further

- background location or foreground services. 

- over-the-air update pipelines. 

What you get

- Work that is yours end to end, not tickets off someone else's board. 

- Your work in real hands the same week, on a product that is live today. 

- Pay that grows with every milestone we hit. 

- Growth that is claimed, not handed out. More opens as you carry more. 

- You're joining before the growth. What you build now is the foundation, and inside the company it will always be known as yours. 

How to be a Xuman

Experience the product first. It costs you a few minutes, nothing else. 

Then pick your path. 

Apply here, and wait for my message to book a time. 

Or come find me in the app. Create your Xuman. Ai profile through

https: //xuman. ai/vishal. chamaria

Put up one thing you know, do, or have a strong POV on, so people can book you. Then text me your profile link in the app, or book a time with me. 

Before you book a time, two things, so I know who I'm talking to: 

• Get your blue tick. It tells me you're real. 

• Fill in your details under Settings → Personal. It tells me who you are. 

Then book a time with me, whenever works. 

Come as a builder, not a candidate.

We are looking for a meticulous and technical Senior QA Engineer to ensure our applications meet the highest standards of quality through a balanced approach of manual exploration and automated efficiency. 

Role Summary

We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer with 5 to 7 years of experience to lead the quality assurance efforts across our web applications. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end testing lifecycle. You will design comprehensive test strategies, perform manual testing for complex user workflows, and architect and maintain automated test suites for UI and API layers. 

Since you will be testing applications built with Angular, . NET, and Python, an understanding of modern web architecture and RESTful APIs is essential. You will act as a quality advocate within our Agile teams, ensuring that bugs are caught early and our CI/CD pipelines run smoothly. 

Key Responsibilities

- Test Strategy & Planning: Analyze product requirements, user stories, and technical design documents to create comprehensive test plans, test cases, and traceability matrices. 
 - Automation Development: Design, build, and maintain scalable automated testing frameworks for UI (Web) and backend APIs from scratch. 
 - Manual Testing: Execute manual testing (exploratory, functional, regression, sanity, and integration testing) for complex edge cases and scenarios that are difficult or inefficient to automate. 
 - API Testing: Thoroughly test RESTful APIs and microservices (built in . NET/Python) using tools like Postman, Swagger, or code-based API frameworks. 
 - Defect Management: Identify, isolate, document, and track bugs using issue-tracking systems (e. g. , Jira). Work closely with developers to reproduce and resolve defects. 
 - CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) to enable continuous testing and faster release cycles. 
 - Database Testing: Write SQL queries to validate data integrity, verify backend processing, and ensure database updates match frontend inputs. 
 - Mentorship: Guide and mentor junior QA team members, establish QA best practices, and drive a culture of quality across the engineering team. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Experience: 5 to 7 years of proven experience in Software Quality Assurance, with a strong balance of both manual and automated testing. 
 - Automation Frameworks: Strong expertise in modern UI automation tools (e. g. , Cypress, Playwright, or Selenium) and test runners. 
 - Programming Languages: Proficiency in writing test scripts using JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, or Python (aligning with our Angular/. NET/Python tech stack). 
 - API Testing Tools: Hands-on experience with API testing tools like Postman, SoapUI, or REST Assured. 
 - Manual Testing Expertise: Deep understanding of software testing methodologies, test design techniques, and the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC). 
 - Databases: Solid understanding of relational databases and the ability to write intermediate to advanced SQL queries for backend validation. 
 - Agile/Scrum: Extensive experience working in Agile environments and actively participating in sprint planning, grooming, and retrospectives. 

Preferred/Nice-to-Have Skills

- Experience with Performance and Load testing tools (e. g. , JMeter, k6). 
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) and containerization (Docker). 
 - Experience testing accessibility (WCAG) and cross-browser compatibility. 
 - Familiarity with behavior-driven development (BDD) frameworks like Cucumber or SpecFlow.

data.title: Engineering Manager - .NET & Azure
data.description:
Engineering Manager - . NET & Azure

Hands-on engineering leadership | Architecture | Client collaboration

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on engineering leader to help a capable team take a mature and growing product forward. The role involves working on interesting product and engineering challenges, combining technical leadership, engineering delivery, mentoring, architecture and close collaboration with product and client stakeholders, with room to influence technical direction and how the team works. 

This is not a traditional project-management role, nor a people-management role disconnected from engineering. You'll remain meaningfully involved in the engineering itself - moving comfortably between code, architecture, debugging, technical decisions and planning, while helping the team make sound decisions and deliver well. 

You'll be working on a product with a rapidly expanding customer base across the global AEC industry. 

Dwaravati is a software development studio with a small team of experienced engineers. We work closely with client stakeholders to shape and build products, and operate as a lean, cohesive and highly effective company with a flat hierarchy and an open, collaborative environment where experienced engineers have significant ownership and autonomy. 

At a glance

- Experience: Engineering Manager / Senior Engineering Manager / Development Manager / Technical Lead
 - Core technology: Microsoft . NET / C# / Azure
 - Engineering: Hands-on leadership across architecture, design, coding, debugging and technical delivery
 - Systems: Significant experience with mature, long-lived production software
 - Leadership: Experience leading and mentoring engineering teams
 - Collaboration: Strong experience working with product, business and client stakeholders

The role and your ownership

You will lead day-to-day engineering and delivery, combining technical leadership, hands-on engineering, mentoring and direct collaboration with product, QA, delivery and business stakeholders. Coding, design reviews and debugging will remain a meaningful part of the role. 

You will work closely with the founder during a gradual leadership transition, learning the product, domain and technical context that has accumulated over time. As you build that context, you will increasingly take ownership of engineering and delivery decisions and become the team's first point of contact for most engineering matters. 

The founder will remain involved in selected architectural, strategic and people matters, while providing historical context where useful. You will have significant autonomy in how the team and system evolve, with the support and context needed to make good decisions. 

This is a role for someone who enjoys ownership without unnecessary hierarchy - someone who still likes getting into technical detail, but also wants the scope to influence engineering direction, help others grow and make the team and product better over time. 

What you will do

Lead technical direction

- Guide architecture and implementation decisions across a mature, long-lived production codebase. 
 - Be a trusted technical sounding board for engineers, helping them work through design choices, difficult bugs, performance and reliability problems, and architectural questions. 
 - Stay hands-on through coding and prototyping, design and code reviews, technical investigation, debugging, system design and technical documentation. 
 - Help the team evolve the system pragmatically, balancing immediate needs with maintainability, performance, reliability and long-term technical health. 

Help the team deliver well

- Work with engineers on estimation, planning, technical task breakdown, sprint execution, bug triage and capacity. 
 - Help turn uncertainty and competing priorities into clear engineering decisions and practical delivery plans. 
 - Identify recurring problems and improve the underlying system or practices rather than repeatedly treating the symptoms. 
 - Improve engineering practices and processes where they make a meaningful difference to quality, delivery or team effectiveness. 

Work closely with product and client stakeholders

- Work directly with product, QA, client and business stakeholders to turn incomplete or evolving requirements into actionable plans. 
 - Explain technical options, constraints and uncertainty clearly, including implications for performance, scalability, reliability and cost. 
 - Disagree constructively when needed, while keeping discussions focused on the problem and the outcome. 

Mentor and support engineers

- Help engineers improve not only their code, but their engineering judgment and ability to make sound technical decisions. 
 - Provide technical guidance and mentoring suited to each engineer's experience and needs. 
 - Contribute to performance discussions, career development and the continued growth of the engineering team. 

Essential experience

This role could suit an Engineering Manager, Senior Engineering Manager, Development Manager, Technical Lead or similar engineering leader with genuine responsibility for both people and engineering outcomes. 

- Strong . NET engineering experience: Substantial experience designing, building and maintaining long-lived production applications using . NET and C#. You have the technical depth and interest to remain hands-on, and are comfortable reasoning about architecture, services and APIs, asynchronous and concurrent systems, persistence and data access, performance, diagnostics and observability. You understand how maintainability, deployment and runtime behaviour shape the evolution of a system over time. 
 - Practical Azure experience: Meaningful production experience with Azure and cloud-hosted applications. You should be comfortable reasoning about compute, messaging, databases and storage, caching, scaling, monitoring, reliability and deployment, including performance and cost. You do not need to know every Azure service. 
 - Engineering leadership: Meaningful experience leading and mentoring engineers, balancing technical and delivery priorities, and taking responsibility for team and engineering outcomes. You are comfortable working with Scrum or similar agile practices and adapting the process when circumstances call for it. You are comfortable giving difficult feedback, handling competing priorities and supporting engineers through their growth. 
 - Strong stakeholder communication: Substantial experience working directly with product, business or client stakeholders. You can explain complex technical situations clearly, navigate ambiguity, discuss trade-offs openly and disagree constructively when needed. 
 - Engineering judgment: You are comfortable working with imperfect information and making pragmatic decisions in complex, evolving systems. You care about long-term technical health without losing sight of the product and business outcomes the team needs to deliver. 

Helpful but not required

Any of the following would be useful, but is not essential: 

- High-volume or performance-sensitive applications
 - Experience with mature B2B products
 - Experience as an application or solution architect
 - Azure or Microsoft certifications
 - AEC domain experience

How we work

We value thoughtful engineering over unnecessary complexity, responsibility over hierarchy, and direct but respectful communication. 

We expect senior people to form opinions, test assumptions and change their minds when better information emerges. We encourage constructive disagreement, intellectual honesty and low-ego collaboration. 

We value sustainable processes that improve outcomes without unnecessary bureaucracy. People are trusted to take ownership, make decisions and raise problems early, while working together to find the best solution for the product, the team and our clients.

data.title: Engineering Manager - Payments
data.description:
Overview

As a part of expanding our Engineering team, we are looking for Engineering manager/s who will be responsible for keeping projects on track, solving technical issues that arise, communicating with other teams and acting as an overall leader for the team. He / She will be working on multiple projects at the same time, building and managing diverse teams of engineers from different disciplines (in-house & outsourced). 

To succeed, you need to possess a blend of strong leadership skills and technical depth in Payments. You will own the systems that move money between diners, restaurants and payment partners across multiple APAC markets, including payment acceptance, orchestration, settlement, reconciliation and merchant payouts. 

This role is for someone who understands why idempotency matters, what happens when a PSP times out mid-capture, and how a one-cent reconciliation break turns into a finance escalation. You will lead a team of in-house and outsourced engineers, partner closely with Product, Finance, Risk and Compliance, and stay close enough to the code to make sound technical calls. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Payments Platform Ownership: Own the end-to-end payments stack including checkout, authorisation, capture, refunds, voids, chargebacks, settlement, and merchant payouts. Lead integrations, onboarding, and ecosystem management with PSPs, acquirers, and gateways such as Stripe, Adyen, and Airwallex, as well as local payment methods across APAC (e. g. , PayNow, GrabPay, QRIS, PromptPay, GCash). 
 - Orchestration & Reconciliation: Drive payment orchestration and smart routing across payment rails (Stripe, Adyen, Airwallex) to improve authorisation rates, reduce costs, and enable failover during outages. Own transaction-level reconciliation, analytics, and reporting across our ledger, gateway/PSP dashboards, reports, and bank statements. 
 - Reliability, Security & Compliance: Set high bars for uptime and correctness with idempotent APIs, clear state machines, and auditable ledgers. Ensure PCI DSS compliance, tokenisation, secure data handling, and partner with Risk/Compliance on 3DS, SCA, and fraud controls. Track payment SLOs and lead incident response. 
 - Delivery and Stakeholder Management: Work closely with Product, Design, QA, Finance, and Operations to sequence work by business value, refine stories, and communicate technical direction clearly to all stakeholders. 
 - Team Leadership: Hire, onboard, coach, and grow in-house and outsourced engineering teams. Provide clear career development, set goals, and drive pragmatic agile execution to deliver value iteratively. 
 - Hands-On Engineering: Stay close to the code, review pull requests, conduct technical design reviews, and debug production issues alongside the team when needed. 

Desired Candidate Specification: 

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years as an Engineering Manager in a start-up or scale-up environment. 
 - At least 4 years building or leading payment systems in production (PSP, fintech, marketplace, e-commerce, or food delivery). 
 - Hands-on experience integrating with PSPs, acquirers, or local payment schemes, and deep understanding of money movement (ledgers, idempotency, reconciliation). 
 - Practical knowledge of PCI DSS, tokenisation, and security/compliance best practices. 
 - Proven track record of building and leading hybrid engineering teams (in-house and outsourced). 
 - Strong tech stack knowledge: Java, Spring Boot, Node. js, JavaScript, HTML, MySQL, MongoDB, AWS/GCP, and event-driven microservices architecture.

data.title: Software Engineer II
data.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We're committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power. 

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care-about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose. 

Could that be you?

Your Mission

We are looking for a Software Engineer II who operates as a Builder - an engineer with an

unusual bias to ship, an eye for craft, and a comfort running toward ambiguity instead of waiting for it to be solved for you. 

- Be immersive in the 'why' of what we're building - not just the ticket. 
 - Validate with real users and teammates early; fail fast and iterate faster. 
 - Operate AI-forward and hands-on; let modern tools expand what you can ship on your own. And the core technical chops of a strong frontend-leaning full-stack engineer. At UiPath we are enabling enterprises to transform via Business Orchestration and modernize their core business processes. The frontend is where customers feel whether the product is world-class. We are a global team that collaborates like a startup and protects the pace and autonomy that lets engineers grow fast. 

What you'll do at UiPath

- Ship Frontend, End-to-End: Build features from empty Figma (or no Figma at all) through production - interactive, accessible, fast, and on-brand. 
 - Builder Mindset: Pick up loosely defined problems and turn them into working product. Prefer a scrappy shipped v1 over a polished plan. 
 - AI-Forward Development: Use Codex, Claude Code, and similar tools as part of your daily loop for coding, refactoring, testing, and debugging. Share what works with the team. 
 - Talk to Users: Join customer calls, review feedback, and watch real people use the thing. Let what you see change what you build. 
 - Touch the Stack When Needed: Write the API, add the column, ship the endpoint - whatever unblocks your feature. Frontend is home base, not a ceiling. 
 - Raise the Craft Bar: Care about spacing, type, motion, loading states, empty states, and edge cases. Modern, delightful UI is the job, not a bonus. 

What you'll bring to the team

- Shipping experience: 3-7 years of professional experience (or equivalent) shipping production software, with a frontend center of gravity. 
 - Modern frontend fundamentals: TypeScript, React (or equivalent), component composition, state management, responsive design, accessibility, and web performance awareness. 
 - Enough backend to unblock yourself: You've written REST/GraphQL endpoints, worked with a database, and handled auth - or you're hungry to learn. 
 - Taste: You notice when a UI is well-crafted and can articulate why. You can produce something clean without a designer holding your hand. 
 - AI-forward habits: You already code with AI tools and have opinions about how to get more leverage from them. 
 - Ownership and time management: You break work down, ship small, communicate early, and finish what you start. Write automated tests for multi-tier systems, debug cross-service issues, and take deep ownership during incidents. 
 - Customer curiosity: You'd rather watch one user try the product than read ten pages of spec. 

Nice to have

Experience with LangChain/Langraph, OCR/large-document pipelines, or LLM evaluation

frameworks. 

Maybe you don't tick all the boxes above-but still think you'd be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes-and passion can't be learned. 

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected. 

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

Overview

Do you want to build secure, scalable cloud controls that protect a large Azure-managed environment while enabling customer-facing teams to move quickly?

The Azure Managed Environment team provides governed Azure tenants and subscriptions for customer demonstrations, proofs of concept, support engineering, and other non-production scenarios. The service applies centralized policy, monitoring, automated remediation, lifecycle governance, and cost controls to reduce production-tenant exposure, limit shadow IT, and preserve delivery agility. 

We are seeking a Software Engineer to design, build, and operate automated control solutions that enforce security and governance requirements across this environment. You will translate SFI, Azure Tenant Baseline, Entra, privacy, and business requirements into scalable policies, automations, telemetry, and remediation workflows. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role that combines software engineering, cloud security, operational judgment, and cross-functional leadership. You will partner with security architects, service owners, support teams, and business stakeholders to improve control effectiveness, reduce manual effort, and strengthen the resilience of the managed environment. 

Responsibilities

- Engineer cloud controls: Design and develop reusable Azure Policy definitions, policy initiatives, automation, and remediation workflows that enforce security and governance requirements across managed tenants and subscriptions. 
 - Lead control implementation: Assess new SFI, Azure Tenant Baseline, Entra, privacy, and internal control requirements; determine affected resources and control gaps; and lead architecture, implementation, validation, and rollout. 
 - Build compliance by design: Embed secure defaults, configuration standards, monitoring, and automated remediation into provisioning and lifecycle processes so compliance is consistent and scalable. 
 - Own engineering quality: Establish design standards, code-review practices, testing, release controls, documentation, and operational readiness for cloud-control solutions. 
 - Improve detection and remediation: Use telemetry, execution logs, and control-effectiveness measures to identify failures, tune enforcement, reduce false positives, and accelerate risk reduction. 
 - Advance lifecycle and cost governance: Engineer solutions for tenant and subscription provisioning, renewal, decommissioning, ownership hygiene, resource governance, allowance management, and cost optimization. 
 - Automate repeatable operations: Replace manual processes and one-off scripts with durable services, APIs, pipelines, and AI-enabled engineering approaches where appropriate. 
 - Support operational resilience: Provide engineering leadership during complex incidents and escalations, perform root-cause analysis, and drive corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Partner across functions: Work with service owners, security and privacy teams, platform engineering, finance, support, and business stakeholders to align requirements, priorities, and delivery plans. 
 - Provide technical leadership: Mentor engineers, communicate design and risk tradeoffs clearly, and influence decisions without relying on direct authority. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience using one or more general-purpose languages, scripting languages, or infrastructure-as-code technologies; OR a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and 1+ years of relevant experience; OR equivalent experience. 
 - Experience leading AI-powered transformation initiatives, including the implementation of agentic workflows, automation, and data-driven solutions at enterprise scale. 
 - Familiarity with AI governance, risk management, and responsible AI practices, with the ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into measurable business value. 
 - Experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting production-quality cloud services, automation, or platform engineering solutions. 
 - Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including Azure Policy, Azure Resource Manager, identity and access management, monitoring, or subscription and tenant governance. 
 - Understanding of secure software development, cloud security controls, least privilege, configuration management, and automated compliance. 
 - Ability to diagnose complex technical issues, use telemetry to drive decisions, and lead remediation across multiple teams. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical and risk tradeoffs to engineering and business audiences. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with C#, Python, PowerShell, TypeScript, Azure Functions, Azure DevOps or GitHub pipelines, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience building Azure Policy definitions and initiatives, policy-as-code solutions, automated remediation, compliance dashboards, or control-evidence pipelines. 
 - Knowledge of Azure landing zones, management groups, subscriptions, Entra ID, role-based access control, resource lifecycle management, and cloud cost optimization. 
 - Experience operating services at enterprise scale, including incident response, root-cause analysis, health service monitoring, and reliability improvement. 
 - Experience applying AI or machine learning capabilities to engineering productivity, operations, detection, or remediation. 
 - Relevant Azure, security, DevOps, or cloud architecture certification. 

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Firmware Architect (7-8 yrs) || Bangalore

Role Overview

Looking for a Firmware Architect who can own and evolve complex firmware and embedded OS layer architecture for high-assurance hardware products. The person should be comfortable working at the boundary of firmware, embedded software, system architecture, product behavior, and real-world customer use cases. The role requires someone who can understand complex end applications, translate them into clean technical architecture, and guide the implementation toward a stable, auditable, and production-ready product. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own firmware and embedded OS-layer architecture for hardware-based products. 
 - Understand product use cases, deployment environments, customer workflows, and system-level requirements. 
 - Translate high-level product and application requirements into firmware architecture, design modules, interfaces, and execution flows. 
 - Comprehend the existing architecture, identify gaps, and evolve it without unnecessary redesign. 
 - Define clean software boundaries across boot, system initialization, runtime services, application layers, management interfaces, and update flows. 
 - Work closely with hardware, FPGA, product, application engineering, and validation teams. 
 - Build architecture that is maintainable, testable, scalable, and suitable for long product lifecycles. 
 - Create clear design documents, interface specifications, state machines, flow diagrams, and implementation guidance for the engineering team. 
 - Review firmware implementation for correctness, robustness, security posture, error handling, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Support structured external evaluation, technical evidence preparation, and product assurance activities. 
 - Mentor engineers and help them convert ambiguous requirements into practical implementation steps. 
 - Own technical decisions across architecture, trade-offs, debugging, and release readiness. 
 - 
Relevant Experience

- o Around 7+ years of experience in embedded firmware, embedded software, or system software development. 
 - o Strong experience in firmware architecture or embedded OS-layer design. 
 - o Good understanding of boot flows, memory management, task scheduling, inter-process or inter module communication, error handling, fault recovery, and system initialization
 - o Experience working with complex embedded systems where firmware interacts with hardware, application logic, and external interfaces. 
 - o Ability to read and understand existing codebases and architecture without needing everything to be explained from scratch. 
 - o Strong C/C++ programming background. 
 - o Ability to design abstractions, interfaces, and modular firmware components. 
 - o Experience with RTOS, embedded Linux, bare-metal systems, or custom embedded runtime environments. 
 - o Good debugging ability across software-hardware boundaries. 
 - o Strong documentation skills for architecture, design, and engineering handover. 
 - o Ability to work with incomplete information and still bring structure to the problem.

Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it's powered by the anime content we all love.

About The Role

We are hiring a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our India Operations and play a crucial role in our mission to establish a world-class data engineering team within the Center for Data and Insights (CDI). In this role, you'll play a key part in building a cutting-edge, real-time data platform, designed to deliver insights at scale and power data-driven decision-making across our organization. Responsibilities will include collaborating with the data team and working on both backend microservices & frontend interfaces, crafting solutions that ensure data is processed, analyzed, and visualized in real time. 

The ideal candidate will bring strong full-stack engineering expertise across modern frontend and backend technologies, with hands-on experience building scalable, secure, and cloud-native applications. You will leverage Java, Spring Boot, React, Next. js, TypeScript, Kubernetes, and modern DevOps practices to deliver high-quality solutions that enable data-driven decision making for our business partners. This role requires a proactive, self-driven engineer who thrives in a collaborative environment, takes ownership from design through production, and balances technical excellence with business impact. By joining the CDI team, you will play a key role in shaping the data product application, building intuitive user experiences, scalable APIs, and robust platform capabilities that empower teams worldwide with timely, actionable insights. If you are passionate about solving complex problems, delivering exceptional user experiences, and driving continuous improvement across the full technology stack, we'd love to hear from you. 

Core Areas of Responsibility

- Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end features across the product, spanning React/Next. js frontend applications and Java Spring Boot backend services. 
 - Build secure, scalable REST APIs using OpenAPI-first design principles and implement robust authentication and authorization using Okta OIDC, OAuth2, and JWT-based security. 
 - Develop intuitive, accessible, and localized user experiences, including dashboards, analytics, data tables, and visualizations, ensuring WCAG-compliant implementations. 
 - Collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, UX designers, and stakeholders to deliver high-impact features and platform enhancements. 
 - Manage integrations with Databricks and other data platforms, optimizing API performance, database connectivity, and concurrent processing for large-scale analytics workloads. 
 - Implement comprehensive testing strategies across the stack, including unit, integration, API, and component testing, to ensure reliability and maintainability. 
 - Support cloud-native deployments using Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions, and GitOps practices, while maintaining observability through Datadog and production monitoring tools. 
 - Drive engineering excellence through code reviews, architectural discussions, performance optimization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

We get excited about candidates, like you, because. . . 

- 8+ years of experience building and delivering modern full-stack applications using Java and React-based technologies. 
 - Strong expertise in Java 21, Spring Boot, REST API design, and secure application development using OAuth2, OIDC, and JWT authentication. 
 - Hands-on experience with React, Next. js, TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks, including state management, API integration, and component-driven development. 
 - Solid understanding of SQL-based data platforms and API-driven integrations, with experience optimizing application performance and scalability. 
 - Experience working with containerized and cloud-native environments, including Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms such as GCP and/or AWS. 
 - Proven ability to write high-quality, maintainable code supported by automated testing frameworks and engineering best practices. 
 - Strong collaboration, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Experience with Databricks, GitOps/Flux CD, observability platforms (Datadog), internationalization, or analytics applications is a plus.

Center for Data and Insights (CDI) is a service oriented horizontal organization that is uniquely positioned within the company to be the trusted and unbiased source of timely data-based insights for Crunchyroll. Our vision is to inspire, support and guide our stakeholders to be data-aware and build the systems of intelligence to discover insights and act on them. data.title: QA lead
data.description:
We are hiring a hands-on QA Lead to own quality across our full commercial technology stack - every system a customer, distributor, or sales team touches between browsing a product and receiving an order. That chain starts on our brand sites and B2B customer portal, runs through search, product configuration, quoting and checkout, and lands in our ERP as a priced, credit-checked, shippable order. This is a doing role: you will write and execute test cases yourself, lead a small QA team to your standards, and give the documented go / no-go on every release. 

What You Will Own

- Customer-facing storefronts - brand sites and the B2B portal - onboarding, account and company management, catalogue, cart, checkout, order history, returns, documents. 
 - Search, discovery and product content - relevance, faceting, autocomplete, and the attributes, media, and cross-sell data behind them. 
 - Quote, configure and price - configurators, guided selling, quote creation and approval, contract and customer-specific pricing, lead times and availability. 
 - Integration and data flows - storefront to middleware to PIM, CRM and ERP - customer and product masters, order submission, shipment and invoice status, payload validation, failure handling, reconciliation. 
 - ERP and downstream reporting - order creation, pricing and tax, credit holds, inventory and fulfilment, invoicing, and the dashboards and data layer leadership runs the business on. 

What You Will Do

- Test strategy and planning. Own the strategy, plan, and estimate for every initiative - scope, depth, environments, data, entry and exit criteria. Maintain a live QA risk register and bring it to every release decision. Keep full traceability between requirements and test cases in both directions. 
 - Test case design and coverage - the core of this role. Personally author clear, complete test cases a new joiner could execute unaided. Decompose business processes - order-to-cash, quote-to-order, returns, onboarding, price change, product launch - into flows covering happy path, edge, negative, and recovery cases. Own the regression suite and the test data strategy, and peer-review the team's cases before execution starts. 
 - Test execution - manual and automated. Execute alongside the team across functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, smoke, SIT and UAT. Decide what earns automation and what stays manual. Own the automation outcome - coverage, reliability, runtime, and failures that point straight at the cause. Prepare and shepherd business UAT. 
 - Release management and QA sign-off. Own release readiness: define and run the checklist, chair go / no-go with engineering, product and business, and give the documented sign-off or the documented reason to hold. Cover environment readiness, deployment validation, production smoke tests, rollback verification, and post-release monitoring. Run the QA calendar across concurrent initiatives and keep change-control evidence audit-ready. 
 - Defect management and reporting. Triage, reproduce, prioritise and drive defects to closure. Publish QA status an executive can read in ninety seconds. Track defect-escape rate, requirement coverage, regression cycle time, and reopened defects - and run a quality retrospective on every release. 
 - Governance and team leadership. Define and enforce the QA governance framework - templates, conventions, severity definitions, quality gates, and protocol checklists - across your team and our delivery partners. Lead, coach and grow the QA engineers, allocate capacity across initiatives, and push testing earlier by reviewing requirements for testability before code is written. 

MUST HAVE

- 9+ years in QA, including 3+ years leading a team and owning quality for a platform or programme rather than a single application.

Position: Assoc Director/Director - Quality (Medical Coding) Coimbatore

Department: Medical Coding - Quality & Compliance

Profile Description

This role is responsible for defining and driving the quality strategy across one or more medical coding portfolios while ensuring coding accuracy, regulatory compliance, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement. The Director - Quality will lead enterprise quality initiatives, strengthen audit governance, partner with Operations and Training teams, and leverage analytics to improve coding quality, reduce denials, and enhance client outcomes. The role is also responsible for ensuring compliance with industry standards, payer guidelines, and organizational quality frameworks. 

Key Responsibilities

Process

- Own the Quality Management System (QMS) across assigned coding portfolios and ensure consistent execution of quality processes. 
 - Establish and maintain coding quality standards aligned with ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS, payer policies, CMS guidelines, NCCI edits, and specialty-specific coding requirements. 
 - Drive achievement of internal and client-defined quality SLAs across all accounts. 
 - Develop audit methodologies including concurrent, retrospective, prospective, focused, and validation audits. 
 - Ensure calibration across Quality, Operations, Training, and Client teams through standardized audit guidelines. 
 - Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for quality defects and implement effective corrective and preventive actions (CAPA). 
 - Monitor coding trends, denial trends, payer edits, and regulatory updates to proactively mitigate quality risks. 
 - Drive continuous process improvement initiatives through Lean, Six Sigma, and automation opportunities. 
 - Standardize quality scorecards, audit tools, and governance dashboards across portfolios. 
 - Ensure readiness for client audits, internal audits, compliance reviews, and external accreditation requirements. 
 - Establish governance around coding policy changes and ensure timely implementation across operations. People

- Build and lead a high-performing Quality organization across multiple coding specialties. 
 - Coach and mentor Quality Managers and Leads to improve audit effectiveness and leadership capabilities. 
 - Develop competency frameworks for auditors and quality professionals. 
 - Partner with Operations and Learning teams to identify knowledge gaps and implement targeted training interventions. 
 - Drive certification programs (AAPC/AHIMA), continuing education, and ongoing competency assessments. 
 - Promote a culture of quality ownership across Operations rather than quality inspection. 
 - Drive employee engagement, succession planning, talent retention, and career development within the Quality function. 
 - Conduct regular calibration sessions to ensure inter-auditor reliability and consistency. 
 - Foster innovation by encouraging adoption of AI-assisted quality monitoring and analytics. Client

- Serve as the Quality leader during client governance meetings including Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs), Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs), and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs). 
 - Present quality performance, audit findings, denial trends, and improvement initiatives to clients. 
 - Build trusted client relationships through proactive communication and consultative quality leadership. 
 - Partner with client coding compliance teams to resolve coding interpretation differences. 
 - Support client onboarding, transitions, and implementation activities by establishing quality governance. 
 - Lead provider education initiatives arising from coding audit findings when required. 
 - Ensure client quality KPIs, contractual obligations, and compliance expectations are consistently achieved. Financial

- Improve client ROI by reducing coding defects, rework, denials, and revenue leakage. 
 - Partner with Operations leadership to improve first-pass quality and operational efficiency. 
 - Support account profitability by minimizing quality-related cost of poor quality (COPQ). 
 - Measure and report financial impact of quality improvement initiatives. 
 - Participate in business reviews and support strategic growth opportunities through quality excellence. 
 - Drive automation initiatives that improve audit efficiency and reduce manual effort. 

Governance & Compliance

- Ensure compliance with HIPAA, CMS regulations, payer-specific guidelines, OIG recommendations, and organizational policies. 
 - Monitor coding compliance risks and implement mitigation strategies. 
 - Lead internal compliance audits and support external regulatory audits. 
 - Maintain documentation supporting quality governance and audit readiness. 
 - Ensure timely dissemination and implementation of coding guideline updates. Analytics & Continuous Improvement

- Develop executive dashboards highlighting quality trends, DPU, accuracy, denials, auditor agreement, productivity, and compliance metrics. 
 - Perform advanced trend analysis using audit data to identify systemic process improvements. 
 - Utilize statistical quality control techniques and predictive analytics to improve coding performance. 
 - Lead enterprise quality transformation initiatives leveraging AI and automation. 
 - Benchmark organizational performance against industry standards and best practices. Qualifications

- Graduate in any discipline is mandatory. 
 - BPT, MPT, B. Sc Nursing, M. Sc Nursing, B. Pharm, M. Pharm, BOT, or Life Sciences preferred. 
 - AHIMA or AAPC certification (CPC, CCS, CCS-P, CIC, CRC or equivalent) is mandatory. 
 - Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt preferred. 
 - MBA or Master's degree in Healthcare Administration or Quality Management will be an added advantage. 
 - MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, or other healthcare professional qualifications would be an added advantage. Role Prerequisites

- 12+ years of experience in Medical Coding with significant leadership experience in Coding Quality and Compliance. 
 - Minimum 5 years of managing enterprise quality programs across multiple specialties and clients. 
 - Extensive experience in coding audits, coding compliance, provider education, and denial prevention. 
 - Strong understanding of US healthcare regulations, payer policies, CMS guidelines, and coding compliance. 
 - Experience in leading quality transformation initiatives across large teams (300+ FTE preferred). 
 - Demonstrated experience working with executive leadership and external clients. 
 - Experience in AI-enabled quality assurance, analytics, or automation initiatives is preferred. Functional Competencies

- Expert knowledge of ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS, CMS Guidelines, and NCCI edits. 
 - Expertise across multiple coding specialties. 
 - Advanced coding audit methodology and compliance knowledge. 
 - Strong understanding of revenue cycle management and denial prevention. 
 - Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective & Preventive Action (CAPA). 
 - Statistical quality analysis and performance analytics. 
 - Governance reporting and executive dashboard preparation. 
 - Lean Six Sigma process improvement methodologies. 
 - Client relationship and stakeholder management. 
 - Advanced Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and Microsoft Office/G-Suite proficiency. 
 - Knowledge of AI-assisted coding validation and quality monitoring tools is preferred. Behavioral Competencies

- Accountability
 - Customer Service Orientation
 - Strategic Thinking

 - Coaching and Mentoring
 - Collaboration
 - Analytical Thinking
 - Decision Making
 - Continuous Improvement Mindset
 - Communication and Executive Presence
 - Change Leadership
