data.title: Supplier Quality Engineer - Mechanical
data.description:
Role: Supplier Quality Engineer - Mechanical

Department: New Product Development Location: Bengaluru, India Experience: 5-10 Years

Your Team: 

You'll be working with New Product Development - a group that runs on coffee and an infectious passion for building products that have never been built before. Our Flexible Energy Stack consists of the e^pack (battery pack) and e^pump (charging station), which unlock 15-minute rapid charging. 

Our philosophy: 

Break. Believe. Build. 

Break stuff, break assumptions, break the thumb rule. 

Believe in the team, the process, and through failures. 

Build fast, build passionately, build to simplify. 

Own it like you mean it. 

What you'll own: 

The Supplier Quality Engineer - Mechanical is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and process capability of mechanical components and assemblies supplied to the organization. The role will drive supplier quality from new product development through mass production, including PPAP, supplier audits, process validation, problem solving, supplier development, and continuous improvement. 

The role requires strong technical understanding of mechanical engineering, manufacturing processes, engineering drawings, GD&T, dimensional inspection, and supplier quality management. The engineer will work closely with Design, VCD, Manufacturing, IQC, and suppliers to prevent quality issues and establish robust supplier processes. 

What you'll do: 

Supplier Quality Management

- Own quality performance of assigned mechanical suppliers. 
 - Monitor supplier KPIs including PPM, rejection rate, line rejection, customer complaints, 8D closure, and repeat issues. Conduct regular supplier performance reviews and drive improvement plans for poor- performing suppliers. 
 - Lead supplier containment and corrective action for critical quality issues. 
 - Establish and maintain supplier quality improvement roadmaps. 
 - Support supplier selection, evaluation, development, and qualification. 
 - Develop suppliers to achieve consistent quality, process capability, and delivery performance

Mechanical Product & Process Quality

- Provide technical quality expertise for mechanical components, parts, and assemblies
 - Review engineering drawings, specifications, BOMs, GD&T requirements, material specifications, and engineering changes from a quality perspective. 
 - Ensure critical-to-quality and special characteristics are identified and effectively controlled. 
 - Assess and control manufacturing processes such as fabrication, welding, casting, forging, machining, sheet metal, heat treatment, surface treatment, and assembly. 
 - Evaluate process risks and establish appropriate process controls, inspection methods, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Drive process capability and quality improvement for critical characteristics. 
 - Support dimensional inspection and validation using appropriate measuring equipment and inspection methods

PPAP

- Support and drive supplier PPAP activities from new product development through SOP and mass production. 
 - Review and approve supplier PPAP deliverables. 
 - Review and challenge Process Flow, PFMEA, Control Plan, Work Instructions, MSA/GR&R, SPC, capability studies, inspection standards, and PPAP documentation. 
 - Ensure special characteristics and critical-to-quality characteristics are identified and adequately controlled. 
 - Conduct supplier Run-at-Rate and production readiness assessments. 
 - Review and approve PPAP submissions for new and modified mechanical components

Supplier Process Audit & Development

- Conduct supplier process audits based on IATF 16949, VDA 6. 3, customer-specific requirements, and internal standards
 - Conduct manufacturing process audits covering various mechanical manufacturing processes. 
 - Assess process robustness, process controls, traceability, inspection systems, and operator practices. 
 - Identify process risks and gaps through manufacturing process audits. 
 - Develop suppliers through structured improvement plans, technical training, and process improvement. 
 - Verify implementation and effectiveness of corrective actions through follow-up audits. 
 - Drive process capability improvement for critical characteristics

Problem Solving & Failure Analysis

- Lead technical investigation and root-cause analysis of mechanical quality issues. 
 - Drive effective containment, 8D, 5-Why, Fishbone, RCA, corrective and preventive actions with suppliers. 
 - Analyze issues related to dimensional variation, machining defects, casting defects, welding defects, fabrication defects, material issues, surface treatment, assembly, and functional performance. 
 - Use appropriate problem-solving and analytical techniques to identify root causes. Coordinate with suppliers and cross-functional teams to validate root cause and corrective actions. 
 - Ensure corrective actions are effective and prevent recurrence. Identify systemic improvement opportunities from recurring supplier quality issues

Incoming Quality & Manufacturing Support

- Work closely with IQC and Manufacturing Quality to establish appropriate incoming inspection requirements. 
 - Define critical inspection parameters, sampling requirements, inspection methods, and acceptance criteria based on supplier process capability and risk. 
 - Support production teams in resolving supplier-related quality issues. 
 - Establish defect standards and limit samples where required. 
 - Drive reduction of supplier-related line stoppages, production rejections, and quality escapes

Change & Sustenance Quality

- Review supplier ECR/ECN/PCN changes for potential quality risks. 
 - Ensure changes related to material, process, tooling, equipment, manufacturing location, or sub-suppliers are appropriately evaluated and validated. 
 - Ensure changes are validated and approved before implementation. 
 - Monitor quality performance after supplier/process/material changes. 
 - Drive continuous improvement projects for chronic supplier quality issues. 
 - Maintain lessons learned and standardization across suppliers

What you'll bring: 

- Education qualification
 - B. E. /B. Tech/Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related discipline
 - 5-10 years of experience in Supplier Quality / Quality Engineering, preferably in automotive, EV, or similar manufacturing industries
 - Strong hands-on experience in mechanical component manufacturing and supplier quality
 - Good knowledge of multiple manufacturing processes such as fabrication, welding, casting, forging, machining, sheet metal, heat treatment, surface treatment, and assembly
 - Good understanding of engineering drawings, GD&T, dimensional inspection, and measurement systems
 - Experience in supplier quality management, supplier audits, APQP, PPAP, and supplier development
 - Hands-on experience with PFMEA, Control Plan, MSA, SPC, Process Capability, 8D, RCA, and problem-solving tools

Preferred Experience (Good to Have): 

- Experience with VDA 6. 3 / VDA 6. 5
 - IATF 16949 Internal Auditor / Lead Auditor certification
 - Core Tools certification. Practical knowledge of GD&T and dimensional inspection
 - Experience with CMM, profile projector, height gauge, gauges, and other precision measurement equipment
 - Experience in supplier capability studies and manufacturing process audits
 - Experience with casting, forging, welding, fabrication, and machining suppliers
 - Experience in new product development and industrialization
 - Experience working with global automotive / industrial / construction equipment suppliers
 - Knowledge of material specifications, heat treatment, surface treatment, and metallurgicalrequirements

What matters to us: 

- Quality of work
 - Structured problem-solving
 - Dissatisfaction with mediocre work
 - Ability to multi-task and handle a dynamic working environment
 - Resilient attitude to bounce back after failing

About Us: 

Exponent is building the energy stack powering commercial EVs in India. Our proprietary battery and charging technology enables safe, reliable 15-minute rapid charging while delivering a 3, 000-cycle battery life warranty using standard lithium-ion cells. Today, our platform powers high-utilisation commercial vehicles - from three-wheelers to intercity buses, making electric mobility rapid, more reliable and more affordable than petroleum. 

Founded by Arun Vinayak (Founding Partner & Former Chief Product Officer, Ather Energy), Exponent is a 250+ member team of passionate builders solving some of the toughest engineering challenges in energy. 

If solving hard engineering problems across mechanics, thermal systems, power electronics, manufacturing, and the charging network, while staying obsessed with customer experience excites you, we'd love to build with you.

data.title: Software Development Engineer 1
data.description:
About The Team & Role

Team builds the infrastructure that keeps commercial drivers and fleets moving from fuel payments

at the pump to the apps and backend services that power authorizations, loyalty, and real-time

transaction data. As an SDE I, you'll join one of two full-stack engineering teams within WEX's

Mobility organization. 

Both teams own their systems end to end. The 10-4 (OTR) team builds the over-the-road platform

customer-facing APIs, event-driven microservices (Java/Spring Boot, Python), Kafka-based async

processing, payment and identity integrations (Fiserv, Okta), and the Android and iOS apps that

drivers use in the field. The NA Mobility Platform team builds and owns the shared frontend

infrastructure that product teams across the organization depend on Angular micro-frontends with

NestJS BFFs, Module Federation, a shared component library (Theseus UI), brand theming, and app

scaffolding via Theseus Builder. 

In both cases, you'll work across layers of a real production stack, ship to real users, and be

supported by engineers who care about doing the work well. We value clean APIs, strong testing

habits, and engineers who improve the systems they touch. You'll work closely with the product, 

other OTR teams, and your peers on features from design through implementation, testing, 

deployment, and production support. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Build specific components within an established architecture. You'll follow the patterns your team
 - has set, whether that's microservices, event-driven design, or component-based frontend, and
 - implement features correctly within those structures rather than redefining them. 
 - Write clean, compilable code with unit tests that meet the team's quality standards. Before you
 - start building, you'll ask the right questions about acceptance criteria and error states so you're
 - solving the right problem, not just writing code. 
 - Identify and fix bugs in well-defined tasks. You'll reproduce issues, pinpoint where in the code
 - they're happening, and work with senior engineers to land the right fix rather than just patching
 - the symptom. 
 - Handle low-priority support tickets as a first responder and participate in on-call rotations under
 - supervision. During incidents, you'll run specific checks and scripts as directed, building your
 - confidence with live systems gradually and safely. 
 - Contribute to basic observability by adding error and info logging that helps the team debug
 - issues. You won't be expected to triage complex production problems alone, but your logs should
 - make it easier for others to do so. 
 - Keep the team's process running smoothly. That means updating Jira daily, following the
 - Definition of Done, moving tickets through the right stages, and raising a flag immediately if
 - something is at risk. You don't deviate from the team's agreed process without checking first. 
 - Show up fully in team rituals like standups, backlog grooming, and demos. You'll listen to
 - stakeholder feedback during demos to understand how your work actually lands with users, not
 - just whether it passed the acceptance criteria. 
 - Use AI tools like Cursor or similar to reduce boilerplate, get unstuck faster, and understand error
 - messages more quickly. You own the quality of everything you ship though, which means
 - validating AI-generated output rather than passing it through unchecked. 
 - Update documentation when you find something inaccurate or missing. Good documentation is
 - part of the job, and you'll be expected to keep it honest as you learn the system. 

Experience You'll Bring

- You have a solid grounding in data structures, algorithms, and software design from a B. S. or M. S. in Computer Science from a reputed institution, with 0 to 1 year of professional experience. 
 - You're comfortable writing clean, compilable, tested code in at least one of Java, Python, or TypeScript/JavaScript, and you understand what makes code maintainable, not just functional. 
 - You understand the testing pyramid and have written unit tests as part of coursework, an internship, or a personal project. You see tests as part of the feature, not an afterthought. 
 - You know never to hardcode secrets, you have a basic understanding of IAM and role-based access control, and you're willing to learn which compliance requirements like PCI or SOC apply to the systems you work on. 
 - You know your way around Git and pull requests, can deploy to an existing CI/CD pipeline, and can tell when your specific commit caused a build failure. 
 - When you're blocked, you ask focused questions and explain what you've already tried. You flag a deadline risk the moment you see it, not the day before it's due. 
 - You receive code review feedback without getting defensive, you actively learn your team's standards and tools, and you're comfortable switching between tasks within a project when priorities shift. 

Preferred Qualifications

- A degree in computer science software engineering from a reputed institution. 
 - Internship or co-op experience where you shipped real code to a production or staging

data.title: Senior AI Evaluation Analyst
data.description:
Senior AI Evaluation Analyst

Location: Kochi

Experience: 5-8 Years

Role Overview

Seeking an experienced and detail-oriented professional to join its Machine Learning Science team, supporting the development and improvement of AI-powered travel products. The team works on conversational AI agents that help travelers discover options, compare products, plan trips, and receive assistance throughout their travel journey. 

You will play a key role in evaluating the quality, accuracy, relevance, and reliability of AI-generated responses against established guidelines and quality metrics. You will analyze evaluation results, identify recurring errors and quality gaps, and translate findings into actionable insights that help improve AI agent performance. 

This role requires a strong foundation in data annotation, quality evaluation, analytical problem-solving, and guideline-based decision-making. The position is suited to professionals who enjoy hands-on evaluation and analysis of AI outputs rather than traditional business reporting or dashboard development. 

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is an experienced, hands-on professional who combines strong evaluation and quality assurance skills with analytical thinking. They should be comfortable reviewing large volumes of information, applying structured guidelines, identifying recurring quality issues, and converting observations into meaningful insights. 

Candidates with experience in AI evaluation, data annotation, content quality, search relevance, or similar quality-focused roles are encouraged to apply. Direct experience with LLMs or conversational AI is an advantage but is not mandatory for candidates with strong transferable experience. 

Key Responsibilities

- Evaluate AI-generated responses from conversational agents against predefined guidelines, evaluation criteria, and quality standards. 
 - Perform and review data annotation, labelling, and classification to assess the accuracy, relevance, completeness, and appropriateness of AI-generated content. 
 - Identify and document incorrect, misleading, incomplete, inconsistent, or irrelevant responses, including potential AI hallucinations. 
 - Conduct quality assurance reviews to ensure consistency, accuracy, and adherence to evaluation guidelines. 
 - Analyze large and complex datasets to identify recurring errors, quality trends, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement. 
 - Interpret quality metrics such as error rates, evaluation consistency, reviewer disagreement, and other relevant indicators. 
 - Investigate ambiguous or borderline cases and apply sound judgment while adhering to established evaluation criteria. 
 - Prepare clear documentation of evaluation findings, root causes, observations, and recommended improvements. 
 - Use Excel or Google Sheets and, where applicable, basic SQL to filter, analyze, and summarize evaluation data. 
 - Collaborate with Machine Learning Scientists, AI product teams, and other stakeholders to communicate quality insights and support improvements in AI agent performance. 
 - Contribute to the refinement of evaluation guidelines, quality frameworks, and review processes based on observed issues and emerging patterns. 
 - Maintain accurate documentation and track identified issues through appropriate ticketing and workflow management systems. 

Required Skills and Qualifications

- 5-8 years of relevant experience in data annotation, data labeling, AI evaluation, content quality, quality assurance, search relevance evaluation, or similar guideline-based assessment roles. 
 - Strong experience evaluating data, content, or system outputs against predefined guidelines, quality standards, and measurable criteria. 
 - Demonstrated ability to analyze large datasets, identify patterns, investigate quality issues, and derive actionable insights. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, particularly when dealing with ambiguous or inconsistent information. 
 - Excellent attention to detail and the ability to apply evaluation criteria consistently. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data filtering, analysis, quality tracking, and reporting. 
 - Strong written communication skills and the ability to document findings, explain issues, and communicate insights clearly. 
 - Ability to work independently on evaluation tasks while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. 
 - Genuine interest in artificial intelligence, conversational AI, and data-driven product improvement. 
 - Experience with Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows, AI training data validation, model output assessment, or LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. 

Good to Have

- Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, conversational agents, or AI-generated content evaluation. 
 - Familiarity with evaluating AI responses for factual accuracy, relevance, completeness, helpfulness, and hallucinations. 
 - Basic SQL knowledge for extracting, filtering, and analyzing datasets. 
 - Experience with quality metrics such as error rates, inter-annotator agreement, reviewer disagreement, and evaluation consistency. 
 - Experience maintaining evaluation guidelines, quality documentation, review workflows, or issue-tracking systems. 
 - Exposure to travel, hospitality, customer experience, search relevance, policy evaluation, or content quality operations.

data.title: DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Job Title: DevOps Engineer (AI & Automation)

Location: Noida

Experience: Min 3 Years

Department: Engineering / Infrastructure & Platform

Role Overview

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to own our core DevOps administration while leading the

implementation of AI-driven development workflows. In this role, you will manage

repositories, establish automated CI/CD pipelines, and design autonomous coding, testing, 

and code-review agents using technologies like Claude Code, Anthropic Agent SDK, and

GitHub Copilot Workspace/Agents. You will bridge classical platform engineering with AI

native software development lifecycles. 

Key Responsibilities

1. DevOps Administration & Repository Management

• Repository Architecture: Design, enforce, and maintain repository branching strategies

(e. g. , Trunk-Based, GitFlow, Feature-Branching) and access governance across

organizations. 

• CI/CD Pipeline Engineering: Build, optimize, and secure multi-environment

deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps with caching

and automated quality gates. 

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Provision and manage cloud resources using Terraform, 

Pulumi, or Bicep, ensuring zero-drift environments. 

• DevSecOps Integration: Implement automated secret scanning (e. g. , Gitleaks), 

dependency vulnerability checks (Trivy/Snyk), and SAST/DAST within CI steps. 

2. AI Coding Agent Setup & Branch Workflows

• Coding Agent Deployment: Configure and orchestrate developer AI agents (e. g. , 

Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Cloud Agents, or custom agent frameworks) to perform

autonomous task execution across different Git branches. 

• Repository Context & Prompts: Author and maintain repository-level context files

(AGENTS. md, CLAUDE. md, custom system prompts, and MCP server integrations) to

steer agents toward project conventions and architecture patterns. 

• Multi-Branch Automation: Configure workflow triggers that allow AI agents to pick up

issue tickets, work within dedicated feature/bugfix branches, and automatically draft

PRs. 

3. Automated Code Review & Testing Agents

• Code Review Agents: Integrate automated AI code-review agents within pull request

workflows to perform compliance checks, security audits, and style adherence reviews

before human sign-off. 

• Automated Testing & QA Agents: Build autonomous testing pipelines where agents

analyze diffs, generate missing unit/integration tests, triage test failures, and suggest

fixes directly in CI. 

• Governance & Safeguards: Establish strict safety guardrails, execution sandboxes, and

human-in-the-loop approvals for agent-generated code. 

Technical Qualifications

Must-Have Experience

• Core DevOps (2+ Years): Hands-on expertise in CI/CD pipeline building, Docker, 

Kubernetes, and IaC (Terraform/Bicep/CloudFormation). 

• Git Administration: Mastery of Git internals, branch protection rules, merge strategies, 

and repository permissions. 

• AI Coding Tools & SDKs: Proven experience configuring or extending GitHub Copilot

(Copilot Workspace, Agent Mode, Custom Instructions/Skills) or Claude (Claude Code

CLI, Anthropic API/SDK, Model Context Protocol). 

• Automation Languages: High proficiency in Python, Bash, or TypeScript/Node. js for

building custom hooks, bots, and API integrations. 

Nice-to-Have Experience

• Experience building multi-agent orchestrations (e. g. , CrewAI, LangChain, or custom

sub-agents). 

• Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) server setups to connect AI agents with

internal tooling, databases, and monitoring systems. 

• Deep understanding of DevSecOps standards and cloud infrastructure cost

optimization. 

Expected 90-Day Deliverables

Month 1: Audit existing repos and establish standardized CI/CD templates and branch

protection rules across all development projects. 

Month 2: Deploy initial Claude / GitHub Copilot agent workflows for automated PR code

reviews and unit test generation. 

Month 3: Fully operationalize an end-to-end agentic workflow where feature tickets can be

assigned to branch-specific coding agents to generate, test, and submit initial pull requests.

Lead Software Engineer

Overview--The Lead Software Engineer provides technical leadership for the Transaction Lookup Services (TLS) platform, driving the design, development, and support of scalable, resilient, and secure transaction lookup APIs and data services. This role partners with Product, TPMs, Architects, Data Engineering, and Operations teams to deliver enterprise solutions supporting transaction processing, disputes, chargebacks, refunds, and historical transaction retrieval capabilities. Role-

- Lead the architecture, design, and development of microservices and APIs using Java, Spring Boot, REST, and gRPC to support mission-critical transaction lookup services. 
 - Design and implement highly scalable, low-latency solutions leveraging Oracle, SQL, PL/SQL, Hadoop, Hive, Impala, and Spark for transactional and historical data retrieval. 
 - Define API contracts, integration patterns, and service standards while ensuring security through TLS/mTLS, OAuth, JWT, and secure coding practices. 
 - Drive performance optimization efforts across application and database layers, including query tuning, indexing strategies, caching, and capacity planning. 
 - Lead modernization initiatives utilizing Kubernetes, Docker, cloud-native architectures, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code practices. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and implementation roadmaps.

 - Ensure production readiness through observability and monitoring using tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Prometheus, and Grafana, implementing proactive alerting and operational dashboards. 
 - Lead incident resolution, root cause analysis, and reliability improvements to meet platform availability and performance SLAs. 
 - Mentor software engineers and senior engineers, providing technical guidance, coaching, and leadership across multiple initiatives. 

Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements that enhance platform scalability, resiliency, maintainability, and developer productivity. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. 
 - 8+ years of experience designing and developing enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, and distributed systems. 
 - Strong experience with Oracle databases, SQL optimization, data modeling, and performance tuning in high-volume transactional environments.

 - Hands-on experience deploying and operating applications on Kubernetes and containerized environments. 
 - Strong understanding of API design, service integration, security frameworks, and authentication mechanisms. 
 - Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Git, Jenkins, SonarQube, Artifactory, and automated testing frameworks. 
 - Proven ability to lead technical design sessions, influence architecture decisions, and drive engineering excellence across teams. 

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively across engineering and business organizations. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices;

data.title: Lead Back End Engineer
data.description:
This is a leadership role in our engineering team - not just a cog in the wheel. 

This is not a "maintenance" role. This is engineering leadership-owning the backend architecture of a global, privacy-first communication platform. You'll lead by example, guide a high-calibre team, and ensure our backend systems remain blazing-fast, rock-solid, and uncompromising on security. You'll be at the intersection of code and leadership-mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and setting engineering standards that define how a global product is built. 

Who are we?

We are a young product company scaling fast and outgrowing the startup tag-with global scale in our crosshairs. We don't do "okay. " We give everything we've got to build the best communication platform in the world. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top institutions-people who care deeply about the craft, performance, and purpose. You'll learn more in 6 months here than most engineers do in 3 years elsewhere. We're intense. High-strung. Focused. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top-tier

backgrounds. But what defines us is not our degrees-it's our refusal to compromise on quality, performance, or privacy. 

What are we building?

WrkTalk is the world's first zero-access, zero-spam enterprise communication product that operates on a structural privacy architecture. One that's already earned the trust of large enterprises like L&T Finance, Adani Group, and Kalyan Jewellers - just to name a few of our enterprise clients. This is not an MVP. This is production-grade software that secures communication for thousands-and soon, millions-of professionals worldwide. 

What's the role?

• Architect backend systems in NestJS and Golang to meet global scale and enterprise-grade performance. 

• Drive design for microservices, real-time comms (WebSockets, WebRTC), and data stores (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Lead code reviews, enforce coding standards, and maintain CI/CD discipline. 

• Mentor and upskill backend engineers. 

• Collaborate cross-functionally with frontend, DevOps, and product leaders. 

• Own technical problem-solving-anticipate bottlenecks, make hard calls, and prevent tech debt from being parked for "later. "

• Manage task allocation, workflow discipline, and ensure smooth collaboration with frontend and DevOps. 

The tech here is serious. 

We work on socket-driven comms infrastructure, distributed control towers, multi-category encryption, root detection, app kill-switches, dynamic guest access, device-level lockout, and OOO/ DND logic layered with smart whitelisting. This is not lightweight app dev. This is protocol-layer decision-making. 

Who should apply?

• 6-8+ years in backend engineering, with at least 2 years in a leadership role. 

• Expertise in Golang and Node. js (NestJS). 

• Strong database tuning skills (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Solid understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, and scalable deployment. 

• Experience building real-time systems at scale. 

• Proven ability to lead technical discussions and inspire engineering teams. 

• Track record of shipping production-grade, high-performance systems. 

Why should you join?

• Because you want to own backend architecture-not just follow it

• Because you'll work directly with established founders, not buried under layers

• Because you'll ship real, deeply engineered features used by large number of enterprise users

• Because you'll grow 10x faster here-in experience, learning, and impact

• And because if you walk this road with us for 3-4 years, it'll catapult you into a tech orbit or fame and glory you never imagined

Where are we located?

We're based in Navi Mumbai and building for the world.

Job Description: 

The Service Desk Lead is responsible for the day-to-day operational leadership of the IT Service Desk team, ensuring SLA targets are met, escalations are managed effectively, and analysts are supported, coached, and held accountable to performance standards. This role acts as the bridge between the Service Desk team and IT management, owning team-level metrics, scheduling, quality, and process governance while remaining hands-on for critical incidents. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Supervise the Service Desk team, including task allocation, shift/roster scheduling, coverage planning, attendance/leave management, and shift swaps. 
 - Conduct coaching, identify skill gaps, coordinate training and onboarding plans, and handle first-line people issues. 
 - Own overall team performance against SLAs (FCR, ART, CSAT, backlog, response/abandonment rates), monitoring queues in real time and reallocating resources during volume spikes or shortages. 
 - Act as incident commander for major incidents (P1/P2), driving communication, coordinating with Level 2/3 and vendors, and ensuring post-incident reviews are completed. 
 - Own escalation paths between Service Desk and Level 2/3 teams, and manage the ITSM tool's queues, routing rules, and SLA configuration. 
 - Review and approve knowledge base articles, SOPs, and runbooks for accuracy and consistency. 
 - Drive continuous improvement, analysing incident trends for root-cause/problem elimination, identifying automation and self-service opportunities, and leading quality audits (ticket/call/chat reviews) with structured analyst feedback. 
 - Own Service Desk SOPs, escalation matrices, and onboarding documentation; 
 - Serve as the primary stakeholder contact for Service Desk performance and major incidents; prepare and present performance reports to IT leadership. 
 - Represent the Service Desk in cross-functional forums (Change Advisory Board, Problem Management reviews, rollout planning) and lead shift handovers and team huddles. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. 
 - 5-8 years of experience in an IT Service Desk, Help Desk, or Technical Support role guiding analysts including at least 2 years in a team lead, supervisory, or shift lead capacity
 - Strong knowledge on ITIL process and hands on of ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or similar ticketing systems.

data.title: Engineering Lead (EL3)
data.description:
About Whatfix

Whatfix is an AI platform that makes enterprise software, and now enterprise AI, usable for the people who depend on it. We call this userization: technology should adapt to the user, not the other way round. 

Our proprietary AI engine, ScreenSense, reads what a user is doing inside an application and the intent behind it. It then delivers guidance, knowledge and automation in the flow of work. ScreenSense powers Digital Adoption, Product Analytics and Mirror, with Whatfix AI Agents built into each. Our newer AI-first products include Seek, an AI-native assistant that understands business context and acts across applications, and Mirror 2. 0, which pairs system and role simulation with assessment. 

- 700+ enterprise customers, including 80+ of the Fortune 500
 - ~$270M raised, including a $125M Series E led by Warburg Pincus with SoftBank Vision Fund 2
 - Named a Leader in Digital Adoption Platforms by Gartner, Forrester, IDC and Everest Group, and a Gartner Customers' Choice for DAP in 2024 and 2025
 - Seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore and Australia

The role

This is a leadership role for someone who still builds. 

Engineering at Whatfix has changed how it works. Every engineer takes a problem from spec to production, with coding agents doing much of the implementation. People own the judgment: what to build, how it should work, and whether what the agent produced is actually right. 

As an Engineering Leader (EL3), you own engineering for a product or platform area end to end. You lead a team of around 7-12 or more engineers and shape the human + agent system they work in. You stay close enough to the code to make, and challenge, the important technical calls. And you still ship. 

What you'll own

- Your area, end to end. Delivery, architecture, reliability, production health, and infrastructure and AI cost for a product or platform area. 
 - The technical bar. Important design decisions in your area come from you or go through you. You take architecture choices to our Architecture Review Board (ARB) and guide other teams that touch your code. 
 - Production quality. Work goes live with a spec, automated tests, monitoring and runbooks. Production issues get root-cause fixes and systemic improvements, not patches. 
 - Customer impact. You stay on top of customer issues, keep customers unblocked, and make sure Presales, Solutions and Support can confidently represent what your area does. 
 - The roadmap, with Product. You bring a clear technical and customer point of view, plan sprints, run spikes to retire risk early, and balance new work against tech debt and stability. 

How your team builds

You don't just encourage AI adoption. You build the system that makes delegating to agents reliable. 

- Spec-first by default. Every meaningful change starts with a written spec: the problem, expected outcome, constraints and acceptance criteria. 
 - The right context and guardrails. Repository context and instruction files, shared specs and prompts, tooling and review workflows that let engineers hand substantial work to coding agents with confidence. 
 - A Definition of Done that holds up with agents in the loop. Spec in the repo, tests before delegation, human review of agent-generated code, context files kept current. 
 - Engineers who verify, not just generate. You coach the team to write executable specs, delegate well, and critically review what comes back. Nothing ships because it compiles or passes its own generated tests. 
 - Clear accountability. Every engineer owns what they merge, whether a person or an agent wrote it. 
 - Safe use of AI. Approved tools only, with security, privacy, data and licensing requirements intact. 

You still build

We mean this literally. With coding agents, there's no longer a trade-off between leading a team and shipping product. 

- You take real problems from spec to production, using coding agents. 
 - You review specs, designs and agent-generated code closely enough to catch the race condition, the missing index or the weak assumption. 
 - You debug production issues hands-on and can explain, change and fix any system your team owns. 
 - You prototype and run spikes on the hardest technical questions before the team commits to an approach. 

Leading the team

- Manage around 7-12 engineers directly, and over time possibly a further team through another Engineering Leader. 
 - Own performance end to end: expectations, ongoing feedback, reviews, compensation inputs, promotions, and managing underperformance, with support from HR. 
 - Give clear, direct feedback all the time, not just at review time. 
 - Build a team that can run several large initiatives in parallel, without you as the bottleneck and with no single points of failure. 
 - Hire for Engineering, not just your team. Raise the bar in interviews and help close strong senior talent. 
 - Build a culture of trust and ownership, where good work gets recognized publicly and in real time. 

What success looks like

- First 90 days: You know your area's architecture, production health and cost. You've shipped real work yourself through the team's agent workflow. Every engineer knows exactly what you expect from them. 
 - By 6 months: Specs, the Definition of Done and agent guardrails are followed consistently, not just on paper. Customer issues are under control. Product and customer-facing teams come to you first for your area. 
 - By 12 months: Your team owns several large features at once without leaning on you. You can show measurable gains in cycle time, rework or escaped defects that come from better specs and delegation, not longer hours. At least one engineer has grown into a bigger scope. 

What you bring

- Usually 8-15 years in software engineering, including time managing engineers directly. What you've owned matters more to us than the number. 
 - Strong engineering judgment in system design and distributed systems, including performance, scalability, fault tolerance and high availability. 
 - Full-stack fluency. Our services are mostly Java and Spring Boot, our frontends TypeScript and React, running on Docker, Kubernetes and cloud-native CI/CD with relational and NoSQL stores. We don't hire by stack boundary. You work across it. 
 - Real experience with coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot on meaningful work. You've delegated substantial work, seen where agents go wrong, and changed how you scope and verify as a result. 
 - A track record of leading teams that ship production-quality software, and of growing engineers who now own complex systems. 
 - Customer-first thinking. You tie technical decisions to business outcomes. 
 - Clear, structured communication. You can explain a hard trade-off to an engineer, a product manager or a customer. 
 - Good to have: experience building AI features into products, such as LLM integration, retrieval, agents or evaluation harnesses. 

This may not be the right role if

- Your current role is mostly reviews, planning and people management, and you don't miss building. 
 - You see coding agents as a productivity add-on rather than a change in how engineering gets done. 
 - You'd rather own one layer of the stack than a whole problem. 

How we'll assess you

Our interviews look like the job. You'll use a coding agent of your choice wherever it fits. 

- Discovery conversation with a peer or our Head of Engineering
 - Problem solving with a coding agent: build something that works, adapt it when a new constraint lands, explain what the agent produced, and review AI-generated code critically. 
 - System design and review: work through a larger problem end to end, then critique an existing design or code. 
 - Leadership conversation: how you've built and run teams, including a real example of meaningful work you handed to an agent, the context you gave it, and what you caught in review. 

Working at Whatfix

How we work. We believe being together in the office 4-5 days a week makes communication easier, builds community and speeds up innovation. 

Benefits (India). Best-in-class medical insurance, lunch and dinner buffet, doorstep cab drop, education sponsorship, internal and global mobility programs, and the chance to represent Whatfix at global events. 

Our values. Customer First · Empathy · Transparency · Fail Fast and Scale Fast · No Hierarchies for Communication · Deep Dive and Innovate · Trust, Do It as You Own It. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse people because of, not in spite of, their differences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability status.

data.title: Senior Java Developer Assistant Vice President
data.description:
Job Summary

At Citi, we believe in the power of engineering to drive success and foster a culture where innovation, collaboration, and professional growth thrive. 

Join Citi's Oasys Financial team as a Senior Java Developer and take a pivotal role in a landmark modernization project. Oasys is Citi's core sub-ledger system for the Over-the-Counter (OTC) business, processing millions of trades daily. We are embarking on a major strategic initiative to transform this key platform, moving it from a legacy system built on shell scripts into a state-of-the-art architecture based on modern Java microservices. 

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated technical leader to drive the design, development, and delivery of our next-generation financial accounting systems, ensuring they meet the highest standards of scalability, performance, and security. 

Key Responsibilities

As a Senior Developer, you will be a technical leader at the heart of this transformation. Your duties will include: 

- Re-Architect and Modernize: Lead the re-architecture of our legacy financial ledger, migrating complex business logic from shell scripts and stored procedures into a modern, event-driven platform built on Java microservices. 
 - Hands-On Development: Design, develop, and implement high-performance, scalable, and secure Java applications that will form the new backbone of our financial systems. 
 - Champion Code Quality: Write clean, well-documented, and thoroughly testable Java code. Act as a champion for software engineering best practices, including Object-Oriented Design, SOLID principles, and Test-Driven Development (TDD). 
 - Database Integration: Collaborate closely with database teams to design and implement strategies for data integration and migration as part of the transition to the new Java architecture. 
 - Problem Solving: Act as a key technical expert, troubleshooting and resolving complex issues that arise during system migration, modernization, and in production. 
 - Mentorship and Leadership: Conduct rigorous code reviews, mentor junior developers, and contribute to the continuous improvement of team standards and development processes. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work in close partnership with product managers, business analysts, and other global teams to ensure technical solutions are perfectly aligned with evolving business requirements. 

Qualifications

Required: 

- Experience: 8+ years of hands-on professional experience in designing and building robust, scalable, and maintainable server-side applications using Java. 
 - Technical Depth: Strong expertise in Object-Oriented Design, data structures, design patterns, and concurrency. 
 - Database Skills: 5+ years of significant experience with SQL databases, demonstrating proficiency in writing complex queries and optimizing database performance. 
 - Operating Systems: Strong command of the Unix/Linux environment, including familiarity with system-level operations and administration. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 

Preferred (Highly Desirable): 

- Legacy Modernization: Proven experience in migrating complex, large-scale legacy systems (particularly those heavily reliant on shell scripting and monolithic databases) to modern, cloud-native microservices architectures. 
 - Modern Technologies: Deep familiarity with modern Java frameworks (e. g. , Spring Boot), microservices architecture, and containerization platforms (e. g. , Docker, OpenShift). 
 - AI-Assisted Development: Experience using AI-powered development tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Claude, Devin) to accelerate development and improve code quality. 
 - Database Systems: Hands-on experience with enterprise-level SQL databases such as MSSQL. 
 - Scripting: Proficiency in shell scripting, which will be essential for understanding and migrating the legacy system. 
 - Domain Knowledge: A solid understanding of the financial accounting domain, including concepts like posting, calculations, and sub-ledger processes. 

Why Join Us?

- Impact: Take a leadership role in a high-visibility modernization project that will directly shape the future of Citi's global financial operations. 
 - Challenge: Solve unique and rewarding technical challenges while dismantling a legacy system and building a cutting-edge platform from the ground up. 
 - Culture: Be part of a world-class engineering team in a dynamic, collaborative, and supportive environment that encourages innovation and continuous learning. 
 - Growth: Access Citi's extensive professional development resources and enjoy clear pathways for career advancement within a leading global financial institution.

data.title: Test Development Engineering Technical Leader
data.description:
Meet the Team

Within Cisco's Product Operations, we transform engineering innovation into products that power the internet - from enterprise networks to the world's most demanding hyper-scaler AI infrastructure. Our Manufacturing Test Development team sits at the critical intersection of design engineering and global manufacturing, ensuring that Cisco's most complex systems are launched with the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and scale. We are a cross-functional, globally connected team collaborating closely with Hardware, Software, and Supply Chain partners across multiple time zones to bring next-generation products to life. Our work directly impacts the reliability and performance of Cisco's high-end router portfolio, including our latest AI-optimized hyper-scaler platforms. If you thrive on solving hard problems at the edge of what's technically possible, this is the team for you. 

Your Impact

- As a Manufacturing Test Development Engineer, you will lead the end-to-end test strategy from Design for Testability (DFT) assessments through mass production readiness. 
 - Drive the development and deployment of board and system-level automated functional test processes at contract manufacturing sites globally, ensuring maximum test coverage and manufacturing efficiency. 
 - Develop robust Python-based test automation scripts and leverage data analytics to continuously improve test capacity, yield, and overall product quality. 
 - Serve as the expert resource for product failure analysis and fault isolation, guiding debug processes at both component and system level to accelerate resolution. 
 - Collaborate with global cross-functional teams across Hardware, Software, and Supply Chain to coordinate proto-build support and ensure seamless production ramp. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication, or Computer Science Engineering. 
 - 8+ years of advanced experience in product test and validation within a multinational corporate environment. 
 - Expert-level understanding of hardware development processes from concept through end-of-life, including manufacturing test solutions such as ICT and Boundary Scan (BSCAN). 
 - Deep proficiency in Ethernet technologies (10/100/400/800G) and hardware protocols including I2C, SPI, PCIe, and SerDes. 
 - Advanced Python scripting skills with demonstrated experience developing automated test frameworks and analytics-driven improvement processes. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, resolve technical conflicts, and make data-driven decisions in a fast-paced environment. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience specifying, developing, and procuring test fixtures and traffic test solutions including Spirent or IXIA for high-speed interface validation. 
 - Proven track record to lead Design for Testability (DFT) assessments and define risk mitigation plans in partnership with hardware and software engineering teams. 
 - Experience supporting proto-builds and driving mass production readiness across globally distributed contract manufacturing sites. 
 - Dedicated and adaptable, with a track record of effective collaboration across global time zones. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

Regeneron is seeking a Manager, Integrated Data Review (IDR) & Quality to support and help build our Integrated Data Review capability in India. data.title: Engineering Director
data.description:
Who We Are

We are Two Circles. We are a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues by knowing fans best. 

We work with clients to help them understand and influence fan behaviour - how fans spend their money, the events they attend, the channels they respond to, and the content they engage with. We use this understanding to help our clients grow both direct-to-consumer and business-to-business revenues. 

Our platforms and services are trusted by over 1, 000 clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL, Nike and Amazon. We are over 1, 000 people, based across 15 offices worldwide, delivering work for sports and entertainment organisations of all shapes and sizes. 

India is a long-term commitment for Two Circles. We're already trusted by the BCCI, one of the biggest and most important properties in world sport, and our Hyderabad office sits at the heart of that relationship. Being here, and succeeding here, is central to how we build a better future for the sports and entertainment industry globally. 

Hyderabad is a Two Circles office, not a GCC. Today it's tech-centric, but our ambition is to diversify what we build here over time, growing into a broad Two Circles presence rather than staying confined to technology propositions. 

What You Will Do

We're looking for an Engineering Director to lead our Hyderabad delivery organisation. You'll lead a team of around 50 engineers, QA and delivery specialists, and the team is still growing. They work across our Data and Digital Products & CRM practices and deliver for clients and colleagues around the world. 

You'll report to our APAC Managing Director, with a dotted line to our Engineering Directors for Data and for Digital Products & CRM. As the most senior Two Circles leader in our Hyderabad office, you'll also play an important role in our work with the BCCI, our most important partner in India. The role is based in Hyderabad. 

This is a leadership role first and foremost. You'll build and run a high-performing team and set the tone for its culture. You'll bring discipline and predictability to how we deliver and make the India team's performance visible to the rest of the business. 

You'll bring enough fluency in engineering and software delivery to earn the respect of our team, understanding trade-offs, spotting risk, and knowing when and how deep to go. You'll govern quality and standards within the technical direction set by our global Engineering Directors and ensure excellence in the process for how we deliver software. You won't be expected to set that direction yourself, but you will be expected to make sure it's executed brilliantly in India. 

We want Hyderabad to be known, by 2029, not just for delivering the work, but for shaping it, owning it, and making it better. That means more ownership of outcomes, greater exposure to our clients and their problems, more leaders and careers built from within Hyderabad, and a reputation for ideas, innovation and smart use of AI, all while protecting the spirit and connection that makes Two Circles what it is as we grow. You'll be the person most accountable for getting us there. 

Key Responsibilities

Leading the team and its culture

- Lead, grow and retain the India team, including recruitment, onboarding and development of new team members
 - Co-own the culture of our Hyderabad office with our HR Lead. You'll treat culture as a core part of your job, not something handed off to the HR team. You will be the role model of Two Circles spirit in the office
 - Build an India leadership layer of Engineering Managers, QA leadership and delivery leadership. Embed progression frameworks, career pathways and regular, structured feedback
 - Be a visible, accessible leader in the office. Build strong relationships and encourage the face-to-face collaboration that builds trust and improves delivery

Delivery and engineering excellence

- Own the software delivery lifecycle across India projects, with consistent processes that drive quality and predictability
 - Oversee QA and release management standards across India builds, aligned with our global standards
 - Stay close to the work: attend key governance forums, review delivery health weekly, and step in when projects need support
 - Work with our Tech Leads to ensure technical standards and architectural approaches are followed, in line with the direction set by our Engineering Directors for Data and Digital Products & CRM
 - Embed the agentic engineering practices being rolled out across our global teams. Drive adoption in India and share what you learn
 - Help the India team take increasing ownership of outcomes end-to-end, including design, not just execution, and reduce reliance on other regions to unblock problems

Performance, metrics and governance

- Create and run a monthly governance process and health report for the India team. It should cover hiring, onboarding, attrition, utilisation, quality and performance, and progress on major initiatives
 - Own delivery, quality and team health metrics, including code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues. Track how the project leaders the India team works with in other regions rate its work
 - Own utilisation and cost efficiency across India delivery. Propose the India hiring plan and work with Delivery Directors globally on resource planning and hotspots

Global collaboration

- Give leadership upward visibility, and give teams clarity on priorities, outcomes and decisions
 - Work with Directors in Melbourne, London and Vancouver to develop operating models that let teams work smoothly across regions
 - Work effectively across time zones and cultures, bringing structure and clarity to complex, global work
 - Help Hyderabad become a knowledge hub, not just a delivery team: bring in what's working well from London, Melbourne and Vancouver, and feed Hyderabad's own innovations back out to the rest of the business

What success looks like in your first year

- A high-performing team, shown in hard metrics such as code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues and in strong feedback from the project leaders the team works with across regions
 - A strong culture in our Hyderabad office, measured against our regular pulse checks
 - Our agentic engineering practices widely adopted across the India team
 - A clear monthly view of the India team's health, shared with the wider business through a regular governance process
 - An India leadership layer in place that can support continued growth

Requirements

- 15+ years' experience, including senior leadership of an organisation of 50+ people across engineering, QA and delivery, and experience managing managers
 - Direct leadership of engineering and QA teams, ideally having started your career as an engineer. You can contribute credibly to architecture and code-quality discussions across both data engineering and digital product engineering
 - Senior client-facing experience in a services, agency or consultancy business
 - Experience working within a multi-region or global delivery model
 - Hands-on ownership of the software delivery lifecycle, delivery processes, resourcing and talent management
 - Strong emotional intelligence and resilience, and the ability to influence senior peers and stakeholders
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to lead and inspire teams and engage a wide range of internal and external stakeholders
 - An interest in AI-enabled development practices and the drive to lead their adoption
 - Eligibility to work in India
 - Able to travel regularly to Vancouver, London and Melbourne

Nice to have

- Familiarity with the platforms we build on (CMS, identity, video, CRM and e-commerce) and modern cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud
 - Familiarity with sports and entertainment
 - Experience building or leading a Global Capability Centre or an India-based global delivery hub
 - Experience in both startup-style and enterprise-scale environments

data.title: NPI Quality Lead
data.description:
About The Business

Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components. 

Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd. ) is building India's first AI-enabled state-of-the-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence. 

Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission 'To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust. '

Role Summary

The NPI Quality Lead - OSAT is responsible for end‐to‐end quality planning and execution during new product introduction at external assembly & test (OSAT) partners. This role drives product and process qualification, builds robust control plans, ensures readiness for ramp, and achieves target DPPM/FPY through data‐driven problem solving. You will be the single‐threaded owner for NPI quality at OSAT-leading gates, aligning design/manufacturing/test stakeholders, and ensuring flawless launch to mass production (MP). 

Key Responsibilities

NPI Quality Planning & Governance

Own NPI quality deliverables from concept to MP: quality plan, control plan, PFMEA/DFMEA inputs, MSA, SPC strategy, sampling plans, and Run@Rate readiness. 

- Lead phase‐gate reviews (e. g. , PRQ/POR/ES/CS/MP) and drive issue closure across design, packaging, test, and supplier teams. 
 - Define CTQs/CTPs, PPV/FAI criteria, golden lot strategy, and qualification lots (ES/CS/MP). 
 - Align acceptance criteria with product requirements (e. g. , performance, reliability, package integrity, test coverage). 

Supplier (OSAT) Readiness & Process Control

- Validate OSAT readiness for assembly & test flows (e. g. , wafer sort handoff, die attach, wire bond / flip‐chip, mold, singulation, final test, burn‐in). 
 - Review and approve OSAT process documentation: traveller/routers, work instructions, control charts, change management procedures, and escape prevention controls. 
 - Implement robust SPC (control charts, control limits, reaction plans) for critical steps; drive MSA (GR&R) for inline and end‐of‐line measurements. 
 - Ensure material control (lots, traceability, moisture sensitivity, bake, MSD handling, labeling, pack‐out). 

Qualification & Reliability

- Plan and execute package/product qualification per target standards and customer segment: 
 - Automotive: AEC‐Q100/Q104 alignment, IATF 16949 processes, PPAP‐like evidence pack. 
 - Industrial/Consumer: JEDEC JESD47/22/94 as applicable. 
 - Define qual matrices, sample sizes, and acceptance criteria; assess results (e. g. , HTOL, HAST/uHAST, TC, THB, BHAST, AC, drop, warpage/co‐planarity, BIB/burn‐in). 
 - Coordinate FA (FIB/SEM/CSAM/X‐ray/decap) and drive 8D for any qual test failures with clear containment, corrective and preventive actions. 
Test Strategy & Yield/Reliability Improvement

- Partner with Test Engineering to ensure test coverage, guard bands, OBA/OLA, correlation, and outlier screening are adequate for NPI risk profile. 
 - Monitor DPPM, FPY, bin paretos, retest/rework, drift and excursions; lead DOE and root‐cause analysis to drive yield up and escapes down. 
 - Build escape prevention and early‐warning systems (e. g. , SPC triggers, stop‐ship criteria, deviation controls, recipe locks, recipe checksum audits). 

Documentation, Compliance & Change Management

- Own the NPI Quality Pack: Control Plan, PFMEA, MSA studies, SPC control setup, qualification report, FA reports, deviations, 8D records, and readiness checklist. 
 - Ensure compliance to QMS (e. g. , ISO 9001; Automotive: IATF 16949 core tools-APQP/PPAP, MSA, SPC, FMEA, 8D). 
 - Assess and approve OSAT PCNs; manage ECN/PDN/PCN impacts to customers and internal stakeholders. 

Stakeholder & Customer Interface

- Act as the quality voice for NPI with Design, Pkg Eng, Test Eng, Reliability, Supplier Quality, and Operations. 
 - Support customer audits, qualification evidence packs, and early customer samples/CS trials with rapid feedback loops. 
 - Provide executive‐level updates on NPI quality risk, readiness, and mitigation plans. 

Essential Attributes

- Strong command of quality tools: PFMEA/DFMEA, Control Plans, MSA (GR&R), SPC (X‐bar/R, IMR, Cpk/Ppk), DOE, 8D/5Why, Ishikawa. 
 - Hands‐on experience with reliability/qualification per JEDEC/AEC, and FA workflows (CSAM, X‐ray, SEM/FIB, decap, SAM/warpage). 
 - Data analysis proficiency (e. g. , Minitab/JMP; SQL/Python a plus). 
 - Excellent communication and leadership; capable of influencing OSAT teams and cross‐functional stakeholders. 
 - Experience with layered process audits (LPA), process capability studies for advanced packaging (FC, WLCSP, SiP). 

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Materials, Mechanical, Industrial) or related. 

Desired Experience Level

10+ years in semiconductor manufacturing/assembly/test quality, and in NPI and supplier/OSAT management.

data.description:
About REA Group: 

In 1995, in a garage in Melbourne, Australia, REA Group was born from a simple question: "Can we change the way the world experiences property?"

Could we? Yes. Are we done? Never. 

Fast forward 30 years, REA Group is a market leader in online real estate in three continents and continuing to grow rapidly across the globe. The secret to our growth is staying true to that 'day one' mindset; the hunger to innovate, the ambition to change the world, and the curiosity to reimagine the future. 

Our new Tech Center in Cyber City is dedicated to accelerating REA Group's global technology delivery through relentless innovation. We're looking for the best technologists, inventors and leaders in India to join us on this exciting new journey. 

If you're excited by the prospect of creating something magical from scratch, then read on. 

What the role is all about: 

We're seeking a Staff Engineer - EDGE Platform who will play a pivotal role in shaping and scaling REA's edge security and content delivery capabilities. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, cloud, networking and security, with a strong focus on building resilient, reusable and well-governed edge platform capabilities for teams across REA. 

You'll help define and evolve our EDGE platform strategy across CDN, WAF, bot management, DNS and traffic management, while applying platform thinking to create paved-road solutions that are secure, scalable and simple for product and engineering teams to adopt. You'll combine deep technical expertise with operational discipline, leveraging automation, observability and incident response practices to improve reliability and customer outcomes. 

This is your chance to work on impactful projects that directly influence availability, performance and security for customer-facing experiences at scale. You'll work with modern tooling and collaborate with engineers across infrastructure, security and product teams in a large, complex technology environment. 

While no two days are likely to be the same, your typical responsibilities will include: 

- Set technical direction for the EDGE platform across CDN, WAF, DDoS protection, bot management, DNS and traffic management, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable and aligned to business priorities. 
 - Lead the design and evolution of platform capabilities using Akamai and Kasada, making sound architectural decisions that balance security, reliability, performance and developer experience. 
 - Define and drive reusable platform patterns using Terraform, with strong platform thinking that enables self-service, consistency, governance and safe adoption across engineering teams. 
 - Work across AWS, networking, CDN and edge security domains to solve complex end-to-end problems and raise the technical maturity of internet-facing systems. 
 - Partner closely with product, platform, security and development teams to influence roadmaps, shape designs early and ensure edge capabilities are built as strategic platform services rather than one-off solutions. 
 - Improve operational excellence through PagerDuty, incident leadership, runbooks, on-call practices, service readiness reviews and clear ownership models. 
 - Define technical standards, guardrails and engineering best practices for the EDGE domain, and ensure they are adopted effectively across teams. 
 - Own and drive meaningful technology outcomes through OKRs, architecture direction and measurable improvements in security, reliability, performance and platform adoption. 
 - Mentor engineers, provide technical leadership across team boundaries and help grow a strong engineering culture centered on accountability, ownership and continuous improvement. 

Who we're looking for: 

- 9+ years' experience in cloud platform, SRE, network and edge engineering roles, including strong hands-on delivery and technical leadership in production environments. 
 - Deep expertise in CDN and edge technologies, ideally including Akamai for CDN, WAF and DDoS protection, with the ability to make sound architectural and operational trade-offs.

Role Overview

Nasuni is hiring a Principal DevOps Engineer to architect, own, and operate the systems that power how we build, test, and deliver software globally. This role is accountable for both CI/CD platform strategy and the end-to-end management of our virtualized infrastructure, ensuring reliability from hardware through application delivery. 

You will operate at the intersection of platform engineering, infrastructure, and developer experience-serving as a key technical authority and escalation point across DevOps systems, VMware-based environments, and release processes. 

This role is ideal for engineers who have moved beyond pipeline ownership into full-system accountability, including infrastructure, platform design, and organizational impact. 

Level & Scope Definition

- Own architecture and operational accountability for DevOps platforms and virtualized infrastructure

data.title: Product Testing
data.description:
Key Responsibilities

- Understand, analyse, and document software requirements and testing scope. 
 - Prepare test strategies, test plans, test cases, test data, and test reports. 
 - Perform functional, integration, system, regression, performance, and load testing. 
 - Prepare testbeds and execute test cases across 3G, 4G, and 5G network environments. 
 - Test telecom protocols and interfaces, including SS7, SIGTRAN, IP, SCCP, M3UA, and TCAP. 
 - Identify, document, track, and verify defects throughout the defect lifecycle. 
 - Perform code coverage analysis and support debugging using appropriate tools. 
 - Develop and maintain test automation using suitable frameworks and scripting languages. 
 - Collaborate with development, product, and network teams to resolve issues and deliver quality releases. 
 - Ask relevant technical questions, clarify requirements, and communicate risks and test results clearly. 

Technical / Functional Competencies

- Software testing concepts, test strategy, test case authoring, test execution, and defect lifecycle management. 
 - SDLC and requirements understanding, gathering, and analysis. 
 - Telecom domain knowledge, including 3G, 4G, and 5G network nodes and architecture. 
 - Protocol stack knowledge: SS7, SIGTRAN, IP, SCCP, M3UA, and TCAP. 
 - Load testing and performance testing. 
 - Testbed preparation and environment configuration. 
 - Code coverage and debugging tools: JUnit, JMeter, JaCoCo, GDB, and Valgrind. 
 - Test automation tools and frameworks: Selenium, Robot Framework, Sahi, Postman, Rest Assured, and Appium. 
 - Scripting and programming languages: Python, Perl, Shell, Java, and PHP. 
 - Relational databases: MySQL, Oracle, and MariaDB. 
 - Operating systems, virtualisation, and web servers, including Tomcat and Apache HTTP Server. 

Experience

- 2-3 years of relevant experience in software testing, telecom testing, test automation, performance testing, or quality assurance. 

Behavioural Competencies

- Analytical approach with the ability to develop alternative technical solutions. 
 - Ability to prioritise effectively and deliver results within timelines. 
 - Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Ability to understand customer and product requirements and translate them into effective test coverage. 
 - Strong documentation, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills. 
 - Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively with Development, Product, Network, and Delivery teams. 

Qualifications And Expertise

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. 
 - Telecom testing or software quality assurance experience is preferred. 

Mandatory Skills

- Software testing and test execution. 
 - Test case design, test strategy, and defect lifecycle management. 
 - Telecom protocols: SCCP, M3UA, SS7, SIGTRAN, IP, and TCAP. 
 - Load testing and test automation. 

Desirable Skills

- Experience with continuous integration and continuous testing practices. 
 - Familiarity with Git, Jenkins, or similar build and source-control tools. 
 - Experience analysing logs, troubleshooting distributed systems, and debugging production-like environments. 
 - Knowledge of API testing and web-service validation. 
 - Experience working in Agile or Scrum teams. 
 - Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

data.description:
Job Description: 

We are seeking a skilled QA Engineer to join our development team for a React and . NET web application. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in web UI test automation using JavaScript and Playwright, alongside strong experience with Jira and Azure DevOps. A solid understanding of CI/CD processes and a passion for crafting robust front-end automated test suites are essential. This role will focus primarily on ensuring the visual integrity, functionality, and overall quality of our web user interfaces through comprehensive testing and automation practices. 

Responsibilities: 

- Develop, maintain, and scale end-to-end UI automated test suites using JavaScript and Playwright. 
 - Design and execute automated UI test cases specifically tailored for React components and modern web interfaces. 
 - Collaborate closely with front-end (React) and back-end (. NET) developers to identify, reproduce, and resolve UI defects and regression issues early in the development lifecycle. 
 - Build resilient page objects, maintain UI locator strategies, and handle dynamic UI elements to ensure high test reliability and minimal flakiness. 
 - Manage UI test suites, bug reports, and quality documentation in Jira. 
 - Integrate automated Playwright UI test runs into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for automated regression testing on builds. 
 - Perform functional UI, cross-browser compatibility, and visual regression testing across target platforms. 
 - Analyze automated test execution results, capture artifacts (trace files, screenshots, videos), and provide actionable reports to the development team. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of UI testing strategies, design patterns, and test execution speed. 
 - Stay updated on industry trends in modern JavaScript development and modern UI testing tools. 

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 
 - 4+ years of experience in software quality assurance with a heavy focus on UI test automation. 
 - Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and hands-on expertise with Playwright for web UI automation. 
 - Deep understanding of DOM manipulation, CSS/XPath selectors, shadow DOM, and handling dynamic React UI elements. 
 - Direct experience testing complex React-based front-end applications. 
 - Familiarity with web architectures (. NET back-ends) to effectively trace UI issues to integration points. 
 - Experience integrating Playwright automated UI suites into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Strong knowledge of Jira for defect tracking, sprint planning, and test management. 
 - Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and modern QA best practices. 
 - Excellent communication and problem-solving skills with a collaborative, team-oriented mindset. 

We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a dynamic and inclusive work environment. If you are excited about this opportunity and believe you have the skills and passion to succeed, we would love to hear from you.
