 - Hands-on experience with mobile application development using frameworks such as React Native, Flutter, or native Android/iOS SDKs
 - Strong expertise in design patterns, with a solid foundation in building scalable and maintainable applications across web and mobile platforms
 - Minimum 2+ years of experience with cloud platform services and application development using Microsoft Azure, GCP, or AWS
 - Familiarity with GitHub Copilot or similar AI-assisted development tools
 - Specialized knowledge of the full software development lifecycle
 - Specialized knowledge of automated unit testing with tools like JUnit/TestNG and test automation frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cucumber, Rest-Assured, Karate; plus mobile testing tools like Appium or Espresso
 - Specialized knowledge of software development methodologies (Agile)
 - Ability to understand client/stakeholder expectations and recognize and escalate issues that may affect delivery
 - Specialized knowledge in CI/CD processes using Jenkins or GitHub Actions
 - Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and/or Kubernetes is a strong plus. 

Competencies: 

- Compassionate and kind, showing courtesy, dignity, and respect. They show sincere interest and empathy for all others. 
 - Show integrity in what is done and how it is done - without sacrificing personal/business ethics. 
 - Embrace an inclusion-focused mindset, seeking input from others on their work and encouraging the open expression of diverse ideas and opinions
 - Team-oriented, positively contributing to team morale and willing to help. 
 - Learning-Focused, finding ways to improvise in their field and use positive constructive feedback to grow personally and professionally
 - Think strategically and proactively anticipate future problems, needs or changes in the work
 - Retail Domain Experience is required
 - Experienced in mentoring development teams
 - Hands-on experience in production environments with an SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) mindset. 

Mandatory Skills Required: 

- Programming Languages: Java / JavaScript / Python / C
 - SQL & NoSQL Databases: MySQL / PostgreSQL / Oracle / MongoDB / Cassandra
 - Frontend Skills: HTML / CSS / JavaScript / ReactJS / AngularJS / Bootstrap
 - Backend Skills: Spring Boot / Node. js / REST APIs / Express. js
 - Automation Testing: JUnit / Selenium / Playwright / Cucumber / Jest. 

Additional Skills Required: 

- Distributing Computing (Spark / Databricks)
 - GraphQL APIs
 - GitHub Copilot or similar
 - Mobile Development/Android Development - Kotlin, Android Jetpack/Compose, iOS
 - BigQuery / Databricks.

Who We Are Looking For

As a Senior Developer, the candidate will be responsible for developing solutions for GTS Integration Services team. The candidate must have 6+ years of experience in developing web applications in Java, JavaScript frameworks, Spring MVC and Microservices on native and open cloud platforms using CI/CD. The successful candidate must be effective at managing multiple projects/tasks of varying complexities and be capable of meeting deadlines. The role expects senior developers with strong experience in business and software development, data analysis, system flows and design patterns in order to strategically develop the various products for Integration Services team. 

As Senior Developer (SA), You Will Be Responsible For

- Analysis, Design and development of solutions for integration services. Candidate should deliver development tasks based on coding best practices and considering non-functional aspects. 
 - Participate in all major technical upgrades and large technical efforts. 
 - Manage your efforts within and outside the agile team and ensure tasks are completed successfully within deadlines with agreed quality standards. 
 - Understand user needs and propose optimized options for solutions. Anticipate critical issues and risks; take responsibility for resolution across the organization. 
 - Apply analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to work independently and collaboratively. 
 - Using and integrating processes through various transmission protocols using BPM based tools. 
 - Developing solutions on file transport, messaging and API integration protocols using proprietary and industry standard formats. 
 - System Integration using integration software's - bespoke, vendor and/or open source. 

These skills will help you succeed in this role with MUST and NICE to have skills: 

- The candidate needs to demonstrate a strong level of competence in Results Focus, Business Acumen and Curiosity and Technology Level Influence/Teamwork

Education & Preferred Qualifications

- Minimum bachelor's degree required. 
 - Minimum 6+ years of experience in developing Enterprise Web applications in Java, Spring Boot or Python. 
 - Must have experience in Angular and/or React. JS & Node. js. 
 - Must have experience on one or more protocols REST, SOAP, GraphQL, GRPC, Avro, WebSocket. 
 - Must have hands-on experience in Relational (Oracle, PostgreSQL, Etc. ) and/or NOSQL DB's. 
 - Must have hands-on experience in Unit Testing framework such as JUnit or Pytest. 
 - Must have hands-on experience in at least one of Azure, AWS, GCP, OpenShift etc. 
 - Must have work experience on Build frameworks (Maven or Gradle) or (Poetry, PDM or PIPenv)

 - Nice to have experience in Dockers, Kubernetes, DevOps/CI/CD.

 - Nice to have experience in File Transfer protocol like SFTP, FTP, Samba and MFT. 
 - Nice to have working knowledge on Co-pilot, Devin or any other AI code-assistant tool.

Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We're driving the company's digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry's best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence and robotics process automation. 

We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We're looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end-to-end, next-generation financial services company.

data.title: Test Manager
data.description:
About The Role

We are looking for an Individual Functional Test Manager to lead functional test delivery across assigned projects, workstreams, or client implementations. This is a hands-on functional test leadership role focused on test strategy, planning, execution oversight, quality governance, risk management, and release readiness. 

You will define and execute the functional test approach for your allocated scope, ensuring test coverage, traceability, defect management, evidence, reporting, and sign-off are delivered in line with FNZ SDLC and project delivery expectations. You will work closely with Project Managers, Delivery Managers, Solution Consultants, Analyst Testers, IAbout the Rolenfrastructure, Release Management, and client stakeholders to ensure high-quality outcomes. 

What You'll Do

As an Individual Functional Test Manager, you will take ownership of functional test delivery for your assigned project or workstream, ensuring testing is planned, executed, evidenced, governed, and reported to the required quality standards. 

- Define and own the functional test strategy and test approach for assigned projects, workstreams, or client implementations. 
 - Lead functional test planning, estimation, scope definition, prioritization, and execution oversight in line with the SDLC. 
 - Ensure testing artefacts such as test plans, scenarios, cases, execution evidence, defect updates, traceability, and closure reports are produced to agreed standards. 
 - Manage functional testing risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, blockers, and residual quality risks for your allocated scope. 
 - Provide clear, timely, and metrics-driven reporting on test progress, execution status, defect trends, coverage, quality gates, and release readiness. 
 - Engage with project, delivery, client, and internal stakeholders to agree the QA engagement model, test scope, entry and exit criteria, dependencies, and execution approach. 
 - Support defect triage and issue resolution through evidence-based analysis, impact assessment, and recommended actions. 
 - Coordinate functional testing sign-off readiness by validating scope coverage, execution results, defect position, residual risks, and exit criteria. 
 - Ensure required test environments, test data, and access needs are identified, requested, and available in line with execution timelines. 
 - Assess testing impact of change requests and ensure functional test plans, estimates, scope, and evidence are updated through change management. 
 - Maintain strong test governance through quality gates, functional test metrics, progress reporting, and stakeholder visibility. 
 - Drive continuous improvement within your functional test scope to improve test coverage, execution discipline, defect prevention, and delivery predictability. 
 - Provide day-to-day functional test directions to Analyst Testers and project contributors without direct line-management responsibility. 
 - Coach and support project team members on test design, coverage, traceability, evidence quality, defect management, and risk-based prioritization. 
 - Capture and share functional testing knowledge, key decisions, assumptions, lessons learned, and recommendations with relevant stakeholders. 

What You'll Bring

We are looking for a career testing professional with strong functional test delivery experience, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced client-facing delivery environments. 

- Strong hands-on functional testing experience across test planning, scenario design, execution, defect management, evidence review, and test closure. 
 - Experience working in client-facing test delivery or engagement roles, preferably within Financial Services. 
 - Ability to manage functional test activities under pressure and deliver to strict deadlines. 
 - Experience working in fast-paced Agile delivery environments. 
 - Experience working with distributed teams across onshore, nearshore, and offshore locations. 
 - Deep understanding of functional test metrics, coverage, defect trends, KPIs, SLAs, quality gates, and release readiness reporting. 
 - Strong experience using Jira and Xray for test management, defect tracking, reporting, and traceability. 
 - Ability to articulate complex information in a clear, concise, and stakeholder-friendly way. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for reporting, analysis, and stakeholder communication. 
 - Ability to prioritize your own workload and coordinate functional test activities across contributors without direct line-management responsibility. 
 - Strong ownership of personal deliverables, functional test outcomes, and project quality commitments. 
 - Collaborative working style with the ability to build trusted relationships and influence delivery teams. 
 - Proactive mindset with the ability to identify improvements to current processes and testing practices. 
 - Adaptability to move between projects and become productive quickly. 
 - Commitment to continuous improvement and measurable quality outcomes. 

Preferred certification: ISTQB Advanced Test Manager Certification or equivalent practical experience. 

Preferred Industry Knowledge

- Experience with investment, wealth, life, and/or pensions products and the markets in which FNZ and its customers operate. 
 - Strong understanding of the regulatory environment relevant to FNZ and its clients. 
 - Knowledge of the FNZ platform across key functional areas is highly desirable. 

About FNZ

FNZ is a global FinTech firm transforming the way financial institutions serve their wealth management customers. We partner with banks, insurers, and asset managers to help people achieve their financial goals through our unique combination of technology leadership, innovation, and asset servicing. 

Our services enable clients to provide best-in-class wealth management solutions to financial advisers, end-investors, and the workplace. We create solutions that are flexible, transparent, and scalable, reflecting the latest market demographic, and regulatory trends worldwide. 

FNZ has experienced exceptional growth over the past decade, both in assets under administration and through the substantial expansion of our international footprint. 

Today, FNZ is responsible for over £1. 5 trillion in assets under administration, held by around 20 million customers of some of the world's largest financial institutions, including Aviva, Barclays, BNZ, Generali, HSBC, Lloyds Banking Group, National Australia Bank, Quilter, Santander, UOB, Vanguard, and Zurich. 

About FNZ

FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back. 

We created wealth's growth platform to help. We provide a global, end-to-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution. 

We partner with the world's leading financial institutions, with over US$2. 5 trillion in assets on platform (AoP). 

Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.

data.title: Senior QA Manager
data.description:
About OvalEdge

OvalEdge is an enterprise-grade AI-powered Data Intelligence platform that unifies Data Catalog, Data Governance, Data Quality, and Analytics into a single, AI-native SaaS product. Trusted by Fortune 500 companies globally, OvalEdge helps organizations discover, govern, and operationalize their data assets at scale - accelerating data-driven decisions while ensuring compliance and trust. Our platform delivers both cloud-hosted SaaS and on-premises deployments to meet the diverse infrastructure needs of enterprise customers. 

The Role

We are looking for a stronger Senior QA Manager candidate profile - to own quality engineering for the OvalEdge product platform. This is a hands-on leadership role: you manage a team and get into the weeds. You write test plans, debug automation suites, design AI evaluation pipelines, run performance reviews, and lead sprint QA planning. 

You come from a product development organization. You know what it means to ship a SaaS release with enterprise SLAs and support customers running on-premises deployments. You treat quality as a shared outcome, not a handoff at the end of a sprint. 

And when release pressure builds and corners are being cut, you are the person in the room who holds the line - calmly, with data, in terms leadership can act on. Professional courage on quality is a requirement of this role, not a personality bonus. 

What You'll Do

Quality Strategy & Ownership

- Define and own the end-to-end QA strategy for the OvalEdge platform - spanning functional, regression, integration, performance, security, and AI/LLM testing. 
 - Establish release quality gates and acceptance criteria in partnership with Engineering and Product; quality sign-off is a release gate, not a formality. 
 - Build and maintain a quality metrics dashboard - escaped defects, automation coverage, defect density, test cycle time - and drive continuous improvement against these targets. 
 - Own the test environment strategy for both SaaS and on-premises deployment configurations; ensure parity between environments. 
 - Implement test frameworks for planning, tracking, reporting and analytics. 
 - Adopt AI and leverage it to the maximum extent possible for efficient test preparation, execution, analysis and reporting. 
 - Own quality risk communication to leadership - when a release carries unacceptable risk, surface it early, frame it in business terms, and be prepared to defend the position. Hands-On Testing & Automation

- Remain hands-on: write, review, and debug test cases, automation scripts, and test frameworks alongside the team - this is not a purely managerial role. 
 - Design and evolve a scalable test automation framework (Playwright) integrated into CI/CD pipelines for continuous regression coverage. 
 - Lead API, integration, and end-to-end testing across REST APIs (RESTAssured, Postman etc. ), and third-party connectors - including OvalEdge's MCP-based enterprise integrations. 
 - Establish performance and load testing practices (JMeter, Gatling, or equivalent) for both SaaS and on-premises deployments at enterprise scale. 
 - Drive shift-left testing - embed QA practices in design and development, not just the testing phase. AI & GenAI Testing

- Build and own the AI testing strategy for OvalEdge's GenAI, Agentic AI, and RAG-powered capabilities - this is a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought. 
 - Implement LLM evaluation pipelines using frameworks such as DeepEval, RAGAS, TruLens, and Promptfoo; define metrics for hallucination rate, faithfulness, context precision, and answer relevance. 
 - Design agent behavior test suites - validate multi-agent orchestration, failure recovery, and goal completion under adversarial conditions. 
 - Establish AI-specific quality gates in CI/CD: automated LLM regression tests that block releases when quality thresholds are breached. 
 - Stay current on AI testing trends and tooling; evaluate and adopt emerging frameworks as the platform evolves. People Leadership & Team Development

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of QA engineers and automation engineers; conduct structured 1: 1s, career conversations, and performance reviews. 
 - Build a technical career ladder for the QA function - clear expectations at each level - so growth is transparent and retention improves. 
 - Define team goals, ownership, performance measures, development plans, and succession plans. 
 - Hire for the team: own the QA hiring process including JD definition, technical assessment design, and interview calibration. 
 - Champion a culture of quality ownership across Engineering - QA is everyone's responsibility, not a separate gate at the end. 
 - Champion automation-first approach within the team using tools, including AI, and upskill the team. Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with the Senior Enterprise Architect on quality architecture standards - test strategy aligns with the platform's broader engineering and AI roadmap. 
 - Work closely with DevOps to integrate test automation into CI/CD pipelines and maintain reliable, fast feedback loops for every commit. 
 - Collaborate with Product Management on acceptance criteria, edge case coverage, and enterprise customer scenarios - especially for data governance and compliance use cases. 
 - Engage with Customer Success to close the feedback loop on production issues - field signals should drive test coverage improvements before problems recur. 
 - Partner with Security on application security testing, VAPT coordination, and secure SDLC practices. 

What You'll Bring

Required

- 12+ years in software quality engineering within a product development organization. 
 - 3+ years in a QA leadership role managing a team of engineers, with direct ownership of quality strategy for a commercial software product. 
 - Experience in hiring, goal setting, performance management, mentoring, and career development. 
 - Mandatory hands-on experience: must be able to write, debug, and review test cases and automation scripts - this is a player-coach role. 
 - Proven experience testing both SaaS (multi-tenant, cloud-hosted) and on-premises enterprise software deployments. 
 - Strong automation engineering skills - Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent - with working knowledge of Python or Java. 
 - Experience with API testing tools (Postman, RestAssured) and CI/CD integration (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent). 
 - Strong experience in Deep AI testing is a must. Demonstrated experience building or implementing AI/LLM testing practices - including familiarity with evaluation frameworks such as DeepEval, RAGAS, or equivalent. 
 - Strong grasp of enterprise software quality - data correctness, security, multi-tenancy isolation, performance at scale, and compliance. 
 - Demonstrated ability to advocate for quality at the leadership level - including the professional courage to push back on release timelines or scope when quality thresholds are not met, backed by data and articulated as business risk, not personal preference. Nice to Have

- Experience testing Data Catalog, Data Governance, Data Lineage, Analytics, or Data Management products. 
 - Exposure to performance testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, k6) for enterprise-scale SaaS workloads. 
 - Familiarity with security testing (OWASP, VAPT coordination) and SOC 2 / ISO 27001 compliance testing. 
 - Experience with observability and monitoring tools (Datadog, CloudWatch, Grafana) as part of production quality feedback. 
 - ISTQB Advanced or equivalent certification. Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (required). 
 - Master's degree or equivalent professional certification (preferred).

As a Global Quality Front-End Central Quality Assurance Remote Operation Control (GQ FECTQA ROC) Engineer at Micron Technology, Inc. , you will be part of a global organization responsible for centralized quality operations supporting Micron wafer fabrication sites across Asia and the United States. You will play a critical role in safeguarding product quality through automated quality screening, lot disposition, statistical risk assessment, and operational excellence initiatives. 

In this role, you will leverage advanced statistical analysis, semiconductor process knowledge, automation, and data-driven decision-making to identify quality and reliability risks, recommend appropriate product dispositions, and drive network-wide quality improvements. You will collaborate closely with Site QA, Product Engineering, Reliability, Manufacturing, and Global Quality teams to ensure consistent execution of quality control strategies and defect containment actions across the Micron network. 

You Will

Design and Develop Quality Screening and Disposition Systems

- Develop quality screening strategies, business rules, and disposition plans for deployment in Micron's centralized quality systems. 
 - Configure and maintain automated lot hold, disposition, and containment workflows. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to establish risk-based quality control methodologies. 
 - Support implementation and validation of quality system enhancements and screening improvements. 
 - Ensure robust controls and interlocks are implemented to minimize quality escapes and operational risks. 

Execute Wafer Lot Disposition and Quality Risk Assessment

- Evaluate wafer lots impacted by planned or unplanned manufacturing deviations. 
 - Assess quality and reliability risks using electrical test data, physical characterization results, process history, and statistical analysis. 
 - Interpret outlier signals, defect signatures, and excursion indicators to determine appropriate disposition actions. 
 - Support disposition activities related to Fab Conversions, Quality Deviations, Special Work Requests, and Manufacturing Excursions. 
 - Document disposition decisions and provide technical justification to stakeholders. 

Perform Advanced Data Analytics and Statistical Monitoring

- Analyze large manufacturing datasets to identify abnormal signatures, trends, and potential quality risks. 
 - Develop statistical models and methodologies for outlier detection, screening optimization, and excursion monitoring. 
 - Perform distribution analysis, SPC review, baseline trending, and risk assessment activities. 
 - Create dashboards, metrics, and reporting solutions to improve operational visibility and decision-making. 
 - Drive data-based continuous improvement opportunities across Micron's manufacturing network. 

Drive Automation and Digital Transformation Initiatives

- Support AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics initiatives for quality monitoring and disposition automation. 
 - Reduce manual intervention by implementing fail-safe controls, automated workflows, and decision-support systems. 
 - Partner with software development teams to define requirements and deploy scalable automation solutions. 
 - Continuously identify opportunities to enhance system capability and throughput. 

Collaborate Across Global Quality Organizations

- Partner with Site QA teams to ensure consistent quality execution across all manufacturing locations. 
 - Participate in global alignment teams focused on quality standards, operational excellence, and best practice sharing. 
 - Support root cause investigations and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) development. 
 - Communicate technical findings, recommendations, and business impacts to diverse stakeholders. 
 - Contribute to the development and publication of global quality metrics and performance indicators. 

Support Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement

- Identify process gaps and propose innovative solutions to improve quality operations. 
 - Lead or participate in cross-functional projects focused on productivity, quality, and automation. 
 - Develop and maintain operational procedures, business process documentation, and training materials. 
 - Support audits, compliance reviews, and quality system assessments. 
 - Drive standardization and scalability of centralized quality operations. 

Education

- Required: Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Material Science, Statistics or related technical discipline. 
 - Preferred: Master's Degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering, Statistics, Data Analytics, or related field. 

Required Qualifications

- 3-5 years of experience in Semiconductor manufacturing, product engineering, quality, reliability, test engineering, or related industry experience. 
 - Strong understanding of statistical methodologies, including: 
 - Statistical Process Control (SPC)

 - Distribution Analysis
 - Trend Analysis

data.description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. 

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures-and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. 

What You'll Do

Product & Stakeholder Partnership

- Partner closely with product owners, functional leaders, and stakeholders within the People function to define requirements, shape backlog items, and translate business problems into technical solutions. 
 - Work with global and local market teams during rollouts to understand adoption, identify gaps, and continuously improve the solution.

 - Ensure GenAI solutions are designed and delivered in accordance with Responsible AI, security, privacy, data governance, and regulatory requirements.

 - Partner with Responsible AI, Security, Privacy, Legal, Risk, and Enterprise Architecture teams to obtain necessary approvals and establish production-readiness standards. 
 - Ensure appropriate documentation of AI system architecture, model usage, data flows, risks, evaluations, and operational controls.

GenAI Architecture & Technical Strategy

- Define the technical vision, architecture, and engineering strategy for enterprise GenAI products. 
 - Design and guide implementation of LLM-powered applications, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, LLM orchestration, tool/function calling, and AI-powered decision-support solutions. 
 - Evaluate and select appropriate foundation models, embedding models, AI platforms, retrieval technologies, orchestration frameworks, and cloud services based on business and technical requirements. 
 - Establish reusable GenAI architecture patterns, reference architectures, engineering standards, and technical accelerators across the AI CoE. 
 - Make pragmatic build-vs-buy, model-selection, and platform decisions considering quality, scalability, security, latency, and cost. 
 - Conduct architecture and design reviews and provide technical direction across multiple engineering teams and workstreams. 

AI Evaluation & Quality

- Define evaluation frameworks for GenAI applications covering accuracy, relevance, groundedness, hallucination, safety, robustness, latency, and cost.

 - Partner with Product and business stakeholders to define AI quality and product success metrics. 

LLMOps / MLOps & Production Engineering

 - Establish CI/CD and automated testing practices for GenAI applications, prompts, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows. 
 - Design AI systems for scalability, availability, reliability, latency, and cost efficiency. 

Delivery & Team Leadership

 - Provide technical direction, unblock teams, and ensure pragmatic, scalable solutions aligned with business needs.

 - Guide development of production-grade GenAI-enabled applications across the frontend, backend, AI/ML, and data layers. 
 - Design and develop scalable backend services, REST APIs, microservices, and integrations required to support AI-powered products. 
 - Guide development of modern frontend applications and user experiences that integrate GenAI capabilities into enterprise workflows. 
 - Work effectively across frontend technologies such as React/TypeScript or equivalent frameworks, and backend technologies such as Python/Java or equivalent technologies. 
 - Guide integration of LLMs, AI agents, enterprise APIs, business systems, and data platforms into end-to-end product experiences. 
 - Remain hands-on in Python-based GenAI/ML development while providing technical direction across the broader application stack. 
 - Work effectively with modern cloud-native development stacks, including GitHub-based workflows, containers/Kubernetes, Airflow, CI/CD, observability, and data pipelines. 
 - Promote modern software engineering practices across full-stack, AI, and ML development. 
 - Remain hands-on in Python-based development, code reviews, and solution design. 
 - Guide development of GenAI-enabled features and applied ML solutions in a product context. 
 - Work effectively with modern cloud-native development stacks (e. g. , GitHub-based workflows, Airflow, containerized/Kubernetes-based deployments, data pipelines). 
 - Promote modern software engineering practices across AI/ML development. 

What You'll Bring

- 10+ years of experience in software engineering, ML/AI engineering, or data science, including significant experience designing and delivering production-grade GenAI/AI products and leading engineering teams. 
 - Hands on engineering development expertise to build and deploy production grade digital products. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead delivery teams and grow into broader leadership responsibilities. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills with a pragmatic, outcomes-oriented approach. 
 - Proven experience leading teams of data scientists, ML engineers, or GenAI engineers delivering enterprise AI or digital products for internal or commercial products. 
 - Strong delivery and execution mindset, with experience owning timelines, dependencies, and outcomes. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage product owners, functional leaders, and senior stakeholders. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with: Python /Applied AI / ML / GenAI in production environments
 - Cloud-based development and deployment environments
 - Data pipelines and production-grade systems
 - Ability to identify the right technical approach to solve business problems and guide teams accordingly. 

Who You'll Work With

You will work closely with the People function & AI CoE leadership, Team Builder Product Owner, Tech owner, AI engineers, data scientists and stakeholders across the People function. You'll partner with product functional and technical teams to ensure successful delivery and global adoption of AI solutions. 

Additional info

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Manager - GenAI Engineering to lead the engineering, architecture, and delivery of enterprise-grade Generative AI and AI products within BCG's Internal People function and will play a critical role in driving the technical strategy, engineering delivery from build, QA to production and global adoption of AI/GenAI capabilities for various BCG's internal digital products that supports HR/People processes. 

The Senior Manager will lead a multidisciplinary team of GenAI engineers, ML engineers, and data scientists while remaining hands-on in architecture, solution design, Python development, technical reviews, and production engineering.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

We are Hiring IT Service Desk Lead for Chennai location !!

Join us and become a part of a transformative Team !!

🎓 Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering or a related field. 

💼 Experience: 6-10 years of IT service desk or end-user support experience, with at least 2 years as a Team Lead or Shift Lead. 

📍 Location: Chennai (Work from Office)

🕒 Employment Type: Full-Time

📅 Workdays: 5 working days

" Candidates who are willing to consider relocation to Chennai are encouraged to apply. Immediate joiners and candidates serving a short notice period are highly preferred. "

Role overview

We are an IT Managed Service Provider looking for an IT Service Desk Lead to run our multi-client service desk from our Chennai office during UK business hours. You will lead a team of L1/L2 analysts supporting several clients at once, each with its own contract, SLAs, ITSM workflows and escalation paths. 

The role blends hands-on technical troubleshooting with people leadership, contract-driven SLA delivery, ITIL process ownership and client-facing service reviews. You will help onboard new clients to the desk and grow our footprint within existing accounts. 

Key roles and responsibilities

Team leadership and people management

- Lead, mentor and motivate a team of L1/L2 analysts working across shared (multi-client) and dedicated client pods. 
 - Plan shift rosters, leave cover and skill mix so every client is covered by trained analysts through UK business hours. 
 - Cross-train analysts on multiple client environments to reduce single points of failure. 
 - Conduct daily huddles, one-to-ones, monthly performance reviews and annual appraisals. 
 - Run onboarding and client-specific training, and handle attendance, conduct and performance issues in line with HR policy. 

Service desk operations

- Oversee the full ticket lifecycle for all clients across phone, email, chat and self-service portal channels. 
 - Monitor queues across multiple ITSM instances or client tenants in real time and prioritize work by each client's contract and SLA. 
 - Act as the escalation point for complex, high-priority, or client VIP issues. 
 - Provide hands-on L2 support across varied client environments: Windows/macOS, Microsoft 365, Active Directory/Entra ID, Intune, VPN, printers and end-user devices. 
 - Ensure accurate ticket categorization, client tagging and closure notes so billing and reporting are correct. 

Multi-client delivery and onboarding

- Deliver each client's service in line with its contract, statement of work (SoW), SLAs and operating level agreements (OLAs). 
 - Maintain client runbooks, contact matrices, escalation paths and approved-change lists for every account. 
 - Lead the service desk side of new client onboarding and transition: knowledge transfer, SOP creation, tool setup, shadow and reverse-shadow phases, and go-live hypercare. 
 - Support client offboarding and handovers cleanly and securely. 
 - Track ticket volumes and effort per client to support capacity planning, resource billing and contract renewals. 
 - Flag out-of-scope requests and support change requests or upsell opportunities with the account team. 

ITIL process management

- Own Incident, Service Request and Problem Management processes at the desk level, adapting to each client's ITIL maturity and workflows. 
 - Coordinate Major Incident response with internal resolver groups and client IT teams, and send timely, client-specific communications. 
 - Raise problem records for recurring issues and share trends across clients to prevent repeat incidents. 
 - Follow both our own and each client's Change Management procedures (including client CAB approvals). 
 - Maintain separate, client-specific knowledge bases and SOPs, plus a shared library of common fixes. 

SLA, reporting and quality

- Track KPIs per client and across the desk: SLA compliance, first contact resolution, average handle time, backlog and CSAT. 
 - Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly client-specific performance reports, plus a consolidated view for internal management. 
 - Avoid and manage SLA breaches that carry contractual service credits or penalties. 
 - Carry out regular ticket quality audits and call/chat reviews, and give feedback to analysts. 
 - Lead monthly or quarterly service review meetings (MSRs/QBRs) with each client and agree service improvement plans. 

Stakeholder and vendor management

- Act as the day-to-day service contact for multiple client IT managers and business users during the UK shift.

data.description:
C# & APL LEAD SOFTWARE ENGINEER IN SIMCORP, INVESTMENT FOUNDATION

Are you a passionate developer with an agile mindset? And would you like to be a strategically important part of the organization in one of the world's leading software providers within the Fintech industry? Then you should join SimCorp as a C# & APL Senior/Lead Software Engineer!

WHO WE ARE?

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with large and global investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 2, 500+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educational backgrounds, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients. While striving to deliver client value, we believe it is vital to consider our people and our planet in every business decision we make. Acting responsibly is not optional. It is essential. 

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

We are building and evolving Investment Foundation, a top-priority project for SimCorp right now and we are building this area to meet our strategic decisions and deliver more outcomes. We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer with expertise in C#, a deep understanding of its ecosystems and a strong background in object-oriented programming. The ideal candidate should be familiar with the . NET framework, skilled in designing and implementing architectural patterns. Additionally, proficiency in automated testing platforms, unit tests, and Git for code versioning, along with experience in Azure environments, is highly desirable. You will be part of an engineering team, contributing to everything from architecture and component design to performance and accessibility and responsible for delivering functionality that enables clients to make investment decisions with our back-office applications. The ideal candidate should have an eagerness to learn APL (A Programming Language). Prior experience with APL isn't required, we provide comprehensive training and a supportive environment to help you succeed. Our company also partly owns Dyalog APL, ensuring the language remains actively maintained and relevant. For now, the most of our work is done in APL. 

WHY SIMCORP, WHY NOW

Simcorp is growing rapidly in the market and we see increasing demand from existing and potential clients. That's why SimCorp is investing in creating a development area Area that is placed uniquely in our Product development ecosystem to meet our top priority strategic decisions and deliver valuable outcomes for our clients. You would be working on topics that touch different areas of Simcorp Dimension which places you in a unique position to view

What You Will Be Responsible For

As a Lead Engineer, you will help drive both technical excellence and team execution, end-to-end: 

- Lead design and development of backend systems in APL (current core). 
 - Architect scalable, secure, high-performance solutions as we move toward cloud-native approaches on Microsoft Azure. 
 - Mentor and guide engineers through code reviews, technical planning and agile ways of working. 
 - Partner closely with Product and engineering peers to deliver outcomes that matter, fast feedback, reliable delivery and maintainable code. 
 - Drive code quality and reliability via unit testing, integration testing, CI/CD and pragmatic engineering standards. 
 - Identify performance bottlenecks and bugs and devise sustainable solutions. 
 - Use Git-based workflows and work effectively in a continuous integration environment. 
 - Collaborate with cross-located teams and contribute to shared ways of working across sites. 
 - Require excellent business and communication skills and to be able to understand client specific requirements. 

Your Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field. 
 - 5+ years of software development experience. 
 - Strong engineering fundamentals: object-oriented design, architecture patterns, clean code, and pragmatic problem solving. 
 - Solid experience in C#/. NET (Core/Framework) and building backend systems (APIs, services, integrations). 
 - Familiarity with APIs (REST/streaming patterns) and messaging concepts (e. g. , service bus patterns). 
 - Proficient understanding of code versioning tools such as Git. 
 - Experience with automated testing and CI/CD, plus strong code review habits. 
 - Acquaintance with AI tools and ML is a plus 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
 - Comfortable collaborating with multiple stakeholders and communicating clearly in an international environment. 

APL READINESS

- You don't need prior APL experience. What matters is curiosity and willingness to learn. We provide training and a supportive environment to help you succeed, and SimCorp partly owns Dyalog APL, helping ensure the language remains actively maintained and relevant. 

NICE-TO-HAVE

- FinTech / regulated-industry experience. 
 - Exposure to vector-based or functional languages (helpful for ramping up in APL). 
 - Experience in a technical leadership role. 

Benefits

Benefits Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, at SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an excellent work & life balance: flexible work hours, and a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have IP sprints where you have time you can spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company's development. There is never just only one route, we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Please click below to apply or get in touch with Aditya Gurijala, Recruitment Consultant or you may send an email to aditya. gurijala@simcorp. com to learn more about the vacancy and what SimCorp has to offer regarding salary, benefits, and perks. Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your CV in English as soon as possible. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process, we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

 - Good understanding of Gear Box, Coupling and systems
 - Support Project Manager to address technical concerns with internal and external clients. Lead global technical project teams of multi-discipline engineers, designers and suppliers
 - Manage Engineering schedule, including on time release of equipment specifications, bills of material, and customer documentation
 - Lead all technical contract requirements on assigned projects to deliver on targets and objectives, including certifications and compliance to all applicable standards
 - Provide engineering support during proposal, manufacturing, testing, installation, commissioning and operation
 - Support team with detailed design decisions to meet contract requirements, such as overall system control philosophies and main equipment specification

What You Bring

- Bachelors Degree in Mechanical Engineering with experience in packaging or operation of rotating equipment

 - Ability to travel up to 20% of the time
 - Ability to direct a small team and give general direction to others

 - Excellent computer skills (Pivot Tables, VBA or other programming language)

 - Prior knowledge of Siemens applications, customers, processes, and products

About The Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities. Candidates want to learn about the divisions they will be joining-the structure, how it works together, and the role it plays in driving Siemens Energy's mission forward. 

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100, 000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. 

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https: //www. siemens-energy. com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character - no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

data.title: Manager,Engineering
data.description:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors. 

About The Role

Menlo Security is looking for a talented Engineering Manager to join our team in Bangalore. You will manage employees located in Bangalore and will contribute technical leadership to the team that designs, builds, and supports the scalable, high-performance services underpinning our world-class Secure Application Access technology. 

Menlo serves millions of users on our worldwide cloud on desktop and mobile platforms. We're looking for a strong leader to guide and mentor the team in the architecture, design, development, deployment, and monitoring of our core microservices, data stores, and cloud infrastructure that power our platform. 

The management team is highly experienced and collegial, with a strong design and code review culture. We encourage candidates with a background in highly scalable distributed systems, networking, and cybersecurity to apply if you feel your skill set can be applied to new challenges. 

The position is full-time and based in our Bangalore, India office. 

Your Experience

Requirements for the role include: 

- Deep expertise in one or more core backend languages, specifically Golang and/or NodeJS. 
 - Experience with Python is a plus. 
 - Proven experience in designing and building scalable, resilient microservices architectures. 
 - Strong knowledge of NoSQL database technologies and experience with services like Spanner, DynamoDB, or GKE exposure for data persistence. 
 - Hands-on experience with modern DevOps practices, including CI/CD, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Docker. 
 - Experience with major cloud providers, specifically GCP or AWS. 
 - A strong background in Networking concepts (e. g. , TCP/IP, HTTP) and Cybersecurity is a significant advantage. 
 - Proven experience leading and mentoring high-performing software development teams. 
 - Experience with Agile development methodologies (e. g. , Scrum, Kanban). 
 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, especially in diagnosing complex distributed system issues. 
 - Ability to provide technical guidance, perform code reviews, and debug complex, high-traffic services. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Proactive, ambitious, with a strong ability to learn new technologies and evolve team practices. 
 - Highly organized and detail oriented. 
 - 2+ years of experience in leading and building high-performing engineering teams, attracting top talent with diverse skills, and hands-on management (including responsibilities such as performance reviews, talent assessment, onboarding and training new team members, etc. )

BE/BTech or Masters in Computer Science with 8 - 12 years of hands on Software development experience

MSGL-I4

Follow us on LinkedIn!

Why Menlo?

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo - in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership, Straight Talk, United Impact, Elevated Talent, and Customer-Compelled. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it - you'll thrive here. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability. 

TO ALL AGENCIES: Please, no phone calls or emails to any employee of Menlo Security outside of the Talent organization. Menlo Security's policy is to only accept resumes from agencies via Ashby (ATS). Agencies must have a valid services agreement executed and must have been assigned by the Talent team to a specific requisition. Any resume submitted outside of this process will be deemed the sole property of Menlo Security. In the event a candidate submitted outside of this policy is hired, no fee or payment will be paid.

data.title: Lead Back End Engineer
data.description:
This is a leadership role in our engineering team - not just a cog in the wheel. 

This is not a "maintenance" role. This is engineering leadership-owning the backend architecture of a global, privacy-first communication platform. You'll lead by example, guide a high-calibre team, and ensure our backend systems remain blazing-fast, rock-solid, and uncompromising on security. You'll be at the intersection of code and leadership-mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and setting engineering standards that define how a global product is built. 

Who are we?

We are a young product company scaling fast and outgrowing the startup tag-with global scale in our crosshairs. We don't do "okay. " We give everything we've got to build the best communication platform in the world. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top institutions-people who care deeply about the craft, performance, and purpose. You'll learn more in 6 months here than most engineers do in 3 years elsewhere. We're intense. High-strung. Focused. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top-tier

backgrounds. But what defines us is not our degrees-it's our refusal to compromise on quality, performance, or privacy. 

What are we building?

WrkTalk is the world's first zero-access, zero-spam enterprise communication product that operates on a structural privacy architecture. One that's already earned the trust of large enterprises like L&T Finance, Adani Group, and Kalyan Jewellers - just to name a few of our enterprise clients. This is not an MVP. This is production-grade software that secures communication for thousands-and soon, millions-of professionals worldwide. 

What's the role?

• Architect backend systems in NestJS and Golang to meet global scale and enterprise-grade performance. 

• Drive design for microservices, real-time comms (WebSockets, WebRTC), and data stores (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Lead code reviews, enforce coding standards, and maintain CI/CD discipline. 

• Mentor and upskill backend engineers. 

• Collaborate cross-functionally with frontend, DevOps, and product leaders. 

• Own technical problem-solving-anticipate bottlenecks, make hard calls, and prevent tech debt from being parked for "later. "

• Manage task allocation, workflow discipline, and ensure smooth collaboration with frontend and DevOps. 

The tech here is serious. 

We work on socket-driven comms infrastructure, distributed control towers, multi-category encryption, root detection, app kill-switches, dynamic guest access, device-level lockout, and OOO/ DND logic layered with smart whitelisting. This is not lightweight app dev. This is protocol-layer decision-making. 

Who should apply?

• 6-8+ years in backend engineering, with at least 2 years in a leadership role. 

• Expertise in Golang and Node. js (NestJS). 

• Strong database tuning skills (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Solid understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, and scalable deployment. 

• Experience building real-time systems at scale. 

• Proven ability to lead technical discussions and inspire engineering teams. 

• Track record of shipping production-grade, high-performance systems. 

Why should you join?

• Because you want to own backend architecture-not just follow it

• Because you'll work directly with established founders, not buried under layers

• Because you'll ship real, deeply engineered features used by large number of enterprise users

• Because you'll grow 10x faster here-in experience, learning, and impact

• And because if you walk this road with us for 3-4 years, it'll catapult you into a tech orbit or fame and glory you never imagined

Where are we located?

We're based in Navi Mumbai and building for the world.

data.title: Platform Integration-Deputy Director
data.description:
Overview

Lead the SAP Integration, Data & AI (D&AI), and LLM Observability strategy, enabling seamless integration across all Observability platforms, Event Management, AIOps, and enterprise monitoring ecosystems. Drive the architecture and delivery of SAP and non-SAP integrations, ensuring unified telemetry, event correlation, intelligent automation, and AI-driven operational insights. establish governance and standards, and accelerate adoption of GenAI, LLM Observability, and Agentic AI capabilities to improve operational visibility, resilience, and business outcomes. 

Responsibilities

- Architect and lead enterprise-scale ServiceNow ITOM Health, Event Management, and Observability solutions aligned to business and technology objectives. 
 - Define and lead SAP platform integration with ServiceNow ITOM and enterprise observability platforms, enabling end-to-end service visibility and operational intelligence. 
 - Architect SAP and non-SAP integrations across ServiceNow, observability platforms, enterprise applications, and infrastructure ecosystems. 
 - Drive event management and intelligent event correlation capabilities across D&AI platforms to improve signal quality, service health, and operational response. 
 - Design scalable event ingestion and monitoring integrations using SNMP, REST APIs, MID Servers, syslog, webhooks, and streaming interfaces. 
 - Define enterprise strategies for event normalization, de-duplication, correlation, suppression, prioritization, and enrichment to reduce alert noise and improve actionable intelligence. 
 - Build and govern integrated observability frameworks spanning AppDynamics, Grafana, SolarWinds, Elastic, Splunk, and third-party monitoring platforms. 
 - Lead CMDB governance, CI lifecycle management, relationship accuracy, service mapping, and CSDM alignment to establish a reliable service topology foundation. 
 - Design and implement service health dashboards, operational KPIs, executive reporting, and business-aligned observability metrics. 
 - Enable automated incident creation, enrichment, triage, orchestration, and remediation workflows using ServiceNow Workflow, IntegrationHub, APIs, and automation platforms. 
 - Drive intelligent automation for observability use cases, including event-driven remediation, operational workflows, and autonomous response capabilities. 
 - Architect LLM Observability and AI Agent Observability capabilities covering model performance, agent behavior, telemetry, reliability, traceability, and operational health. 
 - Enable AI/GenAI-driven observability use cases for intelligent alerting, contextual insights, automated triage, root-cause analysis, anomaly detection, and predictive operations. 
 - Correlate logs, events, metrics, traces, topology, and service context to identify probable root causes and determine the business/service impact. 
 - Optimize MTTD and MTTR through proactive monitoring, intelligent event correlation, AI-driven insights, and automated remediation. 
 - Provide technical leadership, architecture governance, design standards, and strategic direction across ITOM, observability, integration, and automation initiatives. 
 - Conduct solution assessments, architecture reviews, performance optimization, and technology rationalization to improve scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Establish reusable enterprise integration and observability patterns that accelerate onboarding of applications, infrastructure, SAP services, and third-party platforms. 
 - Drive continuous evolution toward AIOps, Agentic Operations, and autonomous IT operations, leveraging AI agents and intelligent automation to transform traditional monitoring and incident management. 

Qualifications

- Candidate should have 12-15 Years of experience 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related technical field. 
 - Hands-on expertise in ServiceNow ITOM, Event Management, Discovery, CMDB, Service Mapping, AIOps, and CSDM, with strong infrastructure, cloud, database, networking, and observability knowledge. 
 - Experienced in SAP-ServiceNow ITOM integration and D&AI platform integrations, connecting enterprise monitoring and observability ecosystems. 
 - Skilled in JavaScript, REST/SOAP APIs, scripting, AI Agents, workflow automation, agentic automation, and self-healing. 
 - Strong understanding of ITIL, SRE, Agile delivery, enterprise implementations, and stakeholder management. 
 - Experienced in LLM/AI-driven observability, identifying telemetry gaps and assessing business impact through Service Mapping and dependency intelligence.

 - Chassis/line-card platform services, Ethernet interfaces, optics, and the underlying system infrastructure that ties hardware and software together
 - Own architecture and end-to-end delivery within JunOS or Junos Evolved - define interfaces between hardware and software and between various software components, evaluate design trade-offs, implement, and integrate across the networking software stack. 
 - Partner with system and solution test teams to set quality bars and build performance and reliability requirements, feedback to strong test strategy, and shorten debug/triage cycles. 
 - Work with support teams as the engineering owner - to perform root-cause analysis on production issues, drive fixes to closure, and continually harden the switching platform for best customer experience. 

What You Need To Bring

Education and Experience Required: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or related discipline. Master's desirable. 
 - Typically, 4-10 years' experience. 

Knowledge And Skills

- Deep experience with low-level systems domain: device drivers, board/system bring-up, and FreeBSD/Linux internals. 
 - Strong systems debugging skills - able to isolate cross-layer failures (hardware/firmware/OS), and reason about performance, concurrency, and resource bottlenecks. 
 - AI-first engineering mindset: comfortable using AI-assisted tools (e. g. , coding copilots, LLM-based assistants) to accelerate design, implementation, and debugging - while validating outputs, writing tests, and protecting sensitive data. 
 - Requirement: consistently apply AI-assisted workflows across the system design lifecycle (problem framing → tradeoffs/interfaces → implementation → test/verification → production triage) to improve speed, quality, and reliability. 
 - Habit of documenting decisions and using lightweight design artifacts (problem statements, tradeoffs, interfaces) to align quickly and iterate with the team. 
 - Solid networking fundamentals (Ethernet; familiarity with switching concepts is a plus). 
 - Strong C/C++ engineering: clean API/interface design, OO design, data structures, and comfort with low-level/system debugging tooling. 
 - Working knowledge of hardware/firmware interfaces and integration points (PCIe, SPI, I2C, FPGA/CPLD) - able to translate datasheets into robust software abstractions and implementation.

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead Software Engineer

Position Overview

The Business Experimentation and Optimization (BE&O) teams within Mastercard's Services organization are building industry-leading software that empowers business users around the world to make data-driven decisions through advanced analytics and experimentation. As we expand our product offerings and modernize our technology stack, we are reimagining how we deliver scalable, cloud-native solutions to our clients. 

We are seeking a hands-on, technically strong Lead Software Engineer to drive the architecture, design, and development of our next-generation experimentation platform. In this role, you will help define and evolve system architecture and non-functional requirements-such as scalability, performance, security, and reliability-ensuring our solutions meet the highest engineering standards. As a technical leader, you will guide cross-functional teams in building scalable services, APIs, and analytical capabilities that power our platform, leveraging technologies like Databricks and cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure. You will collaborate closely with your immediate team and partner with other development teams across programs to align on shared goals, define cross-cutting initiatives, and deliver cohesive, enterprise-grade solutions. You will also mentor engineers, work across global time zones, and champion engineering excellence through best practices in software development, observability, and continuous delivery. 

Our teams are small, agile, and empowered to choose the processes that work best for their goals. Every engineer contributes to the full development lifecycle-from ideation and design to implementation and testing-fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement. 

We are seeking passionate and talented technologists who share our vision of empowering customers to make smarter, data-driven decisions. Join us and help shape the future growth of our team. 

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is the global technology company behind the world's fastest payments processing network. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, and a technology innovation lab. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives. We believe as our company grows, so should you. 

Position Responsibilities

At Mastercard Services, you will serve as a senior technical leader and hands-on engineer for BE&O's next-generation experimentation and analytics platform. As a Lead Software Engineer, you will lead through technical influence, architectural judgment, and execution excellence to help modernize our platform and deliver scalable, secure, cloud-native capabilities for global business users. 

Lead the technical design and delivery of complex, data-intensive software solutions that enable advanced analytics, experimentation, and data-driven decisioning for Mastercard clients. 

Define and drive technical strategy for modernization initiatives, including evolution of legacy systems toward scalable, cloud-native, API-driven, and service-oriented architectures. 

Lead system design across multiple levels of detail, including platform architecture, high-level design, detailed technical design, integration patterns, non-functional requirements, and implementation approach. 

Serve as a hands-on technical contributor, designing, coding, testing, debugging, and delivering production-quality software across the full engineering lifecycle. 

Build and evolve scalable services, APIs, data pipelines, and analytical capabilities using modern engineering practices, cloud platforms, and data technologies such as AWS, Azure, Databricks, Spark/PySpark, and related frameworks. 

Partner closely with product managers, engineering teams, architects, data scientists, QA, security, and operations teams to translate business and functional requirements into robust technical solutions. 

Coordinate and lead technical execution across globally distributed engineering teams, ensuring alignment across regions, time zones, dependencies, design decisions, and delivery milestones. 

Drive architecture and design reviews, code reviews, technical decision-making, and engineering tradeoff discussions to ensure solutions are secure, resilient, observable, performant, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards. 

Identify opportunities to improve platform scalability, reliability, developer productivity, operational readiness, and speed of delivery through modernization, automation, reusable patterns, and engineering best practices. 

Provide technical mentorship to junior and mid-level engineers through design guidance, code review, pairing, knowledge sharing, and modeling strong engineering judgment. 

Navigate ambiguity in complex initiatives by clarifying technical direction, decomposing large problems, identifying risks, and driving alignment across stakeholders. 

Champion a culture of engineering excellence, continuous improvement, ownership, collaboration, and high-quality delivery across the team and partner organizations. 

Ideal Candidate Qualifications

8+ years of software engineering experience delivering scalable, high-performance, and reliable software in an agile environment. 

Strong hands-on experience designing and building distributed systems, microservices, RESTful APIs, and cloud-native applications. 

Strong experience with data-intensive applications and analytics platforms; experience with Databricks, Spark, or PySpark is highly desirable. 

Proven expertise leading system architecture, high-level design, detailed design, and end-to-end technical delivery of complex software solutions. 

Experience driving technology modernization initiatives, including cloud adoption, platform transformation, and modernization of legacy applications. 

Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, CI/CD, containerization, Kubernetes, observability, and modern software delivery practices. 

Demonstrated technical leadership as an individual contributor, influencing architecture decisions, driving technical strategy, and leading large cross-team initiatives. 

Ability to translate business and product requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions. 

Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a proven ability to work effectively across engineering, product, architecture, data science, QA, and operations teams. 

Experience leading and coordinating technical initiatives across globally distributed teams spanning multiple regions and time zones. 

Passion for mentoring and developing engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, and knowledge sharing. 

Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work through ambiguity, make sound technical decisions, and drive results through hands-on execution. 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field; advanced degree is a plus. 

Mastercard is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. Applicants will be considered and treated without regard to gender, gender identity, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disabled status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

 - Proven track record designing and delivering complex integration solutions in high-volume, high-availability environments. 
 - Strong experience with TDD, BDD, and automated testing strategies. (Playwright/Javascript/API)
 - Excellent collaboration and communication skills-able to partner effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experienced working in Agile software development lifecycle. 

Preferred Skills & Experience: 

- Core Engineering: Strong foundation in core Java and Spring Boot to build scalable, resilient enterprise services. 
 - Event-Driven Systems: Hands-on experience designing and operating message-driven architectures using Apache Kafka and RESTful APIs. 
 - Cloud & DevOps: Practical exposure to cloud-native delivery pipelines using Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Git.

In this role you will be reporting to Engineering Manager and will be responsible for designing and executing DCS engineering activities in Service or Greenfield projects with medium to large complexity, according to standard work instructions, quality standards and safety guidelines. Delivering quality customer service to satisfy customers. 

The work model for the role is # LI - Hybrid. 

This role is contributing to the to the Energy Industries for INOPC based in Bangalore, India. 

You will be mainly accountable for: 

- Lead end-to-end execution of automation and control system projects, including design, engineering, configuration, testing, commissioning, and customer acceptance activities. 
 - Develop and review control logic, HMI applications, engineering documents, test plans, FAT/SAT procedures, and technical deliverables. 
 - Provide technical leadership to project teams, ensuring quality, adherence to standards, and timely delivery of project milestones. 
 - Coordinate with project managers, engineers, vendors, and stakeholders to manage project scope, technical requirements, risks, and issue resolution. 
 - Monitor project progress, allocate work packages, track KPIs, and drive project health through effective planning and execution. 
 - Lead technical reviews, design freeze meetings, customer discussions, and project status reviews to ensure successful project outcomes. 
 - Support installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and field service activities while ensuring compliance with safety and quality requirements. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives, mentor junior engineers, capture lessons learned, and contribute to engineering best practices and innovation. 

You will join a talented team, where you will be able to thrive. 

Qualifications for the role: 

- 8-10 years of experience in industrial automation projects covering the complete project lifecycle, from bid phase through engineering, testing, commissioning, and handover. 
 - Proven experience in process industries such as Oil & Gas, Refineries, Petrochemicals, Power & Water, or New Energy sectors (Hydrogen, Carbon Capture & Storage). 
 - Strong knowledge of control system architecture, DCS engineering, field instrumentation, industrial communication protocols, and automation standards including IEC 61508, IEC 61511, IEC 61131-3, IEC 61850, IEC 104, and IEC 101. 
 - Hands-on experience in DCS application engineering, graphics engineering, system configuration, testing, and commissioning. Experience with ABB control systems (800xA, Symphony Plus, Symphony Harmony, Advant, Infi90, Conductor NT, PPB) is highly desirable. 
 - Ability to interpret and work with engineering documents such as P&IDs, Control Narratives, SAMA diagrams, I/O Lists, Functional Design Specifications (FDS), Cause & Effect diagrams, Interlocks, and Protection philosophies. 
 - Experience working with global customers and managing technical interfaces across multicultural project teams. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with willingness to travel internationally (>30%) to support FAT, commissioning, and site activities. 
 - Bachelor's Degree (B. E. /B. Tech) in Instrumentation Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. 

More About Us
ABB a provides a comprehensive range of integrated automation, electrical and digital systems and services for customers in the process, hybrid and maritime industries. These offerings, coupled with deep domain knowledge in each end market, help to optimize productivity, energy efficiency, sustainability and safety of industrial processes and operations. 

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. data.description:
Join us at Orange Business!

We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
