data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. 

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do - and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. 

Job Summary: 

This job implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), follows internal conventions and procedures, makes technical decisions, collaborates with peers and project leads, and contributes to code and design reviews. 

Job Description: 

Essential Responsibilities: 

- Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff
 - Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures
 - Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions
 - Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions
 - May contribute to code & design reviews

Minimum Qualifications: 

- 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. 

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications: 

Subsidiary: 

PayPal

Travel Percent: 

0

PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https: //careers. pypl. com/contact-us. 

For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations. 

Our Benefits: 

At PayPal, we're committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can't do this without our most important asset-you. That's why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing-physical, emotional, and financial-delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health. 

Who We Are: 

Click Here to learn more about our culture and community. 

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal. com. 

Belonging at PayPal: 

Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal. 

Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community. 

We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don't hesitate to apply.

data.description:
At Visteon, the work we do is both relevant and recognized-not just by our organization, but by our peers, by industry-leading brands, and by millions of drivers around the world. That's YOUR work. 

And, as a truly global technology leader in the mobility space, focused on building cross-functional AND cross-cultural teams, we connect you with people who help you grow. So here, whatever we do is not a job. It's a mission. As a multi-billion-dollar leader of disruptive change in the industry, we are shaping the future, while enabling a cleaner environment. No other industry offers more fast-paced change and opportunity. We are in the midst of a mobility revolution that will completely change the way we interact with our vehicles, reduce the number of car accidents and fatalities, and make the world a cleaner place. Visteon is at the epicenter of this mobility revolution. Two major trends in the automotive industry - the shift to electric vehicles and vehicles with autonomous safety technologies - have created unique opportunities for Visteon. We are the only automotive provider focused exclusively on cockpit electronics - the fastest-growing segment in the industry. Job Title: Global Software Quality Manager Location: Chennai

Reports To: Director Role Summary: The Global Software Quality Manager is responsible for driving software quality excellence across global programs. This role ensures that customer requirements are met, internal processes are continuously improved, and quality KPIs are tracked and acted upon. The manager will lead quality initiatives, coach teams on problem-solving, and represent the organization during customer audits. Key Responsibilities: 

- Monitor and analyze key software quality performance indicators (KPIs) across global programs, and define effective countermeasures to address deviations or risks in quality performance. 
 - Plan and execute quality assurance activities for product changes, ensuring thorough impact analysis across software, hardware, manufacturing, and customer-facing functions. 
 - Ensure that customer-specific quality requirements are fully understood, documented, and implemented throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Provide hands-on coaching and guidance to engineering teams on structured problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, Kenshokai, or 5 Whys, especially in response to development or field issues. 
 - Take ownership of customer audits by preparing documentation, leading discussions, and aligning internal teams on quality-related expectations and corrective actions. 
 - Investigate customer complaints and warranty returns by conducting root cause analysis and initiating structured problem-solving processes to prevent recurrence. 
 - Lead internal initiatives aimed at improving software quality processes, tools, and standards, fostering a culture of continuous improvement across global teams. 
 - Define measurable quality targets for products in production, and establish monitoring mechanisms to ensure ongoing compliance and performance. 
 - Facilitate and lead lessons learned sessions across programs and regions, ensuring that insights are captured, shared, and integrated into future projects. 
 - Track and manage design deviation requests, process changes, and special software releases, ensuring proper documentation, risk assessment, and approvals. 
 - Collaborate with manufacturing, product design, and validation teams to prepare for product releases, ensuring all quality gates are met and release readiness is confirmed. 

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. 
 - Proven experience in software quality management, preferably in a global setting. 
 - Strong understanding of quality standards (e. g. , ISO, ASPICE, IATF). 
 - Excellent analytical, communication, and leadership skills. 
 - Experience with customer-facing roles and audit processes. 

More Good Reasons to Work for Visteon Focusing on the Future Our company strategy focuses on leading the evolution of automotive digital cockpits and safety solutions. This strategy is driven by constant innovation, and you will support our efforts through your role. We are recognized across the industry for innovation. We have a strong book of business that is expected to drive future growth, along with a customer base that includes almost every automotive manufacturer in the world. Company Culture Working at Visteon is a journey in which our employees can develop their strengths and advance their careers while making a difference globally. Join us and help change the world and how we interact with our vehicles. Visteon is where the best technical talent creates the future. Learn more about our culture here. About Visteon Visteon is advancing mobility through innovative technology solutions that enable a software-defined future. Our state-of-the-art product portfolio merges digital cockpit innovations, advanced displays, AI-enhanced software solutions, and integrated EV architecture solutions. With expertise spanning passenger vehicles, commercial transportation, and two-wheelers, Visteon partners with global automakers to create safer, cleaner, and more connected journeys. Headquartered in Van Buren Township, Michigan, Visteon operates in 17 countries, employing a global network of innovation centers and manufacturing facilities. In 2024, we recorded annual sales of approximately $3. 87 billion and secured $6. 1 billion in new business.

data.title: Sr. Embedded Test Engineer
data.description:
Your role

As a Senior Embedded Test Engineer at Atlas Copco Group, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of embedded software across a range of advanced industrial products. Your responsibilities include comprehensive verification of embedded software through manual and automated testing, collaboration with cross-disciplinary engineering teams to refine requirements, and the development of Python-based automation to expand regression coverage and enhance testing efficiency. 

You will be embedded within a multidisciplinary team responsible for cutting-edge products such as PLC controllers utilizing CODESYS and Straton, vacuum pump controllers, industrial communication modules, and EtherCAT-based devices. This role demands hands-on expertise in setting up and executing functional, integration, and system tests, managing test artifacts within tools such as Jira Xray, and advancing automated testing frameworks integrated with continuous integration pipelines like TeamCity and Jenkins. 

Your day-to-day tasks will also include thorough analysis of test failures through logs and system behavior observations, defect tracking and retesting, and contributing to the continuous improvement of QA practices and automation tools. You will provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers, influencing quality standards and methodologies across projects. 

Technical and Product Environment

You will work with embedded operating systems, network stacks, industrial communication protocols (such as Modbus, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CANopen), hardware interfaces, and automated test systems. This environment balances both legacy and modern technologies, providing a stimulating setting for innovation and technical growth. 

Key Responsibilities

- Collaborate with product owners and developers during sprint planning to ensure test coverage aligns with acceptance criteria. 
 - Create, maintain, and execute detailed test plans and cases, both manual and automated, ensuring traceability to requirements. 
 - Develop and enhance Python-based automation frameworks and scripts to increase regression test efficiency and reliability. 
 - Perform embedded system testing on physical hardware and hardware simulators, including hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing. 
 - Analyze, document, and report identified defects, facilitating resolution through close cooperation with the development team. 
 - Integrate automated tests into continuous integration workflows to provide rapid feedback on software quality. 
 - Provide technical leadership in QA best practices, contributing to process improvements, and coaching junior QA engineers. 
 - Maintain detailed test documentation and contribute to project documentation to support compliance and audit requirements. 

To succeed, you will need

- Minimum five years of experience in software testing, with proven expertise in embedded systems and Python automation. 
 - Strong capability in defining and executing functional, integration, and regression test suites based on user requirements. 
 - Experience with test management tools such as Jira Xray, defect tracking, and continuous integration systems like TeamCity or Jenkins. 
 - Ability to independently lead QA activities, prioritize tasks effectively, and provide technical mentorship. 
 - Familiarity with embedded hardware, communication protocols, and debugging methodologies. 

In return, we offer

- Join a prestigious global industrial leader with a legacy spanning over 150 years, committed to innovation and excellence. 
 - Empower your professional growth through a culture that encourages autonomy in research and development initiatives. 
 - Engage in challenging projects developing next-generation embedded systems using advanced technology. 
 - Experience global exposure and career development opportunities through Atlas Copco's extensive internal mobility network. 
 - Benefit from a workplace culture that emphasizes mutual care, sustainability, and social responsibility. 
 - Enjoy a competitive total rewards program, including comprehensive insurance coverage, educational support, and flexible working arrangements to promote work-life balance. 

Job location

This position is based in Pune, India, with a hybrid working model. You will have the flexibility to work partly from our Atlas Copco Group, GECIA premises, and partly remotely. This arrangement supports a healthy work-life balance while maintaining effective collaboration with the onsite team. 

Uniting curious minds

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

data.title: Principal Engineer - AI (UCX Platform), VP
data.description:
Join us as a Principal Engineer

- This is a challenging role that will see you design and engineer software with the customer or user experience as the primary objective
 - You'll actively contribute to our architecture, design and engineering centre of excellence, collaborating to improve the bank's overall software engineering capability
 - You'll gain valuable stakeholder exposure as you build and leverage relationships, as well as the opportunity to hone your technical talents
 - We're offering this role at vice president role

What you'll do

As a Principal Engineer, you'll be creating great customer outcomes via engineering and innovative solutions to existing and new challenges, and technology designs which are innovative, customer centric, high performance, secure and robust. 

You'll be working with software engineers in the production and prototyping of innovative ideas, engaging with domain and enterprise architects to validate and leverage these in wider contexts, by incorporating the relevant architectures. We'll also look to you to design and develop software with a focus on the automation of build, test and deployment activities, while developing the discipline of software engineering across the business. 

You'll Also Be

- Defining, creating and providing oversight and governance of engineering and design solutions with a focus on end-to-end automation, simplification, resilience, security, performance, scalability and reusability
 - Working within a platform or feature team along with software engineers to design and engineer complex software, scripts and tools to enable the delivery of bank platforms, applications and services, acting as a point of contact for solution design considerations
 - Defining and developing architecture models and roadmaps of application and software components to meet business and technical requirements, driving common usability across products and domains
 - Designing, producing, testing and implementing the working code, along with applying Agile methods to the development of software with the use of DevOps techniques

The skills you'll need

You'll come with significant experience in software engineering, software or database design and architecture, as well as experience of developing software within a DevOps and Agile framework. 

Along with an expert understanding of the latest market trends, technologies and tools, you'll bring significant and demonstrable experience of implementing programming best practice, especially around scalability, automation, virtualisation, optimisation, availability and performance. 

You'll Also Need

- Strong Python skills or Java back-end engineering experience
 - Generative and agentic AI using AWS services
 - Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and vector databases
 - Long-term and short-term agent memory configuration and tuning
 - Context management and response-suppression techniques
 - AI guardrail implementation and enforcement
 - Tool-calling design and implementation
 - Agent logging, monitoring and auditability

data.title: Emulation Verification Engineer (AI)
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. 

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications. 

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About The Role

As a part of the Emulation Team at Ampere, you will be part of verification of the next generation of microprocessor cores on hardware emulation platform by developing and deploying new capabilities and test content to accelerate bug finding in pre-silicon. 

What You'll Achieve

Your responsibilities may include, but are not limited to, the following: 

- Be part of the emulation verification execution team and be responsible for planning, development, and execution of test content in varied domains including system stress, cache coherency and concurrency. 
 - Work in collaboration with design and architecture teams to root-cause failures using advanced debugging techniques. 
 - Create emulation models from RTL to run test content, using industry standard emulation platform technology. 
 - Develop or integrate high performance transactors and emulation test bench in System Verilog, System C/C++ and Python

About You

- M. Tech or B. Tech in Electronics Engineering or Computer Engineering with 2+ years of semiconductor experience
 - Good understanding of Soc architecture and System Verilog for design and verification. 
 - Strong software development experience in compiled (C/C++) and interpreted (Python, Tcl) languages
 - Strong hardware/software co-debug skills. 
 - Knowledge about Cache coherency models, memory consistency models in AArch64 and/or x86. 
 - Knowledge about coherent interconnect protocols such as AMBA CHI, AXI4, ACE, etc. Knowledge of PCIE, Ethernet, DDR/LPDDR technology is a plus. 
 - Experience developing bare-metal content using C/C++ and assembly language for verification. ARM assembly expertise preferred. 
 - Emulation technology of Zebu, Palladium or Mentor Veloce or FPGA Prototyping would be preferred. 
 - Self-motivated engineer with passion for innovation and demonstrated out-of-box thinking is strongly required. 

What We'll Offer

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits Highlights Include

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance 
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.

data.title: Test Engineer - Product Assurance
data.description:
Creating Peace of Mind by Pioneering Safety and Security

At Allegion, we help keep the people you know and love safe and secure where they live, work and visit. With more than 40 brands, 14, 000+ employees globally and products sold in 130 countries, we specialize in security around the doorway and beyond. 

Additionally, Allegion is proud to be recognized with the 2026 Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award (GEWA) for the third consecutive year, earning distinction in both the employee engagement and strengths categories. This year, Allegion also received Gallup's With Distinction honor - a designation reserved for a select group of organizations that go above and beyond in building exceptional workplace cultures. 

Key Responsibilities

Product Validation & DVP&R

- Develop and own Design Verification Plans & Reports (DVP&R) aligned with product requirements, standards, and engineering intent. 
 - Plan and execute mechanical functional, durability, lifecycle, performance, and environmental tests. 
 - Ensure full traceability between requirements, DVP&R and compliance with applicable regulatory and industry standards. 
 - Review, approve, and present test reports and validation summaries. 

Test Fixture & Rig Development

- Lead the design, development, and validation of mechanical test fixtures, jigs, and automated test rigs. 
 - Create and review CAD designs ensuring accuracy, repeatability, safety, and test intent alignment. 
 - Define fixture and instrumentation needs early in the DVP&R phase. 
 - Support BOM creation, vendor coordination, fabrication, assembly, and commissioning. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of fixtures and rigs based on test data, failures, and design evolution

Measurement, Data Logging & Instrumentation (Hands-On)

- Perform hands-on setup and configuration of measurement and data acquisition systems, including DEWESoft or equivalent DAQ platforms. 
 - Select, integrate, and validate sensors such as load cells, strain gauges, displacement, torque, pressure, and temperature sensors. 
 - Define sampling rates, channel configurations, filtering, triggering, and synchronization to ensure high‐quality data capture. 
 - Ensure measurement accuracy through calibration, system validation, and troubleshooting of signal issues. 

Automation & Test Systems

- Define functional and performance requirements for PLC‐controlled and automated test systems, and collaborate with automation engineers to develop, troubleshoot, and optimize PLC logic. 
 - Integrate PLC controls with DAQ and data‐logging systems to enable synchronized testing and measurement. 
 - Ensure reliability, repeatability, and safe operation of all test equipment. 

Data Analysis & Root Cause Analysis

- Identify failure mechanisms using measurement data, instrumentation feedback, and physical inspection. 
 - Analyze test data to identify trends, degradation behaviour, and failure modes. 
 - Lead root cause analysis (RCA) using structured problem-solving methods (5‐Why, Fishbone, DFMEA, etc. ). 
 - Correlate laboratory test data with field performance and engineering feedback. 

Cross‐Functional Collaboration & Lab Ownership

- Partner with Product Design teams to support Design for Test (DFT) and validation readiness. 
 - Provide validation input to DFMEA and risk assessments. 
 - Own lab equipment, test rigs, instrumentation, and DAQ systems. 
 - Ensure compliance with safety, quality systems, 5S, calibration, and audit requirements. 
 - Support lab capability expansion and mentor test technicians. 

Required Skills & Experience

- Strong experience in DVP&R execution and mechanical product validation
 - Proven expertise in test fixture and rig design
 - Hands‐on experience with DEWESoft or similar data logging systems
 - Knowledge of sensors, DAQ systems, signal conditioning, and calibration
 - Experience with PLC-based or automated test systems
 - Strong RCA and failure analysis capability
 - Proficiency in CAD tools (Creo, SolidWorks, CATIA, or equivalent)
 - Familiarity with ECN, BOM, and product lifecycle processes
 - Excellent analytical, documentation, and communication skills

Preferred: Experience with architectural door hardware and exposure to BHMA / UL standards.

- Experience: 5+ years in mechanical design, testing, validation, or product assurance roles

data.title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
data.description:
About NoteSpark

NoteSpark is an AI-powered call analytics product built as a connector on the LeadSquared

marketplace. It converts recorded sales calls into structured intelligence: transcripts, 

diarization, sentiment, BANT signals, and action items, and enables conversational querying

over call history using RAG. Because the product's core output is AI-generated, quality here

means more than "does the button work"; it means validating that the intelligence itself is

accurate, consistent, and trustworthy. 

What you'll do

- Own test strategy and execution for NoteSpark across its modules: configuration playground, ingestion pipeline, lead-level insights, reports, and dashboards
 - Build and maintain automation suites for API and UI testing, integrated into our CI/CD pipeline
 - Write BDD-style test scenarios (Gherkin/Cucumber or similar) in collaboration with product and engineering, so requirements and tests stay in sync
 - Design test approaches for AI-generated outputs: evaluating transcription accuracy, diarization quality, summary correctness, extraction precision (action items, BANT), and regression across model/prompt changes
 - Test event-driven flows: webhook triggers, queue processing, and end-to-end call analysis pipelines
 - Log clear, reproducible defects and work closely with engineers through fix and verification
 - Use AI tools day to day to accelerate your own testing work: generating test data, drafting scenarios, and analyzing results

Must have

- 3-4 years of QA experience with a strong foundation in test automation (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar; API automation with Postman/RestAssured or similar)
 - Hands-on experience with BDD frameworks: writing and maintaining Gherkin scenarios with Cucumber, SpecFlow, or equivalent
 - Good working knowledge of AI tools and comfort using them as part of the testing workflow
 - Solid understanding of QA fundamentals: test design, regression planning, defect lifecycle, and CI integration
 - Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, especially for outputs where "correct" isn't binary

Good to have

- Experience testing AI/LLM-based applications: evaluating non-deterministic outputs, building golden datasets, prompt regression testing, or model output scoring
 - Exposure to audio/speech products or data-heavy SaaS platforms
 - Basic scripting ability (Python, JavaScript, or C#) beyond test frameworks
 - Familiarity with AWS or cloud-based test environments

Why join

You'll be the quality owner on a small, senior team shipping an AI product to enterprise

customers. This is a chance to define how AI-based applications should be tested (a skill set the industry is only beginning to figure out) rather than following an established playbook.

data.title: ETL Tester
data.description:
Medpace is growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking a full-time, office-based Software QA Test Engineer (Validation Engineer) to join our growing Information Technology (IT) team in Mumbai office. 

Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans, test scenarios, and test cases for ETL pipelines, backend database changes, data warehouse objects, and reporting solutions. 
 - Perform end-to-end ETL testing by validating source-to-target data across different stages of the data pipeline to ensure data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and integrity. 
 - Develop and execute complex SQL and Snowflake queries to perform data validation, reconciliation, data profiling, and root-cause analysis of data discrepancies. 
 - Validate database changes, including schemas, tables, views, stored procedures, indexes, and other database objects, for functional correctness and potential performance impact. 
 - Validate data warehouse dimensional models, including fact tables, dimension tables, and Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD), against business and technical requirements. 
 - Perform functional, integration, regression, and data integrity testing following ETL code changes, source-system updates, database changes, or schema modifications. 
 - Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects using a bug-tracking system, working closely with developers and data engineers to investigate issues, validate fixes, and perform retesting. 
 - Collaborate with Data Engineers, BI Developers, Business Analysts, and other stakeholders to define acceptance criteria, testing requirements, and quality standards for new data pipelines, data models, and reports. 
 - Develop and maintain reusable SQL queries, test scripts, test data sets, reconciliation checks, and automated data validation frameworks to improve testing efficiency, coverage, and repeatability. 

Qualifications

- Minimum bachelor's degree, preferably in computer science background or related background 
 - 1-2 years of experience in ETL, data warehouse or data migration testing; 
 - Strong understanding of software testing fundamentals and the testing lifecycle; 
 - Experience in design and executing SQL queries for database/backend validation using database tools like Casandra/ MSSQL/ Mongo DB/Studio 3T; 
 - Experience communicating and working within cross-departmental teams consisting of software developers, department leads, and end users; 
 - Excellent computer, analytical, written and oral communication skills; and
 - Experience in the regulated healthcare industry is a plus.

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6, 500 people across 40+ countries.

Collaborative Culture

-

 - Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable
Continuous Growth & Development

data.title: SoC Verification Technical Lead
data.description:
Alternate Job Title: 

- SoC Verification Technical Lead

We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years in the trenches of SoC verification, where the difference between a chip that tapes out on schedule and one that slips six months often comes down to a verification plan you wrote in week two. You know that verification is not just about coverage numbers, it is about understanding what can actually break in silicon and making sure it does not. 

Leading a team does not mean delegating and disappearing. You are in the weaveform debugger alongside your engineers when a protocol violation shows up at 2am, and you can spot a gap in a testbench architecture during a design review without needing to see the code. You have learned to read a customer's SOC spec and immediately know where the risk lives, whether it is in the interconnect, the power domain crossings, or that custom accelerator block nobody wants to talk about yet. 

You do not wait for perfect requirements. You ask the right questions, build a verification plan that actually maps to what can go wrong, and adjust as the design evolves. At Synopsys, you will work directly with customers building chips for AI, automotive, aerospace, and high-performance computing, and the verification strategies you build will determine whether their silicon works. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead verification execution for customer SoC, subsystem, and IP projects, from verification planning through signoff, working directly with customer engineering teams to define scope and deliverables
 - Lead verification teams of 3-4 engineers, assigning tasks, reviewing testbenches and coverage reports, and mentoring engineers through complex debug scenarios
 - Develop verification plans that map customer requirements to testbench architecture, coverage goals, and resource allocation, then track execution and adjust as designs evolve
 - Integrate and deploy Synopsys VCS, Verdi, and third-party VIP for protocols like PCIe, Ethernet, USB, and DDR into customer verification environments
 - Debug complex multi-protocol and multi-domain SoC issues using waveform analysis, coverage analysis, and cross-functional collaboration with design, architecture, and post-silicon teams
 - Identify project risks early, propose mitigation strategies, and communicate status and blockers to Synopsys management and customer stakeholders
 - Drive methodology improvements across the SSG verification team, whether that is UVM reuse strategies, regression optimization, or new tool adoption

The Impact You Will Have

- Your verification plans and execution will directly determine whether customer chips tape out on schedule or slip quarters, affecting product launch timelines for AI accelerators, automotive SoCs, and aerospace systems
 - The engineers you mentor will grow into technical leads themselves, building verification capability across Synopsys that scales to future customer engagements
 - Your early identification of design risks and verification gaps will prevent costly respins and post-silicon surprises for customers building chips in 5nm and below
 - The methodology improvements you drive will reduce verification cycle time and improve coverage quality across dozens of SSG projects annually
 - Your direct customer engagement will shape how leading semiconductor companies adopt and deploy Synopsys EDA tools and IP in their verification flows
 - The testbench architectures and VIP integration strategies you build will become reusable assets for future projects, compressing ramp time for new customer engagements
 - Your technical leadership will help Synopsys win and retain customer relationships in high-performance computing, automotive, and aerospace markets where verification complexity is a competitive differentiator

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with 5+ years of hands-on SoC, subsystem, or IP verification experience
 - Deep technical expertise in UVM testbench development, coverage analysis, verification planning, and complex multi-domain debug
 - Proven experience leading verification teams through full project cycles, including resource planning, task assignment, and delivery against customer schedules
 - Strong working knowledge of industry-standard protocols such as PCIe, Ethernet, USB, or DDR, and how they interact in real SoC architectures
 - Hands-on proficiency with Synopsys VCS, Verdi or equivalent waveform analysis tools, and integration of third-party VIP into verification environments
 - Experience with ARM-based technologies including Coresight debug infrastructure, processor architecture, or AMBA protocols is a strong plus
 - Solid understanding of ASIC design flows, RTL design concepts, and how verification fits into the broader chip development process

Who You Are

- You can walk into a customer meeting, hear a high-level SoC architecture description, and walk out with a verification plan that identifies the three highest-risk areas before anyone else in the room sees them
 - When a regression fails at 3am and your team is stuck, you can look at the waveform, the coverage report, and the testbench code and know within 15 minutes whether it is a real bug or a testbench issue
 - You give feedback that makes engineers better, not just feedback that makes you feel heard, and your team knows the difference
 - You do not let a project drift. If a customer requirement is vague or a timeline is unrealistic, you say so early and propose a path forward that actually works
 - You can explain a complex protocol violation to a customer architect, a verification coverage gap to your manager, and a UVM sequence bug to a junior engineer, and all three conversations will be clear and useful
 - You stay current on verification methodology and tooling not because it is required but because you care about doing this work well, and you bring that knowledge back to your team

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the System Solutions Group (SSG), a team that delivers end-to-end SoC design and verification services to Synopsys customers across automotive, high-performance computing, aerospace, and defense. SSG works on everything from individual IP blocks to full turnkey SoCs, partnering with customers ranging from startups to industry leaders and government agencies. Your verification work will span subsystems and full chips, and you will collaborate closely with Synopsys architecture, design, EDA application engineering, and sales teams to deploy tool and IP solutions that solve real customer problems. 

Rewards And Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

We are looking for an AI-SDLC Architect / Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) with strong experience across AWS architecture, IAM, secure AI access, developer tooling integration, CI/CD and enterprise security controls. 

The role requires someone who can operate across architecture, cloud engineering, security and software delivery, and translate technical designs into implementable enterprise solutions. 

The ideal candidate will combine deep AWS and enterprise security expertise with practical experience of AI coding agents and modern software delivery, and be comfortable working directly with engineering, cloud, IAM and security teams from architecture through implementation. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead discovery of the existing SDLC, cloud, identity and security landscape and define the target architecture for AI-assisted engineering. 
 - Own the AWS, IAM and secure AI access architecture, including identity, connectivity, security and governance controls. 
 - Define how AI coding agents integrate with developer environments, repositories, CI/CD pipelines and managed AI services such as AWS Bedrock. 
 - Define the reference architecture, technical blueprint and reusable implementation patterns, translating architecture into clear engineering direction. 
 - Work hands-on with engineering teams to implement, validate and refine the solution, resolving technical, security and integration challenges. 
 - Establish the security, evaluation, observability, audit and delivery controls required to operate AI-assisted development safely at enterprise scale. 
 - Provide technical leadership across cloud, security, engineering and architecture stakeholders through design, implementation and rollout. 

Required Skills And Experience

- Proven experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solution Architect, Cloud Architect, Platform Architect or Lead Engineer working directly with enterprise teams. 
 - Strong hands-on experience designing and implementing AWS enterprise architectures. 
 - Strong practical knowledge of AWS IAM, including roles, policies, federation, service identities, permission controls and least-privilege design. 
 - Experience with AWS Bedrock or equivalent managed AI services and secure enterprise AI access patterns. 
 - Practical experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, AWS Kiro or equivalent. 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise authentication, authorization, secrets management, networking and secure connectivity. 
 - Strong knowledge of CI/CD, DevSecOps and security controls including static analysis, dependency and secrets scanning. 
 - Strong application development background, ideally Python, with experience of APIs and service integration. 
 - Understanding of AI security, evaluation, traceability and observability controls for enterprise AI-assisted development. 
 - Experience working within regulated or highly controlled environments and translating architecture into executable engineering delivery. 
 - Strong client-facing communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with engineers, architects, security teams and senior stakeholders. 

Mandatory Skills

- AWS Architecture - Secure enterprise AWS architecture and implementation. 
 - AWS IAM - Roles, policies, federation, service identities and least-privilege access. 
 - AI Coding Agents - Practical experience with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, AWS Kiro or equivalent. 
 - AWS Bedrock / AI Services - Secure access to managed AI models and services. 
 - CI/CD & DevSecOps - Modern secure build, test and deployment pipelines. 
 - Python & API Integration - Ability to develop or review supporting tooling and integrations. 
 - Security & Governance - Authentication, authorization, secrets, auditability and secure deployment. 

Skills

AWS Architecture, IAM, Bedrock

data.title: Technology Architect
data.description:
Job Summary

The Technology Architect will design and optimize enterprise grade SAP solutions that integrate generative AI capabilities with complex ABAP based components in a hybrid work model. The role focuses on driving robust SAP technical upgrades enhancing system performance and ensuring resilient architecture for web services and WebDynpro applications while aligning with clinical informatics and regulatory compliance needs supporting business outcomes through scalable and secure technology founda

Responsibilities

- Architect end to end SAP solutions that combine core ABAP components with advanced generative AI capabilities to deliver scalable business platforms that support strategic enterprise objectives and long term technology roadmaps. 
 - Design and refine SAP technical upgrade strategies that minimize disruption optimize system performance and ensure backward compatibility for critical ABAP artifacts across hybrid deployment environments. 
 - Develop and govern patterns for ABAP AMDP implementations that enhance data intensive processing streamline complex business logic and improve overall system efficiency within integrated application landscapes. 
 - Create and optimize ABAP web services that enable secure interoperable communication between SAP and external systems while maintaining robust performance and reliable data exchange standards. 
 - Engineer and enhance WebDynpro for ABAP user interfaces that provide intuitive workflows increased usability and consistent user experiences aligned with business process requirements and accessibility expectations. 
 - Plan and oversee core ABAP solution architecture including modular design guidelines code quality standards and performance optimization techniques that support maintainability and future extensibility. 
 - Integrate generative AI based components into SAP processes to enable intelligent automation contextual insights and advanced decision support that contribute to better business outcomes and improved stakeholder experiences. 
 - Collaborate with cross functional teams to translate complex domain requirements from clinical informatics and regulatory compliance into practical SAP and ABAP architectural designs that safeguard data integrity and adherence to standards. 
 - Establish rigorous review mechanisms for technical design documentation solution blueprints and upgrade plans to reduce implementation risk and support consistent delivery quality in a hybrid work environment. 
 - Guide troubleshooting and root cause analysis for high impact incidents within ABAP based and generative AI enabled solutions to restore services rapidly and prevent recurrence through structural improvements. 
 - Coordinate with security and compliance stakeholders to embed privacy controls audit readiness and traceability into SAP architectures that operate within regulated contexts including clinical and regulatory domains. 
 - Optimize integration approaches between SAP modules and external systems using ABAP web services and related technologies to support seamless data flow and reliable process orchestration without requiring travel. 
 - Document architectural decisions patterns and reference solutions in clear English to support knowledge sharing onboarding and long term maintainability for day shift hybrid teams. 

Qualifications

- Demonstrate extensive hands on experience in core ABAP development including performance tuning modular design and complex enhancement frameworks gained over eight to twelve years of progressive practice. 
 - Show proven expertise in planning and executing SAP technical upgrades including impact analysis retrofit strategies and cutover preparation for mission critical landscapes. 
 - Apply deep knowledge of ABAP AMDP to design high performance data processing routines that leverage modern database features and align with enterprise reporting needs. 
 - Utilize practical experience in ABAP web services to create secure reliable and standards based interfaces that connect SAP with diverse clinical and regulatory related systems. 
 - Bring strong proficiency in WebDynpro for ABAP to deliver robust and maintainable user interfaces that support complex transactional workflows and high usability expectations. 
 - Employ core skills in generative AI concepts and tools to design solution patterns where AI services augment SAP processes and enable smarter automation and decision support. 
 - Leverage familiarity with clinical informatics and regulatory compliance domains to shape architectures that respect data sensitivity process traceability and regulatory expectations even when such experience is considered beneficial rather than mandatory. 
 - Communicate fluently in English for reading and writing to produce precise design documentation review technical specifications and participate in remote collaboration across hybrid work arrangements. 

Certifications Required

Preferred certifications include SAP Certified Development Associate ABAP and SAP Certified Technology Professional plus any recognized generative AI practitioner certification.

data.title: Calypso Developer
data.description:
Job Summary

Serve as a principal architect within the capital markets technology group shaping scalable hybrid solutions based on Core Java and a leading COTS product for derivatives processing. Design and optimize Calypso based back office workflows APIs and extensions that improve operational accuracy reduce settlement risk and help deliver resilient trading and post trade platforms for global clients. 

Responsibilities

- Design end to end solution architectures for capital markets systems built on Core Java and a major COTS platform to support complex trading and post trade workflows in a scalable manner
 - Define target application and integration architectures for Calypso implementations that streamline trade capture valuation confirmation and settlement flows across multiple asset classes
 - Guide detailed design of Calypso extensions and custom modules so that business specific requirements are met without compromising performance maintainability or upgrade paths
 - Review and optimize Calypso API usage patterns to improve throughput reliability and observability while integrating with upstream trading platforms and downstream finance and risk systems
 - Create high level and low level design documents for hybrid deployment models that span on premises and cloud environments ensuring that security resilience and regulatory needs are fully addressed
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders product owners and operations teams to translate back office processing rules into robust technical designs that reduce manual effort and operational risk
 - Provide architectural governance across multiple project streams by performing design reviews validating nonfunctional requirements and ensuring conformity with enterprise standards and best practices
 - Drive performance tuning strategies for Core Java services and Calypso workflows so that end to end processing meets service level objectives for latency throughput and cut off times
 - Partner with quality engineering teams to define test strategies data conditions and automation priorities that validate complex events such as corporate actions lifecycle events and settlement exceptions
 - Mentor application engineers on design patterns Calypso configuration approaches and secure coding practices so that delivery teams build solutions that are robust testable and easy to operate
 - Coordinate with infrastructure and DevOps teams to define capacity deployment pipelines monitoring metrics and incident response models for critical back office platforms
 - Assess third party components and integration options for market data reference data and payment systems to ensure compatibility with Calypso based architectures and enterprise guidelines
 - Contribute to architectural roadmaps that modernize legacy back office platforms toward modular API driven services that improve time to market and reduce total cost of ownership

Qualifications

- Bring proven experience in capital markets technology with hands on exposure to at least one major COTS trading or risk product and solid understanding of trade life cycle concepts
 - Demonstrate strong expertise in Core Java including multithreading memory management and integration frameworks applied to high volume post trade processing solutions
 - Show in depth working knowledge of Calypso configuration APIs and extension mechanisms covering trade workflows task stations scheduled tasks and messaging interfaces
 - Exhibit practical experience with Calypso back office operations including settlements confirmations collateral reconciliation and investigation processes in a production setting
 - Apply sound understanding of relational databases SQL and data modeling concepts to design resilient data integration patterns for trade cash and position data
 - Display knowledge of enterprise integration and messaging patterns including use of queues and service interfaces within a hybrid environment that blends on premises and cloud components
 - Utilize familiarity with continuous integration and continuous delivery practices code quality tools and automated testing to support reliable and repeatable Calypso release cycles

data.title: Principal Delivery Architect
data.description:
Role Mandate & Core Responsibilities

You own the thread from customer problem to production outcome. The role is consultative and hands-on: determine what should be built, architect how it should work, guide delivery, remove blockers and ensure the solution can scale. 

1. Customer Discovery & Value

• Lead R&D/QC discovery and requirements workshops; understand science, process, data, pain points and constraints. 

• Quantify value, define success criteria and guide customers toward scalable, sustainable choices. 

2. Solution & Delivery Architecture

• Architect end-to-end solutions spanning DLX, instruments, CDS/LIMS/ELN/LES, APIs, databases, cloud and enterprise systems. 

• Translate requirements into functional, integration, data, security and deployment architecture; own delivery-level technical decisions. 

3. Scalable Delivery & Industrialization

• Establish First-of-Kind patterns and Adaptive Workflows for materially distinct instrument/application families. 

• Drive configuration-led reuse, process harmonization and wave-based scale across laboratories and sites. 

4. Forward Deployed Leadership

• Act as the technical bridge between the customer and PAS, ESG, Product, Engineering, Validation, Support and PMO. 

• Surface dependencies early, accelerate decisions, resolve blockers and bridge central program teams with site/lab stakeholders. 

5. AI-Enabled Lab Transformation

• Translate AI agents and automation into concrete scientific and operational use cases. 

• Map AI opportunities to customer pain points and identify practical uses across data processing, decision support, testing, documentation and delivery. 

6. Proof of Value & Production Readiness

• Lead or advise PoV, pilot and early-production engagements; define success criteria for functionality, security, operability, scalability and reuse. 

• Ensure solutions are testable, monitorable, supportable, traceable and ready for production. 

7. Regulatory & Validation Alignment

• Work with QA/Validation to align delivery with GxP, CSA/CSV, 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5 and data-integrity expectations. 

• Understand intended use and validation impact; ensure evidence supports the agreed assurance strategy. 

8. Cross-Functional & Commercial Alignment

• Partner with Sales, Services, Product, Engineering, Strategy, Marketing and Customer Success. 

• Review SOWs, estimates, assumptions and technical proposals for achievability; feed customer insight into roadmap and methodology. 

9. Technical Governance & Team Multiplication

• Provide technical governance across internal teams, customer stakeholders, System Integrators and vendors. 

• Mentor PAS teams and create reusable architectures, playbooks, templates, patterns and implementation accelerators. 

10. Competitive & Market Awareness

• Understand the lab technology and integration landscape and articulate Scitara's differentiation. 

• Connect technology choices to business value, scalability, risk and total cost of ownership. 

Experience & Technical Bar

Experience

• Typically 10+ years in pharma/life-sciences technology, laboratory informatics, scientific software, enterprise integration or adjacent domains. 

• Significant customer-facing technical/consulting experience with evidence of leading discovery, architecture or complex implementations. 

Scientific & Laboratory Domain

• Strong understanding of R&D and/or QC processes and scientific data flows. 

• Demonstrated ability to solve real scientific/laboratory problems; applications scientist, lab informatics, lab manager or scientist experience is a strong differentiator. 

Lab Informatics & Instruments

• Working knowledge of LIMS, ELN, LES, CDS, scientific data platforms, laboratory automation and instrument integration. 

• Exposure to platforms such as Empower, Chromeleon, UNICORN/ÄKTA, SoftMax Pro, Magellan, LabX and common analytical instruments is desirable. 

Enterprise Integration & Cloud

• Strong understanding of APIs, JSON/XML, file interfaces, SQL/databases, event-driven integration, mapping/transformation, authentication, error handling and retry/recovery. 

• Comfort with cloud/hybrid architecture and enterprise networking; AWS knowledge is advantageous. 

Regulated Delivery

• Working knowledge of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, ALCOA+, CSA/CSV, data integrity and regulated-system lifecycle expectations. 

• Able to engage credibly with QA/Validation stakeholders. 

Education & Mobility

• Bachelor's degree or above in a scientific, engineering, computer science or related discipline. 

• Excellent verbal, written, presentation and listening skills; willing to travel domestically and internationally, typically 20-30%. 

AI & Software Engineering Expectations

AI PROFICIENCY IS A CORE EXPECTATION

AI is not a future training objective for this role. Candidates should already demonstrate active, self-directed use of modern AI technologies and a willingness to build with them. 

Expected AI Familiarity

• Generative AI / LLMs; agentic AI; prompt/context engineering; tool/function calling; RAG; AI-assisted development and workflow automation. 

Evidence We Expect

• Courses, prototypes, projects or internal initiatives completed through self-directed learning. 

• Examples of agents, automations or AI-enabled workflows personally explored or built. 

Software & Data

• Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript proficiency is strongly preferred. 

• Comfort with APIs, structured data and data-engineering approaches for analytics and AI/ML. 

How You Will Apply AI

• Improve discovery, design, coding, testing, documentation, troubleshooting and knowledge retrieval. 

• Help customers design AI-enabled scientific workflows grounded in trusted, contextualized data. 

Leadership DNA

Consultative Leadership - Ask incisive questions and recommend - do not simply accept requirements. 

Ownership - Stay accountable for outcomes and drive issues through to closure. 

Technical Credibility - Earn the confidence of scientists, architects and engineers. 

Executive Presence - Make complex issues clear and actionable for senior stakeholders. 

Constructive Challenge - Professionally disagree when evidence or customer outcomes require it. 

Decision Making - Make sound recommendations even when information is incomplete. 

Influence Without Authority - Mobilize teams and vendors across organizational boundaries. 

Commercial Awareness - Understand how technical choices affect scale, effort, risk and total cost. 

Curiosity - Continuously learn, experiment and stay current - especially in AI. 

Low Ego, High Accountability - Prioritize outcomes and team success over hierarchy or visibility. 

Who Should Apply

This role is designed for a rare combination of domain expert, architect, consultant and delivery leader. You should recognize yourself in most of the statements below: 

• You can walk into an ambiguous customer situation and quickly structure the problem. 

• You are comfortable leading scientists, architects, QA leaders, engineers and executives in the same discussion. 

• You can move from scientific workflow to architecture to delivery implications without losing the thread. 

• You challenge unnecessary customization and naturally look for reusable, scalable patterns. 

• You make recommendations and decisions rather than waiting for perfect information. 

• You influence teams and vendors that do not report to you. 

• You remain engaged through production; you do not stop at the architecture hand-off. 

• You actively experiment with AI and modern software practices because curiosity is part of how you work. 

THE MINDSET

A strong implementation specialist asks: "What needs to be built?" A Principal Delivery Architect asks: "What problem are we solving, what should we build, how should we architect it, and how do we make it repeatable, scalable and successful in production?"

Why Join Scitara?

Shape Digital Labs

• Work on enterprise-scale transformation of pharmaceutical and life-sciences laboratories. 

Solve Hard Problems

• Operate across instruments, scientific applications, enterprise systems, cloud, data and regulated processes. 

Lead at the AI Frontier

• Help define how AI, agents and automation are applied to trusted scientific data and workflows. 

Influence Product & Delivery

• Turn customer experience into better product decisions, architecture patterns and delivery methods. 

Work With Global Experts

• Engage directly with scientists, architects, executives, technology vendors and System Integrators. 

Multiply Your Impact

• Create reusable patterns and methods that can scale across hundreds of instruments, laboratories and sites. 

What Success Looks Like

• Customers treat you as a trusted technical advisor, not simply a vendor resource. 

• Solutions are scalable, supportable and production-ready - not one-off implementations. 

• First-of-Kind patterns are deliberately reused and industrialized. 

• Technical and organizational dependencies are surfaced early and resolved quickly. 

• Services teams become more capable because you mentor, standardize and create reusable playbooks. 

• AI is used practically to improve both customer solutions and delivery productivity. 

FINAL EXPECTATION

We are looking for someone who can understand the scientific and business problem, determine the right solution, earn stakeholder confidence, make difficult technical decisions, mobilize the organization, and remain accountable until the outcome is successfully delivered and adopted. 

If your professional development stops when the working day ends, this role is unlikely to be the right fit. 

We are looking for people whose curiosity naturally drives them to experiment, learn, build and stay current with technologies changing the way scientific work is performed.

data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

EY GDS Technology Consulting - Cloud Native Development

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence. 

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 

Join EY and help to build a better working world. 

About Global Delivery Services

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centres. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda. 

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80, 000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. 

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service. 

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY's global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. 

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. 

The Opportunity: Manager Cloud Native Developer (AWS)

As enterprises accelerate adoption of cloud, AI, and platform-based architectures, EY GDS is seeking a Manager - Cloud Native Developer who brings deep technical breadth and architectural maturity across cloud-native ecosystems. 

In this role, you will act as a technology leader and solution driver, responsible for shaping cloud architectures, guiding engineering teams, and enabling secure, scalable, AI-enabled platforms for global clients. You will work closely with architects, product owners, security teams, and leadership to deliver high-impact cloud transformation initiatives. 

Roles And Responsibilities

Technology & Architecture Leadership

- Design and implementation of cloud-native architectures on AWS, aligned to Well-Architected Framework principles
 - Define reference architectures for microservices, serverless, and container-based platforms
 - Drive architectural decisions across scalability, resilience, performance, security, and cost optimization
 - Review and govern solution designs, ensuring consistency with enterprise and cloud security standards
 - Experience in working with development best practices and approaches such as TDD, BDD and AI collaborative development. 
 - Develop/maintain full stack applications using Node. js and Java (spring boot), Build and deploy scalable solutions on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, EC2), Design APIs, Integrate systems, and support event-driven architectures (KAFKA, MQ). 
 - Create technical designs for user stories and support Agile delivery, Collaborate with teams on CI/CD testing, and cloud deployments, leverage AI tools to improve development efficiency and productivity

Cloud-Native Engineering Development

- Hands on experience in building microservices and APIs using Java. 
 - Design and develop solution based on serverless, event-driven systems, and asynchronous processing. 
 - Hands on knowledge of EKS, containerization, and orchestration strategies. 
 - Establish best practices for observability, logging, tracing, and reliability engineering. 

AI & GenAI Proficiency

- Adoption of AI-enabled and GenAI-based application patterns within cloud-native solutions
 - Hands on experience on: 
 - Integrating LLMs and AI services into enterprise applications
 - Designing prompt-driven, agent-based, or workflow-augmented systems
 - Application implementation of RAG, MCP
 - Applying responsible AI and security considerations in AI usage
 - Act as a technical advisor on AI readiness and AI-driven modernization

People, Delivery & Stakeholder Management

- Mentor senior and mid-level engineers; provide technical coaching and career guidance
 - Act as a technical escalation point for complex engineering challenges
 - Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business outcomes into technology roadmaps
 - Support pre-sales, solutioning, and technical estimations when required

Technical Skills - Primary

- Proficiency in backend programming languages: Node. js/Typescript
 - Compute: EC2, EKS, Lambda
 - Storage: S3
 - Databases: RDS, DynamoDB
 - Networking & Security: VPC, IAM, Security Groups
 - Integration & Messaging: API Gateway, SNS, SQS
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC): CloudFormation, Terraform
 - Cloud Architecture & Design: Landing zone, VPC, ECS, EKS, Lambda, SNS, SQS, 

Technical Skills - Secondary

- DevOps practices: CI/CD, automated builds, testing, and deployments
 - Quality, Security & Reliability (Weightage: Medium)
 - Automated testing, defect prevention
 - Security best practices and vulnerability remediation
 - Performance tuning and reliability initiatives
 - AI, Copilot & Prompt Engineering (Weightage: Medium)
 - Use of Microsoft Copilot and AI-assisted development tools
 - Writing AI prompts for code generation, refactoring, test creation, debugging
 - Integrating LLM APIs
 - Using AI services within cloud-native workflows
 - Prompt-driven or agent-based application patterns like RAG, MCP
 - Cloud cost awareness, scalability, resiliency, fault-tolerant design (Weightage: Medium)

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Strong architectural thinking with pragmatic execution mindset
 - Ability to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels
 - Excellent communication skills to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders
 - Leadership mindset with ownership for outcomes and quality
 - Passion for emerging technologies, especially AI, cloud platforms, and automation
 - Node. js and Java (Spring Boot) expertise

To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field
 - 8 to 12 years of overall IT experience, with significant focus on cloud-native platforms
 - Proven experience leading cloud architecture and engineering teams
 - Hands-on exposure to AWS, containers, serverless, and AI-enabled systems
 - Experience working in large-scale enterprise or global delivery environments

What Working At EY Offers

- Opportunity to work on large-scale, global cloud transformation programs
 - Exposure to cutting-edge cloud, DevOps, and GenAI initiatives
 - Continuous learning, certifications, and career progression opportunities
 - A collaborative, inclusive environment focused on innovation and quality
 - Flexibility and autonomy to grow both technically and professionally

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Architect - Salesforce
data.description:
At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We're fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7, 000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!

Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA. 

Job Description

THE POSITION: 

We are seeking a highly skilled Salesforce Architect specializing in Health Cloud to design, govern, and deliver scalable enterprise-grade solutions. This role requires deep expertise in data modeling, integration architecture, security, multi-org strategy, and end-to-end Salesforce development. The Salesforce Architect will partner closely with business and technology teams to define architecture standards, ensure platform stability, and guide development best practices. 

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by: 

- Architect and design Salesforce Health Cloud solutions, including Data Modeling, Schema Design, and patient-care workflows. 
 - Lead solutioning using Apex (Classes, Triggers), Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura, and Flows. 
 - Define and implement Integration Architecture using APIs, middleware, and enterprise integration patterns. 
 - Establish Security Model standards including authentication, authorization, sharing rules, encryption, and PHI/HIPAA considerations. 
 - Drive Multi‐Org and Environment Strategy, ensuring alignment, governance, and scalable org architecture. 
 - Lead DevOps & CI/CD implementation using tools such as Git, Copado, Gearset, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Review technical designs, provide architectural guidance, and ensure alignment with enterprise standards. 
 - Collaborate with product owners, developers, admins, and cross-functional teams to ensure end-to-end solution delivery. 
 - Identify architectural risks and propose mitigation strategies. 
 - Document architecture decisions, solution blueprints, and system diagrams. 
 - All other duties as assigned. 

Expectations Of The Job

<5% Travel (% or number of days)
 - Hours (45 Hours per week, 5 days of the week)
 - Ability to work independently in a 2 PM - 11 PM shift, coordinating with global teams. 
 - Deliver high-performance, secure, and scalable Health Cloud architectures. 
 - Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders and leadership on Salesforce strategy. 
 - Mentor developers and admins, ensuring adherence to architectural and coding standards. 
 - Translate business needs into future-ready technical solutions. 
 - Own the architectural roadmap and maintain platform integrity. 
 - Ensure compliance with HIPAA, PHI handling standards, and all internal security policies. 
 - Adhere to project timelines and quality standards

Minimum Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required. 

- Strong expertise in Salesforce Health Cloud, including clinical and patient data models. 
 - Deep understanding of Salesforce Architecture, Data Modeling, and Schema Design. 
 - Advanced hands-on proficiency in Apex, LWC, Aura, and Flow automation. 
 - Strong knowledge of Integration Architecture, REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven integrations, and platform events. 
 - Solid understanding of HTTP, Web protocols, and enterprise integration patterns. 
 - Experience defining Security Models including roles, profiles, permission sets, sharing and encryption. 
 - Proven experience with DevOps/CI/CD pipelines. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline. 

Salesforce Certifications (highly Preferred)

- Salesforce Certified Application Architect
 - Salesforce Certified System Architect
 - Salesforce Certified Health Cloud Accredited Professional
 - Salesforce Platform Developer I/II
 - Salesforce Integration Architect
 - Salesforce Security & Identity Architect
 - Experience in Healthcare or regulated industries with compliance standards (HIPAA, PHI, PII). 
 - Familiarity with tools like Copado, Gearset, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent. 

Qualifications

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline. Salesforce Certifications (highly preferred): 
 - Salesforce Certified Application Architect
 - Salesforce Certified System Architect
 - Salesforce Certified Health Cloud Accredited Professional
 - Salesforce Platform Developer I/II
 - Salesforce Integration Architect
 - Salesforce Security & Identity Architect
 - Experience in Healthcare or regulated industries with compliance standards (HIPAA, PHI, PII). 
 - Familiarity with tools like Copado, Gearset, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent. 

Additional Information

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS: 

Patient Minded I act with the patient's best interest in mind. 

Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results. 

Take Action I am empowered and empower others to act now. 

Grow Talent I own my development and invest in the development of others. 

Win Together I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results. 

Communication Matters I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue. 

Embrace Diversity I create an environment of awareness and respect. 

Always Innovate I am bold and creative in everything I do. 

Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA. 

From EVERSANA's inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one's identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility. 

Follow us on LinkedIn | Twitter
