Job Description

Position

Deputy General Manager / General Manager - R&D

Function

Research & Development - Ion Exchange Resins, Speciality Chemicals & Advanced Polymer Products

Reporting To

Chief Technology Officer / Business Head

Location: Patancheru

1. Job Purpose

To lead and drive the organization's Research & Development function for Ion Exchange Resins, Speciality Chemicals and Advanced Polymer Products, with overall responsibility for product innovation, application development, process improvement, technology development, scale-up and successful commercialization. 

The incumbent will provide strategic and technical leadership to R&D laboratories and scientists, develop new chemical and polymer technologies, strengthen the organization's product portfolio, and accelerate innovation in alignment with business strategy and market requirements. 

The role will also be responsible for building strong technical interfaces with Production, Quality, Marketing, Sales, Application Engineering and Customers to ensure successful technology transfer, product commercialization, field validation and resolution of complex technical issues. 

2. Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

A. R&D Strategy & Innovation

- Develop and implement the R&D strategy for Ion Exchange Resins, Specialty Chemicals, Polymers and related advanced materials in line with the organization's business objectives. 
 - Identify emerging technologies, market trends, customer needs and competitive developments to build a strong pipeline of new products and applications. 
 - Lead and promote innovation initiatives involving new chemistries, polymer architectures, formulations, processes and applications. 
 - Identify and evaluate new chemical pathways, raw materials, technologies and scientific approaches for development of differentiated products. 
 - Establish a structured product development pipeline covering concept, laboratory development, validation, pilot scale-up, commercialization and post-launch improvement. 
 - Drive intellectual property generation, technical know-how and technology differentiation wherever applicable. B. Product & Process Development

- Lead the development of new and improved: 
 - Strong and weak acid ion exchange resins, Strong and weak base ion exchange resins
 - Polymeric adsorbents and porous polymers, Catalyst resins
 - Pharma-grade and specialty-grade resins, Polymer dispersants
 - Flocculants and polyelectrolytes, Antiscalants and green polymer inhibitors
 - Emulsion polymers and specialty polymers, Paper chemicals, including sizing and wet/dry strength resins
 - Defoamers and other specialty chemical products
 - Lead product formulation, customization and optimization based on customer and application requirements. 
 - Drive process improvement initiatives to improve product quality, yield, productivity, cost competitiveness and consistency. 
 - Establish appropriate laboratory and pilot-scale procedures for synthesis, modification, formulation and evaluation of new products. 
 - Lead scale-up activities from laboratory to pilot and commercial production in close coordination with Production and Process Engineering teams. 
 - Ensure that R&D projects are delivered within agreed scope, timelines, quality and cost parameters. C. Ion Exchange Resin & Application Development

- Provide technical leadership in the development and application of ion exchange and adsorbent technologies. 
 - Develop new applications for IEX resins in areas including: 
 - Water and wastewater treatment, Demineralization and deionization
 - Process separations and purification, Chromatographic applications
 - Advanced catalysis, Pharmaceutical and specialty applications
 - Recovery and purification of valuable chemicals/materials
 - Develop application solutions for specialty polymers and chemicals in: 
 - Water treatment
 - Cooling and boiler water treatment
 - Petrochemical/refinery applications, Textile, Ceramic, 
 - ETP/wastewater treatment
 - Other allied process industries, Paper and pulp

- Provide technical support for complex customer application problems and develop appropriate resin/chemical solutions. 
 - Lead field trials, customer evaluations and application validation for newly developed products. D. Competitive Benchmarking & Technology Intelligence

- Conduct systematic competitive benchmarking of products, technologies, performance characteristics and application capabilities. 
 - Evaluate competitor products through analytical, physical, chemical and application-performance testing. 
 - Identify gaps in the existing product portfolio and recommend new product development opportunities. 
 - Track advances in polymer chemistry, ion exchange technology, specialty chemicals, water treatment and related fields. 
 - Translate technology and market intelligence into actionable R&D programs. E. Raw Material & Product Evaluation

- Direct the evaluation and qualification of new raw materials and alternate raw material sources. 
 - Establish specifications and acceptance criteria for critical raw materials and finished products. 
 - Direct comprehensive product performance evaluation, stability studies and application testing. 
 - Develop appropriate analytical and performance test protocols for new products. 
 - Work closely with Quality Control/Quality Assurance to establish product specifications and analytical methods. 
 - Ensure consistency between laboratory-developed products and commercial-scale products. F. Characterization & Technical Evaluation

- Provide technical leadership in polymer synthesis and characterization. 
 - Ensure appropriate use of advanced characterization techniques for understanding structure-property-performance relationships. 
 - Guide evaluation of: 
 - Molecular characteristics, Functional groups
 - Porosity and surface properties, Particle characteristics
 - Thermal and chemical stability, Mechanical properties
 - Ion exchange capacity, Adsorption characteristics
 - Chemical resistance, Application performance
 - Establish scientific correlation between polymer structure, processing conditions and final product performance. G. Project Management & Commercialization

- Act as project leader for strategic and high-value R&D programs. 
 - Define project objectives, milestones, resources, timelines, risks and deliverables. 
 - Establish stage-gate/project review mechanisms for major development programs. 
 - Monitor project progress and proactively address technical and resource constraints. 
 - Coordinate laboratory development, pilot trials, plant trials, customer trials and commercialization. 
 - Ensure effective technology transfer from R&D to Manufacturing. 
 - Provide technical inputs for cost estimation, product positioning and commercialization decisions. 
 - Ensure proper documentation of development history, technical data, process parameters and scale-up learnings. H. Customer, Marketing & Cross-Functional Interface

- Work closely with Sales and Marketing teams to understand customer requirements and identify new product opportunities. 
 - Participate in customer meetings, technical discussions, product presentations and troubleshooting activities where required. 
 - Provide technical support for strategic customers and critical applications. 
 - Coordinate customer trials and evaluate field performance of new and existing products. 
 - Collaborate with Production, Quality, Procurement, Engineering and Commercial teams to ensure successful product commercialization. 
 - Provide technical recommendations to management for product development, product modification and technology investment decisions. I. R&D Team Leadership & Capability Development

- Lead, mentor and develop a multidisciplinary team of R&D scientists, chemists, technical specialists and junior researchers. 
 - Build a high-performance, innovation-oriented R&D culture. 
 - Define individual and team objectives, KPIs and development plans. 
 - Monitor team productivity, project delivery and technical performance. 
 - Coach scientists and chemists in experimental design, scientific problem-solving, data interpretation and technical documentation. 
 - Identify competency gaps and implement appropriate training and capability-building programs. 
 - Encourage scientific collaboration, knowledge sharing and cross-functional problem solving. 
 - Develop the next generation of technical leaders within the R&D organization. J. Technical Documentation & Knowledge Management

Ensure preparation, review and maintenance of technical documentation including: 

- Know-How Dossiers (KHDs), Product Data Sheets (PDS)
 - Product Bulletins, Safety Data Sheets (SDS/MSDS)
 - Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
 - Technical specifications, Test methods, technical reports
 - Application notes, Internal technical notes
 - Scale-up and technology-transfer documents, Customer technical reportsEnsure that R&D knowledge, experimental data, development history and process know-how are systematically documented and protected. 

K. Quality, Safety, ISO & Sustainability

- Ensure effective implementation of applicable ISO systems, quality procedures and laboratory management systems within R&D. 
 - Maintain high standards of laboratory safety, chemical handling, waste management and environmental compliance. 
 - Ensure appropriate risk assessment and safe operating practices for chemical synthesis and laboratory activities. 
 - Support organizational sustainability objectives through development of safer, greener and more resource-efficient products and processes. 
 - Promote reduction of hazardous raw materials, waste generation, energy consumption and environmental impact wherever technically feasible. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory and customer requirements. L. Intellectual Property & Technology Protection

- Identify potentially patentable innovations and support IP evaluation and protection. 
 - Develop and maintain proprietary technical know-how related to products, processes, formulations and applications. 
 - Ensure appropriate confidentiality and control of sensitive technical information. 
 - Support patent searches, technical documentation and intellectual property initiatives in coordination with the relevant functions. 

3. Key Product & Technology Domains

The incumbent should ideally possess broad expertise across one or more of the following areas: 

Ion Exchange & Adsorbent Technologies

- Strong/weak acid cation resins, Strong/weak base anion resins
 - Chelating and specialty ion exchange resins, Polymeric adsorbents
 - Porous polymers, Catalyst resins, Pharma-grade resins, Chromatographic resins
 - Specialty separation and purification mediaSpecialty Polymer & Chemical Technologies

- Polyelectrolytes, Flocculants, Polymer dispersants, Antiscalants
 - Scale/corrosion inhibitors, Emulsion polymers, Paper chemicals
 - Sizing chemicals, Wet and dry strength resins, Defoamers
 - Green polymeric additives/inhibitors, other specialty and functional polymers

4. Application Areas

Strong understanding of applications in some or preferably several of the following sectors: 

- Water and wastewater treatment, Industrial water treatment
 - Cooling and boiler water treatment, Process separation and purification
 - Petrochemical and refinery, ETP applications, Pharmaceutical and biotechnology applications
 - Paper and pulp, Textile, Ceramic, Chemical processing, Food and beverage
 - Mining and metal recovery, Chromatography and advanced purification
 - Catalysis and specialty chemical processing

5. Education & Experience

Preferred Qualification

- Ph. D. in Polymer Science, Polymer Chemistry, Materials Science, Organic Chemistry or a closely related discipline from a reputed university/institution, with a minimum of 10 years of relevant industrial R&D experience after Ph. D. OR

- M. Sc. /M. Tech. in Polymer Science, Chemistry, Materials Science or a related discipline, with a minimum of 15 years of relevant industrial R&D experience in ion exchange resins, specialty polymers, polymeric chemicals or allied specialty chemical products. Experience

- Significant experience in industrial R&D, product development and technology commercialization. 
 - Proven experience in development of ion exchange resins and/or specialty polymeric chemicals. 
 - Strong hands-on understanding of polymer synthesis, formulation, modification, characterization and performance evaluation. 
 - Demonstrated experience in leading multidisciplinary R&D teams. 
 - Experience managing a team of approximately 5-15+ R&D scientists/chemists, depending on organizational structure. 
 - Proven experience in leading multiple R&D projects from concept through commercialization. 
 - Experience in pilot-scale development, scale-up and technology transfer to manufacturing is highly desirable. 
 - Customer-facing technical/application development experience will be an advantage. 

6. Core Technical Competencies

The incumbent should demonstrate strong practical knowledge of: 

- Polymer chemistry and polymer synthesis, Functional polymer development
 - Ion exchange chemistry and resin synthesis, Surface chemistry and adsorption
 - Polymer characterization and structure-property relationships
 - Product formulation and optimization, Application development
 - Analytical and performance testing, Process optimization and scale-up
 - Technology transfer, Product benchmarking, Design of experiments and scientific data interpretation, Failure analysis and root-cause investigation
 - Technical troubleshooting, Product and process cost optimization

7. Leadership & Behavioral Competencies

The position requires a strong combination of technical depth, business orientation and people leadership. 

The incumbent should possess: 

- Strategic thinking and innovation mindset, Strong scientific and analytical thinking
 - Excellent problem-solving and decision-making capability
 - Strong project leadership and execution skills, Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities
 - Ability to convert customer/market needs into commercially viable R&D programs, Strong communication and presentation skills
 - Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills
 - Ability to influence cross-functional teams, Strong mentoring and coaching capability, High level of initiative and ownership
 - Independent and self-managing approach, 
 - Result-oriented and commercially conscious mindset
 - Ability to work under challenging timelines
 - Strong commitment to quality, safety and ethical scientific practices

8. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance may be evaluated against the following parameters: 

- Number and quality of new products successfully developed and commercialized
 - R&D project delivery against agreed timelines
 - Successful scale-up and technology transfers
 - Revenue contribution from new products/applications
 - Product cost reduction and process improvement achievements
 - Improvement in product performance and quality
 - Number and success rate of customer/field trials
 - Competitive benchmarking and product improvement initiatives
 - R&D productivity and laboratory utilization
 - Intellectual property/know-how generation
 - Successful resolution of critical technical/customer issues
 - Team capability development and retention
 - Compliance with quality, ISO, safety and sustainability requirements

9. Overall Role Expectation

The DGM / GM - R&D will be expected to function as a technical and innovation leader, rather than only as a laboratory manager. The incumbent should combine deep expertise in polymer chemistry, ion exchange technology and specialty chemicals with strong commercial understanding, customer orientation and people leadership. 

The successful candidate will be responsible for creating a robust R&D pipeline, accelerating development and commercialization of differentiated products, strengthening application capabilities, developing technical talent and establishing the organization as a technology-driven and innovation-focused player in Ion Exchange Resins, Specialty Polymers and Advanced Chemical Products. 

This version is structured to work as a senior-management JD for recruitment, internal grading, or organization approval, while keeping the technical depth expected for a DGM/GM-level R&D leader. 

Note

The above responsibilities represent the minimum requirements of the position. Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned by the Department Head or Management based on operational requirements. This document serves as a guideline and is subject to revision and modification as required by the organization

Manager / Team Leader - Executive Education & Upskilling Sales

Department: Working Professionals

Function: Executive Education & Higher Education

Location: Noida

Experience: 3+ Years

Reporting To: VP - EdTech

Working Days: 6 Days

About the Role

We are looking for a result-oriented Team Leader / Manager to lead a team of counsellors selling premium Executive Education, Upskilling, Professional Certification, PhD and DBA program offered by leading Indian and international institutions, including IITs, IIMs, IIITs and ISB. 

The candidate must have proven experience in high-ticket consultative sales, preferably within EdTech, Executive Education, Higher Education or Premium Learning. Experience engaging working professionals, senior executives and CXO-level learners is essential.

Team Leadership & Revenue

- Lead and motivate counsellors to achieve monthly/quarterly admission, conversion and revenue targets. 
 - Own the complete sales funnel from lead allocation to closure. 
 - Track individual performance, identify gaps and drive corrective action.

- Support counsellors in handling high-value and complex prospects and personally intervene on critical/high-intent leads.

 - 2+ years of team-handling experience in sales/counselling. 
 - Proven experience in high-ticket EdTech / Executive Education / Higher Education / Professional Learning sales. 
 - Experience selling to working professionals and senior executives. 
 - Strong consultative/solution-selling and objection-handling skills. 
 - Proven achievement of revenue and conversion targets. 
 - Excellent communication and presentation skills. 
 - Strong CRM, funnel and sales-dashboard orientation. Preferred Background

Candidates from: 

- IITs / IIMs / IIITs / ISB / Leading B-Schools

 - Premium EdTech organizations
 - International Universities
 - Professional Certification companies

Team Leadership | High-Ticket Sales | Consultative Selling | Executive Counselling | Revenue Management | Sales Coaching | Objection Handling | Negotiation & Closure | CRM & Funnel Management | Data-Driven Performance Management | Communication & Presentation | Target Orientation

Ideal Candidate

Someone who has already led a high-performing counselling/sales team selling premium education or upskilling program to working professionals.

data.title: Senior Integration & Backend Lead Engineer
data.description:
Role Overview

The Senior Integration & Backend Lead Engineer will serve as a technical delivery lead for the RC Limit Tracker (Phase IV) project within the Wheels Business domain. This role leads the development of an event-driven, auditable limit ledger and rules engine that automates dealer Registration Certificate (RC) and collateral limit management to replace manual Excel tracking. 

Key Responsibilities

- Limit Ledger & Rules Engine Development: Build the core RC Limit Service implementing category rules (CAT A/B/C), limit math (Permanent, Adhoc, Grace, Total), debit order processing (Adhoc first, then Permanent), and disbursal blocking rules. 
 - API Architecture & Build: Design and develop 10+ versioned, idempotent, and secure (OAuth2/mTLS) REST APIs covering limit maintenance, disbursal checks, reversals, deferrals, and reporting endpoints. 
 - Enterprise System Integrations: Drive contract-first integrations across core enterprise systems, including FinnOne CAS, MLP/BYOD, SimDocs/LMS PDD, Vahaan, and IDAM enterprise SSO. 
 - Data Modeling & Security: Design encrypted relational datastores (master, transactional ledger, audit logs) compliant with India RBI data residency guidelines. 
 - Testing & Defect Leadership: Lead system and integration testing across sandbox environments, direct UAT defect triage and root-cause analysis, and ensure test-to-requirement traceability. 
 - Technical Documentation: Author technical design specifications, API contracts, deployment runbooks, and conduct Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions for client operations teams. 

Required Technical Skills & Qualifications

- Backend & API Engineering: Advanced expertise in REST API engineering (OAuth2/mTLS, idempotency, versioning), event-driven patterns, and high-integrity transactional ledger logic. 
 - Enterprise Integrations: Proven track record integrating with banking/lending platforms (e. g. , FinnOne CAS, LMS, IDAM, Vahaan). 
 - Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of BFSI lending concepts, specifically vehicle-loan origination, collateral/RC tracking, disbursal logic, and limit deferrals. 
 - Data Engineering: Hands-on relational database modeling, query optimization for reporting, and data encryption practices. 
 - Experience: 6+ years of software engineering experience with lead delivery responsibilities on cloud platforms.

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager, MineStar
data.description:
Career Area

Engineering

Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. 

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do - but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here - we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. 

Senior Engineering Manager, MineStar

Your Work Shapes the World

Whether it is groundbreaking products, best-in-class solutions or creating a lifelong career, you can do work that matters at Caterpillar. When you join Caterpillar, you join a global team of makers, innovators and doers who turn progress and innovation into outcomes for customers and communities. 

Job Summary

Caterpillar is seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to provide product and technical leadership for MineStar development. This role leads engineering teams responsible for developing, integrating, enhancing, maintaining and supporting mining technology solutions that deliver measurable value for customers. 

The Senior Engineering Manager operates across a broader product and organisational scope than an Engineering Manager while providing direct leadership to engineering managers and supervisors in the organization. The role translates MineStar product strategy into executable engineering priorities, develops leaders and technical talent, and ensures teams deliver safe, reliable, supportable and competitive solutions. 

This leader will partner closely with product management, commercial and product support organisations, process owners, suppliers, dealers and mining customers. Success requires strong engineering judgement, disciplined program execution, customer focus, global collaboration and the ability to influence complex decisions through technical and business expertise. 

What You Will Do

- Lead a portfolio of MineStar product development, integration, enhancement, maintenance work, aligning engineering outcomes with product strategy and business priorities. 
 - Translate strategic direction into department objectives, roadmaps, resource plans, budgets and measurable delivery commitments across multiple teams or technical workstreams. 
 - Provide leadership and performance management for engineering managers, technical leaders and product development staff. Build succession strength and a high-performing leadership pipeline. 
 - Coordinate technical feasibility assessment, architecture and design optimisation, validation planning, cost and schedule management, risk assessment, mitigation and ongoing production support. 
 - Own or influence engineering investment decisions and manage the research and development budget for the assigned MineStar portfolio, balancing new capability, modernisation, quality, reliability and customer support. 
 - Establish governance and operating rhythms that provide stakeholders with clear visibility into scope, decisions, dependencies, risks, financial performance and delivery status. 
 - Guide the resolution of complex, cross-component and field issues by bringing together internal experts, suppliers, dealers and customer teams. Ensure that lessons learned improve future product and process decisions. 
 - Champion systems and software engineering discipline, technical excellence, cybersecurity, safety, quality, reliability, scalability and lifecycle support across MineStar solutions. 
 - Monitor customer needs, market dynamics, competitor movement and technology developments. Recommend product, capability and engineering responses that strengthen MineStar customer value and competitive position. 
 - Build strong partnerships across Caterpillar business units and functions and with external suppliers. Reconcile competing priorities and create shared accountability for outcomes. 
 - Represent MineStar with customers, dealers, suppliers and senior leaders, communicating complex technical and business issues clearly and serving as a trusted engineering adviser. 
 - Foster innovation, operational excellence, inclusion and continuous improvement while maintaining urgency and accountability for commitments. 

Education Requirement

- Bachelor's degree in an accredited Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering or closely related technical curriculum. 
 - An advanced technical or business degree is preferred. 

What Skills You Will Have

Planning: Tactical and Strategic

Develops integrated plans across multiple teams; converts product strategy into sequenced engineering priorities; allocates people and funding against the highest-value outcomes; and adjusts plans using data, risks and changing business conditions. 

Technical Excellence

Creates an environment that rewards technical excellence; provides recognised leadership on complex systems and software challenges; engages the appropriate subject-matter experts; and ensures decisions reflect sound architecture, engineering evidence and lifecycle considerations. 

Decision Making and Critical Thinking

Frames ambiguous problems, evaluates alternatives with multiple stakeholders, distinguishes facts from assumptions, anticipates second-order effects and makes timely decisions during high-impact or customer-critical situations. 

Product Design and Development

Leads cross-functional development from concept through production and support; strengthens development methods and governance; and balances customer value, speed, quality, cost, reliability and technical debt. 

Customer and Market Focus

Maintains a direct understanding of mining customer needs and success criteria; responds proactively to market and competitive shifts; resolves difficult customer issues; and converts field insight into prioritised product and engineering action. 

Influencing Through Expertise

Kong's API Management suite includes the Kong Enterprise Gateway, the Konnect SaaS platform and a variety of Managed Gateways in public clouds like AWS, Azure and GCP. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will develop high-performance Go runtime, CLI engines and declarative state managers. You will architect the software that thousands of engineering teams use every day to interact with Kong's runtime - including deck (Kong's state management & drift detection engine), the Kong Terraform Provider, official Go SDKs and automated spec-driven API tooling. 

What You Will Build & Own

You will balance Software Development with APIOps Architecture: 

What You'll Bring: 

- Declarative Engine
 - State & Drift Management Engines: Design and optimize algorithms in Go for state diffing, validation, and real-time drift detection across large-scale multi-tenant API topologies. 
 - Go SDK & Core Libraries: Architect and maintain enterprise-grade, high-performance Go SDKs used by Kong's internal microservices and external clients to interface with the Konnect SaaS platform. 
 - API Design & Standardization: Define clean, extensible REST API contracts across Kong's platform runtimes. 
 - Code Generation & Tooling Pipelines: Architect spec-driven tooling (OpenAPI/AsyncAPI) to dynamically generate SDKs, client libraries, and IaC definitions without manual developer toil. 
 - APIOps & IaC Ecosystem
 - Core CLI Engineering: Build modern, fast, and intuitive CLI-first developer experiences designed for both human developer workflows and high-concurrency CI/CD automation pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). 
 - Terraform & Provider Ecosystem: Build and extend high-reliability Terraform Providers to enable seamless IaC operations. 
 - Support for Next-Gen Runtimes: Bring new runtime capabilities into the declarative management ecosystem as native API primitives. 
 - 5+ years of software engineering experience designing and delivering production-grade backend systems and developer tools using Golang. 
 - API Design Mastery: Proven experience crafting intuitive, developer-friendly API schemas (REST, gRPC, OpenAPI), with a strong focus on backwards compatibility, versioning and developer experience (DX). 
 - Hands-on IaC / Platform Understanding: Production exposure to Terraform provider development, Kubernetes operators or stateful CI/CD automation pipelines. 
 - Engineering Rigor: Strong commitment to clean code, comprehensive automated testing (unit, integration, end-to-end), benchmarking and robust software architecture. 
 - Communication & Technical Leadership: Ability to articulate complex technical decisions, mentor junior engineers and collaborate across global backend and platform teams. 

Why Join Kong?

- Build for Engineers: Your work is open-source adjacent and directly impacts millions of developers and Fortune 500 enterprises around the globe. 
 - Solving Deep Technical Problems: Move beyond standard CRUD services to solve high-impact problems in declarative state sync, API governance and distributed connectivity.

Kong Inc. , the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong's unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic - on any model, any cloud. Guided by the family's leadership and core principles, Marriott International today has grown into a global hospitality giant, operating approximately 10, 000 properties and over 30 leading brands in more than 140 countries and territories.

This role is responsible for driving the planning, coordination, and execution of reliability-focused programs that support the availability, performance, and scalability of critical systems and services.  - Platform & Systems Diagnostic Skills: Mastery of full-stack application architecture, microservices, and enterprise monitoring frameworks. 

Qualifications

- Typical Experience: 5-10 years of relevant technical support and system engineering experience, with a proven track record of delivering independent work products and managing complex technical projects. 
 - Education & Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience; advanced degree or relevant technical/cloud certifications preferred. 
 - Skills: Advanced technical and analytical proficiency; ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex system issues; strong communication and collaborative skills to drive cross-functional alignment. 

Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen. com domain. Who We're Looking For : 

  

- Experience in technical, quality, or operations roles spanning multiple functions  marine spares, industrial automation, e-commerce, or parts distribution background is a strong plus. 
 - Comfortable cross-referencing part numbers, brands, and revisions (ABB, DEIF, Ghisalba, Elfin, etc. ) to judge fit and compatibility. 
 - Sharp eye for detail doesn't let inconsistent listings or stuck shipments slide. 
 - Comfortable driving accountability across teams without formal authority over them. 

Engineering/technical background preferred but a proven track record matters more than the paper.

data.title: DGM - APS & Lean Management
data.description:
Purpose of the Role

Managing and leading a cross-functional team of engineers and production specialists to design, deploy, and sustain a world-class Production System (PS) grounded in Lean Manufacturing principles. The role is pivotal in driving cultural and operational transformation across the cell manufacturing plant by embedding lean tools, methodologies, and a continuous improvement mindset at every level of the organisation. The DGM will be responsible for developing and implementing the Agratas Production System (APS) framework, standardising work processes, eliminating waste, and enabling measurable improvements in people, safety, quality, delivery, cost, maintenance, energy and environment (PPSQDCMEE). The role requires close collaboration with production, maintenance, quality, supply chain, and HR functions, as well as engagement with external partners and benchmarking organisations. 

Key Responsibility Areas

Technical / Functional

- Agratas Production System (APS) Development & Deployment: Design, develop, and implement a comprehensive Production System framework aligned with Lean principles (LEAN MANUFACTURING -PS-derived), covering all manufacturing areas of the cell plant. 
 - Lean Transformation Leadership: Lead end-to-end lean transformation initiatives across all shop floors, including Electrode, Assembly, Formation, and End-of-Line, ensuring sustained change management and cultural adoption. 
 - Value Stream Mapping (VSM): Conduct detailed current-state and future-state VSM exercises to identify waste, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities across the manufacturing value chain. 
 - Standardised Work & Work Instruction Management: Establish, maintain, and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), standardised work documents, and operator work instructions. 
 - Kaizen & Continuous Improvement Programme: Plan, facilitate, and drive structured Kaizen events, improvement workshops, and CI projects targeting PSQDCME metrics. Track and report savings and impact. 
 - 5S & Visual Management: Design and sustain 5S systems, visual factory standards, shadow boards, andon systems, and production control boards across all production areas. 
 - Line Balancing & Flow Optimisation: Lead cycle time studies, takt time analysis, line balancing exercises, and layout optimisation to enhance throughput and reduce WIP

Knowledge Generic

IT SkillsExperience with layout design, ergonomics, and material flow optimisation in greenfield or brownfield plants is desirable

- Proficiency in MS Excel (advanced), PowerPoint, and data analysis tools such as Minitab and project management. 
 - Familiarity with digital lean tools, plant simulation software, or Industry 4. 0 platforms is an advantage. 
 - Good presentation and facilitation skills for senior stakeholder engagement and shop-floor coaching. 
 - 
 - Strong understanding of the Lean manufacturing - Production System philosophy and its application in high-volume high-speed discrete or process manufacturing. 
 - Proven experience in leading large-scale lean transformations with measurable business impact. 
 - Knowledge of statistical process control (SPC), Six Sigma methodologies (Black Belt preferred), and problem-solving tools (A3, 8D, PDCA). 
 - Understanding of battery cell manufacturing processes (Mixing, Coating, Calendaring, Slitting, Assembly, Formation) is desirable. 
 - OEE Improvement: Drive Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) improvement programmes in collaboration with maintenance and production teams; identify and eliminate losses across availability, performance, and quality. 
 - Pull System & Kanban Implementation: Design and implement pull-based material flow systems, supermarkets, and Kanban replenishment loops across internal logistics and production areas. 
 - People Development & Lean Capability Building: Develop and deliver lean training programmes for all levels of the organisation, from operator to senior management. Coach and mentor internal lean champions. 
 - Production System Governance & Lean Maturity Model Adherence: Establish LMM frameworks to assess PS maturity, compliance, and sustainability. Drive corrective action plans based on findings. 
 - Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, Launch Integration, Supply Chain, and HR to align lean initiatives with overall plant and business objectives. 
 - Benchmarking & Best Practice: Lead external benchmarking activities across automotive and adjacent industries. Adapt and integrate best practices into the Agratas Production System. 
 - Project Management: Manage multiple lean and PS projects simultaneously, ensuring on-time delivery, resource allocation, budget adherence, and stakeholder communication. 
 - KPI Monitoring & Reporting: Define, track, and report on lean KPIs including lead time, cycle time, defect rates, first-pass yield, scrap, OEE, and cost savings to senior leadership. 
 - Establish metrics: Ability to identify and drive the drill down of organisational metrics to the front-line leadership level
 - Ability to integrate concepts such as TPM with the broader Production System and lean transformation

Job Context Specific

Mandatory / Desired

- Engineering degree in Mechanical / Industrial Engineering / Manufacturing Engineering or equivalent. 
 - Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (minimum); Black Belt preferred. 
 - Formal Lean / Production System training from an automotive OEM, Tier-1 supplier, or recognised lean institute. 

Mandatory Desired

- 15 to 20 years of experience in manufacturing operations with at least 8 to 10 years in a dedicated Lean / Production System role. 
 - Demonstrated track record of implementing Production Systems in high-volume manufacturing industries such as Automotive, Battery / EV, Pharma, Electronics, FMCG, Tyre, or Aerospace. 
 - Proven experience in building and leading lean teams, coaching frontline supervisors and managers, and driving cultural change. 
 - Experience working in greenfield manufacturing set-ups or transformative lean journeys from inception is strongly preferred.

data.title: React Native Developer
data.description:
Must Have

- 3 to 5 years shipping React Native apps that are live on the Play Store or App Store. 
 - A consumer app you helped grow past 100K active users, where crashes, slow screens and checkout drop-off had a measurable cost and you were the one who brought them down. 
 - Strong TypeScript and a deep grip on React Native: the new architecture, native modules, Reanimated and gestures, navigation, and profiling on real devices. You can explain why a screen is slow and fix it. 
 - A BFF (backend-for-frontend) layer and server-driven UI you have built or consumed in production. This is a big one: it is how we change screens and offers without a release. 
 - Observability and event SDKs wired properly: product analytics and session replay (PostHog or similar), crash reporting (Crashlytics or Sentry), and marketing and attribution SDKs such as MoEngage and the Meta SDK, with a clean event taxonomy that growth and ops can trust. 
 - Expo and EAS, or an equivalent build, release and OTA pipeline. 
 - Automated testing as part of the feature, not after it: Jest, React Native Testing Library, and Maestro or Detox on real devices. 
 - Strong UI/UX sense and real empathy. You can design a flow when there is no mock, and you understand that someone ordering medicine is often anxious, in a hurry, or not fluent with phones. Confusion here is not a bug, it is a missed dose. 
 - Inclusive design you can show: apps built for elderly, low-literacy or first-time smartphone users, and the accessibility and readability choices you made. 
 - Performance-tier engineering: an app that adapts to low-end devices and slow networks, and the measurements you used to segment it. 
 - Comfort going native when needed: Kotlin for Android modules, logcat and the profiler. 
 - AI coding assistants in daily use, and proof they made you faster without lowering what you ship. 
 - Taste. Strong opinions about what a good mobile experience feels like, and a shipped app that shows them. 
 - Ownership. You've carried a product from design through launch through the production incident afterwards, without a QA team to hand it to. 

Preferred

- Quick-commerce, healthcare, fintech or any consumer app where the first order and the repeat order were the metrics that mattered. 
 - Push and in-app campaign tooling beyond the SDK install: journeys, segments and deep links that land on the right screen. 
 - Firebase (Remote Config, Crashlytics, Realtime Database) and a cloud platform (AWS preferred). 
 - Hardware-adjacent mobile work: camera and barcode scanning, background location, foreground services. 
 - Swift and iOS experience, for when the app crosses over. 
 - Startup or product-company experience where you were one of a handful of engineers. 

Who You Are

- High agency. You see a problem, you own it, and you tell people what you did rather than asking whether you may start. 
 - Taste. You can tell the difference between an app that works and an app that feels right, and you care enough to close the gap. 
 - Empathy. You picture the person on the other side of the screen, and you know that for medicines the stakes are higher than for groceries. 
 - All users, not the median one. The 60-year-old on a budget phone with poor eyesight is your benchmark, not an edge case. 
 - Bias to delete. You'd rather remove a screen than add a setting. Simplicity is a feature you fight for. 
 - Ship, then watch. Replays, crash logs and a chat with a customer tell you more than a sprint review. 
 - Whole-surface owner. Happiest in a small team where the app is yours, and comfortable in the backend or native code when it needs you. 
 - AI-native, still accountable. You use AI tools to move faster, and you still read every line that goes out under your name. 
 - Close to the stores. You enjoy a fast pace and a 6-day week in the office, because the stores run every day and you want to be near them. 

What You'll Get

- Health insurance for you and your family. 
 - A top-of-the-line device and the tools you need to do your best work. 
 - ESOPs: own a piece of the company you're helping build. 
 - Real users, every day: the people using your app sit a short ride away, and you'll meet them

data.title: ENGINEER - QUALITY (SPECIAL PROCESS)
data.description:
Sansera Engineering Limited

PRIME FUNCTION

To support Quality Control and Assurance activities for Special Processes in accordance with Nadcap, AS9100, customer, and regulatory requirements by performing inspections, maintaining records, monitoring process controls, and assisting with audits and corrective actions under the guidance of senior quality personnel. 

Job Description / Responsibilities

- Perform incoming, in-process, and final inspections for Special Process components as per approved procedures, drawings, specifications, and control plans. 
 - Verify process parameters, inspection results, and traceability records, and promptly report deviations to the responsible senior engineer or manager. 
 - Maintain inspection reports, process logs, check sheets, calibration status records, and other quality documentation. 
 - Support preparation for Nadcap, AS9100, customer, and internal audits by compiling records and ensuring workplace readiness. 
 - Assist in recording non-conformities, segregating nonconforming product, and supporting root cause analysis and corrective action implementation. 
 - Monitor basic quality indicators such as rejection, rework, first-pass yield, and process compliance, and escalate adverse trends. 
 - Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, and other functions to resolve routine quality issues. 
 - Follow approved QMS procedures, safety requirements, work instructions, and good documentation practices. 
 - Participate in training, improvement activities, and assigned quality projects to build technical competence. 

AUTHORITY

- Authority to hold or identify nonconforming material and immediately escalate the issue to authorized quality personnel. 
 - Authority to request correction of incomplete or inaccurate inspection and process records. 
 - Authority to raise non-conformance reports and recommend corrective actions for review and approval. 
 - Authority to seek clarification when process, drawing, specification, or quality requirements are unclear. 

JOB SPECIFICATION / COMPETENCY

Qualification: 

- Diploma/B. E. /B. Tech in Mechanical, Production, Metallurgy, Industrial Engineering, or a relevant discipline

Experience: 

- 1-5 years of experience in Quality Control, Quality Assurance, manufacturing, or Special Processes; 

Technical Competencies

- Basic understanding of engineering drawings, specifications, inspection methods, and aerospace quality requirements. 
 - Awareness of SPC, RCA, FMEA, non-conformance control, and QMS practices. 
 - Basic awareness of Nadcap Special Process requirements and audit expectations. 
 - Awareness of AS9100 requirements, document control, and traceability. 

Behavioral Competencies

- Attention to detail, discipline, and willingness to learn. 
 - Basic analytical, problem-solving, and decision-support skills. 
 - Clear communication, teamwork, and timely escalation of quality concerns. 

Tools Required

- Quality Management System and document control applications
 - Basic measuring and inspection instruments relevant to the assigned process
 - SPC and basic data-analysis tools
 - FMEA, control plan, and non-conformance reporting formats
 - MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
 - Applicable Nadcap checklists and Special Process documentation

PERFORMANCE MEASURES

- Accuracy and completeness of inspection and quality records. 
 - Timely identification, containment, and escalation of non-conformities. 
 - Adherence to approved procedures, control plans, specifications, and safety requirements. 
 - Support provided for audit readiness and closure of assigned actions. 
 - Contribution to reduction of defects, rework, and documentation errors. 
 - Completion of assigned training and demonstrated improvement in technical competency. 
 - Timely completion of assigned inspections, reports, and improvement activities. 

Skills

Competencies

Adapting to Change

Attentive Listening

Collaboration and Team building

Communicating Effectively

Delivering High Quality Work

data.description:
Location: Delhi

Job Type: In Office | Full-Time

Role Type: Individual Contributor

Experience Level: 0-2 Years

Reports to: Engineering Manager

About the Role

CITiLIGHT is seeking a IoT QA Engineer to ensure that our smart lighting hardware and software work together reliably in real-world deployments. In this role, you will be responsible for testing IoT devices end-to-end through our software platform, verifying device commands and data, investigating issues, and supporting the continuous improvement of product quality. 

The ideal candidate brings a logical and structured approach to problem-solving, strong attention to detail, and an eagerness to learn across IoT, hardware, networking, and software. This role is hands-on and requires close collaboration with firmware, hardware, and software teams to identify, reproduce, troubleshoot, and resolve issues across the full stack. 

About CITiLIGHT

CITiLIGHT is reshaping how smart infrastructure works globally. We operate at the intersection of smart cities, sustainability, and innovation, helping city administrators and private stakeholders deploy cutting-edge IoT-led solutions at scale. 

As we expand our platform capabilities, we are looking for passionate and skilled engineers to help us build robust, user-friendly, and scalable applications that drive real-world impact. 

Key Responsibilities

- Test IoT devices including NEMA, Zhaga, pole-mount controllers, CCMS, and related systems end-to-end through the software platform. 
 - Verify that commands such as switching, dimming, and scheduling reach devices correctly. 
 - Validate that device data including status, energy, alarms, and other telemetry is accurately reflected on the platform dashboard. 
 - Write and execute test cases for new features, software releases, and firmware updates. 
 - Find, reproduce, and clearly document bugs using steps to reproduce, logs, screenshots, and other relevant evidence. 
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing across hardware, firmware, backend, and frontend components. 
 - Work closely with firmware, hardware, and software teams to investigate and troubleshoot issues across the full technology stack. 
 - Fix small bugs and UI issues in the React / Next. js frontend and Node. js backend where appropriate. 
 - Use APIs, logs, device data, and debugging tools to identify the likely source of issues. 
 - Support the improvement of testing processes, test coverage, documentation, and overall product quality as the platform grows. 

Key Responsibilities

- Basic to good knowledge of JavaScript, React / Next. js, and Node. js. 
 - Strong logical and structured problem-solving ability, with an interest in understanding why an issue occurred rather than only identifying that it occurred. 
 - Ability to write, execute, and document clear and repeatable test cases. 
 - Strong attention to detail and clear written communication. 
 - Eagerness to learn IoT, hardware, networking, software platforms, and related technologies as required by the problem. 
 - Hands-on attitude and comfort working with physical IoT devices and equipment in a lab environment. 
 - Ability to investigate issues using logs, screenshots, APIs, device data, and basic debugging tools. 
 - Basic understanding of REST APIs, MQTT, or IoT device communication. 
 - Exposure to Git/version control in a collaborative development environment. 
 - Ability to work closely with hardware, firmware, backend, frontend, and QA stakeholders. 
 - Willingness to work onsite at the CITiLIGHT office in Delhi. 

Soft Skills (Critical for Success)

- Ownership mindset: Takes responsibility for assigned testing and issue-resolution activities. 
 - Team collaboration: Works seamlessly with hardware, firmware, software, and QA teams. 
 - Clear communicator: Documents issues clearly and communicates technical findings effectively. 
 - Problem solver: Approaches failures systematically and investigates root causes. 
 - Eager to learn: Open to feedback, continuous improvement, and learning new technologies. 
 - Adaptable & hands-on: Comfortable switching between software, hardware, testing, and troubleshooting tasks. 

Soft Skills (Critical for Success)

- Experience with manual or automated testing tools such as Postman, Jest, Cypress, Playwright, or similar. 
 - Familiarity with REST APIs, MQTT, or IoT devices. 
 - Exposure to Git and basic debugging tools. 
 - Interest in smart cities, embedded systems, IoT, or hardware.

data.title: DGM – Lean Manufacturing Implementation
data.description:
JOB TITLE DGM - Lean Manufacturing Implementation

JOB ROLE Responsible for Lean Manufacturing Implementation & Production System Development

GRADE/LEVEL (Choose 1) Apprentice / FTC / L6-3/ L6-2 / L6-1 / L5 / L4

FUNCTION / DEPARTMENT Manufacturing

SUB-FUNCTION Production System / Lean

REPORTING TO GM - Manufacturing / VP - Operations

JOB LOCATION Cell Manufacturing Plant (E-Zone)

JOB SCOPE National

PEOPLE MANGEMENT RESPONSBILITY Yes

ABOUT AGRATAS

Agratas is a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons. We design, develop and manufacture high-quality, high-performance, sustainable batteries applied to multiple use cases in the mobility and energy sectors, to match our customers' requirements. 

Agratas is a scale-up business with a start-up mentality, driven by our pursuit of green growth and technological progress. 

We develop next-generation battery technologies at our state-of-the-art R&D Innovation Hubs in India and the UK. 

ROLE SUMMARY

Managing and leading a cross-functional team of engineers and production specialists to design, deploy, and sustain a world-class Production System (PS) grounded in Lean Manufacturing principles. The role is pivotal in driving cultural and operational transformation across the cell manufacturing plant by embedding lean tools, methodologies, and a continuous improvement mindset at every level of the organisation. The DGM will be responsible for developing and implementing the Agratas Production System (APS) framework, standardising work processes, eliminating waste, and enabling measurable improvements in people, safety, quality, delivery, cost, maintenance, energy and environment (PPSQDCMEE). The role requires close collaboration with production, maintenance, quality, supply chain, and HR functions, as well as engagement with external partners and benchmarking organisations. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

Technical / Functional

- Agratas Production System (APS) Development & Deployment: Design, develop, and implement a comprehensive Production System framework aligned with Lean principles (LEAN MANUFACTURING -PS-derived), covering all manufacturing areas of the cell plant. 
 - Lean Transformation Leadership: Lead end-to-end lean transformation initiatives across all shop floors, including Electrode, Assembly, Formation, and End-of-Line, ensuring sustained change management and cultural adoption. 
 - Value Stream Mapping (VSM): Conduct detailed current-state and future-state VSM exercises to identify waste, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities across the manufacturing value chain. 
 - Standardised Work & Work Instruction Management: Establish, maintain, and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), standardised work documents, and operator work instructions. 
 - Kaizen & Continuous Improvement Programme: Plan, facilitate, and drive structured Kaizen events, improvement workshops, and CI projects targeting PSQDCME metrics. Track and report savings and impact. 
 - 5S & Visual Management: Design and sustain 5S systems, visual factory standards, shadow boards, andon systems, and production control boards across all production areas. 
 - Line Balancing & Flow Optimisation: Lead cycle time studies, takt time analysis, line balancing exercises, and layout optimisation to enhance throughput and reduce WIP. 
 - OEE Improvement: Drive Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) improvement programmes in collaboration with maintenance and production teams; identify and eliminate losses across availability, performance, and quality. 
 - Pull System & Kanban Implementation: Design and implement pull-based material flow systems, supermarkets, and Kanban replenishment loops across internal logistics and production areas. 
 - People Development & Lean Capability Building: Develop and deliver lean training programmes for all levels of the organisation, from operator to senior management. Coach and mentor internal lean champions. 
 - Production System Governance & Lean Maturity Model Adherence: Establish LMM frameworks to assess PS maturity, compliance, and sustainability. Drive corrective action plans based on findings. 
 - Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, Launch Integration, Supply Chain, and HR to align lean initiatives with overall plant and business objectives. 
 - Benchmarking & Best Practice: Lead external benchmarking activities across automotive and adjacent industries. Adapt and integrate best practices into the Agratas Production System. 
 - Project Management: Manage multiple lean and PS projects simultaneously, ensuring on-time delivery, resource allocation, budget adherence, and stakeholder communication. 
 - KPI Monitoring & Reporting: Define, track, and report on lean KPIs including lead time, cycle time, defect rates, first-pass yield, scrap, OEE, and cost savings to senior leadership. 
 - Establish metrics: Ability to identify and drive the drill down of organisational metrics to the front-line leadership level
 - Ability to integrate concepts such as TPM with the broader Production System and lean transformationIT Skills

- Proficiency in MS Excel (advanced), PowerPoint, and data analysis tools such as Minitab and project management. 
 - Familiarity with digital lean tools, plant simulation software, or Industry 4. 0 platforms is an advantage. 
 - Good presentation and facilitation skills for senior stakeholder engagement and shop-floor coaching. 

PREREQUISITES - TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE

- In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience of core Lean tools: VSM, 5S, SMED, Poka-Yoke, Kaizen, Kanban, Heijunka, Jidoka, and Standardised Work. 
 - Strong understanding of the Lean manufacturing - Production System philosophy and its application in high-volume high-speed discrete or process manufacturing. 
 - Proven experience in leading large-scale lean transformations with measurable business impact. 
 - Knowledge of statistical process control (SPC), Six Sigma methodologies (Black Belt preferred), and problem-solving tools (A3, 8D, PDCA). 
 - Understanding of battery cell manufacturing processes (Mixing, Coating, Calendaring, Slitting, Assembly, Formation) is desirable. 
 - Experience with layout design, ergonomics, and material flow optimisation in greenfield or brownfield plants is desirable

ROLE-SPECIFIC QUALIFICATION / CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENT

Mandatory / Desired: 

- Engineering degree in Mechanical / Industrial Engineering / Manufacturing Engineering or equivalent. 
 - Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (minimum); Black Belt preferred. 
 - Formal Lean / Production System training from an automotive OEM, Tier-1 supplier, or recognised lean institute. 

Suitable / Optional: 

- Post-graduate qualification in Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, or MBA (Operations). 
 - Certification in TPM (JIPM standard), Shingo Prize framework or similar 
 - Working knowhow of data analytics tool such as Power Bi, Power Apps

Role Specific knowledge, Skills and Experience

Mandatory Desired: 

- 15 to 20 years of experience in manufacturing operations with at least 8 to 10 years in a dedicated Lean / Production System role. 
 - Demonstrated track record of implementing Production Systems in high-volume manufacturing industries such as Automotive, Battery / EV, Pharma, Electronics, FMCG, Tyre, or Aerospace. 
 - Proven experience in building and leading lean teams, coaching frontline supervisors and managers, and driving cultural change. 
 - Experience working in greenfield manufacturing set-ups or transformative lean journeys from inception is strongly preferred. Suitable / Optional: 

- Prior exposure to Lithium-ion Cell Manufacturing, Battery Technology, or New Energy Vehicle production environments. 
 - Experience in deploying digital/Industry 4. 0 solutions as part of a lean transformation (e-Kanban, real-time OEE monitoring, digital SOPs). 

Role Specific Behavioural Skills

Mandatory / Desired: 

- Transformational Leadership: Ability to inspire, influence, and mobilise people at all levels towards a common vision of operational excellence. 
 - Collaborative & Cross-functional: Works effectively across departmental boundaries; builds trust and alignment with diverse stakeholders. 
 - Innovative & Problem-Solving Mindset: Challenges the status quo, experiments with new ideas, and drives creative solutions to complex manufacturing challenges. 
 - Strong Communication Skills: Able to articulate lean concepts clearly to both shop-floor teams and senior leadership; confident presenter and facilitator. 
 - PDCA / Scientific Thinking: Consistently applies Plan-Do-Check-Act discipline; data-driven decision-making grounded in Gemba observations. 

Suitable / Optional: 

- Resilience & Persistence: Committed to sustaining long-term change despite organisational resistance or setbacks. 
 - Coaching & Mentoring: Passionate about developing people's lean capability and nurturing the next generation of internal champions. 
 - Focused & Results-Oriented: Sets ambitious targets, maintains accountability, and drives initiatives through to measurable completion.

data.title: Head of QA / Quality Engineering
data.description:
Flam is building the next generation of interactive media through its content format. We are an AI-native technology company transforming how brands and consumers interact through immersive, interactive content. Our technology enables rich, app-less experiences that can be launched instantly on smartphones, creating a fundamentally different way for brands to engage consumers. We are backed by leading investors and already work with some of the world's largest brands. We are now building Flicks, our interactive media format for the US market. 

The Role

As the Head of QA / Quality Engineering, you will own the overall quality strategy for Flam's products and technology platform. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines people leadership, engineering, automation, architecture, quality strategy, and operational excellence. You will work closely with Engineering, AI/ML, Product, DevOps, Security, and Customer Success to establish a world-class quality engineering organization capable of supporting rapid product development without compromising reliability -moving Flam from a primarily functional QA approach toward a modern, automation-first, engineering-led quality

organization. 

The ideal candidate can build the function from the ground up, define the right processes and metrics, introduce the right automation architecture, and personally drive the transformation. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Build the Quality Engineering Function

- Define and own Flam's overall QA and Quality Engineering strategy. 
 - Establish the organization's quality vision, principles, processes, and engineering standards. 
 - Build and scale the QA organization across manual testing, automation, performance, reliability, and specialized testing. 
 - Define roles, responsibilities, career paths, and technical standards for the QA team. 
 - Establish a culture where quality is everyone's responsibility, while QA provides the engineering framework, tooling, and governance to achieve it. 
 - Partner with engineering leadership to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle. 

2. Automation-First Testing

- Build a comprehensive test automation strategy across frontend, backend, APIs, SDKs, and platform services, establishing automation frameworks for: UI Testing API Testing Integration Testing End-to-End Testing Regression Testing Contract Testing Mobile / Web Testing Significantly reduce dependency on manual regression testing. 
 - Integrate automated testing deeply into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Establish appropriate test pyramids and testing standards across engineering teams. 
 - Define automation coverage and quality gates for every major product area. 

3. AI / ML Quality & Evaluation

- Flam's products introduce testing challenges that go beyond traditional software QA. You will establish frameworks for evaluating AI and multimodal systems, including LLM response quality and consistency, RAG accuracy and relevance, hallucination detection and evaluation, retrieval quality, prompt and model regression testing, speech-to-text and text-to- speech quality, voice interaction reliability, avatar and lip-sync quality, computer vision and multimodal interaction quality, AI response latency, model/version regression, safety and undesirable model behavior, evaluation datasets and golden test sets, and automated AI evaluation pipelines. 

You will work closely with the AI engineering team to establish repeatable, measurable evaluation frameworks rather than relying primarily on subjective testing. 

4. Performance, Scalability & Reliability Testing

- Own the quality strategy for systems operating at scale, including load testing, stress testing, soak/endurance testing, scalability testing, API performance testing, concurrent-user testing, latency benchmarking, realtime interaction testing, GPU/AI inference performance validation, failure and recovery testing, resilience testing, and capacity testing. 
 - Establish clear SLA/SLO-oriented quality metrics and work with Engineering and DevOps to continuously improve production reliability. 

5. Release & Quality Governance

- Establish a robust and predictable release process. You will define release quality gates, definition of done, regression strategy, risk-based testing methodology, release readiness criteria, production and post-release validation, defect severity and prioritization standards, escaped defect analysis, root-cause analysis, and release quality dashboards. 
 - The objective is to enable faster releases with higher confidence, rather than adding process and slowing engineering down. 

6. Shift-Left Quality

- Partner with engineering teams to introduce quality earlier in the development lifecycle. 
 - Drive adoption of unit testing standards, integration testing, contract testing, API-first testing, developer-owned testing, static analysis, code qualitychecks, automated regression suites, CI quality gates, and production observability-driven quality improvement. 
 - QA should not be the final checkpoint before production; quality should be engineered into the product from the beginning. 

7. Defect & Root Cause Management

- Establish a data-driven approach to defect management, owning metrics such as defect escape rate, regression rate, production defect rate, mean time to detect, mean time to resolve, defect recurrence, automation coverage, test execution time, release confidence, and flaky test rate. 
 - Drive systematic root-cause analysis for critical production issues and ensure corrective actions are implemented. 

8. Quality Engineering Architecture & Tooling

- Evaluate and establish the appropriate tooling and frameworks for Flam's technology ecosystem, including test automation frameworks, API testing frameworks, performance testing platforms, CI/CD integration, test management and reporting, AI evaluation frameworks, synthetic test data, test environments, service virtualization/mocking, and monitoring and observability integration. 

The Head of QA should be able to make pragmatic build-vs-buy decisions and create a scalable QA technology stack. 

9. Cross-Functional Leadership

Work closely with Platform Engineering, AI/ML Engineering, Frontend Engineering, Product Management, DevOps/Infrastructure, Security, Customer Success, and business teams - representing quality at the leadership level and ensuring product velocity and product quality remain aligned. 

What We Are Looking For

10+ years of experience in Software Testing / Quality Engineering. 

Strongly Preferred

- Experience testing AI/ML or Generative AI products. 
 - Experience with LLM evaluation, RAG evaluation, or AItesting. 
 - 4+ years in a senior QA leadership role managing andscaling QA organizations. 
 - Proven experience building or transforming a QA organization from manual QA toward automation and Quality Engineering. 
 - Strong experience with test automation architecture. 
 - Strong API, backend, frontend, and end-to-end testing experience. 
 - Experience designing CI/CD-integrated automated testing. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems and modern cloud applications. 
 - Experience with performance and scalability testing. 
 - Experience defining engineering quality metrics and release governance. 
 - Strong programming/scripting skills (Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar). 
 - Experience working closely with engineering and product leadership. 
 - Experience with realtime systems. 
 - Experience testing voice, video, computer vision, or multimodal applications. 
 - Experience with high-scale consumer or enterprise SaaS platforms. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes/cloud-native environments. 
 - Experience building QA organizations in high-growth startups. 
 - Experience with security, reliability, or compliance-oriented testing. 

We are looking for a leader who: 

- Thinks like an engineer, not only a test manager. 
 - Is comfortable going deep into architecture and technology.

data.title: AI Quality and Automation Engineer
data.description:
AI Quality & Automation Engineer

About Nenu

Nenu is a fast-moving, Silicon Valley-based, VC-backed startup building ambitious, user-facing products at the intersection of modern web applications and AI-powered systems. 

From the heart of Chennai, we're building for global scale - focused on speed, ownership, and creating high-impact products from the ground up. 

We're at a stage where the foundations are being built and scaled, which means the people who join now will directly shape how the product, platform, and engineering practices evolve. 

We are an AI-first company, using AI not just in our products, but across how we build, test, deploy, and operate. 

About the Role

We're looking for an AI Quality & Automation Engineer with 4-7 years of experience who thinks beyond traditional QA and wants to redefine how quality is built in an AI-first engineering organization. 

You will own quality end-to-end - not just writing test scripts, but building the systems, frameworks, practices, and intelligence that help the entire engineering team ship better software with confidence. 

This is a 0-1 role. You'll build our quality and automation approach from the ground up, based on how our actual product, systems, and engineering workflows work. You'll use AI throughout the lifecycle to test, validate, analyze, and continuously improve how we build software. 

You'll also be responsible for continuously evolving how we test - bringing in new ideas, tools, techniques, and industry best practices and turning the ones that work into strong engineering practices across the organization. 

In simple terms , you are the person who makes sure what we build actually works, and builds systems to catch what could go wrong before it reaches production. 

You'll be: 

- Building the quality and automation framework from 0-1
 - Testing and validating across the entire product lifecycle
 - Using AI throughout the testing and validation lifecycle
 - Finding problems before they become production problems
 - Continuously improving how the organization approaches quality

Core Competencies - What You Will Do

- Own quality end-to-end: Take responsibility for product quality across development, testing, and deployment - not just individual test cases or automation suites. 
 - Build the quality framework from 0-1: Design and build a strong, scalable testing environment based on our actual product, systems, workflows, and failure modes - not a generic testing template. 
 - Drive testing best practices: Establish and continuously evolve best practices across test design, automation, coverage, validation, regression prevention, reliability, and release quality. 
 - Continuously improve the testing practice: Stay curious about emerging testing approaches, AI capabilities, tools, and industry practices; identify what can make our quality process better and actively implement what is valuable. 
 - Bring learning into the organization: Experiment with new tools, techniques, and approaches, turn useful learnings into repeatable practices, and help the broader engineering team adopt them. 
 - Build proactive quality systems: Think beyond testing what already exists. Identify how systems can fail, anticipate edge cases, and build checks that catch problems before they reach production. 
 - AI-driven testing: Use AI throughout the testing lifecycle - from understanding changes and generating test scenarios to writing tests, debugging failures, identifying gaps, and validating releases. 
 - Validate AI-generated development: Build mechanisms to independently validate code, features, and system changes produced with AI so that development speed does not come at the cost of reliability. 
 - Build intelligent automation: Create automation that is reliable, adaptive, maintainable, and capable of evolving as the product and engineering practices change. 
 - Own deployment quality: Integrate automated validation into development and deployment workflows so changes are continuously tested before and after release. 
 - Find what others don't: Go beyond expected test scenarios, challenge assumptions, and identify edge cases, failure modes, and gaps that traditional testing approaches may miss. 
 - Raise the engineering quality bar: Make quality a shared engineering value by partnering with engineering and product teams and influencing how quality is built into the development lifecycle. 
 - Challenge existing approaches: Question how testing is normally done, identify better ways of working, and introduce approaches that improve speed, coverage, confidence, and reliability. 
 - Influence without authority: Bring clarity, evidence, and practical solutions that help the broader engineering team adopt stronger quality practices. 

Skills & Capability Stack - What You Need to Succeed

- 4-8 years of experience in test automation, quality engineering, software testing, or a closely related engineering role
 - Strong logical and analytical thinking with the ability to break down complex systems and problems
 - Strong understanding of how software can fail and the ability to proactively identify edge cases and failure modes
 - Hands-on experience building or owning automation frameworks end-to-end
 - Deeply hands-on with AI development and engineering tools such as Claude Code, Grok, Codex, and similar tools
 - Ability to use AI for test generation, code generation, debugging, analysis, refactoring, coverage improvement, and problem solving
 - Ability to understand and reason across different layers of a software system
 - Understanding of deployment workflows, CI/CD, release processes, and production environments
 - Ability to work across multiple frameworks, languages, and tools based on what the product requires
 - Strong debugging skills and the ability to trace issues across multiple layers of a system
 - Ability to design testing approaches based on the specific product and system rather than relying on predefined templates
 - Curiosity to continuously learn new tools, technologies, and testing approaches - and the ability to turn useful learning into practical improvements
 - Ability to influence engineers and teams through technical clarity, collaboration, and strong reasoning
 - Strong ownership mindset with the ability to build a quality practice from the ground up
 - Ability to balance speed, coverage, reliability, and maintainability in a fast-moving environment

Tech Environment - What You'll Work With

- Claude Code
 - Grok
 - Codex
 - AI-assisted development and testing tools
 - AI-powered automation
 - Emerging AI testing and quality tools
 - Automation frameworks and tools that best fit the product and problemYou're not expected to come in with a fixed toolbox. The expectation is that you can learn, adapt, experiment, and use the right tools to solve the quality challenges we face. 

What Makes You a Great Fit

- You don't think of yourself as a traditional QA tester - you think like an engineer who owns quality. 
 - You enjoy building things from scratch and are comfortable with 0-1 problems. 
 - You naturally think about what could go wrong, not just whether the expected flow works. 
 - You are deeply curious about AI and already use AI tools as part of how you work. 
 - You don't just learn new tools or practices - you experiment with them and put the valuable ones into practice. 
 - You're comfortable understanding complex software systems and how different parts interact. 
 - You challenge existing approaches when you see a better way to solve a problem. 
 - You care about building simple, reliable, scalable systems rather than creating process for the sake of process. 
 - You can work across teams and influence engineering practices without relying on formal authority. 
 - You thrive in a high-ownership, high-intensity environment where speed and quality both matter. 
 - You want to build a quality practice that becomes a genuine engineering strength for the company. 

What Success Looks Like - First 90-180 Days

- A strong 0-1 quality and automation framework is designed and actively being used. 
 - Critical product flows have meaningful automated coverage and validation. 
 - AI-assisted development changes can be automatically validated through the quality lifecycle. 
 - Testing is integrated into development and deployment workflows rather than treated as a final step. 
 - Major quality gaps, failure modes, and blind spots are identified and addressed proactively. 
 - New testing tools, techniques, and practices are being evaluated and adopted where they create real value. 
 - Engineers have greater visibility and confidence in the quality of their changes. 
 - Stronger testing and quality practices are becoming part of how the engineering organization builds software. 
 - You become a trusted technical partner to Engineering, DevOps, and Product. 

Why Join Nenu

We believe great teams build great products, which is why we invest deeply in our people: 

- Competitive salary and meaningful ESOPs
 - Comprehensive healthcare and insurance coverage
 - Unlimited leave policy built on trust and ownership
 - Real growth in scope, ownership, and technical influence as the company scales

You'll be joining a team building what the future of AI could look like.   We're solving problems and building products that are years ahead of where the industry is, giving you the opportunity to work on things that don't have a playbook yet. 

If you want to be part of a company thinking beyond today, building at the edge of AI, and creating something genuinely transformative, this is the right place to be. 

If you're someone who takes ownership, thinks ahead, and wants to redefine how quality is built in an AI-first company, we'd love to hear from you.
