data.title: AI Product Manager
data.description:
Company Description CareerPassport is building evidence-led professional identity infrastructure designed for the AI era. The company focuses on helping knowledge workers showcase their real, lived experience and capabilities, beyond traditional resumes and profiles. By enabling talent evaluation based on concrete evidence rather than claims, CareerPassport supports more accurate and fair hiring decisions. The platform empowers professionals to present "the real you" and helps organizations hire for what is demonstrably real. Applicants joining CareerPassport will contribute to redefining how professional identity and talent assessment work in an AI-driven world. 

Roles and Responsibilities

• Build and operate services - Design, ship, and run Node. js/TypeScript services that sit behind the GraphQL federation. Own a slice of the ~40-service estate end-to-end: API design, schema, persistence, tests, deployment, on-call. 

• GraphQL federation subgraphs - Add types, resolvers, and capabilities to the federated Platform API. Keep subgraph boundaries clean; respect RBAC at the federation enforcement layer. 

• Commerce backbone - Build the subscription, invoicing, overage, dispute, and payout flows that integrate with Stripe and PayPal webhooks and the billing state machine. Make sure metering, billing, and payouts stay accurate, auditable, and replayable. 

• Proxy control plane - Build the management APIs and background workers that configure the runtime proxy: API keys, plans, rate-limit policies, quota caches, abuse signals. 

• Event-driven systems - Produce and consume Kafka and Kinesis events safely: schema evolution, idempotency, retries, dead-letter handling. Operate Lambda consumers where they're the right tool. 

• Data services - Help own the Node. js Analytics Service and Quota Service that front ClickHouse and Snowflake. Keep latency low, queries cheap, and authorisation correct. 

• Performance and reliability - Diagnose hot paths, tune queries, add caches where they matter, and remove caches that have become liabilities. Write the SLOs and the alerts that defend them. 

• Security isolation - Implement OAuth2 / JWT / mTLS where they belong; respect least-privilege; design APIs that fail closed. 

• On-call and incident response - Take part in the rotation. Lead investigations across services when something rooted in your area breaks. 

• LLM-assisted engineering - Use LLM-based coding and agentic tooling to evolve how features are designed, reviewed, and tested. 

What Success Looks Like

• Services you own meet their SLOs, deploy multiple times a day, and rarely wake anyone up. 

• Billing, subscription, overage, and payout flows you ship are accurate to the cent, replayable, and trusted by both providers and consumers. 

• GraphQL subgraphs you maintain stay fast, well-typed, and pleasant to extend. 

• Event pipelines you produce and consume are idempotent, observable, and survive replay and back-pressure. 

• The first generation of agent-native primitives you help build land in production and start carrying real agent traffic. 

What You Bring

• 5-8 years of backend engineering experience, with non-trivial work on production services that real customers depended on. 

• Strong TypeScript / Node. js in a production service environment; comfort with async patterns, streams, and back-pressure. 

• Solid API design - REST and GraphQL (ideally federation: Apollo Federation, Mercurius, or similar). Schema design, persisted queries, performance tuning. 

• Production fluency with SQL - MySQL and/or Postgres. Bonus for Redis or ClickHouse. 

• Experience with event-driven systems - Kafka or similar. You understand idempotency, exactly-once myths, and consumer lag. 

• Hands-on AWS (EKS, MSK, Kinesis, DynamoDB, Lambda, DMS) and Kubernetes. Comfortable reading and writing Terraform. 

• Modern engineering practice: observability, feature flags, CI/CD, and safe rollouts. 

• Care for correctness on the money path - you have shipped billing, metering, or payment code before and have the scars to show for it. 

• Bonus: experience with API gateways, rate limiting, quota enforcement, usage metering, agent protocols (MCP, A2A, x402), or LLM-based developer tooling. 

• You write small, reviewable PRs. You add the test before you fix the bug. You would rather ship a smaller thing well than a bigger thing badly.

Working alongside a Senior Developer, you will contribute to Python FastAPI backend services, React front-end interfaces, and REST API integrations, including third-party documentation vendor connections that support Emerson's global product information ecosystem. 

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be

 - Develop and maintain React. js front-end components, including state management, responsive UI, and integration with FastAPI backend services for product and asset management workflows.

 - Assist with REST API integrations to third-party documentation platforms (Zoomin and similar) by consuming APIs, handling data transformation, and supporting publication workflows.

 - Write clean, well-documented, and reusable code following team standards, participate actively in code reviews, and maintain technical documentation for owned features, including API endpoint notes, data flow descriptions, and test cases. 
 - Collaborate with Product Owners, QA, and System Analysts to understand requirements and deliver quality solutions on time. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies and CI/CD delivery practices using Azure DevOps. 

Who You Are: 

You readily take on new challenges and display a can-do attitude in good and difficult times. You act with a clear sense of ownership and take personal responsibility for decisions, actions, and failures. You effectively communicate in various settings and provide timely, helpful information to individuals across the organization. You partner with others to get work done and create teamwork that allows the organization to achieve shared objectives. You are curious and eager to learn, you seek feedback, grow from it, and continuously improve your craft. 

For This Role, You Will Need

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 3-5 years of software development experience with hands-on delivery in Python and React in a professional environment. 
 - Proficiency in building REST API services using FastAPI, including endpoint definition, Pydantic models, request/response handling, and basic async patterns. 
 - Solid experience building React components with modern JavaScript (ES6+), state management (Redux or Context API), and integration with REST API backends. 
 - Experience consuming and building REST APIs, understanding of HTTP methods, status codes, JSON payloads, and basic authentication patterns (JWT or API key). 
 - Working knowledge of PostgreSQL or MySQL, including writing queries, basic schema understanding, and supporting data operations in a relational database environment. 
 - Familiarity with Git version control, Azure DevOps, or similar CI/CD tools, and sprint-based delivery and strong English communication skills. 

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart

- Experience integrating with third-party SaaS platforms or documentation tool APIs (Zoomin, Paligo, or similar) via REST.

 - Exposure to asynchronous patterns in Python, including FastAPI Background Tasks, Celery, or task queuing basics. 
 - Experience with automated testing tools such as PyTest for backend, Jest or React Testing Library for frontend. 
 - Basic familiarity with Docker for local development environments.

data.title: Technical Lead - Data Science & AI
data.description:
About Euromonitor

Euromonitor International leads the world in data analytics and research into markets, industries, economies and consumers. We provide truly global insight and data on thousands of products and services; we are the first destination for organisations seeking growth. With our guidance, our clients can make bold, strategic decisions with confidence. 

Overview Of The Role

Passport, Euromonitor's flagship platform, has just been rebuilt from the ground up. It is the largest technology investment in the company's history, and AI now sits at the core of the system. 

Euromonitor is establishing an AI and Data Science team in India to be part of this journey. The remit is a framework driven, platform centric approach: the team builds the AI platform, reusable agents, skills and tooling that product teams use to engineer AI and Data Science capability into Passport and other customer offerings, including new products built on AI and agentic flows. 

Based in Bengaluru and reporting to the Head of Engineering (AI and Data Science), this role is the technical anchor of the team: a hands-on lead who balances applied Data Science, modern AI engineering and backend platform craft in equal measure. You will set technical direction for the platform's components, lead their design and delivery, and stay close to the code. The measure of success is the same as for every role on this team: components adopted across product teams, not features shipped into a single product. 

What You'll Do

Technical Leadership

- Set the technical direction for platform components across retrieval, ranking, evaluation and agentic services, and own the design decisions that keep them coherent as one platform. 
 - Lead design and code reviews, establish engineering standards, and mentor senior and associate engineers across the data science and backend disciplines the team combines. 
 - Make build, buy or adopt decisions on frameworks and tooling, with explicit trade-offs on cost, lock-in and maintainability, documented at decision time. 

Applied Data Science and AI

- Guide the development of reusable ranking, personalisation and recommendation components from experimentation through to shared services with measurable quality baselines. 
 - Own the technical quality of the evaluation harness: golden dataset methodology, LLM-as-judge calibration and regression gates that consuming teams trust. 
 - Steer retrieval strategy across structured and unstructured data: chunking and indexing, hybrid search, reranking and embedding lifecycle. 

Reusable Platform Services

- Architect and build backend services and APIs for the AI platform as versioned, documented, multi-consumer services, including the agent framework and the skills and tool registry. 
 - Ensure production readiness is designed in from the start: observability, cost and token telemetry, quality gates and Responsible AI controls. 
 - Partner with Engineering, Architecture and Data Platform teams to keep the platform aligned with Euromonitor's cloud native architecture, and onboard consuming teams through reference implementations and paved road patterns. 

Requirements

What we're looking for

Essential

- 10+ years in software engineering with substantial applied Data Science and AI experience, including time as a hands-on technical lead accountable for the designs of others as well as your own. 
 - Balanced depth across the three disciplines this team combines: applied Machine Learning (ranking, recommendation or NLP, with the statistical grounding to design and interpret evaluations), modern Generative AI engineering, and backend service architecture. 
 - A proven track record of designing reusable services, libraries or frameworks adopted by multiple teams, with evidence of that adoption and of the versioning and compatibility decisions you made along the way. 
 - Hands-on depth in the Generative AI stack: RAG and retrieval systems; LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex or Semantic Kernel (LangGraph and LangChain preferred); and vector or hybrid search such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search or pgvector (Elasticsearch preferred). 
 - Production operations on a major cloud platform such as Azure, AWS or GCP with Kubernetes (Azure and AKS preferred), and strong Python plus at least one further backend language such as C#, Java or Go (C# and . NET preferred). 
 - Experience leading design reviews and mentoring engineers, and the ability to explain technical approaches, trade-offs and limitations clearly to stakeholders; adoption of platform components depends on it. 

Desirable Experience

- Experience with MCP or tool calling protocols, agent runtimes, or LLM gateway patterns such as routing, caching and fallback. 
 - LLM-as-judge calibration, golden dataset methodology or online experimentation experience, including evaluation frameworks such as Ragas, DeepEval or promptfoo. 
 - Model development experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow or scikit-learn, including training or fine tuning beyond API level usage of foundation models. 
 - Exposure to adjacent agent ecosystems and platforms such as AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, or MLOps tooling such as MLflow, Azure Machine Learning, SageMaker or Vertex AI. 
 - Contribution to internal platforms, open source libraries or SDKs with real external consumers. 
 - Background in market research, publishing, information services or another accuracy-sensitive domain. 

Benefits

Why work for Euromonitor?

Our Values: 

We seek individuals who act with integrity

We look for candidates who are curious about the world

We feel that as a community, we're stronger together

We seek to enable people to feel empowered

We welcome candidates who bring strength in diversity

International: We have a multinational workforce and communicate daily across our 16 global offices. 

Hardworking and Sociable: Our staff balance hard work with enjoyment, offering flexible hours and regular social events, including after-work meetups, summer and Christmas parties. 

Committed to Making a Difference: Our Corporate Social Responsibility Programme provides two volunteering days annually; donation amounts for new starters and supports local and international charities through various initiatives. 

Excellent Benefits: We offer competitive salaries, private health insurance, and generous holiday allowances, amongst much more!

Opportunities to Grow: We provide extensive training and development, promoting from within and across departments, and rewarding talent. 

Equal Employment Opportunity: Euromonitor International does not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, or other non-merit factors.

data.title: Sr. Founding Product Engineer
data.description:
About Teamified: 

Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast-scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high performing global teams simple, fast, and cost-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers, designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day. 

About the client: 

Our client is an innovative Australian health technology company developing an AI-powered anxiety coaching application based on an evidence-based psychological approach to managing anxiety. 

The application is designed for iOS and Android using React Native, with a React-based website supporting user registration and subscriptions. Currently in the testing phase and approaching its soft launch, the platform features an AI-powered coaching assistant that uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to deliver structured, personalised coaching conversations. 

The AI Coach operates within a clinically guided framework, incorporating structured coaching pathways, a toolkit of resources, conversational guidelines, and built-in safety mechanisms that can intervene when necessary. 

As the platform handles sensitive mental health information, security, privacy, and responsible AI development are central to its design and ongoing operation. 

About the role: 

We are hiring one person to own the product's engineering end-to-end. You will be the technical owner of the AI Coach and the systems around it, reporting directly to a non-technical founder. You plan your own work, set your own technical direction within the product brief, and ship. There is no CTO above you and no agency to lean on - you are the engineering function, working at speed with AI-first tooling and agentic coding workflows. 

- Own the AI Coach: prompting, conversation state and progression, retrieval (Pinecone), model selection and evaluation, and the safety/crisis layer - tested against scripted clinical scenarios
 - Own the backend: Python 3. 12, FastAPI, GraphQL (Strawberry), SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, AWS (Sydney)
 - Own mobile and web delivery: React Native (iOS + Android) and React, including App Store / Google Play / Stripe subscriptions
 - Own release engineering: CI/CD, environments, signing credentials, monitoring, backups, rollback - built for fast, safe, frequent releases
 - Bring a product eye: you care how screens look and feel on mobile and web, not just whether the API returns 200
 - Translate technical decisions into plain language for the founder and clinical teamHow you work (this is the core of the role): 

You are an AI-first engineer. You use agentic coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code or equivalent) as your default workflow - planning, generating, reviewing and shipping with AI leverage rather than writing everything by hand. You build evaluation harnesses so the AI Coach can be tested automatically against scenario suites on every change. You are a self-starter who takes a brief, breaks it into a plan, communicates the plan, executes it, and reports outcomes - with direction from the founder but without needing technical supervision. 

- Plan -> Approve -> Deliver: you propose the plan, get sign-off on direction, and own execution
 - Comfortable being the only engineer initially: you learn the system from the code (there is limited as-built documentation) and make it yours
 - Bias to shipping: small, frequent, reversible releases with monitoring and rollback in place
 - Judgement over heroics: this is a mental health product - safety thresholds and crisis handling are governed by legal and clinical sign-off, and you build the systems that enforce them

Requirements

What we're looking for: 

- Proven experience shipping LLM-based products to production: prompt architecture, conversation state machines, RAG/retrieval, evals, moderation and safety handling - not just API calls
 - Strong backend engineering: Python, FastAPI (or similar), SQL/PostgreSQL, AWS; comfortable owning infrastructure, CI/CD and production operations solo
 - Solid React Native and React: can ship and debug on both iOS and Android, including in-app purchase flows on both stores and Stripe on web
 - Demonstrated AI-first development practice: daily use of agentic coding tools, with the judgement to review and own what they produce
 - Product sensibility: a genuine eye for mobile and web UX; you notice broken layouts, bad copy and clumsy flows, and fix them
 - Self-sufficient operator: track record of owning a product or major system end-to-end with minimal technical oversight; excellent written communication for a non-technical founder
 - Care with sensitive data: experience (or demonstrable seriousness) with privacy, security and access controls around personal/health dataNice to have: 

- Experience in mental health, health tech or other regulated/safety-critical consumer products
 - Experience taking over a codebase from an agency or departing team
 - Mobile release operations: App Store / Play Store review cycles, promo codes, staged rollouts
 - Analytics and growth tooling: AppsFlyer, GA4, event taxonomy design, experiment frameworks
 - Voice features (TTS/STT), push notification strategy, CRM/email platform integrationsOur stack: 

Backend: Python 3. 12, FastAPI, GraphQL (Strawberry), SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL. Mobile: React Native. Web: React. Hosting: AWS Sydney. AI: OpenAI (plus OpenAI Moderation), Pinecone vector DB. Mobile services: Firebase. Payments: App Store, Google Play, Stripe. Analytics: AppsFlyer, GA4, Meta Pixel. Code: Bitbucket. Admin: SQLAdmin-based panel. 

Reporting and working style: 

You report directly to the founder, who is not technical. You will get clear product direction, fast decisions and clinical/legal guardrails from the Founders team - and full ownership of how it gets built. You plan and manage your own process and keep the founder informed in plain language: what you're doing, why, what it costs, and when it lands. 

Benefits

- Flexibility in work hours and location, with a focus on managing energy rather than time. 
 - Access to online learning platforms and a budget for professional development
 - A collaborative, no-silos environment, encouraging learning and growth across teams
 - A dynamic social culture with team lunches, social events, and opportunities for creative input
 - Health insurance
 - Leave BenefitsIf you possess the required skills and are eager to contribute to our team's success, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Apply now!

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Platform Engineer Relius / Oracle to take end-to-end ownership of the FIS Relius Administration platform and its underlying Oracle database environment hosted on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). 

This role combines Oracle database administration, PL/SQL development, release management, application support, and production troubleshooting. The ideal candidate will act as a bridge between development and production, ensuring that database changes, releases, and corrective scripts are reviewed, tested, and deployed safely. 

The candidate should have strong hands-on Oracle DBA experience, the ability to debug complex legacy systems, and experience supporting production applications in regulated financial environments. 

Key Responsibilities 1. Relius Platform Administration

- Manage and maintain Relius environments across Development, UAT, and Production. 
 - Handle Relius upgrades, service packs, environment refreshes, configuration changes, and capacity management. 
 - Monitor database storage, tablespaces, audit logs, and platform health. 
 - Manage FIS support tickets and coordinate with external vendors and internal infrastructure teams. 
 - Perform application and web-tier health checks, service restarts, and deployment-related validations. 

2. Oracle Database Administration

- Administer and maintain Oracle 12c/19c databases in production environments. 
 - Perform Oracle database patching, upgrades, backup, recovery, and environment refresh activities. 
 - Manage database performance tuning, query optimization, long-running SQL, and stored procedure performance. 
 - Monitor database capacity, storage utilization, availability, and operational health. 
 - Manage database access, user provisioning, privileges, access reviews, and revocation. 
 - Support Oracle database operations on OCI; AWS or Azure database operations experience is also acceptable. 

3. PL/SQL Development and Code Review

- Develop, review, troubleshoot, and maintain PL/SQL scripts, stored procedures, functions, packages, and triggers. 
 - Review SQL/PL/SQL scripts developed by application teams before deployment to UAT and Production. 
 - Develop safe corrective scripts for production data issues and application integrations. 
 - Analyze legacy database schemas and troubleshoot data inconsistencies. 
 - Ensure database changes follow established coding standards, testing procedures, audit requirements, and change-control policies. 

4. Release and Deployment Management

- Execute scheduled releases, application updates, database deployments, and emergency hotfixes. 
 - Validate deployment readiness, database scripts, dependencies, and rollback procedures. 
 - Coordinate with development, QA, infrastructure, and database service providers. 
 - Maintain deployment records, change documentation, and release updates in Jira. 
 - Improve deployment processes to ensure repeatability, reliability, and auditability. 

5. Production Support and Troubleshooting

- Act as the primary escalation point for Relius/Oracle production incidents. 
 - Investigate transaction-processing failures, report and statement generation issues, data anomalies, and inbound/outbound file-feed failures. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis across application and database layers. 
 - Diagnose complex production issues using SQL queries, logs, database monitoring, and application-level troubleshooting. 
 - Implement corrective actions while protecting data integrity and minimizing production risk. 
 - Provide timely incident updates and coordinate resolution with vendors and technical teams. 

6. Data Integration and Monitoring

- Support Oracle data extraction, replication, and integration with downstream systems and data lakes. 
 - Work with Change Data Capture (CDC) and replication technologies where applicable. 
 - Monitor database and application health, server/event logs, alerts, and operational metrics. 
 - Support integrations with custodians, financial advisors, and other external systems. 
 - Use AI-assisted development and troubleshooting tools as part of daily engineering activities. 

Mandatory Skills And Experience

- Strong, hands-on Oracle DBA experience with Oracle 12c/19c in production environments. 
 - Expertise in Oracle database patching, backup and recovery, database refreshes, performance tuning, and capacity management. 
 - Strong PL/SQL development and debugging skills, including stored procedures, packages, functions, and corrective scripts. 
 - Experience troubleshooting legacy applications and complex database schemas. 
 - Experience handling production incidents, root-cause analysis, release deployments, and change management. 
 - Experience working with cloud-hosted databases; OCI is strongly preferred, with AWS or Azure database operations also considered. 
 - Ability to review database scripts and execute controlled changes against critical production data. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including incident reporting, vendor coordination, and cross-team collaboration. 
 - Practical, regular use of AI-assisted development tools. 

Good to Have

- Hands-on experience with FIS Relius Administration, including its database schema, service packs, and environment management.

 - Knowledge of retirement plan and participant data, contributions, distributions, loans, and financial transactions.

Spectral Consultants is hiring a Product Engineering Leader with 22+ years of technology experience to lead large-scale Product Engineering, Modernization, Quality Engineering and AI Transformation initiatives. 

📍 Location: Pune

This is a strategic technology leadership opportunity for someone who combines strong engineering depth, enterprise modernization expertise, AI-first transformation and large-scale technology leadership. 

🔹 What You Will Drive

The role will focus on transforming how complex technology platforms are designed, engineered, modernized and delivered, with a strong emphasis on: 

✔ Enterprise System Design & Engineering Excellence - driving scalable, resilient architectures, modern engineering practices, technical governance and developer experience. 

✔ Java, Cloud, AI & DevOps - providing technical direction across modern application engineering, cloud platforms, APIs, CI/CD, DevSecOps, observability and AI-enabled engineering. 

✔ Legacy Modernization - leading large-scale, application modernization, modularization, API enablement and cloud adoption. 

✔ AI-First Engineering & Agentic SDLC - evolving traditional SDLC towards an AI-first / Agentic Development Lifecycle (ADLC) and embedding AI across development, testing, code review, defect analysis, release and production support. 

✔ Quality Engineering Transformation - moving towards automation-first, continuous and AI-assisted Quality Engineering, including test automation, regression optimization, quality gates, AI-assisted testing and quality analytics. 

🔹 Scope & Business Impact

The leader will drive measurable improvements in: 

- Engineering productivity and delivery predictability
 - Modernization velocity and technology simplification
 - AI adoption and engineering automation
 - Quality, test effectiveness and defect prevention
 - Production stability, resilience and engineering governance
 - Technology efficiency, cost transparency and value realization
 - Engineering capability and leadership maturityThe role will also involve partnering with senior technology, product, architecture and business stakeholders, while leading large engineering teams, strategic partners and complex transformation initiatives. 

🎯Knowledge, Skills & Experience

✔ 22+ years of overall technology experience

✔ Senior leadership experience in Productj Engineering

✔ Strong System Design & Architecture expertise

✔ Deep understanding of Java, Cloud, AI/GenAI and DevOps

✔ Proven experience leading modernization

✔ Track record of AI-first engineering, Agentic AI or AI-assisted SDLC transformation

✔ Enterprise-scale Quality Engineering / QA Automation transformation experience

✔ Experience managing large engineering organizations, budgets and strategic technology partners

✔ Strong executive stakeholder and transformation leadership skills

✔ Ability to balance innovation with security, quality, resilience and governance

If you are a senior technology leader passionate about modern engineering, legacy modernization, AI/Agentic transformation and enterprise technology excellence, we would love to connect. 

📩 Interested leaders can DM us or share their profile for a confidential discussion.

data.title: Senior Design Verification Engineer – UCIe 2.0
data.description:
Hiring: Senior Design Verification Engineer - UCIe 2. 0

Location: Bangalore, India

Experience: 5+ Years

We are looking for an experienced Design Verification Engineer with strong expertise in IP-level verification and hands-on experience with the UCIe 2. 0 protocol. 

The ideal candidate will have solid experience in SystemVerilog and UVM-based verification methodologies, along with a strong understanding of digital design verification and functional verification environments.

- 5+ years of hands-on experience in Design Verification.

data.title: Project Manager - QA
data.description:
**Lead Quality - Customer Delivery (P&C Insurance)**

**Location: Coimbatore**

**Role Summary**

We are an insurtech business dedicated solely to property and casualty insurance. As a Quality Manager within Customer Delivery, you will build and lead quality practices for client implementations on our policy administration platform. Working alongside Business Analysts, Project Managers, and configuration teams, you will help ensure insurance products, forms, workflows, and rating logic are configured correctly and delivered at a high standard. This position requires solid knowledge of structured testing approaches, process improvement, and the ability to use AI-powered tools to enhance quality and delivery efficiency. 

**Key Responsibilities**

- Establish and maintain quality benchmarks, testing frameworks, and validation methods for insurance product configuration, forms, workflows, and rating logic. 

- Review configured solutions against source documents, business requirements, and rating specifications to confirm accuracy, completeness, and consistency. 

- Lead defect management efforts, including triage, root-cause analysis, trend detection, and preventive action planning. 

- Promote continuous improvement across delivery processes using structured quality methods and measurable quality metrics. 

- Partner with Business Analysts, Project Managers, and development teams to embed quality checkpoints throughout the implementation lifecycle. 

- Create and maintain quality dashboards, reporting mechanisms, and delivery scorecards that provide visibility into quality performance and improvement opportunities. 

- Evaluate, adopt, and contribute to AI-enabled solutions for test case generation, test automation, defect analysis, and quality monitoring. 

- Coach team members on testing best practices, insurance domain concepts, and quality-focused delivery approaches. 

**Required Skills and Experience**

- 6-10 years of experience in quality assurance, quality management, business analysis, or delivery roles, with significant exposure to enterprise software implementations. 

- Strong understanding of testing methodologies, defect management, and quality governance practices. 

- Ability to analyze complex business requirements and validate configured solutions against expected outcomes. 

- Experience designing test cases and test strategies for rule-driven or configurable systems. 

- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify patterns, and drive process improvements. 

- Experience with project and delivery management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms. 

- Interest in AI and automation, with the ability to evaluate and implement AI-driven quality improvements. 

**Nice to Have**

- Prior experience in P&C insurance or insurtech. 

- Familiarity with insurance rating logic, policy forms, underwriting workflows, and bureau-based rating content. 

- Experience with policy administration systems or no-code/low-code platforms. 

- Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, or equivalent process improvement certification. 

- Experience building quality metrics, dashboards, and operational reporting frameworks.

 - Strong understanding of SOLID principles, design patterns, reusable components and SDK development. 
 - Experience in performance optimization, ANR/crash debugging, profiling, memory management and concurrency issues. 
 - Exposure to offline-first architecture, API integrations, CI/CD, unit testing, code reviews, and engineering best practices. 
 - AWS cloud experience preferred. 
 - Prior experience with multimedia applications, audio/video streaming servers or clients is highly desirable. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities, plan engineering activities, and work effectively with cross-functional teams. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience in engineering documentation and customer/stakeholder interactions.

Qualifications

- Bachelor of Science Degree in Computer Sciences, Computer Engineering or Software Engineering or equivalent experience. 
 - 5 to 8 Years' of Experience

Interested? Apply here or share your updated resume at janani. sivanandam@antal. com

data.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test
data.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

We're looking for a  Senior Software Engineer in Test, who is eager to drive non-functional load testing, identify critical optimization areas, and conduct in-depth analysis to understand "what's broken and why. " as well as "How can we improve the simulation?"  

- You'll be at the forefront of research and development, uncovering efficiencies at a platform level and collaborating with engineering teams across the organization to implement solutions. 
 - This isn't your typical QA or testing role, but rather a deep engineering role focused on performance load testingAbout the Team: 

- Our Performance Load testing  team operates on a hub-spoke model, with a core focus on deep understanding load generation systems, test data generation, and node. js and golang applications. 
 - We partner with engineering teams from across all products and platforms at Auth0, working to create more accurate simulated load generation and data generation tests.   
 - You'll be supporting specific teams with performance load coverage, load optimization and testing and ensuring our systems not only maintain their current high level of performance but continuously evolve and improve. 
 - You will partner with other senior load testing engineers, and mentor more junior engineers, working to achieve a high level of team impact.   What We're Looking For: 

- Programming Knowledge: Experience with a programming language like Node. js, TypeScript, JavaScript, or Golang is a requirement. We're looking for someone with a tester's mindset who can understand code, databases and data structures and collaborate effectively with our engineering teams to ensure high-quality software. Experience with Databases: Have used databases such as MongoDb or SQL to store configuration or user data, understand tradeoffs between persistence and performance, and have used optimizations in these areas. Familiarity with indexes, query planners a plus. The ability to understand complex join queries and model datasets that leverage them. 

- Microservices & Kubernetes Exposure: High-level understanding of Kubernetes (K8s) and microservices architecture. 
 - Public Cloud Experience: Familiarity with public cloud environments, AWS and Azure.   
 - A "Developer" Mindset: You're passionate about digging into code, understanding system behavior, and proactively identifying areas for optimization. Observability tooling experience: Experience using or implementing datadog, new relic, open tracing, open telemetry or similar request tracing tooling.       Load testing tool experience with: Jmeter, Apache Bench, Artillery, etc.   Linux and Containers: You have leveraged linux and containers in production in the past.   

- You have deep testing experience, 5+ years working with advanced load generation and analysis systems and tools.   You understand Agentic AI tools, Experience with tools like Claude, Gemini, CoPilot implementing agents, skills, workflows and integrating them into CI/CD pipelines, Git hooks and review processes. 

Why Join Us?

- High Scale, High Impact: Work on a global identity platform with millions of users, where your contributions will have a significant and immediate impact across our entire engineering organization. 
 - Solve Complex Problems: Tackle challenging performance and resilience issues in a distributed, high-throughput environment. 
 - Exceptional Growth Opportunities: 
 - Access to conferences and ongoing learning. 
 - Mentorship from staff and senior team members. 
 - Exposure to low-level problems, infrastructure knowledge, microservices, and Kubernetes scheduling optimization. 
 - Opportunities to go deep into areas that genuinely interest you, continuously expanding your skillset.

data.title: Want to build the foundation for Enterprise AI? Join xAQUA
data.location: Kolkata metropolitan area, West Bengal, India
data.description:
Most engineers maintain products. At xAQUA, you will help build the foundation for enterprise AI. 

xAQUA is hiring in Kolkata - Salt Lake Sector 5. 

Enterprise AI cannot succeed without trusted, accessible, and well-governed data. xAQUA is solving that foundational challenge by building an AI-native enterprise data platform where specialized AI agents work alongside data teams to discover, understand, integrate, govern, and use complex enterprise data. 

We solve demanding data and AI challenges for large enterprises and regulated industries, including a major U. S. public pension organization managing more than $400 billion in assets. 

We are expanding our Kolkata engineering team and looking for exceptional professionals who want to do more than maintain existing systems. At xAQUA, you will help shape the product, architecture, engineering practices, and culture of a growing AI-native company. 

Open Roles

1. Head of Product Engineering

We are looking for a hands-on engineering leader who can translate product vision into scalable, enterprise-grade software. 

Key expectations: 

·            Lead and mentor multidisciplinary product engineering teams

·            Own engineering execution, architecture quality, delivery predictability, and technical excellence

·            Establish strong standards for design, development, testing, DevOps, security, and release management

·            Work closely with product leadership to convert complex business needs into clear engineering plans

·            Remain hands-on with architecture, design reviews, troubleshooting, and critical technical decisions

·            Build an accountable, collaborative, high-performance engineering culture

Preferred background: Strong experience leading enterprise product engineering teams, building cloud-native platforms, and delivering data, AI, analytics, or SaaS products. 

2. Product Engineer - Mid to Senior

Required: Python, microservices and API development, PostgreSQL, S3, strong object-oriented analysis and design, and hands-on experience building AI, GenAI, or LLM-powered applications. 

Preferred: RAG, vector databases, BM25 and similarity search, NLP, distributed systems, and enterprise-grade AI architecture. 

3. Test Automation Engineer

Required: Python, Selenium, Playwright, AI-driven test automation, and practical use of GenAI in test design, test generation, execution, regression analysis, and defect investigation. 

We are looking for someone who can help build an intelligent quality engineering practice-not simply automate existing manual test cases. 

4. Senior DevOps Engineer - Expert

Required: Expert-level cloud and platform engineering experience, with strong AWS expertise. Azure and GCP experience are preferred. 

You should have deep experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, release engineering, deployment automation, observability, security, reliability, and production operations. 

5. Database Engineer - Junior to Mid

Required: Strong PostgreSQL and SQL skills, data modeling fundamentals, and disciplined database schema and configuration change management using Flyway or similar tools. 

Preferred: Performance tuning, synthetic data generation, database validation and reconciliation, and experience working with large, complex schemas containing hundreds of tables. 

All positions require strong analytical and problem-solving skills, an exceptional engineering track record, and a solid academic foundation. 

Why xAQUA?

You will not be limited to implementing tickets or maintaining legacy systems. 

You will work on challenging enterprise-scale problems, influence technical decisions, build AI-native products, and help create technology used by some of the most demanding organizations in the world. 

Location: On-site - Salt Lake Sector 5, Kolkata

Apply: Send your resume to careers@xaqua. io

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

Non-Functional Testing

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

 - Debugging and root cause analysis

Assets

 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)

 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines

data.description:
MLOps Engineer

Job Description

Field

Details

Chapter area

AI (AI Engineering chapter)

Reports to

Chapter Lead - AI Engineering

Works with

AI Engineers, Data Engineers, AI Architects, AI QA, AI Model Risk SME, Run / Managed Services team

Experience

3-6 years in MLOps, DevOps or ML engineering, with production deployment experience

About the Role

The MLOps Engineer builds and operates the pipelines, infrastructure and tooling that take ML and GenAI solutions from development into reliable, governed production. The role owns deployment automation, monitoring and release discipline across the build-to-run lifecycle, and bridges AI Engineering, Data Engineering and platform/DevOps. The role covers both classical ML and LLMOps: evaluation, prompt and model versioning, observability and cost control for LLM-based and agentic systems. 

Key Responsibilities

Deployment and release automation

- Build and maintain CI/CD and continuous-training pipelines for ML and GenAI components, with automated testing, approval gates, safe rollout (canary / blue-green) and tested rollback paths. 
 - Containerise and deploy model, RAG and agent endpoints on Kubernetes-based infrastructure, with environments provisioned as code. 
 - Manage model and prompt registries, versioning, experiment tracking and lineage so every release is reproducible and traceable. Monitoring, observability and reliability

- Implement monitoring, logging and alerting for latency, availability, drift, output quality (groundedness, hallucination) and safety, with agreed thresholds and dashboards. 
 - Define runbooks, support incident response and root-cause analysis, and lead build-to-run handover and hypercare with the Run team. LLMOps and GenAI enablement

- Operationalise RAG pipelines, vector stores, prompt libraries and automated evaluation suites; enforce "no eval suite and rollback path, no release". 
 - Track and optimise token usage, model routing and compute cost, with tagging that supports usage reporting and chargeback. 
 - Implement runtime guardrails (for example PII masking and prompt-injection defence) in partnership with Security and the AI Architects. Governance, security and Responsible AI

- Build AI delivery lifecycle gate evidence (test results, approvals, model and prompt versions, audit logs) into pipelines so it is captured by default. 
 - Apply least-privilege access, secrets management, data-residency and no-production-data-in-development controls. 
 - Implement monitoring thresholds and Responsible AI checks agreed with the AI Model Risk SME. Collaboration and reuse

- Work with AI Engineers and Data Engineers to productionise models and GenAI applications reliably. 
 - Contribute reusable pipeline templates, patterns and documentation to the AI CoE reuse library; coach squad members on MLOps practice. Key Skills & Experience

Qualification

Details

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related technical field

Core engineering (required)

Python and SQL; Docker and Kubernetes; CI/CD tooling (for example GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or GitLab); infrastructure as code (Terraform)

MLOps platforms (required)

Model tracking, registry and orchestration using MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow or cloud-native equivalents (Vertex AI, Azure ML); working knowledge of one ML framework (PyTorch, TensorFlow or scikit-learn)

Cloud (required)

Hands-on with Google Cloud (Vertex AI) or Azure, and working knowledge of the other

Monitoring (required)

ML and application observability: drift detection, performance dashboards, alerting (for example Prometheus / Grafana or cloud-native tooling)

LLMOps (required)

Working knowledge of RAG pipelines, vector databases, prompt versioning, LLM evaluation and tracing, and token / cost tracking

Governance awareness

Understanding of Responsible AI, model risk and audit-evidence expectations in a regulated environment

Collaboration

Works across AI, data, platform, security and risk teams; communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Experience

- End-to-end ML or GenAI deployment pipelines in a regulated industry (insurance, banking or financial services). 
 - GPU resource management and inference optimisation for LLM serving. 
 - Agent observability and tracing; feature stores; model-serving frameworks. 
 - Experience with ITSM incident and change processes (for example ServiceNow) applied to AI services. 
 - Certifications (a plus, not required): Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Microsoft Azure AI certification (for example AI-300 or Azure AI Engineer Associate), Certified Kubernetes Administrator.

In this role, you will develop AI-assisted Python automation solutions, analyze product and protocol requirements, execute validation on storage devices, investigate complex failures, and contribute to release qualification. You will work closely with software, firmware, validation, and release teams across India, Israel, and the United States. This position is ideal for engineers who enjoy Python development, AI-assisted engineering, system-level debugging, Linux and Windows environments, and working close to hardware. Responsibilities

- Understand product requirements, technical designs, and storage protocol specifications. 
 - Create comprehensive validation strategies including functional, negative, integration, stress, recovery, and regression scenarios. 
 - Plan, design, develop, review, and maintain automated validation solutions using Python and AI-assisted engineering tools. 
 - Validate storage features, software enhancements, and bug fixes on physical storage devices. 
 - Execute sanity, functional, integration, performance, and regression test campaigns. 
 - Analyze logs, reproduce failures, and isolate issues across test frameworks, host software, firmware, operating systems, and device layers. 
 - Report defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, configurations, and technical findings. 
 - Verify fixes and provide evidence-based quality sign-off. 
 - Contribute qualified tests to automated sanity and regression suites. 
 - Collaborate with globally distributed development, validation, and release teams. 
 - Improve test automation, diagnostics, reliability, and engineering productivity. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly for test design, coding, debugging, data analysis, and documentation activities. 

Qualifications

Required

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 3 to 5 years of experience in software engineering, validation, system testing, quality assurance, or test automation. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python with hands-on experience developing automated test solutions. 
 - Experience developing, debugging, and maintaining automated test frameworks. 
 - Good understanding of software testing methodologies, defect lifecycle management, and quality engineering practices. 
 - Experience working in Linux and Windows environments. 
 - Working knowledge of Git and GitHub development workflows. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted development, testing, debugging, or engineering productivity tools. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. 
 - Ability to work independently, drive tasks to completion, and take ownership of validation activities. 

Preferred

Qualifications

- Experience with SSDs, flash storage, firmware, drivers, embedded systems, or system software. 
 - Knowledge of storage protocols such as NVMe, SCSI, or ATA. 
 - Experience with Python test frameworks, log analysis, and data-driven testing methodologies. 
 - Familiarity with GitHub, Jira, Agile, Scrum, and Continuous Integration workflows. 
 - Working knowledge of C or C++. 
 - Exposure to large-scale automation environments and test infrastructure development. 
 - Experience using AI tools to improve software development, testing, or engineering productivity. What We Look For
 - Strong problem-solving and debugging abilities. 
 - Attention to detail and commitment to product quality. 
 - Curiosity to understand complex interactions between software, firmware, operating systems, and hardware. 
 - Ownership mindset from requirement analysis through validation sign-off. 
 - Proactive mindset with a high level of accountability. 
 - Assertive communicator who can clearly and confidently express technical viewpoints while respecting others. 
 - Ability to challenge assumptions and make data-driven decisions. 
 - Continuous learning attitude with interest in automation, AI-assisted engineering, and emerging technologies. 
 - Strong collaboration skills across globally distributed teams. 
 - Confidence to take initiative, drive improvements, and deliver results

Additional Information

Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution. 

Sandisk is committed to offering opportunities to applicants with disabilities and ensuring all candidates can successfully navigate our careers website and our hiring process. Please contact us at jobs. accommodations@sandisk. com to advise us of your accommodation request. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

data.title: Head Technology & Innovation
data.description:
Huntsman Corporation is now looking for a dynamic individual as a Head Technology & Innovation. The main objective is to develop new products and new technology platforms for the Indian market. This is done by managing technical resources (people, equipment, facilities, FC and intellectual property) within the Technology & Innovation team. 

The EAIME business requires a dedicated team to develop, validate and support commercialization of new products and applications to drive differentiated growth through a world class innovation pipeline into existing as well as new market spaces to enhance the business portfolio. These resources are managed centrally for maximizing impact through a disciplined approach to project work, risk management as well as leverage and build new technical capabilities within the regional business. Close collaboration with the rest of the organisation is key for success. 

The Platform Manager must be able to effectively deal with the Marketing and Commercial team decision makers as well as work with a number of external partners. Furthermore, the incumbent must work across a wide range of internal personnel in a manner which builds trust, buy-in and understanding. The incumbent must be able to positively influence all the relationships mentioned above and be able to help define, articulate and communicate the value of the project portfolio. 

The level of interactions include higher level strategic, tactical and short- and long-term projects (3+ years). 

Major challenge for this position includes the ability to manage a complex portfolio of Product Innovation projects with a potential of high impact to the business, some results of the decisions taken will only be visible 3 years later or more. 

Project portfolio management includes allocating appropriate resource levels based on potential value creation for the business and providing strong technical expertise to deliver the project efficiently. 

The incumbent will have to be open minded to manage a complex portfolio of high impact projects and develop the skills and competences in the team to deliver those projects. 

Another challenge is to implement a strong project management culture in his/her organisation to ensure most efficient resource utilisation and decision taking. 

The expectation is that an interdependent, collaborative and team-oriented approach will be undertaken. 

This position will be based in Mumbai, India. 

As a Head Technology & Innovation, You Will

Ensure that all activities are conducted to the highest standards of Safety, Health and Corporate Compliance and that the team behavior demonstrates a commitment to safety culture. 

To efficiently manage and drive a portfolio of product development projects for maximum impact and to ensure full alignment to the regional business strategy. Projects can be related to exploring applications and markets. 

To manage and develop the team to improve the delivery of product innovation projects and maximizes value creation for the business. 

To ensure a good connection with platform managers in Tienen and other regions to allow efficient localization of established technologies, taking into account local raw materials and market needs. 

To support the innovation director in defining and delivering the EAIME vision and strategic trusts. 

To manage a seamless integration/collaboration with the other groups of the EAIME organisation as well as Global Research to ensure most efficient project delivery. 

Foster an open and collaborative culture to ensure most efficient use of resources, knowhow and expertise available in the organisation. 

To be an active member of the IMT (India Management Team)

What skills and experiences are we looking for?

The ideal candidate should have a Master in a technical discipline preferably in a chemical related field and have extensive managerial and applications experience. 

He/she should have 15-20 yrs experience in the company or 10yrs in the Polyurethane industry

The candidate should have an in-depth knowledge of how polyurethane works and the processing/applications benefits that can be achieved in existing as well as in potential new application and markets. 

The candidate must have proven managerial skills and ability to take far reaching decisions and influence situations at senior level. 

The candidate must have the ability to manage a diverse project portfolio as well as be able to set priorities in a complex environment. 

Ideally the candidate, in addition to the education above should have 15+ years technical development experience with a track record of project delivery, people management and organisational development. 

In lieu of the education noted above the candidate could qualify if (s)he possessed 15+ years experience in advanced polyurethane product and application environment. 

The incumbent, due to his/her experience, must be able to focus on strategic issues without compromising potential tactical choices. 

What can we offer?

Huntsman offers unsurpassed opportunities to build a successful future. We are a global specialty chemical company with locations in 25 countries around the world, employing over 6, 000 associates. Our diverse portfolio creates a range of career fields including manufacturing, research and development, technical services, sales and marketing, customer service - and the list goes on. 

Here, you can make an impact and make a difference. Come join us. 

Huntsman is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all qualified applicants for employment, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, gender identification, sexual orientation and/or expression or any other characteristic protected by law in every location in which we have facilities national or local. 

Please refer to https: //www. huntsman. com/privacy/online-privacy-notice for Company's Data Privacy and Protection information. 

All unsolicited resumes presented by recruitment agencies are treated as pro bono information or service. 

Huntsman is aware of a scam involving fraudulent job offers. Huntsman does not make job offers until after a candidate has submitted a job application and has participated in a face-to-face interview. Please be advised that emails from Huntsman always end in "@huntsman. com" and that any job offer that requires payment or requires you to deposit a check is likely a scam. If you have questions about any open positions at Huntsman, please visit our Careers website at

http: //www. huntsman. com/corporate/a/Careers.

data.title: Electrical Engineering & Computer Science
data.description:
About Turing: 

- Turing is one of the world's fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. 
 - Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world's leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies. 

Role Overview: 

- We are seeking an experienced Electrical Engineering or Computer Science expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based scientific and engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative. 
 - In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5-10 trainers, review technical tasks for accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure tasks reflect authentic computer science, software systems, and electrical engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent delivery of challenging technical tasks. 

What you'll do: 

- Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of scientific and engineering tasks. 
 - Review technical tasks end to end, including problem statements, codebases, circuit netlists, hardware description languages (HDL), datasets, computational environments, reference solutions, and automated tests. 
 - Validate tasks involving high-performance computing (HPC), parallel computing, algorithms, distributed systems, compilers, operating systems, databases, ML systems, GPU computing, circuit design, signal processing, power systems, and embedded systems. 
 - Ensure tasks reflect realistic software engineering, research, and electrical engineering workflows requiring meaningful multi-step technical reasoning. 
 - Verify technical correctness across algorithm complexity, numerical accuracy, memory management, concurrency, circuit laws, power balance, signal processing, timing constraints, and system stability. 
 - Validate compilers, simulation tools, software dependencies, computational environments, and build processes to ensure reproducible results. 
 - Identify unreliable tests caused by nondeterministic behavior, race conditions, hardware-dependent performance thresholds, or simulation convergence issues. 
 - Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful technical outputs such as functional correctness, performance, frequency response, waveforms, timing, efficiency, and system behavior. 
 - Identify technical inaccuracies, flawed assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass computation, simulations, or automated evaluations. 
 - Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval. 
 - Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices. 

What we're looking for: 

- Ph. D. , postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related discipline. 
 - Strong programming skills in C/C++, Rust, Python, Julia, Fortran, MATLAB/Octave, or hardware description languages (HDL), with advanced Linux and terminal proficiency. 
 - Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: parallel computing, systems programming, scientific software development, circuit simulation, signal processing, power systems, or digital hardware design. 
 - Strong understanding of algorithms, computational systems, numerical methods, software testing, or electrical engineering principles. 
 - Experience reviewing complex codebases, technical implementations, engineering simulations, or research outputs. 
 - Ability to evaluate algorithm correctness, computational performance, numerical accuracy, concurrency behavior, and reliability of technical results. 
 - Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, race conditions, and flawed engineering assumptions. 
 - Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams. 
 - Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards. 

Nice to have: 

- Experience with HPC and systems development tools such as MPI, OpenMP, CUDA, LLVM/GCC, CMake, gdb, Valgrind, perf, sanitizers, or Slurm. 
 - Familiarity with electrical engineering and hardware simulation tools such as ngspice, Xyce, Icarus Verilog, Verilator, GHDL, Yosys, pandapower, PyPSA, MATPOWER, openEMS, GNU Radio, or QEMU. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks such as pytest. 
 - Experience developing technical benchmarks, programming challenges, simulation-based evaluations, or automated grading systems. 
 - Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated technical solutions. 
 - Open-source development or maintainer experience, particularly reviewing and validating external contributions. 
 - Industry experience in semiconductors, high-performance computing, power utilities, telecommunications, or embedded systems. 
 - Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs. 

Offer Details: 

- Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST. 
 - Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
 - Duration of contract : 4 week [expected start date is next week]

As we continue to expand our cloud and enterprise business globally, we are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our global R&D organization. You will be a key player in a dynamic team in a fast pace working environment. 

This is an opportunity to join a profitable, growing cybersecurity company with strong market traction, a collaborative culture, and significant growth potential.

Location: Gurugram, India (Hybrid)

Direct employment

- Promote agile development processes in AlgoSec's leading network security suite of products -

data.title: Principal Engineer, Software (Communication Platforms & Architecture)
data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Job Summary

Designs and delivers scalable software solutions, applying strong engineering practices and technical judgment. Plans and executes defined projects with minimal guidance while collaborating across functions. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Plan and deliver defined software projects, including schedules, dependencies, and coordination with development and support teams. 
 - Design, architect, develop, test, and maintain scalable . NET applications, APIs, and microservices. 
 - Design and implement integrations using REST APIs, WebSockets, SignalR, and real-time voice communication technologies. 
 - Apply HIPAA-aligned security practices for data handling, authentication, voice communications, messaging, and notifications. 
 - Develop clean, maintainable code and drive solutions to complex technical and performance issues. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, designers, users, and cross-functional teams to define requirements and architecture. 
 - Evaluate technical concepts and design alternatives with consideration for business objectives, cost, and product needs. 
 - Conduct code reviews, troubleshoot defects, and ensure adherence to engineering standards and best practices. 
 - Mentor engineers and promote knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. 
 - Monitor relevant technologies and apply them where they improve product quality and competitiveness. 

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field, with 12+ years of relevant experience. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to solve complex technical problems. 
 - Proficiency in . NET, C#, Web APIs, microservices, Kubernetes, and relational databases such as SQL Server. 
 - Experience with Azure or AWS; knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Angular, or React is desirable. 
 - Strong understanding of database design and development, including SQL Server or other relational databases.

data.title: Member of Technical Staff
data.description:
About 3Y Health

3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into other specialties. 

About The Role

Members of Technical Staff own features end to end. You'll work with the clinicians and operators who use what we build, scope the problem, design and build the solution across the stack, deploy it and follow how it performs in production. Our engineering team is flat, with no sub-teams, so you'll work across the whole platform. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same. 

What You'll Do

- Design and build AI agents and automated workflows for clinic operations, such as insurance benefits verification, prior authorizations, patient intake, claims and clinical documentation
 - Build features for clinicians, patients and families, and our internal operations team, on web and mobile
 - Take ambiguous problems from 0 to 1, working with operators and clinicians to define the problem, write the spec and ship a first version
 - Design the services, data models and APIs behind your features and manage the infrastructure as code
 - Own your services in production: deployments, monitoring and incident response
 - Write evals for model-facing features and track the metrics of the workflows you ship
 - Work with protected health information (PHI) safely, with least-privilege access, no PHI in logs and auditable changes
 - Build and maintain the skills, plugins, MCP integrations and review bots our engineers use with Claude Code and Codex

Our stack

- Backend: Python (our primary language for new services), Kotlin with Hasura (GraphQL) on our established platform, plus TypeScript (NestJS) and some Go
 - Frontend and mobile: React, Next. js, React Native
 - Data: PostgreSQL (including pgvector), Snowflake
 - Workflows and contracts: Temporal, gRPC/Protobuf
 - Infrastructure: AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Datadog, LaunchDarkly
 - AI: Claude and OpenAI models, Claude Code and Codex, with our own skills, plugins, MCP integrations and an AI code-review bot

What We're Looking For

- 3+ years of experience building and shipping production software
 - A track record of owning products or features end to end, from an unclear problem to a system people depend on
 - Strong full-stack skills in Python and TypeScript, with experience across frontend, backend, databases and cloud infrastructure
 - Comfort working in a large, established codebase
 - Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including tool use, agent orchestration, structured outputs, retrieval and evals (LangGraph, an agents SDK or similar)
 - Daily use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. You know how to set them up for a codebase (project instructions, skills, MCP servers, hooks, subagents), run several tasks in parallel and review their output carefully. If you haven't heard of Claude Code, this role is likely not a fit. 
 - Good product sense and the ability to make solid UI decisions without a dedicated designer, using our component library
 - High agency: you unblock yourself, look for context and ask questions when you need to
 - Clear written communication. The team is distributed across time zones and most decisions happen in specs, PRs and tickets. 

Nice to have

- Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry (HIPAA, payer and claims workflows, EHR integrations, HL7/FHIR)
 - Temporal or another durable workflow engine
 - React Native
 - Running LLM evaluations or safety checks on model output in production
 - Building your own agent harness, MCP server or plugin for a coding agent
 - Open-source work, side projects or internal tools that other people use

If you meet most of the requirements and the role interests you, we'd like to hear from you, even if you don't check every box.
