data.title: Senior Automation Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Automation Engineer based in India. 

We are seeking an experienced Senior Automation Engineer to drive API quality and automation for a cloud-native microservices platform built with Java and Spring Boot. In this role, you will lead automation strategy, develop scalable testing frameworks, and embed continuous testing into CI/CD pipelines to improve software reliability and delivery efficiency. You will collaborate closely with developers, architects, product teams, and integration partners to identify risks early and ensure APIs meet functional, performance, and security standards. The position also offers an opportunity to apply AI-powered tools and agents to streamline test design, execution, and analysis. You will help strengthen QA practices, promote quality ownership, and support services running on Google Cloud Platform. This remote opportunity is ideal for a technically strong, analytical professional who enjoys solving complex challenges and improving engineering practices in an Agile environment. 

Accountabilities

- Define and execute an API automation strategy aligned with quality objectives, introducing effective testing approaches, tools, and technologies as appropriate. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reusable API automation frameworks using Java, RestAssured or Karate, and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) practices with Cucumber/Gherkin. 
 - Create maintainable, well-documented automated tests covering API functionality, data integrity, performance, and security, including data-driven testing for broad coverage. 
 - Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI to support continuous testing and reliable releases. 
 - Use API testing and exploration tools such as Postman, Swagger, Hoppscotch, or ReadyAPI, applying relevant security testing principles, including OWASP practices. 
 - Leverage AI models and AI agents to generate test cases, identify scenarios, accelerate test execution, and improve test analysis; evaluate emerging tools and recommend practical adoption strategies. 
 - Manage test cases, test catalogs, test sets, execution plans, and results in Xray, maintaining traceability across requirements, tests, executions, and defects in Jira. 
 - Maintain clear documentation of test plans, procedures, scripts, results, and configurations using Git, Jira, and Confluence or SharePoint. 
 - Collaborate with developers, product managers, architects, and integration partners to clarify requirements, improve testability, participate in design reviews, and identify quality risks early. 
 - Contribute to Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives, while communicating test outcomes and quality metrics clearly to stakeholders. 
 - Establish and promote QA standards, review code for functional accuracy and quality, follow secure coding practices, and help maintain code coverage of at least 70%. 
 - Write and maintain unit tests using JUnit or TestNG where applicable, and complete coding tasks according to technical specifications and delivery timelines. 
 - Validate Spring Boot and Spring Cloud microservices, RESTful APIs, and services deployed on Google Cloud Platform, including environments using Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Verify data quality across relational databases such as MySQL and PostgreSQL and NoSQL systems such as MongoDB and Cassandra, including large datasets. 
 - Troubleshoot operational issues independently where possible, using monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK when available. 
 - Contribute to contract testing, performance testing, and domain-specific test coverage where relevant. 

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - 8-12 years of experience in software development and quality assurance, with a strong focus on API automation. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with Java and RestAssured, along with proficiency in BDD frameworks such as Cucumber/Gherkin. 
 - Practical experience with API testing tools such as Postman, Swagger, Hoppscotch, or ReadyAPI, and an understanding of API security testing principles and tools such as OWASP. 
 - Strong knowledge of building reusable automation frameworks, designing data-driven tests, and maintaining comprehensive test coverage. 
 - Familiarity with AI models and their capabilities, including practical use in test-case generation and scenario identification, as well as experience configuring AI agents for testing automation. 
 - Hands-on experience with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud, including microservices architecture, dependency injection, and RESTful API development and testing. 
 - Solid understanding of cloud-native technologies and experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Google Cloud Platform services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, and Cloud Functions. 
 - Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI, and unit testing frameworks such as JUnit or TestNG. 
 - Strong working knowledge of Jira and Xray, including test-case management, test catalogs, test sets, execution tracking, and integration between the tools. 
 - Experience using Git and platforms such as GitHub, Bitbucket, or GitLab for version control, collaboration, and code reviews. 
 - Familiarity with relational databases, including MySQL and PostgreSQL, and NoSQL datastores such as MongoDB and Cassandra, as well as data quality testing and large datasets. 
 - Ability to follow secure coding practices, review code effectively, and maintain code coverage of at least 70%. 
 - Experience documenting test plans, procedures, scripts, and results, using tools such as Jira, Confluence, or SharePoint. 
 - Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with strong written and verbal communication abilities. 
 - Ability to work independently with minimal oversight while collaborating effectively across technical and business teams. 
 - Willingness to learn product architecture, contribute to technical discussions, and participate actively in Agile delivery. 
 - Nice to have: Experience with contract testing tools such as Pact, performance testing tools such as JMeter or Gatling, monitoring and logging platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK, and knowledge of the eCommerce domain. 

Benefits

- Remote work arrangement in India. 
 - Full-time employment. 
 - Opportunity to work on cloud-native microservices and enterprise-scale API automation. 
 - Exposure to AI-assisted testing, modern CI/CD practices, and Google Cloud Platform technologies. 
 - Collaboration with cross-functional engineering, architecture, product, and integration teams. 
 - Salary, healthcare coverage, paid leave, retirement benefits, and other specific perks were not stated in the provided job description.

data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Engineering, Automation & Productization Consultant based in India. 

We are seeking an experienced engineering consultant to support enterprise networking and digital transformation initiatives within a large, global organization. In this remote consulting role, you will transform architectural concepts into scalable, standardized, and production-ready solutions. You will combine enterprise networking expertise with Python-based automation, technical design, validation, and implementation support. Working across architecture, engineering, security, cloud, and operations teams, you will help improve deployment efficiency and establish repeatable engineering practices. You will also contribute to technical governance, documentation, and knowledge transfer, ensuring solutions are reliable, secure, and operationally sustainable. This opportunity is ideal for a proactive technical specialist who can bridge strategy and execution while delivering practical results in a fast-paced enterprise environment. 

Accountabilities

- Architecture and engineering: Support the development and review of High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), ensuring solutions meet requirements for scalability, security, supportability, and operational readiness. Establish and maintain engineering standards, design guidelines, and reference architectures, and participate in technical governance forums and design reviews.

Review connectivity architectures and implementation approaches, support network security integration, and contribute to enterprise and cloud connectivity planning. 
 - Automation and development: Identify opportunities to automate deployment and operational workflows. Develop and maintain Python-based scripts, integrate REST APIs, and create reusable automation templates, frameworks, and engineering accelerators that improve consistency and operational efficiency. 
 - Productization and standardization: Convert individual solutions and pilot implementations into repeatable production models. Develop deployment methodologies, implementation playbooks, reusable design templates, and engineering best practices. Capture lessons learned and translate implementation experience into standardized frameworks and practical guidance. 
 - Validation and implementation support: Support solution testing, validation, pilot deployments, and first implementations. Investigate implementation challenges, recommend remediation actions, and refine designs based on field feedback to ensure solutions meet technical and operational requirements. 
 - Cloud and platform integration: Support integration across enterprise networks, applications, security platforms, and cloud environments. Contribute to hybrid architecture design and help ensure reliable connectivity and effective interoperability between systems. 
 - Documentation and knowledge transfer: Create and maintain architecture documentation, engineering specifications, deployment guides, operational procedures, and implementation instructions. Conduct technical walkthroughs and knowledge-transfer workshops to support smooth handovers to engineering and operations teams. 
 - Consulting and stakeholder collaboration: Work independently across architecture, engineering, implementation, and operational teams. Gather requirements, facilitate technical discussions, engage stakeholders, and help align engineering solutions with enterprise objectives and delivery standards. 

Requirements

- Professional experience: At least 10 years of experience in enterprise networking, engineering, automation, or solution architecture, ideally within large, global enterprise environments. Candidates should have a proven record of delivering technical solutions across architecture, implementation, validation, and operational handover. 
 - Enterprise networking expertise: Strong knowledge of routing and switching, TCP/IP, LAN/WAN technologies, VLAN design, network segmentation, enterprise network security fundamentals, connectivity design, and network integration. 
 - Automation and programming skills: Hands-on experience with Python, SQL, REST APIs, JSON, YAML, Git or other version-control systems, scripting, and automation frameworks. The ability to identify automation opportunities and develop reusable engineering solutions is essential. 
 - Architecture and technical design: Experience developing and reviewing HLDs and LLDs, defining solution architectures, establishing engineering standards, and producing clear technical documentation. Familiarity with validation and testing practices and technical governance processes is required. 
 - Cloud and integration knowledge: Understanding of enterprise cloud connectivity, hybrid architectures, platform integration, and security integration across network, application, and cloud environments. 
 - Productization and engineering practices: Experience developing reusable templates, standardized deployment methodologies, implementation playbooks, and repeatable production processes. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD concepts, DevOps practices, workflow automation, and product engineering is an advantage. 
 - Additional enterprise technology knowledge: Familiarity with SD-WAN, Network Access Control (NAC), Identity and Access Management (IAM) integration, monitoring and observability platforms, and enterprise security technologies is desirable. 
 - Consulting and stakeholder management: Strong customer-facing consulting experience, requirements-gathering skills, and the ability to facilitate technical workshops and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders. Experience supporting global enterprise delivery initiatives is preferred. 
 - Analytical and communication skills: Excellent problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and strong written and verbal communication skills. Candidates should be comfortable explaining complex technical concepts, resolving implementation challenges, and bridging architecture, engineering, automation, and operations. 
 - Personal effectiveness: A proactive, curious, and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to work independently under minimal supervision and adapt to evolving priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Education and certifications: A bachelor's or master's degree is indicated for the role. Preferred certifications include Cisco CCNP or CCIE, Cisco DevNet, AWS, Azure or Google Cloud certifications, automation or DevOps certifications, and TOGAF. 

Benefits

 - Engineering impact: Help establish reusable engineering standards, productized solutions, and scalable deployment practices across enterprise environments.

data.title: SOLUTION ARCHITECT L2
ACCOUNT QUALITY MANAGER L1
data.description:
Job description: 

Job Description Role: 

The purpose of the role is to provide assurance on the quality of deployment for the assigned accounts and support in establishing mechanisms that enhance and sustain customer satisfaction levels. The role is expected to support in enhancing customer advocacy by predicting and preventing customer escalations & dissatisfactions and drive a culture of continuous improvement in the assigned accounts.   

͏ Do: 

- Implement deployment quality strategy for the assigned Accounts
 - Provide inputs in the development of strategy for the assigned accounts while considering the quality standards, client expectations, quality, and monitoring mechanisms
 - Review and reallocate the priorities to align with the overall strategy of the line of business / business unit
 - Quality control and Customer satisfaction
 - Support the completion of Annual Customer Satisfaction survey by ensuring completion of survey by the account customers, representatives for various projects within the account.   
 - Ensure completion of survey and address any queries in a timely manner.   
 - Support in conceptualizing the action planning by communicating with clients and interacting with Delivery Managers, vertical delivery heads and service delivery heads
 - Drive the account wise tracking of action planning identified for sustained CSAT in various projects.   
 - Drive the Quarterly pulse survey for selected accounts or projects for periodic check-ins.     
 - Support the Account Leadership teams for tracking and managing client escalation for closure. 
 - Early Warnings and Business partnership
 - Drive the implementation of mechanisms for preventing client escalations / dis-satisfactions by creating an early warning system in DigiQ covering aspects like delivery quality, delivery schedule, resources constraints, financial issues (overloading of effort / over-run potential), productivity, and slippages on milestones. 
 - Participate in Monthly and Quarterly Business review along with Business and Account leadership to ensure adherence of defined quality processes, define new life cycle models and ensure gating processes are followed the projects within the accounts.   
 - Drive the upskilling of delivery teams on quality management tools, knowledge management and create mechanisms for sharing of best practices. 
 - Support the collection of metrics on the performance / health of process and regular publishing of compliance and metrics dashboards. 
 - Continuous Improvement  
 - Drive a culture of continuous improvement in the assigned accounts to ensure enhance efficiency and productivity of resources
 - Create mechanisms between the projects in the account for sharing knowledge, quality issues, risk mitigation methods within the accounts to drive the continuous improvement
 - Plan and drive year on year improvement goals in various projects by way of process streamlining & improvements and automation, leading to cost savings and / or efficiency
 - Support the collection of metrics to show the improvements- efficiency / productivity improvement. ͏ 
 - Team Management
 - Team Management
 - Clearly define the expectations for the team
 - Assign goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide  constructive feedback to own direct reports
 - Guide the team members in acquiring relevant knowledge and develop their  professional competence
 - Drive geography specific trainings for the quality team, designed basis the statutory norms that apply in different countries
 - Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
 - Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
 -   Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the tea
 - Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement  within the team͏ Deliver

- CSAT Score-BU/Account/Portfolio level
 - Process Compliance/Exceptions Scores
 - Audit Coverage percentage
 - Schedule performance Scores
 - Planned vs actual project effort
 - Resource productivity scores2. Capability Building

- New Employee Onboarding
 - New Employee Certifications3. Continuous Improvement

- Lean projects implemented per year
 - Productivity improvement of resources
 - Continuous Improvement Processes implemented per year4. Team Management

- Team attrition %
 - Employee satisfaction scores5. Capability Building

- % trained on domain and location specific skills,   
 - % of team trained in necessary leadership skills

data.title: IT Support Team Lead / IT Support SME
data.description:
Role: IT Support Team Lead / IT Support SME

Company: Binary Semantics Ltd. 

Location: Gurugram, Haryana, India

Employment type: Permanent, Full-time

Compensation: Negotiable

Work schedule: Rotational US shift | Five-day working week with two rotational week-offs

About Binary Semantics

Binary Semantics is a client-centric global software development company offering IT services, consulting services and knowledge services across several industry segments, including automobiles, manufacturing, FMCG, technology, insurance, travel, hospitality and B2B publishing. Our global operations span the USA, Canada, Europe, Middle-East, Malaysia and India. We leverage our technology expertise and industry knowledge to develop customized solutions and services. 

About the opportunity

We are looking for technically proficient, customer-focused professionals to strengthen our IT support operations and deliver high-quality service across B2C customer environments and B2B client accounts. 

We welcome both experienced IT Support Team Leads and technically strong IT Support SMEs who bring a problem-solving mindset, a sense of ownership and a commitment to continuous improvement. 

For experienced leaders, the opportunity involves guiding teams, driving service delivery, managing escalations and improving operational performance. For technical specialists, it offers the opportunity to apply their expertise to complex issues, strengthen support processes, share knowledge and demonstrate their potential to take on broader responsibilities. 

Prior team-lead experience is preferred for leadership positions. However, we also recognize that leadership potential is not always reflected in a job title. Candidates who demonstrate strong technical capabilities, initiative, accountability, communication skills and the ability to influence and support others will be considered based on their skills, understanding and overall suitability for the role. 

We value individuals who take ownership, learn continuously, challenge problems constructively and contribute to better outcomes for customers and the team. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Support & Service Delivery

- Lead or contribute to day-to-day IT helpdesk operations across B2B client accounts and B2C customer environments. 
 - Provide technical support and troubleshooting across hardware, software, operating systems, networking, cloud and managed IT environments. 
 - Handle customer escalations, supervisor calls and complex technical issues, ensuring timely resolution and positive customer outcomes. 
 - Ensure adherence to service levels, productivity, quality and customer satisfaction goals. 
 - Maintain accurate ticket documentation, incident records and knowledge resources. 
 - Support effective incident and service request management through ticketing and IT Service Management (ITSM) platforms. 

Team Leadership & Capability Development

- For the Team Lead role, lead, mentor and motivate IT Helpdesk Executives to deliver high-quality technical support and customer service. 
 - Coach team members through regular feedback, performance reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions and targeted development plans. 
 - Monitor quality trends, identify skill gaps and collaborate with Quality and Training teams to improve team performance. 
 - For the SME role, act as a technical escalation point, resolve complex issues, mentor colleagues and strengthen troubleshooting capabilities. 
 - Encourage ownership, accountability, collaboration and a positive, performance-driven team culture. 

Operational Performance & Continuous Improvement

- Drive key operational metrics, including CSAT, FCR, AHT, ticket resolution, quality, shrinkage, productivity and revenue, as applicable to the role. 
 - Analyze operational reports and performance data to identify improvement opportunities and implement corrective action plans. 
 - Prepare and present operational reports, root cause analyses (RCA) and performance insights to management. 
 - Identify recurring issues, improve support workflows and strengthen SOPs, troubleshooting guides and knowledge bases. 
 - Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and enhance operational efficiency through technology and AI-enabled solutions. 
 - Ensure compliance with organizational policies, standard operating procedures and information security guidelines. 
 - Contribute to a customer-centric approach through relevant recommendations for IT products, managed services and value-added solutions, wherever appropriate. 

Technical Expertise

Candidates should possess working knowledge of relevant technologies across the following areas: 

- Windows 10/11 operating systems and macOS. 
 - Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Office applications. 
 - Google Workspace and Google SaaS products. 
 - Microsoft Entra ID / Azure Active Directory. 
 - User account, access and password-related administration. 
 - VPNs and remote connectivity. 
 - Desktop/laptop hardware and peripherals. 
 - LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP and basic networking concepts. 
 - Printers and multifunction devices. 
 - Antivirus, endpoint protection and endpoint security. 
 - Cybersecurity and information security best practices. 
 - Software installation, configuration, troubleshooting, patching and updates. 
 - Remote desktop and remote-support tools. 
 - Ticketing and IT Service Management (ITSM) platforms. 
 - Incident and service request management. 
 - Managed IT Services, remote helpdesk environments and basic cloud-based IT environments. 

Leadership & Operational Competencies

- Strong problem-solving, analytical and decision-making abilities. 
 - Ability to coach, mentor and develop team members. 
 - Strong customer escalation and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Ability to interpret operational data and drive measurable improvements. 
 - Excellent organizational, planning and time-management skills. 
 - Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and perform effectively in a fast-paced environment. 
 - A proactive mindset focused on continuous improvement and operational excellence. 
 - Ability to leverage AI tools and automation to improve productivity, troubleshooting efficiency and customer experience. 
 - Strong ownership, accountability, professionalism and a willingness to learn. 

For Team Lead candidates, people management, team performance, coaching and service delivery ownership are particularly important. 

For SME candidates, technical depth, complex troubleshooting, knowledge sharing, documentation and initiative are particularly important. 

Skills & Qualifications

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Strong client, stakeholder management and interpersonal skills. 
 - Exceptional troubleshooting, analytical and research capabilities. 
 - Customer-focused, with a practical and solution-oriented approach. 
 - Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, Outlook and PowerPoint, and Google Workspace. 
 - ITIL Foundation Certification or working knowledge of ITIL Service Management practices will be an added advantage. 

Experience & Education

- Bachelor's degree in any discipline preferred. 
 - Minimum three years of experience in IT Helpdesk, Service Desk, Managed IT Services, IT Operations, End-User Computing or a related IT service environment. 
 - For the Team Lead track, at least one year of experience in a team-lead role within an IT helpdesk or service-delivery environment is preferred. 
 - Experience supporting both consumer and business customers will be an advantage. 

Candidates without a formal team-lead designation are welcome to demonstrate their leadership potential through technical expertise, mentoring, initiative, accountability and relevant experience. 

Work Schedule

- Permanent, full-time employment. 
 - Rotational US shifts. 
 - Five working days per week with two rotational week-offs. 
 - Flexibility to work across shifts based on business and client requirements. 

Compensation & Benefits

- Competitive, negotiable compensation based on skills, experience and role suitability. 
 - Two-way cab transportation for eligible shifts. 
 - Meal facilities or meal benefits, as applicable. 
 - Performance-linked incentives, subject to the applicable incentive structure. 
 - Opportunities for continuous learning, skill development and career progression based on demonstrated performance. 

Why Join Us?

Join a team where technical expertise, customer experience and operational excellence matter. 

You will have the opportunity to solve meaningful problems, share your knowledge, improve how support is delivered and contribute ideas that make a difference to customers and colleagues. 

Whether you bring established leadership experience or strong technical capabilities with the ambition to grow, we value your ability to take ownership, demonstrate initiative and deliver results. 

If you enjoy solving problems, helping others succeed and continuously improving the way things work, we would like to hear from you.

We are looking for an ETL Test Engineer with 2-10 years of experience to support our client in India. data.description:
Senior Software Engineer - Treasury Systems (Findur)

Sr. Software Engineer - Treasury

Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics, generating approximately USD 50 billion in annual revenue and employing more than 100, 000 people worldwide. Operating in nearly 130 countries, we connect and simplify supply chains for customers across the globe through our unique combination of ocean, logistics and terminal services. Guided by our vision to become the Global Integrator of logistics, we are transforming the way global trade moves by delivering seamless, end-to-end supply chain solutions. 

This is an exciting career opportunity to work in a multinational, Global 500 company that makes global trade happen. You will be interacting daily with colleagues internationally, giving you the opportunity to develop your professional skills in a global environment. The environment is dynamic with focus on high performance, results, and respect for our employees. There will be the possibility of continuous professional and personal development and for gaining a professional and social network. 

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help digitise and automate both functional and non-functional processes in our treasury system, Findur - delivered in close partnership with our highly experienced internal DevOps team. You will work with development teams and stakeholders in various locations, e. g. , Pune, Bangalore, UK and Copenhagen. 

You'll be involved early in feature discussions to help shape the best technical outcome and support the business case behind each change, and you'll be closely engaged in our agile processes - driving continuous improvement in code quality, review practices, and ceremonies. 

While Findur/OpenLink expertise is the foundation of this role, we're equally interested in engineers with broad technical curiosity - people who understand, or are willing to learn, adjacent areas such as AI/ML and system integrations. We value adaptability and curiosity as much as a fixed skill set. 

Key Responsibilities

As part of the DevOps team, you will: 

- Own your code across the full software development lifecycle - from requirements and business analysis, through design, development and testing, to release - writing, delivering, and presenting code in walkthroughs against functional specifications. 
 - Write clean, scalable, high-quality code that follows engineering best practices and aligns with our internal standards and processes. 
 - Build strong, collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring a best-in-class experience for our users. 
 - Actively drive scope and user story definition, technical viability assessment, and best practice to meet requirements. 
 - Proactively flag risks and issues affecting system performance and availability. 
 - Share knowledge actively within the team, contributing to our shared knowledge base. 
 - Collaborate with vendors and DevOps team members on root cause analysis of incidents and reported issues. 
 - Work with a high degree of independence, while knowing when to seek a second opinion. 
 - Understand and champion the DevOps process, stay focused on team goals, and give feedback openly in a safe environment. 

What We're Looking For

Must Have

- 7+ years of experience as a software developer on OpenLink Findur, or alternatively Endur. 
 - Solid domain knowledge of treasury operations: financial instruments, confirmations, settlements, cash management, and payment flows, including SWIFT and ISO 20022 concepts. 
 - Experience working in large, global teams with multiple internal and external stakeholders. 
 - Fluency in treasury business language, with the ability to translate business requirements from conversations with end users into Findur/Java code or system configuration. 
 - Solid understanding of Findur data modelling and system design. 
 - Strong ability to write clean, reusable, and efficient code that's easy for others to read and maintain. 
 - Broad technical curiosity - genuine interest in technology beyond Findur, including automation and integrations. 
 - Solid SQL foundation and familiarity with SQL Server. 
 - Genuine interest and willingness to learn AI/ML tooling; hands-on experience building with it is a plus. 

Advantageous

- Experience with Agile practices and tools (Git, Jira, etc. ). 
 - Knowledge of vendor-hosted system setups and integrations. 
 - Diverse experience across different technologies and platforms, beyond Findur. 

Ways of Working

- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a commitment to maintaining a safe space for the team. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills with an ownership mindset and the ability to work across teams. 
 - Collaborative, with strong mentoring, people skills, and personal impact. 
 - Highly motivated and able to perform well under pressure. 
 - Innovative, with the ability to think outside the box. 
 - Fact-based and results-oriented. 

As a Person

- A self-starter, highly motivated and proactive. 
 - Curious, with a drive to keep learning and stay current with emerging technology and business trends. 
 - Flexible and adaptable, comfortable pivoting into different roles as needs evolve. 
 - Culturally aware, with experience working in multi-cultural teams.

data.title: Specialist - Tech Development
data.description:
Position Summary

The Tech Development Lead is a Grade 8 individual contributor who supports design, build, deployment, and operates reliable data pipelines and AI-enabled solutions. The role applies to technical judgment across data engineering, GenAI, and agent engineering, with accountability for production reliability, observability, trusted data access, prompt effectiveness, and responsible operation in a regulated environment. 

The role owns complex components of the data and AI landscape end-to-end, makes day-to-day technical decisions with limited oversight, and helps shape practical engineering direction. It partners with business, product, platform, architecture, security, governance, and engineering teams to translate ambiguous needs and user feedback into scalable, maintainable solutions while mentoring colleagues and strengthening team capability.

 - Build and maintain AI agents and LLM-powered capabilities that support trusted, efficient business workflows.

 - Control and monitor approved data access points across structured and unstructured sources, cloud platforms, documentation, and authoritative business repositories. 
 - AI Agent & GenAI Engineering

 - Test, refine, and govern prompts; identify new prompts aligned with evolving business needs and approved solution scope. 
 - Incorporate user feedback, agent metrics, and production outcomes into a closed-loop improvement process for prompts, models, and agent behavior. 
 - Reliability, Observability & Trust Controls
 - Monitor system health, trace logs, response quality, hallucination indicators, data drift, failures, and operational trends. 
 - Define and maintain practical detection thresholds, alerts, dashboards, and escalation paths for production issues. 
 - Instrument pipelines and agents, respond to incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and drive corrective actions for reliability, quality, security, performance, and cost. 
 - Validate that agent responses rely on approved authoritative data sources and map to defined domain controls, identifiers, measures, or calculation logic where applicable. 
 - Implement refusal or human-escalation behavior when a request is outside approved scope, lacks authoritative evidence, or requires human judgment. 
 - Partner with AI platform and technology teams to improve guardrails, usability, response clarity, and front-end experience without changing approved business logic. 
 - Quality, Governance & Documentation
 - Implement data-quality and testing controls such as freshness checks, contract tests, anomaly detection, test automation, and clear alerting paths. 
 - Ensure changes align with applicable architecture, security, privacy, platform, model-governance, and responsible-AI standards. 
 - Maintain technical documentation, operating procedures, training materials, data lineage, governance records, and service-landscape knowledge. 
 - Act as an effective first-line tester for changes and enhancements, with clear evidence of validation and traceability. 
 - Influence architecture and tooling decisions, balancing delivery speed with maintainability, supportability, scalability, and compliance. 
 - Business Partnership & Capability Building
 - Translate business needs, ambiguous requirements, production findings, and user feedback into prioritized, deliverable increments. 
 - Consult business and technology stakeholders on proposed changes and communicate technical implications clearly to non-technical audiences. 
 - Partner with product owners, risk or control specialists, data and analytics teams, and platform teams to deliver solutions that preserve approved business logic. 
 - Train end users on effective prompt usage, solution boundaries, escalation paths, and good practices. 
 - Mentor engineers and colleagues through pairing, code review, onboarding, troubleshooting support, and practical knowledge sharing; act as a go-to technical advisor within the team. 
 - Development Capability (ability to fulfil at least 1 of the following specialisms)
 - Front-end development - ability to design, build, test and maintain accessible, responsive user interfaces using React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS, or comparable GSK-supported frameworks. Ability to translate user interviews, observation and usability feedback into intuitive, secure user experiences through prototyping, iterative development and validation. 
 - Data engineering - ability to design and operate secure, reliable ingestion from ADLS, Snowflake or other GSK-supported components into Databricks and the appropriate Code Orange foundation, trusted or unified layer. Ability to validate, transform, clean, document and model data through maintainable queries and jobs, producing governed tables or payloads for analytics, data science, AI/ML and LLM solutions, including structured outputs consumable by APIs and front-end applications. 
 - Data science - ability to design, build, evaluate, deploy and support AI/ML models for text, image or numerical analysis. Select reproducible statistical or machine-learning approaches appropriate to the business need and data, define meaningful performance measures, and validate model quality, limitations, robustness and ongoing performance. 
 - AI engineering - ability to design, version, test and optimise prompts, retrieval and agent workflows; integrate approved LLMs through APIs; and select models and reasoning settings against defined quality, latency, security and cost criteria. Ability to use AIGA components for evaluation, registration, deployment and telemetry, including Weights & Biases Weave and OpenTelemetry, to trace lineage, usage, cost, performance and explainability. 
 - Full-stack development - ability to design, implement, secure and test end-to-end applications and API-based data interchange across user interface, service and data layers. Demonstrated capability in at least two other listed specialisms, including integration, deployment, observability and operational support within the GSK technology stack. 

Required Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, data engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Typically 4- years of relevant hands-on experience building, operating, and improving production data, software, AI, or cloud solutions. 
 - Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience developing maintainable production code, APIs, tests, and automation. 
 - Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and concepts such as Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Web Apps or App Services, Key Vault, storage, and deployment practices. 
 - Experience with modern data engineering technologies, including data modeling, Spark, orchestration or transformation tooling, and warehouse or lakehouse patterns. 
 - Experience with AI or application frameworks such as LangChain or related LLM frameworks, FastAPI, Pydantic, and API gateway patterns such as Kong. 
 - Working knowledge of containerization and deployment technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, plus source control and engineering artefacts including GitHub, JSON, JavaScript, Jupyter, YAML, and shell scripting. 
 - Practical experience using AI coding assistants as part of daily engineering work, with disciplined review of generated output. 
 - Strong communication, stakeholder-management, and mentoring skills for guiding colleagues and influencing business, product, governance, architecture, security, data, and engineering teams. 
 - Preferred Qualifications & Experience
 - Master's degree or higher in software engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field. 
 - Experience creating or significantly extending AI agents in an Azure environment using Python, web applications, and enterprise data sources. 
 - Knowledge of large language models, generative AI, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector stores, and fine-tuning techniques.

 - Use AI-assisted engineering as a core working practice while applying strong judgment to generated code, tests, documentation, recommendations, and downstream risk implications. 

Key Responsibilities

- Data Pipeline & Platform Engineering
 - Independently design, build, deploy, and operate batch and streaming data pipelines that meet defined expectations for freshness, correctness, reliability, performance, and cost. 
 - Own data models and datasets across ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving, using modern warehouse or Lakehouse technologies. 
 - Monitor source and platform changes, including ServiceNow data exposed through Databricks views, and address inconsistencies that could affect downstream solutions or agent reliability. 
 - Make informed technical decisions on pipeline, interface, data-model, and automation changes, escalating only where architectural, compliance, or business-risk thresholds require broader approval. 
 - Control and monitor approved data access points across structured and unstructured sources, cloud platforms, documentation, and authoritative business repositories. 
 - AI Agent & GenAI Engineering
 - Build, deploy, and enhance machine learning and GenAI solutions aligned with validated user requirements. 
 - Develop and maintain AI agents using Python, Azure services, APIs, LLM frameworks, retrieval patterns, and appropriate interface technologies. 
 - Use AI coding assistants and LLM tooling to plan, scaffold, refactor, test, document, and debug code, while validating outputs before adoption. 
 - Create agent-based automations for data-quality investigation, failure triage, documentation, schema and lineage analysis, dataset discovery, and routine remediation. 
 - Test, refine, and govern prompts; identify new prompts aligned with evolving business needs and approved solution scope. 
 - Incorporate user feedback, agent metrics, and production outcomes into a closed-loop improvement process for prompts, models, and agent behavior. 
 - Reliability, Observability & Trust Controls
 - Monitor system health, trace logs, response quality, hallucination indicators, data drift, failures, and operational trends. 
 - Define and maintain practical detection thresholds, alerts, dashboards, and escalation paths for production issues. 
 - Instrument pipelines and agents, respond to incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and drive corrective actions for reliability, quality, security, performance, and cost. 
 - Validate that agent responses rely on approved authoritative data sources and map to defined domain controls, identifiers, measures, or calculation logic where applicable. 
 - Implement refusal or human-escalation behavior when a request is outside approved scope, lacks authoritative evidence, or requires human judgment. 
 - Partner with AI platform and technology teams to improve guardrails, usability, response clarity, and front-end experience without changing approved business logic. 
 - Quality, Governance & Documentation
 - Implement data-quality and testing controls such as freshness checks, contract tests, anomaly detection, test automation, and clear alerting paths. 
 - Ensure changes align with applicable architecture, security, privacy, platform, model-governance, and responsible-AI standards. 
 - Maintain technical documentation, operating procedures, training materials, data lineage, governance records, and service-landscape knowledge. 
 - Act as an effective first-line tester for changes and enhancements, with clear evidence of validation and traceability. 
 - Influence architecture and tooling decisions, balancing delivery speed with maintainability, supportability, scalability, and compliance. 
 - Business Partnership & Capability Building
 - Translate business needs, ambiguous requirements, production findings, and user feedback into prioritized, deliverable increments. 
 - Consult business and technology stakeholders on proposed changes and communicate technical implications clearly to non-technical audiences. 
 - Partner with product owners, risk or control specialists, data and analytics teams, and platform teams to deliver solutions that preserve approved business logic. 
 - Train end users on effective prompt usage, solution boundaries, escalation paths, and good practices. 
 - Mentor engineers and colleagues through pairing, code review, onboarding, troubleshooting support, and practical knowledge sharing; act as a go-to technical advisor within the team. 
 - Development Capability (ability to fulfil at least 1 of the following specialisms)
 - Front-end development - ability to design, build, test and maintain accessible, responsive user interfaces using React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS, or comparable GSK-supported frameworks. Ability to translate user interviews, observation and usability feedback into intuitive, secure user experiences through prototyping, iterative development and validation. 
 - Data engineering - ability to design and operate secure, reliable ingestion from ADLS, Snowflake or other GSK-supported components into Databricks and the appropriate Code Orange foundation, trusted or unified layer. Ability to validate, transform, clean, document and model data through maintainable queries and jobs, producing governed tables or payloads for analytics, data science, AI/ML and LLM solutions, including structured outputs consumable by APIs and front-end applications. 
 - Data science - ability to design, build, evaluate, deploy and support AI/ML models for text, image or numerical analysis. Select reproducible statistical or machine-learning approaches appropriate to the business need and data, define meaningful performance measures, and validate model quality, limitations, robustness and ongoing performance. 
 - AI engineering - ability to design, version, test and optimise prompts, retrieval and agent workflows; integrate approved LLMs through APIs; and select models and reasoning settings against defined quality, latency, security and cost criteria. Ability to use AIGA components for evaluation, registration, deployment and telemetry, including Weights & Biases Weave and OpenTelemetry, to trace lineage, usage, cost, performance and explainability. 
 - Full-stack development - ability to design, implement, secure and test end-to-end applications and API-based data interchange across user interface, service and data layers. Demonstrated capability in at least two other listed specialisms, including integration, deployment, observability and operational support within the GSK technology stack. 

Required Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, data engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Typically, 7- years of relevant hands-on experience building, operating, and improving production data, software, AI, or cloud solutions. The overall capability, judgment, autonomy, and technical influence should be consistent with a Grade 7 individual contributor role. 
 - Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience developing maintainable production code, APIs, tests, and automation. 
 - Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and concepts such as Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Web Apps or App Services, Key Vault, storage, and deployment practices. 
 - Experience with modern data engineering technologies, including data modeling, Spark, orchestration or transformation tooling, and warehouse or Lakehouse patterns. 
 - Experience with AI or application frameworks such as LangChain or related LLM frameworks, FastAPI, Pydantic, and API gateway patterns such as Kong. 
 - Working knowledge of containerization and deployment technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, plus source control and engineering artefacts including GitHub, JSON, JavaScript, Jupyter, YAML, and shell scripting. 
 - Practical experience using AI coding assistants as part of daily engineering work, with disciplined review of generated output. 
 - Strong communication, stakeholder-management, and mentoring skills for guiding colleagues and influencing business, product, governance, architecture, security, data, and engineering teams. 
 - Preferred Qualifications & Experience
 - Master's degree or higher in software engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field. 
 - Experience creating or significantly extending AI agents in an Azure environment using Python, web applications, and enterprise data sources. 
 - Knowledge of large language models, generative AI, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector stores, and fine-tuning techniques. 
 - Experience with unstructured data, data contracts, data-quality frameworks, catalogs, lineage tools, and observability platforms. 
 - Familiarity with model governance, privacy-preserving techniques, responsible AI, bias mitigation, and controls for high-stakes or regulated solutions. 
 - Experience in financial risk management, finance controlling, controls testing, or another regulated business domain. 
 - Experience working effectively in international, distributed, and cross-functional environments. 

Skills

Business Data Mining, Data Analysis, Data Analysis Tools, Data Mining, Data Modeling, Data Storytelling, SQL Databases, Statistical Analysis, Structured Query Language (SQL)

data.description:
IMEA (India, Middle East, Africa) India LIXIL INDIA PVT LTD Employee Assignment Not remote Full Time 13 April 2026

JOB DESCRIPTION - Engineer/ Sr. Engineer - Mechanical & Utility Maintenance

Location-Bhimadole

Purpose: Maintain all zones such as Ball mills, KILN, conveyors, vacuum systems, Stirrers, Agitators, 

Dust collection system, Bowers, spraying system, RO plant, ETP, STP, FIRE HYDRANT & fighting installations, material, handling & lifting equipment like - Fork lifter, HOPT, EOT crane, JIB crane, Electric hoist, chain blocks, Automobiles, ZLD, Chiller, Cooling Tower, Heat Exchangers, dryers, refrigeration system, Industrial gas storage & pumping system (LPG & PNG), compressed air & AIR COMPRESSOR's Position may also serve as back up for plant equipment. 

Qualification: BE/B. Tech - Mechanical with AutoCAD proficiency (AutoCAD, SolidWorks)

Experience: Required Minimum 5-8 years specific on hand work experience- advantage if the experience is in the same business line/continuous process industry like - Sanitaryware/ceramic field/FMCG/Automobile/Cement/Oil & Gas/Steel/Paper. 

General Requirements

- Shall be responsible for two primary functions: Utility Maintenance and co-ordination of TPM system. 
 - Perform maintenance management by supervising maintenance personnel and establishing priorities in maintenance schedules. Taking decision for Predictive & corrective maintenance of plant equipment based on performance. Control of shift maintenance losses as per plan and deputing manpower for optimum utilization. 
 - Maintain manufacturing assets, utilities, facility, parts inventory, monitoring purchase orders, invoice approvals, and manage the department budget. 
 - Manage maintenance personnel by setting direction & priorities and provide training & continuous development on all maintenance personnel. 
 - Ensure the facilities, utilities, layout, and machinery run to their maximum efficiency & output. Manage to upkeep of all the manufacturing assets, resources and assisting in the design & installation of new systems and implementation of energy saving projects. 
 - Timely Perform Performance Evaluations on direct reports and Verify Performance Evaluations are being performed on technical work force. 
 - Drive the Maintenance & Reliability initiative focused on Preventive & Predictive Maintenance, not reactive and maintain work order & inventory management. 
 - Managing, maintaining, and establishing maintenance procedures to ensure production meets & performs better than budget. 
 - Developing and maintaining quality & safety standards. Develop associate and supervisor skills by conducting training meetings, one on one development sessions, outside technical skills training, establishing, and monitoring performance reviews for supervisors. 
 - Setting and maintaining departmental budget by reviewing financial statements, monitoring efficiencies & cost and other expenses. 
 - Participate in designing & developing future production capacities & improvements by coordinating with user departments and updating maintenance operating procedures & schedules to incorporate the changes. 
 - Design & maintain mechanical maintenance plans, strategies, Schedules, procedures & methods for the plant & critical utility equipment's. 
 - Ability to maintain water records such as RO water, RAW water, ETP, ZLD, Fire Hydrant & STP Waters as per the statutory & legal requirements. All fire prevention equipment was maintained and tested to insure 100% operation. 14) Need to have knowledge on statutory & legal requirements for utility services and Maintain Daily logbooks & records accordingly. 
 - Adherence of preventive maintenance schedule. Carry out routine maintenance work and respond to equipment faults and diagnose breakdown problems. 
 - Monitor and control maintenance costs. Need to work on specific consumption & utilization. 
 - Ability to operate & update data in SAP, MS word, MS excel, MS power point, & Auto cad etc and understand & develop drawings in Auto cad. 
 - Design and specify new equipment installations undertaken by the business unit. Prepare project cost estimates and capital appropriation requests justifying proposed spending with economic returns meeting company standards. 
 - Coordinate with production, maintenance, purchasing departments while preforming engineering activities. 
 - Must be able to work a flexible schedule & calculate the MTTR & MTBF. Complete engineering projects on time and at or under budget. 
 - Provide process engineering and troubleshooting support to production, utilities as necessary to meet all the production commitments. Contributes to production flow by minimizing downtime due to equipment/parts failures. 
 - Willingness to work in a team-based environment and a commitment to continuous learning and improvement. Need to have knowledge on TBT, KAIZEN, HAICHIBAN, 5S, Critical Six, OHSAS, ISO, QMS, EMS and Behaviour Based Safety. 

Typical Responsibilities

- O& M of RO plant, ETP, STP, ZLD, FIRE HYDRANT SYSTEM & AIR COMPRESSOR simultaneously. 
 - Maintain required inventory such as consumables, machinery spares, etc. , safe work

environment by following company safety procedures, water parameters as per APPCB

Standards, AMC for all the required utility machinery, zero leakages in Compressed Air Line & Water Lines and monthly PPT'S Such as graphical representations & improvements. 

- Manage the utility maintenance staff and external contractors for the projects & required

modifications. 

- Worked individually and in teams, demanding & maintaining 0% damage & injury rates. 
 - Assisting the HOD in mechanical maintenance services of the process machinery, equipment's & supporting utilities. 
 - Handling contract management for the plant maintenance and other related activities. PM/CBM Compliance to 100% RCA to be carried out for major & repetitive failures with appropriate corrective action and preventive actions and smooth execution/supervision of ongoing projects and plant modification activities within stipulated time frame with focus on safety and quality. 
 - Record and analyze non-conformities, initiate corrective action/guide on implementation of corrective/preventive action & MIS. Maintain the QMS & OHSAS system and the subsequent records regarding the plant. Guide and develop the department team members.

Expert - Full Stack Development - IN

Full Stack Development are involved in full stack development and implement end-to-end components of custom applications. Their job involves designing and developing the UI, business logic, data & integration layer along with testing and maintenance of these layers. 

Key Responsibilities And Duties

- They are adept in the use of tools and technologies across tiers, and are proficient in working with systems infrastructure, creating, querying & manipulating databases, APIs and integration, Front-end code (HTML/CSS, bootstrap, React JS, Angular JS) and web stack back-end technologies (PHP, Python, Java, ruby on rails etc. ).

- 10+ Years Required

- Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work

Career Level

9IC

Associate Director - AWS, Python & Snowflake Developer

Experience Required

10+ years of relevant technology experience, with substantial hands-on engineering work in cloud data platforms

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Associate Director to join our team who continues to write code and build solutions. This role requires deep, practical expertise in AWS, Python, and Snowflake, with a strong emphasis on Snowpark development, serverless architectures, and orchestrated data pipelines. The ideal candidate combines senior-level technical depth with the ability to guide architecture decisions and mentor engineering teams. 

Must-Have Skills (Core Requirements)

- Python Development

Strong hands-on programming experience in Python, including building production-grade data processing applications, writing efficient and maintainable code, and working with common libraries used in data engineering workflows. 

- Snowflake & Snowpark

Demonstrated experience building and deploying Snowpark stored procedures, working with Snowflake's data engineering capabilities, writing efficient SQL, and optimizing Snowflake warehouses and query performance for large-scale datasets. 

- AWS Cloud Services

Practical, Hands-on Experience With: 

- AWS Lambda for serverless compute and event-driven processing
 - Amazon S3 for data storage, lifecycle management, and integration with downstream pipelines
 - General familiarity with the AWS ecosystem to support cross-service integrations
 - Workflow Orchestration

Experience designing, building, and maintaining DAGs (using tools such as Apache Airflow or equivalent orchestration frameworks) to manage complex, multi-step data pipelines with dependencies, scheduling, and failure handling. 

- Secondary Skills (Good to Have)
 - Version control proficiency with Git, including branching strategies, pull request workflows, and CI/CD integration
 - Familiarity with additional AWS services such as Glue, Step Functions, CloudWatch, IAM, ECS/EKS, or SNS/SQS
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation)
 - Exposure to containerization (Docker) and deployment pipelines
 - Understanding of data governance, security, and compliance practices in cloud environments
 - Domain Knowledge

Prior exposure to or working knowledge of the asset management/Investment banking or broader financial services industry is a strong plus. Familiarity with investment data concepts, portfolio management systems, or regulatory reporting requirements in this space would be beneficial. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable data engineering solutions using Python, Snowflake, and AWS services
 - Build and optimize Snowpark stored procedures for complex data transformations
 - Develop serverless applications leveraging AWS Lambda integrated with S3 and other AWS services
 - Design and manage DAG-based orchestration for end-to-end data pipeline execution
 - Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance while remaining actively engaged in hands-on development
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including data analysts, business stakeholders, and platform engineering
 - Establish and enforce coding standards, best practices, and code review processes
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, fostering technical growth within the team
 - Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, ensuring high availability and performance of data pipelines
 - Contribute to technical roadmap planning and platform modernization initiatives

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
 - 10+ years of overall technology experience, with significant time spent in hands-on data engineering roles
 - Proven track record of delivering production-grade solutions in Python and Snowflake environments
 - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in ambiguous or evolving requirements
 - Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting technical solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Related Skills

Agile Methodology, Continuous Integration and Deployment, Data Analysis, Debugging, DevOps, Enterprise Application Integration, Operating Systems Management, Problem Solving, Programming, Software Development, Software Development Life Cycle, Web Application Development

data.description:
Position Description

Job Title: AI Engineer

Position: Senior Software Engineer

Experience: 7-12 Years

Category: Software Development/ Engineering

Shift: Hybrid - (1PM to 10 PM Shift)

Main location: Hyderabad, Bangalore

Position ID: J0926-0014

Employment Type: Full Time

Position Description: We are looking for a Lead AI Developer to join our team. This position involves design, develop, and lead enterprise-grade Generative AI solutions. This role requires deep hands-on expertise in Python, Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and agent-based architectures. 

Your future duties and responsibilities

- Lead the design and development of scalable Generative AI solutions using LLMs
 - Define and implement architectures for RAG, agentic, multi-agent, and multimodal systems
 - Review and guide solution designs to ensure alignment with AI CoE standards and enterprise architecture
 - Mentor and guide developers on GenAI patterns, tools, and best practices
 - Develop end-to-end AI solutions using Python
 - Design, test, and optimize prompt engineering strategies
 - Build and manage embeddings, vector search, and semantic retrieval pipelines
 - Develop applications using LangChain and monitor, evaluate, and debug workflows using LangSmith
 - Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, and structured/unstructured data sources
 - Implement agent-based and multi-agent workflows for task orchestration and automation
 - Work with multimodal models involving text, documents, and images
 - Work closely with the AI CoE to align on AI frameworks, reusable components, and architectural standards
 - Contribute to enterprise GenAI accelerators, reference architectures, and best practices
 - Support governance, security, responsible AI, and compliance requirements
 - Share learnings, patterns, and improvements across teams to drive consistency and adoption
 - Apply deep understanding of LLM capabilities, limitations, and optimization techniques
 - Implement techniques such as RAG, tool/function calling, memory, and agents
 - Evaluate and recommend appropriate models (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, open-source models)
 - Ensure performance, scalability, cost optimization, and reliability of AI solutions

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

data.description: Job Title: Senior Tunnel ManagerOverview: We are seeking an accomplished Senior Tunnel Manager with a minimum of 15 years of professional experience, including at least 10 years in Hydel and/or Metro tunnelling projects. The successful candidate will provide technical leadership and strategic oversight for complex underground infrastructure projects, ensuring safe, economical, and constructible tunnel solutions. This role involves managing multidisciplinary teams, interfacing with clients and authorities, and guiding projects from concept through construction and commissioning. ResponsibilitiesProvide overall technical leadership and management for tunnelling projects, including hydropower tunnels, metro tunnels, shafts, caverns, cross passages, and associated underground structures. Lead and review geotechnical and tunnel design activities, including ground characterization, rock mass classification, support philosophy, lining systems, and construction methodology selection. Oversee and approve design basis reports, calculations, drawings, and technical specifications, ensuring compliance with project requirements, international standards, and best industry practices. Guide the application and interpretation of advanced numerical modelling and analytical studies (FEA / FEM / FDM) for ground-structure interaction, construction staging, and risk-critical scenarios. Manage and coordinate multidisciplinary teams comprising geotechnical, structural, construction, and BIM engineers to achieve integrated and optimized tunnel designs. Lead geotechnical risk assessments, constructability reviews, and value engineering exercises, and develop mitigation measures for adverse ground conditions and geological uncertainties. Provide strategic input on tunnelling methods (TBM, NATM / SEM, drill and blast, cut-and-cover) and temporary works in consultation with construction teams and contractors. Act as the primary technical interface with clients, independent engineers, regulatory authorities, and stakeholders, supporting approvals, technical negotiations, and statutory clearances. Support construction-phase engineering, including design change management, review of method statements, site observations, and resolution of technical issues arising during execution. Mentor and develop junior and mid-level engineers, contributing to capability building, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement of tunnel engineering practices within the organization. QualificationsBachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or Geotechnical Engineering; Master's degree in Rock Mechanics, Tunnel Engineering, or Geotechnical Engineering is strongly preferred. Minimum 15 years of total professional experience, with at least 10 years of direct experience in Hydel and/or Metro tunnelling projects, preferably in urban and complex geological settings. Strong expertise in rock mechanics, tunnel support design, ground behaviour, and geotechnical risk management, particularly for long tunnels and deep underground works. Sound understanding of structural design principles for tunnel linings, caverns, shafts, portals, and underground stations. Proven experience in guiding and reviewing analyses using PLAXIS, FLAC, MIDAS GTS, RS2/RS3, SAP2000, or similar engineering software. Demonstrated ability to manage large design teams and multiple work fronts, while maintaining technical quality, programme, and budget objectives. Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder-management skills, with experience in client interactions, design reviews, and high-level technical presentations.

Job Description

Principal AI Engineer

TechGrove AI Engineering Pod

You build the intelligent features that make software feel like magic, and you make them work in production. You are equally at home shipping a clean API, standing up a RAG pipeline, evaluating an agent, or tuning guardrails so an LLM behaves safely at scale. You are excited by the current moment in AI and pragmatic about where it actually adds value. 

As Principal AI Engineer, you design and build the AI capabilities that differentiate an OpCo's modernized applications: GenAI features, agentic workflows, and ML-powered functionality, integrated safely and reliably. You work side by side with the Technical Lead / Architect, contribute as a strong full-stack engineer, and help the whole pod raise its game in AI-native development. 

If you want to turn the frontier of applied AI into shipped, dependable product features, this role is for you. 

About The Pod

A TechGrove AI Engineering Pod is a self-contained, AI-native software delivery team that we embed inside one of our Operating Companies (OpCos) to build, modernize, and ship production software. Each pod pairs senior engineering talent with agentic AI tooling such as Claude Code, plus the accelerators of Banyan's AI Application Modernization Factory, to deliver at a velocity and quality bar a traditional team cannot match. 

A pod is typically four to eight people, and OpCos add more pods as their ambitions grow. You will work as part of a tight, high-trust team with real ownership of what you build. Pods are delivered from Banyan's India-based TechGrove. 

What You Will Do

- Ship production AI/ML features: Design, build, and deploy GenAI integrations, agentic workflows, RAG and GraphRAG systems, and ML-powered functionality into the OpCo's modernized applications. 
 - Orchestrate and integrate LLMs: Implement LLM orchestration, prompt and context engineering, guardrails, and evaluation to deliver reliable, safe, production-grade AI. 
 - Engineer cloud-native services: Build scalable, secure, resilient services that host and serve AI capabilities, as a strong hands-on contributor. 
 - Build agents and tooling: Develop AI agents and tooling, including building and connecting MCP servers and tools, and champion agentic development practices across the pod's SDLC. 
 - Own data and retrieval: Design the data, retrieval, and vector or knowledge-graph infrastructure that powers GenAI features, with quality, performance, and security built in. 
 - Own technical design and quality: Lead design and implementation for AI features, write clean, well-tested code, and uphold engineering standards, security, and observability. 
 - Collaborate and mentor: Partner with the Architect and senior engineers, and coach the team on AI/ML engineering best practices. 
 - Apply pragmatic judgment: Know where AI adds real value versus risk, and navigate a fast-moving landscape with a clear head. 

What You Bring

- Experience: 8+ years in software engineering, with significant hands-on experience implementing ML/AI features in production. 
 - Production experience on AWS or Azure (required): You have designed and built cloud-native applications on AWS or Azure, including containers, serverless, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform). Experience limited to GCP alone does not meet this requirement, although GCP in addition to AWS or Azure is a plus. 
 - Applied AI/ML: Demonstrated experience implementing GenAI capabilities (RAG and GraphRAG, LLM orchestration, prompt and context engineering, guardrail design) and/or ML features in production systems. 
 - Agentic and GenAI frameworks: Hands-on experience with GenAI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), multi-agent frameworks (crewAI, AutoGen, or similar), and developing AI agents and MCP servers and tools. 
 - Software engineering depth: Strong full-stack ability with solid SQL/No-SQL and API design skills. 
 - Modern tech stacks: Hands-on production experience with at least two of: . NET Core, Python, TypeScript, and Java. 
 - AI-native tooling: Fluency with AI-assisted development tooling (Claude Code or similar) as a daily, core part of your workflow. 
 - Engineering principles: Solid grounding in DDD, design patterns, clean code, test-driven development, and application security. 
 - DevSecOps: Experience with CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and cloud-native observability. 
 - Collaboration: Strong communication and an ownership mindset, comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Nice to Have

- Deep LLM and vector database expertise: hybrid vector databases, knowledge graphs, and advanced prompt and guardrail design for enterprise AI safety. 
 - Experience fine-tuning or evaluating models, building eval harnesses, or implementing LLM observability. 
 - Experience building and operating multi-tenant SaaS at scale. 
 - Prior experience modernizing or re-platforming enterprise or B2B applications. 

What Success Looks Like

- First 90 days: You have shipped your first production AI feature, established reliable patterns for orchestration, retrieval, and evaluation, and the pod has a clear, safe approach to building with LLMs. 
 - First 6 months: AI capabilities are a dependable, differentiating part of the product, with measured quality and guardrails, and the team is meaningfully more capable in applied AI because of your mentorship. 

Why TechGrove, Why Banyan

- Permanent home, long-term thinking: Banyan acquires great software businesses and keeps them for good. We invest for the long term, which means you build software meant to last, not to flip. 
 - Real ownership: You own outcomes end to end inside a small, senior team. The OpCo owns the "what"; the pod owns the "how. "
 - AI-native by default: You work every day with agentic tooling and the AI Application Modernization Factory, not as a side experiment but as the core of how we build. 
 - Variety with stability: Pods work across a portfolio of real products and domains, so you keep learning, with the security of a permanent employer behind you. 
 - Growth and excellence: A Banyan Director of Engineering Excellence supports every pod with coaching, standards, and continuous improvement, so your craft compounds over time. 

Should You Apply?

We have written this role to be honest about what it takes, not to describe a mythical perfect candidate. If you meet most of what is listed and you are excited by the work, we want to hear from you. Strong engineers grow into the rest, and we will help you do exactly that. 

We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and we welcome applicants of every background. What matters most is the quality of your engineering, your curiosity about AI-native development, and your appetite to own outcomes.

data.description:
About Us

Sauce Labs is the world's largest full-lifecycle, test automation platform, and the company behind Selenium. Trusted by 80% of the world's top ten largest financial institutions and over 300, 000 enterprise users, Sauce Labs provides the only AI platform capable of turning business intent into autonomous testing and quality assurance. With a proprietary dataset of 8. 7 billion test runs, Sauce Labs empowers the Fortune 2000 to bridge the gap between AI-driven code generation and enterprise-grade software quality. Learn more at saucelabs. com. 

The Role

We are seeking an innovative and experienced AI Architect to join our engineering leadership team. This is a strategic role that will be instrumental in designing and building the next generation of AI-powered features for our continuous testing platform. You will be responsible for architecting scalable and robust AI solutions that transform how our customers gain insights from their test data and production environments, and how they create tests. 

Responsibilities

- Define AI Architecture: Lead the design and architecture of cutting-edge AI/ML solutions for new product offerings, ensuring scalability, performance, quality and reliability within a cloud-native environment. 
 - AI-Powered Insights (Test & Production): Architect AI systems to derive actionable insights from vast quantities of test run logs and analytics data. This includes identifying patterns, anomalies, and performance trends. 
 - Production Error Reporting Integration: Design AI solutions that integrate with our existing error reporting product to analyze production issues for mobile and web applications, providing deeper understanding and predictive capabilities. 
 - Unified Data Intelligence: Develop architectures for combining insights from both test runs and production data, creating a holistic view of application quality and user experience.
