data.title: Enterprise AI Architect
data.description:
Job Description

Accountable for the end-to-end architecture, engineering blueprint, deployment model, operational readiness, security, governance, and integration strategy of the client's enterprise AI systems, ensuring that AI solutions operate as secure, scalable, compliant, and business-aligned systems across models, applications, infrastructure, data, networks, and external dependencies. That means the architect will have visibility across the entire chain: Business Rules, AI Platform, Models, Data/Knowledge Graphs APIs/Integration Network, Infrastructure, Security Deployment, Operations, Monitoring. The core responsibilities for the job include the following: End-to-end AI system architecture: - Define the overall architecture of AI systems across models, agents, applications, data, APIs, infrastructure, and external services. - Establish architecture principles, reference architectures, and technology standards. - Define the technology selection principles and coding standards. - Define the architecture standards to be followed by individual AI products. - Ensure architecture supports scalability, resilience, performance, and maintainability. Infrastructure and deployment: - Define/approve the deployment architecture across cloud/on-premise/hybrid environments for both Maveric and client environments. - Define/approve requirements for Kubernetes, GPU infrastructure, storage, networking, and compute. - Establish/approve deployment, release, and rollback patterns for AI systems. - Define checklists and guidelines to ensure production-readiness of AI products. AI engineering ecosystem development: - Define the standardized and reusable capabilities, such as the following, that need to be consumed by all Maveric AI products in a standardized manner. - Foundation models, AI gateways, model routing, vector databases, prompt management, RAG, guardrails, observability, and AI security. - Define how Maveric AI platforms consume centralized platform capabilities. - Work with the delivery and integration leader to create the reusable services. - Determine what should be centralized as a platform capability versus embedded within individual AI products. Business rules and AI controls: - Ensure business rules, policies, decision logic, and human-in-the-loop controls are properly incorporated into the Maveric AI Platforms. - Define boundaries between LLM/model behavior and deterministic business logic (i. e. , what goes to the LLM vs. what is not going to the LLM). - Define the model selection guidelines. - Ensure AI products follow the architecture patterns in a manner in which their outputs can be controlled, validated, and audited. Integration and external ecosystem: - Own the architectural integration of AI systems with core banking/enterprise applications, APIs, identity platforms, data platforms, external AI/model providers, third-party services, and enterprise networks. - Assess dependencies and architectural risks associated with external providers. Security, risk, and compliance: - Ensure AI architecture incorporates security and regulatory requirements. - Define controls for data privacy, model security, prompt injection, data leakage, access control, and model abuse. - Work with cybersecurity, risk, legal, and compliance teams to establish AI controls. - Ensure appropriate auditability and traceability are defined and implemented. Reliability and operations: - Define SLOs, RTO/RPO, and operational readiness requirements. Net suite of applications in the Product and Service Delivery Function under Enterprise Solutions.

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‐powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‐performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities. 

At Lumen, you'll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what's next, where performance, security, and resilience matter. 

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you're ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‐ready connectivity, join us today. 

The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Security Automation Engineer to design, develop, and maintain security automation solutions that improve SOC efficiency, accelerate incident response, and enhance security operations. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SIEM/SOAR platforms, scripting, API integrations, workflow automation, and security operations. 

The Main Responsibilities

Security Automation & Workflow Development

- Design, develop, and maintain automated security playbooks, runbooks, and orchestration workflows. 
 - Automate repetitive SOC processes to improve operational efficiency and response times. 
 - Enhance incident response processes through security automation and workflow optimization. 

SIEM / SOAR Engineering

- Configure, customize, and support SIEM and SOAR platforms, including Microsoft Sentinel, Cortex XSIAM/XSOAR, and Azure Logic Apps. 
 - Develop and optimize automated investigation and remediation workflows. 
 - Integrate security monitoring tools to improve detection and response capabilities. 

Scripting & Development

- Develop automation solutions using Python (required), PowerShell, Bash, and JavaScript.

 - Implement robust error handling, validation, and troubleshooting mechanisms. 

API & Integration Engineering

- Design and manage integrations using REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and authentication frameworks such as OAuth and API keys. 
 - Integrate security tools, ITSM platforms, and third-party solutions to streamline operations. 
 - Develop custom connectors and automation frameworks. 

SOC Operations & Incident Response

- Support security operations through alert enrichment, case management, and detection workflow automation. 
 - Collaborate with SOC analysts and incident responders to enhance operational effectiveness. 
 - Improve investigation workflows and reduce analyst response time. 

EDR & Security Platform Integration

- Integrate and manage security platforms including CrowdStrike, Microsoft Sentinel, SOAR solutions, threat intelligence platforms, and ITSM tools. 
 - Support endpoint detection and response (EDR) workflows and automated remediation capabilities. 

ITSM & Ticketing Automation

- Develop integrations with ServiceNow and other ticketing systems. 
 - Automate alert routing, ticket generation, case creation, and workflow management processes. 
 - Improve service management operations through automation. 

DevOps & Source Control

 - Manage deployment templates, workflow releases, and code repositories. 
 - Support CI/CD practices for automation deployment and maintenance. 

Documentation & Process Improvement

- Develop and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and reusable automation templates.

 - Provide ongoing support and knowledge sharing across teams. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

- Strong experience in Security Automation, Workflow Development, and SOC Process Automation. 
 - Proficiency in Python scripting and automation development. 
 - Hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Cortex XSIAM/XSOAR, and Azure Logic Apps. 
 - Experience with REST APIs, JSON, Webhooks, OAuth, and API integrations. 
 - Strong understanding of Incident Response, Security Operations, Alert Enrichment, and Case Management. 
 - Experience integrating EDR, SIEM, SOAR, ITSM, and Threat Intelligence platforms. 
 - Knowledge of ServiceNow integration and ticket automation. 
 - Experience with GitHub, version control systems, and deployment methodologies. 
 - Strong troubleshooting, testing, and operational support skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

Cloud & Automation Platforms

- Experience with Azure Functions, Azure Automation, and Azure administration. 
 - Experience with Power Automate and Power Apps. 

Security Engineering

- Experience with log source onboarding, parser development, detection engineering, and rule tuning. 
 - Understanding of MITRE ATT&CK framework and threat detection methodologies. 

Reporting & Analytics

- Experience developing dashboards and reports using Power BI. 
 - Ability to build KPI, SLA, and operational performance reporting. 

Additional Security Tools

- Experience with Microsoft Defender XDR, SentinelOne, and other EDR technologies. 
 - Familiarity with Jira and workflow management platforms. 

AI-Driven Security Operations

- Experience with Microsoft Security Copilot and AI-assisted SOC automation. 
 - Understanding of Agentic AI concepts and their application in cybersecurity operations. 

Preferred Certifications

High Priority

Medium Priority

data.title: Senior HPC Cluster Engineer - AI, ML

NVIDIA is looking for a Senior AI/ML HPC Cluster Engineer to join our MARS team. You will provide leadership and strategic guidance on the management of large-scale HPC systems including the deployment of compute, networking, and storage. You will be working with a team of passionate and skilled engineers across NVIDIA that are continuously working to provide better tools to build and manage this infrastructure. Ideal candidate is strong in building and maintaining distributed clusters, driving improvements, and has the ability to understand researcher computing needs. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Provide leadership in systems administration and service delivery on our AI/HPC fleet by coordinating system upgrades, responding to incidents, and delivering reliability improvements.

data.title: Shift Manager
data.description:
Business Unit: 

Cubic Transportation Systems

Company Details: 

When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people's lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners. 

We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic. com. 

Job Details: 

Job Summary

As a Shift Coordinator on the CTS 24x7 Service Operations team, you will provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 staff across the Network Operations Center (NOC), Security Operations Center (SOC), and Service Desk during your assigned shift. You act as the technical and operational command authority during the shift. You are responsible for ensuring that events across all three functions are correctly triaged, tickets are properly assigned and tracked, incidents are escalated per defined protocols, and shift handovers preserve full situational awareness for the incoming shift. 

You are responsible for confirming shift staffing coverage in real time and for adjusting assignments to accommodate last-minute absences. You are the immediate escalation path for issues that exceed the authority of the Tier 1 and Tier 2 analysts on the shift, and you escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for issues that exceed shift authority. 

Work is conducted under the compliance frameworks that govern CTS operations, in particular ITIL 4 (Monitoring and Event Management, Incident Management, Continual Improvement), ISO/IEC 27001: 2022 (Annex A logging, monitoring, and incident management controls), and PCI DSS v4. 0. 1 (Requirements 10 and 12. 10). You will be recognized inside CTS as the shift-level owner for cross-function coordination and evidence continuity. 

Responsibilities

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities

Shift Command and Team Coordination

- Provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 NOC, SOC, and Service Desk analysts during the assigned shift. 
 - Assign work at shift start and re-balance workload throughout the shift based on ticket volume, incident severity, and individual analyst capacity. 
 - Confirm complete shift coverage across NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues at shift start; adjust in real time when staff are unavailable because of sick calls, unplanned PTO, or emergency absence. 
 - Serve as the initial escalation point for any Tier 1 or Tier 2 analyst who needs additional authority, judgment, or cross-functional coordination. 
 - Track and report shift-level metrics (ticket volume, SLA adherence, incident count by severity) at shift close. 

Shift Handover Discipline

- Execute a formal shift handover at the start and end of every shift, per the protocols defined in the NOC Scope Definition and the CTS SOC Scope of Operations. 
 - Ensure the handover record captures, at minimum: open incidents with owner and next action; active containment actions in progress; watchlist items; active maintenance windows; tooling or coverage gaps. 
 - Retain handover records as ISMS evidence supporting ISO/IEC 27001: 2022 A. 5. 10 and ITIL 4 Monitoring and Event Management practice. 

Incident Management Coordination

- Apply ITIL 4 Incident Management practice throughout the shift: validate alerts, classify severity, assign ownership, coordinate escalation, and track resolution against SLA. 
 - Coordinate the first 15 to 30 minutes of any SEV 0 or SEV 1 incident: declare the incident, engage the appropriate tiers, initiate stakeholder communications, and hand off to the Incident Commander or on-call Tier 3 engineer. 
 - Enforce severity special rules from the NOC Scope Definition (for example, loss of logging or monitoring is never a SEV 4 event; SEV 0 or SEV 1 with a recent production change requires a change correlation step). 
 - Ensure joint NOC-SOC coordination during Major Incidents: NOC leads operational recovery; SOC leads security investigation and containment; the Shift Coordinator maintains the shared incident bridge until the Incident Commander takes over. 

Cross-Function Ticket Routing and Escalation

- Monitor NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues in the ITSM platform; ensure tickets are correctly categorized and assigned per the RACI. 
 - Route security-relevant events from the NOC or Service Desk to the SOC per the defined Escalation pathway with enriched context. 
 - Route operational recovery actions from the SOC to the NOC or regional IT Operations per the defined protocol. 
 - Escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for any issue that exceeds shift authority. 

Compliance Evidence and Documentation

- Ensure shift activities produce audit-ready evidence supporting PCI DSS v4. 0. 1 Requirement 10 and Requirement 12. 10, and ISO/IEC 27001: 2022 A. 5. 24-A. 5. 28 and A. 8. 15-A. 8. 16. 
 - Verify handover records, incident timelines, and containment action logs are complete and accurate before shift close. 
 - Support monthly and quarterly evidence pack preparation. 

Continuous Improvement Contribution

- Identify recurring patterns during the shift (repeat incidents, noisy alerts, gaps in playbook coverage) and log them for review by the NOC, SOC, and Service Desk Managers. 
 - Participate in post-incident reviews and contribute to the Continual Improvement Register per ITIL 4 Continual Improvement practice. 
 - Recommend changes to shift-level procedures where the shift experience identifies opportunities. 

General Duties And Responsibilities

- Reliably demonstrate accountability for work assignments and proactive communications about issues and status. A strong history of proactively identifying effective solutions for challenges. 
 - Able to work effectively and uphold professional standards, with the customer and system stakeholders. 
 - Self-motivated and able to work unsupervised. 
 - Methodical and attentive to detail. 
 - Proactive in seeking advice from senior operations and security subject matter experts when required. 
 - Comfortable working with staff at all levels and in other geographical locations within the organization. 
 - Comply with Cubic's Quality Management System. 
 - Comply with Cubic's quality, health, safety, and security policies. 
 - Support the company's strategic objectives and collaborate across departments. 
 - Comply with Cubic Human Resources Procedures. 

Skills / Experience / Knowledge

Essential: 

- Experience providing direct supervision to a team of individual contributors in a technology operations, security operations, or service desk environment. 
 - Working knowledge of NOC operations: event monitoring, incident management, SLA management, change and configuration control. 
 - Working knowledge of SOC operations: SIEM and EDR alert triage, security incident classification, escalation protocols. 
 - Working knowledge of Service Desk operations under a Tier 1-3 tiered model. 
 - Familiarity with ITIL 4 practices, in particular Monitoring and Event Management and Incident Management. 
 - Ability to interpret and explain incident status, containment actions, and escalation decisions to peers, subordinate staff, and functional peer groups. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Collaboration and Interaction expectations. 
 - Sound judgment in resolving problems that require analysis of data and relevant factors under real-time pressure. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Complexity and Problem Solving expectations. 
 - Ability to develop and manage routine operational plans and meet targets against a monthly performance plan. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Discretion and Impact expectations. 
 - Experience preparing accurate shift reports and handover records. 
 - Comfort operating 24x7 shift patterns, including nights, weekends, and public holidays. 

Desirable: 

- Familiarity with PCI DSS v4. 0. 1 requirements, in particular Requirement 10, Requirement 11. 5, and Requirement 12. 10. 
 - Familiarity with ISO/IEC 27001: 2022 Annex A controls covering logging (A. 8. 15), monitoring activities (A. 8. 16), and incident management (A. 5. 24 to A. 5. 28). 
 - Exposure to NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2. 0 (NIST CSWP 29) Detect and Respond Functions. 
 - Working knowledge of ServiceNow (or equivalent enterprise ITSM) and Jira. 
 - Understanding of the ITIL 4 Major Incident model and Problem Management practice. 
 - Experience coordinating across NOC, SOC, and Service Desk boundaries. 

Qualifications

Essential: 

- Must be able to work on-site at Cubic Hyderabad, Aparna Plaza, on a 24x7 rotating shift pattern. 
 - Minimum 5-8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree. 
 - University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or other technical field; or Business Administration with relevant IT work experience. 
 - At least 5 years of experience in a Tier 1-3 operations environment (NOC, SOC, Service Desk, or NOC/SOC hybrid). 
 - At least 3 years' experience managing shift workers. 
 - Demonstrated ability to make severity classification and escalation decisions in a real-time operations setting. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead a team through a shift, including workload assignment, coaching, and formal handover. 
 - At least 3 years' experience working in an ITIL 4 operation. 

Desirable: 

- ITIL 4 Foundation certification; ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader preferred. 
 - CompTIA Security+, ISC2 SSCP, or equivalent security operations certification. 
 - ServiceNow ITSM administrator or user certification. 
 - Experience in a payment card processing environment, or in a similarly regulated real-time operations environment. 
 - Experience with global follow-the-sun shift models spanning NAM, EMEA, and APAC time zones. 

Condition of Employment: 

Successful outcome of a National Police Check

Position Title: SAP Architecture Lead

Position Type: Regular - Full-Time

Requisition ID: 39785

Role Summary

The SAP Architecture Lead owns the end-to-end architectural vision and integrity of the SAP S/4HANA landscape, ensuring that solution, application, and integration architecture align with enterprise strategy and emerging AI-driven capabilities. Acting as a bridge between business intent and technical execution, this role sets architectural standards, governs the technology roadmap, and partners with global functional, technical, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, future-ready SAP environments. A core expectation is the active use of SAP LeanIX to model, govern, and communicate the enterprise architecture landscape. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and own the target-state SAP S/4HANA architecture across application, data, integration, and technical layers, ensuring alignment with the broader enterprise architecture. 
 - Maintain the SAP architecture landscape, application portfolio, and technology roadmaps within SAP LeanIX, driving transparency, rationalization, and data-driven decision-making. 
 - Embed AI and intelligent enterprise capabilities into the architecture roadmap - including SAP Business AI, Joule, generative-AI use cases on SAP BTP, and AI-assisted automation across business processes. 
 - Establish and enforce architecture governance, design principles, and standards across projects and run-state operations. 
 - Provide architectural oversight for major programs (greenfield, brownfield, and selective transformations), integrations, and BTP-based extensions. 
 - Evaluate emerging SAP technologies and AI tooling, advising leadership on adoption, fit, and value realization. 
 - Partner with security, infrastructure, and data teams to ensure compliance, performance, scalability, and resilience. 
 - Mentor architects and technical leads, raising the overall architectural maturity of the organization. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. 
 - Approximately 15 years of experience in SAP Architecture, with significant depth in S/4HANA solution and technical architecture. 
 - Demonstrated hands-on experience with SAP LeanIX for enterprise architecture management, portfolio rationalization, and roadmap governance. 
 - Strong understanding of SAP BTP, integration architecture, and the SAP AI/intelligent enterprise portfolio. 
 - Proven track record leading architecture for large, complex, multi-region SAP landscapes. 

Soft Skills & Leadership

- Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with a proven ability to engage global functional, technical, and business stakeholders and translate complex architecture into business-relevant terms. 
 - Strong influencing, facilitation, and consensus-building abilities across geographies and cultures. 
 - Confident decision-making, with the maturity to balance strategic vision against delivery constraints. 
 - Mentorship and team-leadership orientation suited to a mid-management role. 

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

- SAP and/or TOGAF architecture certifications. 
 - Experience in regulated or manufacturing/consumer-goods environments. 
 - Exposure to cloud (RISE with SAP / hyperscaler) and large-scale transformation programs.

data.title: Sr. Manager, Data Engineering
data.description:
Role Summary

We're looking for a Senior Manager to lead a blended AI engineering team building the agentic AI platform and the marketing solutions that run on top of it. This is a delivery-leadership role: you own the roadmap, execution, and quality bar for a team of platform engineers, applied-AI solutions builders, and data engineering - turning cutting-edge agentic AI into reliable, production systems that marketing and analytics teams depend on every day. 

You will operate at the intersection of platform and product: hardening the agentic infrastructure (LLM orchestration, retrieval, tool/MCP integration, deploys, reliability) while making sure the AI solutions built on it deliver real marketing outcomes. You'll grow the people on your team, set a high engineering bar, and partner across a global AI organization. 

What You'll Do

Platform & infrastructure

- Own delivery and reliability of the agentic AI platform: LLM orchestration, retrieval/RAG pipelines, tool and MCP integration, model routing, and evaluation. 
 - Drive engineering quality - test discipline, deployment safety, observability, cost and latency management - across everything the team ships. 
 - Set technical direction with your senior engineers; make the hard architecture calls and unblock the team (design-level involvement; not expected to write production code day-to-day). 

Applied AI solutions

- Lead the team that builds AI agents and workflows for marketing use cases (analytics, paid media, content-to-intent, executive reporting) on top of the platform. 
 - Ensure solutions are grounded in real business outcomes and adopted by stakeholders - not demos that stall. 
 - Balance platform investment against solution delivery so both advance. 

People leadership & delivery

- Manage, coach, and grow a blended team; run hiring to build out the function. 
 - Own the roadmap and quarterly planning; convert ambiguous priorities into committed, sequenced delivery. 
 - Represent the team's work to leadership and cross-functional partners; drive alignment across a globally distributed AI organization. 

The Team You'll Lead

A blended engineering team of: 

- Agentic AI / platform engineers - Python, LLM orchestration, RAG, MCP/tooling, cloud-native deploys. 
 - Applied-AI solutions builders - wiring AI to marketing and analytics use cases. 
 - Data engineering - the pipelines and semantic layer the AI grounds on. 

Must-Have Qualifications

- ~12+ years in software / AI/ML engineering, with 4+ years managing engineering teams (including hiring and growing engineers). 
 - Demonstrated depth in agentic AI / LLM systems - orchestration, retrieval/RAG, tool use, agent frameworks, and evaluation of AI quality. 
 - Track record of shipping production AI/ML systems at scale - reliability, deployment safety, cost/latency awareness - not just prototypes. 
 - Strong Python and modern cloud-native / containerized delivery. 
 - Ability to set a high engineering bar and make sound architecture decisions while leading primarily through the team. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management across a globally distributed organization. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Marketing technology or analytics domain experience - AEP / AJO / CJA, adtech, or digital marketing analytics. 
 - Experience with Databricks, vector databases (pgvector), graph stores (Neo4j), or similar data/AI infrastructure. 
 - Hands-on with agent/LLM frameworks and MCP, prompt/eval tooling, and LLM cost governance. 
 - Experience standing up or scaling a new AI engineering function. 

What Success Looks Like (First 6-12 Months)

- A team operating with a clear roadmap, predictable delivery, and a visibly higher quality/reliability bar. 
 - At least one AI solution moved from concept to in-production use, adopted by marketing/analytics stakeholders. 
 - Platform reliability, evaluation, and cost/observability practices established as the default, not the exception. 
 - Key hires made; team members growing and taking on larger scope. 

Leadership Behaviors

- Candor and clarity - lead with the bottom line, disagree openly, separate fact from guess, flag risks early. 
 - Ownership - own outcomes end-to-end, not just handoffs; the team ships things that work and says so honestly when they don't. 
 - Bar-raiser - hire people better than the current team and hold a high engineering standard. 

Builder's bias - move fast on real problems, cut scope ruthlessly, prefer working systems over polished plans. 

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe's industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity. 

Our 30, 000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We're on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. 

Let's Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create. 

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more. 

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe. com. 

AI Use Guidelines for Interviews: 

Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

Recruitment Scam Notice: Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as "name@cvent. com" email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent. 

If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent. com. 

For more information, visit Cvent's Recruitment Fraud Notice. https: //www. cvent. com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud. 

About Cvent: 

www. cvent. com

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6, 000+ employees and ~34, 000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we're transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers human connection. 

Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4. 6B in 2023. 

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections. 

Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection. 

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we're committed to continuous learning and adaptation-AI isn't just a tool for us, it's part of our DNA. We're looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you'll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation. 

Throughout our interview process, you'll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you're excited to be part of a team that's leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we'd love to meet you. 

Role Overview

Splash is Cvent's event marketing platform. We are standing up a new engineering team in Bengaluru with a single charter: build the AI-powered features that will define the next generation of Splash. You will build this team from zero, then lead it as a peer to the established Splash engineering and product teams in Bengaluru, North America, and Spain, who own adjacent parts of the platform and with whom you will plan, design, and ship. 

This is an AI-first role in two senses. The team ships AI into the product, and the team builds software with AI: agentic coding tools, spec-driven development, and disciplined review of AI-generated output are the default way of working here, not an experiment. We are looking for a manager whose value comes from engineering judgment and a high quality bar rather than from the volume of code they personally write. You will decide what gets built and how, set the standard for what is good enough to ship, and hold the team to it. 

Reporting line: Director of Engineering, Splash India. Team size: 4-5 engineers by the end of the first year, hired by you. 

In This Role, You Will: 

Build the team (your main job in year one)

- Hire the founding team from 0 to 4-5: define the roles and levels, run the hiring loop end to end, close candidates, and onboard them to be productive quickly. 
 - Establish the team's engineering standards, operating rhythm, and ways of working from day one, including how AI tools are used, reviewed, and measured. 
 - Create a culture where engineers own outcomes, learn fast, and hold a high bar for quality. 

Lead delivery of AI features for Splash

- Own execution of the AI feature roadmap for Splash in partnership with Product, Design, and the Splash teams in Bangalore, North America, and Spain. 
 - Make architecture and technology decisions for the team's services and front ends; ensure what ships meets non-functional requirements (security, scalability, resiliency, accessibility, performance) and responsible-AI expectations. 
 - Run the team across time zones: coordinate dependencies, manage production issues and incidents, and keep stakeholders informed with clear, honest status. 

Set the engineering bar in an AI-native workflow

- Define how the team works with agentic coding tools and spec-driven development: what a good spec looks like, when to delegate to an agent, and what must be verified by a human. 
 - Be the quality gate. Review designs, AI-generated code, tests, and evaluations for correctness, security, and maintainability, and teach the team to do the same. 
 - Keep the team's tooling and practices current as the AI development landscape changes, and share what works with the wider Splash organization. 

Grow people

- Coach engineers, set goals, give direct and timely feedback, and run performance reviews and career development. 

Here's What You Need: 

These are requirements, not nice-to-haves. We expect candidates to meet all of them. 

- People management and hiring. 12+ years of software engineering experience, with depth in backend systems and 3+ years managing software engineers, with a track record of hiring, onboarding, and growing strong engineers, and the appetite to do that here from the ground up. 
 - Depth in our stack. Java with Spring Boot for backend services; React or Next. js with TypeScript on the front end; GraphQL APIs; relational and NoSQL databases; event-driven microservices on AWS. 
 - Hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic software development. You use tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or GitHub Copilot agents in your own work: writing specs an agent can execute, reviewing and correcting its output, and knowing where these tools fail. This must be lived experience, not familiarity with the concepts. 
 - Strong engineering judgment. You can evaluate a design or a change for correctness, security, scalability, and maintainability without having written it yourself, and you have a track record of owning non-functional requirements for production systems. 
 - Experience shipping AI product features. You have taken LLM-powered functionality to production (for example retrieval, agents, or structured generation) and understand evaluation, prompt and model lifecycle, cost, latency, and failure modes. 
 - Cross-geography collaboration. Proven ability to work as a peer with engineering, product, design, and SRE teams in other regions and time zones, including in a matrixed or distributed organization. 
 - Clear communication. You write specs, decisions, and status updates that people in other time zones can act on without a meeting, and you can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Education. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

Nice to Have: 

- Experience forming a team from scratch (0 to N): defining roles and levels, standing up the hiring loop, and establishing norms rather than inheriting an existing team. 
 - Experience in event, marketing, or martech products, or other B2B SaaS with high-volume customer-facing workflows. 
 - Experience building evaluation frameworks or observability for LLM features in production.

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Software Engineering
data.description:
About The Team

The Developer Experience (DevEx) Delivery Engineering team builds and operates Zillow's software delivery platform. This is the paved road from commit to production that every Zillow Group engineer relies on to build, test, deploy, and ship. The platform supports org-wide delivery infrastructure at meaningful scale: CI/CD, runners, GitLab, Artifactory, Progressive Delivery, mobile build and release, and legacy migration programs. We are shifting from hands-on infrastructure operations toward secure, compliant, AI-first paved paths that improve reliability, release safety, and developer productivity. 

We are standing up a new India-based team to expand capacity, enable follow-the-sun coverage, and take first-class ownership of high-impact platform initiatives. As one of the founding members, you'll help shape a brand-new engineering site while working on infrastructure that multiplies the productivity of the entire engineering organization. 

What the team works on

GitLab (including GitLab Dedicated and Duo): operate the central source-control and CI/CD platform and enable secure, AI-assisted SDLC workflows. 

CI/CD runners: modernize Linux, macOS, iOS, and Android runner fleets improving isolation, queueing, and cost attribution. 

Progressive Delivery: scale canary, health-gated, rollback-aware deployment patterns. 

Artifactory and supply chain: operate a Tier-0 artifact platform and improve upgrade, backup, retention, and lifecycle practices. 

Migration and modernization: retire legacy CI/CD (Concrete) using dashboards, partner engagement, and agentic migration. 

Mobile build/release and Mobile DevOps: sustain a high release cadence while modernizing build tooling. 

Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow's mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India. 

About The Role

About the role

As the Engineering Manager for the new India-based Delivery Engineering team, you'll build and lead a founding, general-purpose platform team responsible for high-impact work across CI/CD and build infrastructure, Progressive Delivery, migration and deprecation programs, GitLab/Artifactory operations, and mobile release/build tooling. 

You'll own hiring, people management, performance, and career development while bringing enough technical depth to earn credibility, engage in design reviews, and represent India-owned areas in engineering leadership forums. This is a founding leadership role: the standards you set and the first engineers you hire will define the long-term success of Delivery Engineering in India. 

What you'll do

- Build and grow a high-impact founding team that owns platform, Progressive Delivery, migration, and mobile-release work as first-class contributors. 
 - Establish a follow-the-sun operating model with defined overlap, handoff practices, async-first documentation, and a phased India on-call rotation. 
 - Hire a senior founding team and set and hold a high hiring bar. 
 - Partner with US area leads and the TPM to allocate capacity, limit work in progress, reduce context switching, and drive predictable delivery. 
 - Raise the bar on operational excellence: on-call practices, incident response, post-incident reviews, SLOs, runbooks, and toil reduction. 
 - Champion AI-first delivery across the SDLC, including agentic migration, AI code review, rollout analysis, and platform operations. 
 - Create a healthy engineering culture across time zones with clear goals, feedback, performance management, development plans, and technical-leadership growth. 

This role has been categorized as an Office position. "Office" employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute. 

In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. 

Who you are

What you'll bring

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 5+ years managing engineering teams that build backend, platform, infrastructure, SRE, or developer-productivity services. 
 - Staff+ technical depth and sound judgment: able to align business goals with platform capabilities and guide architecture beyond the immediate team. 
 - Strong operating experience: production ownership, on-call, incident response, observability, runbooks, and improving reliability over time. 
 - A proven hiring and talent-development bar: able to recruit, assess, onboard, mentor, and manage performance with clarity and empathy. 
 - Exceptional written and verbal communication across seniority levels and geographies; comfortable with async-first decision-making. 
 - Demonstrated ability to build trust with distributed stakeholders and represent India engineering as a peer ownership function. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building or scaling a new site or distributed engineering team, especially across US-India. 
 - Experience in DevEx, platform, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, release engineering, or SRE organizations supporting many internal customers. 
 - Hands-on familiarity with AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitLab, CI/CD runners, observability tooling, and modern incident management. 
 - Experience applying AI to engineering workflows with a quality, governance, and developer-trust mindset. 

Why join

- Founding role: shape a new India engineering site and help set the technical and cultural bar from day one. 
 - High leverage: work on the platform used by every Zillow engineer and every major product surface. 
 - Modernization agenda: GitLab Dedicated, runner rearchitecture, Progressive Delivery, Artifactory modernization, and legacy retirement. 
 - AI-first work: real production use cases across code review, migrations, incident analysis, and deployment safety. 
 - Global collaboration: partner directly with US engineering leaders while building durable India ownership. 

Get to know us

At Zillow, we're reimagining how people move-through the real estate market and through their careers. 

As the most-visited real estate platform in the U. S. , Zillow helps millions of customers navigate buying, selling, financing, and renting with greater ease and confidence. Our teams in India play a critical role in building and scaling the technology, products, and operations that power this experience. 

Whether you're working in tech, operations, or shared services, you'll collaborate with global partners to solve meaningful problems and help more people make home a reality. 

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U. S. . Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. 

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry-and your career-forward, together. 

Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, maternity status, HIV status, or veteran status. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to candidates with disabilities, in accordance with applicable policies.

data.title: RCM Associate Manager - Quality
data.description:
Job Description Summary

The Associate Manager - Quality, RCM is responsible for leading, monitoring, and continuously improving the quality assurance function within Revenue Cycle Management operations. This is a people-plus-process leadership role that combines hands-on audit governance with team management, client engagement, and strategic quality improvement. 

You will serve as the primary quality ambassador between operations, clients, and senior leadership - ensuring compliance with payer guidelines, HIPAA regulations, and internal SOPs while driving performance excellence across all QA analysts. You will own the quality scorecard, shape audit strategy, and build a culture of accountability and continuous learning within your team. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Oversight & Governance

- Own and enforce quality benchmarks across all RCM functions - coding, billing, AR follow-up, denial management, and payment posting
 - Establish and maintain quality control checkpoints at each stage of the revenue cycle workflow
 - Ensure 100% alignment with CMS guidelines, payer-specific rules, client contractual obligations, and HIPAA/PHI regulations
 - Define and manage the monthly/quarterly audit plan, sampling strategies, and QA frameworks

Audit Management & Root Cause Analysis

- Oversee daily, weekly, and monthly transaction audits and calibration sessions across all RCM verticals
 - Drive root cause analysis (RCA) for all identified errors and ensure actionable corrective plans are documented and tracked
 - Maintain comprehensive audit trails and error logs for regulatory and client review
 - Identify recurring defect patterns and escalate critical findings to operations leadership with data-backed reports

Team Leadership & People Management

- Lead, mentor, coach, and manage a team of 20+ QA analysts, ensuring equitable workload distribution and professional growth
 - Facilitate regular team huddles, one-on-one feedback sessions, and calibration meetings to promote a quality-first culture
 - Identify skill gaps through error trend analysis and develop targeted coaching and upskilling plans
 - Act as the first point of escalation for QA analysts and provide real-time guidance and support
 - Participate in monthly/quarterly performance reviews for all QA team members in coordination with HR

Performance Management & Analytics

- Track, analyze, and report quality metrics including accuracy rates, defect rates, rework rates, and SLA adherence
 - Manage and implement corrective action plans (CAPs) for underperforming analysts and processes
 - Align team KPIs with organizational quality goals and report progress to senior leadership
 - Monitor Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) and drive year-on-year reduction targets

Process Improvement & Innovation

- Drive continuous improvement (CI) initiatives to reduce defects, rework, and COPQ using Lean/Six Sigma methodologies
 - Design and optimize QA workflows, sampling strategies, and feedback loop mechanisms
 - Collaborate with operations, IT, and training teams to implement process changes that improve first-pass accuracy rates
 - Evaluate and pilot quality improvement technologies (e. g. , AI-powered auditing tools, automation)

Client Engagement & Stakeholder Management

- Lead and participate in client quality calls, review meetings, and audits - presenting quality metrics, trends, and action plans
 - Manage and resolve client escalations related to quality issues within defined SLAs
 - Support client-specific onboarding by documenting payer rules, quality requirements, and SOPs
 - Build and maintain strong client relationships by ensuring consistent delivery of quality benchmarks

Reporting, Documentation & Compliance

- Prepare and share daily/weekly/monthly quality MIS reports, scorecards, and dashboards with leadership
 - Maintain up-to-date QA SOPs, error category definitions, calibration logs, and feedback templates
 - Design and deliver quality-related training modules for new joiners and refresher programs for existing staff
 - Stay current with payer policy changes and disseminate relevant updates to the quality and operations teams

What We're Looking For

Education & Experience

- Graduate in any discipline; additional certification in Medical Billing / Coding (CPC, CRC, CPMA) preferable
 - 9 - 11 years of experience in RCM operations with a minimum of 7 years in a Quality Analyst / Senior QA / Team Lead role
 - Proven track record of managing quality teams of 10+ members in a healthcare BPO/KPO environment

Domain Expertise

- In-depth knowledge of Billing , payment posting AR follow-up, denial management, and payer rules
 - Strong understanding of HIPAA, PHI, CMS guidelines, and payer-specific compliance requirements
 - Experience with EMR/PMS systems) and QA dashboards
 - Proficiency in MS Excel (advanced), data analysis, and MIS/dashboard reporting
 - Familiarity with Lean/Six Sigma methodologies or process improvement frameworks is a strong plus

Leadership & Soft Skills

- Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and drive performance improvements across teams
 - Excellent written and verbal communication for client interactions, presentations, and internal reporting
 - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving ability, and attention to detail
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet tight deadlines, and thrive in a fast-paced environment
 - Effective stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence without authority

Compensation for this job is subject to market conditions, geographic considerations, the candidate's unique skills and experience, state and local laws, and budget. Our commitment to pay transparency is a testament to our dedication to creating a fair, equitable, and inclusive workplace. By continuously analyzing market trends, staying abreast of changes in state laws, and making budgetary adjustments accordingly, we strive to ensure that our compensation practices reflect the value we place on our associates' unique contributions and support their professional growth. 

Enhancing Lives and Building Careers

Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work and to further their professional development. Together, we are In the Network. Interested in learning more?

Take a look at our Culture, Benefits, Early Talent Program, and Additional Openings. 

Visa Sponsorship is not offered for this position. 

At Veradigm, our greatest strength comes from bringing together talented people with diverse perspectives to support the needs of healthcare providers, life science companies, health plans, and the patients they serve. The Veradigm Network is a dynamic, open community of solutions, external partners, and cutting-edge artificial intelligence technologies that provide advanced insights, technology, and data-driven solutions. Veradigm offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including holidays, vacation, medical, dental, and vision insurance, company paid life insurance and retirement savings. 

Veradigm's policy is to provide equal employment opportunity and affirmative action in all of its employment practices without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, age, individuals with disabilities, sexual orientation or gender identity or expression or any other legally protected category. Applicants for North American based positions with Veradigm must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada. Verification of employment eligibility will be required as a condition of hire. Veradigm is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse and inclusive workforce.

The Project Quality Manager has independence and authority to manage quality and nuclear safety across the project and is the key quality interface with the Customer, manages the quality and nuclear safety activities across the entire execution chain of an integrated project.

 - Define and implement a strategy, priorities, and an action plan to drive nuclear safety across the project. It needs to be in line with the organization's overall strategy and priorities. 
 - Ensure that the nuclear safety culture is deployed within the project, support its assessment and training campaigns and / or any event to promote nuclear safety (e. g. , nuclear safety moments). 
 - Ensure that ITNS-item information and data are rigorously communicated into our internal documentation (e. g. , ITPL etc. ). 
 - Contribute to quotation / negotiation from a Quality and Nuclear Safety perspective (ITO)
 - Analyze the project contractual requirements and translate them into a comprehensive project quality strategy via the PMF (Project Management File) and quality plans. 
 - Ensure project Quality induction to the entire project team. 
 - Chair the project quality kick off meeting to share issued Quality plans with the Customer for validation. 
 - Accountability for the ITPs (Inspection and Test Programs) and ensuring compliance with contract / customer expectations. 
 - Prepare and drive regular Project Quality Review (internal), Quality KPI of the Project (part of the bowler chart) and to report them to the Project Director and Quality Management. 
 - Represent Quality within the Project reviews with the Customer (external) and share remedy plans, as necessary. 
 - Establish surveillance strategy (e. g. , training, audit), based on project risk assessment. 
 - Define and deploy appropriate governance with relevant project stakeholders to regularly follow-up of project tracking. 
 - Coordinate resolution of complex Quality issues raised along project execution. 
 - Ensure plans are in place to demonstrate conformance to Technical Regulation and Standards (TRS), local regulation, and requirements (PED etc. ). Follow-up Product PQMs (internal manufacturing), Supplier Quality (external supply) during manufacturing phase and Site Quality Management during site execution. 
 - EOMR compilation and follow-up to the Customer in a timely manner (in line with master time schedule)
 - Coordinate preparation and ensure flawless execution of the Customer audits. 
 - Guide, train, support, and coach the Project team for using relevant quality tools. 
 - Support Project Management within the PEQ (Project Execution Quality) process. 
 - Support Project Management within the Customer Satisfaction process. 
 - Ensure the Non-Conformance Report (NCR) governance and interface with customers.

data.title: Lead Engineer - Process Engineering
data.description:
Within Nuclear New Build (NNB) engineering organization, the Lead Process Engineer holds full responsibility for the assigned Process Engineering scope, ensuring technical excellence, the quality of deliverables, and adherence to schedule and cost targets throughout the entire project lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities - Lead Process Engineer

As a Lead Process Engineer, you will play a central role in driving the technical execution of complex power generation projects. Your main responsibilities will include: 

Project & Contract Execution

- Represent the Process Engineering scope within the project team. 
 - Take over the project from the Tendering team, including review of the Division of Work, contract documentation, and risk log. 
 - Perform contract review, identify risks and opportunities, and propose technical deviations and clarifications to the Project Engineering Manager. 

Planning & Coordination

- Contribute to the development of the overall engineering schedule and manage the planning of Process Engineering activities. 
 - Support resource planning at both project and functional levels. 
 - Coordinate daily with other Lead Engineers (calculations, arrangement, mechanical equipment, piping & valves, electrical, etc. ). 
 - Ensure efficient communication across teams, functions, as well as with the partners and the client. 

Process Engineering Activities

- Lead and perform the following engineering tasks, supported by the team of Process engineers and internal experts: 
 - Process system design including P&IDs, System Design Manuals, control logic diagrams, management of mechanical/electrical/I&C interfaces. 
 - Nuclear safety, functional safety, and RAM (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability) studies. 
 - Manage mechanical and functional interfaces with customers and partners. 
 - Participate in technical meetings with clients and partners related to your scope. 
Quality & Compliance

- Ensure that all engineering deliverables meet contractual requirements, project standards, and internal Arabelle Solutions procedures. 
 - Guarantee timely, accurate and high‐quality information delivery to internal and external customers. 
 - Lead design reviews (mechanical process, process control, system layout), ensure timely closure of actions, manage design freeze, and apply design change processes. 

Testing, Construction Support & As-Built Documentation

- Coordinate and participate in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) for the control system. 
 - Ensure quick processing of Non‐Conformity Reports and provide support to construction and commissioning teams on site. 
 - Coordinate and deliver the Process "as‐built" documentation, and collect and share lessons learned for continuous improvement. 

Reporting

- Report operationally to the Project Engineering Manager for all project-related matters (what, when). 
 - Report functionally to your Line Manager for all other topics (how, who). 

Candidate Profile

- Engineering degree in Energy Engineering, or Fluid Mechanics, Thermodynamics. 
 - 5 years of experience in Process & Control Engineering within the energy or better power generation sector. 
 - On‐site experience, ideally a minimum of 3 months. 
 - Knowledge of the nuclear or broader energy industry. 
 - Strong understanding of multidisciplinary aspects of power plant engineering, including equipment specifications, installation, and electrical design. 
 - Knowledge of water‐steam cycles and steam turbine and generator auxiliary systems used in power plants. 
 - Proficiency with standard office software tools (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc. ). 
 - Excellent communication skills in both French and English, written and spoken. 
 - Ability to plan, organize and co-ordinate well, delegate and supervise. 
 - Ability to lead, motivate and persuade their team members, enjoys personal contact. 
 - Is "Customer Focus" minded. 
 - Ability to solve conflicts. 
 - Ready and willing to take responsibility. 
 - Ready and willing to provide good service (effort, steadiness of performance, good resilience, self-motivation). 
 - Ready and willing to accept changes (learning capability, openness to innovations, flexibility, self- criticism). 
 - Intellectually alert (Reasoning power, comprehension, creativity). 
 - Willing to travel.

At Arabelle Solutions, we know diversity makes teams and business stronger.

data.description:
Company Description Core ASIC Inc is a customer-focused VLSI design and verification services company with operations in Bengaluru, India and Austin, Texas. The company delivers complete spec-to-silicon turnkey solutions, including firmware co-development, for custom semiconductor and IoT applications. Its silicon-proven platform solutions support IP design and verification, VIP development, SoC verification, and emulation services. Core ASIC emphasizes on-time delivery, strong client collaboration, and alignment with customer vision to improve time-to-market and return on investment. A dedicated team of engineering, technology, and domain experts works as a growth partner to clients across the product development lifecycle. 

Experience: 5-10 years

Key Skills

Gate Level Simulation, SDF Annotation, Timing Verification, Low Power Verification, Debugging, Verdi, VCS, Xcelium

Detailed Job Description

Execute gate-level simulations with and without SDF, perform timing validation, low-power checks, reset verification and debug GLS failures. Analyze setup/hold violations and work closely with STA, RTL and Physical Design teams to achieve sign-off. 

Role Description The GLS Verification Engineer is responsible for gate-level simulation and verification of complex digital designs, ensuring functional correctness, timing closure, and manufacturability. Day-to-day tasks include creating and executing GLS test plans, developing verification environments and testbenches, running regressions, analyzing waveforms, and debugging failures across RTL and gate-level netlists. The role involves close collaboration with RTL design, physical design, DFT, and validation teams to resolve issues, support sign-off, and improve verification methodologies. The engineer will also contribute to documentation, process improvements, and best practices for GLS and functional verification. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru and Hyderabad

Qualifications

- Strong experience in RTL Design and Functional Verification for complex digital ASIC/SoC projects. 
 - Proficiency in Debugging simulation failures, timing issues, and gate-level mismatches. 
 - Knowledge of Validation processes and methodologies for pre-silicon and post-silicon environments. 
 - Understanding of Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) or equivalent quality and reliability standards in semiconductor development. 
 - Hands-on experience with GLS flows, STA concepts, and EDA tools (e. g. , simulation, lint, formal verification). 
 - Familiarity with Verilog/SystemVerilog, scripting languages (such as Python, Perl, or TCL), and regression automation. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to collaborate in cross-functional engineering teams. 
 - Experience in VLSI design services or semiconductor product companies is an advantage.

data.description:
About The Team

The Developer Experience (DevEx) Delivery Engineering team builds and operates Zillow's software delivery platform. This is the paved road from commit to production that every Zillow Group engineer relies on to build, test, deploy, and ship. The platform supports org-wide delivery infrastructure at meaningful scale: CI/CD, runners, GitLab, Artifactory, Progressive Delivery, mobile build and release, and legacy migration programs. We are shifting from hands-on infrastructure operations toward secure, compliant, AI-first paved paths that improve reliability, release safety, and developer productivity. 

We are standing up a new India-based team to expand capacity, enable follow-the-sun coverage, and take first-class ownership of high-impact platform initiatives. As one of the founding members, you'll help shape a brand-new engineering site while working on infrastructure that multiplies the productivity of the entire engineering organization. 

What the team works on

- GitLab (including GitLab Dedicated and Duo): operate the central source-control and CI/CD platform and enable secure, AI-assisted SDLC workflows. 
 - CI/CD runners: modernize Linux, macOS, iOS, and Android runner fleets improving isolation, queueing, and cost attribution. 
 - Progressive Delivery: scale canary, health-gated, rollback-aware deployment patterns. 
 - Artifactory and supply chain: operate a Tier-0 artifact platform and improve upgrade, backup, retention, and lifecycle practices. 
 - Migration and modernization: retire legacy CI/CD (Concrete) using dashboards, partner engagement, and agentic migration. 
 - Mobile build/release and Mobile DevOps: sustain a high release cadence while modernizing build tooling. 

Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow's mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India. 

About The Role

As the founding Principal Engineer for the India Delivery Engineering team, you'll be the technical anchor for a brand-new site and the most senior individual contributor on the team. You'll set the architecture for our most important platform systems, CI/CD execution, build and runner infrastructure, and GitLab/Artifactory integrations. Drive standards that other teams adopt, and turn India's ownership into durable technical authority through design reviews, reliability practices, and real deliverables from day one. 

This is a hands-on, high-leverage role for someone who wants to lead platform architecture and mentor a growing team while partnering closely with engineering leaders across geographies. 

What you'll do

- Set the architecture for CI/CD execution, build and runner infrastructure, GitLab/Artifactory integrations, and the paved paths all Zillow engineers use. 
 - Drive patterns and standards that other teams adopt, acting as design authority for India-owned areas in partnership with senior engineers across the org. 
 - Take the most ambiguous components from problem framing to production-ready, observable, well-documented systems. 
 - Hire and mentor engineers, raise the quality of code and design reviews, and help set the team's engineering standards. 
 - Lead the safe adoption of AI across migration, code review, platform operations, incident triage, and rollout guidance. 
 - Shape on-call maturity, SLOs, incident response, runbooks, and reliability practices for the team's services. 
 - Write clear design docs and distill complex platform tradeoffs for engineers, managers, partner teams, and executives across geographies

This role has been categorized as an Office position. "Office" employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute. 

In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. 

Who you are

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, with extensive experience in large-scale CI/CD, build/runner infrastructure, cloud-native platform engineering, developer-productivity tooling, or SRE/platform systems. 
 - Deep system design and architecture judgment for scalable, reliable, maintainable systems, with strong testability, resilience, security, and observability practices. 
 - Technical leadership and influence without direct authority, with a proven ability to align multiple teams on standards and tradeoffs. 
 - Production ownership: incident response, on-call, operational debugging, capacity planning, and post-incident prevention. 
 - Strong programming fundamentals in Python, Java, Go, or similar; able to review code, debug systems, and reason about performance and concurrency. 
 - Hands-on or deep conceptual experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, containers, CI/CD platforms, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Exceptional written communication: design docs, strategy docs, decision records, rollout plans, and executive-ready tradeoff summaries. 
 - Comfort operating async-first across US-India time zones and helping build a new engineering culture. 

Bonus points

- Depth in GitLab (including GitLab Dedicated and Duo), runner fleets, or Artifactory. 
 - Experience with SaltStack, Ansible, Puppet, or comparable automation tooling. 
 - Mobile build infrastructure experience (iOS or Android). 
 - Prior experience applying AI in the software development lifecycle. 
 - Experience founding or scaling a new site or distributed engineering team. 

Why join

- Founding role: shape a new India engineering site and help set the technical and cultural bar from day one. 
 - High leverage: work on the platform used by every Zillow engineer and every major product surface. 
 - Modernization agenda: GitLab Dedicated, runner rearchitecture, Progressive Delivery, Artifactory modernization, and legacy retirement. 
 - AI-first work: real production use cases across code review, migrations, incident analysis, and deployment safety. 
 - Global collaboration: partner directly with US engineering leaders while building durable India ownership. 

Get to know us

At Zillow, we're reimagining how people move-through the real estate market and through their careers. 

As the most-visited real estate platform in the U. S. , Zillow helps millions of customers navigate buying, selling, financing, and renting with greater ease and confidence. Our teams in India play a critical role in building and scaling the technology, products, and operations that power this experience. 

Whether you're working in tech, operations, or shared services, you'll collaborate with global partners to solve meaningful problems and help more people make home a reality. 

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U. S. . Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. 

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry-and your career-forward, together.

data.title: Quality Assurance Manager (Python and selenium)
data.description:
We are looking for a QA Manager to own the QA function across Arcitech's product portfolio. This is the senior-most QA seat in the organization. You will set QA strategy across products, manage a team of 8-12 QA engineers (including the QA Lead who owns hands-on senior QA beneath you), run QA across 7-8 concurrent projects, and be the QA counterpart to product and engineering leadership. Reporting directly to the CEO, you are accountable for the release-readiness of everything Arcitech ships. 

This is a management role, not primarily a hands-on IC role. You are the strategist, the reviewer, and the leader of the function. Hands-on senior QA - designing frameworks, running performance tests, writing critical automation - sits with the QA Lead beneath you; your job is to set direction, hold the bar, grow the team, and represent QA at the leadership table. That said, on the hardest technical problems and the highest-risk releases, you will still be hands-on - particularly on new-product launches and cross-product testing initiatives. Prior experience running QA at a SaaS / IT product company is non-negotiable. Prior experience genuinely managing a QA team of 8+ is non-negotiable. This is a role for someone who has already done this work before, not someone stepping up into it for the first time. 

You will report directly to the CEO. 

Key Responsibilities

QA Strategy & Direction

• Own the QA vision and strategy across the SaaS portfolio. 

• Define what gets tested manually, what gets automated, and what needs performance testing - per product, per release. 

• Own release-readiness decisions in partnership with product and engineering leadership. 

• Set priorities across 7-8 concurrent projects; make trade-offs on coverage vs speed explicit. 

Team Management

• Manage a team of 8-12 QA engineers, including the QA Lead as your direct report. 

• Set clear expectations, run 1: 1s and reviews, and own performance conversations end-to-end. 

• Grow the team's technical depth in manual, Python + Selenium automation, and performance testing. 

• Own hiring for the QA team - who joins, at what level, and how they ramp up. 

• Develop the QA Lead specifically as a senior report with their own career growth needs. 

Quality Bar & Review

• Define and hold the QA quality bar across the whole function. 

• Review the QA Lead's work and the wider team's work on strategic / high-stakes releases; catch issues before ship. 

• Own QA process, documentation, and best practices across the SaaS portfolio. 

• Set the standard through your own review - not by out-executing the Lead. 

Cross-Team Leadership & Business Communication

• Partner with engineering and product leadership on release scope, quality trade-offs, and CI/CD integration. 

• Represent QA to the CEO and leadership clearly - what's shipping, what's at risk, what needs decisions. 

• Communicate quality risks in business terms, not QA jargon - impact, likelihood, mitigation, cost. 

• Coordinate with DevOps on CI/CD integration of automated tests across products. 

Hands-On QA (Selective)

• Personally own the hardest technical problems on high-risk releases when it matters. 

• Design or review critical automation frameworks and performance test strategies for new-product launches. 

• Delegate day-to-day execution to the Lead and the team - stay in strategy and review mode by default. 

Required Skills & Experience

• Experience: 6+ years in QA, with at least 3 years in a QA management role

• Team management (must-have, non-negotiable): proven experience managing a QA team of

8+, including at least 2+ years directly leading a team - real people-management with 1: 1s, 

reviews, hiring, and performance calls; not just informal mentoring

• SaaS / IT product background (must-have, non-negotiable): prior QA leadership at a

technology / SaaS / IT product company

• Manual QA depth (must-have): 6+ years of hands-on manual QA experience - deep, thorough

process across test planning, execution, defect management, no shortcuts

• Automation (must-have): 3+ years minimum, hands-on Python + Selenium (not Java). Real

frameworks you have built and led teams to build. 

• Performance testing (must-have): hands-on with performance / load testing tools (JMeter, 

Locust, K6, or similar); can design, run, analyze

• QA strategy (must-have): genuine experience setting QA direction across multiple products or

product lines

• Multi-project (must-have): proven ability to run QA across 7-8 concurrent projects without

dropping quality

• CI/CD integration: hands-on with CI/CD integration of QA (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI); 

driven CI adoption at team level

• Communication: clear, senior communicator; can represent QA to the CEO and cross-functional

leadership

Nice to Have

• API testing depth (Postman, REST Assured with Python). 

• SQL / database validation experience. 

• Experience testing AI-driven products or non-deterministic outputs. 

• Exposure to security-testing basics. 

• Prior experience defining or scaling a QA function from small to mid-size. 

• Experience with observability / monitoring integration for post-release quality signal. 

The Ideal Candidate

• Has genuinely managed a QA team of 8+, and can point to what specifically improved under their

leadership. 

• Has worked inside a technology / SaaS / IT product company for a meaningful part of their career. 

• Is strong across all three testing disciplines - manual, automation, and performance - not just

one. 

• Can balance strategy, review, team management, and selective hands-on work. 

• Communicates well with the CEO and leadership; represents QA as a business function, not a

purely technical one. 

• Runs a QA function with process and craft, not chaos and heroics.

A new regulatory change lands somewhere in the world every six minutes, and agentic AI is outpacing most teams' ability to govern it. At Archer, we help the enterprises powering the global economy turn that pressure into an advantage.

As a Senior Quality Engineer, you will be responsible for elevating product quality through intelligent test strategies, automation, continuous validation, performance engineering, and close partnership with engineering and product teams. You'll help teams identify risks early, find defects quickly, and ensure every release meets high standards for functionality, performance, security, and reliability. Test Automation Excellence

Performance Engineering & Reliability

Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution

What You Bring

data.description:
About Refold AI

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days.
