I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge. 

Job Description: 

The Future Begins Here: 

At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet. 

Bengaluru, the city, which is India's epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda's recently launched Innovation Capability Center. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement. 

At Takeda's ICC we Unite in Diversity: 

Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team

OBJECTIVES/PURPOSE: 

- Support the realization of MGO strategy and the broader Medical Operating System by translating approved governance and operating-model requirements into clear, documented, and practical processes that teams can implement, follow, monitor, and improve. 
 - Lead the operational design and improvement of priority Medical processes supporting the Medical Governance Office and other assigned Global Medical areas, making them clear, consistent, and easy to follow. 
 - Work directly with the Head, Medical Governance Office and relevant MGO capability leads to translate approved requirements into workable processes with clear steps, responsibilities, approvals, checks, handoffs, documentation, and escalation routes. 
 - Review existing ways of working, remove unnecessary complexity and duplication, close process gaps, and coordinate the implementation of agreed improvements. 
 - Document and maintain the Medical execution model, showing how work is carried out through end-to-end processes, roles, decision rights, governance forums, approvals, handoffs, systems, documents, measures, and escalation routes. 

ACCOUNTABILITIES: 

Make Processes Clear and Workable: 

- Review priority processes with the people who own and use them. Understand the current steps, pain points, interdependencies, delays, unclear responsibilities, repeated work, and areas where requirements are not being applied consistently. 
 - Support enterprise alignment on the role of vendors and digital enablers, including AI, within governed workflows. 
 - Working with MGO capability leads and accountable process owners, design or update clear end-to-end processes based on approved requirements. Show what needs to happen, who is responsible, what decisions or approvals are required, which systems and documents are used, and when an issue must be escalated. 
 - Help global, regional, local, and Bengaluru teams understand and adopt new or updated processes and monitor whether those processes are working as intended. 
 - Simplify processes wherever possible by removing unnecessary steps, reducing duplication, improving handoffs, and clarifying responsibilities. 
 - Support consistent global ways of working while ensuring that valid local legal, regulatory, or business requirements are clearly identified and documented. 
 - Work with the relevant document owners and the Medical Data Governance & Knowledge Management Lead to ensure that process maps, SOPs, procedures, templates, checklists, training materials, and supporting guidance are aligned, current, and easy to find. 
 - Work with MGO and Medical Excellence & Operations to ensure that assigned processes align with the Medical Operating System and that gaps, overlaps, unclear ownership, or broken handoffs are identified and addressed. 
 - Ensure that approved changes to processes, roles, governance, systems, or responsibilities are reflected in the Medical execution model and communicated to affected global, regional, local, and Bengaluru teams. 

Work Directly with MGO and Accountable Process Owners: 

- Receive functional direction from the Head, Medical Governance Office on MGO priorities and expected outcomes. Agree the scope, workplan, deliverables, timelines, and escalation needs for assigned processes, and reflect approved requirements in the Medical execution model. 
 - Partner with MGO capability leads and the accountable owner of each Medical activity to translate approved governance requirements into practical ways of working. 
 - Help clarify process ownership, responsibilities, decision points, approvals, and final accountability, and support the agreed process design and implementation. 
 - Bring together the appropriate partners, including Quality, Ethics & Compliance, Legal, Privacy, DD&T, Finance, Procurement, Medical Excellence & Operations, regions, and local teams, when their input or approval is required. 
 - Facilitate process discussions and working sessions, document agreed decisions, follow up on open actions, and escalate unresolved questions to MGO or the appropriate accountable owner. 

Implement and Improve Processes: 

- Support the introduction of new or updated processes through clear implementation plans, communication, training, readiness checks, launch support, and follow-up after implementation. 
 - Monitor a small set of practical measures, such as timeliness, delays, rework, overdue actions, exceptions, user feedback, and repeated process issues, to understand whether each process is working effectively. 
 - Lead reviews of recurring process problems, identify the underlying cause, agree practical improvements with the responsible owners, and track those improvements through completion. 
 - Identify opportunities for simple workflow tools or automation where they will reduce manual effort, improve consistency, or make the process easier to follow. Partner with DD&T and system owners on any technology changes. 

DIMENSIONS AND ASPECTS: 

Technical/Functional Expertise: 

- Strong understanding of how to review, design, document, implement, and improve end-to-end processes in a regulated environment. 
 - Good knowledge of Medical Affairs operations and governance processes, including the relationship between policies, SOPs, procedures, roles, approvals, systems, records, training, and day-to-day execution. 
 - Good understanding of operating models and execution models, including how roles, decision rights, governance forums, processes, systems, measures, and handoffs work together. 
 - Ability to take complex or unclear requirements and turn them into simple, practical ways of working that people can understand and follow. 
 - Understands the difference between designing and supporting a process and owning the final governance, scientific, compliance, legal, financial, or business decision. 

Leadership: 

- Leads cross-functional discussions and helps stakeholders reach clear and practical decisions. 
 - Constructively challenges unnecessary complexity, unclear responsibilities, inefficient ways of working, and repeated activities. 
 - Influences stakeholders across functions and geographies without relying only on formal authority. 
 - Maintains momentum by ensuring that decisions are documented, responsibilities are clear, and agreed actions are completed. 

Decision-Making and Autonomy: 

- Accountable for the operational approach used to review, design, document, implement, and improve processes within the approved scope. 
 - Makes recommendations on how a process should work, how responsibilities should be divided, and how operational process issues should be resolved. 
 - Makes operational decisions within approved governance requirements and agreed decision boundaries. 
 - Escalates decisions that involve governance direction, policy interpretation, Medical or scientific judgment, Quality, Ethics & Compliance, Legal, Privacy, Finance, technology ownership, or business accountability. 
 - Final governance requirements and decisions remain with MGO or the relevant accountable functional owner. 

Interaction: 

- Works directly with the Head, Medical Governance Office and relevant MGO leads to translate approved MGO requirements into the documented Medical execution model and practical ways of working, monitor progress, and escalate significant process issues. 
 - Works closely with MGO capability leads and the accountable owners of Medical activities to design, implement, and improve the processes supporting their areas. 
 - Maintains close alignment with the GCM Medical Operations & Governance Lead as the formal line manager and regarding Bengaluru priorities, resources, and cross-team dependencies. 
 - Partners closely with the Medical Data Governance & Knowledge Management Lead to ensure that process documents, definitions, records, and supporting knowledge remain aligned. 
 - Collaborates with Audit, Inspection Readiness & Risk Management, Medical Excellence & Operations, Quality, Ethics & Compliance, Legal, Privacy, DD&T, Finance, Procurement, and global, regional, and local Medical teams. 

Innovation: 

- Looks for practical ways to make processes easier, faster, and more consistent. 
 - Uses digital tools, workflow solutions, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities where they solve a clear process need and can be introduced with appropriate controls and oversight. 
 - Avoids automating an unclear or unnecessarily complex process before the process itself has been clarified and simplified. 

Complexity: 

- Works across different Medical activities, functions, systems, regions, and local organizations. 
 - Balances the need for consistent global processes with valid local legal, regulatory, or business requirements. 
 - Manages situations where responsibilities, requirements, or handoffs may initially be unclear and helps the appropriate owners reach agreement. 
 - Supports consistent implementation without taking ownership of governance strategy, policy requirements, or the final decisions of MGO and other accountable functions. 

EDUCATION, BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS: 

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in life sciences, business, operations, quality, healthcare administration, engineering, or a related discipline is required. 
 - An advanced degree or relevant certification in process improvement, change management, quality, or project management is preferred but not required. 

Experience: 

- Eight or more years of relevant professional experience, including at least four years in the biopharmaceutical, healthcare, or another regulated industry. 
 - Experience reviewing, designing, improving, or implementing cross-functional processes. 
 - Experience in Medical Affairs operations, Medical governance, quality, compliance, business operations, process improvement, or a related area. 
 - Experience working with global, regional, and local stakeholders in a matrixed organization. 
 - Experience supporting the implementation of new processes, organizational change, centralization, or the transition of activities to a global capability center is preferred. 
 - Experience leading cross-functional work, projects, or senior individual contributors is preferred. 

Skills: 

- Ability to understand and clearly describe an end-to-end process. 
 - Ability to identify unnecessary steps, duplication, delays, unclear responsibilities, missing checks, and difficult handoffs. 
 - Ability to create clear process maps, role descriptions, procedures, templates, checklists, training materials, and implementation plans. 
 - Strong facilitation skills and the ability to guide stakeholders toward clear and practical decisions. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn recurring issues into practical improvements. 
 - Ability to use simple measures and stakeholder feedback to assess whether a process is working effectively. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complicated topics in clear language. 

Behavioural Competencies: 

- Practical and solutions-oriented, with a strong focus on making processes usable for the people who need to follow them. 
 - Comfortable asking questions, challenging unnecessary complexity, and clarifying unclear responsibilities. 
 - Collaborative and respectful, while able to hold stakeholders accountable for agreed decisions and actions. 
 - Organized, reliable, and able to follow work through from initial review to implementation and ongoing improvement. 
 - Demonstrates sound judgment and knows when a question must be escalated to MGO or another accountable function. 

Languages: 

Fluent English required; additional languages advantageous. 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: 

- Formal line reporting is to the GCM Medical Operations & Governance Lead. 
 - For MGO-assigned scope, the role works directly with the Head, Medical Governance Office, who provides functional direction on priorities, approved requirements, expected outcomes, workplans, and escalation of significant process matters. 
 - The role supports the realization of MGO strategy and the Medical Operating System by turning approved governance and operating-model requirements into the documented Medical execution model and clear, practical processes; coordinating implementation; monitoring how processes work; and leading agreed improvements. 
 - MGO and the relevant accountable process owners retain responsibility for governance direction, policy requirements, and final business or functional decisions. 
 - The role does not replace the responsibilities of Quality, Ethics & Compliance, Legal, Privacy, Finance, DD&T, Audit and Inspection Readiness, or other accountable functions. 

BENEFITS: 

It is our priority to provide competitive compensation and a benefit package that bridges your personal life with your professional career. Amongst our benefits are

- Competitive Salary + Performance Annual Bonus
 - Flexible work environment, including hybrid working
 - Comprehensive Healthcare Insurance Plans for self, spouse, and children
 - Group Term Life Insurance and Group Accident Insurance programs
 - Employee Assistance Program
 - Broad Variety of learning platforms
 - Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Programs
 - Reimbursements - Home Internet & Mobile Phone
 - Employee Referral Program
 - Leaves - Paternity Leave (4 Weeks) , Maternity Leave (up to 26 weeks), Bereavement Leave (5 calendar days)

ABOUT ICC IN TAKEDA: 

- Takeda is leading a digital revolution. We're not just transforming our company; we're improving the lives of millions of patients who rely on our medicines every day. 
 - As an organization, we are committed to our cloud-driven business transformation and believe the ICCs are the catalysts of change for our global organization.

data.description:
What You'll Do

Avalara is modernizing its global registration, licensing, and compliance platforms to make complex tax and regulatory work faster, more scalable, and easier for customers to navigate. As Principal Engineer, you will lead the architecture for cloud-native, compliance-critical platforms that support automation, workflow orchestration, intelligent decisioning, and reusable shared services. You will work across product, engineering, operations, and design to turn business strategy into reliable platform capabilities with measurable customer and operational impact. You will report to the VP of Engineering. This is a fully remote role. 

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

- Shape architecture for a cloud-native, jurisdiction-aware platform supporting global registration, licensing, and compliance services. 
 - Lead modernization work that consolidates shared capabilities, decouples user experiences, and improves platform scalability. 
 - Architect rules engines, decision systems, and workflow orchestration for long-running compliance operations. 
 - Design systems that use AI-assisted automation responsibly, with human oversight, explainability, auditability, privacy, and operational control. 
 - Establish scalable data models, governance strategies, and integration patterns for complex regulatory and licensing data. 
 - Partner with product, engineering, operations, and design teams to deliver platform capabilities that improve customer outcomes. 
 - Set standards for performance, reliability, security, observability, resiliency, and operational excellence. 
 - Lead architectural reviews, technical strategy discussions, and design decisions across multiple engineering teams. 
 - Find and address scalability risks, technical debt, reliability concerns, and performance bottlenecks before they affect customers. 
 - Mentor engineers and promote high standards for ownership, simplification, AI-enabled engineering practices, and long-term platform sustainability. 

What You'll Need To Be Successful

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science Engineering
 - 15+ years of software engineering experience, including enterprise-scale platform architecture, modernization, and distributed cloud-native systems. 
 - Experience designing, scaling, and operating cloud-native software-as-a-service platforms, including hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services, continuous integration and delivery, infrastructure automation, and modern DevOps practices. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy or fragmented platforms into scalable shared-service architectures. 
 - Experience building rules-based, policy-driven, workflow, or compliance-oriented systems that require auditability, traceability, security, privacy, and regulatory control. 
 - Demonstrated applied AI experience, including responsible use of large language models, agents, intelligent decisioning, or workflow automation to improve engineering, operational, or customer outcomes. 

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability. 

- You'll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here. 
 - You'll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers. 
 - You'll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too. 

How We'll Take Care Of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses. 

Health & Wellness

Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance. 

Inclusive culture and diversity

Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship. 

What You Need To Know About Avalara

We're defining the relationship between tax and tech. 

We've already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6. 6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we're not slowing down until we've achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world. 

We're bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we've designed, that empowers our people to win. We've been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too. 

We're An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company - we don't want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. data.description:
At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence. 

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 

Join EY and help to build a better working world. 

EY Job Description

Job Title: Engineering Lead - AI

Job Rank (must note a single rank only for each job description): Associate Director

Function: EY Technology - Enterprise Technology

Scope (indicate either "global/cross-border" or "local/country"): Global

Sub Function: EY Technology | CBS Technology | Intelligent Automation

Reports to (Job Title): Service Delivery Lead: AI & Automation

Job Summary: 

The Engineering Lead is responsible for hands-on engineering delivery of enterprise AI/ML/GenAI and automation solutions, coding standards, design patterns, ensuring production-grade security, scalability, reliability, and supportability. It is not a solution advisory, PoC, or platform administration role. Success is measured by the quality, reliability, scalability, and operability of AI systems in production. 

Operating as a player-coach, the Engineering Lead works alongside AI Engineers to design and build ML Models, LLM pipelines and agentic workflows, while also setting engineering standards, coaching teams, and ensuring delivery. 

The ideal candidate will possess: 

- Extensive, hands-on software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and operating complex systems in production environments. 
 - Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, business-relevant outcomes. 
 - Ability to independently design and code across multiple technical components, while guiding and elevating the work of senior engineers. 
 - Deep technical expertise across the full stack, including cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, and data-intensive platforms. 
 - Strong command of non-functional requirements, including reliability, availability, scalability, performance, and cost optimization, and the ability to make sound technology and architecture decisions as systems evolve over time. 
 - Demonstrated experience delivering production-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, including: 
 - LLM-powered applications and services
 - Agentic workflows and orchestration frameworks
 - Model integration, evaluation, and lifecycle management
 - MLOps / LLMOps pipelines and operational practices
 - Proven experience partnering with Data Science and AI Research teams to operationalize models and AI capabilities at enterprise scale. 
 - Ability to drive the design and delivery of AI-first architectures, including LLM-powered services, agentic workflows, orchestration layers, and human-in-the-loop systems. 
 - Experience building robust data and software foundations that enable advanced analytics, real-time AI inference, and intelligent decisioning at scale. 

Essential Functions of the Job: 

- Engineering Ownership & Delivery Accountability
 - Own end-to-end technical delivery of AI and GenAI solutions-from design through production and BAU support. 
 - Act as the technical authority for the build team, accountable for: 
 - Code quality and engineering standards
 - Security, privacy, and compliance
 - Reliability, scalability, performance, and cost
 - Operational readiness and supportability
 - Make hard engineering trade-offs balancing latency, accuracy, cost, reliability, and scale. 
 - Own production systems post go-live, including incident analysis, performance tuning, and architectural evolution. 
 - Hands-on GenAI & AI Systems Engineering
 - 
 - Collaborate with solution architecture on design and own build production-grade GenAI systems, including: 
 - Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines
 - Agentic workflows and tool-based orchestration
 - Prompt pipelines, routing, and integration layers
 - Human-in-the-loop and safety guardrails
 - Work shoulder-to-shoulder with AI Engineers and Data Scientists to: 
 - Productionize models and LLM pipelines
 - Implement evaluation, monitoring, and observability
 - Optimize inference cost, performance, and reliability
 - Ensure experimental AI capabilities are engineered into real systems, not isolated prototypes. 
 - Architecture & Engineering Standards
 - Define and enforce reference architectures and engineering standards for AI and GenAI systems. 
 - Drive consistent adoption of: 
 - Clean and modular architecture patterns
 - Reusable components and shared frameworks
 - CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud-native practices
 - Partner with architecture, platform, security, and data teams while retaining final accountability for build quality. 
 - AI Platform Engineering & MLOps / LLMOps
 - Build and evolve AI platforms that support: 
 - Model lifecycle management
 - LLMOps / MLOps pipelines
 - Evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection
 - Secure access, auditability, and governance
 - Ensure AI systems meet enterprise non-functional requirements over time, not just at launch. 
 - Team Leadership & Capability Building
 - Lead and grow a team of senior engineers within the AI & Automation build function. 
 - Coach engineers on: 
 - Backend and distributed systems engineering
 - GenAI application design and implementation
 - Writing maintainable, testable, production-quality code
 - Set a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, rigor, and continuous improvement. 
 - Support hiring and skills development aligned to future AI engineering needs. 
 - Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration
 - Partner closely with: 
 - AI/ML Engineering and Data Science teams
 - Platform, security, and operations teams
 - Architecture and governance forums
 - Translate business and functional requirements into robust technical designs. 
 - Act as a senior technical voice in design authorities and delivery governance. 
Engineering Expectations (Non Negotiable)

- Has built and operated complex, distributed backend systems in production. 
 - Comfortable debugging production incidents involving AI/LLM pipelines. 
 - Writes, reviews, and maintains production-quality code, not just prototypes. 
 - Understands failure modes of AI systems and designs for resilience. 
 - Takes ownership for systems after go-live, including reliability and cost optimization. 

Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities: 

This role is critical to ensuring the enterprise's AI ambition translates into real, reliable, and scalable systems-not just innovation theater. You will define how AI is built, shipped, and operated across the organization. 

Knowledge and Skills Requirements: 

Core Engineering Skills

- Strong hands-on experience in Python, Java, C#, or similar backend languages. 
 - Proven experience building API-driven, cloud-native systems. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and reliability patterns. 

GenAI / AI Engineering (Essential)

- Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, including: 
 - RAG pipelines
 - Agentic or tool-augmented workflows
 - Prompt orchestration and integration layers
 - Experience with: 
 - Vector databases and embeddings
 - LLM evaluation, observability, and monitoring
 - Guardrails, safety, and cost controls
 - Experience operationalizing AI models at scale in enterprise environments. 

Nice to Have (Not Core Identity)

- Experience integrating AI services into enterprise automation platforms (e. g. , Power Platform, ServiceNow). 
 - Familiarity with Azure AI services and data platforms. 

Detailed Responsibilities: 

- Solution Development: Design, develop, and implement automation solutions using Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and ServiceNow. Create custom workflows, forms, and applications to automate business processes and enhance user experience. 
 - Integration Management: Integrate Microsoft and ServiceNow platforms with other enterprise applications using APIs, web services, and middleware. Ensure seamless data flow between systems and maintain data integrity across integrated applications. 
 - Testing and Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough testing of automation solutions to ensure functionality, performance, and compliance with business requirements. Implement best practices for code quality, documentation, and version control. 
 - Observability and Maintenance: Monitor the performance of automation solutions and troubleshoot issues as they arise. Perform regular maintenance and updates to ensure optimal functionality and security of automation applications. 
 - Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for automation solutions, including design specifications, user guides, and technical manuals. Document processes, workflows, and integration points for future reference and knowledge transfer. 
 - User Training and Support: Provide training and support to end-users and team members on automation tools and processes. Develop training materials and conduct workshops to facilitate user adoption of automation solutions. 
 - Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, project managers, and IT staff, to ensure alignment on automation initiatives. Engage with stakeholders to gather feedback and make necessary adjustments to automation solutions. 
 - Performance Metrics and Reporting: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of automation solutions. Generate reports and dashboards to communicate the impact of automation on business processes and operational efficiency. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on the latest trends and advancements in automation, AI, and relevant technologies. Identify areas for continuous improvement and propose enhancements to existing automation solutions. 
 - Governance and Compliance: Ensure that automation solutions adhere to organizational policies, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements. Participate in risk assessments and audits related to automation initiatives. 
 - Innovation and Research: Explore and evaluate new technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance automation capabilities. Conduct research on industry best practices and competitor strategies to inform decision-making and innovation. 
 - Change Management: Analyze the impact of automation on organizational processes and culture, making recommendations for change management strategies. Assist in developing communication plans to inform stakeholders about automation initiatives and their benefits. 

Other Requirements: 

- Familiarity with Python practices and tools. 
 - Strong communication, stakeholder management and influence
 - Strong leadership and conflict resolution capability
 - Leading virtual teams

Job Requirements: 

Education: 

- A degree in Computer Science / Engineering or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience

Experience: 

- 10+ years in a Global IT environment working with multiple disciplines to deliver projects in line with customer needs
 - 3+ Years Global delivery or transformation preferably in large scale infrastructure programs
 - 3+ Years in a global operations environment

Certification Requirements: 

- Relevant certifications in MS Power Platform and ServiceNow RPA
 - Python Certification
 - Azure AI Services
 - Azure Data Services

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets. 

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. 

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

data.description:

What We Offer

At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are. 

Group Summary

Magna is more than one of the world's largest suppliers in the automotive space. We are a mobility technology company built to innovate, with a global, entrepreneurial-minded team. With 65+ years of expertise, our ecosystem of interconnected products combined with our complete vehicle expertise uniquely positions us to advance mobility in an expanded transportation landscape. 

Job Responsibilities

Magna is seeking a skilled and forward-thinking AI Developer, RPA & Testing to join our Intelligent Automation and Testing organization. This role will play a key part in designing and implementing AI-driven solutions that elevate automation, improve testing efficiency, and strengthen decision support across HR, Payroll, and Finance functions. 

As part of the Intelligent Automation team, you will collaborate closely with test automation engineers, RPA developers, business analysts, and business stakeholders to build AI-enabled prototypes and production-ready solutions. You will leverage Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Databricks, and enterprise APIs to create scalable, secure, and maintainable AI components that transform how data, workflows, and quality processes operate across the organization. 

This position is ideal for candidates who enjoy combining AI/ML, automation, and modern software engineering to deliver real-world business impact. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain AI-powered solutions, prototypes, and POCs using Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI services, and Copilot Studio. 
 - Integrate AI capabilities into RPA workflows and test automation frameworks, supporting automation developers and QA engineers. 
 - Build data processing, orchestration, and integration logic using Python and/or C#, following clean coding and modular design principles. 
 - Work with Databricks, SQL, Microsoft Fabric and data pipelines to prepare, transform, and analyze datasets from HR, Payroll, and Finance systems. 
 - Connect AI components with enterprise applications using REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and secure integration patterns. 
 - Apply best practices in prompt engineering, model tuning, and evaluation to improve solution accuracy, safety, and relevance. 
 - Implement comprehensive logging, monitoring, observability, and testing (unit, integration, functional) across AI and automation flows. 
 - Ensure solutions adhere to internal standards for security, privacy, compliance, and data governance, particularly for sensitive HR/Payroll data. 
 - Participate in requirements gathering, technical design sessions, sprint planning, and review ceremonies, providing technical leadership and estimates. 
 - Document solution designs, architecture decisions, and operational/handover materials for support and maintenance teams. 
 - Stay current with emerging AI, automation, and testing capabilities across Azure AI, Copilot Studio, Databricks, and Power Platform. 
 - Contribute to building a library of reusable AI components, prompt templates, best practices, and internal accelerators. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or related field; or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5-7 years of hands-on experience in software development, AI/ML engineering, data engineering, or intelligent automation. 
 - Practical experience building solutions with Azure-based AI services (Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, or similar). 
 - Experience using Copilot Studio, Power Platform, or similar chatbot/automation technologies to build AI copilots or automated workflows. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python and/or C#, including writing clean, maintainable, and testable code. 
 - Solid understanding of SQL and relational databases, with experience writing complex queries and optimizing data interactions. 
 - Experience integrating solutions using REST APIs (authentication, error handling, JSON processing). 
 - Understanding of RPA or test automation tools and concepts (e. g. , UiPath, Power Automate, Selenium, Playwright, etc. ). 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a track record of turning business requirements into technical AI/automation solutions. 
 - Effective communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in cross-functional teams (HR, Payroll, Finance, IT). 

Nice-to-Have / Preferred Skills

- Hands-on experience with Databricks/Microsoft Fabric for data engineering, ML, or analytics workloads. 
 - Experience building solutions using LLMs, advanced prompt engineering, or model evaluation methodologies. 
 - Understanding of DevOps practices, including CI/CD, deployment pipelines, and environment/configuration management. 
 - Knowledge of test automation best practices, test strategy, regression testing, or quality engineering methodologies. 
 - Exposure to enterprise systems such as Workday, SAP, Oracle HR/Finance, or similar platforms. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments. 
 - Professional certifications in Azure AI, Azure Data, Databricks, RPA tools, or AI/ML engineering. 

Awareness, Unity, Empowerment

At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That's why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law. 

AI-Assisted Screening Disclosure

As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. Final decisions are always made by the hiring manager and the hiring team. Importantly, no applicant data is shared externally through these AI tools. All information remains securely within our systems and is handled in accordance with our privacy and data protection policies. 

Under conditions defined by applicable law, you may have the right to request an explanation of how AI is used to support decision-making. 

If you have any questions or concerns about this process, feel free to contact our Talent Attraction team.

data.title: Senior Software Test Engineer
data.description:
Senior Test Engineer

Suportra AI Solutions | Kochi, Kerala, India | Full-time | Hybrid

About Suportra AI Solutions

Suportra AI Solutions is an AI delivery and consulting company based in Kerala, India. We work with founders, enterprise leaders, and growth-focused businesses across India, Europe, the USA, and the DACH region to build AI-powered solutions that are practical, well-governed, and genuinely useful. 

Our core services span AI strategy and governance, AI pipeline and LLM integration, intelligent automation, enterprise software delivery, and blockchain-based real-world asset tokenization. We partner closely with clients from first conversation through to final outcomes, and delivery quality is something we take personally. 

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Test Engineer with 5 to 7 years of experience who can own quality across our AI, software, and technology engagements. This is a hybrid role based in Kochi, combining structured test planning with hands-on automation work. 

You will work closely with developers, product managers, and delivery leads to embed quality at every stage of the software lifecycle, not just at the end. You bring both the discipline of manual testing and the engineering fluency to build and maintain robust automation frameworks. In a team delivering AI-integrated and enterprise-grade software, your work ensures that what we ship to clients is reliable, accurate, and production-ready. 

What You Will Do

- Design, write, and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts for web, mobile, and API-based software products
 - Build and maintain automation frameworks and test suites using industry-standard tools
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, performance, and exploratory testing across product releases
 - Test AI-integrated features and pipelines, including LLM outputs, automation workflows, and data-driven components
 - Collaborate with developers to integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and shift quality left in the delivery process
 - Identify, document, and track defects clearly, working with the development team to ensure timely resolution
 - Define and maintain test environments, test data, and coverage metrics
 - Contribute to test strategy discussions and help establish quality standards across projects
 - Review requirements and user stories to identify testability gaps and raise concerns early
 - Support UAT with clients and document acceptance criteria outcomes
 - Mentor junior QA team members where relevant and contribute to process improvement initiatives

What We Are Looking For

Essential

- 5 to 7 years of experience in software testing, with a strong combination of manual and automation skills
 - Solid hands-on experience with automation frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, or equivalent
 - Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language used for test automation, such as Python, JavaScript, or Java
 - Experience testing REST APIs using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, or similar
 - Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile or Scrum delivery methodologies
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests into build workflows (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar)
 - Ability to write clear, structured test plans, test cases, and defect reports
 - Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as Jira, TestRail, or equivalent
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail in identifying edge cases and failure modes
 - Good written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with development and client teams
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Advantageous

- Experience testing AI-powered features, LLM integrations, or intelligent automation workflows
 - Familiarity with performance or load testing tools such as JMeter or k6
 - Exposure to blockchain, Web3, or fintech product testing
 - Experience working with distributed teams across time zones
 - ISTQB certification or equivalent quality assurance qualification

What We Offer

- Work on diverse, technically interesting projects spanning AI, enterprise software, and blockchain
 - A delivery-focused team that values quality as a first-class concern, not an afterthought
 - Exposure to AI-integrated products and emerging technology domains
 - Opportunity to work on engagements with international clients across India, Europe, and the DACH region
 - Hybrid flexibility with a base in Kochi

How to Apply

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. 

Send your CV along with a brief note on a testing challenge you've solved, automation, a tricky edge case, or a process you improved to hello@suportra. com with the subject line "Senior Test Engineer Application".

About Clean Harbors

Clean Harbors Inc. (www. cleanharbors. com) is a NYSE listed US based $4. 3 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim, who today remains the company's Chairman and CEO. 

Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 18, 000 employees and has over 450 service locations across the U. S. , Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300, 000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment. 

Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Identity Security Posture Management (ISPM)
data.description:
With identity now serving as the main attack vector for modern enterprises, having complete visibility to understand every identity in your environment and proactively eliminate risk before it's exploited is more essential than ever. As one of Abnormal's fastest-growing divisions, ISPM is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to drive the technical roadmap and guide an engineering team in developing the next generation of identity security defenses. 

About The Role

This is a hands-on technical leadership role at the intersection of identity security and distributed systems engineering. You'll write code, design systems, set technical standards, and mentor engineers - while partnering closely with Product Management to define what we build next. 

You'll own the full stack: backend services that continuously evaluate millions of identity configurations, a frontend used daily by enterprise security teams, and the data infrastructure that powers posture scoring and proactive risk remediation. 

What You'll Do

Technical Strategy & Leadership

- Direct the ISPM technical roadmap by converting product requirements into robust system designs, mapping out implementation phases, and making strategic build-vs-extend decisions. 
 - Architect, design, and scale core identity security posture systems. 
 - Cultivate and drive cross-functional technical alliances with platform teams across the security and identity stack. 
 - Author, review, and evaluate technical design documents while facilitating architectural discussions and design reviews. 
 - Establish, promote, and uphold engineering best practices across the sub-team, focusing on testing, code quality, API design, and observability. 

Software Engineering & Architecture

- Construct and scale high-performance backend services using Go - including event-driven systems, REST/gRPC APIs, cron jobs, and integration layers. 
 - Build and maintain user-facing interfaces using React/TypeScript - focusing on policy dashboards, identity visualization, and mitigation workflows. 
 - Design, model, and optimize database schemas capable of handling large-scale multi-tenant identity workloads. 
 - Implement event-driven architectures using Kafka as a message queue to manage asynchronous workflows and ensure continuous evaluation of identity postures. 
 - Maintain operational reliability and service health through standard runbooks, feature flags, and robust monitoring setups. 

Team Collaboration & Delivery

- Support, mentor, and guide a distributed team of 3-4 engineers located across India and Singapore. 
 - Collaborate closely with Product Managers and EM to align on technical strategy, prioritize roadmaps, and deliver quarterly key results and milestones. 
 - Own operational health for all services - on-call rotation, incident response, and SLO management
 - Serve as the team representative during organizational alignment, review sessions, and client interactions. 

Must-Have Qualifications

- 7+ years of software development experience, including at least 2+ years in a tech lead or senior technical leadership role
 - Proven track record of mentoring engineers and elevating the overall technical standards of the team
 - Exceptional system architecture skills-experienced in designing and running scalable, multi-tenant, event-driven distributed systems at scale
 - Deep hands-on experience with Kafka or similar high-throughput event-streaming technologies
 - Extensive backend production experience with Go-writing idiomatic services with clean design patterns, thorough testing, and robust error handling
 - Production-level React and TypeScript skills, with the capability to drive and own user-facing features end-to-end
 - Strong proficiency in SQL and PostgreSQL-including schema design, query optimization, and data modeling for multi-tenant workloads
 - Superb communication abilities-expert at detailing technical trade-offs to PMs, presenting architecture to leadership, and writing comprehensive design documents
 - High tolerance for ambiguity-adept at making decisions with partial data and iterating quickly

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

- Experience in identity security, IAM, or security posture management - familiarity will be good. 
 - Background in cybersecurity products 
 - Experience with gRPC/Protobuf API design
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted software development workflows and tools

A note on AI in our process: 

Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore. They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.

data.description:
About AlphaSense

The world's most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients' own research content. 

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6, 000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2, 000 employees across the globe and offices in the U. S. , U. K. , Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About The Role

Our Site Reliability Engineering team is growing, and we are looking for a highly experienced Staff Site Reliability Engineer to help shape the future of reliability, scalability, and performance at AlphaSense. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you will architect core reliability platforms, lead by example in incident response, and drive cultural adoption of SRE best practices across our global engineering organization. 

Our mission is to engineer our platform to the reliability standards of mission-critical systems, targeting 99. 99% uptime, while continuously enhancing our systems and processes. This role is key to that mission and goes beyond traditional system maintenance; it's about pioneering the platforms, practices, and culture that enable engineering to scale effectively. You will act as a force multiplier, mentoring fellow engineers, influencing architectural decisions, and setting the technical bar for reliability across the company. 

Who You Are

- 8+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or a similar role, with at least 3+ of those years operating in a Senior+ SRE position
 - Strong background in running production SaaS systems at scale. 
 - Proficiency in at least one programming/scripting language (Python, Go, or similar). 
 - Hands-on expertise with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and Kubernetes. 
 - Deep understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, load balancing). 
 - Experience with monitoring & alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK). 
 - Familiarity with advanced observability (OTEL, continuous profiling). 
 - Proven incident management experience, including leading high-severity incidents and postmortems. 
 - Strong troubleshooting skills across the full stack. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 

What You'll Do

- Architect Reliability Paved Paths: Build frameworks and self-service tooling that let teams own the reliability of their services in a "You Build It, You Run It" culture. 
 - Lead AI-Driven Reliability: Drive our AIOps strategy - automating diagnostics, remediation, and proactive failure prevention. 
 - Champion Reliability Culture: Embed SRE practices across engineering via design reviews, production readiness, and operational standards. 
 - Incident Leadership: Act as Incident Commander during critical events, modeling operational excellence, and ensuring blameless postmortems lead to lasting improvements. 
 - Advance Observability: Deliver end-to-end monitoring, tracing, and profiling (Prometheus, Grafana, OTEL, Continuous Profiling) to optimize performance proactively. 
 - Mentor & Multiply: Elevate engineers across SRE and product teams through mentorship, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing. 

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense's commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination. 

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works. 

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We At AlphaSense Have Been Made Aware Of Fraudulent Job Postings And Individuals Impersonating AlphaSense Recruiters. These Scams May Involve Fake Job Offers, Requests For Sensitive Personal Information, Or Demands For Payment. Please Note

- AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training. 
 - All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense. com email address. 
 - If you're unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page. 

If you believe you've been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

Job Title: Manager, Packaging Development

Focus Personal Care, Skincare, & Color Cosmetics

Travel Approximately: 15-20 %

Work

Environment: Fast-paced, Flexible, Startup Culture

Job Summary

The Manager, Packaging Development will be the key technical leader driving all

packaging initiatives for new product launches across Personal Care and Color

Cosmetics. 

This role requires an innovator with deep technical knowledge in rigid, 

semi-rigid, paperboard and laminate packaging. 

The candidate must possess exceptional project management and stakeholder management skills, a hands-on approach to mould development, and a proven ability to perform value

engineering while maintaining strong quality standards. 

Crucially, the manager must have an in-depth understanding of the cost breakdown for key formats, including glass bottles, PET bottles, Cap/Closures, Labels, Paperboard, and corrugated

shippers, to drive maximum profitability and efficiency. 

This position requires flexibility, strong conflict resolution skills, and the ability to thrive in a high-growth, startup culture. 

Core Responsibilities

I. New Product Launch & Innovation Leadership

Drive NPD Process: Lead the full packaging lifecycle from concept definition to commercialization for a high volume of new product launches in the personal care and color cosmetics segments. 

Innovation & Ideation: Act as a packaging innovator, continuously scouting

new materials, formats, and design technologies to enhance consumer experience, improve sustainability, and reduce costs. 

Mould Development Expertise: Directly manage and execute the technical development and validation of new tooling and moulds for custom primary packaging components (e. g. , bottles, jars, closures). 

II. Project Management & Stakeholder Management

End-to-End Project Ownership: Utilize exceptional project management skills to define scopes, manage timelines, control budgets, and ensure on- time delivery of all packaging projects. 

Stakeholder Alignment: Serve as the primary liaison, demonstrating strong stakeholder management and communication skills to align cross- functional teams (Marketing, Operations, R&D, Procurement). 

Conflict Resolution: Exhibit proficiency in critical thinking and managing conflict situations effectively to resolve technical and project-related roadblocks quickly and maintain positive team dynamics. 

III. Technical Expertise & Quality Assurance Costing & Value Engineering: Possess deep expertise in the costing of packaging material, including bottles, caps, pumps, labels, paperboard cartons, and glass bottles. Conduct robust cost analysis and value

engineering activities. 

IV. Material Specialization: Provide in-depth technical knowledge and troubleshoot issues related to the functional performance of laminates (e. g. , tubes) and rigid packaging components. 

Decoration Mastery: Maintain a good understanding of decoration techniques (e. g. , screen printing, hot stamping, labeling, offset printing) and ensure technical feasibility and quality execution on all packaging. 

Quality Resolution: Lead and execute projects focused on resolving complex quality issues related to packaging components or filling line performance, driving effective and lasting resolution. 

V. Sustainability and Regulatory Leadership

Plastic & Rigid Packaging: Drive the adoption of Post-Consumer Recycled (PCR) content in bottles, jars, and closures, setting targets and validating

material performance, color, and compatibility. 

Paperboard Packaging: Lead initiatives to optimize carton design for material reduction, ensuring all paperboard is sourced from certified sustainable forests (e. g. , FSC-certified) and maximizing the use of recycled fiber. 

Flexible Packaging (Laminates): Focus on transitioning complex multi- material flexible packaging (e. g. , sachets, tubes) to mono-material structures that are designed for recyclability without compromising product preservation. 

Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all packaging materials and claims comply with local and international environmental regulations, recycling mandates, and labeling standards. 

Reporting: Track and report key packaging sustainability metrics, such as plastic usage and recyclability rates, in line with company goals. 

Qualifications And Required Skills

Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering , PG in Packaging from IIP/SIES. 

Experience: 7+ years of dedicated packaging development experience, specifically within the Personal Care and/or Color Cosmetics industry. 

Technical: Proven expertise in mould development, strong understanding of injection moulding processes, and comprehensive knowledge of material properties for both plastic and glass packaging. 

Soft Skills: Demonstrated excellence in communication, problem-solving, critical thinking, and conflict management. 

Travel: Willingness to travel up to 20% internationally and domestically for supplier visits, trials, and trade shows. 

About Company

Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India's premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1, 000+ brands, 60, 000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences. 

Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6, 000+ offline touchpoints and launched 8 exclusive stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses-FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae-offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials. 

What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach. 

In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India's 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures. 

With a 3, 000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India's booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

 - Integrate self-service storage workflows for Kubernetes CSI and OpenStack consumers (VM and Baremetal). 
 - Implement and manage backup solutions (preferably Rubik). 
 - Build and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code for storage platforms using Ansible, Terraform, Helm and Git, with Python/Bash automation.

 - Develop and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and runbooks

Preferred Qualifications

 - ITIL Foundation/advanced certifications in support of ITSM standard methodology.

data.title: Aerospace-FMS System Test Engineer (ARP4754A)
data.description:
We are hiring! FMS Aerospace System Testing Engineer

Location: Bangalore, Karnataka (onsite)

Experience: 3-5 Years

Are you passionate about aviation safety and mission-critical systems?

Qubist Solutions is expanding our engineering team, and we are looking for a rigorous and detail-oriented Aerospace System Testing Engineer. In this role, you will bridge system design, software, and hardware to ensure our airborne products meet the highest levels of safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance. 

What You Will Do: 

- Design, develop, and execute system-level test plans and procedures for complex avionics architectures. 
 - Ensure bi-directional requirements traceability from aircraft-level safety objectives down to implementation artifacts. 
 - Configure and manage Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), System Integration Labs (SIL), and automated test environments. 
 - Partner with cross-functional engineering teams to resolve defects and root-cause anomalies during integration. 
 - Generate objective evidence and traceability matrices to support SOI (Stage of Involvement) audits and FAA/EASA certification. 

The Standards You Will Drive: 

You will directly apply the core ecosystem of aerospace certification guidelines to our testing lifecycle: 

- ARP4754A: Validating system architectures and requirement allocations. 
 - ARP4761: Utilizing FHA, PSSA, and SSA outputs to drive safety-critical failure-mode testing. 
 - DO-178C: Executing high-level/system-level software integration tests. 
 - DO-254: Verifying complex electronic hardware behavior at the system and LRU levels. 
 - DO-330: Defining Tool Operational Requirements and validating automated verification toolchains. 
 - DO-356A: Testing system vulnerabilities and verifying airworthiness cybersecurity architectures. 

What You Bring to the Table: 

- Bachelor's or Master's in Aerospace, Electrical, Systems Engineering, or related fields. 
 - 6+ years of hands-on avionics testing and integration experience in a certified program. 
 - Proficiency in Requirements Management tools (DOORS, Jama, Polarion). 
 - Experience with test automation scripting (Python, C/C++) and aviation data buses (ARINC 429, AFDX, MIL-STD-1553B). 
 - A proven track record of generating certification artifacts for regulatory audits. 

How to Apply: 

Ready to build the future of flight? Click "Apply" on this post or send your resume directly to communications@qubistsolutions. com with the subject line "Aerospace Testing Engineer - [Your Name]".

data.title: Creative Lead
data.description:
Role: Creative Lead

Location: Bengaluru

Experience: 6+ Years

Reporting To: Head of Design

About Remidio

Remidio is a Bengaluru-based medical technology company transforming eye care through AI-powered retinal imaging and digital health solutions. With a presence across 55+ countries and over 4, 000 devices deployed globally, Remidio has enabled approximately 16 million retinal screenings, making eye care more accessible through innovative technology. Its solutions support the detection of conditions such as diabetic retinopathy, glaucoma and age-related macular degeneration, with a growing focus on expanding AI-enabled screening into other areas of healthcare. 

At Remidio, innovation meets impact, creating opportunities to build meaningful brands and communicate technology that makes a difference in people's lives. 

About the Role

We are looking for a Creative Lead to drive the day-to-day brand and creative agenda of the organisation. Working closely with Marketing, Sales, Product Management and other stakeholders, the role will translate business objectives into effective creative plans and ensure timely, high-quality execution. 

The role combines brand planning, stakeholder management, creative team leadership and hands-on execution. The Creative Lead will own the brand calendar, manage creative priorities and resources, and ensure consistent brand communication aligned with business objectives. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Brand Strategy, Planning & Stakeholder Management

- Own and manage the annual brand and content calendar in collaboration with Marketing, Sales, Product and other stakeholders. 
 - Translate business objectives into clear creative briefs, communication plans and execution priorities across campaigns, product launches, events, digital initiatives, presentations and corporate communications. 
 - Act as the primary creative point of contact for internal stakeholders, aligning requirements, expectations, timelines and deliverables. 
 - Manage creative workflows and competing priorities across projects, balancing business needs, available resources and delivery timelines. 
 - Coordinate with internal creative teams, agencies and external partners to ensure smooth execution from brief to final delivery. 
 - Anticipate upcoming creative requirements, identify resource or capability gaps, and proactively address dependencies and delivery risks. 
 - Strengthen brand consistency across communication channels and business functions through clear standards and effective stakeholder alignment. 2. Creative Team Leadership

- Lead the day-to-day functioning of the creative team, including work allocation, prioritisation, capacity planning and delivery. 
 - Assign projects based on business priorities, complexity, team capabilities and available resources. 
 - Guide team members through constructive feedback and creative reviews, strengthening their creative thinking, execution quality and understanding of the brand. 
 - Partner with the Head of Design on broader creative direction, design standards and key strategic decisions. 3. Creative Execution & Quality

- Review and guide creative concepts and final outputs across digital, print, presentations, events and other brand touchpoints. 
 - Maintain and evolve brand guidelines, templates, visual assets and creative standards, ensuring consistency in typography, composition, colour, visual hierarchy and communication quality. 
 - Support campaigns and product launches from concept to final execution, providing creative direction to designers and external partners. 
 - Remain hands-on when required by creating, adapting or modifying basic creative assets, social media posts, presentations and other communication materials. 

What We're Looking For

- 6+ years of relevant experience in brand communication, creative management, creative coordination or related fields. 
 - Strong understanding of brand communication, visual design and creative processes. 
 - Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders, competing priorities and timelines in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Experience working with creative teams, agencies and external partners. 
 - Ability to translate business objectives into actionable creative briefs and provide clear creative direction. 
 - Strong visual judgement with an understanding of typography, composition, colour and brand consistency. 
 - Proficiency with relevant design and creative tools. 
 - Formal education in Design, Visual Communication, Creative Arts or a related field is an added advantage. 
 - A portfolio showcasing creative projects is mandatory. 

Ideal Candidate

A hands-on creative professional who combines strategic thinking, stakeholder management, team coordination and strong creative judgement. The ideal candidate can translate business needs into effective creative plans, lead multiple projects and ensure high-quality, consistent brand communication while remaining hands-on when required.

Location: Hyderabad, India (Onsite)

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly technical Lead Developer to spearhead our Windows desktop application development team. In this onsite role based in Hyderabad, you will be responsible for the end-to-end architecture, design, and delivery of robust Windows-based software. Leveraging your 8 to 9 years of expertise in C++, VC++, and MFC, you will balance hands-on coding with team leadership, guiding developers to build scalable, high-performance applications while ensuring architectural integrity. 

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & System Design

- System Architecture: Define, build, and evolve the architectural blueprint for complex Windows desktop applications, ensuring long-term scalability, security, and maintainability. 
 - Technical Strategy: Evaluate product requirements and translate them into robust Object-Oriented Designs (OOD), technical specifications, and development roadmaps. 
 - Performance Optimization: Analyze existing legacy architectures to identify bottlenecks, driving system-level optimizations, advanced memory management, and multithreading strategies. 

- Team Leadership & MentoringTechnical Leadership: Lead and manage a dedicated team of C++ developers, setting clear engineering standards and driving daily technical execution. 
 - Code Quality Assurance: Conduct rigorous code reviews, enforce coding best practices, and ensure the delivery of reliable, zero-defect code. 
 - Mentorship: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning, rigorous problem-solving, and technical excellence. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with product owners, QA teams, and stakeholders to align technical deliverables with business objectives and project timelines. 

Software Development

- Hands-On Coding: Design, develop, and maintain feature-rich Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs) and core business logic using C++, VC++, and Microsoft Foundation Classes (MFC). 
 - Debugging & Troubleshooting: Lead root-cause analysis and complex debugging efforts for software defects, utilizing tools like Visual Studio Debugger, WinDbg, and system profilers. 
 - Lifecycle Management: Oversee the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) from concept, prototyping, and unit testing through to deployment and post-release support. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Core Experience: 8 to 9 years of professional software engineering experience, strictly focused on Windows desktop application development. 
 - Programming Mastery: Deep, hands-on proficiency in C++ and VC++, with a strong command of modern C++ standards, STL, data structures, and algorithms. 
 - Windows Frameworks: Extensive, verifiable experience developing applications using MFC (Microsoft Foundation Classes) and the Windows API (Win32). 
 - Architecture & Design: Proven ability to architect complex software systems from scratch and apply Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles effectively. 
 - Leadership Track Record: Demonstrated experience acting as a Team Lead or Lead Architect, with a history of successfully delivering full-cycle technical projects. 
 - Memory & Concurrency: Exceptional grasp of dynamic memory allocation, pointer manipulation, and multithreading/concurrency within a Windows environment. 
 - Development Tools: Strong proficiency with version control systems (e. g. , Git) and familiarity with CI/CD integration. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience integrating or migrating legacy MFC applications with modern UI frameworks (e. g. , Qt, WinUI, or WPF). 
 - Knowledge of C# and . NET interoperability (C++/CLI). 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and facilitating sprint planning activities. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively interface with non-technical stakeholders. 

If you are a driven technical leader who thrives in a collaborative onsite environment and is passionate about building high-performance Windows applications, we encourage you to apply and help shape the future of our software ecosystem. 

Please send your resume to communications@qubissolutions. com
