data.description:
Job Purpose

Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (ICE) presents a unique opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology and solve complex business challenges in the financial sector. This role is responsible for testing and delivering high-quality trading, market data, clearing, settlement, compliance, and post-trade applications across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). 

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior QA Engineer with strong experience in Equities, Options, Market Data, FIX Protocol, Linux, SQL, Trading Systems, Clearing & Settlement, Trade Lifecycle validation, and Trading Systems UI Testing. The ideal candidate should have proven experience designing and executing test scenarios for complex trading platforms, validating order and trade workflows, troubleshooting logs and database records, and supporting regression, UAT, production validation, and release sign-off activities. 

The successful candidate will work in a dynamic, globally distributed team environment and collaborate closely with Development, Product Management, Operations, Support, and Business teams. The role requires strong domain knowledge, hands-on technical troubleshooting, strong analytical ability, clear communication, and the ability to independently drive QA activities with minimal supervision. 

This role is best suited for a Senior QA professional with strong Capital Markets domain knowledge, hands-on technical troubleshooting capability, and proven experience validating complex trading, market data, clearing, settlement, UI, and trade lifecycle workflows. The candidate should be able to independently own QA delivery, collaborate across teams, improve test coverage, and support high-quality releases for mission-critical trading systems. 

Responsibilities

- Trading Systems QA
 - Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans, test scenarios, test scripts, and test cases for Equities, Options, Market Data, Clearing, Settlement, and Trading applications. 
 - Validate order entry, routing, execution, cancellation, modification, trade capture, allocation, clearing, settlement, reporting, and downstream workflows. 
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, smoke, UAT, and production-like validation across integrated trading systems. 
 - Trade Lifecycle Testing
 - Validate complete trade lifecycle workflows from order entry through execution, trade capture, clearing, settlement, reporting, and downstream consumption. 
 - Verify lifecycle transitions, business rules, reference data impacts, trading session behavior, and product-specific scenarios for Equities and Options. 
 - FIX Protocol Testing
 - Validate FIX order entry, execution reports, cancel/replace flows, cancel rejects, drop copy, trade capture, allocation, and market data message flows. 
 - Analyze FIX logs for message sequencing, tag-level validation, session behavior, connectivity, reject handling, and execution flow accuracy. 
 - Market Data and Feed Validation
 - Test market data feed ingestion, transformation, dissemination, replay, recovery, and downstream publishing workflows. 
 - Validate trades, quotes, order book data, symbol/security lifecycle events, market status messages, session transitions, and reference data updates. 
 - Verify market data accuracy, completeness, timeliness, sequencing, entitlement/availability, and consistency across systems. 
 - Clearing and Settlement Testing
 - Validate clearing account processing, trade allocation, settlement workflows, reconciliation, and post-trade processing accuracy. 
 - Ensure exchange, business, and regulatory processing requirements are correctly applied across end-to-end trade flows. 
 - Trading Systems UI Testing
 - Validate application screens, user workflows, navigation, field behavior, permission-based behavior, error messages, data consistency, and usability aspects. 
 - Perform front-end and back-end reconciliation to confirm UI behavior aligns with database, logs, FIX messages, and downstream system outputs. 
 - Defect Management and QA Delivery
 - Identify, document, and track defects using Jira or equivalent tools, including clear evidence, logs, screenshots, data points, and impact details. 
 - Review and triage test failures, isolate root cause, collaborate with developers and product teams, and verify fixes through retesting and regression validation. 
 - Maintain clear documentation of test plans, test cases, execution results, defect summaries, sign-off notes, and release readiness updates. 
 - Automation and Continuous Improvement
 - Develop, maintain, and execute automated tests for regression, recurring validations, and high-value business workflows. 
 - Improve test coverage, execution efficiency, defect triage, test data management, and regression quality through process and automation enhancements. 
 - Use AI-based tools where appropriate for test case generation, log analysis, root cause investigation, and intelligent defect triage. 
 - Production, UAT, and Release Support
 - Support UAT preparation, production change validation, release testing, issue investigation, service restoration, and post-deployment verification when required. 
 - Work with minimal technical supervision while maintaining strong ownership, timely communication, and quality-focused delivery. 
Knowledge And Experience

- Capital Markets Domain: Strong hands-on experience with Equities, Options, electronic trading systems, market structure, exchange operations, and end-to-end trade lifecycle workflows. 
 - FIX Protocol: Proven ability to validate and troubleshoot FIX messages for order entry, execution, drop copy, cancel/replace, trade capture, and session-level behavior. 
 - Linux: Strong command-line skills for log analysis, process monitoring, file handling, grep/awk/sed usage, scripting basics, and QA environment troubleshooting. 
 - SQL: Hands-on experience writing SQL queries for backend validation, result verification, reconciliation, database state analysis, and test data preparation. 
 - Market Data: Experience validating feed ingestion, data transformation, dissemination, symbol/security lifecycle events, reference data, trade/quote data, order book data, and downstream consumption. 
 - QA Methodologies: Strong knowledge of functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, usability, smoke, UAT, and production-like validation techniques. 
 - Defect Lifecycle: Experience using Jira or similar tools to manage defects from identification through resolution verification and release closure. 
 - Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze complex issues, identify edge cases, isolate root cause, document evidence, and communicate impact clearly. 
 - Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively with Development, Product, Operations, Support, Business, and globally distributed QA teams. 
 - Ownership: Ability to work independently with minimum supervision, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality results within tight schedules. 

Preferred Knowledge And Experience

- Experience with exchange trading platforms, order management systems, market data distribution systems, clearing platforms, or regulatory reporting applications. 
 - Knowledge of XDP, multicast feeds, real-time feeds, replay/recovery concepts, market status messages, order book validation, or similar market data technologies is a plus. 
 - Exposure to automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, test data management, release validation, and regression optimization practices. 
 - Experience supporting production deployments, UAT testing, production issue debugging, and post-release validation activities. 
 - Experience leveraging AI tools to improve QA productivity, including test design, log analysis, defect triage, and root cause investigation. 
 - Results-driven mindset with strong ownership, attention to detail, customer focus, and commitment to delivering quality in the right way.

am development

data.description:
Job Description

We are the AI Infrastructure - Network Operations team at OCI (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure). We support and operate the RDMA/RoCE/InfiniBand network fabrics for OCI's largest AI and HPC customers. These fabrics are the foundation underneath OCI's AI, GPU and HPC services, and support major tier-0 vendors in the generative AI industry. If you're running an AI workload at OCI, we're running the RDMA network underneath your workload. 

A Network Operations Engineer on our team supports the design, deployment, and operations of a large-scale global Oracle cloud computing environment (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure - OCI). Primarily focused on operation and support of RDMA/RoCE/InfiniBand network fabrics and systems, through a combination of a deep network understanding and automation skills to operate a production environment. As OCI is a cloud-based network with a global footprint, this support will include hundreds of thousands of network devices supporting millions of servers, connected over a mix of dedicated backbone infrastructure and the Internet. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Lead network lifecycle management initiatives by defining technical objectives, delivery plans, and implementation procedures for large-scale network infrastructure projects. 
 - Translate high-level network architectures into detailed designs and deployment plans while ensuring scalability, reliability, and operational readiness. 
 - Serve as the technical lead for moderately complex network projects, coordinating the efforts of multiple engineers across design, deployment, automation, and operational support. 
 - Design, implement, and support network solutions across data center, backbone, cloud, and service provider environments. 
 - Partner with service owners and infrastructure teams to ensure network solutions are fully integrated with monitoring, observability, automation, and operational support systems. 
 - Act as a Tier 2 and specialized escalation point for network incidents, driving root cause analysis, corrective actions, and long-term reliability improvements. 
 - Lead the investigation and resolution of complex network issues and large-scale service-impacting events. 
 - Develop automation solutions, tools, and scripts to improve operational efficiency, network reliability, deployment consistency, and incident response. 
 - Contribute to the design and delivery of network automation frameworks and operational tooling. 
 - Collaborate closely with product teams, program managers, network leadership, and PMO organizations to align infrastructure capabilities with product and service requirements. 
 - Partner with vendor engineering teams and account managers to troubleshoot issues, evaluate new technologies, and drive operational improvements. 
 - Participate in hardware evaluations, RFQ/RFP processes, and adoption of new networking technologies and platforms. 
 - Drive technology decisions that support business, product, and service objectives. 
 - Mentor junior engineers through technical guidance, troubleshooting support, design reviews, and knowledge sharing. 
 - Contribute to engineering best practices, documentation standards, operational excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Preferred Skills & Experience

- 12+ years of experience. 
 - Bachelor's degree (Master's preferred) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related field. 
 - Strong experience with large-scale network operations, design, and troubleshooting. 
 - Expertise in routing and switching technologies, including BGP, OSPF, EVPN-VXLAN, MPLS, and data center networking. Prion experience with RDMA/RoCE/InfiniBand would be a plus. 
 - Experience with network automation using Python, Ansible, APIs, or similar technologies, building AI agents to automate. 
 - Strong understanding of observability, monitoring, telemetry, and incident management. 
 - Experience working with cloud infrastructure, hyperscale environments, or large-scale distributed systems. 
 - Ability to lead technical projects and influence outcomes across multiple teams. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across engineering, operations, and leadership teams. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. In this role, you will own engineering investments spanning Sovereign Cloud Platform (SCP) policy content, audit evidence and validation workflows, and foundational landing zone experiences for greenfield sovereign cloud deployments. You will work closely with engineering, compliance, security, operations, and program management partners to translate regulatory, operational, and customer assurance requirements into scalable platform capabilities. 

You will lead a high-performing team focused on enabling customers, auditors, and internal stakeholders to validate operational controls, consume trustworthy compliance evidence, and accelerate sovereign workload adoption while maintaining the highest standards of security, compliance, and operational excellence.

Position Overview: 

The Regional Etail Quality Improvement Manager is responsible for driving service quality, process adherence and continuous improvement across the regional Etail First Mile and Last Mile network. 

The role monitors end-to-end shipment lifecycle performance across Service Centres and delivery locations, identifies service-quality gaps and drives corrective actions with branch, area and regional operations teams. 

Owns regional Etail quality analytics and governance across key service metrics including pickup and delivery performance, First Attempt Delivery Success, undelivered shipments, NDR, ageing, customer complaints, shipment exceptions and operational process adherence. 

The role leads the regional Etail Quality Improvement team and works closely with Operations, Customer Service, Security, IT/Digital and other stakeholders to improve shipment flow, eliminate recurring defects and strengthen customer experience. 

This is primarily a quality governance, analytics and continuous improvement role, working in partnership with line Operations teams who continue to own day-to-day operational execution. 

Job Purpose: 

To continuously improve Etail service quality across the regional First and Last Mile network by identifying operational defects, analysing shipment lifecycle performance, driving root-cause resolution and ensuring sustained adherence to service standards, thereby improving delivery reliability, customer experience and operational quality. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities: 

Leadership

- Lead and manage the regional Etail Quality Improvement team and ensure clear ownership of quality-monitoring priorities. 
 - Build strong quality and problem-solving capability across the team. 
 - Establish regular quality-review mechanisms with regional, branch and operational teams. 
 - Drive accountability for closure of recurring service-quality gaps. 
 - Build a culture of proactive quality management rather than reactive exception resolution. 
 - Coach teams on root-cause analysis, corrective actions and sustained process improvement. 

Etail Service Quality Management

- Monitor end-to-end Etail shipment lifecycle across pickup, processing, movement and delivery stages. 
 - Track regional Etail service-quality performance against defined organisational standards and customer commitments. 
 - Identify service failures, ageing shipments, delivery exceptions and recurring operational defects. 
 - Drive improvement in First Attempt Delivery Success and reduction in avoidable delivery failures. 
 - Monitor NDR reasons and ensure corrective action on operationally controllable causes. 
 - Review undelivered, misrouted, delayed, damaged or exception shipments and drive closure with respective teams. 
 - Identify high-defect locations, routes and operational pockets and initiate targeted improvement plans. 
 - Ensure consistency of Etail service-quality standards across locations within the Region. 

Quality Analytics & Exception Management

- Analyse shipment-level and location-level quality data to identify trends, recurring defects and systemic issues. 
 - Develop regional quality dashboards and exception reports for management review. 
 - Establish proactive alerts for shipments or locations at risk of service failure. 
 - Conduct root-cause analysis on major service deviations and recurring customer-impacting issues. 
 - Track corrective and preventive actions through closure. 
 - Use data to differentiate isolated operational exceptions from structural process issues. 
 - Maintain visibility of quality performance by branch, service centre, route and relevant operational parameters. 

First & Last Mile Quality Improvement

- Partner with First Mile and Last Mile Operations teams to improve pickup and delivery quality. 
 - Review adherence to pickup and delivery processes, operational cut-offs and shipment handling standards. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve delivery attempt quality, shipment visibility and customer communication. 
 - Support improvement of address quality, delivery instructions and exception coding. 
 - Drive reduction in repeat attempts arising from avoidable operational reasons. 
 - Work with operational teams to improve route-level quality and delivery consistency. 
 - Support peak-period quality readiness and identify potential service risks before volume surges. 

Process Compliance & Standardisation

- Conduct periodic process-quality reviews across regional operating locations. 
 - Ensure adherence to defined Etail SOPs, shipment handling processes and service standards. 
 - Identify deviations from standard processes and drive corrective action. 
 - Support implementation of national quality initiatives across the Region. 
 - Standardise proven quality-improvement practices across branches and Service Centres. 
 - Ensure sustained implementation through follow-up audits and control mechanisms. 
 - Support quality readiness for new facilities, routes or operating models where required. 

Customer Experience & Complaint Reduction

- Analyse Etail-related customer complaints and identify underlying operational causes. 
 - Partner with Customer Service and Operations teams to reduce repeat complaints. 
 - Identify systemic customer experience issues and recommend operational solutions. 
 - Monitor complaint trends by location, failure type and root cause. 
 - Ensure major recurring service failures are addressed through structured corrective-action plans. 
 - Support improvements in delivery experience and shipment visibility. 

Continuous Improvement

- Build and maintain a regional quality-improvement pipeline focused on recurring service defects. 
 - Apply structured problem-solving methodologies such as RCA, PDCA, Pareto analysis and process mapping. 
 - Conduct field visits / Gemba reviews at locations with persistent quality gaps. 
 - Identify opportunities for process simplification, automation and preventive controls. 
 - Track measurable benefits from improvement initiatives. 
 - Institutionalise successful interventions across relevant locations to prevent recurrence. 

Technology, Data & Automation

- Use operational dashboards and shipment-level analytics to identify quality gaps and intervention priorities. 
 - Drive accurate exception coding and data discipline across operating locations. 
 - Support implementation and adoption of digital tools that improve shipment visibility and quality control. 
 - Partner with IT/Digital teams to automate recurring quality reports and exception identification. 
 - Identify opportunities for predictive / proactive quality monitoring. 
 - Ensure quality data used for decision-making is accurate, timely and actionable. 

Stakeholder & Governance

- Collaborate closely with Regional Operations, Branch Operations, First & Last Mile teams and Service Centres. 
 - Partner with Customer Service on complaint trends and customer-impacting quality issues. 
 - Coordinate with Security on shipment loss, damage and other quality exceptions wherever relevant. 
 - Work with IT/Digital teams on system or data issues impacting shipment visibility and quality. 
 - Conduct periodic Etail quality reviews with regional stakeholders. 
 - Escalate structural or recurring quality risks requiring regional or national intervention. 
 - Act as the regional SME for Etail service quality and continuous improvement. 

Qualifications & Experience: 

- Education: Bachelor's degree in operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Business Administration or related discipline preferred; MBA / PG qualification desirable. 
 - Experience: 5-8 years of relevant experience in express logistics, eCommerce logistics, last-mile operations, service quality, operational excellence or supply chain operations. 
 - Strong exposure to First Mile / Last Mile operations and shipment lifecycle management. 
 - Experience in analysing service-quality metrics and driving corrective actions across multiple operating locations. 
 - Understanding of delivery performance, NDR, ageing, service failures, customer complaints and operational exception management. 
 - Experience in data analysis, operational dashboards, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement. 
 - Exposure to multi-location operational governance and stakeholder management. 
 - Experience managing or coordinating quality / operational improvement teams preferred. 
 - Preferred Industries: Express Logistics, Courier, eCommerce Logistics, 3PL, Last Mile Delivery, Distribution and Supply Chain Operations. 

Skills & Capabilities:

- First & Last Mile Quality Management

 - First Attempt Delivery / Delivery Success Management 
 - NDR & Exception Management 
 - Shipment Lifecycle Analysis 
 - Root Cause Analysis & Corrective Action

 - Operational Dashboards & MIS

Strong performance optimization skills (rendering, virtualization, lazy loading, re-render control).

Experience handling real-time / near real-time data in frontend applications. 

Strong code quality practices (clean code, code reviews, testing). 

Work efficiently with development tools such as VS Code and Cursor.

Working knowledge of Kubernetes (pods, deployments, logs, metrics)

data.title: Manager, Quality Engineering
data.description:
Location: India

Function: Engineering / Cloud Platform

Reports To: Sr. Director, Cloud Platform

Are you. . . 

- Passionate about building quality into cloud platforms from development through production? 
 - Excited to establish the standards, tooling, metrics, and practices that enable engineering teams to deliver with confidence? 
 - Interested in leading quality transformation and release discipline across multiple engineering teams?

If so, we'd love to meet you. 

Why Esko?

Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25, 000 customers across 140+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation. 

Our vision is to create the industry's leading AI-native Product Intelligence Platform. This modern, multi-tenant cloud platform unifies product, packaging, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain data into a single intelligent ecosystem. By combining cloud-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence. 

About The Role

As the Quality Engineering Lead - Cloud Platform, you will define and drive the quality engineering strategy for the Cloud Platform and help raise quality across the products that build on it. 

You will establish quality standards and test policies, common test harnesses and tooling, quality metrics and dashboards, environment promotion gates, and release management and readiness governance. You will work across Engineering, Product, Platform, Security, and Operations to drive consistent quality practices and improve release confidence. 

What You Will Do

- Set quality standards and test policy and drive consistent adoption across platform and product engineering teams. 
 - Establish common test harnesses and tooling for API, integration, compatibility, performance, reliability, and cross-product testing. 
 - Define quality metrics and dashboards that make regression health, performance, reliability, escaped defects, and release quality measurable and visible. 
 - Set promotion gates by environment, defining the quality and readiness criteria required for software to progress toward production. 
 - Own release management and readiness, coordinating releases across teams and governing release risks, dependencies, and exceptions. 
 - Drive quality improvement across product teams, identifying systemic gaps and influencing engineering leaders and teams to improve quality practices. 
 - Continuously evolve quality practices using production incidents, customer-impacting issues, metrics, and retrospectives. 

Required Experience

- 12+ years of experience in quality engineering, SDET, software engineering, test automation, or related engineering disciplines. 
 - Proven experience establishing and driving quality engineering strategy across multiple engineering teams or products. 
 - Experience defining quality metrics, release-readiness criteria, environment promotion gates, and release processes across multiple teams. 
 - Experience establishing shared test automation frameworks, harnesses, test data capabilities, and quality tooling. 
 - Hands-on Experience with API and test automation technologies such as Playwright, or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Experience with performance, scalability, and reliability testing using technologies such as JMeter, Gatling, or equivalent, including establishing performance baselines. 
 - Strong understanding of AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, microservices, APIs, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience using observability technologies such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Splunk, Dynatrace, or equivalent to understand system health and quality. 
 - Strong collaborative and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to align cross-functional teams-including engineering, product, and operations-around shared quality goals. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience with large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS platforms on AWS. 
 - Experience driving adoption of quality standards, tooling, and engineering practices across multiple teams, building alignment and influencing across organizational boundaries. 
 - Experience with resilience testing or chaos engineering for distributed systems. 
 - Experience leading complex releases involving multiple products, services, and engineering teams. 
 - Experience leading, mentoring, or building teams of Quality Engineers and SDETs. 
 - Experience establishing quality practices in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments. 

What Does Success Look Like

In this role, success means: 

- Product and platform teams have clear quality standards and take accountability for meeting them. 
 - Teams use common test harnesses, tooling, metrics, and performance baselines to consistently measure and improve quality. 
 - Software progresses between environments based on clear, measurable promotion gates rather than subjective release decisions. 
 - Platform releases are predictable and production-ready, with risks and exceptions explicitly understood and governed. 
 - Production regressions decrease, and you become a trusted quality engineering leader who drives improvement across organizational boundaries.

data.title: Senior Manager - Quant Developer
data.description:
The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance

At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance. 

As India's first crypto unicorn valued at $2. 45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale. 

We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what's next. 

If you're driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you'll feel right at home here. 

SM Quant Developer - Crypto Market Making

About The Role

This isn't a typical quant developer role. 

You will own the systems that quote prices and manage risk across crypto markets in real time - the engine that lets CoinDCX provide deep, reliable liquidity to every trader on our platform. This is work that directly shapes how price discovery and market quality happen for millions of Indian users. 

We're looking for a builder who can architect low-latency market making infrastructure in C++, connect resiliently to multiple exchanges over WebSocket and REST, and lead a small team of quant developers. You'll be hands-on with the hardest engineering on the desk: keeping order books accurate under messy, high-rate, sometimes-failing exchange feeds, and turning microsecond-level decisions into consistent PnL. You will set the technical bar for how we build, measure, and scale our trading systems. 

What You'll Do

- Design and build low-latency market making systems in modern C++ (C++17/20), optimising the hot path for memory, cache, and lock-free performance. 
 - Own resilient connectivity to multiple crypto venues (Binance, Bybit, Deribit, CoinDCX and more) over WebSocket and REST - handling reconnects, heartbeats, sequence-gap recovery, and snapshot+delta order book reconstruction. 
 - Build a normalisation layer that tames inconsistent exchange APIs, rate limits, and weight systems into one clean, reliable interface for strategies. 
 - Lead a team of quant developers - reviewing code, setting engineering standards, breaking down work, and mentoring them into strong systems engineers. 
 - Deliver the quoting, order management, and risk-check components end-to-end, partnering closely with traders and quants to translate strategy needs into robust production systems. 
 - Measure and improve performance and reliability relentlessly - instrumenting, benchmarking, and tuning the system against real latency budgets dominated by network round-trips and exchange behaviour. 

You'll Excel in This Role If You

- Have 7-8 years building low-latency, high-throughput systems in C++, with deep performance-engineering instincts (lock-free structures, no allocations on the hot path, CPU pinning, profiling). 
 - Have shipped production systems with` persistent WebSocket and REST connectivity at scale - trading background preferred, but strong low-latency engineers from any domain are welcome. 
 - Think in first principles about where latency actually lives - network RTT, exchange matching, and rate-limit budgeting - rather than mechanically applying nanosecond-hardware playbooks. 
 - Have led as a tech lead - owning components, reviewing code, and guiding junior engineers 
 - Are obsessed with correctness and resilience under messy, inconsistent, sometimes-failing exchange APIs. 
 - Communicate latency and risk tradeoffs clearly to traders and non-engineers, and bring a measurement-driven, owner mindset. 
 - (Bonus) Understand crypto market microstructure - order books, funding rates, perpetuals, liquidations, maker/taker fee tiers - or have worked with kernel bypass, or colocation/proximity hosting. 

You'll Know You're Winning When

(Key success metrics for the first 6 months)

- You've taken ownership of the core market making stack and shipped measurable latency and reliability improvements on the hot path. 
 - Your exchange connectivity layer maintains accurate order books with robust gap recovery and minimal downtime across venues. 
 - Junior developers in the team are independently shipping reviewed, high-quality components against a clear engineering standard you've set. 
 - Traders and quants trust your systems - quoting and risk checks run consistently in production with fewer incidents and faster iteration. 

Why This Role Matters & What's In It For You

Market making is the heartbeat of an exchange - the systems you build directly determine the liquidity, spreads, and trading experience for millions of users. You'll sit at the intersection of engineering, trading, and risk, with real ownership over a business-critical edge. 

You'll work closely with senior leadership and our researchers and traders, influence high-stakes technical and strategic decisions, and grow into a leader of one of the most demanding engineering functions in one of the world's fastest-evolving industries. 

How To Apply

This role is for you if you thrive on hard systems problems, love working close to the action with sharp traders and engineers, and want to own infrastructure that matters. 

Apply via: 

- Careers page link 
 - LinkedIn link

Hiring Process

Here's what your journey with us looks like: 

- Application Review - We assess for skills, alignment, and intent 
 - Recruiter Connect - A short conversation to understand you better 
 - Functional Round(s) - Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving 
 - Assignment / Simulation Round - A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios 
 - Culture & Values Discussion - A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best 
 - Founder Conversation (Optional) - For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit

Where We Work

We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space. 

With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our Bengaluru HQ, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time. 

Perks That Empower You

- Design Your Own Benefits: A flexible benefits program tailored to your lifestyle. 
 - Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Take time to rest and recharge as you need. 
 - Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources. 
 - Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly sessions to learn, unlearn and grow continuously. 

Ready to Build What's Next?

If you're looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it. 

Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

data.title: Senior System Engineer, GIOC
data.description:
Who We Are

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3. 5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world's largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company. 

Vultr Cares

- Medical Insurance stipend paid annually 
 - 9 Company-Paid Holidays 
 - Generous Leave Policy + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year
 - Professional Development Reimbursement 
 - Internet reimbursement 
 - Fitness membership reimbursement
 - Company paid Wellable subscription

Join Vultr

Vultr is expanding its India presence and is building its first Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai - the 24x7 nerve center for monitoring, triage, and first response across Vultr's global cloud, systems, network, and security operations. 

We are seeking Senior Systems Engineers to serve as the first line of response for Vultr's systems estate - compute, storage, operating systems, and virtualization. This is a frontline operations role for engineers who thrive in a fast-paced, alert-driven environment and want to grow into deeper SRE, systems, and platform engineering careers. You must be comfortable working a rotational shift model - including nights, weekends, and holidays - to sustain follow-the-sun coverage. 

Role Overview

The Senior Systems Engineer is the entry point of the GIOC incident lifecycle. You monitor health signals across Vultr's systems estate, acknowledge and triage alerts within defined first-response SLAs, execute documented runbooks to resolve common issues, and escalate cleanly to Senior Engineers when an issue falls outside L2 scope. The role ensures fast, accurate first response that protects customer experience and keeps incidents moving toward resolution. 

You operate from a consolidated single-pane-of-glass dashboard, classifying and routing incidents by severity and tower while owning accurate, complete documentation of every action. Success is measured by first-response SLA adherence, triage accuracy, and runbook resolution rate. The role runs on a rotational schedule to sustain 24x7 coverage. 

Key Responsibilities

Alert Monitoring & First Response

- Monitor systems-estate health signals (compute, storage, OS, virtualization) from a consolidated single-pane-of-glass dashboard
 - Acknowledge alerts and incidents within first-response SLA targets 
 - Perform initial review - read the alert, check recent changes, and review the CMDB before acting

Triage & Severity Classification

- Classify each incident by severity and customer impact, confirming the owning tower (Systems / Network / Security / cross-tower)
 - Route and assign tickets accurately to the correct tower or escalation path
 - Sustain triage accuracy at or above the GIOC go-live standard
 - Reassess severity as impact evolves, and declare higher when in doubt

Runbook-Driven Resolution

- Match alert signatures to documented runbooks and execute permitted L2 actions
 - Resolve common, well-understood systems issues end to end within L2 scope
 - Document every step taken, with supporting evidence, in the incident ticket

Escalation & Handoff

- Escalate unresolved or out-of-scope issues to L2/L3 with a clean, complete handoff (symptom
 - evidence collected
 - steps tried
 - current state)
 - Flag missing or ineffective runbooks as runbook gaps for review and continuous improvement
 - Initiate and support major-incident (Sev-0 / Sev-1) bridges per the escalation matrix
 - Track escalations to closure and confirm service is restored before resolving the ticket

Operational Documentation & Communication

- Maintain accurate shift logs, ticket updates, and incident timelines
 - Provide clear, timely status communication to stakeholders and customers per severity
 - Produce thorough shift-handover notes for seamless continuity

Continuous Improvement

- Identify recurring alerts and noise as candidates for tuning and automation
 - Contribute to and improve runbooks and knowledge-base articles
 - Participate in post-incident reviews (PIR) and trend reviews

Qualifications & Experience

- Graduate/Engineer in a relevant field (B. E. /B. Tech, or equivalent) 
 - 5-8 years of experience in systems administration, NOC/SOC, or IT operations, including hands-on Linux and/or Windows server administration
 - Working knowledge of operating systems - processes, services, and log analysis (Linux and/or Windows)
 - Familiarity with compute, storage, and virtualization concepts - VMs, hypervisors, and basic networking
 - Understanding of incident-management fundamentals and severity-based triage
 - Exposure to monitoring/observability tools and ticketing systems (alerting consoles, ITSM)
 - Strong written communication for accurate documentation and clean escalation handoffs; willingness and ability to work a rotational 24x7 shift model, including nights, weekends, and holidays
 - Proficient in English verbal and written communication

Preferred Qualifications

- ITIL V4 Foundation certification or equivalent ITSM knowledge
 - Linux certification (RHCSA / LFCS) or a cloud-fundamentals certification
 - Scripting familiarity (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) for routine automation
 - Exposure to cloud platforms and GPU / high-density infrastructure
 - Prior experience in a 24x7 NOC, SOC, or command-center environment, and tools such as JIRA, Confluence, PagerDuty, and observability platforms

Inclusion & Privacy

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted. 

We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U. S. privacy rules and India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures. 

Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

Responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced Front‐of‐Line (FOL) Lead to own and optimize IC assembly/process steps up to EOL handoff in a high‐volume OSAT environment. The ideal candidate brings deep process expertise across wafer bump/RDL, wafer thinning & dicing, die prep, die attach, wire bond/flip‐chip attach, underfill, molding, singulation, and pre‐test/readiness, driving yield, cost, cycle time, and reliability improvements while ensuring stable HVM at OSATs. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own end‐to‐end FOL process flows for assigned packages (e. g. , QFN/QFP, BGA/FCBGA, WLCSP, SIP/POP). 
 - Define, optimize, and maintain process windows, golden parameters, and control plans for: 
 - Wafer‐level: RDL, UBM, bumping (Cu pillar/SnAg), wafer thinning, WLCSP passivation, dicing/saw. 
 - Die prep/attach: die singulation, pick/place, epoxy/DAF attach, eutectic/Ag‐sinter, FC attach. 
 - Interconnect: wire bond (Au/Cu/Al), stud bumping, flip‐chip reflow; underfill/edge‐bonding. 
 - Encapsulation & singulation: transfer mold/compression mold, post‐mold cure, saw/laser singulation. 
 - Own cost of manufacturing (COM) levers: materials usage (epoxy, underfill, mold compound), rework, tool life, consumables, and setup optimization
 - Create package build plans, control plans, and risk assessments (PFMEA) for new products/packages. 
 - Lead engineering builds, pilot runs, correlation plans, and ramp‐to‐HVM with stable yields and CPK. 

Essential Attributes

- Proven track record in advanced IC packaging: Wirebond, Flip-Chip, WLCSP, SiP, Fan-Out, or 2. 5D/3D. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with APQP/PPAP, SPC/MSA/DOE, FMEA, 8D, and reliability (JEDEC/AEC). 
 - Strong understanding of assembly/process flows and failure modes (e. g. , delamination, bond lift, die crack, BLR/CLR, substrate warpage). 
 - Customer-facing quality ownership, including escalation handling and audit leadership. 
 - Experience with automotive (IATF 16949) or AEC-Q100/104 qualification. 

Qualifications

data.title: Head of Quality Assurance -  Robotics Labs
data.description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we're looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works. 

About IRL (Instawork Robotics Labs)

Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a "100, 000-year data gap" - the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork's answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments - kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, homes - to capture the high-fidelity task data that the world's leading Robotics labs use to train their foundation models. Read more here. 

Location: Bangalore

Experience: 10+ years

Industry: Automotive / Mobility / Robotics / Manufacturing

About The Role

Instawork Robotics creates the highest-quality, highest-diversity datasets for robotics and physical AI. We work with many of the most important robotics builders and research labs to solve the most important challenge in robotics - closing the data gap. 

We are looking for a Head of QA with 10+ years of experience in automotive, manufacturing, mobility, robotics, or a closely related industry. This person will own the end-to-end quality and data-labeling function across Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Visual Inspection, and process quality. 

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can build quality systems from the ground up, establish rigorous processes, lead teams, and drive a strong quality culture across operations and engineering. 

What You'll Do

- Own the QA/QC function: Build and lead the overall quality strategy, processes, standards, and KPIs across operations and manufacturing. 
 - Visual & Product Quality: Establish robust visual inspection and defect detection processes, including inspection standards, sampling methodologies, defect classification, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Quality Systems: Design and implement SOPs, inspection protocols, quality gates, audit mechanisms, CAPA, and continuous improvement processes. 
 - Team Leadership: Build, manage, and develop high-performing QA/QC teams across locations and functions. 
 - Cross-functional Quality: Partner closely with Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Product teams to identify and eliminate recurring quality issues. 
 - Data & Metrics: Build quality dashboards and drive metrics such as defect rates, first-pass yield, rework, rejection rates, customer complaints, and quality escapes. 
 - Supplier & Process Quality: Drive supplier quality, incoming inspection, in-process quality, and final inspection standards. 
 - Root Cause & Continuous Improvement: Lead RCA, corrective/preventive actions, and quality improvement initiatives using structured methodologies such as 8D, FMEA, SPC, Six Sigma, or similar frameworks.

data.title: Cloud Architect
data.description:
We're improving the way we live and work by intelligently connecting energy systems, buildings, and industries!!

Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place - where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered optimally and efficiently. It provides the flexible infrastructure to allow society to evolve and respond to changing conditions. Technology and the ingenuity of people come together to be at one with our environments and to care for our world. We do this from the macro to the micro level, from physical products, components, and systems to connected, cloud-based digital offerings and services. Siemens offers a broad portfolio of grid control and automation; low- and medium-voltage power distribution, switching and control; and building automation, fire safety and security, HVAC control and energy solutions. 

JOIN US! WE MAKE REAL WHAT MATTERS. THIS IS YOUR ROLE

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Architect - IoT & Digitalization to define and drive the cloud architecture for our next generation of digital products and IoT solutions. 

In this role, you will take technical ownership of scalable, secure and highly available cloud architectures. You will work closely with Product Owners, Software Architects, developers, cybersecurity experts and globally distributed engineering teams to translate product requirements into robust cloud-native solutions. 

The role provides an opportunity to influence architecture from edge to cloud, establish reusable technology patterns and enable engineering teams to build secure, scalable and maintainable digital solutions. 

Your key responsibilities

As a Cloud Architect, You Will

Define and drive end-to-end cloud architecture for IoT and digital applications. 

Design scalable, resilient, secure and highly available cloud-native solutions. 

Establish cloud architecture principles, reusable design patterns, standards and technology guidelines. 

Translate business and product requirements into technical architecture and solution concepts. 

Architect solutions based on microservices, containers, Kubernetes, serverless technologies and managed cloud services. 

Define integration concepts using REST APIs, API gateways, event-driven architecture and messaging technologies. 

Design cloud infrastructure covering networking, compute, storage, databases and platform services. 

Drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated cloud provisioning approaches. 

Embed security-by-design principles covering identity, authentication, authorization, encryption and secure communication. 

Define architectural approaches for high availability, scalability, disaster recovery and performance. 

Enable DevOps/DevSecOps practices, automated CI/CD and cloud-native deployments. 

Define observability concepts covering system monitoring, logging, metrics and alerting. 

Evaluate and recommend appropriate cloud technologies, platforms, frameworks and tools. 

Lead architecture and design reviews and support teams in resolving complex technical issues. 

Mentor engineering teams and promote cloud-native architecture and engineering practices. 

Collaborate with globally distributed R&D teams and other stakeholders on technology and product roadmaps. 

These capabilities build on Siemens' existing internal architecture profiles, which cover microservices, APIs, messaging, container orchestration, serverless development, DevOps, observability, cloud networking, IaC, high availability and disaster recovery. 

We Are Looking For Someone With

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline. 

Strong professional experience in software engineering, cloud technologies and solution architecture. 

Proven experience designing scalable, secure and highly available cloud applications. 

Strong knowledge of cloud-native architecture and distributed systems. 

Hands-on architectural experience with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS. 

Strong understanding of microservices, Docker and Kubernetes. 

Experience with serverless architecture and managed cloud services. 

Experience designing REST APIs, API management and event-driven architectures. 

Good understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases. 

Strong knowledge of cloud networking, security and identity/access management. 

Experience with CI/CD, DevOps and DevSecOps practices. 

Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform or comparable technologies. 

Understanding of observability, monitoring and logging concepts. 

Strong knowledge of software architecture principles, system design and design patterns. 

Strong analytical, debugging and problem-solving capabilities. 

Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. 

Ability to technically lead, influence and mentor engineering teams. 

Siemens internal architecture material specifically references AWS/Azure/Google cloud experience, Terraform/AWS CloudFormation/Azure ARM Templates, DevOps, containerization, microservices and cloud security as relevant architectural capabilities. 

WE DON'T NEED SUPERHEROES, JUST SUPER MINDS!

WE'VE GOT QUITE A LOT TO OFFER. HOW ABOUT YOU?

We're Siemens. A collection of over 379, 000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in across Gender, LGBTQ+, Abilities & Ethnicity. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination, and help us shape tomorrow.

data.description:
Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it's consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future. 

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Lead Developer to lead technical delivery for a team: hands-on coding, architecture alignment, and raising the bar on quality and operations. You will design and ship backend capabilities, partner on requirements and trade-offs, and help the team deliver reliably in production. 

Responsibilities

- Design, implement, and review features and APIs (services, integrations, data access). 
 - Own reliability for services you touch: correctness, performance, observability, and safe releases. 
 - Work with the team on architecture for new capabilities and on improving existing systems (database schema, caching, deployment, operational runbooks). 
 - Partner with product and other engineering teams on requirements, estimates, and technical trade-offs. 
 - Review code, clarify design, and mentor engineers informally; contribute to a culture of quality and learning. 
 - Identify and drive process improvements: clearer contracts, better tests, CI/CD hygiene, and reduced operational toil. 
 - Create and maintain technical documentation where it helps onboarding and operations. 

Qualifications

- 4+ years of professional experience shipping production backend services in Java (e. g. Spring Boot) or an equivalent JVM stack; comfortable with REST APIs, validation, auth integration (e. g. OAuth2 / JWT), and common Spring patterns. 
 - Data stores - solid PostgreSQL: schema design, migrations (e. g. Flyway or similar), indexing, transactions, and debugging slow queries. 
 - Caching - hands-on use of Redis or Valkey (or similar): cache keys, TTLs, invalidation, and failure modes when cache is down or stale. 
 - Build and quality - Gradle or Maven, unit/integration tests, constructive code review habits, and CI-friendly workflows. 
 - Containers and cloud - Docker; deploying or operating services on AWS (or similar): configs, secrets, logs, metrics. 
 - Observability - metrics, logs, and tracing sufficient to find regressions and latency issues in production. 
 - API and integration design - clear contracts, versioning or backward-compatibility discipline, and safe handling of errors and idempotency where it matters. 
 - Education - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience). 
 - Version control - strong experience with Git and collaborative branching/review practices. 

Preferred Skills

- Ad tech or high-QPS adjacent - experience with auctions, bidding, strict latency budgets, or very high read/write traffic. 
 - Rust or other systems languages - for performance-critical services or tooling. 
 - Kubernetes and GitOps-style deployments. 
 - UI collaboration - comfort reading, debugging, or occasionally contributing to our web UI built with React, TypeScript, Vite, Material UI (MUI), TanStack Query, React Router, and Tailwind CSS (pairing with UI engineers on API contracts, auth flows, and end-to-end behavior). 
 - Event-driven design, messaging, or stream processing. 
 - Infrastructure-as-code (e. g. Terraform, CloudFormation). 
 - Prior mentoring, technical leadership, or leading small initiatives. 

Additional Information

data.title: Embedded Software Engineer – Battery Management Systems (BMS)
data.description:
About Us

MEAtec is a fast-growing deep tech company developing AI-driven battery analytics, digital battery passport solutions, second-life decision-making tools, lifecycle management platforms, and edge-to-cloud BMS technologies for electric vehicles and energy storage systems. With a strong focus on sustainability and the circular economy, we collaborate with leading academics, industry partners, and international organizations to advance battery intelligence and next-generation mobility across Europe and beyond. 

Position Overview

As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will develop, test and integrate the embedded software infrastructure supporting Battery Management Systems for electric vehicles (EVs) and battery energy storage systems (BESS). 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain BSW components according to defined software requirements and architecture. 
 - Implement and configure microcontroller peripherals and device drivers, including ADC, GPIO, timers, watchdogs, SPI, I2C, UART and CAN. 
 - Develop hardware abstraction and interface layers for battery monitoring devices, sensors and control outputs. 
 - Implement communication services between the BMS and vehicle controllers, chargers, energy management systems and other connected equipment. 
 - Develop diagnostic services, fault reporting, non-volatile data storage and configuration management functions. 
 - Support software initialisation, task scheduling, interrupt handling and real-time operating system integration where applicable. 
 - Support bootloader integration, firmware update mechanisms and software recovery functions. 
 - Integrate BMS application software and MATLAB/Simulink-generated code with BSW interfaces. 
 - Perform unit and integration testing, debug hardware-software interface issues, and assess execution time and memory usage. 
 - Maintain source code, configuration files, interface documentation and test results using version control and review processes. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, Mechatronics or a related field. 
 - 1-3 years of relevant experience in embedded software development; relevant internships and practical university projects will also be considered. 
 - Proficiency in C and understanding of pointers, bitwise operations, memory organisation, interrupts and embedded state machines. 
 - Hands-on familiarity with microcontrollers, peripheral configuration, development environments and hardware debugging. 
 - Understanding of communication interfaces such as CAN, SPI, I2C and UART. 
 - Ability to read hardware schematics and device datasheets when developing or debugging software interfaces. 
 - Familiarity with Git, software testing and technical documentation. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and excellent written and spoken English at C1 level or higher. 

What We Offer

- A hands-on, immersive experience in a cutting-edge R&D environment. 
 - Mentorship from experienced battery modeling and simulation professionals. 
 - Opportunity to work on real-world projects with meaningful outcomes. 
 - Flexible work schedule and a collaborative team culture. 
 - A chance to be part of a mission-driven company shaping the future of battery intelligence.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale.

In this role, you'll lead, build, and grow teams of world-class engineers, taking responsibility for their technical execution and impact through ambiguity as we scale. This role is based in our Hyderabad office with a hybrid setup, typically 3 days in the office. 

Get to know our Engineering team - what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect. 

What You'll Be Doing

data.title: Founding Engineer - AI Systems & Product Engineering
data.description:
Company: Ve - The Intent Company

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India (Hybrid)

Experience: Minimum 4 years

Employment: Full-time

Role: Individual Contributor - End-to-End Engineering Ownership

About Ve

At Ve, we're building a new generation of AI-native software that fundamentally changes how people interact with computers, intelligence, and technology. 

We believe the future of software won't simply respond to instructions. It will understand intent, reason through complex problems, take action, and help people accomplish things that previously seemed impossible. 

We're a small, deeply technical team building at the frontier of artificial intelligence, autonomous agents, and human-computer interaction. 

We're not interested in building another AI wrapper. 

We're interested in building systems that redefine what software can do. 

The Opportunity

We're looking for exceptional Founding Engineers who want to build ambitious technology from the ground up. This is not a conventional software engineering role. 

You won't be joining a large team where responsibilities are narrowly divided and someone else makes all the important decisions. You'll work directly with the founder and a small group of highly capable engineers. You'll have significant ownership over architecture, implementation, performance, reliability, and the final product experience. We need engineers who can take a difficult problem, figure out the right approach, build it, ship it, and make sure it actually works. Not just people who write code. People who own outcomes. 

What You'll Own

- End-to-end engineering: Take complex features and systems from initial concept through architecture, implementation, deployment, and production. 
 - AI-native systems: Build intelligent agents, orchestration systems, model integrations, and autonomous workflows. 
 - Product engineering: Develop fast, intuitive, reliable experiences across desktop applications, backend services, and AI-powered interfaces. 
 - Systems architecture: Design scalable, maintainable systems capable of supporting sophisticated, long-running AI operations. 
 - Performance engineering: Identify bottlenecks, optimize execution, reduce latency, and continuously improve system efficiency. 
 - Reliability and quality: Build robust error handling, observability, testing, recovery, and verification into everything you ship. 
 - Technical decisions: Evaluate trade-offs, challenge assumptions, and independently choose the right technologies and approaches. 
 - Production ownership: Debug difficult problems, investigate failures, and take responsibility for keeping your systems working. You'll be expected to understand the bigger picture, not just your assigned component. 

What We're Looking For

Minimum Requirements

- At least 4 years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping real products. 
 - Exceptional programming ability in at least one modern language such as TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go, or C++. 
 - Strong fundamentals in computer science, algorithms, data structures, concurrency, and systems design. 
 - Experience designing, building, and maintaining complex production systems. 
 - Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, databases, and asynchronous architectures. 
 - Ability to work across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and integrations when needed. 
 - Excellent debugging skills and the ability to understand unfamiliar codebases quickly. 
 - Experience making architectural decisions and understanding their long-term consequences. 
 - Strong engineering judgment around performance, reliability, scalability, and security. 
 - Ability to work independently, move quickly, and deliver production-ready solutions. 

Especially Valuable

- Experience building AI agents, coding agents, or LLM-powered products. 
 - Experience with Claude, Codex, OpenAI, or other model APIs and agent harnesses. 
 - Understanding of agent orchestration, parallel execution, tool calling, memory, and context management. 
 - Experience with Electron, Chromium, desktop applications, or native macOS development. 
 - Experience building developer tools, IDEs, CLIs, or code intelligence systems. 
 - Experience with AWS, cloud infrastructure, containers, and distributed execution. 
 - Contributions to meaningful open-source projects. 
 - Experience building products from zero to one. You don't need to know every technology we use. 

But you must be exceptionally good at learning, reasoning, and building. 

The Kind of Engineer Who Will Thrive Here

You are deeply curious about how things work. 

You don't stop at the first solution. You ask whether there's a fundamentally better way to solve the problem. 

You care about speed, but never confuse writing code quickly with building something correctly. 

You can navigate large, unfamiliar systems and identify the real cause of difficult problems. 

You don't need detailed specifications for every decision. 

You take initiative, investigate independently, and make things happen. 

You care about the quality of what ships. 

You don't consider a task complete because the code compiles, a pull request is merged, or a demo looks good. 

You consider it complete when the intended outcome works reliably in the real product. 

You're comfortable taking responsibility, receiving direct feedback, and working in an environment where expectations are extremely high. 

You want to build something important, not simply complete tickets. 

How We Work

We're a small team with an unusually ambitious technical vision. 

We move fast. We experiment constantly. We challenge existing approaches and aren't afraid to rebuild something when we discover a better architecture. 

Engineers have significant freedom, but that freedom comes with responsibility. 

We expect you to think independently, communicate clearly, collaborate closely, and own the quality of your work. 

We use AI extensively in our engineering process. 

But we believe the most valuable engineers are those who can exercise exceptional judgment- understanding what to build, how to build it, why it works, and whether it actually solves the problem. 

AI can accelerate implementation. Engineering judgment is what makes the result exceptional. 

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, we expect you to: 

- Develop a deep understanding of Ve's architecture, product, and technical direction. 
 - Independently take ownership of important engineering systems or product capabilities. 
 - Ship meaningful improvements that users can experience. 
 - Improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of the systems you own. 
 - Identify technical weaknesses and proactively solve them. 
 - Become someone the team can trust with complex, ambiguous engineering challenges. Over time, we want you to become a defining technical contributor to the company. 

Why Join Ve?

Because you want to build technology that doesn't already exist. 

You'll work directly with the founder, influence fundamental architectural decisions, and help shape a product from its earliest stages. 

You'll have the opportunity to work on some of the most interesting problems in AI-native computing - intelligent agents, autonomous execution, developer tools, and new forms of human-computer interaction. 

No unnecessary engineering bureaucracy. 

No narrowly defined responsibilities. 

No endless layers of approvals. 

Just difficult problems, talented people, real ownership, and the opportunity to build something extraordinary. 

We're looking for engineers who want to do the most important work of their careers. 

How to Apply

Please share: 

- Your GitHub profile or examples of meaningful technical work. 
 - The most complex system you've personally designed and built. 
 - A difficult engineering problem you solved independently. 
 - One example of something you've shipped and owned in production. 
 - Why you're interested in building AI-native software at Ve. 

We're far more interested in what you've actually built than where you've worked. 

Minimum 4 years of experience. Exceptional engineering ability. Complete ownership.

About the Organisation & Role: 

You will be part of the Consumer Experience Engineering organisation responsible for building fast, intuitive, accessible and premium digital experiences across web and mobile. The organisation owns the web & mobile platforms, engineering delivery for consumer-facing journeys, shared design systems, performance, accessibility and AI-native engineering practices that help product teams deliver consistent, reusable, high-quality consumer experiences across the globe. 

The Lead Engineer (Web) is responsible for defining frontend architecture, providing technical leadership, and delivering scalable, reliable, accessible, and high-performing consumer-facing digital experiences.

 - Drive frontend performance engineering with a strong focus on Core Web Vitals and real-user experience. 
 - Define strategies for rendering, code splitting, lazy loading, asset optimisation, caching, and bundle management. 
 - Apply CDN and edge technologies to improve application performance, scalability, and global availability. 
 - Ensure digital experiences meet WCAG accessibility standards and inclusive design principles. 
 - Partner with UX and Design teams to develop reusable components and evolve enterprise design systems.

Mentor frontend engineers and provide technical guidance on architecture, design, coding, testing, and troubleshooting

- 10+ years of software engineering experience with significant expertise in frontend application development. 
 - 3+ years of experience leading a technical capability, project or engineering team. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in ReactJS, TypeScript, JavaScript, Next. js, and GraphQL. 
 - Deep understanding of browser fundamentals, rendering behaviour, web standards, and frontend application lifecycles. 
 - Proven expertise in frontend system design, application architecture, and modern engineering patterns. 
 - Experience designing scalable, modular, reliable, secure, and maintainable frontend applications. 
 - Strong knowledge of server-side rendering, static generation, client-side rendering, and hybrid rendering strategies. 
 - Strong understanding of application state management, data-fetching, caching, and synchronisation patterns. 
 - Experience designing reusable components, shared libraries, and scalable frontend platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of secure frontend development, authentication, authorization, and consumer data protection. 
 - Proven experience improving Core Web Vitals, page-load performance, responsiveness, and runtime efficiency. 
 - Strong knowledge of CDN, edge computing, browser caching, asset optimisation, and content delivery strategies. 
 - Strong understanding of consumer journeys, conversion optimisation, personalization, and digital experience quality. 
 - Practical knowledge of WCAG standards, semantic HTML, keyboard accessibility, and assistive technology compatibility. 
 - Experience with experimentation platforms, feature flags and A/B testing. 
 - Strong understanding of design systems, reusable component libraries, responsive design, and UX engineering principles. 
 - Proven ability to influence architecture and engineering practices across multiple teams without direct authority. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, communication, technical leadership, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills. 
 - Experience designing or delivering headless and composable commerce solutions is preferred. 
 - Proven ability to drive architectural decisions, influence technical direction and mentor engineers. 
 - Experience using coding agents, LLMs or AI-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery and developer productivity. 
 - Experience in eCommerce, retail, or consumer digital products is strongly preferred. 

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. data.description:
Who We Are

At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support. 

Bluehost is in growth mode, and this role is part of the team building the next generation of AI-powered customer experiences. You'll work across the stack, from React front ends to Java/Spring Boot services, APIs, data layers, and AI/LLM integrations. You'll have the opportunity to design and ship production systems while developing strong skills in system design, scalability, reliability, and AI engineering. 

What You'll Do & How You'll Make Your Mark

- Build and ship AI-powered, customer-facing experiences, integrating React with scalable Java/Spring Boot backend services and AI/LLM capabilities. 
 - Work across the stack, building React experiences backed by Java/Spring Boot services, REST APIs, databases, and AI/LLM services. 
 - Build production AI features using LLM/model APIs, tool/function calling, and agentic workflows where appropriate. 
 - Translate product requirements into clean, maintainable, well-tested code, including unit, integration, and API tests across frontend, backend, and AI components. 
 - Participate actively in code review and pull-request discussions, both giving and receiving feedback that sharpens the whole team's craft 
 - Debug and resolve production issues across frontend, Java services, APIs, databases, and AI components using logs, tracing, browser tooling, and monitoring dashboards. 
 - Ship features that reach small-business customers directly, in an Agile/Scrum cadence with real sprint ownership 
 - Contribute to a fast-moving, modernizing codebase while identifying opportunities to improve architecture, scalability, reliability, AI quality, and developer experience. 
 - Participate in technical design and architecture decisions, considering scalability, reliability, latency, cost, security, data flow, caching, asynchronous processing, and failure handling. 

Who You Are & What You'll Need To Succeed

- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, ideally building customer-facing production systems. 
 - Strong proficiency in React, including hooks, component composition, state management, and building production-quality user experiences. 
 - Solid grasp of modern JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3 fundamentals, with strong proficiency in Java and object-oriented programming. 
 - Strong understanding of REST APIs and backend services, with the ability to design, consume, debug, and trace issues end-to-end across frontend, Java services, databases, and AI integrations. 
 - Hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot, including building production-grade REST APIs and backend services. 
 - Strong understanding of system design fundamentals, including API design, databases, caching, asynchronous processing, messaging/queues, scalability, reliability, observability, and distributed-system tradeoffs. 
 - Ability to reason about AI and system-design tradeoffs across quality, latency, cost, scalability, reliability, and security. 
 - Hands-on experience building production applications using Generative AI/LLMs, with experience in one or more of RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt engineering, tool/function calling, agents, or LLM evaluation. 
 - AI-augmented delivery: you use AI across the delivery lifecycle, not just code generation, and can say which models suit which problems and where you don't use them. You review AI-generated code knowing its failure modes, and you work within clear boundaries for what customer data enters a prompt and what a security or compliance review will ask for. 
 - Bonus: experience with Python, TypeScript, SQL, AWS/Azure/GCP, Kafka, Redis, vector databases, AI/ML frameworks, LLM evaluation/observability, or AI application frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph. 

Why You'll Love Us

 - Work-life balance. Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.

Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20 + affinity groups where you can network and connect with Newfolders globally.
