data.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are

At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support. 

As Bluehost scales from millions toward tens of millions of customers, DevOps is the team that makes sure every other team can ship fast without breaking things. You'll own the pipelines, cloud-native infrastructure, and observability that keep our platform fast, safe, and reliable, modernizing legacy pieces along the way and using AI tooling to move faster than a team our size normally could. 

What You'll Do & How You'll Make Your Mark

- Design, build, and operate Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure across AWS, GCP, Azure, and/or OCI, covering compute, storage, networking, and IAM 
 - Own Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, version-controlled in Git and aligned with team-wide best practices across environments 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and Argo (CD/Workflows), automating build, test, and release for dozens of services 
 - Drive release and deployment management practices, including progressive rollouts, rollback strategy, and change management that reduces risk without slowing teams down 
 - Configure and harden web servers (Apache/Nginx), virtual hosts, and SSL/TLS across environments 
 - Build out observability, metrics, tracing, and log aggregation (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki), with real alerting that catches issues before customers do 
 - Use AI across the delivery lifecycle - scripting, infrastructure code, root-cause investigation, and runbooks - and set the guardrails the team works inside: how generated infrastructure code gets reviewed before it touches production, how provenance and licensing are checked, and what customer or secret data may enter a prompt 
 - Own networking fundamentals in production: TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls (iptables/nftables), and load balancing across cloud and on-prem environments 
 - Carry on-call rotation, lead incident response, and turn postmortems into concrete reliability improvements

Who You Are & What You'll Need To Succeed

- 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering roles 
 - Deep, hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containerization (Docker), and cloud-native architecture patterns 
 - Strong Infrastructure as Code experience (Terraform) plus configuration management tooling (Ansible or Puppet) 
 - Proven experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and Argo, or comparable GitOps tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) 
 - Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, firewall rules, and load balancing in cloud and on-prem environments 
 - Familiarity with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki) and building alerting that's actually actionable 
 - AI-augmented delivery: you use AI across the delivery lifecycle, not just script generation, and can say which models suit which problems and where you don't use them. You review AI-generated infrastructure code and automation knowing its failure modes, and you have set the guardrails others work inside - review expectations for generated code, provenance and licensing checks, and clear boundaries for what customer or secret data enters a prompt and what a security or compliance review will ask for. 
 - Strong Bash and Python scripting ability, with public cloud experience across AWS, GCP, Azure, or OCI 
 - Working knowledge of Linux security fundamentals: TLS, SSH hardening, patch management, and IAM in cloud environments

Why you'll love us. 

- We've evolved: We provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work-from-home, hybrid, or work-from-the-office environment. 
 - Work-life balance: Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well. 
 - We celebrate one another's differences: We're proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with employees globally. 
 - We care about you: At Bluehost, taking care of our employees is our top priority. We make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community with one domain at a time, one employee at a time. 
 - Where can we take you? We're fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with Bluehost #OTOD!

About Us: 

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. 

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers-ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies-depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. 

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View) APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture-recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years-emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. 

What It's Like to Work at YipitData: 

YipitData isn't a place for coasting-it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. 

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: 

- Ownership That Matters: You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
 - Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
 - Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
 - Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high-always with purpose and intention

Who Thrives Here?

We hire sprinters, not coasters-people who: 

- Choose growth over comfort
 - Lead through challenges
 - Are energized by high expectations

It's not for everyone, and that's intentional. If your ambition is matched by your work ethic-and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm-YipitData might be the opportunity you've been waiting for. 

About The Role: 

SpendHound is a SaaS spend management platform that helps finance, operations, and procurement teams understand and manage their software and cloud spend. Our product collects and organizes vendor, invoice, contract, receipt, and transaction data from different sources, including ERP and accounting systems, customer emails, and AI-generated datasets. 

We are seeking a Data QA Associate to join our team in India to manage a large portion of the data cleaning and quality assurance processes for this product. As a Data QA Associate, you will be responsible for transforming raw financial and accounting data into accurate business expense insights. You will review transactions and accounting records, validate expense categories, identify bad cases, investigate the root causes of data issues, and help improve the rules and processes used to maintain data quality. 

You will work with a top-notch engineering team and data team from the U. S. and China. You'll complete your work primarily using data in our proprietary software. This position offers the opportunity to meaningfully contribute to the growth of our company. Exceptional employees may have the opportunity to be promoted and manage a team of other Data QA Associate. 

- This is a fully remote role based in India. 
 - Working hours: 8 am - 5 pm IST
 - In general, we expect some overlap with Chinese or U. S. work hours. More details on work-hour expectations will be shared during the recruiting process. 
 - We expect hires to start in the position as soon as possible, and no later than June, 2025

As our Data QA associate, you will: 

- Review and validate accounting data exported from ERP systems, including vendor, invoice, bill, payment, and transaction records. 
 - Apply accounting knowledge to understand different bookkeeping patterns and determine how transactions should be reflected in expense data. 
 - Review and correct vendor and spend category mappings. 
 - Identify and resolve duplicated, incomplete, or inconsistent records. 
 - Investigate data quality issues and collaborate with data and engineering teams to improve data processing rules. 
 - Ensure that the final data is accurate and reliable for business expense analysis. 
 - Ensure compliance with company data security and confidentiality policies. 

You Are Likely To Succeed If you have: 

- Bachelor's degree or above. Majors in Accounting, Finance, Business, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field are preferred. 
 - 0-2 years of hands-on accounting or bookkeeping experience, including relevant internship experience. Or 0 - 2 years of experience as a data or quality assurance analyst in finance data. 
 - Experience with accounting processes such as transaction categorization, invoice processing, expense review, account reconciliation, accounts payable, accounts receivable, or general ledger entries. 
 - Hands-on experience using at least one mainstream ERP, accounting, or expense management system, such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, QuickBooks Online (QBO), Ramp, Xero, or a similar system. 
 - Familiarity with accounting standards, the ability to distinguish the company's accounting categories, and an understanding of company accounting records. 
 - Experience managing multiple processes in parallel. 
 - Basic data analysis skills and familiarity with Excel, SQL, or Python are a plus. 
 - Exceptional attention to detail, problem-solving, and critical thinking abilities. 
 - Ability to work independently while coordinating with a remote team. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to interact effectively with clients, vendors, and internal teams across time zones and cultures. 

What We Offer: 

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary: 

- We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, parental leave, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
 - Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. 

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Description

Do you want to revolutionize how millions of Amazonians worldwide receive HR support? Are you passionate about building intelligent, AI-powered solutions that transform employee experiences? Do you want to work on a platform that combines AWS services with generative AI to deliver personalized, efficient HR support at Amazon scale? If so, we invite you to join the PXT Case Management team within HR Experience and Technologies org. 

Key job responsibilities

You will collaborate with senior engineers (SDE-IIIs and L5s) to implement components of our 3-year architecture plans while gaining deeper understanding of system design and architectural patterns. You'll be responsible for driving individual projects from design to delivery, making data-driven decisions to balance technical debt with business needs. You will have opportunities to mentor SDE-I engineers on coding practices and technical implementation while receiving mentorship from senior team members to grow your technical and leadership skills. You'll work closely with SDMs and PMs to break down complex requirements into executable tasks and contribute to technical discussions that shape team-level solutions. Additionally, you'll be expected to demonstrate ownership of your work by maintaining high standards for code quality, participating in on-call rotations, and continuously improving our operational excellence. 

A day in the life

- Write maintainable, well-structured, and testable code to advance your in-flight project and submit a code review to the team
 - Design a system to solve an Amazon scale problem and present a design document to the team to build consensus on your recommended approach
 - Attend a team-level operations review meeting to understand system health and identify actions we need to take to keep the system available for our clients
 - Meet with a customer to understand the problems they are facing, brainstorm solutions, and discuss with your management to affect team priorities
 - Review a teammate's code change and raise the bar on team code quality by providing insightful comments
 - Research new technologies that could help simplify your team's system and draft a message to the team with your findings
 - Root cause and resolve a trouble ticket filed by a customer of your system
 - Attend a one to one meeting with your manager to receive support on your work and discuss career development

About The Team

PXT Case Management System (PXT CMS) is Amazon's first-party HR case management platform, launched in 2022. It powers HR support for more than 1. 5 million Amazonians worldwide - corporate, operations, and everything in between. Every day the platform processes over 120, 000 new cases and 700, 000 updates across 23+ HR business domains, from onboarding and leave to benefits and payroll. 

We are building the next generation of the platform: an AI-native case orchestration system that lets HR business teams automate routine work through configurable workflows and AI agent skills, so advisors and HR partners can spend their time on the moments that need human judgment. 

We are a senior, engineering-driven team with a strong bias for ownership, deep customer empathy, and craft. We move fast, dive deep on hard problems, and treat AI as a first-class tool for reshaping how HR support gets delivered at Amazon scale. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

data.title: Engineering Manager - Nonlinear Productivity (Friction Elimination & Solutions)
data.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 

- Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

An Overview Of This Role

As Manager, Engineering, Nonlinear Productivity (Friction Elimination & Solutions), you'll help GitLab break the linear relationship between headcount and engineering output. In this role, you'll oversee the initiative's forward-scanning work, reviewing GitLab's software development lifecycle and code-generation workflows to spot recurring friction, test durable fixes, and identify internal solutions that could become customer-facing products. 

You'll report to the Senior Manager or Director, Nonlinear Productivity and work at the intersection of engineering, developer productivity, AI-assisted development, and product. You'll build a data-backed view of where technical interventions can have the highest leverage, test solutions through prototypes, drive validated fixes into internal adoption, and help build the case for productizing the strongest outcomes. 

What You'll Do

- Survey GitLab's internal software development lifecycle and code-generation workflows to identify structural friction early, and build a data-backed view of where technical interventions will have the highest leverage. 
 - Evaluate build, buy, and adapt options for each opportunity, including emerging agentic and AI tooling, with a clear view of cost, risk, and durability. 
 - Stand up prototypes and review architecture directly to test whether a proposed fix moves a target metric and represents a durable solution before GitLab makes broader engineering investment. 
 - Hire and manage a small, high-caliber team, or operate as a hands-on working manager, with a focus on talent density over headcount. 
 - Drive validated fixes from prototype to internal adoption by partnering with affected teams so solutions are relied on, used, and maintained. 
 - Build the technical and business case for productizing internal fixes that prove durable, in partnership with product. 
 - Document reusable learnings so successful internal fixes don't remain tribal knowledge. 
 - Report impact through changes in key metrics and progress on turning internal fixes into products, including a clear account of what didn't work. 

What You'll Bring

- Ability to use GitLab. 
 - A track record of identifying and shipping technical fixes for developer productivity, continuous integration and continuous delivery, or platform friction, including problems you found before they were assigned. 
 - Comfort operating with high ambiguity and no existing backlog, building the roadmap rather than executing one handed down. 
 - People management experience, including in a small-team or working-manager capacity. 
 - Technical depth to evaluate and prototype solutions directly, not only direct others toward them. 
 - Product judgment to assess whether an internal tool could hold up for paying customers. 
 - Familiarity with agentic or AI-assisted development tooling. 
 - Experience moving an internal tool toward an external, customer-facing product is advantageous. 

About The Team

The Nonlinear Productivity team improves how GitLab engineers, and increasingly agents, build, review, and ship code. We test and scale durable technical fixes that improve our internal engineering output. 

Career ladder

In this role, you can progress to Senior Manager, Nonlinear Productivity, with an expanded mandate across the full set of team metrics we use to track improvement. 

Additional details about our process can be found on our hiring page. 

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

 - Flexible Paid Time Off 
 - Team Member Resource Groups

 - Growth and Development Fund
 - Parental Leave

Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

data.title: Application Tech Lead - .NET
data.description:
Avanade is the world's leading Microsoft expert, helping more than 7, 000 organizations modernize securely and scale AI using Microsoft technology, faster. Founded by Microsoft and Accenture, and operating as Microsoft's Client Zero, Avanade brings deep expertise and proven delivery to simplify complexity, accelerate innovation, and deliver measurable results. 

Together with Accenture, Avanade combines global scale with expertise in AI, cloud, data, cybersecurity, and ERP to design solutions that put people first. With 60, 000 Microsoft professionals worldwide, 165, 000 certifications, and the largest community of Microsoft MVPs, Avanade has spent more than 25 years helping organizations unlock the full potential of people and technology to create lasting impact for clients, employees, and communities. 

Role Summary

Avanade India's Applications & Engineering practice is looking for an Application Technical Lead to own the technical delivery of . NET applications for our clients. This is a hands-on role - the person in it designs the solution, writes code alongside the team, reviews what others produce, and is accountable for what ships. 

You will lead a team of four to five engineers through build and release, own the engineering standards and the Azure DevOps pipelines that enforce them, and lead modernisation work from . NET Framework to modern . NET. We also expect you to be fluent with LLM-based development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code - using them to raise the team's productivity and code quality, and setting sensible rules for how they are used on client work. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end technical delivery of . NET applications - technical design, build, code quality, testing, release and production readiness. 
 - Lead a team of four to five engineers: allocating work, reviewing code and designs, unblocking the team and holding the quality of what is delivered. 
 - Design and develop applications hands-on in C# and . NET - ASP. NET Core, Web API, microservices and service integrations. 
 - Lead migration and modernisation of legacy . NET Framework applications to . NET Core / modern . NET - assessment, dependency and package analysis, migration approach, incremental cutover and regression testing. 
 - Apply LLM-based development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or equivalent) across the lifecycle - code generation, refactoring, test generation, legacy code comprehension and documentation - and set the team's standards for their safe and effective use on client code. 
 - Build and run CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps - multi-stage YAML, build and release gates, approvals, artifact and environment management, automated testing and continuous delivery to higher environments. 
 - Define and enforce engineering standards: branching strategy, pull request and code review discipline, unit and integration test coverage, static analysis and security scanning. 
 - Design and optimise data access and database interaction - SQL Server or Azure SQL, Entity Framework Core, query tuning and caching. 
 - Work with cloud and platform teams on deployment architecture - Azure App Service, Functions, containers and AKS, Key Vault, configuration and secrets. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve performance, reliability and production issues, and drive root-cause fixes rather than workarounds. 
 - Run technical design discussions with architects, business analysts and client technical stakeholders, and explain and defend design decisions. 
 - Plan and estimate work with the project manager - breakdown, sizing, sprint planning and realistic commitments - and report technical progress and risk. 
 - Mentor and uplift engineers on . NET, engineering practice and AI-assisted development, and support hiring and technical interviews. 
 - Contribute reusable components, templates, pipeline accelerators and reference implementations to the practice IP library. 
 - Support presales where needed - technical approach, effort estimation and client technical discussions. 

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience

- 8-10 years of overall experience in application development, with a substantial recent focus on Microsoft . NET. 
 - Deep hands-on expertise in C#, . NET Framework and . NET Core / modern . NET - ASP. NET Core, Web API, dependency injection, asynchronous programming and design patterns. 
 - Proven experience migrating . NET Framework applications to . NET Core / modern . NET, including assessment, dependency resolution, refactoring and phased cutover. 
 - Hands-on experience using LLM-based coding tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code in real project delivery, with judgement about where they help, how to review their output and how to use them safely on client code. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading a team of four to five engineers on delivery - work allocation, code review, mentoring and accountability for quality. 
 - Strong Azure DevOps capability: multi-stage YAML pipelines, build and release pipelines, environments, approvals, artifact management and continuous delivery; equivalent GitHub Actions experience is acceptable alongside Azure DevOps. 
 - Solid Git discipline - branching strategy, pull requests and meaningful code review. 
 - Strong grounding in SQL Server or Azure SQL and Entity Framework Core, including performance tuning. 
 - Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating with external systems. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure application services - App Service, Functions, Key Vault, storage and application monitoring. 
 - Experience with automated testing - unit, integration and the role of testing in the pipeline. 
 - Strong communication skills, including running technical discussions with client stakeholders and translating technical risk into plain language. 
 - Based in Bengaluru or Delhi NCR, or willing to relocate. 

Preferred / Good To Have

- Front-end development experience with React or Angular, and the ability to guide full-stack delivery. 
 - Experience with containers and Kubernetes (Docker, AKS), and with microservices architecture at scale. 
 - Microsoft certifications: Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204), DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400) or Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305). 
 - Experience building AI features into applications - Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, agents or RAG patterns. 
 - Exposure to the Microsoft Power Platform or Dynamics 365 alongside custom . NET development. 
 - Experience with infrastructure as code (Bicep or Terraform) for application environments. 
 - Experience with legacy modernisation beyond . NET - monolith decomposition, re-platforming or re-architecting older systems. 
 - Experience in a consulting, global delivery or SI environment with distributed teams. 
 - Prior contribution to accelerators, reusable frameworks or practice-building initiatives

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Work Flows
data.description:
What Cognite is: Relentless to achieve

Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI, and data solutions that solve the world's hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements. 

We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you'll feel right at home here. 

Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future. 

About The Role

We're seeking a Senior Software Engineer who excels at building high-performance distributed systems and thrives in a fast-paced startup environment. You'll be working on cutting-edge data infrastructure challenges that directly impact how Fortune 500 industrial companies manage their most critical operational data. 

How you'll demonstrate Ownership

- Platform Ownership: Design, build, and operate the core serverless execution engine and Workflows orchestration layer that serve as foundational primitives for CDF's AI and automation capabilities. 
 - Reliability Engineering: Own uptime, latency SLOs, and incident response for platform services ensuring Functions execute deterministically and Workflows progress without data loss or silent failures. 
 - Scalability: Architect for multi-tenant & multi-cloud, high-throughput workloads. Design scheduling, queueing, and retry mechanisms that degrade gracefully under pressure. 
 - API Design: Define and evolve clean API-first architecture, versioned REST and event-driven APIs that downstream engineering teams and external customers depend on. 
 - Observability: Instrument services with distributed tracing, structured logging, and alerting (Open-telemetry / Prometheus / Grafana / Honeycomb stack) so failures surface before customers notice. 
 - CI/CD & Testing: Champion test automation - unit, integration, and smoke tests and maintain deployment pipelines that ship to production with confidence. 
 - Performance: Profile and resolve bottlenecks in execution throughput, cold-start latencies, and cross-service call chains driving a "snappy" platform experience for industrial workloads. 
 - Cost Efficiency (Bonus): Model compute and storage costs for functions execution; identify and implement optimizations that reduce cloud spend without sacrificing reliability. 

The Impact you bring to Cognite

- 6-8 Years of Engineering: Proven track record building and operating production backend services at scale. 
 - Expertise: Deep mastery of JVM languages (Kotlin preferred, Java acceptable), Python(FastAPI), distributed systems patterns, and cloud-native service design (Kubernetes, Azure, GCP, AWS, Private cloud). 
 - Workflow & Orchestration: Hands-on experience with workflow engines (Conductor, Apache Airflow, or equivalent) and event-driven architectures (Kafka, Pub/Sub). 
 - Data & Storage: Comfortable working with relational databases (PostgreSQL) & non-relational databases, object storage(Data-lakes), and caching layers (Redis) in multi-tenant environments. 
 - Observability Stack: Practical experience with Open-telemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana for instrumentation and operational insight. 
 - ML Platform Exposure: experience supporting ML workloads & notebooks in production, whether through job scheduling, resource management, experiment tracking integration, or model serving infrastructure. 
 - Contextualisation Domain (Bonus): Familiarity with industrial knowledge graph construction, entity resolution, or NLP/CV pipelines as they relate to industrial asset data is a strong differentiator. 
 - Full-Stack Awareness (Bonus): Familiarity with React or TypeScript is a plus for consuming and dogfooding your own platform's developer tooling. 
 - The Platform Thinking Spirit: A passion for building composable, well-documented, and automated platform systems that empower other engineers including ML engineers to build faster. 

Good to have

ML Platform & Contextualisation

- ML Workload Support: Build and extend platform primitives compute scheduling, environment management, and secrets handling, that enable ML engineers to run model training, fine-tuning, and batch inference jobs reliably. 
 - Contextualisation Pipelines: Support the engineering infrastructure behind Cognite's Contextualisation capabilities (entity matching, asset hierarchy inference, P&ID parsing) by ensuring the platform can orchestrate long-running, GPU-aware, and data-intensive ML workflows without manual intervention. 
 - Vector & Embedding Infrastructure (Bonus): Familiarity with serving or storing vector embeddings to support semantic search and RAG-based contextualisation use cases. 
 - Model Lifecycle Awareness: Understand model versioning, A/B experiment tracking, and the boundary between platform concerns and ML framework concerns, so the platform stays lean while ML teams stay unblocked. 

Learn More About Us

- Impact 2025
 - Cognite's Industrial AI: Moonshot
 - We're globally recognized domain experts with an international presence that spans Phoenix, Houston, Oslo Tokyo, Bengaluru, and Abu Dhabi. 

Equal Opportunity

Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.

data.title: Principal Pre-Silicon Firmware Lead
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. 

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications. 

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About The Role

We are seeking a Principal Pre-Silicon Firmware Lead to architect and implement low-level software for our next-generation microcontrollers/ SoCs. You will bridge the gap between hardware architecture and final software delivery. You will own the pre-silicon development lifecycle-including driver development for CAN/CAN-FD/CAN XL stacks -using high-performance enterprise emulation environments and ensures hardware-software co-design that satisfies strict ISO 26262 safety and high-quality engineering frameworks up to ASIL-D. 

What You'll Achieve

Technical Leadership & Hardware Co-Design

- Drive firmware architecture and technical roadmaps for in-house microcontroller/ SOCs. 
 - Align development milestones with SoC architecture, RTL design, verification, and post-silicon validation teams. 
 - Provide technical mentorship and enforce rigorous coding standards (MISRA C/C++). 
 - Author comprehensive design specifications, firmware architecture documentation, and test strategies. 

Pre-Silicon Validation & Emulation

- Develop early boot code, low-level drivers, and runtime firmware targeting pre-silicon environments. 
 - Lead virtual bring-up and hardware-software co-verification using both enterprise emulation platforms like Cadence Palladium/ Synopsys ZeBu. 
 - Optimize firmware execution speed
 - Debug complex, deep-silicon anomalies using JTAG/SWD debuggers, logic analysers, and internal emulator trace features. 

Communication Drivers & Protocols

- Design, implement, and optimize highly robust peripheral drivers for CAN, CAN-FD, and CAN XL. 
 - Develop and maintain critical application layer protocols, featuring standard diagnostics (ISO 14229), network management, and heavy-duty diagnostic framing fault handling. 
 - Design, implement and Integrate communication driver stacks into industry standard layers (e. g. , AUTOSAR MCAL interfaces). 
 - Deep knowledge of priority-based identifier arbitration, bit-stuffing mechanisms, and cyclical redundancy check (CRC) validation

Safety & Quality Compliance

- Enforce absolute compliance with ISO 26262 safety requirements. 
 - Participate in safety analyses (FMEA, root cause analysis) to ensure driver-level fault-handling routines are deterministic. 

About You

- Bachelor's degree with 8 years or Master's degree with 6 years of experience in embedded firmware development, specifically within the embedded semiconductor or safety-critical industry
 - 3+ years acting as a Technical Lead or Principal Engineer guiding architectural decisions and mentoring engineering teams. 
 - Expert proficiency in Embedded C with strict adherence to MISRA guidelines. 
 - Deep knowledge of embedded MCU/SoC architectures, including ARM Cortex-M/R or multi-core safety architectures. 
 - Direct hands-on experience with hardware emulation platforms, specifically Cadence Palladium and/or Synopsys ZeBu systems
 - Authoritative understanding of industrial fieldbus architectures (ISO 11898 standard family), physical/data link layers, priority-based identifier arbitration, bit-stuffing mechanisms, and diagnostic implementations
 - Proficient with professional embedded pipelines, including ARM compiler toolchains, JTAG debuggers (e. g. , Lauterbach), and emulation control scripts
 - Experience with ISO 26262 functional safety requirements up to ASIL-D
 - Understanding of HSM/SHE concepts and secure boot requirements

Harness brings AI and automation to this "outer loop, " helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle. 

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform. 

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9. 1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2. 8B in cloud spend - enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

data.title: Front-End Engineer II
data.description:
Description

READY TO DO SOMETHING BIG?

How would you build the next generation of experiences that help hundreds of thousands of sellers make smarter decisions about where, when, and how to send billions of products into Amazon's fulfillment network?

Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is a global service that gives sellers access to Amazon's world-class fulfillment and distribution network. Sellers-from large global brands to small businesses and entrepreneurs across 135 countries-rely on FBA to store their inventory, fulfill customer orders, and deliver products quickly and reliably to customers around the world. 

The FBA Placement organization is at the heart of this experience. We build intelligent systems and seller-facing experiences that determine how inventory enters and is distributed across Amazon's fulfillment network. Our products help sellers understand their inbound options and make decisions across cost, delivery speed, inventory placement, capacity, and operational constraints-while helping Amazon position inventory closer to customers. 

We are looking for a Front-End Engineer II to help build the next generation of FBA inbound and placement experiences. 

As a Front-End Engineer II, you will work at the intersection of customer experience and large-scale distributed systems. You will translate complex supply-chain decisions and optimization capabilities into simple, intuitive experiences that sellers can understand and act on. You will build responsive, performant, accessible, and maintainable web applications used by sellers around the world. 

You will collaborate closely with UX designers, product managers, software engineers, and science teams to take ideas from concept through launch. You will influence front-end architecture, establish reusable patterns and components, and raise the engineering bar for seller experiences across FBA. 

This is an opportunity to solve challenging customer and technical problems, influence the evolution of a global product, and build experiences that directly affect how billions of units move through Amazon's fulfillment network. 

Come join us and help build the future of FBA. 

Key job responsibilities

As a Front-End Engineer II, You Will

- Design, develop, test, and launch high-quality web experiences for FBA sellers worldwide. 
 - Translate complex workflows involving inventory placement, capacity, cost, and delivery options into simple and intuitive customer experiences. 
 - Work closely with UX designers and product managers to turn customer needs and product concepts into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Own significant front-end features and components from design through implementation, launch, measurement, and continuous improvement. 
 - Build reusable UI components, frameworks, and patterns that improve consistency and accelerate development across FBA experiences. 
 - Make sound architectural and technology decisions for large-scale front-end applications while balancing near-term delivery with long-term maintainability. 
 - Integrate front-end experiences with APIs and distributed backend services, designing gracefully for latency, failures, asynchronous operations, and changing data. 
 - Deliver responsive, performant, secure, and accessible experiences across browsers, devices, marketplaces, and seller workflows. 
 - Apply strong computer science and software engineering fundamentals to write simple, extensible, testable, and maintainable code. 
 - Improve engineering quality through code reviews, automated testing, observability, operational excellence, and continuous improvements to development practices. 
 - Investigate customer and operational issues across the full application stack and drive them to resolution. 
 - Collaborate with engineers across FBA and Amazon to influence technical direction and deliver experiences spanning multiple systems and organizations. 
 - Mentor other engineers, contribute to engineering best practices, and help raise the technical bar of the team. 

A day in the life

You might start your day reviewing customer feedback and operational metrics for a recently launched seller experience. You could then work with a UX designer and product manager to refine a new workflow that helps sellers understand their inventory placement and delivery options. 

Later, you may collaborate with backend and science engineers to define an API contract for a new optimization capability, review a teammate's design or code change, and spend focused development time building and testing a new experience. 

The problems we solve often span UX, front-end architecture, distributed services, and complex supply-chain decisions. You will have significant ownership over how those capabilities ultimately come together as a simple experience for our sellers. 

About The Team

The FBA Placement organization owns the technology that determines where and when seller inventory enters Amazon's fulfillment network. 

Our systems evaluate factors including fulfillment cost, customer delivery speed, available capacity, seller preferences, and network constraints to provide sellers with inbound options and recommendations. These decisions have significant impact on both the seller experience and Amazon's fulfillment network. 

Our front-end experiences are where these sophisticated optimization systems become tangible for sellers. Our goal is to make complex supply-chain decisions understandable and actionable-helping sellers confidently choose the right inbound options without needing to understand the complexity of the systems operating behind them. 

We are a multidisciplinary organization spanning front-end and backend engineering, product, UX, and applied science. We operate with a high degree of ownership and encourage engineers to influence both the customer experience and the underlying technical architecture. 

If you enjoy turning complex problems into simple customer experiences, building products at global scale, and working across the full technology stack, FBA Placement offers a unique opportunity to make an impact. 

Basic Qualifications

- 2+ years of non-internship professional front end, web or mobile software development using JavaScript, HTML and CSS experience
 - 4+ years of computer science fundamentals (object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, problem solving and complexity analysis) experience
 - Experience using JavaScript frameworks such as angular and react

Preferred Qualifications

- 1+ years of agile software development methodology experience
 - Experience with common front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JS, TypeScript, and Node

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.title: Mobile Engineer
data.description:
About Uplevyl

Uplevyl builds AI-powered knowledge and community infrastructure for organizations serving women. Our products include UpGenie (our domain-specific AI assistant), WeHub (our community platform), and UpSocial (a social platform for women). We work with mission-driven partners to turn complex, high-stakes information into clear, trustworthy guidance, and to build systems that create lasting impact. 

We hold a simple conviction: in high-stakes domains like rights, law, and financial security, a generic AI is not enough. The answers people stake their lives and livelihoods on need a purpose-built system with verified, native data. That is what we build, and it is why the work is urgent. AI is reshaping how the world learns, works, and earns, and the women we serve cannot afford to be left off that train. 

We have also made a deliberate choice about how we build: a small team of exceptional people, paid well above market, each doing work that would normally take several. We would rather be ten people who move the world than thirty who move paper. That choice sets the bar for every hire, including this one. 

About the role

The Mobile Engineer works with product, design and backend engineers in a small team, with responsibility for reliable delivery and maintainable code. 

This is a full-time, on-site role based in our Noida office. 

What you'll own  

- Build and maintain React Native and TypeScript interfaces for iOS and Android, including navigation, state and platform-specific integration. 
 - Implement mobile authentication flows against agreed services, handle deep links, and integrate notifications with backend engineers. 
 - Handle slow connections, failed requests, lifecycle transitions and accessible layouts on smaller devices. 
 - Contribute to build automation, signing, store submissions, release monitoring and staged delivery. 
 - Write focused tests, diagnose device-specific defects, and review code and implementation notes. Backend engineers own identity policy, account linking, server authorization and notification delivery services. The Mobile Engineer owns client integration and coordinates contracts. Release and compatibility decisions are made with the team. 

Who we're looking for

- React Native, TypeScript, component state, asynchronous work and navigation. 
 - Understanding of foreground, background and cold-start behavior, networking and mobile storage choices. 
 - Experience delivering and debugging a working mobile application; private demonstrations and equivalent project evidence are acceptable. 
 - Ability to inspect native build logs and investigate platform-specific issues. Senior candidates should have deeper release and native integration experience. Implementation candidates should deliver a coherent feature and explain its failure cases. Senior candidates should also coordinate lifecycle and navigation state, investigate production failures and explain release trade-offs. The level is agreed before assessment. 

Even better if

- You have experience with Swift or Kotlin. 
 - You have experience with secure storage libraries. 
 - You have experience with push notification integration. 
 - You have experience with accessibility testing. 
 - You have experience with low-end device profiling. 
 - You have experience with app release automation. Store links and public source code are helpful but not mandatory. 

Before you apply

The hiring exercises use fictional, general-purpose data and require no knowledge of the company's business domain. Our interview process works as follows: 

- An initial conversation covers shipped work, role expectations and the appropriate assessment track. 
 - You complete one take-home: Track A for implementation roles or Track B for senior roles. Track B does not require Track A. The track is agreed before it is sent. 
 - This is followed by a 60-minute technical review: 10 minutes of demo, 20 minutes of code walkthrough, 20 minutes on a small changed requirement and 10 minutes of discussion. 
 - You explain the submitted code and trade-offs. The reviewer may request a short independent explanation of a core concept; any tool restrictions will be disclosed before that segment. The suggested time cap is four hours for Track A and five hours for Track B. Stop at the cap and describe unfinished work. An incomplete submission is assessed on the evidence available. If local setup blocks progress, contact the recruiter for an equivalent supervised exercise. 

How we work at Uplevyl

We clarify requirements, communicate risks early, review changes and verify behavior before shipping. Engineers can use coding assistants and remain accountable for the code, tests and decisions they submit. 

- We finish what we start, and we do it well. We follow through on what we say we'll do, and we care about the difference our work makes. 
 - We listen before we decide. Before we act, we ask who it actually affects: a customer, a partner, a teammate, or the communities we serve. Trust here is built the plain way, by consistently showing up for people. 
 - We move with ownership and urgency. We don't wait for perfect information or for someone else to raise their hand. If something looks like it could go wrong, we say so early. We make the call, we move fast, and we hold a high bar for quality. 
 - We are better together than alone. We work across teams, say what we actually think, and go out of our way to help each other succeed. Leadership here is measured by the impact you create. 
 - We stay curious and keep learning, including how to use AI well. We hold ourselves to the bar we're building toward: questioning our own assumptions and using AI to think better and move faster.

data.description:
Req ID: 386632

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now. 

We are currently seeking a NetReveal Technical Lead to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN). 

NetReveal Technical Lead

We are seeking an experienced NetReveal Technical Lead to lead the technical implementation of a high-volume Transaction Monitoring migration. 

The role will own the NetReveal technical workstream, including historical data loading, profile generation, scenario execution, batch optimisation and technical readiness. The successful candidate will provide hands-on leadership to the development team and work closely with Product Owner, Data, Financial Crime, Testing, Architecture and Governance stakeholders. 

Key Responsibilities

Lead the end-to-end NetReveal technical workstream including interlocks with wider migration programme. 

Assess the existing NetReveal implementation, processing model, batch schedules and technical constraints. 

Define the technical approach for loading historical customer, account and transaction data. 

Design an efficient approach for loading data at scale and reduce the existing method from 20 to 30 days to 5 or 10 days. 

Define the strategy for customer profile creation, rebuild and reprofiling. 

Ensure sufficient transaction history is available to support scenario look-back periods. 

Evaluate alternative approaches to historical transaction and sequential batch processing. 

Lead the technical implementation of customer segmentation requirements. 

Agree the design and lead implementation of a process for customer matching and merging between TSB and Santander records. 

Assess the impact of the migration on existing NetReveal scenarios, profiles and processing windows. 

Lead performance tuning, batch optimisation and technical problem resolution. 

Provide technical direction to NetReveal developers. 

Review technical designs, code, configuration and deployment artefacts. 

Work with the Test Lead to define technically representative test scenarios. 

Agree data controls and certification approach. 

Produce technical documentation and evidence for design, risk and governance approval. 

Support cutover planning, implementation, reconciliation and post-migration assurance. 

Essential Experience

Extensive hands-on experience implementing or enhancing SymphonyAI NetReveal version 8 or later (version 9 preferred). 

Strong experience with the Transaction Monitoring SMBD engine using Spark; experience limited to the classic NetReveal TM engine will not be sufficient. 

Strong understanding of NetReveal data structures, profiling, segmentation, scenarios and batch processing. 

Experience with customer profile generation, large-scale reprofiling and migration using the TM SMBD Spark engine. 

Experience loading significant volumes of historical transaction data into NetReveal. 

Experience using and analysing Parquet files generated by the TM SMBD Spark engine for profile validation and migration activities. 

Strong understanding of AML Transaction Monitoring concepts. 

Experience with scenario look-back periods, behavioural monitoring and customer segmentation. 

Strong SQL and data analysis capability. 

Experience diagnosing performance issues and optimising batch processing. 

Experience working within a highly governed banking environment. 

Ability to lead technical delivery while remaining sufficiently hands-on.

data.description:
PRINCIPAL AI ARCHITECT

Generative AI, SLM Fine-Tuning & RAG Platforms

Location: Noida / Chennai

Role Level: Principal / Lead / Solution Architect

Employment: Full-time

Total Experience: 12+ years overall

Role Overview

Hands-on Principal AI Architect to design and operationalize domain SLM, RAG / GraphRAG, and multi-turn agentic solutions-from enterprise data ingestion and fine-tuning to low-latency serving, APIs, security, observability, HA/DR, and governance. 

Key Responsibilities

AI Architecture & SLM Development

- Own enterprise GenAI architecture and build domain SLMs using Gemma, Llama, Qwen, Phi, Mistral, or equivalent models. 
 - Deliver multi-turn operational workflows for triage, diagnosis, approval-gated remediation, validation, ticket updates, escalation, durable state, resumability, and loop prevention. Data Preparation & Ingestion

- Build event-driven and scheduled ingestion for PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, SharePoint, APIs, and approved email folders or attachments using change notifications, delta sync, checkpoints, and reconciliation. 
 - Implement idempotency, incremental reprocessing, OCR/parsing, deduplication, malware and PII/secret controls, metadata and ACL preservation, security-trimmed retrieval, durable queues, retries, dead-letter handling, lineage, freshness, and ingestion monitoring. Fine-Tuning & Alignment

- Lead SFT/instruction tuning, continued pretraining, domain adaptation, LoRA, QLoRA, DoRA, DPO/RLHF, knowledge distillation, quantization-aware optimization, and model compression. 
 - Engineer training datasets with cleaning, labeling, synthetic data, JSONL/chat formats, versioning, quality gates, and train/validation/test splits. RAG & Grounded AI

- Architect RAG with chunking, embeddings, hybrid dense/sparse search, metadata filtering, reranking, context assembly, citations, and grounded-ness evaluation using Qdrant or equivalent. 
 - Build GraphRAG with Neo4j/AuraDB, Amazon Neptune, etc. ; apply ontologies, entity resolution, graph traversal, subgraph retrieval, Cypher/open Cypher or Gremlin, and vector-graph hybrid retrieval for multi-hop reasoning and provenance. Inference Engineering & Model Serving

- Deliver low-latency serving with vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, TGI, or Triton using dynamic batching, paged attention, KV/prefix caching, speculative decoding, streaming, routing, autoscaling, and INT4/INT8/FP8, AWQ, or GPTQ quantization. 
 - Develop intelligent model routing across SLMs, specialist models, and frontier LLMs using rules, semantic or complexity classification, model cascades, and learned routing; select the lowest-cost model that meets task-fit, quality, latency, context, privacy, safety, region, and availability requirements, with budgets, token metering, caching, circuit breakers, fallback, and continuous evaluation of routing accuracy, escalation rate, cost per successful task, and quality or latency regression. 
 - Declare and test TTFT, inter-token and p50/p95/p99 end-to-end latency, tokens/second, requests/second, concurrency, queue time, error rate, GPU/KV-cache utilization, context and token limits, cost, and performance under sustained, burst, failover, and degraded modes. API, Platform & Production Operations

- Build OpenAI-compatible APIs with structured outputs, function/tool calling, orchestration, API gateway, authentication, RBAC/ACL, rate limits, quotas, secrets, and audit logging. 
 - Deploy through Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, and CI/CD across Azure/AWS/GCP with multi-node/multi-zone HA, load balancing, autoscaling, automated failover, graceful degradation, blue-green/rolling release, rollback, cross-region DR, backups, point-in-time recovery, and tested RTO/RPO. Evaluation, Security & Governance

- Define release gates for task success, Exact Match/F1, retrieval precision/recall, grounded-ness, citation coverage, hallucination/refusal, schema validity, safety, latency, throughput, availability, RTO/RPO, and cost. 
 - Implement layered guardrails across input, retrieval, dialogue, routing, tool execution, and output: prompt-injection/jailbreak defense, PII/secret masking, grounding checks, tool allowlists, least privilege, HITL/dual approval, blast-radius and retry limits, kill switches, and deterministic fallback. 
 - Establish OpenTelemetry-compatible model/agent tracing across sessions and turns for model/prompt versions, retrieval, graph paths, tool calls, guardrail decisions, approvals, tokens, cost, errors, and component latency; provide redacted dashboards, SLO alerts, drift/anomaly monitoring, continuous evaluation, trace replay, audit lineage, and rollback signals. 

Required Skills

Model Engineering

Python, PyTorch, Transformers, Hugging Face, TRL/PEFT, SFT, LoRA/QLoRA/DoRA, DPO/RLHF, BF16/FP16, DDP/FSDP/ DeepSpeed ZeRO, MLflow / W&B. 

RAG & GraphRAG

Chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, Qdrant, Neo4j/AuraDB, Amazon Neptune, etc. ; ontology, entity resolution, Cypher/Gremlin, vector-graph retrieval, grounding and citations. 

Inference & APIs

vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, TGI/Triton, batching, KV/prefix cache, speculative decoding, quantization, FastAPI / OpenAI-compatible APIs, structured output and tool calling; intelligent model routing using rules, semantic/complexity classifiers, cascades, cost-quality-latency policies, FinOps budgets, metering, fallback, and routing observability. 

Platform & Resilience

Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, CI/CD, Azure/AWS/GCP, multi-zone HA, cross-region DR, autoscaling, failover, backup/PITR, observability, RTO/RPO. 

Security & Quality

Layered guardrails, prompt-injection defense, PII/secrets, RBAC/ACL, HITL, auditability, Open Telemetry tracing, evaluation, drift monitoring, latency/throughput/cost SLOs. 

Experience & Qualifications

- 12+ years in software, data, platform, or AI engineering; 7+ years in AI/ML and 3+ years in GenAI, SLM, or RAG. 
 - Hands-on ownership of a production domain model or enterprise RAG platform, with strong architecture, stakeholder, and cross-functional leadership. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer science / AI&ML / Data Science / Engineering, or related discipline. 

Preferred Candidate Profile

Hands-on architect who combines deep model, retrieval, platform, security, and operations expertise to move enterprise GenAI from experimentation to governed, highly available production. 

Success Measures

- Production-ready SLM and RAG / GraphRAG platform with measurable grounded-ness, quality, latency, throughput, availability, safety, and cost. 
 - Repeatable ingestion, tuning, evaluation, deployment, rollback, HA/DR, guardrail, tracing, and monitoring pipelines with auditable lineage.

About Revun

Revun is the software platform and infrastructure layer behind modern property operations. 

The platform brings together CRM functionality, leasing workflows, maintenance operations, payments, owner and vendor payouts, communications, compliance, reporting, AI automation, staff dashboards, tenant/owner/vendor portals, third-party integrations, and multiple user roles into one connected operating system. 

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Software Architect / Technical Lead to take technical ownership of the platform, lead the engineering team, evaluate the existing technology, strengthen the architecture, and help move the product toward a stable commercial launch. 

About The Role

This is not a purely advisory architecture position.

Job Overview

The AVP, AI/ML Engineering, Tech Lead is a senior technical leader responsible for architecting, building, and operationalizing the AI systems that will transform LPL's advisor, client, and operational experiences. 

This role guides the engineering of LLM-driven applications, agentic AI systems, autonomous workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and the enterprise Knowledge Graph, all built within a scalable, governed, cloud-native environment. Operating within the AI/ML Engineering organization, this leader sets technical direction for how LPL builds production-quality AI-leveraging AWS Bedrock, generative model ecosystems, and modern ML tooling. 

Responsibilities

- AI/ML Architecture & Agentic System Design: Architect and lead implementation of agentic AI systems capable of multi-step reasoning, tool use, workflow orchestration, and domain-specific autonomy. Build LLM-based agents that interact with APIs, data products, and enterprise systems to drive intelligent automation and decision support. Design orchestration layers that incorporate memory, context management, and dynamic planning for advanced agent behaviours. Develop RAG architectures that integrate embeddings, vector search, and semantic retrieval into agentic workflows
 - AWS Bedrock-Driven AI Platform Engineering: Lead adoption of AWS Bedrock for model selection, orchestration, governance, and enterprise scaling of LLMs and generative AI. Implement Bedrock Features such as: Guardrails, Model evaluation, Provisioned throughput, Custom model fine-tuning. Integrate Bedrock models with downstream systems, including microservices, pipelines, and agent frameworks. Partner with enterprise architecture to define standards for Bedrock usage and model lifecycle governance. 
 - Knowledge Graph & Semantic Intelligence: Own engineering and operationalization of the Enterprise Knowledge Graph and integrate it with LLM and agent frameworks as a structured reasoning layer, Implement ontology-driven enrichment, entity resolution, and graph-based retrieval for AI capabilities, Connect graph services to agents to support semantic grounding, consistency, and contextual awareness
 - ML Engineering & MLOps: Build and maintain automated pipelines for training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring of traditional and generative ML models, Establish rigorous MLOps standards including CI/CD, reproducibility, drift detection, and quality gates, Develop feature stores, vector databases, and real-time inference services optimized for AI workloads. 
 - Engineering Delivery & Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner deeply with DIME to ensure upstream data pipelines meet enterprise AI-grade requirements for freshness, quality, lineage, and metadata, Work with Lakehouse Engineering and Data Product teams to align models, features, and data availability, Collaborate with governance and security teams to enforce responsible AI practices and regulatory controls

What are we looking for?

We're looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work. 

Requirements

- 8+ years of software engineering experience, with 3+ years in hands-on leadership of ML/AI initiatives. Should have leadership in designing and deploying machine learning systems in production. 
 - Full-stack proficiency building agentic/chat web experiences with Angular + TypeScript on the front end and Python (Flask/FastAPI) services on the back end. Experience implementing real-time/streaming UIs for LLM chat (e. g. , server-sent events / streamed token responses) with responsive state management. Comfortable owning a feature end-to-end: RESTful API design, front-end integration, and deployment of both tiers to AWS (containerized services, ECR/ECS, CloudFront/S3-hosted SPA)
 - Hands-on expertise with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, vector search, semantic retrieval, or agentic AI development. Should have experience with AWS services, especially Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, Step Functions, OpenSearch, DynamoDB, ECR, and S3
 - Experience building/managing agentic solutions with solid understanding of agent orchestration, tool use, and guardrails for autonomous systems
 - Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face). Familiarity with graph databases, ontologies, and knowledge graph technologies (Neptune, Neo4j, RDF/OWL)
 - Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Strong experience with MLOps and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes). Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science or a related field (years experience may apply to cover this requirement)

Core Competencies

- Provide architectural and engineering leadership across AI/ML Engineering
 - Mentor engineers on ML system design, LLM development, agentic architectures, and cloud-native AI delivery
 - Champion engineering excellence, innovation, and a builder mindset across the team
 - Shape LPL's enterprise AI roadmap, influencing priorities and platform capabilities
 - Translate complex AI concepts into executive-ready narratives
 - Evaluate emerging agentic technologies and generative AI frameworks to guide platform evolution

About Ethos

Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

As the engineering leader on our Consumer team, you will oversee teams responsible for the direct to consumer user experience. In this role, you will work closely with Product, Design, User Research, and other stakeholders to build fullstack features that educate and support users through the pre-application, application, package select, and checkout funnels. You will lead, strategize, develop and execute projects to optimize conversion rates through AB tests. You will collaborate with our Underwriting, Enterprise Sales, and Data engineering teams to support the entire user and event lifecycle and data model. You will work with Senior Engineers to decompose an existing monolithic application into scalable micro services. 

The Consumer team is responsible for the customer journey and is the largest revenue driver across the company. You will be joining at a critical time to drive outsized impact, define organizational strategy and shape team culture. 

Duties And Responsibilities

- Lead high-impact tech and product initiatives in order to accelerate our business growth. 
 - Work closely with product, design, content and marketing to ideate and experiment with new product strategies. 
 - Use quantitative and qualitative insights to make data-informed decisions. 
 - Obsess over your pod's core metrics and KPIs. 
 - Uphold a strong bar for engineering velocity, delivery and execution. 
 - Review design, architecture and help mentor the team. 
 - Recruit, hire, grow, and retain A+ engineering talent. 
 - Provide meaningful feedback to your team to enable their work and growth. 

Qualifications And Skills

- 3+ years of engineering management experience in high-growth engineering organizations
 - 5+ years of engineering experience as an individual contributor
 - Experience building large, business critical projects which are highly cross functional in nature and require a deep understanding of business logic
 - Demonstrated ability to work closely with product to craft a strategy for new business opportunities
 - Ability to own consumer-focused metrics like ARPU, conversion, retention, and churn. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills, adept at working in a cross-functional group. 
 - Be a self-starter, you are able to get things going without much guidance. 
 - Experience implementing process best practices within a rapidly growing team. 
 - Know how to build focused roadmaps and make difficult trade-offs. 

Don't meet every single requirement? If you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. 

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records. 

To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice. 

Recruitment Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. All legitimate communication from our team will only come from email addresses ending in @ethos. com or @getethos. com. 

We will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent us from a different email address, please treat it as fraudulent.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2. 5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability. 

Our people

With over 2, 000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home. 

Our impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1. 5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We're proud to be a part of that. 

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Team: 

The Social Planner team is a dedicated product group within HighLevel's Leadgen organization, focused on delivering a seamless social media management experience. We empower agencies and businesses to create, schedule, and manage posts across multiple platforms, while also providing automation, analytics, and engagement tools. 

Our primary objectives are to drive Social Planner adoption, improve feature retention, and maximize user engagement by making social publishing effortless and impactful. 

We are responsible for: 

Post Publishing & Scheduling We enable agencies to publish and schedule posts across major social platforms, ensuring timely and consistent content delivery. 

Post Automation We support advanced publishing workflows, including CSV uploads, RSS-to-post, Review Posts, Category Queues, and Recurring Queues-giving agencies full flexibility to manage content at scale. 

Engagement & Insights Through Social Statistics, Comment Management, and Social Listening, we provide agencies with deep insights into performance and engagement, enabling data-driven content strategies. 

Best Time to Post We surface AI-driven recommendations on when to post for maximum reach and engagement, helping agencies optimize their content strategy. 

Multi-Platform Integration We currently support integrations with 9 major platforms-Google Business Profile, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Threads, and Bluesky-along with HighLevel's internal Community product. 

About the Role: 

Millions of businesses post to social media through HighLevel's Social Planner. Hundreds of thousands of posts go out every day across every major social platform, each with its own API, rate limits and frequent changes. Our job is to make that look easy. 

We're a small team with a big surface area, and we're building the next layer on top of publishing: understanding what the internet is saying about our customers, at scale, with AI. We're hiring a senior full stack engineer who wants to own that. 

Responsibilities

- Own features end to end, from PRD to production to "did it work?". 
 - Design and operate reliable distributed systems: message queues, background workers, schedulers and integrations with third-party platform APIs. 
 - Build data pipelines that gather millions of social data and metrics from many sources, enrich them, and built infrastructure for fast analytics. 
 - Process media at scale: images and video uploaded, transformed, generated and delivered to every social platform in the format each one expects. 
 - Ship both the backend APIs and the frontend UI. Care about how it feels, not just that it works. 
 - Integrate AI into the product where it makes things better. 
 - Notice things nobody asked you to fix, and fix them. 

Requirements

- 4+ years building and operating production distributed systems. 
 - Experience with large-scale data engineering: ingestion, ETL/ELT, data warehousing (ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake or similar), and analytics over billions of rows. Social listening, NLP or sentiment analysis is a big plus. 
 - Strong fundamentals in any language. We write TypeScript (Node. js, NestJS, Vue. js). 
 - Customer-first mindset. You start from the problem, not the tech. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development. You use AI coding tools daily, can explain your workflow and stand behind the output. 
 - Genuine passion for software. You follow the industry for fun and want to grow as fast as the product does.

Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status.
