data.description:
Lead Specialist, Solution Architect - OnVUE

About OnVUE

OnVUE is Pearson's online proctored test delivery platform, supporting the secure, reliable, and scalable delivery of assessments for Pearson's certification and professional testing business. The platform enables candidates to test remotely while maintaining exam integrity through identity verification, monitoring, secure delivery workflows, and operational controls. The OnVUE environment includes modern and legacy systems, with ongoing focus on platform modernization, service resilience, API-first integration, cloud-native delivery, candidate and proctor experience, and improved developer and operational practices. 

Role summary

As a Lead Specialist, Solution Architect, you are a recognized subject-matter expert who provides technical leadership for sophisticated, high-impact solution work. You independently translate business needs, stakeholder constraints, and technical requirements into secure, scalable, viable, and maintainable architectural models and guide solution delivery from inception through implementation. 

You maintain technical consistency within the assigned scope, balance advanced solution design with hands-on support for complex delivery challenges, and resolve day-to-day integration and build issues. You influence through depth of knowledge, sound judgment, clear communication, and the ability to steer architecture discussions toward practical outcomes. You mentor engineers, junior architects, and peers, establish trusted technical patterns within your domain, ensure conformance to established frameworks, and escalate decisions that materially exceed the assigned scope to senior experts. 

Key responsibilities

Solution architecture and technical leadership

- Translate business needs, stakeholder constraints, and technical requirements into robust architectural models and fit-for-purpose solution designs. 

- Own solution architecture from discovery and design through implementation and production adoption. 

- Provide technical leadership for high-impact projects, major features, product changes, services, domains, or business capabilities. 

- Maintain technical consistency within the assigned product, service, project, domain, or broader solution footprint. 

- Evaluate and communicate tradeoffs involving scalability, security, resilience, maintainability, integration, delivery risk, operational needs, and business value. 

Implementation and delivery guidance

- Guide engineering and delivery teams through implementation while preserving architectural intent. 

- Resolve complex architectural, integration, and build issues within the assigned scope. 

- Consult on technical feasibility for major features, updates, integrations, and solution approaches. 

- Identify high-stakes architectural risks early and coordinate practical mitigation. 

- Adapt architecture to changing requirements without sacrificing solution stability, security, or long-term maintainability. 

Standards, influence, and capability building

- Establish trusted and repeatable technical patterns within the assigned domain while ensuring conformance with established architecture frameworks, standards, and guidelines. 

- Participate in architecture forums and guide discussions toward sound, practical outcomes. 

- Mentor engineers, junior architects, and peers in solution design, technical practices, and architectural decision-making. 

- Communicate design options, recommendations, constraints, and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

- Escalate decisions outside the assigned scope or requiring senior technical or enterprise direction. 

Required education and experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience. 

- Progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or a related technical discipline. 

- Demonstrated experience designing sophisticated solutions and guiding delivery from inception through implementation. 

- Experience translating business needs and technical constraints into secure, scalable, maintainable architecture. 

- Experience influencing architecture and delivery outcomes without formal authority. 

Desired knowledge, skills, and abilities

- Strong solution architecture, system design, integration, and technical problem-solving skills. 

- Ability to evaluate solution options and explain tradeoffs across business value, delivery feasibility, risk, and long-term technology health. 

- Working knowledge of Java-based enterprise application stacks, cloud-native design, APIs, microservices, event-driven integration, containers, orchestration, CI/CD, observability, security, data consistency, and operational readiness. 

- Practical familiarity with service decomposition, API gateway patterns, versioned API contracts, distributed tracing, messaging, data-driven backend systems, and headless or decoupled front-end and back-end architecture patterns. 

- Strong documentation, facilitation, communication, and influencing skills. 

- Ability to mentor others and introduce trusted, repeatable technical approaches. 

Success measures

- Architecture artifacts are clear, fit for purpose, timely, and enable secure, scalable, stable implementation. 

- Solution designs are adopted successfully, integrate effectively, and remain durable in production. 

- Design choices minimize avoidable rework, support business continuity, and reduce preventable technical risk. 

- Technical blockers and high-stakes architectural risks are identified and resolved or escalated in time to protect delivery. 

- Documentation and quality standards are met with limited revision cycles. 

- Repeatable technical approaches, mentorship, and knowledge transfer improve team effectiveness. 

- Stakeholders trust the role to explain design options, constraints, and tradeoffs and to guide solution delivery. 

Leadership behaviors

- Customer Centricity - Tailors architecture decisions to real operational and business needs and responds quickly when issues threaten outcomes. 

- Raise the Performance Bar - Applies advanced design techniques, strengthens technical practices, and shares approaches that improve solution quality. 

- Exceptional Collaboration for Value - Guides technical discussions, incorporates different perspectives, and supports alignment and integration across the assigned scope. 

- Our Leaders Inspire - Models technical curiosity, sound judgment, visible accountability, and a commitment to developing others. 

Location & Working Pattern

India. Bangalore is the preferred location and Chennai is an option. Exact hybrid attendance requirements will be shared during the recruitment process. 

Why Join Pearson?

This is an opportunity to develop engineering talent, strengthen delivery and quality practices, and help teams adopt emerging AI-assisted ways of working across technology that supports assessment experiences at scale.

data.title: Automation and AI Developer
data.description:
Thomson Reuters is a "Great Place to Work® certified Organization". We are looking for a skilled Automation & AI Developer to design, build, and own intelligent solutions from concept to production. In this role, you will work on agentic AI implementations using AWS AgentCore and LangGraph, contributing to both rapid POCs and live systems. 

About The Role

In this role as an Automation & AI Developer, you will: 

- Implement LangGraph agentic workflows on AWS AgentCore - state graphs, tool orchestration, conditional routing, error recovery. 
 - Build custom RAG pipelines end-to-end: chunking strategy, embeddings, vector retrieval, accuracy evaluation. 
 - Contribute to rapid POC delivery alongside the Architect and Lead. 
 - Write production-grade Python with FastAPI, Pydantic, testing, and proper error handling. 
 - Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Cline) to accelerate builds. Own and fix all generated code in production. 
 - Build Low Code automations using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate when use case and bandwidth allow. 
 - Understand Pro Code vs Low Code trade-offs - flag where Low Code is the better fit. 
 - Stay current on Low Code platform capabilities as they expand rapidly. 
 - Own assigned components in production - monitor, debug, optimise, iterate. 
 - Debug agent failures independently: context issues, tool errors, hallucination, retrieval degradation. 
 - Collaborate with the Lead on architecture translation and implementation planning. 
 - Mentor Associate Developers through code reviews and pair programming. 
 - Work Mode: Hybrid - 3 days from office. 
 - Shift Timing: 1pm IST to 10pm IST

About You

You're a fit for the role of Automation & AI Developer, if your background includes: 

- Experience - 3-5 years total; 1-2 years GenAI/LLM; 6-12 months LangGraph; 2-3 projects with working code. 
 - LangGraph - State graphs, conditional routing, checkpointing - primary framework, non-negotiable. 
 - LangChain - Chains, memory, custom tools - solid foundational knowledge. 
 - AWS AgentCore - Hands-on preferred; strong LangGraph depth with ramp path acceptable. 
 - AWS Bedrock - Model invocation, knowledge bases, guardrails. 
 - Database & AI Data Access - SQL proficiency, NL-to-SQL, LLM-powered query and insight patterns. Snowflake a plus. 
 - RAG Pipelines - End-to-end: chunking, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation. 
 - Vector Databases - Pinecone, ChromaDB, OpenSearch, or FAISS - hands-on with at least one. 
 - Python - Production-quality - type hints, async/await, FastAPI, Pydantic. 
 - Multi-Model - OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Llama - understand trade-offs across providers. 
 - Pro Code vs Low Code - Copilot Studio and Power Automate - build when use case fits. 
 - AI Development Tools - Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Cline - accelerate delivery; own and fix all generated code. 
 - AWS AgentCore Deep - Runtime, Memory, Tools Gateway hands-on. 
 - MCP / A2A - Server/client implementation or protocol awareness. 
 - Enterprise Integration - SAP HANA, Salesforce connectors. 
 - Document Intelligence - OCR, layout-aware chunking. 
 - Evaluation Frameworks - RAGAS, Promptfoo, DeepEval
 - Certifications - AWS, GCP, or Azure AI/ML.

data.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
Job Title - Senior Quality Assurance Engineer - ExamDeveloper

Summary

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you are a highly skilled individual contributor recognized as a technical authority for quality within your area. You lead quality engineering strategy and execution for one or more product squads, combining hands-on testing and automation with release-quality accountability and technical guidance for other quality engineers. 

You design advanced test strategies that anticipate complex system interactions, integration risks, and failure modes, and you establish an automation-first approach with complete, visible coverage. You are frequently consulted on the most challenging defects, complex integrations, performance and reliability concerns, and critical release decisions. You lead through expertise rather than formal authority - mentoring quality engineers, improving practices, and helping teams make sound quality and release decisions. You partner closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Product Architects, Dev Leads, DevOps, security, accessibility, and vendor teams to protect candidate experience, delivery reliability, and product quality. 

The Product

ExamDeveloper is a web-based exam development platform that allows customers to write, review, and manage questions on their exams. Customers rely on ExamDeveloper to support the full workflow around item writing, collaborative review, scoring, and test management for certification and professional assessment programs. 

ExamDeveloper is a leading web-based tool for creating tests that certify test-takers in the professional skills they require. The Senior Quality Assurance Engineer plays a critical role in protecting workflow accuracy, automation reliability, delivery confidence, and product quality as the platform continues to support complex exam-development workflows. 

Key responsibilities

Quality strategy and test design

- Lead test strategy and coverage planning for assigned squad initiatives, releases, and platform changes. 

- Design advanced test approaches spanning functional, regression, integration, negative, accessibility, and API coverage. 

- Define quality gates and test readiness criteria for stories, defects, releases, and production-impacting changes. 

- Ensure stories and defects include clear testing evidence, including test cases executed, edge cases considered, environment details, data notes, and traceability where appropriate. 

- Use metrics, defect trends, and production signals to continuously improve the test strategy. 

Hands-on testing and automation

- Contribute directly to hands-on testing for high-risk, complex, cross-team, or automation-critical work. 

- Create, improve, and review automated tests across UI, API, integration, and regression coverage. 

- Review regression results, identify failure patterns, and drive resolution of flaky, missing, or outdated tests. 

- Use manual, exploratory, accessibility, usability, or complex workflow testing when automation is not practical or sufficient. 

- Promote automation-first practices and ensure tests are reliably incorporated into regression suites. 

Quality ownership and collaboration

- Lead defect triage, retesting, and resolution follow-through, and escalate major quality concerns early. 

- Raise defects with clear reproduction steps, environment details, test data, supporting evidence, and business or user impact where possible. 

- Serve as the technical authority on quality within your domain and inform critical release decisions. 

- Mentor and coach quality engineers in automation, test design, accessibility, and release validation. 

- Provide quality perspective during backlog refinement, design reviews, technical planning, and release readiness. 

- Surface QE capacity, coverage, or dependency risks early when testing scope may affect sprint or release timelines. 

Required education and experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience. 

- 5+ years of professional quality engineering, software testing, or test automation experience. 

- Demonstrated experience leading quality for complex, distributed, cloud-based, or customer-facing platforms. 

- Strong experience with test strategy, test design, defect management, regression planning, and release validation. 

- Experience providing technical guidance and mentorship within Agile engineering squads. 

Desired knowledge, skills, and abilities

- Experience with Gauge-style BDD automation, Selenium/WebDriver, C# step implementations, and sustainable web application test automation. 

- Experience maintaining automated test suites that run on virtual machines, with awareness of potential cloud-based testing infrastructure. 

- Experience with relational databases, test data validation, defect investigation, and evidence-based quality review. 

- Experience with SQL, log analysis, telemetry, dashboards, and production issue investigation. 

- Demonstrated technical leadership in Agile quality engineering, including test planning, automation review, and continuous improvement. 

- Willingness and ability to incorporate artificial intelligence technologies into QA responsibly, including validation of AI-assisted outputs. 

- Experience working with offshore teams, vendors, and globally distributed delivery models. 

Success measures

- Quality strategy and test design are visible, current, and used by the squad. 

- Stories and defects close with clear, reviewable evidence of testing and coverage. 

- Regression coverage and automation reliability improve; missed scenarios trend down. 

- Achieves near-zero critical defect leakage post-release for owned areas. 

- Quality risks are surfaced early and resolved through clear ownership and follow-through. 

- Improves the capability of the broader quality team through mentorship. 

Leadership behaviors

Customer Centricity Ensures advanced and edge-case scenarios are considered so user-impacting failures are prevented before release. 

Raise the Performance Bar Pilots new methodologies, strengthens test architecture and automation, and sets a high standard for quality rigor. 

Exceptional Collaboration for Value Mentors peers, contributes strong input during reviews, and aligns quality priorities across product and engineering. 

Our Leaders Inspire Provides informal leadership during complex releases, steps up during peak workloads, and models expert problem-solving. 

Who we are: 

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson. 

Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act. 

If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing TalentExperienceGlobalTeam@grp. pearson. com.

Job Title - Software Engineering, Team Manager

Description - Lead engineering teams that support critical assessment services, with two opportunities across Vue Testing Services and Test Delivery in India. You will combine people leadership, delivery oversight, technical judgement and responsible AI adoption to strengthen team performance and customer outcomes. Also known in the market as: Engineering Manager; Software Development Manager; Technology Manager; Software Engineering People Manager.

Pearson is hiring two Software Engineering Team Managers in India through one recruitment campaign. The roles share a common leadership profile but support different product areas: Vue Testing Services (VTS) and Test Delivery. 

VTS supports services around a candidate's assessment journey, including registration, payment and score reporting. Test Delivery powers the delivery of assessments in test centres and online, in a high-volume environment where quality, reliability and operational readiness matter. 

In either opportunity, you will lead through clarity, coaching, accountability and partnership. You will translate priorities into achievable plans, strengthen engineering and delivery practices, develop people, manage risk and help teams adopt AI-assisted development responsibly. This is a management role with minimal hands-on coding expected. 

What You'll Do

- Hire, onboard, coach, develop and retain engineers and technical professionals. 

- Set clear goals, feedback rhythms, development plans and team operating practices. 

- Translate product and department priorities into achievable team plans, capacity choices and ownership. 

- Track sprint and release progress, dependencies, blockers, defects, quality and immediate delivery risks. 

- Partner with Product, Architecture, Quality Engineering, DevOps, Security, Operations and business stakeholders. 

- Maintain strong standards for design, testing, automation, security, observability, documentation and operational readiness. 

- Use engineering, delivery, quality and team signals to identify patterns and drive improvement. 

- Guide deliberate adoption of AI-assisted development, testing, review and documentation while protecting quality and security. 

What We're Looking For

- A hands-on technical foundation in software engineering, quality engineering, architecture, technology solutions or a closely related discipline. 

- Demonstrated experience leading, coaching or managing technical professionals and building effective teams. 

- Experience delivering software products, platforms or technology services in Agile or similarly iterative environments. 

- Evidence of leading meaningful change, making sound decisions and improving delivery or team effectiveness. 

- Working knowledge of modern software delivery, cloud, DevOps, CI/CD, automation, security, reliability, observability and operational readiness. 

- Experience making people, capacity, priority and delivery decisions in a cross-functional environment. 

- Experience working across distributed teams, functions or time zones. 

- Practical experience using or introducing AI-assisted engineering tools, with sound judgement about quality and risk. 

- Strong communication, collaboration, problem-solving and stakeholder-influence skills. 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent practical experience. 

The Opportunities

VTS Lead teams supporting services around the assessment journey, including registration, payment and score reporting. Product and service-platform leadership experience may be particularly useful. 

TEST DELIVERY Lead teams supporting the delivery of assessments in test centres and online. Experience with high-volume, operationally critical or reliability-focused platforms may be particularly useful.

India. Bangalore is the preferred location and Chennai is an option. Exact hybrid attendance requirements will be shared during the recruitment process.

data.description:
About The Company

Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them. 

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself. 

Empower is a leading financial services organization dedicated to improving the financial, physical, and mental well-being of its clients. Our company, in partnership with Canada Life, provides a wide array of insurance and wealth management products tailored for individuals, families, and business owners across Canada. Headquartered in Winnipeg, Manitoba, Empower is committed to good corporate governance, innovation, and customer-centric solutions. Our technology team is a strategic partner in our business, striving to be a forward-thinking, agile organization that delivers secure, resilient, and cutting-edge solutions supporting millions of Canadians' financial futures. 

About The Role

We are seeking a skilled Full Stack Developer to join our dynamic engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining secure, scalable, and high-performance user-facing applications and backend services. Your contributions will span the entire technology stack, including front-end interfaces, backend services, integrations, and data management, ensuring solutions align with business needs and strategic architecture. 

The ideal candidate will collaborate within an Agile environment, working closely with Architects, UX/UI designers, QA teams, Business Systems Analysts, and Product/Project Managers. You will play a key role in establishing development standards, creating reusable components, and implementing best practices across our digital platforms. This position offers an exciting opportunity to impact the digital transformation initiatives at Empower and help shape innovative financial solutions for our clients. 

Qualifications

Job Title: Technical Manager

Company: Sureify

Location: Hyderabad

About SureifySureify is dedicated to modernizing the life insurance and annuity industry. We provide cutting-edge digital solutions that empower insurers to easily engage with, sell to, and service their customers. Our mission is to drive meaningful digital transformation by offering scalable technology that enhances customer engagement and streamlines carrier operations. Sureify's products deliver the advanced digital experiences that life insurance carriers, agents, employees, and consumers now expect in this rapidly evolving technological landscape. At Sureify, we cultivate a culture that prioritizes innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. 

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced and highly-skilled Technical Manager who is responsible for end-to-end delivery of software projects while also leading, mentoring, and managing engineering teams. This role bridges technical execution, delivery management, and people leadership to ensure high-quality, scalable solutions are delivered on time and teams continue to grow and perform at their best. 

What We Look For

We are interested in self-motivated individuals who can easily function in a high-demand, 

performance-driven environment. In addition, we are looking for individuals who recognise the team's accomplishments before their own and are sought after as people developers. If you are passionate about problem-solving and helping our customers with some of their most complex issues, this role is for you. 

Key Requirements & Responsibilities

- Project & Delivery Management
 - Own end-to-end delivery of multiple software projects, from planning through execution and release
 - Manage Project scope and milestones effectively
 - Project estimations, assessing resource needs and allocation
 - Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget
 - Identify and mitigate delivery risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks
 - Collaborate with Product Managers, Architects, QA, and other stakeholders to align delivery with business goals
 - Track and report project progress, metrics, and outcomes to leadership
 - Ensure adherence to engineering best practices, SDLC processes, and quality standards
 - Technical Leadership
 - Provide technical guidance and decision-making across projects
 - Review system designs, architecture, and key technical solutions
 - Ensure code quality through reviews, standards, and best practices
 - Support teams in resolving complex technical challenges
 - Drive adoption of modern tools, frameworks, and engineering practices
 - Balance short-term delivery needs with long-term technical scalability
 - People Management & Team Leadership
 - Lead and manage a team of software engineers and/or technical leads
 - Conduct regular 1: 1s, performance reviews, and career development discussions
 - Set clear goals, expectations, and development plans for team members
 - Mentor and coach engineers to improve technical and professional skills
 - Foster a high-performance, collaborative, and inclusive team culture
 - Support hiring, onboarding, and team capacity planning
 - Address performance issues constructively and proactively
 - Stakeholder & Communication Management
 - Act as a primary point of contact for delivery-related communication
 - Translate business requirements into actionable technical plans
 - Communicate risks, trade-offs, and progress clearly to non-technical stakeholders
 - Partner with cross-functional teams (Product, UX, DevOps, QA, Support)

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Overall 12+ years of Industry experience and a minimum of 4+ years of experience as Technical Manager, 
 - Strong Experience developing production code using TypeScript, Go-Lang, PHP, React, Node JS. Expertise in a few of these technologies is mandatory. 
 - Experience developing SaaS applications that run on top of AWS (and familiarity with S3, EKS, RDS, EC2)
 - Familiarity with Docker
 - Experience with CI/CD tooling
 - Collaborate on complex customer requirements with internal and external stakeholders
 - Contribute towards the design of a specific customer implementation over the development lifecycle, with a particular focus on delivery components
 - A desire to work with engineers to develop their test-driven development practice
 - A firm understanding of object-oriented design or functional programming, as well as common data structures and algorithms
 - Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross cross-functional team
 - Experience working with 3rd party software integrations (REST APIs, SOAP APIs, XML, JSON, etc. )
 - Experience building secure applications and methodically improving application performance (Profilers, APM tools, Security scanning tools)

Experience Needed To Qualify

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field
 - Minimum 12+ years of work-related experience
 - Experience in developing complex integrated technical solutions involving vendor software across the development lifecycle
 - Experience building customer solutions using existing assets and capabilities, including alliances
 - Problem-solving skills, costing, and technology-based solutions with deals and offerings
 - Industry knowledge across different technologies, especially in Cloud/SaaS/PaaS solutions and the role of IT in digital change
 - Experience in Insurance Technology solutions (preferably policy administration systems), in Life & Annuity, will be an added advantage

Why Join Sureify?

At Sureify, you'll be part of a collaborative, innovation-driven culture where your expertise will directly influence the quality and success of products, transforming the life insurance landscape. You'll work alongside passionate technologists and industry experts, tackling complex challenges with cutting-edge technologies while helping shape the future of digital insurance. 

Our Guiding Principles

Our products are for nothing if their creators are not fulfilled in their work. We want our employees to flourish at Sureify. We do not fawn over status or titles; instead, we honour effort and intelligence. The best idea wins, no matter which colleague proposed it. We do not shortcut our mission with overblown claims or false promises. Sticking to the truth is both a strategy and a principle for us. 

Sureify is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

data.description:

Our mission is to bridge the gap between state-of-the-art AI research and real-world enterprise applications - helping organizations innovate faster, make smarter decisions, and scale AI solutions seamlessly. 

We're looking for a Frontend (UI/React. js) Developer with strong experience in building scalable, high-performing web applications using React. js and the MERN stack. In this role, you'll design and implement intuitive user interfaces, build robust client-side architectures, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver seamless, user-centric experiences. If you love crafting clean UIs, reusable components, and enterprise-grade frontends - we'd love to hear from you!

Why You? Why Now?

As enterprises adopt AI-driven platforms, intuitive and performant user interfaces are becoming critical for product adoption and user satisfaction. This role is perfect for someone who loves blending great UI/UX with solid engineering practices, building reusable systems, and shaping the visual layer of next-gen AI products.

- Deep dive into GoML's products, frontend architecture, and design workflows
 - Understand existing UI frameworks, coding standards, and deployment pipelines
 - Get familiar with backend APIs, GraphQL endpoints, and data flows

 - Strengthen MERN-stack capabilities by contributing to full-stack development

What You Bring (Qualifications & Skills)

Must-Have

- 3+ years of experience in frontend development 
 - Strong expertise in JavaScript, React. js, and modern ES6+ concepts 
 - Hands-on experience with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express. js, React, Node. js)

Nice-to-Have

- Experience with server-side rendering (SSR) and Node. js

 - Version control experience (Git)

Why Work With Us?

- Remote-first culture with office in Coimbatore for collaboration
 - Work on cutting-edge AI/ML & GenAI platforms solving real-world problems

 - Competitive compensation, career growth opportunities, and ESOPs down the line

data.title: Sr. Technical Lead - Game Testing
data.description:
At Aristocrat, we build the world's greatest gaming experience every day! As a world leader in gaming entertainment, our mission is to push the boundaries of innovation, creativity, and technology. Joining our team means becoming part of a diverse, passionate group of experts dedicated to delivering outstanding gaming experiences. Our culture emphasizes quality, individual ownership, and collaboration, making it an exciting place to grow your career. 

What You'll Do

- Develop, maintain, and complete comprehensive manual test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on functional specifications and user stories for slot games. 
 - Conduct detailed manual testing of slot games, including gameplay mechanics, bonus features, animations, and audio-visual elements. 
 - Diagnose and resolve code errors to determine the underlying causes of problems, offering thorough details to the development team. 
 - Modify game code to trigger features required by testing objectives to achieve desired test coverage. 
 - Ensure games meet industry standards and regulatory requirements, including RNG testing and certification processes. 
 - Generate game builds on production media with platform and core code for debug and production environments, and configure the EGMs without supervision. 
 - Identify, document, and track defects using bug tracking systems such as Jira. 
 - Collaborate closely with the Game Development team, including Game Designers, Artists, and Software Development Engineers, to resolve issues found during execution of SIT test cycles. 
 - Follow guidelines set by SIT management to plan and complete tests that support business objectives. 
 - Suggest improvements to the overall testing process in terms of tools, processes, and test cases. 
 - Mentor new or junior-level test engineers on the processes, game setup, and understanding of overall testing objectives set for the SIT team. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field, or its equivalent. 
 - A minimum of 8+ years of experience in software test engineering, with a focus on Casino/Slot games or related industries. 
 - Knowledge of gaming regulations and compliance standards in various jurisdictions. 
 - Understanding of slot game mechanics, RNG, and dynamic/bonus systems. 
 - Demonstrated experience in planning and accomplishing testing activities for gaming products. 
 - Basic understanding of automation tools or scripting languages is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with UNIX/Linux. 
 - Experience with C/C++ programming desired. 
 - Analytical approach with the ability to identify root causes and propose solutions. 
 - Excellent oral and written communication skills.

Testing - Hil - Dspace

Diagnostic

Senior Test Engineer - Playwright Automation

Role: Senior Test Engineer / Test Automation Engineer

Role Summary

We are looking for a skilled Senior Test Engineer with 2-5 years of relevant experience in functional and automation testing. The candidate should have strong hands-on expertise in Playwright, along with experience in designing and executing test cases, maintaining regression/sanity suites, defect management, and following testing best practices. 

Key Responsibilities

- Analyze functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to define effective test scenarios. 
 - Design, create, execute, and maintain manual and automated test cases. 
 - Develop and maintain Playwright-based automation test suites. 
 - Perform functional, regression, smoke, sanity, system, API, integration, security, performance, and release testing as applicable. 
 - Identify positive, negative, boundary, and corner test scenarios. 
 - Review automated test scripts and test results. 
 - Maintain regression and sanity automation packs. 
 - Identify defects and maintain clear defect records using JIRA. 
 - Ensure traceability of testing activities, defects, and results. 
 - Perform root cause analysis for defect leakage and enhance test coverage accordingly. 
 - Continuously improve overall test automation coverage and testing processes. 
 - Work closely with development and other stakeholders to maintain product quality. 
 - Participate actively in Agile/Scrum ceremonies. 
 - Guide junior test engineers and support knowledge-sharing/training activities. 
 - Independently plan and drive assigned testing activities to closure. 

Mandatory Skills

- Playwright Test Automation
 - Strong Functional/Manual Testing
 - Test case design, execution, and maintenance
 - Regression, Smoke and Sanity Testing
 - Strong knowledge of Test Automation frameworks
 - JIRA for defect/test management
 - GitHub / Git commands
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Experience creating positive, negative, boundary and corner test cases
 - Agile/Scrum working experience
 - Ability to work independently and guide junior team members

Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

- Automotive domain knowledge
 - DTC Authoring / diagnostic tool-related testing
 - API and integration testing exposure
 - ISTQB or equivalent testing certification

Job Responsibilities

Verify quality of requirements and reject if insufficient for qualified development and test creation

- Translate functional and non-functional requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria into various test cases
 - Define, create and execute test cases for manual and for automated execution
 - Define, create and execute test cases for different levels and stages (system, API, integration, regression, security, performance, release)
 - Define, create and execute test cases to validate the inter-operability of the software with other tools of the KPIT diagnostic tool chain if applicable. 
 - Actively look for ways to break the software
 - Review test code of other test engineers
 - Follow up discovered issues with descriptive defect records using the standard tooling (JIRA)
 - Ensure traceability of all testing related activities and results using standard workflow and tooling (JIRA)
 - Maintain high hygiene in testing activities and processes
 - Influence other stakeholders to ensure quality expectations are met. 
 - Constantly increase level of test automation and related processes where possible and beneficial
 - Plan testing activities in close cooperation with or as part of the development team / authoring team
 - Proactively gather data to highlight system improvement areas
 - Participate in all scrum ceremonies
 - Plan and organize training of test engineers. 
 - Perform root cause analysis on why reported bugs were not detected by our test team (Leakage Cause) and enhance own test scenarios accordingly

☰ Automation Engineer Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka

Experience: 2-5 Years

Qualification: B. E / B. Tech in ECE or Mechanical

Role Overview

Advance Sensing is hiring a Machine Vision Engineer to design, develop, test, deploy and support industrial machine vision inspection systems for automated quality control, defect detection, dimensional measurement and smart factory inspection applications. 

This role is suitable for engineers with practical experience in machine vision, computer vision, industrial cameras, optics, illumination, OpenCV, image processing, AI-based inspection and automation integration. As part of one of the growing machine vision and industrial sensing technology companies in Bengaluru, you will work on real production-line inspection systems used across manufacturing environments. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop industrial machine vision inspection systems for automated quality control applications. 
 - Develop image processing algorithms using OpenCV, CV2, Python and related computer vision libraries. 
 - Work on surface defect detection, dimensional inspection, part presence inspection, measurement validation and visual verification systems. 
 - Integrate industrial cameras, lenses, lighting systems, triggers, sensors and image acquisition hardware. 
 - Select suitable optics, illumination geometry and camera configuration based on application requirements. 
 - Support AI/ML-based defect detection, classification, segmentation and anomaly detection models using PyTorch, TensorFlow or similar frameworks. 
 - Work with PLC, automation and electrical teams for camera triggering, reject signals, inspection outputs and production-line integration. 
 - Conduct feasibility studies, sample trials, image analysis and proof-of-concept validation for customer applications. 
 - Commission, tune, debug and validate machine vision systems at customer manufacturing sites. 
 - Create inspection reports, technical documentation, validation records and application notes. Required Skills

- Strong understanding of machine vision, computer vision and industrial image processing fundamentals. 
 - Hands-on experience with OpenCV, CV2, Python and vision algorithm development. 
 - Knowledge of industrial cameras, GigE cameras, USB cameras, smart cameras or camera SDKs. 
 - Understanding of optics, lenses, lighting techniques, exposure control, calibration and image acquisition. 
 - Experience in defect detection, pattern matching, edge detection, contour analysis, thresholding and measurement algorithms. 
 - Basic or working knowledge of AI/ML, deep learning, PyTorch, TensorFlow, object detection or image classification. 
 - Understanding of industrial automation, sensors, PLC communication and production-line inspection requirements. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, debugging ability and problem-solving mindset. Preferred Knowledge

- Industrial machine vision inspection systems for manufacturing quality control. 
 - AI-based visual inspection systems for surface defect detection and automated inspection. 
 - Camera calibration, pixel-to-mm conversion, metrology inspection and dimensional measurement. 
 - Lighting methods such as backlight, ring light, dome light, coaxial light, darkfield and brightfield illumination. 
 - PLC integration, trigger synchronization, reject actuation, conveyor inspection and inline inspection systems. 
 - Experience with manufacturing sectors such as automotive, electronics, metal components, plastics, packaging or precision engineering. 
 - Exposure to Industry 4. 0, IIoT, data logging, traceability and inspection analytics. Tools and Technologies

- Python, OpenCV, CV2 and image processing libraries. 
 - PyTorch, TensorFlow or basic AI/ML frameworks. 
 - Industrial cameras, smart cameras, GigE Vision, USB3 Vision and camera SDKs. 
 - Industrial lighting, lenses, optical filters and vision accessories. 
 - PLC signals, sensors, triggers, encoders and automation interfaces. 
 - Inspection software, data logging, image logging and traceability systems. Why Join Advance Sensing?

Advance Sensing works on advanced machine vision systems, AI-driven inspection software, industrial sensing platforms, automated inspection machines and smart factory quality control solutions. This role gives engineers hands-on exposure to industrial cameras, optics, lighting, OpenCV, AI/ML, automation hardware, PLC interfaces and real-world production-line machine vision systems. 

If you are looking for machine vision engineer jobs in Bengaluru, computer vision jobs in India, AI inspection jobs in Karnataka, industrial automation careers, industrial camera jobs or opportunities with one of the growing machine vision technology companies in India, this role offers strong technical learning and practical engineering exposure. 

Apply for This Position

Interested candidates can submit their resume and details through the application form below. 

Machine Vision Engineer: Engineering Expertise, Applications and Industry Value

Advance Sensing Private Limited provides Machine Vision Engineer careers in machine vision, industrial automation and AI engineering for manufacturers seeking dependable, scalable and application-specific engineering. Based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, the company combines more than 30 years of industry leadership experience with a young, technically strong engineering team working across machine vision, industrial automation, artificial intelligence, robotics, industrial sensing and manufacturing intelligence. 

Careers at Advance Sensing give early-career engineers the opportunity to work on real industrial problems involving machine vision, automation controls, software, AI, robotics, optics, sensors and mechanical system design. Candidates can gain exposure to customer applications, system architecture, proof-of-concept development, commissioning, validation and technical documentation while learning from industry veterans with more than 30 years of experience. 

Industrial applications

Typical applications include machine vision engineering, automation controls, AI and machine learning, software development, mechanical design, application engineering and industrial commissioning. Every deployment should be engineered around the production environment, target defects, takt time, product variation, operator workflow, data requirements and acceptance criteria. 

Why manufacturers evaluate Advance Sensing

Advance Sensing brings together machine vision, AI inspection, industrial cameras, optics, lighting, sensors, PLC connectivity, robotics and software in a unified engineering approach. This helps manufacturers reduce manual inspection dependency, improve defect detection consistency, strengthen traceability, automate repetitive operations and build a practical roadmap toward smart factory and Industry 4. 0 adoption. 

Frequently asked questions

How should a manufacturer choose a machine vision or automation partner?

Review proven application engineering capability, system integration experience, validation methodology, support model and the provider's ability to connect cameras, sensors, robotics, software and factory controls into one reliable production solution. 

Does Advance Sensing provide customized systems?

Yes. Solutions are developed around the customer's product, defect criteria, process, line speed, environment, automation architecture and reporting needs rather than being limited to a one-size-fits-all platform.

data.description:
Job Requirements

Who We Are: 

Quest Global delivers world-class end-to-end engineering solutions by leveraging our deep industry knowledge and digital expertise. By bringing together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals and their areas of expertise, we are able to solve problems better, faster. This multi-dimensional approach enables us to solve the most critical and large-scale challenges across the aerospace & defense, automotive, energy, hi-tech, healthcare, medical devices, rail and semiconductor industries. 

We are looking for humble geniuses, who believe that engineering has the potential to make the impossible possible; innovators, who are not only inspired by technology and innovation, but also perpetually driven to design, develop, and test as a trusted partner for Fortune 500 customers. As a team of remarkably diverse engineers, we recognize that what we are really engineering is a brighter future for us all. If you want to contribute to meaningful work and be part of an organization that truly believes when you win, we all win, and when you fail, we all learn, then we're eager to hear from you. The achievers and courageous challenge-crushers we seek, have the following characteristics and skills

What You Will Do

Lead Quality Engineer is accountable for leading quality execution and continuous improvement across systems, software, and mechanical equipment supporting GE Gas Power customers in the NAM region. This role ensures rapid identification, containment, and resolution of quality issues while driving systemic corrective actions to prevent recurrence. 

Working closely with the NAM Quality Leader and cross‐functional stakeholders, you will champion Built‐In Quality, strengthen customer confidence, ensure compliance with the Quality Management System, and foster a culture focused on customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and waste reduction. 

As a Lead Quality Engineer, you will be responsible for: 

Non-conformance Management

- Lead review, investigation, and triage of field and factory non-conformances, ensuring clear documentation of containment, correction, root cause, and validation. 
 - Coordinate field return analysis and failure investigations with internal teams and external suppliers. 
 - Partner cross‐functionally (Sales, Projects, Engineering, Operations, Sourcing, Services) to initiate early Stop Work actions, drive rapid issue resolution, and implement lessons learned. 

Continuous Improvement

- Facilitate and lead cross‐functional root cause analyses using structured methodologies (8D, Apollo Reality Charting, 5‐Why, Ishikawa). 
 - Lead RCA readouts with leadership to align on root cause, corrective actions, and risk mitigation. 
 - Support Built‐In Quality (BiQ) initiatives in Manufacturing by developing and executing quality improvement roadmaps. 
 - Track corrective actions and audit findings, ensuring timely and effective closure
 - Conduct Voice of Customer engagement and analyze customer survey feedback to identify improvement opportunities. 
 - Perform quality data analysis, including use of AI tools where applicable, to identify trends, risks, and systemic issues. 

Quality Management System Support

- Supporting internal audit program to assure compliance and evaluating effectiveness of Quality Management System to deliver intended results. 
 - Supporting Quality KPIs: customer satisfaction, customer issue and nonconformance resolution, CoPQ, continuous improvement and corrective action cycle times, line stops, risk analysis. 
 - Communicating and mentoring widely to cultivate a quality culture of customer passion, compliance, and waste reduction. 
 - Other
 - Support deployment of new and emerging quality initiatives as required. 
 - Act as a trusted quality advisor to leadership and operational teams. 

What You Will Bring

- Bachelor's degree in STEM majors (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) from an accredited college or University or equivalent. 
 - Have minimum 5 to 8 years in Quality role including demonstrated success facilitating cross-functional root cause analysis. 

Desired Characteristics

- ASQ CQE certification. 
 - Experience with ISO9001 and nuclear quality standards. 
 - Experience with ERP systems (SAP). 
 - Hold Six Sigma Black or Green Belt and/or Lean certification. 
 - Be comfortable and effective working in new areas that require rapid problem solving
 - Experience in controls and/or turbines. 
 - Have solid understanding of key manufacturing, supply chain, engineering, Services processes. 
 - Excellent communicator, works well in a team environment, appreciates challenges. 
 - Flexible, continuous learner, willing to share knowledge and experience
 - Organizational skills to manage multiple and changing priorities. 
 - Presentation skills, both oral and written. 

Leadership

- Highly motivated, energetic, confident, self-starting personal characteristics
 - Influences through others; builds direct and "behind the scenes" support for ideas
 - Identifies opportunities and actively pursues appropriate changes with the input & support of the Quality Team
 - Able to work well with global teams, including time-zone flexibility when necessary

Job Requirements

The role involves designing control architectures based on customer requirements and leading the improvement of equipment stability and performance, as well as the standardization of automation.

data.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‐throughput, hyper‐scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‐scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‐tolerant, in‐service‐upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‐shedding, throttling, and rate‐limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‐management plans. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems. 

-Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met. 

-Design systems to scale with elasticity (e. g. , effectively scaling both up and down). 

-Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Design performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e. g. , network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. 

-Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting. 

-Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems. 

-Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health. . 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems. 

-Design complex test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 

-Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes. 

-Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance. 

-Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation. 

-Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls. 

-Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps. 

-Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date. 

Automation & Change Management: 

-Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. 

-Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

-Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

-Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

-Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies. 

Continuous Learning: 

-Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams. 

Continuous Improvement: 

-Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement. 

Performance and Development: 

-Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

Lead Software Engineer

Leverage testing to verify both functional and non-functional application requirements. Drives efforts to build and maintain lower environments that accurately reflect production.

data.title: Tech Lead
data.description:
About Alaan

Alaan is an AI-native finance platform for businesses in the Middle East. The platform combines corporate cards, expense management, cross-border payments, accounting automation, treasury, business banking*, and more, with AI doing the work finance teams used to do by hand: coding transactions, chasing approvals and receipts, flagging policy breaches, placing treasury deposits, and closing the books. 

Our mission is to simplify finance for businesses so they can save time and money. 

Over 3, 000 businesses use Alaan, from first-time founders to enterprises like Careem, G42, Tabby, Al Barari, and Rivoli. Since 2022, they have saved more than 2. 2 million hours of manual finance work. 

Alaan has raised $55Mn to date, including one of the largest Series A rounds in Middle East history, backed by Peak XV (formerly Sequoia India), Y Combinator, 468 Capital, and 885 Capital, among others. Headquartered in Dubai, Alaan has more than 250 employees across its Dubai, Riyadh, and Bangalore offices, with a team that comes from Careem, McKinsey, BCG, Goldman Sachs, Amazon, Revolut, Rippling, and the world's leading firms. 

Alaan has been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 list, UAE Future 100 list, selected as an Endeavor company, and ranked the No. 1 spend management platform in EMEA by G2. 

*Alaan is a fintech company, not a bank. Business bank accounts are issued by ruya. 

About the role

We are looking for a Tech Lead to design, build, and optimize our platform architecture. You will play a key role in leading the backend team, ensuring high availability, scalability, and performance of our services. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in Node. js, cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), APIs, and event-driven architectures, along with experience in both SQL and NoSQL databases. 

You will also be responsible for monitoring, logging, and observability, ensuring seamless performance using tools like New Relic, Datadog, and other observability stacks. 

What you'll do

- Technical Leadership: Lead and mentor a team of engineers in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable backend systems. 
 - Backend Development: Build high-performance, secure, and scalable backend services using Node. js. 
 - API Development: Design and implement RESTful, ensuring best practices in API security and efficiency
 - Cloud Infrastructure: Manage and optimize deployments on AWS & GCP, including infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform/CDK. 
 - Event-Driven Architecture: Implement event-driven microservices using Pub/Sub, Kafka, SNS/SQS, or EventBridge. 
 - Database Management: Work with SQL (PostgreSQL/RDS) and NoSQL (MongoDB or Elasticsearch) databases, ensuring performance and scalability. 
 - Scalability & Performance: Design and implement strategies for high availability, auto-scaling, and load balancing in cloud environments. 
 - Security & Compliance: Enforce security best practices, manage IAM roles, and ensure compliance with industry standards. 
 - Automation & CI/CD: Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for seamless deployment and integration
 - Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, frontend engineers, and DevOps teams to drive efficient development and deployment processes. 

What we're looking for

Must-have skills: 

- At least 5 to 8 years of relevant experience in technical development
 - Strong proficiency in Node. js with frameworks like NestJS, Express. js
 - Experience with AWS & GCP services (EC2, S3, Lambda, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, IAM, VPC, etc. )
 - Expertise in API development & integration (REST, GraphQL, WebSockets)
 - Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures (SNS/SQS or Pub/Sub)
 - Strong knowledge of SQL databases (PostgreSQL, RDS) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Elasticsearch)
 - Experience in scaling microservices & optimizing system performance
 - Proficiency in logging, monitoring, and observability tools (New Relic, Datadog, Prometheus, Loki, etc. )
 - Strong understanding of containerization (Docker or Kubernetes or Cloud Run)
 - Knowledge of security best practices, authentication mechanisms (JWT, oauth, SAML)Good-to-have skills: 

- Experience in serverless architecture (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions)
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code (cloudFormation, Terraform, CDK, C)
 - Knowledge of message queues (AWS SQS, GCP Pub/Sub, Kafka)
 - Exposure to distributed tracing (Jaeger, OpenTelemetry)
 - Hands-on experience with feature flagging & experimentation (LaunchDarkly)
 - Background in high-volume transaction systems & fintech is a plus

What's in it for you

- Contribute to building the Middle East's most beloved fintech brand from the ground up
 - Benefit from a role with significant ownership and accountability
 - Thrive in a flexible hybrid culture with ample work-life balance
 - Participate in exciting offsite events
 - Competitive salary and equity
 - Enjoy additional perks like travel allowances, gym memberships, and more

What You'll Do

- AI Development: Drive the enablement of AI and Generative AI, specifically focusing on the development and management of applications using Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and Agentic AI.

 - Engineer prompt handling and intent recognition for LLMs, exposing capabilities via APIs for enterprise-scale use cases. 
 - Design, develop, and optimize in-app and role-based AI Agents with secure, scalable semantic layers, multi-agent protocols, and agent training features. 
 - Lead implementation of agentic frameworks (langraph, langchain, LLMs) to enable robust Ask/Respond capabilities using enterprise data sources. 
 - Build and maintain advanced Natural Language Interaction (NLI) & Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems tailored for enterprise data. 
 - Develop, maintain, and enhance secure data connectors for major enterprise databases (Oracle, MongoDB). 

Who You'll Work With

As a member of the Cisco IT team, you will be a valuable part of the Asset & Entitlement Engineering team. Our team is dedicated to delivering exceptional services, tools, platforms, and data that are essential for powering one of the top Supply Chain, Customer Experience and Product Lifecycle Management to Cisco Customers. 

At Cisco, we prioritize innovation and evolution to provide our Supply Chain, Customer Experience and Commerce Product Management team with a competitive advantage. This includes optimizing and automating business process systems, effectively utilizing cloud service providers, and developing cutting-edge in-house solutions. 

You will collaborate with Product Owners, Other Architects, Tech Leads, Analysts, and global delivery teams within the Organization, as well as across various functions in Cisco. 

You'll have the opportunity to join a dynamic, empowered, and collaborative team that values diverse perspectives and inclusive practices, all focused on building, supporting, and enhancing a seamless end-to-end Orchestrator system. 

We believe that embracing diversity and fostering an inclusive environment are key to driving innovation and achieving success. Our team is committed to ensuring that everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to contribute their unique ideas and experiences. 

Who You Are

As an experienced software engineer, you possess a deep passion for technology and excel in developing applications within agile environments. Your self-motivation and resourcefulness enable you to tackle complex challenges and drive innovative solutions. You thrive in collaborative settings, working effectively with stakeholders to deliver growth and value across projects. 

Your adaptability allows you to navigate ambiguity with ease, making you an asset in dynamic and evolving situations. You have a demonstrated ability to influence and inspire both within your team and across the organization, contributing to strategic initiatives and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. 

Minimum Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in computer science/engineering with 5 years of software development experience or master's degree in computer science/engineering with 3 years of relevant experience
 - A good team player, with a positive and self-starter attitude. 
 - Data Structures: In-depth knowledge and practical application of various data structures. 
 - Algorithms: Proficiency in the design, analysis, and implementation of algorithms. 
 - Database Proficiency: Proficient in SQL for relational databases and experienced with NoSQL database concepts. 
 - Java Programming: Strong programming skills in Java, including Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and framework experience. 
 - Proficiency in Python programming language or similar. 
 - Strong understanding of artificial intelligence concepts and experience in implementing AI techniques in practical applications, as well as a proficiency in security. 
 - Good understanding of Agile and DevSecOps practices and toolsets. 
 - Hands on experience on AI Native Development and Tools
 - In-depth knowledge on Design Patterns
 - Hands on experience in developing web-based applications using Java, Spring Boot, ELK, Mongo, Snowflake, Angular/React JS, Python, PL/SQL, Kafka
 - Proficiency in Sql, Pl/Sql and Extensive hands-on experience with relational, in-memory and NoSQL databases including Oracle, Snowflake and Mongo. 
 - Hands-on with Web Services and JSON. 
 - Positive and self-starter attitude, with a strong communication and time management skillset. 
 - Works independently but seeks guidance from leaders when needed and determines the best approach to accomplish work. Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience. 

Preferred Requirements

- Oracle Ecosystem Expertise: Advanced skills in Oracle Database, PL/SQL

 - MongoDB (NoSQL): Experience with database design, querying, and management in a NoSQL environment.

 - Experience with vector databases, such as Weaviate or similar. 
 - Experience with design and development of advanced Agentic AI workflows orchestration. 

Why Cisco?

#WeAreCisco. We are all unique, but together we bring our talents to work as a team to develop innovative technology and empower a more inclusive, digital future for everyone. How do we accomplish this? Well, to start with, we have people like you!

Almost every internet connection worldwide is connected to Cisco. We are optimistic about the internet. Our technology ensures that data travels securely at the speed of light across connections. It's not just about what we create, but about the impact we make. We assist those in the healthcare industry in connecting with patients and each other, as well as helping schools, colleges, and universities teach even in the most difficult times. We also help businesses of all sizes connect with their employees and customers in new ways, providing people with the digital skills they need and reaching the most remote parts of the world. 

We tackle any challenges that come our way. We support and recognize each other's achievements, and we grow together. We celebrate and support each other, from small everyday moments to significant career milestones. Giving back is part of our DNA (we have 10 days off each year to do just that). 

We understand that building an inclusive future begins with us. Without diversity and a commitment to equality, progress is not possible. Our 30 Inclusive Communities, which bring people together based on common interests or passions, are leading the way. Together, we are dedicated to learning, listening, caring for our communities, and supporting the most vulnerable through collective efforts to make the world a better place, whether through technology or our actions. 

So, do you have colorful hair? We don't mind. Tattoos? Show off your ink. Like polka dots? That's cool. A fan of pop culture? Many of us are too. Do you have a passion for technology and changing the world? Be yourself, join us! #WeAreCisco

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.
