 - You're energised by early-stage ambiguity and can build a path where there isn't one
 - You communicate clearly with designers, PMs, and backend engineers

What We Offer

- Hard UX problems: making AI output feel fast and trustworthy inside the tools people already use
 - Direct access to the founder
 - Competitive salary plus ESOPs
 - Best-in-class dev tools and AI assistants
 - Health insurance

IND Senior Software Engineer - GCC024

We're determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals - and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own design, development, unit/integration testing, implementation, and support for assigned components within enterprise Employee Benefits applications. 
 - Design and maintain . NET Framework and . NET Core / . NET 8 services, APIs, backend components, and batch jobs. 
 - Translate business and technical requirements into secure, maintainable application modules and APIs. 
 - Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to accelerate coding, test generation, documentation, analysis, and refactoring while validating quality, security, and compliance. 
 - Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, estimation, feature/story refinement, demos, retrospectives, and production readiness discussions. 
 - Collaborate with product owners, scrum masters, architects, QA/SDET, UX, platform, DevOps, and business partners to deliver outcomes, not just code. 
 - Partner with Java/API, Angular/UI, and QA/SDET engineers when the same business capability spans BFF, domain APIs, UI, integrations, and batch platforms. 
 - Perform peer code reviews and contribute to engineering standards for code quality, testing, security, accessibility, observability, and performance. 
 - Troubleshoot production/non-production issues using logs, monitoring dashboards, traces, database analysis, and structured root-cause thinking. 
 - Support modernization and reverse-engineering of legacy . NET assets, using analysis, tests, documentation, and AI-assisted tools to reduce SME dependency. 
 - Document technical decisions, implementation notes, runbooks, operational impacts, and knowledge-transfer artifacts for the POD. 

Technical Knowledge Requirements

Area

Required Capability

What good looks like in the HIG India POD

Core . NET engineering

C#, . NET Framework, . NET Core / . NET 8, APIs, backend services, batch/process design, dependency injection, exception handling. 

Produces clean, testable, secure code; understands tradeoffs between quick fixes, refactoring, and long-term maintainability. 

API and integration

RESTful APIs, JSON, service contracts, authentication/authorization concepts, API gateway integration awareness, experience API/BFF patterns. 

Can design/consume APIs, validate payloads, handle failure modes, and communicate integration dependencies early. 

Data and SQL

Oracle SQL, relational database design principles, stored procedures/functions awareness, query performance, NoSQL exposure. 

Can troubleshoot data issues, write efficient queries, understand impact of data model changes, and work with DBAs when needed. 

Cloud and DevOps

AWS fundamentals including EC2, ECS, Batch, Lambda, S3, SQS, CloudWatch; CI/CD concepts; GitHub, pull requests, branching, GitHub Actions/Jenkins. 

Builds cloud-ready solutions, understands deployment pipelines, and anticipates operational/readiness needs. 

Testing and quality

Unit testing, integration testing, automated regression, mocking, test data setup, code coverage, static analysis, secure coding. 

Treats testing as part of engineering ownership rather than a downstream QA handoff. 

Observability and support

Splunk/Dynatrace/CloudWatch concepts, structured logging, error handling, performance analysis, root cause analysis. 

Can diagnose issues, improve logging, and turn recurring defects into tech debt reduction stories. 

AI-assisted engineering

GitHub Copilot or equivalent; prompt-based code analysis, test generation, documentation, refactoring assistance; responsible review of AI output. 

Uses AI to accelerate delivery while validating security, correctness, maintainability, and enterprise standards. 

Frontend awareness

JavaScript/TypeScript, Angular or React exposure; CSS/HTML basics; accessibility/WCAG awareness. 

Can collaborate with UI engineers and understand end-to-end flow even when primarily backend focused. 

Leadership Expectations

Area

What Good Looks Like In The HIG India POD

Ownership

Takes accountability for outcomes, not only assigned tasks. 

Raises risks early, follows through on commitments, and drives blockers to closure. 

Technical judgment

Uses design thinking and tradeoff analysis to choose maintainable solutions. 

Can explain options, risks, and recommended approach to tech leads and stakeholders. 

Collaboration

Works across US/India time zones and functions without waiting for perfect instructions. 

Brings questions, proposals, and artifacts that make decisions easier. 

Mentoring

Helps peers with code reviews, debugging, standards, and onboarding. 

Improves POD capability through examples, documentation, and pairing. 

Bias for action

Moves work forward with appropriate urgency while respecting enterprise controls. 

Breaks ambiguous problems into next steps and demonstrates follow-through. 

Business Acumen Expectations

Area

What Good Looks Like In The HIG India POD

Outcome orientation

Understands how technical work supports claimant, employer, operations, and product outcomes. 

Frames decisions around stability, speed, user experience, and business risk. 

Domain awareness

Develops working knowledge of Employee Benefits, claims, intake, leave, payments, profile, and service workflows relevant to the POD. 

Can connect defects/features to user journeys and operational impact. 

Risk and controls

Understands compliance, data protection, security, accessibility, and production-readiness expectations. 

Does not treat controls as afterthoughts; plans for them during development. 

Financial awareness

Understands HIG India is a strategic capacity and vendor-reduction lever. 

Demonstrates productivity, knowledge transfer, and reduced dependency on external SMEs. 

Communication

Communicates clearly with business/technology partners using concise status, risks, decisions, and asks. 

Can explain technical topics in business-friendly language. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 4+ years of software engineering experience, preferably in enterprise application environments. 
 - Hands-on C# and . NET development experience; . NET Framework and . NET Core / . NET 8 proficiency preferred. 
 - Strong SQL skills with Oracle experience; ability to analyze data issues and support query-level troubleshooting. 
 - Experience building or consuming REST APIs and integrating with enterprise systems. 
 - Experience with Agile delivery and sprint-based planning/execution. 
 - Working knowledge of Git/GitHub workflows, pull requests, branch management, and peer code reviews. 
 - Understanding of unit/integration testing and DevSecOps practices. 
 - Cloud fundamentals, with AWS exposure strongly preferred. 
 - Ability to use AI-assisted development tools and review AI-generated output responsibly. 

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

- Python experience for scripting, batch, data processing or automation. 
 - Angular/React/TypeScript exposure and ability to support full-stack delivery when needed. 
 - Experience with AWS ECS, Lambda, Batch, CloudWatch, SQS, or similar services. 
 - Observability tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, CloudWatch, or equivalent. 
 - Experience supporting production applications and participating in incident/problem resolution. 
 - Insurance, benefits, claims, leave, billing, or portal experience.

Description

Do you want to be a leader in the team that takes last mile delivery in the Transportation models to the next generation? Do you have a solid analytical thinking and want to solve problems with solutions that will meet the growing worldwide need? If you have passion to learn and be curious, and want apply your programming and analytical skills to help Amazon grow, then Last Mile Delivery Service Partner (Last Mile DSP) is the team for you. We are looking for top notch SDEs to be part of our world class software development team. 

DSP (Delivery Service Partners) are medium and large sized 3rd party businesses delivering packages from amazon last mile delivery stations to the customer on behalf of Amazon. The team's global mission is to become Amazon's logistics labor capacity of choice by building the provider network required to support Amazon's growth and meet customer expectations for any deliveries, at any time of the year through scalable, innovative, and low cost operations, and in a way that both delights customers and empowers DSPs and their Delivery Associates. 

The DSP Engagement tech owns and develops technical infrastructure for a multi-tenant omni channel platform to create and send communications across Amazon Delivery partners, delivering 100M individual notifications per year. We own the how, the when and the what of all communications sent to Amazon delivery partners. 

SDE2s in this team will be independent problem solvers creating business impact through their tech deliverables. They will learn, grow and create a lasting impact to business and their careers while having fun at work. 

Key job responsibilities

- You can effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions to tech and non-tech audiences. 
 - You have experience with architecting systems involving data processing components, workflow orchestration and dependency management. 
 - You have expertise in the creation and management of backend and frontend applications and data stores, as well as proven ability to translate data into meaningful insights. 
 - You use object-oriented design concepts to program large multi-tier systems. 

A day in the life

You will be part of a team that is responsible for all aspects of logistics capacity, onboarding and customer experience areas covering visual interface to the back end services. You will be working with technologies to improve usability and increase resiliency and scalability. 

You will translate business requirements to technical deliverables and deliver operationally stable solution that provide good customer experience. 

Candidates need to have strong ownership, passion to provide great customer experience and excellent troubleshooting skills. Experience building resilient web/mobile loved applications and/or web services-based applications is desired. 

We strongly believe in work life harmony, diversity, recognition, career and fun@work

data.title: Team Leader
data.description:
Job Description: 

About Us

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. 

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates' physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. 

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. 

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs. 

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Global Business Services

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. 

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. 

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services

Process Overview

The GBS GMO QA team sits within the Global Markets Operations Risk function. The team delivers robust and consistent oversight and support for all forms of GMO Risk performed QA and EIT (Enterprise Independent Testing) performed QA of GMO processes and controls. QA includes in-house QA which is supported by the GMO Risk team and EIT (Enterprise Independent Testing) QA. 

Job Description

The role drives centralized execution and oversight of GMO QA activities, including test design, execution, validation, and reporting. It involves coordinating with FLU and EIT to ensure effective governance, accurate issue resolution, and continuous improvement through data-driven insights and automation. 

undefined

Responsibilities

Support BAU, including the execution of in-house QA testing Manage new tests, modification of tests. Critical partner for EIT and FLU in test design, development and migration to EIT. 

Manage the end-to-end process of test results, critical liaison with FLU including: 

Monitor and accept testing results. 

Investigate and rebut unacceptable results. 

Validate failed tests and ensure satisfactory resolution of valid fails. 

Self-serve and interpret results data, create reporting and manage escalations as necessary. 

Carry out testing of new QA tests (where applicable), 

Manage the implementation of new tests and

Oversee the transition of tests to EIT

Report testing results to FLU

Analyze testing results to identify trends, themes, and systemic issues to drive

remediation and continuous improvement

undefined

Provide overarching governance and oversight of all GMO EIT QA: 

Monitor and oversee EIT as service provider. 

Define the organizational approach for QA, including the rationale for which QA is transitioned to EIT, and which remains. 

Define the organizational approach for test design/test script standards, calculation methodologies and thresholds, change controls and test script reviews. 

Design tests, create test scripts, capture all testing documentation. 

Carry out testing of new QA tests, manage the implementation of new tests and oversee the transition of tests to EIT. 

Define the process and rationale for the proactive review and refresh of QA tests and manage all identified changes. 

QA data analysis - trending, themes etc

To explore and implement automated solutions to create efficiency within the QA process

Requirements

Education: Graduate / Post Graduate. 

Certifications If any: NA

Experience Range: 4-6 Years

Foundational skills: 

- Strong organizational, prioritization, and communication (oral / written) skills with attention to detail· 
 - Strong coordination skills as will need to navigate across several GMO teams and enterprise stakeholders· 
 - High level of attention to detail, ability to self-start and adapt to a fast-paced environment with multiple deliverables. 
 - Able to build/maintain relationships with key stakeholders· 
 - Preferred skills include experience with SharePoint, BI and Tableau reporting, risk data analysis, Alteryx/ETL workflows, and advanced Excel and PowerPoint. 
 - Knowledge of GMO processes and controls is desirable, to be able to understand and define testing requirements for key processes. 
 - Experience in a testing environment is preferred. 
 - Within a risk, regulatory compliance or audit function would be an advantage but not essential

Desired skills: 

- 
 - 2 years of overall experience in banking industry· 
 - Strives to bring new thoughts and ideas to teams in order to drive innovation and unique solutions· 
 - Excels in working among diverse viewpoints to determine the best path forward· 
 - Experience in connecting with a diverse set of clients to understand future business needs - is a continuous learner· 
 - Commitment to challenging the status quo and promoting positive change. 
 - Participate in and drive collaborative efforts to advance tools, technology, and ways of working to better serve an evolving client base· 
 - Believes in value of diversity so we can reflect, connect and meet the diverse needs of our clients and employees around the world 
 - Work Timings: 11: 30 AM to 8: 30 PM IST
 - Job Location: GIFT/ Hyderabad

data.description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours. 

You are part of a team responsible for experimenting with cutting-edge technologies, delivering solutions by testing and learning and developing strong partnerships to enable growth through innovation and agile methodologies. 

How You Will Contribute

You will conduct innovative pilot projects to drive disruptive ideas across the organization, using the learnings from these projects to inform decisions on whether to incorporate them as a portfolio project or to introduce them as a new proof of concept. Working with other Mondelēz teams, you will get to experiment with cutting-edge technologies to build a strong pipeline of ideas to pursue. In addition, you will get to bring the outside in by building relationships with start-ups and building your knowledge of actual proof-of-concept cases and lead end-to-end product management activities after the proof of concept has been successfully adopted. 

What You Will Bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in: 

- Project management including knowledge of Agile
 - Technical expertise and a passion for innovation
 - Technical and business acumen to evaluate opportunities with internal and external partners
 - Understanding a variety of disruptive technology products and services
 - Machine learning/artificial intelligence programming languages
 - The start-up landscape
 - Familiarity with the fast-moving consumer goods or related sector
 - Driving for results and Analytical skills

More About This Role

What you need to know about this position: 

The individual in this role will be the process and system expert in Customer Care and Order to Cash, with a focus on AI-powered solutions. Responsible for leading end-to-end project delivery - from scope definition through build, delivery, and deployment - of intelligent Customer Care capabilities including Agentic AI, intelligent insights, automated case management, and human-in-the-loop workflows that improve service quality and reduce manual effort across OTC. 

What extra ingredients you will bring: 

- The SDE is accountable for ensuring all project activities in their area are on track, within cost, ensuring the benefits are realized
 - SDE will drive applying and leveraging existing processes and systems, while identifying opportunities to introduce AI-driven automation
 - Acquire a maintain a global view of business set up and practices to draft fit for purpose test plans across various changes
 - Level 5 expertise in OTC and Customer Care process design and implementation at application level (Functional design template owner)
 - Lead the design and delivery of Agentic AI capabilities plus product specific products (SAP; analytics BI/ Databricks)- including intelligent query intake, intent-based routing, case coordination, and automated resolution
 - Partners with MDS community and business stakeholders to understand Customer Care requirements and translate those into technical requirements, AI solution designs, and implementation plans
 - An Application Functional role in a project team to execute and support full project lifecycle including blueprint, build, testing, implementation, user training and post go-live support - with particular focus on AI model validation and confidence tuning
 - Define and implement Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) frameworks for AI-assisted response generation and case resolution oversight
 - Accountable for adherence to Toll Gate Methodology and all appropriate Global release processes
 - Responsible to implement new AI-powered solutions as per the architecture designed by the GSO, enterprise architects and solution architects, ensuring that new solutions are cost optimized and easy to maintain
 - Support non-discretionary projects leveraging an external partner strategy (including AI/cloud vendors)
 - Provides project planning and estimates to develop, implement and roll out pilot and commercialized AI and Customer Care solutions in OTC
 - Ensure adoption of globally harmonized processes, ways of working, and strategic AI solutions within the Customer Care and OTC space

Job specific requirements: 

'- Sales & Distribution, Order to Cash process experience with a focus on Customer Care and case management

- Experience designing or delivering AI/ML or Generative AI solutions (e. g. , intelligent automation, NLP, agentic workflows)
 - DevOps deployment methodologies; TGM methodology understanding, Project/Program Management (internal process can be taught)
 - Good knowledge of sales and distributions of fast-moving retail business processes and related technology solutions
 - Vendor Management, particularly with cloud and AI technology partners (e. g. , AWS)
 - Good understanding of OTC tools, architecture, functions and features - including AI orchestration frameworks (e. g. , AWS Agent Core)
 - Good functional knowledge of SAP SD modules, standard Customer EDI processes (5-7 years' experience minimum)
 - Familiarity with customer query management, case routing, SLA monitoring, and resolution workflows
 - Advanced English level oral and written

Work schedule: Hybrid

No Relocation support available

Business Unit Summary

At Mondelēz International, our purpose is to empower people to snack right by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way. That means delivering a broad range of delicious, high-quality snacks that nourish life's moments, made with sustainable ingredients and packaging that consumers can feel good about. 

We have a rich portfolio of strong brands globally and locally including many household names such as Oreo, belVita and LU biscuits; Cadbury Dairy Milk, Milka and Toblerone chocolate; Sour Patch Kids candy and Trident gum. We are proud to hold the top position globally in biscuits, chocolate and candy and the second top position in gum. 

Our 80, 000 makers and bakers are located in more than 80 countries and we sell our products in over 150 countries around the world. Our people are energized for growth and critical to us living our purpose and values. We are a diverse community that can make things happen-and happen fast. 

Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead Platform Engineer

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. 

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. 

Overview

The Lead Platform Engineer is a hands-on technical leader responsible for designing, building, and maintaining automation frameworks and platform services that support largescale hybrid infrastructure environments. This role focuses on engineering reusable automation patterns using Chef, Infrastructure as Code, and DevOps tooling to deliver consistent, secure, and self-service infrastructure capabilities. The ideal candidate brings strong DevOps engineering experience, deep knowledge of Chef (Infra, Habitat, or Automate), and a passion for building scalable automation systems, not performing manual operations. 

- Design, develop, and maintain Chef cookbooks, recipes, roles, and policy files to automate configuration management across cloud and prem environments. 
 - Build and maintain Chef Automate or equivalent orchestration pipelines for compliance, reporting, and fleet management. 
 - Engineer reusable automation frameworks, including shared libraries, templates, and patterns for consistent infrastructure provisioning. 
 - Integrate Chef automation with CI/CD pipelines, secrets management, artifact repositories, and enterprise governance controls. 
 - Implement automated testing and validation for Chef code using tools such as Test Kitchen, InSpec, and ChefSpec. 
 - Collaborate with cloud, platform, and security teams to define and enforce configuration baselines, compliance policies, and hardened system standards. 
 - Support the design and implementation of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep) for provisioning compute, network, and platform services. 
 - Troubleshoot complex automation, configuration, and infrastructure issues across hybrid environments. 
 - Contribute to platform engineering initiatives such as self-service catalogs, GitOps workflows, and automated remediation. 
 - Document automation patterns, architectural decisions, and operational runbooks. 

All bout you

- 5-8+ years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, or configuration management roles. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Chef Infra, including cookbook development, policy files, Test Kitchen, and InSpec. 
 - Experience managing largescale configuration management environments (Chef Server, Chef Automate, or similar). 
 - Solid understanding of Linux systems administration, OS hardening, and configuration of lifecycle management. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and on Prem virtualization (VMware, HyperV). 
 - Strong scripting or programming skills (Ruby preferred for Chef, plus Python, Bash, or PowerShell). 
 - Experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Strong understanding of Git workflows, branching strategies, and code review practices. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot complex automation and infrastructure issues across hybrid environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Chef Habitat or application-level automation. 
 - Experience with Chef Automate for compliance, reporting, and fleet orchestration. 
 - Familiarity with Terraform or other IaC tools for provisioning infrastructure. 
 - Experience with policyascode tools (OPA, Conftest, Sentinel). 
 - Background in security hardening, compliance frameworks, or CIS benchmarks. 
 - Exposure to Kubernetes, Helm, or container orchestration. 
 - Experience with monitoring and observability platforms (Prometheus, Datadog, Splunk, ELK). 
 - Knowledge of network automation or infrastructure APIs. 
 - Core Technical Skills (Competency Areas)
 - Configuration Management
 - Chef Infra (cookbooks, recipes, policy files)
 - Chef Automate, InSpec, Test Kitchen
 - Ruby development for automation
 - Infrastructure as Code & Provisioning
 - Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep (preferred but not required)
 - Hybrid cloud provisioning (AWS, Azure, GCP)
 - VMware and on Prem infrastructure automation
 - DevOps & CI/CD
 - Pipeline design and automation
 - Automated testing, linting, and security scanning

 - Automation & Scripting
 - Ruby, Python, Bash, PowerShell

 - Platform Engineering
 - Self-service automation
 - Configuration baselines and compliance automation
 - Observability and operational tooling

Corporate Security Responsibility

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:

data.title: Senior Angular Developer
data.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Angular Frontend Developer to serve as the technical owner and frontend gatekeeper for the MPS2 platform. 

The application is a large enterprise Angular system (~900+ TypeScript files, 120+ routes) developed by multiple contributors over time. The primary objective is to lead the structural modernization of this codebase: decomposing a monolithic root module into domain-driven lazy-loaded feature modules, establishing reusable UI components, remediating architectural tech debt, enforcing robust quality gates, and standardizing patterns to prepare the application for AI-assisted SDLC workflows. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architectural Refactoring & Modularization: 
 - Progressively decompose the oversized root module (AppModule) and routing configuration into clean, domain-driven, lazy-loaded feature modules (e. g. , Programme Authoring, Payments, Vehicle Inquiry, Batch Runs). 
 - Enforce clear boundaries between Core, Shared, and Feature layers, eliminating boundary leaks (such as direct HttpClient calls in UI components). 
 - UI/UX Standardization & Reusable Components: 
 - Design, build, and maintain a centralized library of reusable UI components and shared layout/form patterns. 
 - Standardize UI styling, design tokens, and user flows across disparate screens created by different contributors. 
 - Reactive Stream & State Management Governance: 
 - Overhaul RxJS subscription handling across 150+ components-introducing strict teardown patterns (takeUntilDestroyed, DestroyRef, async pipe) to eliminate memory leaks. 
 - Rationalize state management and transition away from scattered, ad-hoc localStorage/sessionStorage dependencies toward predictable reactive services. 
 - Code Quality, Standards & Gatekeeping: 
 - Serve as the frontend gatekeeper by conducting rigorous PR reviews for contributions made by other engineers. 
 - Establish and enforce strict linting, TypeScript typing, and naming conventions to clean up multi-author drift and folder anomalies. 
 - Activate meaningful unit test baselines (Jasmine/Karma), restoring automated test coverage and CI build/lint validation gates. 
 - AI-SDLC Enablement: 
 - Clean, standardize, and document coding patterns and component templates to allow effective adoption of AI-assisted engineering tools across the team. 
 - Experience: 5 to 8 years of professional frontend development, with at least 4+ years dedicated to modern Angular (Angular 14+, Angular 17 strongly preferred) and TypeScript. 
 - Large-Scale Architecture: Demonstrated experience restructuring large monolithic Angular codebases into lazy-loaded feature modules and core/shared libraries. 
 - RxJS Mastery: Advanced command of RxJS operators, observable lifecycle management, leak prevention, and change detection optimization (ChangeDetectionStrategy. OnPush). 
 - Design Systems & Component Design: Hands-on experience building modular, reusable component systems, accessible forms (Reactive Forms), and scalable SCSS structures. 
 - Quality & Testing: Strong proficiency in writing robust unit tests using Angular TestBed, Jasmine, and Karma, along with configuring ESLint/Stylelint rules. 
 - Engineering Discipline: Strong PR review etiquette, technical leadership, and clear communication skills to guide and mentor non-frontend-focused developers.

data.title: Senior Design Engineer
data.description:
About Aion

aion is the enterprise AI platform, a full-stack solution for building, fine-tuning, and deploying AI at scale. Whether an organization is modernizing internal operations, launching AI-powered products, or transforming customer experiences, aion takes them from concept to production on a single, unified platform. 

We're a fast-growing, VC-backed startup led by founders with a track record of successful exits. With teams across the US, UK, and India, we're building the next generation of enterprise AI and we're looking for exceptional people to help us scale. 

We're hiring a design engineer who builds like a founder. You see what's missing and make it exist: you design it, build it, ship it and own it. Code is your design material, and you write a shader when CSS runs out. The bar is an interface that feels physical: it tracks the finger, carries momentum and never drops a frame. 

What You'll Do

- Take ideas from a blank file to production: decide what's worth building, prototype it in code, and own it once it ships
 - Build production UI in React and TypeScript, from primitives to complete surfaces
 - Build the custom tools that make the team faster: design-system tooling, motion tuners, debug overlays and internal apps
 - Tune motion and gestures until they feel physical: momentum, weight and interruption
 - Create 3D, shader and generative work where it lifts the experience
 - Review every build on real devices at 1× and 2×, and keep it fast, accessible and robust under abuse

Requirements

Interaction

- You treat interaction design as thinning the layer between intent and software, and your work has moments where the interface inferred what someone wanted instead of asking
 - Physics is a toolkit to you, not a style: springs tuned by stiffness, damping and mass; velocity projected on release so a flick finishes the job; rubber banding where a hard stop would feel broken; secondary elements interpolated from the gesture driving them
 - You give movement conceptual weight: light things settle quickly, heavy and destructive things resist, and bounce appears only where something was thrown
 - Your gestures have three beats, constrain on start, track 1: 1 on move, resolve on end, and stay contained: no stray text selection, no triggered neighbours, no pointer lost at the edge
 - Choreography is second nature: the primary element answers instantly, secondary elements follow late, exits clear faster than entrances arrive, and a touch of blur hides the seams
 - Your restraint scales with frequency and input: touch gets the most feedback, the pointer some, the keyboard almost none, and anything used a hundred times a day loses its animation

Craft

- You build without waiting: when a tool, component or prototype doesn't exist, you make it, and you've shipped things of your own that people use
 - Code is your design material. You judge an idea by building and using it, prototype in the browser rather than in static frames, and polish only once the idea has earned it
 - You iterate until nothing is left to explore, then have the discipline to choose the simple version from many iterations back
 - Robustness is binary to you: you spam every state, scroll too fast, drag past every edge, and cut any detail that can't work every time
 - You see at the pixel: optical alignment at high zoom, animations scrubbed frame by frame, and before-and-after captures on every change
 - Native first: real scroll over hijacked wheel events, clip-path over animating width, CSS keyframes before reaching for a library
 - You study the work you admire by rebuilding it, then make something unmistakably your own

Engineering

- 5+ years shipping production front ends, with live work you can link to
 - React and TypeScript at expert level, with component APIs that don't lie: contextual props, derived state, variants over boolean flags and compound components
 - Motion values and direct DOM updates for anything high-frequency, so gestures and scroll never wait on a render
 - CSS in depth: clip-path, masks, backdrop filters, blend modes, scroll-driven animations, container queries and the View Transitions API
 - Type and pixels in code: variable fonts, optical sizing, OpenType features, and layouts free of shift and subpixel blur at 1×, 2× and 3×
 - Performance as a feature: an 8 ms frame budget at 120 Hz, compositor-only animation, and pages that load instantly because every byte was questioned
 - Accessibility as craft: focus rings styled rather than removed, focus moved into overlays and back, full keyboard paths and reduced-motion settings honoured

3D and creative

- Real-time 3D with Three. js or React Three Fiber on WebGL or WebGPU
 - Shaders in GLSL or WGSL: noise, signed distance fields, glass, refraction, lighting and post-processing, all inside the frame budget
 - Motion studies in After Effects and 3D in Cinema 4D or Blender, so ideas move before a line of production code exists
 - Generative and data-driven work in Canvas and SVG, and interactive animation in Rive

Building for AI

- Interfaces for streamed, non-deterministic output: progressive rendering, interruption and retry
 - You build daily with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, use them to ship whole tools and products on your own, and review every line they write

Good to have

- Custom tools you built that others rely on: plugins, design and motion tooling, debug overlays, generators or internal apps
 - Something you started and shipped yourself: a product, a studio, a library or a side project with real users/customers
 - Writing and articles about your craft: essays, breakdowns or notes that show how you think
 - Creative coding or generative art
 - Open-source work in motion, graphics or UI components

Benefits

- Work directly with high-pedigree founders shaping technical and product strategy
 - Build infrastructure powering the future of AI compute globally
 - Significant ownership and impact with equity reflective of your contributions
 - Competitive compensation, flexible work options, and wellness benefits

Lead and manage the quality assurance function across the assigned cluster, ensuring that the right quality of products is consistently manufactured to meet customer requirements. - Lead efforts to resolve customer complaints by ensuring the root cause is identified and corrective actions are implemented across all plants in the cluster.

 - Ensure consistent communication and reporting of quality metrics and improvement initiatives to customers and corporate quality teams. 2. Product Quality Assurance

- Ensure all manufacturing plants within the cluster adhere to defined product quality standards and processes.

 - Coordinate observations from all plant audits through Plant Quality Head and Plant Head for reporting and submission to the customer

- Provide strategic direction and operational support to Plant Quality Heads, ensuring alignment with cluster-level quality goals. 
 - Establish clear quality-related expectations and review the performance of Plant Quality Heads through regular assessments and feedback sessions. 
 - Act as a bridge between Plant Quality Heads and the Regional Quality to address escalations and implement cluster-wide quality improvement initiatives. 
 - Facilitate collaboration among Plant Quality Heads to share best practices and address common challenges. 5. Continuous Improvement in Quality

- Lead initiatives to drive continuous improvement in product quality, focusing on reducing internal and external defects. 
 - Oversee the implementation of corrective and preventive actions for recurring quality issues. 
 - Promote a culture of quality and accountability by fostering ownership of quality metrics at all levels within the cluster. 6. Team Development and Management

We are seeking a highly experienced Staff Cloud Engineer to support enterprise-scale application migrations to the cloud with a primary focus on AWS.

You will partner with platform engineering, security, and external vendors to build, deploy, and operate cloud-native infrastructure and application platforms, focusing on container-first deployment patterns and Kubernetes-based architectures. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Implement and execute standardized migration patterns to AWS, including rehost, replatform, redeploy, refactor.

- Automation pipelines

- Runbooks and deployment frameworks

- Cutover orchestration and execution

- Build and implement tooling and automation frameworks to support high-scale migrations. 

- Drive adoption of container-first strategies, including VM-to-container migration and Kubernetes (EKS) deployments. 

- Define and implement technical deployment models, including: 

- VM rehosting and replatforming patterns

- Containerized application deployment models

- Kubernetes-based microservices architectures

- Configure and deploy AWS infrastructure and platform services, including: 

- Compute, storage, and networking services such as VPCs, load balancers, and DNS

- Databases and middleware platforms

- Container platforms, container registries, and runtime environments, including EKS

- Build and support CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure automation and containerized application deployment. 

- Develop Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) modules and reusable deployment templates. 

- Integrate automation and scripting using Python and Bash to streamline provisioning, deployment, and operational workflows.

data.description:
Hello Visionary!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We're looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you'd make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent run company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. In Mobility, we help our customers meet the need for hard-working mobility solutions. We're making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions!

We are looking for Project and Design Lead Engineer - Cubicle Design (Locomotive and Cab Cars)

You'll make a difference by

As a Technical Manager, you coordinate software development for locomotive control technology within the framework of customer-neutral product development, ensuring timely and quality-compliant implementation. You are responsible for work packages for the European market, manage engineering teams, and ensure compatibility with hardware and platform requirements. You bring a solid technical education, extensive experience in rail vehicle software and project management, as well as strong communication and teamwork skills. 

- You will be responsible for the integration process of electrical components from the beginning of concept development to the assembly support of rail vehicles. 
 - You will be fully responsible for the design and integration of electrical and pneumatic components (including electrical cabinets and containers with associated cable-routing). 
 - You must understand standard engineering practices (example: material selection, Tolerance stack up, Location strategy, manufacturing, serviceability, assembly, LCC, testability, DFMEA). 
 - Within development, you will define and consider transversal and interface requirements (e. g. insulation coordination, fire protection, EMC, earthing, ethernet, electrical cable-routing etc. ) and be the link between electrical and mechanical design as well as related disciplines such as circuit engineering. 
 - You must analyze and evaluate the customer specifications, standards, and regulations, always consider the current process regulations, technical instructions, information as well as standards and laws. Having working exposure of rail norms as per UIC, EN, DIN, IS is a plus. 
 - In addition, you will act as a process contact person/multiplier regarding the above-mentioned transversal and interface requirements. 
 - For a successful assembly of the components, you will prepare the necessary production documents, simulate the installation of the electrical equipment and plan the electrical cable routing. 
 - You will report to the project manager in engineering and to your group management. 
 - You will facilitate execution through coordination across multiple functions including engineering, business controlling, supply management, manufacturing development and other interfaces as required. 
 - You are entrusted to drive the product development, integrate with other sub systems, and validate the system performance as per the functional requirements adhering to the Quality, Cost & Delivery (QCD) commitments of the Project/Tender. 
 - You will establish and provide standardized reports on product/project execution to line & project management and must be able to work effectively in a Matrix Organization. 

Desired Skills

data.title: Director- Architect
data.description:
About Us

At apexanalytix, we're lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we've been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We're the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here. 

And you'll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you'll be helping build that reputation. 

Read more about apexanalytix - https: //www. apexanalytix. com/about/

Job Details

The Role

apexanalytix is the world's leading provider of supplier onboarding, risk management and recovery solutions. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Greensboro, NC, apexanalytix is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM for Supplier Risk Management Solutions, recognized for both Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute. More than 320 of the world's largest companies use our AI-native, Quantum Era-ready platform to protect over $9. 5 trillion in annual spend. 

apexanalytix is seeking a hands-on Architect to own the technical foundation of our platform and the applications that run on it as we scale globally. 

apexanalytix runs its own private cloud - more than 60 Kubernetes clusters across two datacenters, each declared in Git and reconciled by GitOps, networked with Cilium's eBPF datapath, and backed by Ceph. On top of that platform run our supplier management and risk products on . NET, a Go microservice estate, a React front end and a growing set of internal engineering products. Very little here is a black box: you can follow a request from a BGP-advertised service IP, through the eBPF datapath, into a pod, into the application request pipeline, to a query against a tenant database the team migrated itself. 

This is a high-leverage technical leadership role. The successful candidate sets architectural direction and standards across both planes - Kubernetes at fleet scale, GitOps, networking, storage, identity and observability on one side; n-tier application architecture, multi-tenancy, service contracts and distributed data on the other - while remaining hands-on with the code and the cluster, and mentoring engineers across apexanalytix's global engineering teams, including the Noida, India GCC. 

The ability to reason across the infrastructure and application boundary is the defining requirement of this role. The hardest problems at apexanalytix - and the most valuable ones - live exactly on that line. 

Quick Take -

- Leverages deep subject-matter expertise in private-cloud architecture and enterprise application architecture to advise engineering leadership on platform and product strategy and trade-offs. 
 - Acts as the go-to technical authority on how apexanalytix software is built and how it runs, and on the interaction between the two. 
 - Partners with the Global Head of Engineering & Infrastructure, the Head of Software Development and global engineering teams to ensure one architectural standard spans design, build and run. 
 - Roles and Requirements
 - Infrastructure and platform architecture. Owns the architectural vision and standards for apexanalytix's private cloud: Kubernetes across bare-metal, virtualized (KubeVirt with Cluster API and hosted control planes) and managed-cloud footprints. Designs and evolves cluster architecture, multi-tenancy (namespaces, RBAC, admission control, Pod Security standards), and workload placement and scheduling. 
 - GitOps as the only path to production. Sets direction for GitOps delivery (FluxCD, Kustomize, Helm) through a layered model - component template, shared baseline, per-cluster overlay - so the fleet's desired state always lives in Git. 
 - Networking and storage. Defines standards for the Cilium eBPF networking layer (BGP control plane, LB-IPAM, ClusterMesh, network policy, Hubble) and for Rook-Ceph and cephadm storage (CephFS, RBD, CSI drivers, snapshots, backup and DR). Contributes to network fabric design, including QoS and buffer engineering on the 100/200/400G data-plane fabric. 
 - Platform services. Sets direction for the services the fleet depends on - container registry, identity and OIDC, secrets management, certificate management - and for the Prometheus/Thanos/Grafana/Loki/Tempo observability stack. 
 - Application architecture. Owns architectural standards across the product estate: a . NET 10 enterprise platform (ASP. NET Core, EF Core, OData, gRPC, . NET Aspire) with a React 19 front end; a Go microservice estate with mTLS and shared contracts; and the supplier-facing community platform. 
 - Multi-tenancy and service contracts. Sets and enforces the multi-tenancy model end to end - tenant resolution, per-tenant data isolation, cache key discipline and the identity and access model - across both the . NET and Go estates. Owns service contract architecture: gRPC and REST/OData surface design, versioning, and backward-compatibility discipline across independently released packages. 
 - Performance and resilience by design. Owns application performance architecture - data access patterns, large-column materialization, caching topology and query-plan discipline - and sets resilience standards including replica counts, host anti-affinity, disruption budgets, health and dependency endpoints and graceful degradation, applied as a design gate rather than an incident finding. 
 - Data platform architecture. Owns the architecture of a distributed data tier spanning SQL Server, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, OceanBase, CockroachDB, Vitess, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, Snowflake and in-memory stores. Owns the geo-replicated database programme - distributed database architecture, migration tooling and sequencing, and the application-side changes each migration requires - and sets standards for schema change management, index and query design across the multi-engine estate. 
 - Internal engineering products. Owns the architecture of apexanalytix's internal product and tooling estate, ensuring it is held to the same standards as customer-facing products for identity, secrets handling, observability and supportability. 
 - Tooling and standards. Evaluates and introduces new tooling - CI/CD, policy-as-code, custom static analysis, service mesh enhancements - to improve engineering velocity and platform reliability. Partners directly with engineering teams to review designs, unblock complex technical problems and ensure architectural consistency. 
 - Hands-on delivery. Writes and reviews production code and configuration - C#, Go, Helm charts, OpenTofu/Terraform, Ansible, Python and Bash automation. This role remains technically hands-on. 
 - AI-assisted engineering. apexanalytix is an AI-first engineering organization. This role practises AI-assisted development, extends the organization's automation capability, and mentors engineers into it. This is a core expectation of the role, not a bonus. 
 - Security and compliance. Ensures the platform and applications meet enterprise security and compliance requirements - RBAC, network policy, secrets management, image signing and scanning, dependency governance - in a SOC 2 and FedRAMP-readiness environment. 
 - Mentoring. Mentors engineers across global teams, including the Noida, India GCC, on Kubernetes, GitOps, application architecture and cloud-native best practice. 

Required Skills

- 8+ years of infrastructure/platform engineering experience, with 4+ years of deep, hands-on Kubernetes expertise in production environments at scale - bare-metal experience strongly preferred, not managed-cloud-only. 
 - Strong GitOps practice (FluxCD or ArgoCD with Kustomize and Helm) and the conviction that Git should be the only path to production. 
 - Substantial CNI experience with Cilium (eBPF datapath, BGP control plane, LB-IPAM, ClusterMesh, network policy, Hubble) or comparable eBPF-based networking. 
 - Substantial CSI/storage experience, ideally with Ceph (Rook or cephadm): OSD/CRUSH management, CephFS and RBD, snapshots, and performance troubleshooting. 
 - Experience owning platform services such as a container registry, an identity provider and secrets management, plus observability at scale (Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, Loki or equivalent). 
 - Strong Linux fundamentals (RHEL/AlmaLinux, Ubuntu or similar): systemd, kernel and sysctl tuning, and the storage and network stacks. 
 - Demonstrated architecture ownership of a large n-tier enterprise application, not only operating one. Multi-tenant SaaS strongly preferred. 
 - Hands-on . NET/C# - modern ASP. NET Core, EF Core, and the ability to read and review a production request pipeline. Equivalent depth in another managed enterprise stack will be considered when paired with a genuine willingness to work in . NET from day one. 
 - Hands-on Go. A significant and growing share of the estate is written in Go; this is not optional. 
 - Service contract design experience - gRPC and/or REST/OData - including versioning and backward-compatibility discipline across independently released packages. 
 - Distributed and geo-replicated database architecture experience. Direct OceanBase experience is ideal; CockroachDB, Vitess, Spanner, YugabyteDB or TiDB experience transfers. 
 - Automation skill in OpenTofu/Terraform, Ansible, and at least one of Go, Python or Bash. 
 - Active, practising experience with AI-assisted software development, including the ability to build reusable automation for other engineers and mentor them into it. 
 - Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or equivalent demonstrable depth; CKS or CKAD a plus. 
 - Experience operating in a B2B enterprise SaaS environment, ideally serving large enterprise customers with strict security and compliance requirements (SOC 2, FedRAMP or comparable). 
 - Strong communication skills; comfortable operating as a technical leader who influences without direct authority across global, distributed teams. 
 - Non-negotiable versus trainable
 - Non-negotiable: hands-on production Kubernetes at scale; genuinely hands-on coding in at least one of C# or Go; n-tier application architecture ownership; practising AI-assisted development; and the ability to reason across the infrastructure and application boundary. 
 - Trainable on the job: OceanBase specifically, given distributed-database fundamentals; the apexanalytix product domain; and Cilium and Ceph specifics, given strong CNI and CSI fundamentals. 
 - Education Levels/Credentials (Degree types and Emphasis) - Undergraduate degree in computer science, engineering, or another technical field required; graduate degree a plus but not required. 

Physical/Remote/Travel Work Environment

- apexanalytix Global Capability Center, Noida, India. 

Scope Boundaries

Travel required - occasional. 

This role holds design authority across infrastructure and applications. Line management of the engineering organization sits with the SVP, Global Head of Engineering & Infrastructure; day-to-day operation of the estate with the Global IT Managed Services Leader; delivery management and release with the VP, Head of Software Development; security policy and compliance attestation with the CISO; and AI and automation delivery with a separate AI & Automation organization. 

Over the years, we've discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call "The apex Way". Read more about The apex Way - https: //www. apexanalytix. com/careers/

Benefits

At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees' growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence. 

With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

data.title: SCADA Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Job Purpose

To contribute as a Solar SCADA Engineer in renewable energy projects (Solar, Wind, and BESS) across India, working in a collaborative, team-based environment. The role involves applying technical expertise in energy storage, renewable systems, Solar PV, wind technologies, and industrial automation tools such as SCADA, PLCs, and data loggers. It also requires proficiency in cybersecurity, communication protocols, networking, schematic diagrams, and power plant control (PPC) to support the design, integration, monitoring, and optimization of renewable energy systems. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the development and design process for all SCADA/Remote monitoring related topics for rooftop and utility Solar power plants. 
 - Design the interface systems for Wind and Solar Hybrid plants and Energy storage projects. 
 - Support the procurement team with technical expertise throughout different project phases. 
 - Develop and coordinate the design of monitoring and control systems for utility scale solar PV i. e SCADA units, Power Plant Controller, RTU and IT equipment. 
 - Develop and coordinate the design of monitoring and control systems for rooftop solar PV i. e Datalogger units, PLC Units, DG-PV Synchronization, Zero Export and other interface equipment's. 
 - Specify monitoring equipment, meteorological stations, weather sensors, PLC's, network topology/architectures of FO rings, human machine interfaces (HMIs) and other equipment together with other project stakeholders. 
 - Integration of major components into SCADA, such as inverters, meteo (Weather) stations, energy meters, UPS, protection relays and security systems. 
 - Develop detailed design documentation including signal lists, IP address lists, wiring diagrams and equipment lists. 
 - Work on Power Plant Controller compliance with grid connection requirement in cooperation with the Grid team. 
 - Generate project documentation including commissioning documents, as-built drawings, operator manuals and training material. 
 - Work with the project team to report project status, risks and mitigation measures. 
 - Work with the SCADA suppliers to validate functionality of the site SCADA system, power plant controller and HMI. 
 - To develop in-house capabilities related to control drawings, panel drawings, electrical drawings, programming from scratch and integrate various brands of PLC and Dataloggers. 
 - Coordinate with on-site engineers for commissioning and installation support. 
 - Work with O&M Team in providing solutions for ease of remote monitoring. 
 - Technical lead for SCADA troubleshooting and diagnostics. 
 - Monitor and evaluate market trends and innovation. 
 - Provide internal and external technical/product support via phone, web, email, chat and other channels as required. 
 - Research, diagnose, troubleshoot and identify solutions to resolve issues. 
 - A self-starter, you will be able to manage your time and take the initiative. 
 - The person who wants to participate strongly in the development of a growing business. 
 - Flexibility to work and adapt himself to different cultures and new projects. 
 - Ready to travel on site whenever required. 

Requirements

Qualifications

- Education : B. Tech/B. E - Electronics and Communication / Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering
 - Experience : 4 to 5 years of total work experience in Hands-on experience with Solar, Substation - Automation. 
 - Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to gain understanding through listening, and to communicate technical concepts clearly. 
 - Knowledge of Cybersecurity networking. 
 - Experience with network concepts based on Modbus, DNP3 and IEC 61870-5-104. 
 - Understanding of power plant operating procedures preferred. 
 - Ability to interpret diagrams and schematics including but not limited to; power protections systems, networking and control, electrical, mechanical, and civil drawings. 
 - Knowledge of serial RS-232/RS-485 and Ethernet TCP/IP networking. 
 - Experience in SCADA systems for Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) will be an advantage. 
 - Experience in programming languages like C, Python will be an advantage. 
 - Experience with Microsoft Office including Word and Excel and Teams. 
 - Proactive personality, solution minded and willing to take calculated risks to achieve results. 
 - Adept in MS Office Suite, SQL database & operating systems. 
 - Excellent communication skills - written and spoken - English / Hindi / Kannada.

data.description:
Description

The ACES Manager is responsible for driving continuous improvement, process standardization, and operational excellence across all functional areas of the fulfillment center. This role leverages Lean and Six Sigma methodologies to identify and eliminate defects, reduce variability, and improve safety, quality, and productivity outcomes. The ACES Manager partners closely with Operations, Safety, Quality, and HR teams to build a culture of data-driven decision-making and sustainable process improvement. 

Key job responsibilities

Continuous Improvement & Kaizen

Lead and facilitate Kaizen events, value stream mapping, and process improvement workshops across Inbound, Outbound, and ICQA functions

Drive adoption of Lean tools (5S, visual management, standard work) on the floor

Achieve measurable year-over-year improvements in productivity, quality, and cost metrics

Defect Elimination & Root Cause Analysis

Own the site defect elimination pipeline; manage projects from identification through verification of effectiveness

Partner with process engineers and operations leaders to implement corrective and preventive actions

Standard Work & Process Audits

Develop, deploy, and maintain standard work documentation for all critical process paths

Conduct regular Gemba walks and layered process audits to ensure compliance with SOPs

Coach and train associates and area managers on standard work adherence and problem-solving techniques

Drive audit finding closures and escalate systemic non-conformances to leadership

data.title: Quality Assurance Manager
data.description:
Role Overview: 

We are looking for a hands-on Quality Assurance Manager to oversee Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Food Safety, Regulatory Compliance, and Quality Systems across Nova Nova and Skinny Chocolates Contract Manufacturing (CM) network, warehouses, products, packaging, and new product launches. 

The role will ensure that products are safe, compliant, consistent, and manufactured as per approved specifications, while working closely with CMs, vendors, laboratories, NPD, Operations, Procurement, Design, Marketing, and Q-commerce teams. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Quality Assurance & Quality Control

- Conduct regular audits and visits to CM units and warehouses PAN India. 
 - Ensure products meet approved recipes, specifications, quality, hygiene, and food safety standards. 
 - Conduct batch-wise, in-process, finished-product, sensory, packaging, and pre-dispatch checks. 
 - Implement and monitor GMP, GHP, HACCP, hygiene, and food safety systems. 
 - Maintain and review COAs, batch records, retention samples, traceability, and quality documentation. 
 - Identify quality deviations and drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective & Preventive Actions (CAPA). 
 - Investigate customer, warehouse, and platform-related quality complaints. 

2. CM & Vendor Quality Management

- Evaluate existing and new CMs for capacity, infrastructure, machinery, certifications, hygiene, food safety, and quality systems. 
 - Conduct CM audits and maintain quality performance scorecards. 
 - Verify required licences, certifications, and documentation before vendor/CM approval. 
 - Evaluate raw material and packaging vendors on quality, capacity, certifications, and scalability. 
 - Ensure appropriate NDAs/confidentiality agreements are in place to protect recipes and product formulations. 

3. Regulatory & Compliance

- Own compliance with applicable FSSAI, Legal Metrology, food safety, packaging, labelling, ingredient, additive, allergen, and claims requirements. 
 - Monitor relevant regulatory updates and ensure implementation across products and packaging. 
 - Review formulations and ingredients for regulatory compliance. 
 - Coordinate with external laboratories and regulatory consultants where required. 

4. Packaging & Labelling

- Review and approve packaging artwork for regulatory accuracy. 
 - Cross-check artwork against approved formulations and product specifications. 
 - Ensure packaging is suitable for manufacturing, storage, transportation, and handling conditions. 

5. NPD, Testing & Shelf Life

- Support NPD trials, reformulations, pilot batches, and commercial scale-ups. 
 - Establish quality specifications and quality parameters for new products. 
 - Coordinate microbial, nutritional, stability, and shelf-life testing. 
 - Review laboratory reports and ensure corrective actions where required. 
 - Ensure quality approval and compliance readiness before commercial launch. 

6. Escalations and Complaint Resolution: 

- Cross-check product listings against approved packaging, product specifications, and master product information, ensuring accuracy of product descriptions, ingredients, nutrition, allergens, grammage, shelf life, storage, and other compliance information. 
 - Own the quality-related escalation and resolution process for complaints received through Customer Care, Q-commerce platforms, marketplaces, warehouses, and other channels. 
 - Coordinate with Customer Care, CM partners, laboratories, and internal teams to investigate and resolve complaints. 
 - Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) using batch records, retention samples, production records, COAs, photographs/videos, customer feedback, and CM investigations. 
 - Define and implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) and ensure timely closure. 
 - Track recurring complaints and identify trends to drive preventive actions and continuous product improvement. 
 - Maintain a quality complaint tracker covering complaint type, batch, root cause, corrective action, preventive action, owner, and closure status. 
 - Escalate critical or recurring quality, food safety, packaging, and regulatory issues to management. 

7. Production & Warehouse Quality Oversight

- Monitor CM production from a quality and process-control perspective. 
 - Ensure approved recipes, processes, and specifications are followed during production. 
 - Support pilot runs, first productions, scale-ups, and production troubleshooting. 
 - Audit warehouse storage, hygiene, handling, temperature, stacking, and traceability. 
 - Ensure appropriate FIFO/FEFO practices and product handling standards. 

8. Documentation & Reporting

Maintain and monitor: 

- CM audit reports
 - Quality inspection records
 - COAs and testing reports
 - Shelf-life records
 - CAPA/RCA reports
 - Retention samples
 - Vendor/CM documentation
 - Regulatory and packaging approvals
 - Quality complaints and closure
 - Track key quality metrics and escalate critical quality, food safety, or regulatory risks to management. 

What We're Looking For

- Degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Microbiology, or a related field. 
 - 3-4 years of relevant experience in QA/QC, food safety, or regulatory compliance within the food/FMCG industry. 
 - Strong knowledge of FSSAI, GMP, GHP, HACCP, food safety, labelling, and packaging compliance. 
 - Experience with Contract Manufacturing / Third-Party Manufacturing preferred. 
 - Understanding of food manufacturing processes, testing, shelf life, and quality systems. 
 - Strong documentation, audit, RCA/CAPA, and vendor-management skills. 
 - High ownership, attention to detail, and strong problem-solving ability. 
 - Comfortable with extensive PAN India travel and working in a fast-paced startup environment. 

Why Join Nova Nova

- High-ownership role with direct impact on quality, food safety, compliance, and product launches. 
 - Opportunity to build QA, QC, and compliance systems from the ground up. 
 - Exposure to Contract Manufacturing, NPD, Q-commerce, Modern Trade, and rapid FMCG scale-up. 
 - Work closely with Product, Operations, Sales, and Marketing Leads.

The Role

Join AMD's PAVS team as an Automotive Infotainment Stack Validation Engineer, leading validation strategies and end to end use case validation for AMD's Automotive Virtualization on AMD platforms. The role focuses on validating Xen based virtualization, multi OS domains (Android, Yocto, FreeRTOS/SafeRTOS), IVI features, graphics, and Ryzen AI workloads. You will work across the hypervisor, OS domains, drivers, and system level performance to enable next generation automotive compute platforms.

data.title: SW QA Engineer - Simcenter Flightstream
data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking a talented and driven Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Quality Assurance team and contribute to the continued growth and development of our industry-leading CAE/CFD solutions. 

In this role, you will contribute across the software development lifecycle of Simcenter Flightstream, helping ensure the quality, accuracy, reliability, and robustness of capabilities used for aerodynamic, hydrodynamic, and multidisciplinary analysis. 

As a key member of the Quality Assurance team, you will independently design, develop, and execute manual and automated test cases, validate software capabilities delivered by the Development team, and analyze complex technical results. You will combine strong engineering knowledge with a quality mindset to identify issues, assess risks, improve test coverage, and continuously enhance testing tools and processes. 

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in aerodynamics, CFD, or aircraft design, combined with excellent analytical thinking, attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and programming ability. 

Key Responsibilities

- Validate complex engineering capabilities: Design and develop comprehensive test cases to evaluate aerodynamic, hydrodynamic, and multidisciplinary capabilities, ensuring software results are accurate, reliable, and consistent with expected engineering behavior. 
 - Develop automated regression testing: Create, maintain, and improve automated regression tests to identify unintended changes and ensure the stability of Simcenter Flightstream capabilities across software releases. 
 - Analyze and communicate technical results: Analyze test results, investigate unexpected behavior, and prepare clear technical reports using visualizations, key performance indicators, and other relevant data. 
 - Ensure release quality: Thoroughly test software releases, assess quality and technical risks, document test execution results, and communicate findings and recommendations to relevant stakeholders. 
 - Investigate and manage defects: Identify, reproduce, document, and track software defects; communicate risks effectively and collaborate with Development teams to support timely investigation and resolution. 
 - Improve quality engineering practices: Identify opportunities to improve test coverage, automation, tools, and processes, contributing to the continuous improvement of the overall QA approach. 
 - Collaborate globally: Work effectively with a globally distributed and cross-functional team, contributing technical expertise and participating in projects across Quality Assurance, Development, and other engineering functions. 

Qualifications

- Master's degree in Aeronautical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Strong academic background or professional experience in Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), aerodynamics, hydrodynamics, aircraft design, or related engineering disciplines. 
 - Solid understanding of aerodynamics and CFD workflows, including the ability to analyze engineering results and identify unexpected or potentially incorrect behavior. 
 - Knowledge of panel methods, vortex-lattice methods, or other reduced-order aerodynamic methods. 
 - Experience designing, executing, or analyzing complex engineering test cases, simulations, or validation studies. 
 - Programming or scripting experience using Python, C++, Java, or similar languages, with the ability to develop or maintain automated testing and analysis solutions. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, combined with excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. 

Preferred Skills

- Hands-on experience with Simcenter Flightstream and/or Simcenter STAR-CCM+, including the ability to create, configure, analyze, and troubleshoot complex simulation cases. 
 - Experience with software quality assurance, validation, verification, or regression testing of engineering or scientific software. 
 - Experience managing or troubleshooting Windows and Linux test environments. 
 - Experience creating technical reports, visualizations, and engineering performance indicators. 
 - Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a globally distributed and matrix organization. 
 - Strong ownership mindset, self-motivation, and commitment to continuous learning and technical development. 

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30, 000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Diversity & Inclusion

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation.
