data.title: SW QA Engineer - Simcenter Flightstream
data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking a talented and driven Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Quality Assurance team and contribute to the continued growth and development of our industry-leading CAE/CFD solutions. 

In this role, you will contribute across the software development lifecycle of Simcenter Flightstream, helping ensure the quality, accuracy, reliability, and robustness of capabilities used for aerodynamic, hydrodynamic, and multidisciplinary analysis. 

As a key member of the Quality Assurance team, you will independently design, develop, and execute manual and automated test cases, validate software capabilities delivered by the Development team, and analyze complex technical results. You will combine strong engineering knowledge with a quality mindset to identify issues, assess risks, improve test coverage, and continuously enhance testing tools and processes. 

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in aerodynamics, CFD, or aircraft design, combined with excellent analytical thinking, attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and programming ability. 

Key Responsibilities

- Validate complex engineering capabilities: Design and develop comprehensive test cases to evaluate aerodynamic, hydrodynamic, and multidisciplinary capabilities, ensuring software results are accurate, reliable, and consistent with expected engineering behavior. 
 - Develop automated regression testing: Create, maintain, and improve automated regression tests to identify unintended changes and ensure the stability of Simcenter Flightstream capabilities across software releases. 
 - Analyze and communicate technical results: Analyze test results, investigate unexpected behavior, and prepare clear technical reports using visualizations, key performance indicators, and other relevant data. 
 - Ensure release quality: Thoroughly test software releases, assess quality and technical risks, document test execution results, and communicate findings and recommendations to relevant stakeholders. 
 - Investigate and manage defects: Identify, reproduce, document, and track software defects; communicate risks effectively and collaborate with Development teams to support timely investigation and resolution. 
 - Improve quality engineering practices: Identify opportunities to improve test coverage, automation, tools, and processes, contributing to the continuous improvement of the overall QA approach. 
 - Collaborate globally: Work effectively with a globally distributed and cross-functional team, contributing technical expertise and participating in projects across Quality Assurance, Development, and other engineering functions. 

Qualifications

- Master's degree in Aeronautical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Strong academic background or professional experience in Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), aerodynamics, hydrodynamics, aircraft design, or related engineering disciplines. 
 - Solid understanding of aerodynamics and CFD workflows, including the ability to analyze engineering results and identify unexpected or potentially incorrect behavior. 
 - Knowledge of panel methods, vortex-lattice methods, or other reduced-order aerodynamic methods. 
 - Experience designing, executing, or analyzing complex engineering test cases, simulations, or validation studies. 
 - Programming or scripting experience using Python, C++, Java, or similar languages, with the ability to develop or maintain automated testing and analysis solutions. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, combined with excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. 

Preferred Skills

- Hands-on experience with Simcenter Flightstream and/or Simcenter STAR-CCM+, including the ability to create, configure, analyze, and troubleshoot complex simulation cases. 
 - Experience with software quality assurance, validation, verification, or regression testing of engineering or scientific software. 
 - Experience managing or troubleshooting Windows and Linux test environments. 
 - Experience creating technical reports, visualizations, and engineering performance indicators. 
 - Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a globally distributed and matrix organization. 
 - Strong ownership mindset, self-motivation, and commitment to continuous learning and technical development. 

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30, 000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Diversity & Inclusion

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

data.description:
Position: C++ Development (Senior Manager)

Grade: Senior Manager

Department: Technology

Location: Andheri, Mumbai

Qualifications: Graduate, Post Graduate

Work Exp: 10 to 14 years

Job Description / Roles & Responsibilities

The Technical Lead C++ Development (Senior Manager) will act as the core technical authority and delivery anchor for our ultra-low-latency engineering pod. This role balances hands-on, high-performance C++ systems programming (roughly 60%-70% of the time) with technical mentorship and agile sprint management (30-40%). The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between high-level architectural designs and concrete, microsecond-optimized code implementation. 

Core Role Information

- Designation: Technical Lead (Senior Manager) - C++ Development
 - Department: Technology
 - Reporting To: Assistant Vice President (AVP) - Development Head

Key Responsibilities: 

1. Hands-on Low-Latency Systems Engineering

- Write, optimize, and maintain high-performance execution engines and market data applications using Modern C++ (C++17/20). 
 - Implement deterministic, low-latency programming paradigms, strictly avoiding runtime heap allocations (malloc/new) on the trading hot-path through custom memory pools and placement new. 
 - Develop ultra-fast Inter-Process Communication (IPC) frameworks-such as shared memory rings and lock-free circular queues-to pass data across trading components with sub-microsecond overhead. 
 - Design highly concurrent, multi-threaded workflows, configuring thread affinity (pthread_setaffinity_np) and optimizing data layouts to prevent CPU cache thrashing and lock contention. 
 - Incorporate proprietary template-based architectures or High-Level Template (HTL) constructs to shift computational logic to compile-time. 2. Core Data Engineering & Domain Integration

- Apply expert-level knowledge of Data Structures and Algorithms to engineer optimal custom indexing, sorting, and binary parsing solutions. 
 - Design and maintain high-throughput relational tracking databases using MySQL for order logs, risk configurations, and reference data management. 
 - Leverage trading domain knowledge to translate complex financial logic (such as order routing, compliance checks, risk management parameters, or exchange protocols like FIX, ITCH, or SBE) into concrete technical implementations. 3. Technical Leadership & Code Governance

- Lead daily sprint cycles, translate functional specifications into technical tasks, and ensure timely product delivery. 
 - Enforce absolute code quality via strict peer code reviews, continuous profiling (using tools like Valgrind, gprof, or Perf), and performance regression benchmarking. 
 - Provide daily technical guidance and mentorship to engineers, establishing standardized coding guidelines for the team. 

Job Specific Skills

- C++ & Metaprogramming Expertise: Exceptional mastery of systems-level C++, including template metaprogramming, RAII, smart pointers, and strict memory safety. 
 - Concurrency Mastery: Practical experience writing production-grade, lock-free, atomic, and multi-threaded processing pipelines. 
 - Low-Latency Infrastructure: Clear understanding of CPU architectures (cache line synchronization, branch predictors) and Linux OS tuning (core isolation, kernel bypass). 
 - Data Layout & DB Optimization: Advanced ability to optimize algorithms for hardware cache locality and structure complex database queries, indexes, and schemas in MySQL. 
 - HTL Frameworks: Experience using template libraries or customized HTL concepts to achieve zero-overhead abstractions. 

Minimum Qualifications & Experience

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related quantitative stream. 
 - Experience: 8+ years of professional software development experience in systems programming, with at least 3+ years of experience leading small-to-mid-sized developer teams or pods. 
 - Domain Advantage: Prior background in High-Frequency Trading (HFT), investment bank execution desks, derivatives risk systems, or market data feeds is highly desirable. 

For more details, contact Archana at Archana. tiwari@tnmhr. com / +91 9821821884.

data.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone-freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow- helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. 

Join us to put AI to work for people. 

Job Description

This role requires a blend of technical expertise, leadership skills, and the ability to foster a collaborative and innovative environment. We are looking for a Project Lead familiar with cloud-native and AI-native development practices. Our software is built around AI at its core-LLMs, agents, and retrieval systems-and runs on IaaS (Google Cloud/AWS/etc. ), so familiarity with these environments and their managed AI services is a plus. Full ownership of your code will be encouraged, including deployment, testing, evaluation, and validation of both traditional and AI components. You will lead a team of software and AI engineers, coaching and mentoring them. Familiarity with CI/CD, test-driven development, and evaluation-driven development (eval harnesses for AI features) will be a benefit. 

Responsibility Area: Software Development

- Develop intuitive AI-native software that meets and exceeds the needs of the company
 - Development of technical specifications and planning, including model selection, prompt/agent design, and data/retrieval architecture
 - Analyze and automate tests for software components prior to delivery, and build evaluation harnesses (accuracy, regression, and hallucination checks) for AI features
 - Troubleshoot coding and model-behavior problems quickly and efficiently to ensure a productive workplace
 - Follow secure software coding practices, including AI-specific safeguards (prompt-injection defense, data privacy, PII handling, and responsible-AI guardrails)
 - Professionally maintain all software and create updates regularly to address customer and company concerns, including monitoring model performance and drift in production
 - IaaS procedures and practices, including managed AI/ML services (e. g. , Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI)
 - Experience with Kubernetes and containerization is welcome; experience serving models or deploying inference/GPU workloads is a plus

Responsibility Area: Communication

- Communicate effectively and professionally in all forms of communication with internal and external customers
 - Liaise with team members, management, and clients
 - Be transparent about challenges, failures, and successes, including the limitations and non-deterministic nature of AI systems
 - Deliver presentations and write progress reports for stakeholders, translating AI capabilities and trade-offs for both technical and non-technical audiences
 - Actively seek ways to improve business software processes and interactions, including where AI and automation can add value

Responsibility Area: Leadership

- Manage individual contributors' daily tasks
 - Mentor software and AI engineers to ensure high product quality across both deterministic code and AI/model behavior
 - Perform detailed code reviews, including reviews of prompts, agent logic, and evaluation results
 - Evaluate performance, provide feedback and constructive criticism to team members
 - Set and track quarterly goals for all team members
 - Assist with training and recruitment activities
 - Provide status updates, weekly reports, and issue details to senior leadership as needed
 - Participate in Root Cause Analysis for customer-reported issues, including failures rooted in model behavior, hallucinations, or data/retrieval quality
 - Aid and support the coaching and training of other team members to ensure all employees are confident in the use of software applications and AI tooling
 - Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including product management, domain specialists, and engineering to define requirements and develop scalable AI-driven solutions
 - Stay current with the latest advancements in AI and related technologies (new models, frameworks, and techniques), and proactively identify opportunities to apply them to our products and services

Qualifications

- 8-10 years of practical Java experience
 - 2 years of experience with prompt engineering and prompt/agent scripting
 - 2 years of hands-on experience integrating third-party AI/ML services and platform APIs (e. g. , OpenAI, Anthropic, Salesforce and other SaaS)
 - Proven ability to design and manage domain-specific languages, prompt templates, and agent instruction frameworks
 - Develop and optimize microservices that power high-performance data and embedding pipelines, handling up to 10 million rows and feeding vector stores
 - Proficiency in Python, Java, and JavaScript, with strong Python skills for the ML/AI ecosystem
 - Experience with RESTful and streaming APIs, model/inference endpoints, web services, and integration technologies
 - Knowledge of cloud computing and managed AI services (e. g. , AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI)
 - Create customer-centric AI solutions such as RAG assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-driven customer service
 - Create data and knowledge-base migration tools for SaaS applications, including moving embeddings and vector data between cloud instances
 - Experience with LLM orchestration and retrieval frameworks (e. g. , LangChain, LlamaIndex) and vector databases (e. g. , Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector)
 - Outstanding collaboration and communication skills
 - Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, including working with non-deterministic AI outputs
 - Ability to learn quickly, take direction, work independently, and as part of a team
 - Ability to develop unit tests and AI evaluation harnesses (accuracy, regression, and hallucination checks) for code components, prompts, and complete applications
 - Ability to debug and isolate the root cause of complex issues in probabilistic and distributed systems
 - Experience with Agile and Scrum development methodologies
 - Experience with Spring Boot or similar frameworks
 - Experience working with APIs, REST standards, JSON, SQL, and NoSQL/vector stores
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field; coursework or experience in ML/AI a plus

Additional Information

data.title: Azure Cloud Engineer
data.description:
About Us

We're rebuilding vertical software with AI - from the inside. 

Embrace owns the software running inside 16% of the Fortune 500, 45+ state agencies, and 450+ banks and credit unions. We acquire entrenched vertical software businesses and rebuild them around AI - products, operations, go-to-market, all of it. Our Venture Lab launches new AI-native products into those same markets, using the distribution and customer relationships our portfolio already owns. 

You'll ship AI into production against real workflows, real customers, and a P&L you can see move within a quarter. 

We hire people who want scope, speed, and ownership, and who are tired of working on AI that never reaches a customer. If you want to spend the next five years shipping into software that already runs the economy, talk to us. 

Job Description

This is a remote position. 

Embrace Technology Group is the unified engineering organization across the Embrace portfolio, encompassing our Venture AI Labs. We build and modernize software products across six regulated industry verticals, and we are reshaping how that work gets done - AI-first, forward-deployed, and outcome-driven. Our engineers ship real products to real customers, fast. 

We are looking for a CloudOps Engineer to operate and continuously improve the reliability, security, scalability, observability, and cost efficiency of our Azure-hosted SaaS products. Our products run across dev, QA, staging, and production environments, with infrastructure managed in Terraform and CI/CD automated through GitHub Actions. 

You will partner with engineering teams to ensure our SaaS platforms and AI-enabled solutions are deployed consistently, monitored effectively, secured properly, and operated reliably in production. 

Environment and Technology Context

- Microsoft Azure-hosted SaaS products across dev, QA, staging, and production. 
 - Terraform for infrastructure as code and repeatable provisioning. 
 - GitHub Actions for application and infrastructure CI/CD. 
 - Azure services: Static Web Apps, Container Apps, PostgreSQL, Storage Accounts, SignalR, Service Bus, Azure AI Foundry, Speech-to-Text, and Azure Arc. 
 - AI-enabled capabilities: STT workloads, LLM integrations, AI service endpoints, quotas, usage and latency monitoring, and cost controls. 

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure Operations

- Manage and support Azure infrastructure across dev, QA, staging, and production. 
 - Maintain operational health of Static Web Apps, Container Apps, PostgreSQL, Storage Accounts, SignalR, Service Bus, Azure AI Foundry, and Azure Arc. 
 - Ensure resources are provisioned, monitored, maintained, and retired per company standards. 
 - Support environment setup for new products, customers, and integrations. 
 - Identify and resolve infrastructure issues affecting performance, reliability, availability, or security. Terraform and Infrastructure as Code

- Build and maintain Terraform modules and environment configurations. 
 - Ensure infrastructure changes are version-controlled, peer-reviewed, tested, and approved. 
 - Manage Terraform state, workspaces, variables, secrets, and deployment workflows. 
 - Detect and resolve drift between Terraform and deployed Azure resources. 
 - Standardize naming, tagging, resource group structure, environment isolation, and module patterns. 
 - Support scalable provisioning of new SaaS environments using reusable templates. GitHub Actions and CI/CD

- Build, maintain, and troubleshoot GitHub Actions workflows for application and infrastructure deployments. 
 - Support CI/CD pipelines across multiple SaaS products and environments. 
 - Implement promotion flows from dev to QA to staging to production. 
 - Add deployment safeguards: environment protection rules, approvals, rollback procedures, validation checks, release gates, and audit trails. 
 - Manage pipeline secrets, service principals, managed identities, and deployment credentials. 
 - Improve build and deployment reliability and traceability. AI Service Operations

- Operate and monitor Azure AI services, including Azure AI Foundry and Speech-to-Text workloads. 
 - Support production operations for LLM integrations and AI-enabled product features. 
 - Monitor AI service availability, latency, quota usage, token consumption, API failures, throttling, and cost. 
 - Help define operational standards for AI workloads: access control, logging, alerting, failover, usage governance, and provider disruption handling. 
 - Partner with engineering to troubleshoot AI service issues, integration failures, degraded model responses, or provider-side disruptions. 
 - Support secure handling of AI secrets, endpoints, keys, managed identities, and private network access. Monitoring, Alerting, and Observability

- Implement and maintain monitoring with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights. 
 - Build dashboards for infrastructure, application, database, messaging, storage, AI service, and deployment health. 
 - Configure alerts for availability, latency, errors, resource saturation, queue depth, failed jobs, failed deployments, database health, quota exhaustion, and cost anomalies. 
 - Improve signal quality by reducing noise and ensuring alerts are actionable. 
 - Partner with engineering to define SLIs, SLOs, and production health metrics. Incident Response and Production Support

- Participate in production incident response for infrastructure, deployments, integrations, and platform services. 
 - Triage and resolve issues across Azure services, CI/CD, Terraform, networking, databases, messaging, and AI integrations. 
 - Create and maintain runbooks for common operational issues. 
 - Support root cause analysis and post-incident reviews. 
 - Implement preventive actions after incidents to improve reliability. 
 - Help define severity levels, escalation paths, response expectations, on-call processes, and production support procedures. Security, Identity, and Access Management

- Implement cloud security best practices across Azure environments. 
 - Manage Azure RBAC, managed identities, service principals, Key Vault access, and least-privilege permissions. 
 - Secure GitHub Actions workflows, deployment credentials, environment secrets, and production access. 
 - Support secret rotation, certificate management, and secure configuration management. 
 - Enforce network security via private endpoints, firewalls, IP restrictions, and environment-specific access rules. 
 - Support audit and compliance readiness for SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar frameworks. Database, Storage, and Messaging Operations

- Support Azure PostgreSQL operations: backups, restores, performance monitoring, connection limits, HA, and capacity planning. 
 - Monitor and maintain Azure Storage Accounts, lifecycle policies, access controls, backup strategy, and usage trends. 
 - Support Azure Service Bus operations: queue/topic monitoring, dead-letter handling, retry behavior, and throughput. 
 - Support SignalR operational health, connection metrics, and scaling behavior. Cost Management and Optimization

- Monitor Azure spend across products, environments, services, and customers where applicable. 
 - Implement tagging standards to support cost allocation by product, environment, customer, or business unit. 
 - Build cost dashboards, budget alerts, anomaly detection, and recurring cost reviews. 
 - Identify underutilized resources and recommend right-sizing opportunities. 
 - Review AI service costs, LLM and token usage, STT usage, storage growth, database sizing, and environment costs. 
 - Recommend savings plans, reservations, scaling rules, lifecycle policies, or shutdown schedules. Reliability, Backup, and Disaster Recovery

- Define and maintain backup and recovery procedures for critical cloud services. 
 - Test database restores and validate backup reliability. 
 - Help define RTOs and RPOs for production systems. 
 - Support disaster recovery planning for SaaS products and customer-facing services. 
 - Improve resilience through scaling rules, failover patterns, health checks, synthetic monitoring, and production readiness reviews. Documentation and Operational Standards

- Create and maintain CloudOps documentation, runbooks, deployment guides, and environment standards. 
 - Define standards for naming, tagging, logging, alerting, access control, Terraform structure, GitHub Actions patterns, and production changes. 
 - Document procedures for cloud services, CI/CD workflows, AI services, and incident response. 
 - Enable engineering teams with reusable patterns, templates, and self-service guidance. 

Requirements

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years of hands-on experience operating production workloads in Microsoft Azure. 
 - Strong experience with Terraform and infrastructure as code. 
 - Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions. 
 - Experience with containerized workloads, preferably Azure Container Apps or similar. 
 - Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights. 
 - Experience with Azure PostgreSQL or similar managed relational databases. 
 - Strong understanding of Azure networking, DNS, identity, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, and security best practices. 
 - Experience troubleshooting production incidents across infrastructure, deployments, networking, and cloud services. 
 - Comfortable scripting in Bash, PowerShell, Python, or similar. 
 - Strong documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in any of the following is a plus: 

- Operating AI-enabled applications or Azure AI services.

data.title: AI Evaluation Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

As an AI Evaluation Engineer, you'll own the quality bar for both our AI-powered features and the broader product experience they sit inside. You'll design and run evaluation frameworks that catch regressions in model behavior (accuracy, hallucination, safety, compliance-sensitive edge cases) as well as classic product/QA issues - so that what we ship to customers handling real securities and compliance data is trustworthy every time. This is a hands-on, blended role: part evaluation engineering for LLM/AI systems, part product quality ownership. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and maintain evaluation frameworks and benchmark suites for AI/LLM-powered features (e. g. , document extraction, compliance checks, automated workflows), covering accuracy, consistency, hallucination rate, and safety. 
 - Define golden datasets, rubrics, and scoring methodologies (human-in-the-loop and automated/LLM-as-judge) to measure model and product quality objectively. 
 - Build automated eval pipelines that run in CI/CD, flag regressions before release, and produce clear, trackable quality metrics over time. 
 - Extend evaluation coverage beyond the model layer into full product/QA testing - functional, regression, and end-to-end testing of AI-powered features and the surrounding product. 
 - Partner with product managers and engineers to translate ambiguous quality bars ("is this good enough to ship?") into measurable, repeatable evaluation criteria. 
 - Investigate failures and edge cases, perform root-cause analysis across the model/product boundary, and drive fixes with engineering. 
 - Maintain traceability and reporting on eval/QA results for compliance-sensitive workflows, given the regulated nature of the data we handle. 

What We're Looking For

- 5 plus years of experience in QA/test engineering, ML evaluation, or a related quality-focused engineering role. 
 - Hands-on experience testing or evaluating AI/LLM-powered features - building eval sets, scoring rubrics, or benchmark harnesses (or strong adjacent automation/QA experience with a demonstrated interest in AI evaluation). 
 - Solid automation/testing fundamentals: scripting (Python and/or TypeScript/Java), API testing, SQL for data validation, and CI/CD integration. 
 - Comfort working with LLMs and AI tooling directly - prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or AI-assisted development tools - either as a builder or a rigorous evaluator of them. 
 - Strong analytical mindset: comfortable defining metrics for fuzzy, subjective quality questions and defending them with data. 
 - Clear written communication - you'll be documenting failure modes and quality bars for both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Bonus: experience in fintech, compliance, or another regulated domain where correctness and auditability matter. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with vector databases / semantic search (FAISS, ChromaDB, or similar) and RAG evaluation. 
 - Familiarity with eval tooling/frameworks (e. g. , Ragas, DeepEval, promptfoo, custom LLM-as-judge pipelines). 
 - Background in Agile/Scrum environments and defect-management tooling (Jira or similar). 

What we offer

- Competitive compensation based on experience
 - Equity participation
 - Comprehensive health insurance (self + family)
 - Paid leave and wellness benefits

To apply: send your résumé to careers@vinylequity. com.

Job Description Summary

The System Testing Engineer is a specialist-level individual contributor responsible for executing and driving advanced system testing activities for substation automation and protection systems. This role centers on IEC 61850 (Edition 2. 1), top-down engineering, and multi-vendor relay interoperability, with a modern mandate to integrate AI-agentic workflows into the testing lifecycle.

 - Validation: Review and validate AI-generated automation scripts for accuracy, maintainability, and standard compliance.

data.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
data.description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer who can take ownership of a project from start to finish. This role is for someone who is comfortable understanding a problem, speaking with the client, deciding how to approach it technically, building the solution, deploying it, and making sure it continues to work well after going live. You'll be working on different projects, so the ability to switch context, understand new requirements quickly, and work independently is important. We're not looking for someone who only focuses on one part of the stack. You should be comfortable working across frontend, backend, databases, APIs, deployment, and production issues whenever the project requires it. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

Own projects from the initial requirement discussion through development, deployment, and postlaunch support. 

Understand client requirements and convert them into clear, practical technical solutions. 

Work across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, integrations, and deployment. 

Speak directly with clients when required to understand requirements, discuss progress, clarify issues, and suggest solutions. 

Join client meetings, both online and in person, whenever needed. 

Make technical decisions based on the project requirements instead of waiting for detailed instructions at every step. 

Build applications that are reliable, maintainable, and ready for production. 

Handle deployments, environment setup, releases, debugging, and production issues. 

Take responsibility when something goes wrong and work towards resolving it quickly. 

Work on multiple projects and switch between different business and technical contexts when needed. 

Get comfortable with unfamiliar codebases and understand existing systems quickly. 

Communicate blockers, risks, and delays early rather than waiting until they become bigger problems. Work closely with other team members while still being able to independently drive a project. 

Balance good engineering practices with project timelines and business requirements. 

Look for ways to improve the product, development process, and overall quality of the work. 

What We're Looking For: 

3+ years of professional software development experience. 

Strong hands-on experience in full stack development. 

Comfortable working independently across frontend and backend. 

Experience working with APIs, databases, third-party integrations, and deployments. 

Experience taking a project or major feature from development to live production. 

Good debugging and problem-solving skills. 

Ability to understand a new codebase and start contributing without a lot of hand-holding. 

Comfortable handling multiple projects and changing priorities. 

Good written and verbal communication skills. 

Comfortable speaking directly with clients and understanding their business needs. 

Able to explain technical topics in a simple way to non-technical people. 

Comfortable attending client meetings in person when required. 

Someone who takes responsibility for the final outcome, not just the code assigned to them. 

The Kind of Person We're Looking

For The best fit for this role is someone who can be given a problem and take it forward without needing every step to be defined. 

You should be comfortable asking the right questions, figuring out what needs to be built, choosing a sensible technical approach, and seeing the project through until it is live and working well. 

We value people who: 

Take ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do next. 

Communicate clearly with both clients and internal teams. 

Can move between different projects without getting stuck. 

Are comfortable making decisions when everything is not perfectly defined. 

Raise concerns early and take responsibility for solving problems. 

Care about building something that actually works well for the end user. 

What We Value

Most For us, strong technical skills are important, but they are only one part of the role. 

We value people who are dependable, take ownership, communicate well, and can solve problems without needing constant supervision. 

We also expect developers to make good use of AI tools in their day-to-day work. 

This could mean using AI to speed up development, understand unfamiliar code, debug issues, write tests, research solutions, improve documentation, or explore different approaches. 

The goal is not to use AI for the sake of it. 

It is to use the right tools to work faster and better while still applying your own judgment and taking responsibility for the final output.

data.title: Head of Software Development
data.description:
About Us

At apexanalytix, we're lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we've been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We're the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here. 

And you'll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you'll be helping build that reputation. 

Read more about apexanalytix - https: //www. apexanalytix. com/about/

Job Details

The Role

apexanalytix is the world's leading provider of supplier onboarding, risk management and recovery solutions. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Greensboro, NC, apexanalytix is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM for Supplier Risk Management Solutions, recognized for both Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute. More than 320 of the world's largest companies use our AI-native, Quantum Era-ready platform to protect over $9. 5 trillion in annual spend. 

apexanalytix is seeking an experienced Technology Leader to serve as VP, Head of Software Development, setting delivery direction for the product engineering organization and driving the teams responsible for new and existing customer-facing software and SaaS products, including apexanalytix's supplier management platform, the QubitOn data validation and risk API platform, and the Conductor supplier community platform. 

This role works in close collaboration with fellow executive staff members, Architecture, Infrastructure Operations, Product Development and Marketing to drive the organization's client-facing products towards continued growth. 

This role will lead a multi-national team of 65+ staff across Greensboro, NC and Noida, India, including Software Engineering, Technical Product Management, Quality Assurance, Project Management and Documentation. 

apexanalytix is an AI-first engineering organization: this role sets the bar for high-quality, AI-assisted engineering practice and the guardrails around it, while staying close enough to the code to lead by example. 

The technology surface. A . NET 10 enterprise platform (ASP. NET Core, EF Core, OData, gRPC, . NET Aspire) with a substantial shared package estate and a React 19 front end; a Go microservice estate with mTLS, shared contracts and a service template; a supplier community platform; and internal engineering products. Databases in production include SQL Server, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, OceanBase, CockroachDB, Vitess, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch and Snowflake. Deployment is Kubernetes-only and GitOps-reconciled across a fleet of more than 60 clusters. 

Quick Take -

- Leverages subject-matter expertise in the . NET and Go development stacks, modern web application architecture, and AI-assisted engineering practices to address customers' needs. Partners with internal industry experts to strengthen understanding of the industry. Leverages a deep understanding of customers to drive and create deep impact, share knowledge with the virtual team, and promote customer business perspectives. 
 - Acts as the voice of the customer and internal advocate by providing insights, feedback and challenges from the customer to internal teams across all levels of the organization. Drives action to ensure internal teams understand and respond to insights. Escalates pressing customer issues to apexanalytix internal stakeholders to facilitate the appropriate solutions and capabilities for the customer. 

The Work -

- Leads technical strategic planning to maximise business goals through the development and deployment of all products and services, and is accountable for predictable, high-quality release outcomes. 
 - Defines development standards, organization and methodologies for the company, and coordinates plans across multiple product lines in partnership with Architecture. 
 - Collaborates closely with the business and customer segments to understand market requirements and help translate strategic and product priorities into technology roadmap plans. 
 - Manages prioritisation of strategic objectives with operational, client-facing support for multiple teams and products. Owns the priority and work-assignment process end to end, against a single, auditable system of record. 
 - Champions AI-led engineering practice across the organization - setting the bar for AI-assisted code quality, defining guardrails for AI-generated code (review, testing, security, IP), and driving adoption of agentic coding workflows. Is accountable for measured adoption against a stated baseline, not announced adoption. 
 - Sets and enforces the engineering quality bar: code review standard, automated test coverage expectations, static analysis and formatting and build gates in CI. 
 - Owns release and package discipline across an independently published, floating-version package estate, including the producer-first sequencing required when shared contracts change, and the CI invariants that keep builds reproducible. 
 - Owns regression prevention: every defect fix ships with a test that fails before the fix and passes after it, and every fix is swept across sibling occurrences rather than applied in one place. 
 - Owns the Quality Assurance function and the automated test estate, including the end-to-end suite, and is accountable for defect escape rate to production. 
 - Partners with Architecture on design review, and with Infrastructure Operations on the operability of what ships - health and dependency endpoints, replica and anti-affinity requirements, resource requests and limits, and graceful degradation. 
 - Mentors and oversees personnel development plans for all technical staff, including Engineering Managers and Tech Leads across Greensboro, NC and Noida, India, and builds a technical leadership bench in Noida capable of owning full product areas. 
 - Balances senior engineering capacity across the portfolio, ensuring strategic platforms are staffed with the experience they require. 
 - Provides clear forecasts and technical roadmaps to the executive team and executes against those plans. 
 - Works within a strongly collaborative environment, negotiates challenges, identifies risks, and provides associated mitigation strategies. 
 - Provides budget planning, resource allocation and capital spend within the organization's overall business requirements. 
 - Ability to roll up their sleeves, understand code, and provide guidance to the development organization to solve complex problems - remaining an active, credible technical contributor. 

The Must-Haves -

- 12+ years leadership experience in software development, including planning, build, launch and support of multi-release complex software products sold commercially to external clients. 
 - Extensive knowledge of the . NET stack, including . NET Core/9. 0+, C#, ASP. NET Core, Razor, MVC, and modern JavaScript frameworks (Node. js, React. js). 
 - Working depth in Go, sufficient to set standards and review production services. A significant and growing share of the estate is written in Go. 
 - Experience with relational and distributed database design. SQL Server and PostgreSQL required; exposure to MariaDB, Vitess, CockroachDB or another distributed SQL engine strongly preferred, given an active multi-engine migration programme. 
 - Experience with containerized, Kubernetes-based application deployment, and enough fluency with GitOps delivery to partner credibly with Infrastructure Operations. 
 - Experience driving AI-assisted and agentic engineering practices at organizational scale, with concrete examples of workflows, tools and measurable outcomes. 
 - Experience with Agile development processes, particularly SCRUM methodology, and with microservices architecture and DevOps practices. 
 - Experience leading multi-national development organizations, including in-house staff and contract positions located on-shore, off-shore and hybrid, with sustained US-overlap working hours. 
 - Experience managing a budget matching the organization's strategic business goals and timelines with product deliverables. 
 - Experience in customer-centric product design. Contextual Inquiry or other customer-focused development process experience a strong plus. 
 - Strong communication skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience shipping in a SOC 2 or FedRAMP-readiness environment. 
 - Experience in supply chain, procurement, fintech, audit or data/analytics domains. 
 - Education Levels/Credentials (Degree types and Emphasis) - Undergraduate degree or graduate degree in computer science or another technical field, and/or a graduate business degree a strong plus but not required. 

Physical/Remote/Travel Work Environment

- apexanalytix Global Capability Center, Noida, India. 

Travel required - occasional, including periodic travel to apexanalytix HQ in Greensboro, NC. 

Scope Boundaries

This role owns how software is built and delivered - quality, throughput, predictability and engineering practice. Architectural standards and design authority sit with the Architect; infrastructure and platform operations with the Global IT Managed Services Leader; product strategy and roadmap with the Product Leader; security policy and compliance attestation with the CISO; and AI and automation delivery with a separate AI & Automation organization. Where AI services are consumed by the product platforms, this role owns the integration contract - interface, versioning, SLA and failure behaviour. 

Over the years, we've discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call "The apex Way". Read more about The apex Way - https: //www. apexanalytix. com/careers/

Benefits

At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees' growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence. 

With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

En typisk arbejdsdag veksler mellem at være tæt på driften, sparre med medarbejderne, holde udviklingssamtaler, følge op på vagtplaner og rapportere på dagens resultater. Du skal trives med, at tempoet kan være højt - og med at gøre en positiv forskel for både kunder og kolleger. 

Hvem er du?

Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis have en finansiel uddannelse eller tidligere ledererfaring. Det vigtigste er, at du har en tydelig interesse for kundeservice og motiveres af at få andre mennesker til at lykkes. 

Vi Forestiller Os, At Du

- Har erfaring fra en lignende funktion i en kundeserviceafdeling - eller fra en medlemsorganisation og/eller den finansielle sektor
 - Har god forståelse for drift, kvalitet og kundeoplevelser
 - Er god til at skabe overblik og bevare roen, når der er travlt
 - Er tydelig, nærværende og motiverende i din kommunikation
 - Trives med at udvikle medarbejdere gennem sparring og feedback
 - Har lyst til at være en del af et team, hvor vi løfter i flok og arbejder målrettet mod fælles mål

Om Kundeservice

Du bliver en del af en afdeling med 40 engagerede medarbejdere på og du indgår i et lederteam bestående af to teamledere og en afdelingschef. 

I Kundeservice har vi et højt ambitionsniveau, men også et stærkt fællesskab og en god energi i hverdagen. 

Som Kundekonsulent Stine Andersen Siger Om Hverdagen i Kundeservice

"Arbejdsdagen hos Kundeservice starter med en god energi allerede fra morgenstunden, hvor man altid bliver mødt med et smil fra sine kollegaer. Vi har helt klare og faste mål, og vi er gode til at løfte i flok, så vi kommer i mål som et team, hvilket giver et fantastisk sammenhold. "

Vil du være en del af holdet?

Hvis du kan se dig selv i rollen som teamleder i Kundeservice, glæder vi os til at høre fra dig. 

Skriv en kort motiveret ansøgning hvor du fortæller hvorfor dette teamlederjob er interessant for dig og upload den sammen med dit CV. 

Vi værdsætter mangfoldighed og opfordrer alle - uanset alder, baggrund, køn eller erfaring - til at søge. Du behøver ikke vedhæfte billede. 

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Afdelingschef Morten Norling Bæk på tlf. 33781528. 

Vi ser frem til at få dig med på holdet!

About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager - Mobile to lead mobile engineering teams and drive the development of high-quality, scalable, and reliable digital products. - Lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable native mobile applications for Android and iOS platforms.

 - Collaborate with geographically distributed teams across different time zones. 
 - Manage stakeholder expectations while balancing delivery timelines, technical constraints, and business priorities.

 - Lead root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive measures. 
 - Define and maintain security, performance, and availability SLAs in accordance with governance standards. 
 - Identify and mitigate technical, operational, and delivery risks. 
 - Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, development practices, and release management. 

Required Technical Skills & Experience

- 12+ years of overall software engineering experience, including RESTful API development, server-side technologies, and cloud-based architectures.

 - Proven experience leading engineering teams in dynamic, product-focused environments with complex technical and business requirements. 
 - Demonstrated success in building, scaling, and maintaining native mobile applications. 
 - Strong knowledge of mobile development technologies and frameworks, including Kotlin, Swift, and Firebase. 
 - Expertise in cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Strong understanding of microservices architecture, distributed systems, and API integrations. 
 - Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and DynamoDB. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD automation, DevOps practices, automated testing, and modern software engineering tools. 
 - Strong understanding of mobile application security, performance optimization, and release management. 

Required Soft Skills

- Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. 
 - Deep understanding of Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban. 
 - Proven ability to manage complex projects with multiple dependencies and deliver high-quality releases. 
 - Strong risk management, issue resolution, and process improvement capabilities. 
 - Ability to align engineering priorities with business outcomes and influence cross-functional stakeholders. 
 - A proactive mindset focused on innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. 

Education & Preferred Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience working with highly available, large-scale enterprise systems and performance-critical applications. 
 - Previous experience in retail technology, consumer-facing digital products, or cloud-native product development is preferred.

Seeking a NPDI Lead Engineer - Liquid Cooling (TCS/SFN) with expertise in Technical Cooling Systems (TCS) / Secondary Fluid Networks (SFN) or broader piping and fluid systems to lead NPDI projects for TCS/SFN and drive the development of next-generation liquid cooling distribution solutions. The role is responsible for setting design standards, leading the team and projects globally, ensuring integration across NPDI, Application Engineering, and ETO, and mentoring engineers to build global consistency. The position requires deep technical skills in fluid and piping systems, expert proficiency with Creo, strong PLM experience, and the ability to define and own tools and processes that streamline layout creation, quoting, and product development. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead TCS/SFN design deliverables through all NPDI stages, from concept to product launch, ensuring technical robustness and manufacturability. 
 - Define and develop standard TCS/SFN modules (headers, manifolds, valves, fittings, hoses, expansion tanks, filters, quick disconnects) for reuse across platforms. Create and manage PTC Creo models, design libraries, and assemblies for TCS/SFN components and systems. 
 - Perform system sizing and validation, flow balancing, pressure drop, NPSH margin, valve Cv selection, and pump/loop analysis. 
 - Oversee prototype builds, validation test plans, and test execution (pressure, leak, flow/thermal, cleanliness, condensation/dew point). 
 - Work in PLM systems (e. g. , Oracle PD Cloud, Windchill) to manage BOMs, drawings, engineering changes, and product documentation. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with global engineering, operations, supply chain, and quality to align TCS/SFN design with product roadmap goals. 
 - Ensure integration across Application Engineering, NPDI, and ETO projects to drive consistency, reuse, and customer alignment. 
 - Drive supplier engagement, define specifications, support RFQs, and validate supplier designs for manufacturability and cost effectiveness. 
 - Provide technical ownership of future configurator and rapid layout tools (e. g. , CPQ-Creo integration, Revit) to streamline quoting and design processes. 
 - Mentor mechanical engineers and review custom order learnings to feed back into NPDI modules and roadmap planning. 
 - Ensure adherence to ASME/ASHRAE standards and internal design guidelines for liquid-cooled piping systems. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering. 
 - 10+ years of experience in piping and fluid systems, preferably in data center liquid cooling, HVAC, hydronics, or process cooling, with direct experience in Technical
 - Cooling Systems (TCS) / Secondary Fluid Networks (SFN) highly desirable. 
 - Expert proficiency with PTC Creo for assemblies, layouts, routing, and detailed drawings. 
 - Strong working knowledge of PLM systems (e. g. , Oracle PD Cloud, Windchill) for BOM management, engineering change control, and design lifecycle management. 
 - Proven record of leading NPDI projects using Stage Gate or equivalent processes, ensuring integration across application engineering, NPDI, and ETO workflows. 
 - Hands-on validation experience including pressure/leak testing, flow and thermal testing, cleanliness protocols, and condensation/dew point checks. 
 - Knowledge of ASME and ASHRAE guidelines for liquid cooling and piping systems. 
 - Deep expertise in DFM/DFA principles, weld/braze methods, and supplier fabrication processes. 
 - Strong documentation skills, including preparation of PFDs, P&IDs, test reports, engineering change orders, and sustaining handoffs. 
 - Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). 
 - Demonstrated ability to work effectively with global engineering teams across regions. 
 - Strong leadership, organizational, and collaboration skills. 
 - Proven ability to define and own engineering tools and configurators that enable rapid layout creation, quoting, and design reuse. 

Preferred Skills

- Direct experience with TCS/SFN systems for high-density data centers, AI, or HPC applications. 
 - Experience with hydraulic modeling for loop balancing, pressure-drop analysis, and system sensitivity studies. 
 - Exposure to CFD or other thermal/fluid simulation tools. 
 - Experience with sanitary or high-cleanliness stainless-steel piping, orbital welding, flushing, passivation, and contamination control. 
 - Experience with PP-R/PP-RCT or other engineered polymer piping systems. 
 - Experience overseeing prototype builds, FAT/SAT, commissioning, and validation reporting. 
 - Experience with modular/prefabricated liquid-cooling systems, CPQ tools, Creo automation, or Revit workflows.

About Indian Digital Payment Intelligence Corporation (IDPIC)

Indian Digital Payment Intelligence Corporation (IDPIC) is a Section 8 company, incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013. It is promoted by the State Bank of India (SBI) and Bank of Baroda, along with other banks/payment companies, and functions under the regulatory approval and oversight of the Department of Financial Services and the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). IDPIC has been established as the nation's central digital payment fraud intelligence platform. Its primary mandate is to detect, prevent, and analyse fraud in India's rapidly expanding digital payments ecosystem in real time. Leveraging cutting-edge technologies, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Big Data Analytics, IDPIC plays a pivotal role in strengthening the security and trustworthiness of India's digital payment infrastructure. 

Position Overview: 

The Network Specialist/Site reliability Engineer will be responsible for designing, securing, and maintaining DPIP's resilient, high-availability network infrastructure to enable secure, uninterrupted data exchange across banks, RBIH, payment entities, and partner systems. The role will ensure reliability, performance, scalability, and resilience of critical services through proactive monitoring, incident management, automation, capacity planning, release support, and HA/DR operations. 

Qualification and Eligibility Criteria: 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science / Information Technology / Electronics & Communication Engineering or equivalent. Master's degree in relevant technology disciplines is desirable. 

Preferred: Certifications such as CCNP / CCIE, and cloud-networking (AWS / Azure / GCP)

Work Experience: 

Minimum 5+ years of relevant experience in enterprise network design, administration and security. 

Expertise in TCP/IP, routing & switching, firewalls, load balancers, VPN, SD-WAN, DNS, network segmentation and zero-trust, and cloud / hybrid networking. Experience operating high-availability, low-latency financial networks with DDoS protection and network-security controls. Experience in SRE, DevOps, Production Engineering, Infrastructure Operations or similar roles, preferably in banking, financial services, payment systems or other mission-critical environments. Experience in managing high-availability production systems and API-based platforms is preferred. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Network Infrastructure Management - Design, implement, secure and maintain resilient, scalable and high-availability network infrastructure supporting DPIP's real-time data exchange and critical services. 
 - Production Reliability & Observability - Ensure high availability, performance, scalability and resilience of production environments through proactive monitoring, performance tuning, observability and tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch and API monitoring.

Job Title: Software Development Engineer- EDA Simulation & Automation

Job Type: Full Time

Location: Bangalore and Gurgaon (Hybrid 3-Days in the office)

Responsibilities: 

About the Role

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to design and build the next generation electromagnetic (EM) simulation, Thermal, Spice, Spectre and RF/microwave design automation tools and build & interfaces to & fro for for semiconductor foundries and customers. You will work on the software that powers full-wave EM solvers, Thermal simulation engines, Spice & Spectre simulators, layout-driven extraction flows, and the automation pipelines that turn foundry technology data (ITF/LTD, layermaps, tech files) and physical layout (GDS) into accurate S-parameter models. 

This role sits at the intersection of computational electromagnetics, numerical methods, and large-scale software engineering. You will collaborate with EM research scientists, application engineers, and product managers to deliver robust, high-performance features used by RF, mmWave, IC design teams worldwide. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain tooling and utilities (parsers, comparators, validators) for technology stackups and simulation inputs to ensure correctness and reproducibility. 
 - Build automation and data-processing pipelines: technology file conversion (iRCX/ITF → LTD), layout/GDS import, port/pin placement, simulation setup, and S-parameter (SnP) export. 
 - Develop automated tools and scripts for PDKs, create tests, run, maintain, and verify regressions. Review & verify code checked into Keysight EDA ADS (Advanced Design System) software. 
 - Participate in design reviews, code reviews, testing, and debugging; write clean, well tested, maintainable code. 
 - Collaborate with EM, Thermal, Circuit Simulation squad to translate numerical methods and prototypes into production-quality, cross-platform (Windows/Linux) software. 
 - Leverage AI-powered development tools, coding assistants, and autonomous agents to accelerate design, development, testing, debugging, and documentation. 

Qualifications

Qualification: B. E. /M. E. /Ph. D. in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or a related field

Required Skills

- Strong programming skills in C++ (Modern C++ preferred) and/or Python, with solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles. 
 - Good understanding of Object-Oriented Design, Design Patterns, and Software Engineering principles. 
 - Solid foundation in numerical methods and linear algebra (matrix solvers, sparse systems, iterative methods, floating-point numerics). 
 - Experience developing on Linux and/or Windows, with familiarity in build systems (CMake), version control (Git), and CI/CD workflows. 
 - Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills. 
 - Understanding of software security, testing, and code quality practices. 
 - Knowledge & insight of TSMC iRCX file format. 
 - Working knowledge of AES and other encryption method and implementations. 
 - Basic understanding of high frequency electronic design, its process (PCB/PKG/RFIC/MMIC) and key components. 
 - Understanding electromagnetic / RF / microwave theory (Maxwell's equations, transmission lines, S-parameters, antenna parameters, signal & power integrity). 

Preferred Skills

- Familiarity with electromagnetic simulation tools 
 - Knowledge of computational electromagnetics (FEM, MoM, FDTD, integral-equation methods) or other physics-based simulation techniques. 
 - Familiarity with EDA tools and flows (e. g. , ADS, RFPro, EMPro, Momentum, HFSS, Heatwave, IcePak, Thermal simulators (CAE/ EDA), Cadence, or similar) and technology data formats (GDS, ITF, LTD, layermap, tech files, Touchstone/SnP). 
 - Experience building automation frameworks, scripting APIs, or plugin architectures for simulation tools. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor) and understanding of AI/LLM concepts, prompt engineering, and agentic workflows. 
 - Contributions to open-source scientific/numerical software. Selection Process

- HackerRank Assessment (C++ & Python) 
 - Technical Coding and Design Interviews 
 - Hiring Manager Interview

Preferred: Candidates with a strong software development background in EDA / CAD CAE / electromagnetic simulation, excellent problem-solving skills, and a passion for building high-quality products.

data.description:
Description

Own a core part of Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) for Amazon's fastest-growing and most strategic marketplaces - from emerging international markets to the future of FBA in Europe. International FBA builds the software that lets third-party (3P) sellers send inventory into Amazon's network, keep it in stock, and fulfill orders, and we're hiring a Software Development Manager to lead a high-impact engineering charter end to end. 

Key job responsibilities

Own the vision, multi-year roadmap, and quarterly execution for the engineering charter, translating seller and business goals into a clear, prioritized delivery plan. 

Lead, coach, and grow a team of software engineers - owning hiring, performance management, and career development, and building a strong bench of technical leaders. 

Drive the architecture and design of high-scale, low-latency, highly available distributed systems, making sound technical and build-vs-adopt decisions. 

Build Generative AI (GenAI) solutions and conversational assistants that simplify complex, multi-step seller workflows into guided experiences. 

Own operational excellence - availability, latency, and correctness - for services with direct seller and business impact; strengthen on-call, reduce operational load, and drive issues to root-cause resolution. 

Manage region-specific complexity across diverse international marketplaces, including local compliance, tax, and capacity requirements. 

Partner across Product, Applied Science, Operations, Compliance, and worldwide (WW) FBA teams to align on shared roadmaps, resolve dependencies, and deliver end to end. 

Represent your area in leadership, business, and operational reviews; communicate crisply in writing (narrative style) and in person to both technical and business audiences. 

Set and uphold a high bar for engineering quality, security, and best practices across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). 

A day in the life

You start the morning by scanning your team's operational dashboards and any overnight on-call activity - checking the health of the seller-facing systems you own and making sure nothing is blocking sellers from getting inventory into Amazon. You join your team's daily standup, unblock engineers, and dive into a design review for a new Generative AI (GenAI) conversational assistant feature that will help sellers manage their inventory. 

Midday, you meet with your Product and Applied Science partners to align on the quarterly roadmap and prioritize the next set of deliverables - balancing near-term seller impact against longer-term bets like the Europe FBA transformation. You spend focused time writing or reviewing a technical narrative, and you have a career-development one-on-one with one of your engineers. 

In the afternoon, you make a key architecture decision on a high-scale service, review a peer's design document, and represent your area in a business review with leadership. You close the day by clearing code reviews, responding to your team, and jotting down priorities for tomorrow. Throughout, you're operating as both a builder and a leader - setting technical direction, growing your people, and delivering measurable impact for sellers across International FBA's marketplaces. 

About The Team

International FBA builds the seller-facing software behind Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) across two strategic frontiers. In Emerging Markets - India, UAE, KSA (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia), Egypt, Mexico, Brazil, Turkey, Australia, and South Africa - we own the end-to-end seller journey, building region-specific architecture where local law and network economics demand it, and pioneering Generative AI (GenAI) assistants that make selling on Amazon radically simpler. 

In Europe, we're reinventing FBA itself: transforming a fragmented, country-by-country operation into a single, unified European supply chain (the "One EU" vision) - one shipment, one inventory pool, one set of controls - so sellers reach the whole continent effortlessly. 

We're a team of builders who care equally about seller experience and engineering excellence. We work across product, science, and operations, own our systems end to end, and take real ownership of outcomes that move Amazon's international business forward. 

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

data.title: Lead AI Data Engineer
data.description:
About Amplify Health

Who We Are

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain. 

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam. 

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies-with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems. 

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health's health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company's technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards. 

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security. 

Our Vision and Ambition

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery. 

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals' lifestyle/ behavioural choices. 

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia's strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools. 

The Position

Role Overview

As a Lead AI Data Engineer, you will lead a small team that designs and delivers AI-ready data platforms and GenAI data solutions on Azure and Databricks. You stay hands-on, writing code, reviewing designs and unblocking the team, while owning the technical direction, delivery quality and people development for one or two projects. You will make the architecture trade-offs that decide whether AI solutions are accurate, secure, governed and cost-effective in production. 

Role at a Glance

Experience: 9 to 12 years in data engineering, including 2+ years leading engineers and 2+ years delivering AI/ML or GenAI data solutions to production

Team Leadership: Leads a team of 3 to 6 engineers; may line-manage some. Accountable for technical delivery and team health

Project scope: Leads 1 to 2 projects at a time

Stakeholder / client exposure: Primary technical point of contact for project stakeholders and client teams; presents designs, demos and progress

Hands-on expectation: About 50 to 70% hands-on engineering

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership and Architecture

- Own the end-to-end solution design for data and AI workloads on 1 to 2 projects: ingestion, lakehouse modelling, unstructured-data processing, retrieval, serving and evaluation. 
 - Make and document architecture decisions (for example, as architecture decision records) on trade-offs such as batch versus streaming, Databricks Vector Search versus Azure AI Search, chunking and embedding strategy, model and endpoint selection, and build versus buy. 
 - Define project engineering standards: coding conventions, testing strategy, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, environment promotion and release management. 
 - Stay hands-on: build critical or complex components, prototype new patterns and lead deep-dive troubleshooting of production issues. AI and GenAI Delivery

- Lead delivery of RAG, agentic and ML data pipelines from proof of concept to production, including permission-aware retrieval, freshness service levels and fallbacks. 
 - Set up evaluation and observability for AI solutions (golden datasets, offline and online evaluation, tracing, guardrails, quality dashboards) and use them as release gates. 
 - Design how governed data is exposed to AI agents (MCP servers, tools and functions, semantic layers, Genie spaces or Fabric data agents) with the right access controls and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. 
 - Manage AI cost and capacity: token budgets, model routing, caching, AI gateway policies and GPU / serverless sizing. Governance, Security and Responsible AI

- Ensure solutions meet data governance, privacy and security requirements: Unity Catalog / Purview, classification, masking and de-identification, lineage and audit. 
 - Embed responsible-AI practices (risk assessment, data and model documentation, bias and quality checks, transparency) aligned to frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and applicable regulations. 
 - Work with information security and data protection teams on AI threat modelling, including prompt injection, data leakage and excessive agent permissions. Delivery and Stakeholder Management

- Translate business and client requirements into technical scope, estimates, plans and milestones; manage risks, dependencies and change. 
 - Act as the main technical contact for project stakeholders; present designs, demos and progress to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Work with product owners, data scientists, AI engineers, architects and platform teams to align priorities. People Leadership

- Lead a team of 3 to 6 engineers: allocate work, set clear goals, run code and design reviews, and remove blockers. 
 - Coach and develop team members through regular feedback and development plans, and contribute to performance reviews. 
 - Drive team adoption of AI-assisted engineering with clear guardrails (review standards, security, IP and data-handling rules) and measure its impact. 
 - Take part in hiring through interviews, technical assessments and onboarding. 

Candidate Profile

Required Qualifications

- 9 to 12 years in data engineering, with 2+ years leading a team or workstream of engineers. 
 - Expert Python, PySpark and SQL, with strong system design and distributed data processing fundamentals. 
 - Proven delivery of production lakehouse platforms on Azure and Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, streaming, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code). 
 - Proven delivery of at least two AI or GenAI data solutions to production (for example, RAG, document intelligence, agentic data access, feature / ML pipelines), including evaluation and monitoring. 
 - Strong retrieval design knowledge: embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, re-ranking, index freshness and access control. 
 - Experience with MLOps / LLMOps tooling (MLflow, model serving, AI gateway, prompt management) and AI evaluation methods. 
 - Solid grasp of data governance, privacy, security and responsible-AI practices for sensitive data. 
 - Experience planning and estimating work, managing delivery risk and communicating with senior stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated ability to coach engineers and to set and enforce engineering standards. 

Technology stack: Primary stack (Azure + Databricks)

Cloud & storage: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Microsoft Fabric / OneLake

Lakehouse & processing: Azure Databricks: Delta Lake, Lakeflow (Connect, Spark Declarative Pipelines, Jobs), Structured Streaming, Photon, serverless compute

Governance & catalog: Unity Catalog (lineage, tags, ABAC, row/column security), Microsoft Purview

AI, retrieval & agents: Databricks Vector Search, Model Serving, Agent Bricks, Lakebase; Azure AI Search; Microsoft Foundry (Azure OpenAI and other models, Agent Service); Azure AI Document Intelligence

MLOps / LLMOps: MLflow 3 (tracking, tracing, evaluation, prompt registry), Feature Store, Unity AI Gateway, inference tables

Engineering & DevOps: Python, PySpark, SQL, Git, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, Terraform / Bicep, Databricks Asset Bundles, Docker

AI-assisted engineering: GitHub Copilot, Databricks Genie Code / Assistant

Nice to have

- Multi-agent systems and MCP server design; Databricks Agent Bricks or Microsoft Foundry Agent Service. 
 - Microsoft Fabric and OneLake interoperability with Databricks. 
 - Ontology, knowledge graph or semantic layer design for AI agents. 
 - Experience in healthcare, insurance or other regulated industries; familiarity with HL7 FHIR and privacy regulations (for example, PDPA, HIPAA, GDPR). 
 - Agile delivery certification or formal leadership training. 

Preferred Qualifications & Certifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional. 
 - Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate. 
 - Microsoft Certified: Azure AI App and Agent Developer Associate (AI-103) or MLOps Engineer Associate (AI-300). 
 - HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (optional). 

How you Lead

- Lead by example: you still ship code and hold yourself to the standards you set. 
 - Clarity: you turn ambiguous requests into clear plans, decisions and trade-offs. 
 - Growth mindset: you invest in each team member's development and give honest, timely feedback. 
 - Responsibility: you make AI risk, quality and cost visible and act on them before release. 

How success is measured

- Projects delivered to the agreed scope, quality, timeline and budget, with production service levels met. 
 - AI solutions go live with defined evaluation thresholds, monitoring and guardrails, and keep meeting them in production. 
 - Engineering standards adopted across the team: test coverage, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code and documentation. 
 - A motivated, growing team: engineers build new skills, earn certifications and stay engaged. 
 - Positive stakeholder and client feedback on technical leadership and communication. 
 - Measurable productivity or cost gains from AI-assisted engineering and platform optimisation. 

Join Us

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply. 

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
