data.description:
Job Description

JoJob Description / Area of Responsibility

- Lead the end-to-end Operations workstream for the development and flawless launch of advanced, safety-critical automotive mechatronic systems across two focus factories. Integrate mechanical, electronics, electric motor and embedded software disciplines; align worldwide stakeholders, customers and suppliers; and deliver industrialization, quality, cost, timing, capacity and ramp-up targets. Provide decisive, hands-on leadership in a highly dynamic environment and coach launch teams. 
 - Support quotations and business cases with operations feasibility, industrial concepts, footprint and capacity scenarios, investment estimates, launch timing and risk assessment for complex mechatronic products. Ensure assumptions cover both focus factories and the required revenue-growth roadmap. 
 - Define Operations targets for safety, quality, cost, timing, scope, capacity and launch maturity across both focus factories. Establish project governance, decision rights, integrated master plan, gate deliverables, cadence, documentation and escalation paths. 
 - Build and lead the global launch team; secure resources and ownership with line management. Drive early risk management, manufacturing concept selection, make-or-buy inputs and work-package definition. 
 - Align factory readiness and industrialization strategy with the growth path from approximately €250M to €600M annual revenue. Lead operations delivery for the complete mechatronic system, integrating mechanical, electronics, electric motor and embedded software interfaces. 
 - Translate product requirements into robust manufacturing, assembly, testing, traceability and end-of-line concepts. Drive DfM/DfA, design reviews, process validation, equipment implementation, supplier readiness and capacity installation. 
 - Staff, direct and coach the two-factory launch team; resolve cross-functional dependencies and resource conflicts. Ensure all deliverables meet customer, regulatory, safety, cost, quality and timing requirements. Control the integrated plan and recover deviations through clear owners, countermeasures and escalation. 
 - Manage capital expenditure, tooling, launch costs, labor, ramp-up cost and obsolete-material exposure against approvals. Lead APQP, FMEA, control-plan, capability, test-coverage, traceability, line-release, PPAP and safe-launch readiness. 
 - Coordinate equipment, process, component, logistics and software-release maturity across both factories. Run risk-based launch reviews and drive rapid problem solving to achieve a stable, flawless ramp-up. 
 - Maintain one transparent, fact-based status for both factories covering milestones, budget, quality, capacity, resources, risks and decisions. Report gate maturity and forecast to Project Management, Operations leadership, plant management and executive steering committees. 
 - Escalate product, process, supplier, customer or safety-critical issues early, with impact, containment, recovery plan and required decision. Track actions to closure and ensure disciplined change control. 
 - Capture lessons learned and standardize reusable launch methods, equipment concepts, controls and best practices across both factories. Drive continuous improvement in yield, cycle time, scrap, reliability, test coverage and launch efficiency. Support warranty, 0-km, field and supplier-quality containment and root-cause resolution. Optimize capacity and requalification throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Represent Operations and both focus factories on project, customer, supplier and executive meetings worldwide. Build alignment among diverse stakeholders and communicate complex issues clearly, directly and early. Lead feasibility, change and problem-resolution discussions using timing, cost, quality, safety and risk evidence. Maintain a strong customer focus while protecting operational readiness and launch integrity. 
 - Own the transition from launch through stable serial production and formal handover at both factories. Monitor ramp-up performance, capacity, yield, quality, delivery and cost until agreed exit criteria are achieved. 
 - Coordinate product maintenance, engineering changes, non-conformance resolution and requalification. Lead capacity adaptations and phase-out preparation in line with business and customer requirements. 

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical, electronics, mechatronics, manufacturing, industrial engineering or a related technical field. At least 15 plus years of progressive experience in automotive or another safety-critical, high-volume industry, including complex mechatronic product development, manufacturing industrialization and launch. Experience across multiple functions or factories is required. 

Demonstrated successful delivery of at least three new-product launches, including a complex multi-site or safety-critical mechatronic program. Strong competence in APQP/PPAP, industrialization, launch planning, risk management, budget control, capacity planning, supplier readiness and structured problem solving. 

At least 5 years as a Launch Manager, Operations Project Manager or comparable cross-functional leader. Proven ability to lead international matrix teams, steer two factories, make timely decisions, escalate effectively and deliver under high pressure. 

Proven leadership of worldwide, multicultural stakeholders across functions, factories, customers and suppliers. Fluent business English is required; additional languages are advantageous. Strong intercultural sensitivity, executive communication and willingness to travel are expected. 

Additional Information

- Global Customer, Business Unit and Operations Governance: Expert knowledge of matrix decision-making, escalation paths and stakeholder management across factories and functions. Ability to establish clear governance, accountability and communication in a worldwide project environment
 - New Product Launch and Product Lifecycle Management: Expert application of NPL processes, gate reviews, industrialization planning, launch readiness and serial-life handover. Strong command of multi-site launch governance and operational deliverables
 - Safety-Critical Quality in Launches: APQP, PPAP, safe launch, line release, control plans, process capability, test coverage and end-to-end traceability. FMEA-based risk prevention and awareness of functional-safety implications for manufacturing and validation
 - Operations Program Control and Reporting: Integrated planning, milestone and gate control, resource steering, risk and opportunity management, change control and executive reporting. Rapid problem resolution, disciplined escalation and recovery planning across two factories. 
 - Manufacturing and Launch Financials: Business-case understanding and management of Capex, tooling, launch cost, labor, ramp-up cost, capacity and obsolete-material exposure. Ability to align industrial investment with growth from approximately €250M to €600M annual revenue. 
 - Advanced Mechatronic Product and Manufacturing Knowledge: Strong system-level understanding of mechanical, electronics, electric motor and embedded software interfaces. Manufacturing, assembly, testing, calibration, traceability, software-release and configuration-control concepts
 - Customer and Supplier Management: Customer-specific milestones, audits, PPAP, capability and drawing requirements. Executive-level communication, negotiation, expectation management and recovery alignment with customers and suppliers
 - Matrix Team Leadership: Lead, motivate and coach international cross-functional teams without relying solely on direct authority. Delegate outcomes, resolve conflict, manage performance input and create ownership across both focus factories
 - Change Management and Complex Problem Resolution: Evaluate changes across system interfaces and quantify impact on safety, quality, timing, cost, capacity and industrial readiness. Drive fast, structured decisions and implementation while keeping worldwide stakeholders aligned.

data.title: Sr. Principal Engineer, Emulation & IP Verification
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent 15 years learning that emulation is not just about running tests faster, it is about finding the bugs that matter before they cost millions in silicon respins. The difference between a verification plan that looks complete and one that actually catches corner cases is something you can spot in the first ten minutes of a review. You know PCIe, DDR, and Ethernet at the protocol level, not just the spec level, because you have debugged enough real failures to understand where theory and implementation diverge. 

Working with Zebu is second nature to you. You have built emulation environments that bridge the gap between what the platform can do and what your design team actually needs. When someone says "the emulation IP does not support that feature, " you do not stop there. You figure out the workaround, propose the enhancement, or find another path entirely. 

You operate comfortably across geographies and functions. Design teams, verification teams, IP teams, they all speak slightly different languages, and you translate between them without losing the technical thread. Matrixed organizations do not slow you down because you know how to build consensus without waiting for perfect alignment. At Synopsys, you will define how we validate the next generation of high-speed interfaces, and the IP you help verify will ship in products that power everything from data centers to autonomous systems. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Close the gap between Zebu emulation IP capabilities and what Design IP teams need to verify PCIe, DDR, and Ethernet controllers and PHYs across functional and performance domains
 - Define technical requirements for emulation IP, working directly with IP development teams to ensure correct implementation, deployment, and integration into verification flows
 - Track and report emulation IP quality metrics, identifying trends, gaps, and improvement opportunities that directly impact product schedules and silicon success
 - Stay ahead of evolving PCIe, DDR, and Ethernet standards, translating specification updates, ECNs, and errata into actionable requirements for both emulation and design teams
 - Review and validate test plans for emulation IP and design IP, ensuring coverage is complete, traceable, and aligned with real-world use cases and customer requirements
 - Drive cross-functional alignment on verification methodology, standardizing workflows and best practices across global teams to improve efficiency and reduce rework
 - Mentor engineers on emulation strategy, IP verification techniques, and how to think critically about coverage and quality in pre-silicon environments

The Impact You Will Have

- Accelerate time to market for high-speed interface IP by catching critical bugs in emulation before they reach silicon
 - Influence the roadmap and feature set of Synopsys emulation IP, shaping tools that thousands of engineers across the company depend on
 - Elevate verification quality across multiple product lines by defining and evangelizing best practices that become the standard
 - Reduce costly silicon respins by ensuring emulation environments accurately model real-world system behavior and corner cases
 - Build bridges between geographically distributed teams, turning fragmented verification efforts into cohesive, repeatable strategies
 - Position Synopsys as the industry leader in pre-silicon validation by driving adoption of cutting-edge emulation techniques
 - Enable the next generation of AI, automotive, and data center products by ensuring the IP that powers them is verified to the highest standard

What You'll Need

- 15+ years of hands-on experience in emulation, IP verification, or ASIC digital design
 - Deep expertise in PCIe and DDR protocols, including verification strategies, corner cases, and standards compliance
 - Extensive experience with Zebu or similar emulation platforms, particularly for IP-level verification and system-level integration
 - Proven track record leading or contributing to IP product development with a focus on emulation-based verification
 - Strong ability to work across global, matrixed teams and drive alignment between emulation IP and design IP organizations
 - Excellent communication skills, you can explain a complex tradeoff to a design lead in two sentences without losing the nuance
 - Experience interpreting and applying industry standards updates, ECNs, and errata in real verification contexts is a strong plus

Who You Are

- You can walk into a test plan review, spot the missing corner case that everyone else missed, and explain why it matters in two sentences
 - When something does not work in emulation, you do not wait for someone else to fix it. You dig in, reproduce it, and come back with a proposal
 - You are comfortable saying "this verification strategy will not catch that class of bugs" in a room full of senior engineers, and you can back it up with data
 - Ambiguity does not slow you down. You ask the right questions, make reasonable assumptions, document them, and keep moving
 - You have mentored engineers before and you know the difference between giving someone the answer and helping them learn how to find it
 - You treat verification like a product. You think about the user experience, the failure modes, and what happens six months from now when someone else has to maintain what you built

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join a dynamic, high-performing engineering team focused on IP development, emulation, and verification at the forefront of semiconductor innovation. Our team is collaborative, cross-functional, and globally distributed, working together to solve complex challenges and deliver industry-leading solutions. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with experts across multiple domains, drive impactful initiatives, and shape the future of digital design and verification at Synopsys. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

Job Description

- This role is a Site Engineering position within Nokia's Product Validation & Test (PV&T) R&D organization, where you will operate as a full member of the PV&T engineering team. Your primary purpose is to serve as PV&T's direct presence and working arm at manufacturing sites, focusing on Test Station Development (TSD). You will be actively involved on the factory floor, responsible for the setup, debugging, and continuous improvement of test stations. A key aspect of the role is driving the implementation of R&D-developed hardware, software, fixture, and procedural changes directly into manufacturing operations. This is distinctly an R&D engineering role situated within the production environment, not a CM test technician, supply chain, operations, or pure program management function. data.title: Software engineer - Python Validation
data.description:
Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today's needs and tomorrow's next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we're living in and that we have the power to shape. 

Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality. 

Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward. 

Description

Job Description Join SanDisk's Storage Validation Engineering team and help deliver high-quality software solutions for validating next-generation flash storage products. In this role, you will develop AI-assisted Python automation solutions, analyze product and protocol requirements, execute validation on storage devices, investigate complex failures, and contribute to release qualification. You will work closely with software, firmware, validation, and release teams across India, Israel, and the United States. This position is ideal for engineers who enjoy Python development, AI-assisted engineering, system-level debugging, Linux and Windows environments, and working close to hardware. Responsibilities

- Understand product requirements, technical designs, and storage protocol specifications. 
 - Create comprehensive validation strategies including functional, negative, integration, stress, recovery, and regression scenarios. 
 - Plan, design, develop, review, and maintain automated validation solutions using Python and AI-assisted engineering tools. 
 - Validate storage features, software enhancements, and bug fixes on physical storage devices. 
 - Execute sanity, functional, integration, performance, and regression test campaigns. 
 - Analyze logs, reproduce failures, and isolate issues across test frameworks, host software, firmware, operating systems, and device layers. 
 - Report defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, configurations, and technical findings. 
 - Verify fixes and provide evidence-based quality sign-off. 
 - Contribute qualified tests to automated sanity and regression suites. 
 - Collaborate with globally distributed development, validation, and release teams. 
 - Improve test automation, diagnostics, reliability, and engineering productivity. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly for test design, coding, debugging, data analysis, and documentation activities. Qualifications Required Qualifications
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 3 to 5 years of experience in software engineering, validation, system testing, quality assurance, or test automation. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python with hands-on experience developing automated test solutions. 
 - Experience developing, debugging, and maintaining automated test frameworks. 
 - Good understanding of software testing methodologies, defect lifecycle management, and quality engineering practices. 
 - Experience working in Linux and Windows environments. 
 - Working knowledge of Git and GitHub development workflows. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted development, testing, debugging, or engineering productivity tools. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. 
 - Ability to work independently, drive tasks to completion, and take ownership of validation activities. Preferred Qualifications
 - Experience with SSDs, flash storage, firmware, drivers, embedded systems, or system software. 
 - Knowledge of storage protocols such as NVMe, SCSI, or ATA. 
 - Experience with Python test frameworks, log analysis, and data-driven testing methodologies. 
 - Familiarity with GitHub, Jira, Agile, Scrum, and Continuous Integration workflows. 
 - Working knowledge of C or C++. 
 - Exposure to large-scale automation environments and test infrastructure development. 
 - Experience using AI tools to improve software development, testing, or engineering productivity. What We Look For
 - Strong problem-solving and debugging abilities. 
 - Attention to detail and commitment to product quality. 
 - Curiosity to understand complex interactions between software, firmware, operating systems, and hardware. 
 - Ownership mindset from requirement analysis through validation sign-off. 
 - Proactive mindset with a high level of accountability. 
 - Assertive communicator who can clearly and confidently express technical viewpoints while respecting others. 
 - Ability to challenge assumptions and make data-driven decisions. 
 - Continuous learning attitude with interest in automation, AI-assisted engineering, and emerging technologies. 
 - Strong collaboration skills across globally distributed teams. 
 - Confidence to take initiative, drive improvements, and deliver results

Let's talk numbers We are currently the market leader in India across the e-bike category and are just on the verge of announcing our series C. Having grown from a team of 5 to 150+ across the globe, from a small garage to offices across 15 countries and clocking in INR 300+ Cr revenue in first three years of operations. We have raised a series B from global investors. We think this is a great start to our exciting journey. 

We think this is a great start to our exciting journey. 

Come, join us, help us transform the world, mobility, and have a blast while doing it! Think you are the right fit? Feel free to apply!

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Quality Engineer with 3+ years of hands-on experience in Lithium-Ion Battery manufacturing and quality. The candidate should have strong knowledge of cell, battery module and battery pack manufacturing, electrical testing, BMS, welding processes, EOL testing, process quality and defect analysis. Exposure to BLDC Motor manufacturing will be an added advantage. 

Key Responsibilities

- Manage IQC, IPQC and OQC activities for Lithium-Ion Battery manufacturing. 
 - Strong hands-on knowledge of cell inspection, cell grading, OCV/IR testing, cell matching, module assembly and battery pack assembly. 
 - Monitor critical processes including spot/resistance welding, nickel strip/busbar assembly, insulation, soldering, BMS assembly, wiring/harnessing and pack enclosure assembly. 
 - Conduct and monitor battery charging/discharging, capacity, voltage, current, IR, BMS communication, protection function and EOL testing. 
 - Ensure critical quality parameters such as weld strength, insulation resistance, polarity, voltage balance, cell matching and BMS protection functions are controlled. 
 - Handle battery defect analysis, RCA, 8D, CAPA, Pareto and rejection/rework reduction. 
 - Prepare and maintain PFMEA, Control Plan, SOP, Work Instructions, inspection standards and quality check sheets. 
 - Monitor battery process rejection, PPM, rework, FPY and customer complaints. 
 - Coordinate with Production, R&D, Supplier Quality and Manufacturing Engineering for process and product improvements. 
 - Support supplier quality activities, incoming cell/component inspection and supplier corrective actions. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable battery safety, quality and ISO requirements. 
 - Drive continuous improvement projects to improve battery reliability, safety, quality and manufacturing yield. 

Key Technical Skills

Lithium-Ion Battery - Mandatory

- Cell Inspection & Grading
 - OCV / IR Testing
 - Cell Matching & Sorting
 - Battery Module & Pack Assembly
 - Spot/Resistance Welding
 - Nickel Strip / Busbar Quality
 - BMS Assembly & Functional Testing
 - Battery Charging & Discharging
 - Capacity & Performance Testing
 - Insulation Resistance Testing
 - EOL Testing
 - BMS Communication & Protection Testing
 - Battery Safety & Quality Controls
 - Battery Traceability
 - Defect Analysis & Process Improvement

Quality Tools

- PFMEA
 - Control Plan
 - SPC
 - MSA
 - 8D
 - RCA / CAPA
 - Process & Product Audits
 - 5 Why / Fishbone / Pareto

Additional Exposure

- BLDC Motor manufacturing and testing will be an added advantage. 

Candidate Profile

- 3+ years of relevant experience in Lithium-Ion Battery manufacturing/quality, preferably in EV or automotive applications. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in battery production, testing, inspection and troubleshooting. 
 - Good understanding of battery-related electrical, mechanical and safety requirements. 
 - Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.

data.title: Test Analyst
data.description:
Job Summary

Test analyst position for an experienced professional with strong hands on skills in Python and Java to design implement and optimize test automation for complex enterprise systems in a hybrid day shift environment with no travel contributing to highly reliable software delivery that supports global merchandising operations and business growth. 

Responsibilities

- Design comprehensive test strategies and detailed test plans using Python and Java to validate complex application features and integrations ensuring robust quality across enterprise systems and minimizing defect leakage to production. 
 - Develop scalable and maintainable automated test suites in Python and Java that integrate smoothly with continuous integration pipelines improving coverage reducing manual effort and accelerating delivery of high confidence releases. 
 - Execute functional regression integration and system tests while thoroughly documenting test evidence and outcomes providing clear traceability from requirements through defects and final sign off for day shift hybrid teams. 
 - Analyze requirement specifications and technical designs to derive precise test scenarios and data sets identifying ambiguities and risks early and collaborating with stakeholders to refine testable acceptance criteria. 
 - Investigate defects with methodical root cause analysis using logs code level insights and test data review providing concise defect reports and recommendations that help engineers resolve issues efficiently. 
 - Optimize automated and manual test cases by eliminating redundancies refining validation steps and aligning with evolving system behavior improving test cycle efficiency while preserving coverage for critical business flows. 
 - Collaborate closely with developers business analysts and operations teams in a hybrid work model to clarify expected behavior reproduce complex issues and agree on risk based testing priorities that align with release objectives. 
 - Monitor test execution metrics such as pass rates defect density and execution time preparing structured test summary reports that inform release readiness decisions and highlight areas needing additional validation. 
 - Support configuration of test environments and synthetic test data creation to mirror realistic production scenarios ensuring reliable validation of merchandising related workflows and inventory processes where applicable. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of testing frameworks and guidelines by proposing enhancements to automation utilities coding patterns and documentation helping the testing function scale to larger and more complex initiatives. 
 - Coordinate with hybrid teams to schedule test cycles for day shifts ensuring dependencies environment availability and data readiness are managed so test execution proceeds without avoidable delays. 
 - Review peer test cases scripts and defect reports providing constructive feedback that improves clarity maintainability and consistency with established quality standards and organizational practices. 
 - Mentor less experienced test professionals by demonstrating effective test design automation techniques in Python and Java and structured defect analysis methods strengthening overall team capability and delivery quality. 

Qualifications

- Possess six to ten years of focused experience in software testing with strong exposure to enterprise applications and proven ability to design thorough and efficient test suites. 
 - Demonstrate advanced practical proficiency in Python by writing clean test automation scripts utilities and reusable components that integrate with modern test frameworks and pipelines. 
 - Display solid applied skills in Java for creating stable test harnesses service level validation tools and automation frameworks that can be shared across multiple project teams. 
 - Bring hands on understanding of quality assurance concepts such as traceability risk based testing boundary coverage and defect life cycle management applied consistently on past projects. 
 - Exhibit familiarity with merchandising or retail domain processes including product setup pricing promotions and inventory flows using this knowledge to design realistic and business relevant test scenarios. 
 - Show experience working in hybrid delivery models and coordinating with distributed stakeholders using structured communication and documentation practices that sustain smooth day shift collaboration. 
 - Apply practical knowledge of continuous integration and version control tooling to trigger automated test runs review execution logs and maintain stable test branches within shared repositories. 
 - Utilize strong analytical and problem solving abilities to interpret requirements detect edge cases and convert complex business rules into clear verifiable test conditions that reduce production incidents. 
 - Maintain high standards for written and verbal communication producing precise test cases defect descriptions and summary reports that support transparent quality decisions and stakeholder confidence. 
 - Adapt quickly to new tools frameworks and business processes embracing ongoing learning to refine testing approaches and support the organization goal of delivering reliable solutions that positively impact customers and society.

data.title: QA Automation Engineer
data.description:
Build and maintain the automated regression suites behind our clients' release cycles, so testing that used to take days runs itself. 

Location Chennai, Tamil Nadu

Type Full time

Posted 29 July 2026

About The Role

You will build the automation that lets a client ship. On our travel-platform programme, regression that used to consume days of manual effort now runs itself and the team releases several times a week - that shift is the job. 

What you will do

- Write and maintain automated functional and regression tests for web applications. 
 - Convert existing manual test cases into reliable automated coverage, and retire the ones that no longer earn their place. 
 - Keep suites trustworthy: investigate failures, fix flakiness, and keep run times short enough to stay in the release path. 
 - Integrate test runs into CI so results reach the team on every build. 
 - Work with client engineering teams on defects - reproduce, isolate and report clearly enough to act on. 

What you will bring

- Hands-on experience automating tests for web applications with a modern framework such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or similar. 
 - Working knowledge of at least one programming language used for test automation - JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java or C#. 
 - An understanding of test design: what to automate, what to leave manual, and why. 
 - Familiarity with version control, CI pipelines and defect tracking. 
 - A degree in engineering, computer science or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
About Audax

audax means courage. To have the courage to change the banking scene, eliminating constraints caused by existing legacy infrastructure. Our mission is to empower banks and financial institutions to scale and modernise at speed, reaching new customers without breaking the bank. 

We began our journey supplying services to and powering Standard Chartered's white-label plug and play Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) solution, Standard Chartered nexus, through our technology capabilities. At audax, we seek go-getters who are hungry for growth and can bring fresh perspectives. 

Website - https: //audax. io/

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to lead architecture, design and engineering delivery for high-volume financial transaction platforms across payments, cards, transaction processing/core banking and Personal Financial Management (PFM). 

As Audax is a product platform, solutions must be designed as reusable, configurable and extensible capabilities rather than bank-specific implementations. The role should enable different banks, countries and regulatory requirements through configuration, reusable components and low-code/no-code approaches where appropriate, while maintaining a common product base. 

The role requires deep hands-on engineering experience in distributed systems, real-time transaction orchestration and cloud-native architecture, together with strong technical leadership, delivery ownership and the ability to lead by example. 

What You'll Do

- Own architecture, direction and delivery for high-volume, real-time financial transaction processing, including orchestration, concurrency, retries, idempotency, distributed transaction handling, batch processing and bulk posting. 
 - Lead solution design across payments, cards, PFM and core banking/transaction-processing engines, including integrations with payment hubs, payment rails, gateways, processors and country clearing systems. 
 - Design financial-services capabilities as generic, reusable and configurable product features, with clear separation between core product and bank-specific rules, workflows, integration endpoints and regulatory variations; use low-code/no-code patterns where practical. 
 - Apply strong working knowledge of payment messaging and standards such as ISO 20022, SWIFT and PAIN messages, together with PCI DSS and Open Banking considerations, in solution and integration design. 
 - Architect and build cloud-native solutions using Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST/gRPC, event-driven architecture, Kubernetes with appropriate SQL/NoSQL and messaging technologies. 
 - Ensure systems are scalable, resilient, secure and operable, with strong observability through logs, metrics, traces and end-to-end transaction visibility for TechOps/SRE teams. 
 - Lead architecture and design reviews, translate product requirements into implementable technical solutions, and support teams through engineering delivery, testing, release and production readiness. 
 - Remain hands-on in solving complex engineering and production issues, mentor engineers, establish engineering standards and lead by example across teams. 
 - Apply AI-assisted development tools such as code generation, developer tooling to improve engineering efficiency, testing and code quality within the owned domain. 

Who You Are

- 12+ years of software engineering experience, with strong architecture and delivery experience in financial-services or high-volume transaction-processing platforms. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST/gRPC, distributed systems, event-driven architecture and Kubernetes. 
 - Demonstrated domain experience in one or more payments, cards, transaction processing/core banking or PFM, with a strong understanding of accounts, transactions and financial transaction lifecycles. 
 - Experience integrating with payment hubs, payment rails, gateways, processors and clearing systems, with practical understanding of ISO/SWIFT-based payment messaging. 
 - Strong product-engineering experience building configurable and extensible platforms that support multiple banks, countries or regulatory variants without creating separate product forks. 
 - Strong cloud-native experience across AWS and/or GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, Git and infrastructure/deployment automation, with working knowledge of PostgreSQL, Cassandra or equivalent DB platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of scalability, performance, resilience, observability, security and production-readiness requirements for distributed transaction systems. 
 - Proven ability to lead architecture and technical delivery across teams while remaining hands-on, mentoring engineers and collaborating effectively with Product, Engineering, QA, SRE and Security teams. 
 - Experience applying AI-assisted SDLC practices to improve development efficiency, code quality, testing and engineering delivery

Why Join Us?

- Be Part of a Bold Vision - At audax, we're not just building software - we're transforming how financial institutions and businesses manage risk, compliance, and growth. Join a team that's fearless in challenging the status quo. 
 - Flexible, People-First Workplace - We value the importance of Family, Team, Self. In that order. 
 - Competitive Rewards and Startup Perks - We offer competitive salaries and meaningful benefits that look after your well-being. 

Privacy Notice: 

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood audax's Privacy Policy for Employees, Freelancers, Contractors and Job Applicants (the "Policy"), and consent to the collection, use and disclosure of your personal data by audax for the purposes set out in the Policy. 

You may withdraw consent for such collection, use and disclosure, and make an access or correction request in respect of your personal data, in accordance with the Policy by emailing dpo@audax. io. 

Disclaimer: At Audax, we use AI to support our recruitment process, including reviewing applications and identifying candidates whose skills and experience best match our opportunities. AI assists our recruiters-it does not make hiring decisions. All applications are reviewed by our recruitment team, and hiring decisions are made by people. Please ensure the information you submit is accurate and reflects your own qualifications and experience.

We're looking for an Assistant Manager to lead our guest posting and link-building function. You'll own campaign strategy, manage a team of executives, oversee the publisher and vendor ecosystem, and make sure client campaigns deliver high-quality, cost-efficient links at scale.

 - Create and improve SOPs, trackers, templates and reporting dashboards to make the function more scalable and consistent.

data.description:
About us: As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400, 000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. 

Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful. 

Overview about Target In India: At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. And that hasn't happened by accident. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target's global team and has more than 4, 000 team members supporting the company's global strategy and operations. 

About Pyramid: The Identity & Access Management team within Cyber Solutions is responsible for delivering the capabilities that secure access to Target resources globally for our Team Members, contractors, partners, and Guests. From authentication to encryption, from certificate management to identity management, from humans to workloads, we focus on leveraging robust engineering principles, open standards, common target tech patterns, and a passionate and motivated team of engineers to turn ideas into solutions and outcomes. 

About Team: The Strong Authentication team provides authentication capabilities to protect Target applications, data, and business processes for Enterprise users as well as Partners and Third Parties. This team has to seamlessly balance Security objectives with User Experience, constantly adapting and maturing as Threat Actors pivot. To do this, we use in-house developed capabilities and strong organizational partnerships to achieve shared goals. 

About a Senior Engineering Manager (SEM)

The Sr. Engineering Manager (SEM) is responsible for managing a team of engineers. This role is accountable for leading a team, developing code, deploying and managing in production. Most importantly, the SEM, while working alongside the Product Manager, drives the product Net Promoter Score (NPS), user satisfaction, building the product roadmap and delivering highly functional, exceptionally innovative and intelligent software. You will be called upon to be the technical representative for your team during cross-team collaborative efforts and planning. Success in this role will require strong and innovative approaches to problem solving, great technical leadership, excellent communication (written and verbal, formal and informal), flexibility, accountability and a self-motivated working style with attention to detail. 

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs. 

Use your skills, experience, and talents to be a part of groundbreaking thinking and visionary goals. As a Sr. Engineering Manager, you'll take the lead as you. . . 

- Lead a team to build a suite of tools, processes, and capabilities to ensure we defend against an evolving threat landscape, while balancing Security and User Experience for our users. 
 - Stay current with industry standards and Cyber- and Identity-Security trends to leverage appropriate capabilities to deliver Cybersecurity outcomes. 
 - Partner with our Cybersecurity Threat Intelligence team to understand Threat Actor TTPs to reduce risk and ensure optimal defense capabilities to protect Target
 - Use innovation and critical thinking to solve complex security and technology problems. 
 - Establish good stakeholder relationships and work closely with Tech teams, influence the product roadmap and help drive requirements while being a strong advocate of agile and DevOps practices across the team. 
 - Execution of the team-developed strategy, solving enterprise-wide problems and addressing key security concerns. 
 - Provide career development and performance management to a team of engineers. 
 - Elevate your collective team's performance by providing insightful, motivating, and constructive feedback to all roles on the team while also working with senior leadership and peers across pyramids to negotiate and remove execution-related barriers for your team. 

About You

- 4 year degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
 - 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 1-3 years of managing teams with a strong track record of delivery for cross-functional products
 - Expertise in Java programming languages
 - Proven ability to deliver high-performance, scalable, repeatable, and secure solutions with broad impact
 - Experience leading functional design and architecture discussions, with an understanding of process flows and system diagrams to support design decisions
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to variety of audiences
 - Team-orientated, passionate about developing others' skills and capabilities
 - Demonstrated experience providing technical oversight and coaching to others in resolving technical issues
 - Successful track record of working in large enterprise technology ecosystems leading complex technology teams
 - Deep understanding of agile development processes and methodology including continuous integration and delivery, with a mindset of building incrementally and delivering business value quickly
 - Strong collaboration skills, effective management of complex cross-team initiatives and leads with the desire to enable our engineering teams. 
 - Experience evaluating new technologies and participating in decision-making, considering factors such as viability within Target's technical environment, compliance requirements, approved tech status, maintainability, and cost of ownership

data.description:
Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others. 

If you're looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further. 

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions. 

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Engineering (GCB4. 1)

In This Role, You Will

Technical leadership & architecture

- Solution architecture and modernisation: Contribute to the overall solution architecture for high-performance data pipelines and microservices, covering non-functional requirements such as resilience, scalability, latency, observability, and security. Define and drive modernisation roadmaps, including re-platforming, refactoring, and microservices decomposition, while minimising disruption to live services. 
 - Engineering standards and technical debt: Establish standards for API design, event-driven integration, data modelling, testing, CI/CD, and operational readiness. Manage technical debt through clear prioritisation, measurable outcomes, and continuous improvement. 
 - Application and data platform engineering: Architect, design, and build core services using Java 8+, Spring Boot 3, relational databases, cloud storage such as Amazon S3 and Google Cloud Storage, serverless technologies such as AWS Glue, Glue Data Catalog, Lake Formation, Amazon EKS, Step Functions, SQS, and event-streaming patterns. Lead the design and implementation of solutions using Apache Spark, YuniKorn, and/or Apache Beam where appropriate. 
 - Cloud engineering - GCP: Drive engineering delivery on Google Cloud Platform, using Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Google Cloud Storage, Composer/Airflow, BigQuery and/or ClickHouse, and Google Kubernetes Engine. Ensure data quality, integrity, lineage, and security controls across pipelines and downstream consumption. 
 - Operational excellence: Own production reliability through monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, performance tuning, incident resolution, resilience improvements, and cost optimisation. 
 - AI-enabled engineering productivity: Use AI tooling and at least two code-development large language models (LLMs) to support regular engineering tasks, agentic workflows, and specification-driven development. Build AI-enabled automation for scripting, tooling, and unit, regression, and functional testing, using Python where appropriate. 
 - Technical collaboration: Partner with engineers through code reviews, pair debugging, performance tuning, and production incident resolution. 
 - People leadership and stakeholder management: Coach and mentor engineers at different levels, fostering a culture of craftsmanship, accountability, and continuous improvement. Communicate effectively with senior stakeholders by translating business outcomes into technical plans and delivery milestones. Proactively manage risks, dependencies, and delivery impediments, with clear mitigation and escalation paths. 

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements: (MAX 8 Points)

- Cloud, Kubernetes and deployment tooling: Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Docker, OpenShift, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and GitLab CI/CD. 
 - Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Stackdriver/Cloud Monitoring, and distributed tracing. 
 - Cloud and Kubernetes security: Automated secrets management, Identity and Access Management (IAM), network segmentation, and secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices. 
 - Data engineering and processing: Apache Spark, with proficiency in at least one Spark-related language, preferably Python or Spark SQL. 
 - Advanced SQL and data management: Data modelling, cloud storage mechanisms, and file formats such as Parquet and Iceberg. 
 - Databases and build tooling: DocumentDB and SBT. 
 - Containerised application development: Hands-on experience designing and developing containerised applications, including auto-scaling and load balancing. 
 - DevOps delivery: Experience developing end-to-end DevOps pipelines for automated testing, regression testing, and deployments. Experience with Jira and Confluence is required. 
 - AI tooling: Hands-on experience with AI tooling, preferably including Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration. Familiarity with Claude Code, SpecKit, specification-driven development (SDD), and AI/LLM technologies is desirable. 
 - Front-end technologies: React and TypeScript exposure is helpful but not essential. 
 - Cloud technology: Hands-on experience with cloud technologies and a strong technical background. 
 - Financial services domain knowledge: Understanding of Financial Accounting, Credit Risk, Market Risk, Operational Risk, and Regulatory Reporting. 

You'll achieve more when you join HSBC. 

www. hsbc. com/careers

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

data.title: Director of Software Engineering
data.description:
About Cvent: 

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6, 000+ employees and ~34, 000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we're transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers human connection. 

Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4. 6B in 2023. 

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections. 

Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection. 

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we're committed to continuous learning and adaptation-AI isn't just a tool for us, it's part of our DNA. We're looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you'll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation. 

Throughout our interview process, you'll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you're excited to be part of a team that's leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we'd love to meet you. 

Recruitment Scam Notice: Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as "name@cvent. com" email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent. 

If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent. com. 

For more information, visit Cvent's Recruitment Fraud Notice. https: //www. cvent. com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud. 

Director, Software Engineering - Goldcast (a Cvent company)

Goldcast is an AI-powered video event platform for B2B marketers. Teams use Goldcast to run webinars, virtual and hybrid events, and video series, and then use Content Lab to turn every recording into clips, blogs, social posts and other content that keeps driving pipeline long after the event ends. 

In December 2025, Goldcast became part of Cvent, the leading meetings, events and hospitality technology company. Together we are combining Cvent's large-scale event management platform with Goldcast's AI and video capabilities so every event becomes a content engine that drives measurable ROI. You get the pace and ownership of a product team, with the reach and resources of a global company. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an engineering leader to own a major part of the Goldcast engineering organization in India. You will lead multiple teams through managers, own delivery and reliability for your product areas, and help shape how AI shows up in both our product and the way we build it. You will also play a key role in bringing Goldcast and Cvent together, on the platform, in process, and in product. 

In This Role, You Will: 

- Lead and grow the org: Run multiple teams through engineering managers and tech leads. Hire, coach and develop managers, and build a culture of ownership, speed and high standards. 
 - Own outcomes, not just delivery: Be accountable for what ships, how reliable it is, and what it costs to run. Set clear goals and track them with real metrics (delivery predictability, uptime, quality, cloud cost). 
 - Build AI into the product: Partner with Product and our AI team to ship features like transcription, summaries, AI clipping, content generation, recommendations and agent-based workflows, with the right guardrails for quality, cost and safety. 
 - Make the team AI-native: Drive the use of AI coding and testing tools across the org, and measure the impact on speed and quality. 
 - Run live, at scale: Make sure our live video and streaming experiences hold up when thousands of attendees join at once. Own SLAs, on-call, incident management and postmortems. 
 - Shape the architecture: Work with architects and principal engineers on the technical roadmap: scaling the platform on AWS, media and data pipelines, and paying down tech debt with a plan. 
 - Lead the Cvent integration: Drive platform, tooling and process alignment with Cvent (Jira, incident management, security, data) and integrate Goldcast with Cvent Event Cloud products, without slowing down the roadmap. 
 - Partner across functions: Work closely with Product, Design, CS, Support and US leadership. Turn business goals into engineering plans for the next quarter and the next year, and keep stakeholders informed. 
 - Stay close to customers: Understand how B2B marketers use the product, own customer-impacting escalations for your area, and use that feedback to set priorities. 

Here's What You Need: 

- 18+ years in software engineering, with at least 5 years leading managers (manager of managers) in a product company. 
 - A track record of shipping and running a SaaS product at scale: distributed systems, high-concurrency services, and multi-tenant architecture on a public cloud (AWS preferred). 
 - Hands-on understanding of how AI/LLM features are built and run in production: model selection, prompt and evaluation workflows, cost and latency trade-offs. 
 - Experience with real-time video, streaming, media processing or other low-latency systems is a strong plus. 
 - Strong technical judgment. You don't need to write code every day, but you can go deep on a design review, an incident, or a performance problem. 
 - Experience hiring and building teams, including growing first-time managers and setting up career paths. 
 - Comfort leading through change: post-acquisition integration, reorgs, or platform migrations. 
 - Clear, direct communication with senior leaders and with distributed teams across India and the US. 
 - A product mindset. You care about why we are building something, not only how. 

Nice to Have: 

- Experience in martech, events, webinar or video platforms. 
 - Experience with data platforms and analytics that show customer ROI. 
 - Background in a high-growth startup as well as a larger company. 

Why join: 

You will lead a team building one of the most AI-forward products in the events space, with direct impact on how thousands of companies run and reuse their events, and with the backing of Cvent to scale it globally.

 - Experience leading through technical expertise and influence - setting direction, solving complex engineering problems and mentoring others while remaining a hands-on individual contributor.

Building HSBC's AI engineering capability

PracticeOS Quality Assurance

Experience: 4-5 years in software testing

Location: Kochi, Kerala, India • On-site • Full-time

Reports to: Engineering Lead / QA Lead

About Caretech360 and PracticeOSWe are building PracticeOS for small and mid-size medical practices. It connects patient acquisition, engagement, clinical coordination, practice operations, knowledge and training, and intelligence in one platform. It works alongside the EHR as a system of action, knowledge and intelligence, with integrations that connect records to daily work. 

The platform includes marketing and CRM, intake and patient communication, prior authorization and coding support, injury care referrals, PACS and imaging, tasks and scheduling, staff onboarding and training, inventory, vendor management, IT and compliance, and analytics. AI assistants and agents help users find information, draft actions and coordinate work with human review. Product maturity varies by module; these roles support both existing experiences and new releases. 

The roleOwn hands-on testing of PracticeOS web and mobile experiences, APIs and connected workflows. Work with product, designers and developers to define acceptance criteria, find failures early and give clear evidence of release readiness. The role combines strong manual and exploratory testing with practical automation of stable, high-value regression scenarios. 

Core responsibilities·              Turn requirements, designs and user journeys into test scenarios and acceptance checks. Cover happy paths, exceptions, permissions, integrations and workflow transitions. 

·              Perform functional, exploratory, integration, smoke, regression and UAT support across desktop browsers, responsive layouts and mobile devices. 

·              Log reproducible defects with steps, expected and actual results, screenshots or recordings, environment details and impact; verify fixes and affected workflows. 

PracticeOS testing scope·              Test inquiry and referral capture, CRM handoffs, intake submission, patient communication and appointment coordination; verify data reaches the correct record. 

·              Test clinical coordination and prior authorization stages, ownership, deadlines, note correction, submission, approval and scheduling. Check both authorization-required and not-required paths using approved sample rules. 

·              Test injury case referrals, external record uploads, PACS study association and viewer interactions, and access for internal and external roles using synthetic or approved de-identified data. 

·              Test staff onboarding, training assignment and completion, knowledge review and publishing, task creation, inventory and operational workflows for assigned release scope. 

·              Validate backend role permissions and tenant isolation, not only UI visibility. Check direct API access, record ownership, upload and download access, notifications and audit entries. 

·              Test APIs using Postman or equivalent: authentication, schema and payload validation, status codes, pagination, error handling, retries and duplicate events. Use SQL to verify data integrity and state changes. 

·              Test AI features against approved scenarios and expected behaviors. Check context, sources where applicable, draft versus committed actions, approval gates, invalid outputs, unavailable services and safe recovery. 

·              Validate voice and mic interactions where supported, interrupted intake, session expiry, upload limits, slow connections, mobile touch behavior and cross-browser rendering. 

·              Check accessibility basics, including keyboard navigation, visible focus, labels, validation messages and contrast. Collaborate on specialist security, accessibility and performance reviews. 

·              Build and maintain API and UI regression automation; run reliable suites in CI, report failures, and investigate flaky tests. Track release coverage, critical defects and remaining risks. 

Required skills and experience·              4-5 years of hands-on testing experience for web applications, with mobile or responsive testing experience and strong manual test design. 

·              API testing with Postman or equivalent and SQL skills for validating records, relationships and transactional updates. 

·              Hands-on automation experience with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium or a comparable framework; ability to maintain tests using JavaScript, TypeScript or another relevant language. 

·              Understanding of authentication, role-based access, multi-tenant applications and integration testing; experience with Git and CI test execution. 

·              Clear defect reporting, risk-based regression selection and ownership of test execution through release; effective collaboration with developers and product teams. 

Preferred qualifications·              Healthcare software experience, including practice workflows, EHR integrations, prior authorization, patient portals or imaging. 

·              Native mobile testing or Appium experience; familiarity with real-device and emulator testing. 

·              Exposure to AI or LLM evaluation, asynchronous jobs, webhooks, file processing, performance tools and accessibility testing. 

·              Experience testing React front ends, Node. js APIs and PostgreSQL-backed applications; familiarity with FHIR, HL7 or DICOM integration scenarios. 

First 90 days·              Days 1-30: Understand the product and environments; map critical journeys and role combinations; establish test data, a defect baseline and a release smoke checklist. 

·              Days 31-60: Build a repeatable regression suite for agreed priority modules, API checks and permission tests; automate stable critical paths and support UAT. 

·              Days 61-90: Integrate agreed automated checks into CI, validate an assigned release, document remaining risks and improve coverage based on defects and usage. 

Expected outputs and success measuresMaintain a test plan, journey-based test cases, synthetic test data, API collections, automated regression checks, defect reports and a concise release quality summary. Measure critical-path coverage, defect escape patterns, reproducibility, regression reliability and timely risk reporting. Release recommendations should identify what was tested, what remains untested and any unresolved high-impact defects. 

How to applySubmit your resume with examples of web and mobile testing, API and SQL validation, and automation work. Describe your personal role in a release, a significant defect you found and how you selected regression coverage. Use sanitized examples that contain no client data or credentials. 

Selection processExperience review, a practical test-design and defect-analysis discussion using a sample PracticeOS workflow, and an API or automation exercise. Final discussion covers collaboration and release ownership. 

Working arrangementsFull-time, on-site in Kochi, with working-hour overlap for the US team. Compensation will be discussed during the hiring process. The reporting line will follow the engineering and QA team structure

data.title: General Manager Engineering & Projects
data.description:
Job Purpose

To lead and oversee Engineering, Process Equipment, Utilities, Maintenance, and Projects for a sterile injectable manufacturing facility, ensuring equipment reliability, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and successful execution of infrastructure development and capacity expansion projects. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead overall Engineering, Process Equipment, Utilities, Maintenance, and Projects operations for the sterile injectable manufacturing facility. 
 - Ensure optimal performance, reliability, and uptime of process equipment, manufacturing systems, and critical utilities. 
 - Oversee the installation, commissioning, qualification, validation, and maintenance of process equipment and utility systems. 
 - Manage preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance, including troubleshooting, root cause analysis (RCA), and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA). 
 - Lead greenfield and brownfield projects, facility development, plant modifications, capacity expansion, and equipment upgradation. 
 - Review and finalize equipment specifications, URS, plant layouts, PFDs, P&IDs, engineering designs, and project estimates. 
 - Manage project planning, CAPEX budgeting, cost control, procurement coordination, vendor selection, and execution timelines. 
 - Coordinate Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), equipment erection, commissioning, and performance verification. 
 - Ensure compliance with cGMP, WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, EHS, and applicable regulatory requirements. 
 - Maintain engineering documentation, equipment qualification records, calibration records, preventive maintenance schedules, and audit readiness. 
 - Monitor critical spare inventory, equipment performance, utility consumption, and maintenance expenditure. 
 - Drive energy conservation, cost optimization, equipment reliability, productivity enhancement, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Collaborate with QA, Production, Validation, EHS, Procurement, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of engineering and project activities. 
 - Lead, mentor, and develop the Engineering, Utilities, Maintenance, and Projects teams. 

Mandatory Technical Expertise

1. Process Equipment - Sterile Injectables

- Aseptic liquid filling lines and vial filling systems. 
 - Filling line equipment from B+S, Bosch, Groninger, IMA, Tofflon, Optima, Truking, Steriline, or equivalent OEMs. 
 - Lyophilizers (freeze dryers), autoclaves, and terminal sterilizers. 
 - Manufacturing vessels, holding vessels, and associated process equipment. 
 - Equipment selection, technical evaluation, troubleshooting, maintenance, qualification, and performance improvement. 2. Utilities and Facility Systems

- HVAC systems, AHUs, cleanrooms, and environmental control systems. 
 - Purified Water (PW), Water for Injection (WFI), and clean/pure steam generation and distribution systems. 
 - Boilers, chillers, air compressors, and other critical plant utilities. 
 - Building Management System (BMS) and utility monitoring systems. 3. Projects, Qualification and Compliance

- Greenfield sterile injectable facility setup and brownfield expansion projects. 
 - Equipment erection, installation, commissioning, and qualification, including IQ/OQ/PQ. 
 - Engineering change control, calibration, preventive maintenance, and GMP documentation. 
 - Regulatory inspection readiness and engineering compliance. 

Candidate Profile

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering; relevant engineering qualifications preferred. 
 - 18-25+ years of experience in pharmaceutical engineering, with substantial exposure to sterile injectable manufacturing. 
 - Proven leadership experience in Engineering, Process Equipment, Utilities, Maintenance, and Projects at a senior management level. 
 - Demonstrated capability in managing sterile facility operations, major engineering projects, CAPEX, and cross-functional teams. 
 - Strong expertise in process equipment, clean utilities, HVAC systems, project execution, and equipment reliability. 
 - Sound understanding of aseptic manufacturing practices, cleanroom requirements, GMP compliance, and regulatory expectations. 
 - Excellent leadership, planning, budgeting, vendor management, and problem-solving skills. 

Preferred: Experience in setting up or expanding sterile injectable manufacturing facilities and independently managing end-to-end engineering and project operations.

Job Title: Principal Engineer

Experience : 12+ Years

Location: Trivandrum, India (Onsite)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Reporting To: Head of Engineering

Job Purpose

The Principal Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for driving the design, implementation, and management of scalable, secure, and highly available AI solutions that power AOT's portfolio of digital products for the public and private sectors. This role blends deep technical expertise with strategic thinking and hands-on leadership - setting architectural direction, championing AI-assisted engineering practices, and mentoring engineers to build the next generation of intelligent, cloud-native applications. The Principal Engineer partners closely with the Head of Engineering, product leaders and cross-functional teams to translate complex business and user needs into resilient, future-ready technical solutions grounded in open-source principles and modern cloud architecture. 

Job Duties and Responsibilities

- Lead the end-to-end design, architecture and delivery of scalable, secure and highly available AI-powered solutions across AOT's product portfolio. 
 - Define and evolve the technical vision for AI/ML platforms, including LLM-based applications, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows and ML model lifecycle management. 
 - Architect distributed, cloud-native systems leveraging AWS, Azure, and/or GCP - ensuring high availability, fault tolerance, observability and cost efficiency across multi cloud environments. 
 - Champion the adoption of AI-assisted development practices (e. g. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or other agentic coding tools) to accelerate engineering velocity and elevate code quality across teams. 
 - Drive the evaluation, selection and integration of open-source frameworks, libraries, and platforms to build sustainable, vendor-agnostic solutions aligned with AOT's hybrid-source philosophy. Provide hands-on technical leadership - writing production-grade code, building proof-of-concepts and prototypes, reviewing pull requests and shaping critical design decisions across multiple teams. 
 - Establish engineering excellence standards across security, performance, scalability, observability, accessibility and privacy compliance - with special focus on responsible and ethical AI practices. Mentor and grow senior engineers, tech leads and architects through coaching, design reviews, technical deep-dives and structured feedback - building a strong engineering bench. 
 - Partner with the Head of Engineering, Product and Solutions teams to align technical strategy with business outcomes, customer needs and long-term product roadmaps. 
 - Lead cross-team architectural reviews and serve as the principal authority on technical trade-offs, build-vs-buy decisions and platform standardization. 
 - Define and guide DevOps, SRE and MLOps practices - including CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, model deployment, monitoring and continuous evaluation of AI systems. 
 - Stay at the forefront of emerging trends in Generative AI, LLMs, agentic systems, and applied ML - actively bringing innovation back into AOT's products and engineering culture. 
 - Represent AOT's engineering organization in technical forums, customer conversations, open-source communities, and industry events as needed. 
 - Champion a culture of psychological safety, continuous learning, experimentation, open knowledge-sharing, and shared ownership of outcomes. 

Required Qualifications Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Experience
 - 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years in a Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer or Enterprise Architect role. 
 - Proven track record of architecting and delivering large-scale, production-grade AI/ML or data-intensive solutions in cloud environments. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and operating highly available, distributed systems serving enterprise or public sector customers. 
 - Hands-on experience leading the productionization of AI/ML workloads - including LLM-based applications, RAG systems, vector databases, prompt engineering, finetuning or agentic workflows. 

Technical Skills

- Deep expertise in scalable architecture patterns: microservices, event-driven systems, distributed computing, caching, queueing and high-throughput data pipelines. 
 - Strong proficiency across multiple cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) - including compute, storage, networking, identity, container orchestration (Kubernetes, ECS, AKS), and managed AI/ML services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI). 
 - Strong hands-on coding ability in one or more modern backend languages/frameworks such as Python, Java, Node. js or Go. 
 - Working knowledge of frontend frameworks such as React, Vue, or Angular, and the ability to reason about full-stack performance and architecture. 
 - Practical experience with AI/ML frameworks and ecosystems: PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Hugging Face, LangChain/LlamaIndex, OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock APIs, vector databases. 
 - Strong command of AI-assisted development tools and workflows (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor or any other agentic coding agents) and ability to operationalize them across an engineering organization. 
 - Solid understanding of DevOps, SRE and MLOps practices: CI/CD, IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry) and model monitoring. 
 - Deep understanding of secure coding practices, identity and access management, data privacy, accessibility and compliance frameworks relevant to enterprise and public sector software. Experience with process orchestration and workflow tools (e. g. , M8Flow, Camunda, Airflow, Temporal) is a strong plus. Leadership & Communication
 - Proven ability to lead through influence - driving alignment across engineering teams, product, design and executive stakeholders without direct reporting authority. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Strong mentorship and coaching skills, with a track record of growing senior engineers and tech leads. 
 - Skilled in agile development methodologies and iterative, customer-centric delivery. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience building and deploying agentic AI systems, multi-agent orchestration or tool-using LLM applications in production. 
 - Experience contributing to or leading open-source projects, or managing hybrid source software portfolios. 
 - Background in low-code/no-code platforms, BPMN-based process automation (e. g. , Camunda, M8Flow), or workflow orchestration products. 
 - Familiarity with government digital standards, procurement environments, and compliance regimes (e. g. , SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, FedRAMP). 
 - Exposure to responsible AI practices - bias evaluation, model governance, AI safety, and red-teaming of LLM systems. 
 - Experience presenting at conferences, publishing technical content, or contributing to industry communities around AI, cloud or software architecture. 
 - Certifications in cloud architecture (AWS/Azure/GCP) or AI engineering are an added advantage. 

Working Conditions

- Work Arrangement: This is an opportunity based out of our Trivandrum office. 
 - Travel Requirements: Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, customer engagements, industry conferences or knowledge-sharing forums. 
 - On-Call Requirements: Light on-call rotation may be required to support critical production systems, depending on operational needs. 
 - Hours of Work: Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week, with overlap with PST required as needed to collaborate with global teams. 

Living AOT's Values Our values guide how we work, collaborate, and grow as a team. Every role at AOT is expected to embody and promote these values: 

- Innovation: We pursue true innovation by solving problems and meeting unarticulated needs. Integrity: We hold ourselves to high ethical standards and never compromise. 
 - Ownership: We are all responsible for our shared long-term success. 
 - Agility: We stay ready to adapt to change and deliver results. 
 - Collaboration: We believe collaboration and knowledge-sharing fuel innovation and success. Empowerment: We support our people so they can bring the best of themselves to work every day.

The focus of this role is the platform itself - its reliability, supportability, and usability - and the standards and self-service patterns that help teams adopt it consistently. We help network owners service providers and Enterprises understand how applications perform, how users experience them, and where action is needed to improve quality, efficiency, security, and profitability. Our software combines application intelligence, experience visibility, contextual insights, and real-time control to help customers elevate observability and do more with the networks they already run. The next generation of enterprise networking and analytics products won't be built by teams that simply execute a roadmap, they will be built by engineers who combine deep technical expertise with modern AI-driven software development. At AppLogic Networks, we are looking for a Software Engineering Manager to lead the development of our high-performance data plane. This is an opportunity to build products that solve complex enterprise networking challenges while playing a direct role in shaping product strategy, technical direction, and customer success. 

We're looking for experienced engineers from organizations that build enterprise networking and analytics products, people who understand what it takes to develop software that is secure, scalable, reliable, and deployed in mission-critical enterprise environments.
