Position Overview: 

The Regional DP Quality Improvement Manager is responsible for driving service quality, process adherence and continuous improvement across the regional DP First Mile and Last Mile network. 

The role monitors end-to-end shipment lifecycle performance across Service Centres and delivery locations, identifies service-quality gaps and drives corrective actions with branch, area and regional operations teams. 

Owns regional DP quality analytics and governance across key service metrics including pickup and delivery performance, First Attempt Delivery Success, undelivered shipments, NDR, ageing, customer complaints, shipment exceptions and operational process adherence. 

The role leads the regional DP Quality Improvement team and works closely with Operations, Customer Service, Security, IT/Digital and other stakeholders to improve shipment flow, eliminate recurring defects and strengthen customer experience. 

This is primarily a quality governance, analytics and continuous improvement role, working in partnership with line Operations teams who continue to own day-to-day operational execution. 

Job Purpose: 

To continuously improve DP service quality across the regional First and Last Mile network by identifying operational defects, analysing shipment lifecycle performance, driving root-cause resolution and ensuring sustained adherence to service standards, thereby improving delivery reliability, customer experience and operational quality. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities: 

Leadership

- Lead and manage the regional DP Quality Improvement team and ensure clear ownership of quality-monitoring priorities. 
 - Build strong quality and problem-solving capability across the team. 
 - Establish regular quality-review mechanisms with regional, branch and operational teams. 
 - Drive accountability for closure of recurring service-quality gaps. 
 - Build a culture of proactive quality management rather than reactive exception resolution. 
 - Coach teams on root-cause analysis, corrective actions and sustained process improvement. 

DP Service Quality Management

- Monitor end-to-end DP shipment lifecycle across pickup, processing, movement and delivery stages. 
 - Track regional DP service-quality performance against defined organisational standards and customer commitments. 
 - Identify service failures, ageing shipments, delivery exceptions and recurring operational defects. 
 - Drive improvement in First Attempt Delivery Success and reduction in avoidable delivery failures. 
 - Monitor NDR reasons and ensure corrective action on operationally controllable causes. 
 - Review undelivered, misrouted, delayed, damaged or exception shipments and drive closure with respective teams. 
 - Identify high-defect locations, routes and operational pockets and initiate targeted improvement plans. 
 - Ensure consistency of DP service-quality standards across locations within the Region. 

Quality Analytics & Exception Management

- Analyse shipment-level and location-level quality data to identify trends, recurring defects and systemic issues. 
 - Develop regional quality dashboards and exception reports for management review. 
 - Establish proactive alerts for shipments or locations at risk of service failure. 
 - Conduct root-cause analysis on major service deviations and recurring customer-impacting issues. 
 - Track corrective and preventive actions through closure. 
 - Use data to differentiate isolated operational exceptions from structural process issues. 
 - Maintain visibility of quality performance by branch, service centre, route and relevant operational parameters. 

First & Last Mile Quality Improvement

- Partner with First Mile and Last Mile Operations teams to improve pickup and delivery quality. 
 - Review adherence to pickup and delivery processes, operational cut-offs and shipment handling standards. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve delivery attempt quality, shipment visibility and customer communication. 
 - Support improvement of address quality, delivery instructions and exception coding. 
 - Drive reduction in repeat attempts arising from avoidable operational reasons. 
 - Work with operational teams to improve route-level quality and delivery consistency. 
 - Support peak-period quality readiness and identify potential service risks before volume surges. 

Process Compliance & Standardisation

- Conduct periodic process-quality reviews across regional operating locations. 
 - Ensure adherence to defined DP SOPs, shipment handling processes and service standards. 
 - Identify deviations from standard processes and drive corrective action. 
 - Support implementation of national quality initiatives across the Region. 
 - Standardise proven quality-improvement practices across branches and Service Centres. 
 - Ensure sustained implementation through follow-up audits and control mechanisms. 
 - Support quality readiness for new facilities, routes or operating models where required. 

Customer Experience & Complaint Reduction

- Analyse DP-related customer complaints and identify underlying operational causes. 
 - Partner with Customer Service and Operations teams to reduce repeat complaints. 
 - Identify systemic customer experience issues and recommend operational solutions. 
 - Monitor complaint trends by location, failure type and root cause. 
 - Ensure major recurring service failures are addressed through structured corrective-action plans. 
 - Support improvements in delivery experience and shipment visibility. 

Continuous Improvement

- Build and maintain a regional quality-improvement pipeline focused on recurring service defects. 
 - Apply structured problem-solving methodologies such as RCA, PDCA, Pareto analysis and process mapping. 
 - Conduct field visits / Gemba reviews at locations with persistent quality gaps. 
 - Identify opportunities for process simplification, automation and preventive controls. 
 - Track measurable benefits from improvement initiatives. 
 - Institutionalise successful interventions across relevant locations to prevent recurrence. 

Technology, Data & Automation

- Use operational dashboards and shipment-level analytics to identify quality gaps and intervention priorities. 
 - Drive accurate exception coding and data discipline across operating locations. 
 - Support implementation and adoption of digital tools that improve shipment visibility and quality control. 
 - Partner with IT/Digital teams to automate recurring quality reports and exception identification. 
 - Identify opportunities for predictive / proactive quality monitoring. 
 - Ensure quality data used for decision-making is accurate, timely and actionable. 

Stakeholder & Governance

- Collaborate closely with Regional Operations, Branch Operations, First & Last Mile teams and Service Centres. 
 - Partner with Customer Service on complaint trends and customer-impacting quality issues. 
 - Coordinate with Security on shipment loss, damage and other quality exceptions wherever relevant. 
 - Work with IT/Digital teams on system or data issues impacting shipment visibility and quality. 
 - Conduct periodic DP quality reviews with regional stakeholders. 
 - Escalate structural or recurring quality risks requiring regional or national intervention. 
 - Act as the regional SME for DP service quality and continuous improvement. 

Qualifications & Experience: 

- Education: Bachelor's degree in operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Business Administration or related discipline preferred; MBA / PG qualification desirable. 
 - Experience: 5-8 years of relevant experience in express logistics, eCommerce logistics, last-mile operations, service quality, operational excellence or supply chain operations. 
 - Strong exposure to First Mile / Last Mile operations and shipment lifecycle management. 
 - Experience in analysing service-quality metrics and driving corrective actions across multiple operating locations. 
 - Understanding of delivery performance, NDR, ageing, service failures, customer complaints and operational exception management. 
 - Experience in data analysis, operational dashboards, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement. 
 - Exposure to multi-location operational governance and stakeholder management. 
 - Experience managing or coordinating quality / operational improvement teams preferred. 
 - Preferred Industries: Express Logistics, Courier, eCommerce Logistics, 3PL, Last Mile Delivery, Distribution and Supply Chain Operations. 

Skills & Capabilities: 

Technical Competencies: 

- First & Last Mile Quality Management 
 - Delivery Performance & Service Quality Analytics 
 - First Attempt Delivery / Delivery Success Management 
 - NDR & Exception Management 
 - Shipment Lifecycle Analysis 
 - Root Cause Analysis & Corrective Action 
 - Quality Audits & Process Compliance 
 - Operational Dashboards & MIS 
 - Data Analysis & Trend Identification 
 - Customer Complaint & Defect Analysis 
 - Continuous Improvement / PDCA / Lean Tools 
 - Process Standardisation & Governance 
 - Excel / BI Tools and operational reporting

Behavioural Competencies: 

- People leadership & coaching, succession planning, and change management. 
 - Data‐driven decisioning; stakeholder and supplier negotiation; execution rigor. 
 - Strong communication in English and local language(s); ability to influence cross‐functionally.

Sr. No.

data.title: Senior Staff, Embedded Software Engineer
data.description:
Description

Enphase Energy is a global energy technology company and a leading provider of solar, battery, and electric vehicle charging products. Founded in 2006, our innovative microinverter technology revolutionized solar power, making it a safer, more reliable, and scalable energy source. Today, the Enphase Energy System enables users to make, use, save, and sell their own power. Enphase is also one of the most successful and innovative clean energy companies in the world, with more than 80 million products shipped across 160 countries. 

Join our dynamic teams designing and developing next-gen energy technologies and help drive a sustainable future!

This role at Enphase requires working onsite 3 days a week, with plans to transition back to a full 5 day in office schedule over time. 

About The Role

Enphase is seeking a Senior Staff Engineer, Embedded Software to serve as a technical authority and organizational leader within our Application Development team. In this high-impact role, you will provide strategic project leadership and architect the development of mission-critical C/C++ applications that power our core energy ecosystem-including smart gateways and home energy management systems. 

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you won't just write code; you will directly lead software engineering teams, define technical roadmaps, and drive end-to-end project execution. A key part of your leadership role will be to understand, introduce, and evolve modern AI workflows into our software development lifecycle-optimizing how our engineering organization codes, tests, and delivers software. In this position, you will bridge the gap between complex energy management theory, cutting-edge development workflows, and high-performance, production-grade Linux software. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Team & Project Leadership: Direct software engineering teams through the entire development lifecycle. Define project scope, manage sprints and software delivery timelines, align engineering output with business milestones, and cultivate a high-performing software development culture. 
 - Technical Leadership & Architecture: Define the high-level architecture for embedded Linux applications, ensuring modularity, scalability, and sub-millisecond execution for power distribution logic. 
 - AI Workflow Innovation: Evaluate, integrate, and evolve modern AI tools and developer workflows (such as AI-assisted coding, automated unit test generation, and intelligent CI/CD pipelines) to accelerate team velocity and code quality. 
 - System Design: Lead the design of complex multi-threaded frameworks, IPC mechanisms, and state machines that interface across hardware drivers, networking protocols, and cloud layers. 
 - Strategic Problem Solving: Drive technical roadmaps, resolve complex architectural bottlenecks, and ensure software scalability matches evolving global grid requirements and next-generation smart-home demands. 

What You Need to Bring

- Education & Experience: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with 12+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Software Leadership: Proven track record of leading software teams and managing complex projects from conceptual architecture to high-volume production deployment. 
 - Core Software Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in C/C++ and modern software engineering practices within embedded Linux environments. 
 - Modern Developer Workflows: Deep understanding of how to leverage AI-powered development tools, workflows, and methodologies to optimize coding efficiency, automated testing, and team throughput. 
 - Systems Architecture: Deep understanding of multi-threaded application design, Inter-Process Communication (IPC), real-time operating constraints, and hardware-to-software abstraction layers. 
 - Soft Skills: Outstanding mentorship skills with a passion for growing senior engineering talent, coupled with excellent communication skills to align technical strategy with business executives.

Job Description- Manager - Flight Safety (Audit)

Designation / Role : Manager - Flight Safety (Audit)

Department : Flight Safety

Location: Gurgaon

Role Description

To support the Flight Safety function in ensuring effective safety oversight through audits, inspections, risk assessments, compliance monitoring, and safety performance management. The role will be responsible for driving adherence to regulatory requirements, supporting the Safety Management System (SMS), and promoting continuous improvement across operational safety processes. 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualification

- Graduate from a recognized university. 

Preferred Qualification

- Degree, Diploma, or Certification in Aviation, Safety Management, Quality Management, or a related discipline. 

Experience

- 7-10 years of overall experience in the aviation industry. 
 - Experience in flight safety, safety assurance, compliance monitoring, audit management, quality assurance, operational safety, or risk management functions. 
 - Hands-on experience in conducting audits, inspections, surveillance activities, and corrective action follow-ups. 
 - Exposure to Safety Management Systems (SMS), Quality Management Systems (QMS), safety performance monitoring, hazard management, and risk assessment processes. 
 - Experience in working with cross-functional stakeholders to drive regulatory compliance and safety improvement initiatives. 

Preferred Background

- Experience in Dangerous Goods (DG) regulations, compliance, or oversight. 
 - Experience in Ground Handling Operations within an airline, airport, or aviation services environment. 
 - Exposure to DGCA, ICAO, and IATA regulatory frameworks. 

Key Competencies

- Audit & Inspection Management
 - Safety Management System (SMS)
 - Quality Management System (QMS)
 - Safety Risk Assessment
 - Hazard Identification & Management
 - Safety Performance Monitoring (SPI)
 - Regulatory Compliance
 - Aviation Safety Assurance

Key Responsibilities

- Prepare and publish the annual Audit Plan. 
 - Ensure timely conduct of audits and adherence to the approved Audit Plan. 
 - Participate as a member of the audit team for conducting audits, inspections, and surveillance activities. 
 - Follow up on audit, inspection, and surveillance findings to ensure timely closure of corrective actions. 
 - Develop, review, and update audit and inspection checklists. 
 - Assist in ensuring compliance with applicable DGCA regulations and company standards. 
 - Conduct and participate in Safety Risk Assessments. 
 - Maintain risk assessment records and supporting documentation. 
 - Monitor and follow up on mitigation actions arising from risk assessments. 
 - Maintain records of hazard reports and ensure timely follow-up of corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Analyze and finalize Safety Performance Indicators (SPIs) in coordination with relevant departments. 
 - Monitor safety performance trends and provide recommendations for improvement. 
 - Support safety data analysis and reporting activities. 
 - Support the implementation and continuous improvement of the Safety Management System. 
 - Maintain safety and quality databases and records. 
 - Participate in safety review meetings and monitor closure of agreed actions. 
 - Assist in the preparation of safety meetings, presentations, bulletins, and circulars. 
 - Assist in updating Flight Safety manuals, audit checklists, circulars, and bulletins. 
 - Support Occupational Health & Safety (OHS) initiatives and compliance requirements. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives related to safety, quality, and operational excellence. 
 - Perform any other duties assigned by the Chief Flight Safety or Deputy Chiefs of Flight Safety.

data.title: Salesforce Solution/Technical Architect
data.description:
Description

Life at Ness

At Ness, people come first. Here, you'll be part of a vibrant team that values curiosity, innovation, and growth. We work with industry-leading clients on projects that truly make an impact while supporting every team member in carving out their unique career path. With resources for learning, certifications, and hands-on experiences, Ness offers you more than just a job it's a place where your ideas, ambition, and well-being matter. 

The Role

Seeking a seasoned Salesforce Development Lead to guide a team of developers while contributing hands-on to the design, development, and enhancement of Salesforce solutions. This role demands strong technical depth, leadership capability, and the ability to architect scalable, high-performing, and secure Salesforce applications across complex environments. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead a team of 3-5 Salesforce developers, ensuring high-quality delivery. 
 - Design, develop, test, and release new features, components, and managed packages. 
 - Support and troubleshoot integrations and production issues across multiple client accounts. 
 - Track development and support activities using Jira and ensure timely delivery. 
 - Partner with stakeholders to define requirements, technical approaches, and integration strategies. 
 - Enforce Salesforce development best practices, coding standards, and architectural guidelines. 
 - Drive CI/CD, version control, and deployment processes in Salesforce environments. 

Qualifications And Skills

- 5-8 years of Salesforce development experience, including at least 1 year in a technical lead capacity. 
 - Strong expertise in Salesforce architecture, data modeling, and component-based design. 
 - Proven experience leading development teams and coordinating releases. 
 - Deep knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Live Chat, and core platform capabilities. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Mandatory: Salesforce Platform Developer I certification. 
 - Preferred: One or more advanced architecture certifications (System Architect, Application Architect, Integration Architect, etc. ). 

Core Skills

- Development: Apex, LWC, Aura, Visualforce, SOQL
 - Architecture & Packaging: Managed packages (1st gen), SFDX, AppExchange
 - Integration: SOAP web services, integration patterns, middleware interactions
 - Engineering Practice: CI/CD pipelines, version control, OOP principles
 - Platforms: Sales Cloud, Live Chat Implementation

Nice to Have

- Salesforce Platform Developer II certification. 
 - JavaScript Developer I certification. 
 - Experience with AppExchange lifecycle, deployment architecture, or enterprise-scale implementations. 
 - Exposure to Agile methodologies and tools (Jira, Confluence). 

What Makes You a Great Fit

- Brings clarity and structure to complex technical requirements. 
 - Balances leadership and hands-on development with ease. 
 - Elevates team performance through mentoring and technical guidance. 
 - Approaches challenges with a solution-first, architecture-driven mindset. 
 - Champions high-quality engineering standards and scalable design. 

Why Join Us

At Ness, you will work with diverse, talented professionals who are dedicated to making an impact through technology. Identify and raise issues and risks with functional design and offer alternative solutions. Works with the Product Owner to confirm the code and acceptance tests reflect the desired functionality. Provides expertise in the solution design and functionality of business applications. Reviews and validates application technical design of team members to ensure alignment with business needs and best practice architecture principles. Analyzes and evaluates existing manual and computerized systems/procedures to improve efficiency. Researches and develops techniques for automation. Documents and implements programs according to installation standards and conventions. Analyzes and makes recommendations on the need for system backup, security, restart/recovery, balancing & controls and recommends approaches for meeting such needs. Analyzes and documents the requirements and approaches to data conversion and data modeling. Quality checks program code, related objects and documentation. Delivers working code each sprint. data.description:
Job Summary

As a Principal Software Release Engineer, you will define, own, and continuously improve the end-to-end release lifecycle for software delivered across cloud-service and storage-platform environments. You will coordinate release planning, build generation, readiness validation, change approvals, deployment execution, status reporting, and post-release follow-through while progressively replacing manual handoffs with reliable automation and clear engineering controls. 

Job Requirements

Own the end-to-end software release lifecycle, from release intake and planning through build, validation, approval, deployment, verification, and closure. 

Plan and coordinate concurrent releases across development, test, staging, and production environments, maintaining clear schedules, dependencies, milestones, owners, and decision points. 

Design, maintain, and improve CI/CD and release automation that reduces manual steps, accelerates delivery, and provides repeatable, auditable outcomes. 

Partner with development and quality teams to confirm required test coverage, regression results, performance validation, and environment readiness; escalate gaps that could compromise release quality. 

Lead response to build or deployment failures by rapidly coordinating triage, clarifying ownership, documenting the failure path, and ensuring the correct new release, hotfix, retry, rollback, or recovery workflow is initiated. 

Conduct post-release reviews and convert lessons learned into improved tooling, templates, quality gates, automation, and release policy. 

Mentor engineers and release participants on release processes, tools, quality expectations, change controls, and failure-recovery practices. 

Job Requirements

12+ years of software engineering, DevOps, build and release engineering, site reliability engineering, or production engineering experience, including technical leadership for complex, business-critical software releases. 

Demonstrated experience managing the full release lifecycle for production software or cloud services across multiple environments and teams. 

Hands-on experience with CI/CD systems, build automation, source control, branching and versioning strategies, artifact management, and deployment pipelines. 

Proficiency in one or more scripting or programming languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, Go, or similar languages used for release automation. 

Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or comparable build, release, and work-tracking platforms. 

Ability to analyze release risks using defect data, test evidence, dependencies, configuration changes, and operational impact rather than relying only on schedule readiness. 

Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to isolate build, pipeline, configuration, environment, and deployment issues under time pressure. 

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including concise executive status, detailed technical handoffs, and decision-focused escalation. 

High attention to detail, disciplined follow-through, and the ability to manage multiple releases and priorities without losing traceability or control.

data.title: Platform Engineer - Datacenter Infrastructure
data.description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation. 

Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive. 

About Us

F5 is a leading technology company dedicated to securing and optimizing applications across diverse on-premises, edge, and multi-cloud environments. We are looking for passionate individuals who are ready to help us build and scale resilient infrastructure that supports our global operations and innovative product suite. 

The Role

We are seeking a Platform Engineer to modernize and automate our virtual machine and core infrastructure services that form the backbone of our data center and hybrid-cloud environments. This role is multifaceted, focused on increasing the reliability, scalability, and security of foundational services such as DNS, PKI, logging, and observability through Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and GitOps practices, as well as scaling and executing on our VM and hypervisor management ecosystems. You will also be responsible for automating the deployment and lifecycle management of critical COTS (Commercial Off-The-Shelf) management tools. The ideal candidate has a strong background in traditional data center technologies and system engineering, combined with a passion for modern automation and platform engineering principles. 

Key Responsibilities

- Support hypervisor operations across a global datacenter footprint and provide VM management services, such as patching, backups, and monitoring through automation and at scale. 
 - Create and manage reusable Terraform modules and Ansible playbooks to ensure consistent, repeatable, and version-controlled deployments of all core services. 
 - Apply GitOps principles for managing all infrastructure and service configurations, using pull requests for changes and enabling automated reconciliation. 
 - Lead the architecture, automation, and operational management of core infrastructure services, including enterprise DNS, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and NTP. 
 - Design, build, and maintain a centralized log aggregation to feed observability platform for infrastructure and applications. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate the testing, validation, and promotion of changes to core service configurations and infrastructure. 
 - Embed security and compliance into the entire sevice lifecycle, including secret management, certificate lifecycle automation, and vulnerability scanning. 
 - Implement monitoring, alerting, and dashboards for all managed services, and apply SRE principles to improve their reliability and performance. 
 - Collaborate with network, security, and application teams to ensure seamless integration and consumption of core services. 

Required Qualifications

- +5 year experience working as a systems engineer or site reliability engineer supporting on-premise datacenter infrastructure and core infrastructure services 
 - Proficient with hypervisor technologies that support operating systems and containers (e. g. , VMware, Nutanix, Openshift) 
 - Proficient with automation and management of Windows Server and Linux VMs (eg Ubuntu, Redhat, Debian, etc) 
 - Deep hands-on experience engineering and automating core infrastructure services within a large-scale data center environment (e. g. , DNS/BIND, Active Directory Certificate Services/PKI). 
 - Experience building container platform capabilities in an on-premise ecosystem. 
 - Strong proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management tools, particularly Terraform and Ansible. 
 - Proven experience building CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure automation (e. g. , using GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar tools). 
 - Comfortable with Git-based workflows (PR reviews, branching strategies, versioning) and GitOps principles. 
 - Strong scripting and programming ability (e. g. , Python, Bash, PowerShell) to build automation, integrations, and tooling. 
 - Solid understanding of data center networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, firewalls) and security principles (least privilege, encryption, network security zones). 
 - Experience with centralized logging and observability platforms (e. g. , Splunk, Elastic Stack, LogicMonitor). 

Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with security and control frameworks such as NIST CSF, SOX, and ISO 27002. 
 - Experience working in hybrid-cloud environments and connecting on-premises services to public cloud providers (AWS, Azure). 
 - Knowledge of containerization and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with platform engineering concepts like building internal tools and APIs to improve the developer/operator experience.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer
data.description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for a Senior QA Engineer to own quality across a product area of our platform, from the user-facing web application down to the data it produces. This is a hands-on senior role: you'll set the test strategy for your area, write and maintain automation, and do the structured manual and exploratory testing that automation can't replace. Much of our product is data-processing and workflow logic, so correctness here means the right records, in the right state, with the right values, not just a page that renders. You'll verify that directly in the database, test APIs and integrations, keep test suites reliable in CI/CD, and extend quality into performance and application security. You'll work closely with developers and product, and your defect reports, test plans, and risk assessments will be clear enough that people can act on them without a follow-up conversation. 

This is a full-time position and reports directly to the VP, Data Platform. 

Preferred Location

Qualified candidates should be based in or near Kochi and able to work from our Kochi office as part of a hybrid schedule. 

Travel Requirements

Expected travel is minimal for this role. 

Essential Functions

- Own quality for an assigned product area end to end: define the test strategy, decide what to automate versus test manually, and be accountable for release readiness
 - Design, build, and maintain automated end-to-end and UI tests using a modern browser automation framework (Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, or equivalent), working directly in the product codebase
 - Plan and run structured manual and exploratory testing sessions to uncover edge cases, usability issues, and failure modes that scripted tests miss
 - Test REST APIs and service integrations using automated suites and tools such as Postman, covering contract, functional, and negative scenarios
 - Verify data-processing and workflow outcomes with SQL, writing joins across staging and production tables to confirm that pipelines produce the correct records, states, and values
 - Create, manage, and reset test data independently to support repeatable, reliable test runs
 - Integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines and keep them fast, stable, and trustworthy over time, actively addressing flaky tests and coverage gaps
 - Design and execute performance and load tests with tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or Locust, including defining realistic load profiles, analysing results, and identifying bottlenecks
 - Write precise, reproducible defect reports and clear test documentation that developers can act on immediately
 - Partner with engineering and product early in the development cycle to review requirements, identify risk, and build testability into features
 - Raise the quality bar across the team by sharing practices, reviewing test code, and mentoring others in testing approaches

Education Requirement

Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent education and work experience. 

Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills

- 5+ years in QA, with real seniority: you've owned quality for a product area, not just executed someone else's test plan
 - Solid experience testing web applications end to end, combining hands-on automation with structured manual and exploratory testing. We need both; candidates who only do one will struggle here. 
 - You write code. Proficiency in at least one automation language (TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Java or similar) and comfort working in a real codebase. 
 - Hands-on with a modern browser automation framework (Playwright, Selenium WebDriver or equivalent) and with API testing (REST clients, Postman or similar)
 - Strong SQL. Non-negotiable - you'll be writing joins across staging and production tables to verify what the pipeline produced, and building and resetting your own test data. 
 - Experience testing data-processing or workflow systems where correctness means "the right records, in the right state, with the right values" rather than "the page rendered" 
 - Experience integrating test suites into CI/CD and keeping them reliable over time
 - Performance testing with a real tool (JMeter, Gatling, Locust) - able to design a load profile, not just run one
 - Clear, precise written communication. A defect report a developer can act on without a follow-up conversation is a skill, and we value it

About Dodge Construction Network

Dodge Construction Network exists to deliver the comprehensive data and connections the construction industry needs to build thriving communities. Our legacy is deeply rooted in empowering our customers with transformative insights, igniting their journey towards unparalleled business expansion and success. We serve decision-makers who seek reliable growth and who value relationships built on trust and quality. By combining our proprietary data with cutting-edge software, we deliver to our customers the essential intelligence needed to excel within their respective landscapes. We propel the construction industry forward by transforming data into tangible guidance, driving unparalleled advancement. 

Dodge is the catalyst for modern construction.

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with:

 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective.

 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines

Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers. 

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs. 

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients' systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that's shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?

Role Summary

We are looking for a Shift Lead to run our 24/7 Operations team on a rotational basis. You will be the first point of command during your shift, owning monitoring, incident response, escalations, and handovers for Linux-based production systems. You will guide a team of operations engineers, keep services stable, and ensure incidents are resolved within SLA with clear communication to stakeholders. 

Key Responsibilities

Shift Leadership

- Lead and coordinate the shift team, assigning work and prioritising tickets, alerts, and incidents
 - Run structured shift handovers, ensuring open incidents, risks, and pending changes are clearly documented
 - Act as the escalation point for L1/L2 engineers and make timely decisions during live incidents
 - Mentor and coach team members; support onboarding, training, and skills development

Incident and Problem Management

- Monitor dashboards and alerts, triage events, and drive incidents through detection, resolution, and closure
 - Manage major incidents: coordinate bridge calls, assign roles, provide regular updates to stakeholders, and escalate to engineering or management as needed
 - Contribute to post-incident reviews and root cause analysis, and track follow-up actions to completion

Linux Operations

- Perform first- and second-line troubleshooting on Linux servers (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, Amazon Linux), covering CPU, memory, disk, network, and service issues
 - Manage users, permissions, services (systemd), cron jobs, log analysis, and package updates
 - Support patching, reboots, and routine maintenance using approved change procedures

data.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
data.description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to help modernize a legacy production system. The platform is built on Grails, Angular, and Oracle, with significant business logic in PL/SQL stored procedures. Over the coming years we'll move it to AWS, migrate off Oracle, and replace legacy components incrementally, without disrupting the users who depend on it every day. 

This isn't a rewrite-from-scratch role. You'll work in the existing system while it remains in production: read and understand logic that could be scarcely documented, prove that new code behaves like the code it replaces, and make careful, reversible changes. You'll also work on the platform's data pipeline, including ingestion, matching, deduplication, enrichment, and search, and help integrate new capabilities such as machine learning models. If you find untangling a mature system more satisfying than starting fresh, and you care about leaving clear decisions behind for the next engineer, this role is for you. 

This is a full-time position and reports directly to the VP, Data Platform. 

Preferred Location

Qualified candidates should be based in or near Kochi and able to work from our Kochi office as part of a hybrid schedule. 

Travel Requirements

Expected travel is minimal for this role. 

Essential Functions

- Own features end to end across the Angular front end and server-side stack, as primary author on either side
 - Read, document, and reason about existing PL/SQL logic, and migrate it into well-tested application code
 - Plan and carry out incremental modernization so old and new paths can be compared safely in production 
 - Write characterization tests that capture current system behavior before changes and build the test coverage the codebase lacks today
 - Build and maintain containerized services on AWS, using managed databases and proper secrets management, and diagnose your own production issues through logs and metrics
 - Develop and improve data-pipeline stages, including ingestion, matching, deduplication, enrichment, and geocoding, and the Elasticsearch/OpenSearch indexes that serve them
 - Design event-driven integrations using queue-based messaging (SQS/SNS) with appropriate delivery guarantees
 - Integrate ML model endpoints into existing pipelines in a way that is observable and safe to roll back
 - Keep the current Grails application stable and secure while it remains the production system, including upgrades and fixes
 - Write pull requests, design notes, and decision records that someone joining the team a year from now can follow
 - Work closely with product, data, and operations stakeholders to sequence the migration around business priorities and risk

Education Requirement

Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent education and work experience. 

Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills

- 8+ years building and maintaining production web applications, with substantial experience on a system you inherited rather than greenfield work
 - Genuine full-stack depth: a modern front-end framework and a server-side stack at a level where you can be the primary author on either side of a feature
 - Strong SQL, and the ability to read and reason about stored-procedure logic. You will be reading thousands of lines of PL/SQL. Oracle experience is a significant advantage; willingness and ability to work in it is required. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy code incrementally - strangler-fig, branch-by-abstraction, parallel-run, characterization tests. You can describe a migration you worked on concretely: what moved first, how equivalence was proven, what went wrong. 
 - Production AWS experience - containerized services, managed databases, secrets management, and reading logs and metrics to diagnose your own problems
 - A real testing habit. Replacing logic you can't fully see demands it, and this codebase will not protect you. 
 - Clear written communication - pull requests, design notes and decisions that make sense to someone reading them a year later

Preferred Experience, Knowledge And Skills

- Angular, especially a large application upgraded across several major versions
 - Grails or Groovy, or another JVM framework of that generation - enough to work safely in it while it is still the production system
 - Experience re-platforming off Oracle (e. g. to PostgreSQL/Aurora), including moving 
 - stored-procedure logic into application code
 - Data-pipeline/ETL work; ingestion, matching, deduplication, enrichment, geocoding. 
 - Elasticsearch or OpenSearch in production
 - Python, and event-driven integration patterns - queue-based egress (SQS/SNS or equivalent) and the delivery guarantees that come with it
 - Experience integrating an ML model endpoint into an existing pipeline

About Dodge Construction Network

Dodge Construction Network exists to deliver the comprehensive data and connections the construction industry needs to build thriving communities. Our legacy is deeply rooted in empowering our customers with transformative insights, igniting their journey towards unparalleled business expansion and success. We serve decision-makers who seek reliable growth and who value relationships built on trust and quality. By combining our proprietary data with cutting-edge software, we deliver to our customers the essential intelligence needed to excel within their respective landscapes. We propel the construction industry forward by transforming data into tangible guidance, driving unparalleled advancement. 

Dodge is the catalyst for modern construction.

About Us

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we're on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We're looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team. 

What You'll Do

An experienced individual contributor within P&CSE, the Senior RF Systems Engineer delivers complex hands-on technical work across the satellite ground station engineering lifecycle with a high degree of autonomy. This is a purely technical role with no people management responsibilities and no direct reports. The postholder designs, integrates, and tests earth station RF systems; contributes to DiFi (VITA 49) and RFoIP programmes; deploys cloud-based (AWS / GCP) signal processing workloads; maintains DevOps pipelines and IaC modules; and applies AI tools to engineering workflows. The role includes participation in the P&CSE oncall rota. Candidates must be willing and able to fulfil this requirement as a condition of employment. 

The day-to-day

- Perform detailed RF system design and analysis: link budgets, G/T, EIRP, linearity, antenna system characterisation across L/S/C/Ku/Ka/Q/V bands. 
 - Plan, execute, and document FAT, SAT, and IOT test campaigns for new and upgraded earth station RF systems. 
 - Contribute to DiFi (VITA 49) digitiser chain design, validation, and interoperability testing. 
 - Contribute to RFoIP encapsulation, QoS, PTP synchronisation, and SDR modem integration activities. 
 - Develop and maintain CI/CD pipeline stages, IaC modules (Ansible/Terraform), and automated RF test scripts. 
 - Deploy and support containerised RF signal processing workloads on AWS EKS or GCP GKE. 
 - Contribute to cloud RF data pipelines using AWS Kinesis / GCP Pub/Sub and post-pass analysis via Athena / BigQuery. 
 - Apply AI/ML tools to engineering workflows: LLMs for documentation, anomaly detection on RF telemetry, AI-assisted simulation. 
 - Provide third-line RF support to Operations and NOC, including on-call rota participation. 
 - Produce and maintain engineering documentation (ICDs, test plans, acceptance reports) to P&CSE quality standards. 
 - Travel to earth station sites and supplier facilities as required by programme activities. 

What You'll Need

- 8-12 years ground station system design, integration, and test experience. 
 - Degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering or Telecommunications. 
 - Proven hands-on RF expertise across multiple frequency bands with strong link budget and test skills. 
 - Working knowledge of DiFi/VITA 49, RFoIP, DevOps CI/CD, AWS/GCP, and AI engineering tools. 
 - Seeking a technical individual contributor role with no people management responsibility. 

What Will Help You On The Job

- Fully available for P&CSE on-call rota and international travel. Based in or able to commute to London.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer - Network Protocols & Data Plane
data.description:
Vectra® is the leader in AI-driven threat detection and response for hybrid and multi-cloud enterprises. 

The Vectra AI Platform delivers integrated signal across public cloud, SaaS, identity, and data center networks in a single platform. Powered by patented Attack Signal Intelligence, it empowers security teams to rapidly prioritize, investigate and respond to the most advanced cyber-attacks. With 35 patents in AI-driven threat detection and the most vendor references in MITRE D3FEND, organizations worldwide rely on the Vectra AI to move at the speed and scale of hybrid attackers. For more information, visit www. vectra. ai. 

Position Overview

Vectra is looking for senior, AI-forward engineers to help expand and modernize our network data plane. This team builds the high-performance systems that ingest, process, parse, enrich, and deliver network metadata used by our detection, investigation, and response platform. 

This role sits at the center of Vectra's packet-processing architecture. You will work on the systems that receive network traffic, steer it through the right processing paths, extract meaningful protocol metadata, and deliver that data reliably through the platform at production scale. Protocol parsing is a major part of the mission, but the broader opportunity is to help shape a scalable data plane that can support more protocols, higher throughput, better validation, and faster delivery over time. 

The work requires systems engineering depth, hands-on networking experience, and comfort operating close to Linux, packet capture, hardware constraints, and performance limits. We are looking for engineers who can operate independently, use modern AI-assisted development tools effectively, and help build a repeatable engine for delivering data-plane capabilities with strong validation, test coverage, performance discipline, and operational reliability. 

Responsibilities

- Design, implement, test, and maintain core network data-plane capabilities, including packet processing, protocol parsing, metadata extraction, and downstream delivery. 
 - Improve scalable network data-path architecture on Linux, including packet ingestion, traffic steering, parser execution, metadata modeling, and downstream delivery. 
 - Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to accelerate investigation, implementation, test generation, and code review while maintaining engineering rigor. 
 - Work across parsing, serialization, metadata modeling, validation, performance, and downstream platform integration. 
 - Build feedback loops and test harnesses that validate data-plane behavior end-to-end, not just in isolated parser tests. 
 - Diagnose correctness, performance, memory, concurrency, and reliability issues in complex packet-processing systems. 
 - Collaborate with Product, Security Research, Data Science, and engineering teams to turn customer and platform needs into concrete technical outcomes. 
 - Contribute to technical direction, design reviews, and engineering standards for network data-plane development. 
 - For Staff-level candidates: lead data-plane designs, make major architectural tradeoffs clear, mentor engineers, establish repeatable engineering practices, and help grow durable technical ownership within the India team. 

Requirements

- 10+ years or equivalent technical leadership. 
 - 5+ years of production C++ experience in systems, infrastructure, networking, or similarly performance-sensitive environments. 
 - Meaningful Rust experience or demonstrated ability to build production-quality systems in Rust or another memory-safe systems language. 
 - Strong Python coding, debugging, automation, and code review experience. 
 - Experience developing and debugging software on Debian-based Linux or similar Linux environments. 
 - Hands-on protocol experience, including inspecting packet captures, using Wireshark or equivalent tools, and implementing or debugging parsing and serialization logic. 
 - Experience with substantial data-path technologies such as DPDK, XDP/AF_XDP, kernel-bypass networking, high-performance packet capture, or equivalent systems. 
 - Understanding of NIC queues, RSS, tunneling, offloads, routing, traffic steering, and the practical constraints of packet-processing hardware. 
 - Systems programming depth across Linux networking internals, allocators and memory ownership, data structures, concurrency, CPU/cache behavior, and performance diagnosis. 
 - Experience building reliable, maintainable systems where correctness, throughput, latency, and operational reliability all matter. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot complex systems using measurement, logs, traces, packet captures, profiling, and careful reasoning. 
 - Ownership mindset: able to take a problem, clarify ambiguity, make tradeoffs visible, and drive it to completion. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills across distributed teams. 

Preferred

- Experience building protocol parsers, packet-processing systems, network telemetry systems, or high-throughput data pipelines. 
 - Experience with parser validation, fuzzing, golden datasets, packet replay frameworks, or property-based testing. 
 - Familiarity with DPDK, Linux networking internals, eBPF, XDP/AF_XDP, Suricata, Zeek, or similar systems. 
 - Experience tuning systems across CPU, memory, NUMA, storage, and network boundaries. 
 - Experience designing schemas or metadata models consumed by downstream analytics, search, detection, or investigation workflows. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, Jenkins or similar systems, and Git-based development workflows. 
 - Prior Staff+ ownership of a critical production data path or distributed systems component. 

What We're Looking For

The strongest candidates will be hands-on builders who are energized by hard systems problems. They should be comfortable moving fast, but not casually; quality, testability, maintainability, and performance all matter. We are especially interested in engineers who already use AI tools as part of their development workflow and can explain how they use them responsibly to improve speed, coverage, and understanding. 

For Staff-level candidates, we are looking for engineers who can shape technical direction and raise the execution level of the team around them. Staff engineers should be able to lead domain designs, write clear architectural proposals, guide major technical tradeoffs through Vectra's architecture process, raise engineering standards, mentor others, and help establish durable data-plane ownership in India. 

Education

B. S. , M. S. , or Ph. D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 

Vectra provides a comprehensive total rewards package that supports the financial, physical, mental and overall health of our employees and their families. Compensation includes competitive base pay, incentive plan eligibility, and participation in the employee equity plan (stock options). Specific benefits offered varies by location, but commonly include health care insurance, income protection / life insurance, access to retirement savings plans, behavioral & emotional wellness services, generous time away from work, and a comprehensive employee recognition program. 

Vectra is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. 

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Job Summary

As a Principal Software Release Engineer, you will define, own, and continuously improve the end-to-end release lifecycle for software delivered across cloud-service and storage-platform environments. You will coordinate release planning, build generation, readiness validation, change approvals, deployment execution, status reporting, and post-release follow-through while progressively replacing manual handoffs with reliable automation and clear engineering controls. 

Job Requirements

Own the end-to-end software release lifecycle, from release intake and planning through build, validation, approval, deployment, verification, and closure. 

Plan and coordinate concurrent releases across development, test, staging, and production environments, maintaining clear schedules, dependencies, milestones, owners, and decision points. 

Design, maintain, and improve CI/CD and release automation that reduces manual steps, accelerates delivery, and provides repeatable, auditable outcomes. 

Partner with development and quality teams to confirm required test coverage, regression results, performance validation, and environment readiness; escalate gaps that could compromise release quality. 

Lead response to build or deployment failures by rapidly coordinating triage, clarifying ownership, documenting the failure path, and ensuring the correct new release, hotfix, retry, rollback, or recovery workflow is initiated. 

Conduct post-release reviews and convert lessons learned into improved tooling, templates, quality gates, automation, and release policy. 

Mentor engineers and release participants on release processes, tools, quality expectations, change controls, and failure-recovery practices.

12+ years of software engineering, DevOps, build and release engineering, site reliability engineering, or production engineering experience, including technical leadership for complex, business-critical software releases.

Hands-on experience with CI/CD systems, build automation, source control, branching and versioning strategies, artifact management, and deployment pipelines. 

Proficiency in one or more scripting or programming languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, Go, or similar languages used for release automation. 

Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or comparable build, release, and work-tracking platforms. 

Ability to analyze release risks using defect data, test evidence, dependencies, configuration changes, and operational impact rather than relying only on schedule readiness.

data.title: AVP / VP – Product & Technology Innovation
data.description:
For the position of AVP / VP - Product Technology Innovation

Location: Mumbai/Bangalore

Reports to: Chief Technology Officer

Works closely with: CEO, Marketing, Business Heads (BFSI, IAM, e‐Gov, Retail, Industrial Automation, Smart Manufacturing, ESS)

Being the AVP / VP - Product Technology Innovation for Group company, you will be responsible for

Owning discovery, product strategy and early‐stage R D for new solution and platform plays in biometric IAM, IoT/edge and ESS, from concept to validated proto/pilots. Drive IP and patent creation while shaping GTM narratives; hand over scaled execution to engineering and delivery teams. 

The Opportunity

This role provides a unique opportunity to shape Evolute's next-generation product platforms and innovation agenda, create defensible IP and convert emerging technologies into scalable solution platforms that drive new revenue streams across BFSI, IAM, e-Gov, Retail, Industrial Automation, Smart Manufacturing and ESS domains. The role reports into the CTO and works in close collaboration with the CEO, Marketing leadership and Business Heads across BFSI, IAM, e-Gov, Retail, Industrial Automation, Smart Manufacturing and ESS. 

Key Responsibilities Include

- Product platform strategy (0→1)
 - Define product vision and platform roadmaps for biometric IAM, IoT devices/platforms and ESS solutions across BFSI, e‐Governance, Retail, and Industrial/Smart Manufacturing segments. 
 - Identify high‐value problems and use‐cases with business heads and key customers, translate them into product hypotheses and experiment backlogs. 
 - Shape solution blueprints (hardware, firmware, cloud, analytics) that extend your current embedded‐hardware strength into full solutions and platforms. 
 - Deliver a targeted number of validated platform concepts taken to pilot per year. 
 - Drive adoption of new platforms across customer deals, increasing the share of platform-led solutions vs bespoke hardware-only solutions. 
 - Research, feasibility and IP
 - Lead deep‐tech feasibility for new bets in AI/ML, biometrics, security, IoT/edge and ESS controls, balancing "Can we?" with "Should we build it?" from a commercial lens. 
 - Run structured PoCs and lab prototypes; define clear go/no‐go criteria and success metrics before scaling. 
 - Drive an IP pipeline around algorithms, architectures, and control schemes, coordinate invention disclosures, patentability checks, and filings with external counsel. 
 - Build a measurable IP funnel tracked through invention disclosures, patent filings and patents granted. 
 - Go‐to‐market design (without full delivery ownership)
 - Craft positioning, value propositions, and solution narratives for each platform in partnership with Marketing and Sales. 
 - Define reference architectures, pricing logic and deployment models (on‐prem/edge/cloud, OEM/white‐label, managed service) for pilots and first‐wave customers. 
 - Support selected lighthouse deals with domain/solution expertise and proof‐points from pilots; hand execution to engineering and delivery once patterns are validated. 
 - Create a measurable new product/platform revenue pipeline from pilots and lighthouse deals. 
 - Proto and pilot ownership (no BAU delivery)
 - Own the lifecycle from idea → lab prototype → limited customer pilots; ensure designs are secure‐by‐design and manufacturable. 
 - Work with Engineering Head to define clear handover criteria from pilot to scale (architecture baselines, backlog, documentation, non‐functional requirements). 
 - Stay involved post‐handover only as "platform owner" for roadmap and major architectural decisions, not day‐to‐day project management. 
 - Collective decision‐making and governance
 - Run regular innovation/roadmap councils with CTO, CEO, Marketing and business heads to choose which bets to start, stop or scale. 
 - Maintain a simple portfolio view of innovation bets (stage, TRL, expected impact, risk) to guide investment decisions. 
 - Ensure compliance with biometric, KYC/AML, e‐Gov and IoT/ESS security guidelines in all concepts and prototypes. 
 - Track portfolio performance through pilot throughput, revenue pipeline, IP outcomes and platform adoption metrics. 

To qualify for the role, you must have -

- 10-15+ years across product, R D or platform roles in deep‐tech / embedded / IoT / ESS domains, with strong exposure to BFSI/IAM/e‐Gov and/or industrial/energy sectors. 
 - Proven 0→1 experience: has taken deep‐tech products from concept to successful pilots or early commercial rollout. 
 - Demonstrated IP orientation (patents filed/granted, or platforms with defensible technical moats). 
 - Strong systems thinking (hardware-firmware-cloud-data), excellent stakeholder facilitation with CXO and business heads, and comfort working in an MSME/startup environment. 

Key attributes for success -

- Strategic thinking with strong commercial orientation. 
 - Ability to influence CXOs and business heads and drive cross-functional alignment. 
 - High ownership mindset with comfort in ambiguity and early-stage problem spaces. 
 - Strong governance, prioritization and decision-making capability for innovation portfolios. 

You will earn brownie points if you have -

- Patents filed/granted or demonstrable IP-led platforms with defensible technical moats. 
 - Experience working in MSME/startup or 0→1 innovation environments. 
 - Prior exposure to lighthouse customer pilots and early GTM motions for new platforms. 

Qualifications

10-15+ years across product, R D or platform roles in deep‐tech / embedded / IoT / ESS domains, with strong exposure to BFSI/IAM/e‐Gov and/or industrial/energy sectors.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer, Tech Foundations
data.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 

The Community You Will Join

The CRM Engineering team builds world-class tools that drive growth and foster meaningful relationships between Airbnb and its community, including Hosts, Guests, Law Enforcement, Government Regulators, Local Community Leaders, and more. This team tackles some of the most challenging and unique problems faced by our business. Here are a few examples: 

- Growth Platform: Designed to increase supply and retain existing hosts. 
 - Policy Platform: Enables Airbnb to engage with regulatory bodies across the globe regarding short-term rental regulations. This platform tracks regulations that impact the Airbnb business and provides intelligence to address unique business challenges. 
 - Community Platform: Establishes a social platform to drive community enablement, collaboration, and success. 
 - Agent Tools: Empowers agents to understand and resolve issues that customers are unable to address on their own. 
 - Aircover Claims Platform: Facilitates the processing of claims for Aircover insurance products, offering protection to both hosts and guests. 

The Difference You Will Make

Our team is building an AI driven growth platform to serve as a true growth engine for Airbnb's supply expansion. This platform will leverage AI-driven intelligence to provide sales insights, meet diverse supply needs, help current hosts achieve greater success on the Airbnb platform, and build lead funnels to attract more high-quality hosts to Airbnb. 

There is immense potential for AI-driven initiatives to revolutionize the supply funnel at Airbnb. This role presents an exciting opportunity to create a unique and impactful platform that addresses complex business challenges. 

In this position, you will closely collaborate with and influence stakeholders across technical, business, product, and design teams to identify, scope, and deliver critical initiatives. As you lead efforts across these stakeholders and work with a distributed team of engineers, you will also actively contribute to prototyping, evaluating, and implementing solutions. This is your chance to make a lasting impact on Airbnb's growth trajectory and technology landscape!

A Typical Day

- Design the future state of our technical systems by combining a strategic understanding of our highest level product goals with a deep understanding of our existing systems to inform the right technical and product tradeoffs for both short and long term
 - Lead engineers-both inside and outside your immediate team; in building out these technical solutions
 - Participate in the development of product and UX requirements by engaging early and often with designers, product managers and other stakeholders to help steer teams on the most efficient path towards overall goals
 - Nurture a culture of technical quality from design, through code review, to production operations
 - Mentor other engineers in developing their technical and collaboration skills
 - Identify and propose solutions to problems coming in the way of technical and product engineering excellence
 - Collaborate with internal teams across the tech community, Hosting, Guest and Mobile and data engineering. 

Your Expertise

- 10+ years of relevant software development industry experience in a fast-paced tech environment
 - Strong proficiency in at least one major backend programming language (e. g. , Java, Kotlin, Scala, Python) and experience with modern frontend frameworks (e. g. , React, Angular, Vue. js)
 - Proven track record of delivering end-to-end products in a collaborative environment, from ideation and planning to implementation and launch
 - Experience with architectural patterns of large-scale web applications, including well-designed APIs, high-volume data pipelines, and efficient algorithms
 - Demonstrated ability to make data-driven decisions, articulate technical trade-offs, and communicate effectively with cross-functional partners
 - Passion for creating intuitive user experiences and a keen interest in data systems and analytics
 - Good judgment in making tradeoffs to balance short-term business needs with long-term technical quality
 - Strong understanding of how deep backend systems are expressed in the UX shown to customers
 - End-to-end mentality that transcends team boundaries and helps find globally optimal solutions
 - Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team and with teams across the engineering organization
 - Passionate about efficiency, availability, system quality and user experience
 - Passionate about building AI-driven applications that deliver innovative and impactful solutions

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. 

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb's hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb's Career's Page at careers. airbnb. com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb. com or @ext. airbnb. com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We'll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

data.title: Platform Software and Validation Engineer
data.description:
Navii is an AI recruiter, running this search on behalf of Proxelera. 

HERE'S HOW IT WORKS

Rather than your resume sitting in a queue, you have a conversation with Navii about your experience and what you want next. What you say reaches Proxelera's hiring team in your own words. It is a required step, and there is nothing to schedule. 

NEXT STEP

A conversation with Navii about this role: 

https: //app. heynavii. ai/careers/platform-software-and-validation-engineer-e5d1735c

ABOUT PROXELERA

Proxelera does end-to-end chip design from India, specification through silicon. Most chip companies use their India centres for validation or one slice of the process. Proxelera was built on the opposite idea: the whole system, owned ground up, in country. Over 190 engineers across the Bengaluru and Mysuru design centres, working on AI, DSP, AMS and wireless networking silicon. 

THE ROLE

You will build the software that makes Proxelera's AI chips and networking silicon usable: BIOS, UEFI, firmware, Linux kernel and drivers, all against real hardware. 

Also a fit if you call yourself: Firmware Engineer, Systems Software Engineer, Validation Engineer. 

THE WORK

• Own development and validation of BIOS, UEFI and firmware, making sure the chips perform in real-world conditions. 

• Work closely with hardware engineers to debug and validate software on actual hardware, with limited visibility. 

• Drive test automation and tooling that makes future failures easier to diagnose. 

• Take on post-silicon validation and bring-up, directly affecting product performance and reliability. 

• Make the call on whether a failure belongs to your layer, which takes a real understanding of the stack. 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

• Strong C and data structures, in systems that run on real hardware. 

• Experience debugging on hardware with limited visibility, using JTAG, trace and crash dumps. 

• Solid command of one layer of the stack, whether firmware, kernel and drivers, or platform validation. 

• Python or shell scripting for automation, with a focus on making failures reproducible. 

EVEN BETTER IF

• You have contributed upstream or have a public patch trail, particularly in BIOS, UEFI or graphics drivers. 

• You are familiar with protocols and interfaces such as I2C, SPI, PCIe and USB. 

• You have done customer-facing debugging and been the point of contact during critical failures. 

WHO THRIVES HERE

• You like hard problems and a hands-on environment where you directly influence product outcomes. 

• You work well across teams, where communication matters as much as the technical call. 

• You are comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-moving, evolving stack. 

THE TEAM

You will join over 190 engineers across Bengaluru and Mysuru, working across functions to drive projects from specification through to silicon. 

COMPENSATION AND LOGISTICS

Full-time, on-site five days a week, Bengaluru or Hyderabad. The hiring team will share compensation details directly. Benefits include health insurance, paid time off and professional development support.
