data.title: Manager-Financial Systems
data.description:
Job Description

The Regulatory Reporting Quality Assurance (RRQA) team is responsible for providing governance and oversight of AMEX's regulatory reporting processes, with a focus on proactively identifying risks and control improvement opportunities to ensure reports remain accurate, complete, and compliant. This is achieved through Quality Assurance reviews, which include the following pillars: 

- Process and controls testing
 - Validation of reported data against regulatory instructions
 - Detailed analysis and testing of underlying data to ensure data quality. 

This work is increasingly enabled by continuous monitoring and advanced analytics to enhance risk identification and coverage. The team partners closely with Regulatory Report owners, Technology, Data Governance, and other stakeholders to strengthen the control environment, drive timely remediation, and evolve capabilities through the use of innovative tools, including emerging analytics and GenAI solutions. 

Responsibilities

Participate as a key member of the RRQA Analytics & Insights team by leading the identification, prioritization, development, and implementation of analytics that strengthen the Regulatory Reporting Quality Assurance (RRQA) program. A QA Manager - Analytics & Insights will help shape the team's analytics strategy while remaining actively engaged in the design and development of high-value analytical solutions. This role will elevate the team's analytics capabilities by leveraging data, emerging technologies (e. g. , GenAI), and innovative approaches to deliver proactive insights and improve quality assurance effectiveness. 

Responsibilities

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of financial services processes, system infrastructure, and risk and control frameworks, along with demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, and leadership skills. Specific responsibilities include: 

- Identify and prioritize regulatory reporting risk and control areas where analytics can enhance QA effectiveness, improve testing coverage, and advance overall program maturity. 
 - Partner with QA leadership and business stakeholders to translate strategic priorities, business risks, controls, and data into a prioritized analytics roadmap and actionable requirements. 
 - Lead the design and development of complex analytics while providing technical guidance and oversight for analytics developed by team members. 
 - Drive the delivery of analytics that generate impactful, forward-looking insights and enable more proactive, risk-based quality assurance. 
 - Establish and promote analytics best practices, development standards, documentation, and governance to ensure solutions are scalable, sustainable, and well controlled. 
 - Evaluate the effectiveness and business impact of analytics initiatives, identifying opportunities to enhance testing efficiency, automate manual activities, and strengthen QA outcomes. 
 - Assess and incorporate emerging technologies, advanced analytics techniques, and GenAI capabilities to continuously evolve the team's analytical capabilities and drive innovation. 
 - Build strong partnerships with regulatory reporting, technology, data governance, service management, and other stakeholders to influence priorities, facilitate data access, and promote adoption of analytics solutions. 
 - Lead, coach, and develop team members by fostering analytical thinking, technical capabilities, and a culture of continuous learning and innovation. 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

- 3+ years of relevant experience in quality assurance, audit, risk management, technology, and/or data analytics within financial services
 - Experience applying data analytics to support quality assurance, audit, risk management, and/or financial services. 
 - Hands-on experience with data visualization and business intelligence tools (e. g. , Tableau, Power BI, or similar). 
 - Ability to translate business objectives, risks, controls, and processes into analytical requirements and actionable insights. 
 - Experience partnering with business and technology stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver data-driven solutions. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex issues and recommend practical, actionable solutions. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly communicate analytical findings and complex quantitative information to a variety of audiences. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. 
 - Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or other relevant field (e. g. , Analytics, Finance, Accounting, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems). 

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of relevant experience in quality assurance, audit, risk management, technology, and/or data analytics within financial services. 
 - 3+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and implementing analytics that support quality assurance, audit, risk management, regulatory reporting, or other financial services functions. 
 - Experience with programming and data querying languages such as SQL, Python, or similar. 
 - Experience developing scalable analytics, dashboards, automated reporting, and/or continuous monitoring solutions. 
 - Familiarity with emerging technologies (e. g. , GenAI) and their application to data analytics, quality assurance, and risk management. 
 - Demonstrated ability to identify analytical opportunities, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-impact solutions in a dynamic, evolving environment. 
 - Experience leading analytics initiatives or cross-functional projects, including coordinating stakeholders and developing team members. 
 - Advanced degree in a quantitative or related field
 - Relevant professional certifications (e. g. , CPA, CIA, CISA, CAP, or analytics/technology-focused equivalents)

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service. 

As part of Team Amex, you'll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express. 

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally: 

- Competitive base salaries
 - Bonus incentives
 - Support for financial-well-being and retirement
 - Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
 - Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
 - Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
 - Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
 - Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
 - Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law. 

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

data.title: QA Automation Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Role Overview: 

We are looking for a strong, hands-on, highly motivated QA Automation Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of the Service Layer (SL-QTC) platform supporting Quote-to-Cash (QTC), customer lifecycle, and enterprise integration workloads. 

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining automation frameworks and quality engineering practices for a cloud-native, event-driven platform built on AWS, Kafka/MSK, APIs, databases, and distributed microservices. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Architecture, and DevOps teams to ensure robust test coverage, early defect detection, and high-quality releases. 

The ideal candidate combines strong automation expertise with experience testing distributed systems, event-driven architectures, cloud-native applications, APIs, and complex enterprise integrations. 

Key responsibilities: 

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for APIs, microservices, event-driven workflows, and cloud-native applications. 
 - Develop automated functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, and data validation test suites for Service Layer integrations and Quote-to-Cash business processes. 
 - Validate Kafka/MSK event flows, message transformations, canonical data models, database transactions, and downstream system integrations. 
 - Implement automated API testing, contract testing, service virtualization, and integration testing across enterprise applications and services. 
 - Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and collaborate with Engineering and DevOps teams to enable continuous quality and shift-left testing practices. 
 - Perform non-functional testing including performance, reliability, resiliency, and scalability testing of distributed systems. 
 - Develop automated data validation and reconciliation testing across PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, DynamoDB, and other platform data stores. 
 - Analyze defects, troubleshoot complex issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive quality improvements across the platform. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define test strategies, quality standards, release readiness criteria, and engineering best practices. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of automation frameworks, test coverage, quality metrics, and release processes. 

Must Have Skills: 

- Strong experience designing and developing test automation frameworks using Java, Python, TypeScript, or similar programming languages. 
 - Strong experience with API automation testing using tools and frameworks such as REST Assured, Postman, Karate, PyTest, Selenium, Playwright, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Strong experience testing microservices, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures, including Kafka, AWS MSK, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging platforms. 
 - Strong experience validating REST APIs, asynchronous workflows, message queues, data transformations, and enterprise integrations. 
 - Strong experience with PostgreSQL, relational databases, NoSQL databases, and data validation techniques, including query development and database testing. 
 - Experience implementing CI/CD-integrated test automation using GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Experience with AWS cloud services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, SQS, SNS, CloudWatch, and serverless application testing. 
 - Experience with performance, load, reliability, and resiliency testing using tools such as JMeter, K6, Gatling, or equivalent solutions. 
 - Experience with test reporting, observability, and quality metrics using tools such as Allure, Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, ClickHouse, or similar platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of quality engineering principles, test strategy, test design, defect management, root cause analysis, and agile testing practices. 

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline. 
 - 7+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance, Test Automation, or Quality Engineering roles. 
 - 4+ years of experience developing and maintaining automated testing solutions for enterprise applications and APIs. 
 - Experience testing cloud-native, distributed, and event-driven systems in production-scale environments. 
 - Experience working in Agile delivery environments with cross-functional engineering teams. 

Nice to have: 

- ISTQB, Certified Agile Tester, AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, or equivalent certifications. 
 - Experience implementing shift-left testing, test quality metrics, and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience testing Salesforce, Oracle ERP, OIC, ORMB, or enterprise integration platforms. 
 - Experience validating Kafka/MSK event streams, schema evolution, message contracts, and event orchestration workflows.

data.title: Engineering Manager (Chemical Engineer)
data.description:
Job Purpose

JOB DESCRIPTION

People Leader, accountable for providing leadership for Process Engineers within the Engineering & Process Technology group through creating shared vision & values, developing and utilising talent and driving performance. Leads and directs programs with the objective to enhance engineering productivity and efficiency. 

Responsibilities

Principal accountabilities

Leadership

Manage EHS through management of change, behavioural safety and ensuring a safe work environment and compliant with Business and Group operating standards, procedures and systems. 

Drive results through aligning the team with business strategy and goals, establishing clear standards of engineering excellence, and setting clear direction and accountabilities through performance management whilst providing balanced feedback at the most critical times to maintain momentum and a strong sense of ownership. 

Act as a change agent, lead, support and contribute to change programmes, driving and championing the implementation, gaining acceptance to enable an agile and engaged team. 

Feed into workforce plans to ensure the right resourcing requirements for current and future business needs. This includes understanding current and future capability needs and addressing those through development interventions. 

Lead succession planning to ensure a strong talent pipeline and to mitigate critical skills gaps. 

Inspire growth through career conversations, developing talent and ensuring the team has the skills and experiences to deliver, develop and progress careers within JM - Honeywell. 

Ensure all team members have up to date Personal Development Plans, which are reviewed on a regular basis and provide input into training planning to ensure team members have access to relevant and appropriate training opportunities. 

Provide input to Engineering resource planning to ensure developmental objectives are known and addressed. 

Support team development and ensure team are appropriately aligned to the technical career path based on their capability and business need. Provide input to the Grade Review Process. 

Responsible for allocating resource to basic engineering/development projects according to business demands. 

Instil trust and value differences, generating confidence and safety with others through openness and authenticity, modelling high standards of honesty, transparency and integrity whilst promoting a team environment that values, encourages, and supports differences. 

Develop employee engagement strategy for the team to motivate and drive engagement. 

Facilitate collaboration with shared values for engineering to partner across teams and functions to create high performing teams to achieve common goals. 

Provide input and recommendations on reward and benefits processes for team e. g. annual review. 

Carry out people and business processes within HR and Business systems (e. g. Workday process initiation, leave & expense approvals, etc). 

In conjunction with other Engineering Managers, establish and maintain engineering capability across CT's offices. 

Execution & Delivery (Program Management)

Maintain and enhance the capabilities and productivity within the Engineering & Process Technology function. 

Initiate and lead major transformation projects to scale and grow engineering capacity and capability for the organization. 

Deputise for the Engineering Management Director, as required. 

Drive L&D/training requirements and transition into an Engineering Academy. 

- Monitor and assess the training requirements of new starters and current engineering staff. 
 - Developing training programs to address training needs. 
 - Identify training themes to address and initiate the preparation and presentation of courses with the objective of building a library of training material (recorded presentation, how-to guides, interactive training tools, etc) that support the engineering functions. 
 - Identify internal and external training providers working alongside Learning and Development. 
Recruitment / Onboarding

- Responsible for recruitment of permanent and contingent engineering staff. Manage relationships with engineering service providers. 
 - Work with the Talent Acquisition team to develop recruitment campaigns to attract new hires. 
 - Set the standard for competencies and capabilities required for new hires, and methodology for assessment. 
 - Review CVs, interview candidates and recommend outcomes. 
Engineering Tasks

- Approve BEP engineering documentation as required. 
 - Approve basic engineering package execution strategy and engineering hour estimation. 
 - Ensure procedures are reviewed and updated as required. 
 - Identify and prepare new procedures/guidance as required by Engineering. 
 - Identify improvements to Engineering tools and methodologies, implementing improvement programs as required. 
 - Support Lead Engineers in project execution. 
To take on any other duties which are within the employee's skills and abilities whenever reasonably instructed. 

Scope

Primary interactions are within CT E&PT Leadership team and CT's engineering service providers. 

Planning horizon 1-3 months tactical, 3-36 months for S&OP process resourcing, 5 years for strategic engineering footprint. 

People leadership & development. 

Special factors

Geography global. 

Up to 25% international and domestic travel on average can be expected. 

Flex work patterns to accommodate working across different time zones, when required. 

Qualifications

Person specification

This describes what is required to do the job, it may not describe the current job holder but should describe the typical attributes or traits needed for success in the position. 

Qualifications/ Knowledge/ Experience

Degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent experience

Understanding of technology development, engineering and licencing

Member of a recognised Professional Institution

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world's most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50, 000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy.

data.title: Embedded and Project Team Lead
data.description:
About Job Profile

Experience: 8+ yrs

Salary: As per industry norms

Location: R&I Park, IIT Delhi

Description: CLUIX is seeking a high-caliber Embedded and Project Team Lead to head embedded firmware development and oversee end-to-end hardware-software engineering projects. In this hybrid technical and project management role, you will architect robust, low-power embedded systems for our precision water testing devices, lead a multidisciplinary engineering team, and manage product delivery timelines from prototype to mass production. 

About The Role

- Lead and mentor the embedded firmware and IoT engineering team, setting architecture standards, code quality benchmarks, and sprint goals. 
 - Manage cross-functional engineering project delivery, coordinating electronics, firmware, mechanical design, chemistry R&D, and QA. 
 - Architect, develop, and review production-grade firmware in C/C++ on ARM Cortex microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, etc. ) and RTOS. 
 - Define hardware-software interface specifications, sensor data acquisition algorithms, power management logic, and wireless telemetry (BLE, Wi-Fi, 4G-LTE/NB-IoT). 
 - Manage engineering project roadmaps, sprint planning, Gantt charts, risk matrices, and bill of materials (BOM) readiness. 
 - Oversee hardware board bring-up, system-level debugging, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, and compliance certification (CE, FCC, RoHS). 
 - Implement automated firmware build pipelines, version control (Git), OTA update mechanisms, and CI/CD test rigs. 
 - Drive root-cause failure analysis for field issues and execute timely engineering change orders (ECOs). 

Skill(s) required

- Expertise in embedded C/C++, RTOS (FreeRTOS / Zephyr), bare-metal firmware, and microcontroller architectures. 
 - Strong technical project management skills using Agile/Scrum, Jira/ClickUp, risk analysis, and engineering milestone tracking. 
 - Proficiency with communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, USB, MQTT, CoAP) and sensor signal conditioning. 
 - Familiarity with hardware design principles, reading complex schematics, PCB layout reviews, and lab tools (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers). 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead, inspire, and manage team dynamics while maintaining high engineering rigor. 

Eligibility

- B. Tech / M. Tech in Electronics & Communication (ECE), Electrical Engineering (EE), Computer Science, or Embedded Systems. 
 - 6+ years of hands-on experience in embedded systems and firmware development, with at least 2+ years leading engineering teams or hardware projects. 
 - Proven experience delivering commercial-grade IoT/embedded hardware products to production. 

What we are looking for

- A hands-on technical leader who balances deep embedded engineering expertise with structured project management. 
 - Proactive problem-solver committed to code quality, product durability, and timely milestones. 
 - Excellent communicator capable of translating complex engineering details across multidisciplinary teams. 

What we Offer

- Lead key engineering initiatives at an innovative clean-tech startup. 
 - Work with cutting-edge optical, chemical, and IoT sensing technologies. 
 - World-class lab and prototyping infrastructure at IIT Delhi R&I Park. 
 - Competitive salary package with strong professional recognition and growth.

data.title: Group Lead SDE
data.description:
Key Accountabilities

JOB DESCRIPTION

- Understand and be a champion of DP World's business and product strategy 
 - Have a deep understanding, both low level and high level, across a swathe of technologies 
 - Have built and helped build business systems from the ground up, and having scaled them 
 - While being strategic, provide a very 'Hands-on' technical leadership and mentoring for engineers 
 - Own the software design, architecture and operational excellence across the cargoes products 
 - Work with product management and business heads to rapidly iterate on features and grow the business. 
 - Actively seek to prevent redundancies, while allowing that where appropriate in order to accomplish an effective balance between short term and long term goals 
 - Establish and promote software design and development guidelines, deployment strategies, best practices, and standards 
 - Ensure the security-first approach during the design & development of applications 
 - Adhere to all the DP World policies including information security 
 - Responsible for the indirect management and leadership of an engaged team, promoting collaboration and ensuring that each is developed and evaluated against goals and objectives which are aligned, specific, measurable, attainable yet challenging, realistic and time bound. 
 - Act as an ambassador for DP World at all times when working; promoting and demonstrating positive behaviors in harmony with DP World's Founder's Principles, values and culture; ensuring the highest level of safety is applied in all activities; understanding and following DP World's Code of Conduct and Ethics policies 
 - Perform other related duties as assigned

Other

JOB CONTEXT: 

DP World is a leading enabler of global trade and an integral part of the supply chain. We operate multiple yet related businesses - from marine and inland terminals, maritime services, logistics and ancillary services to technology-driven trade solutions. 

We have a portfolio of 78 operating marine and inland terminals supported by over 50 related businesses in over 70 countries across six continents with a significant presence in both high-growth and mature markets. We aim to be essential to the bright future of global trade, ensuring everything we do has a long-lasting positive impact on economies and society. 

Our dedicated team of nearly 100, 000 employees from 110 countries cultivates long-standing relationships with governments, shipping lines, importers and exporters, communities, and many other important constituents of the global supply chain, to add value and provide quality services today and tomorrow. 

Container handling is the company's core business and generates more than three quarters of its revenue. In 2018, DP World handled 71 million TEU (twenty-foot equivalent units) across our portfolio. With its committed pipeline of developments and expansions, the current gross capacity of 90 million TEU is expected to rise to more than 100 million TEU by 2020, in line with market demand. 

By thinking ahead, foreseeing change and innovating we aim to create the most productive, efficient and safe trade solutions globally. 

Qualifications, Experience And Skills

- Bachelors in Computer Science or related field from a reputed institution. Masters degree is a plus. 
 - Around 15 years of experience in the software development field, working across a wide swathe of technologies 
 - 5-10 years of experience leading the architecture and design function in an organization, and managing enterprise architecture 
 - Ability to take complex problems and simplify them elegantly. Meet time to market requirements of the business while not compromising software design principles. 
 - Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal and analytical skills, including the ability to communicate software choices and tradeoffs clearly and persuasively 
 - Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with stakeholders across multiple organizations and drive alignment 
 - Ability to work efficiently and demonstrate a bias for action in a fast-paced environment, working on ambiguous and challenging projects 
 - Relentless desire for innovation, balanced with business needs, and customer expectations 
 - Experience with tools and standards of software development, testing, deployment and operational excellence

data.title: Supplier Quality Engineer
data.description:
Inseego is a global leader in wireless broadband, delivering fast, reliable connectivity to homes, businesses, and people on the move. With the acquisition of Nokia's FastMile fixed wireless access product, Inseego offers one of the industry's broadest cellular broadband portfolios, spanning fixed wireless gateways, mobile hotspots and routers, enterprise and industrial gateways, and cloud-based device, network, and subscriber management software. Backed by decades of wireless engineering expertise across 5G, Wi-Fi, antenna design, and cloud software, Inseego partners with mobile network operators worldwide to deliver connectivity at scale. Headquartered in San Diego, California, Inseego has offices in Amsterdam, Bangalore, and Athens. 

Position Overview

The Supplier Quality Engineer ensures that all components, materials, and assemblies sourced from suppliers and products sourced from the CM meet Inseego's, and the customer's, quality standards, regulatory requirements, and performance specifications. The Inseego Supplier Quality Engineer will primarily work onsite at one of our (CM) manufacturing partners in India. This role is critical in ensuring production yield and quality for New Product Introduction (NPI), ramp-up, and Mass Production. The engineer will also lead customer complaint management, drive continuous quality improvements, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance supplier performance and product quality. A strong focus will be placed on PCBA manufacturing processes, advanced quality tools, lean methodologies, and smart manufacturing. This role also validates the CM's QMS systems, production processes and production quality. This is a cross-functional role supporting operations and engineering aimed at ensuring the production quality of Inseego products. This role works closely with procurement, engineering and operations. 

Responsibilities

- Collaborate with suppliers and R&D teams to ensure production predictability and stability at the supplier (CM) site. 
 - Support capacity planning and ensure consistent output with high-quality standards at the supplier. 
 - Manage customer complaints using 8D reporting methodology, ensuring timely resolution and communication. 
 - Drive the implementation and validation of improvement and corrective actions. 
 - Conduct risk assessments and provide recommendations for new suppliers and process technologies. 
 - Oversee sustaining activities and process optimization to ensure long-term efficiency. 
 - Develop and execute a comprehensive continuous improvement plan. 
 - Work with suppliers to establish and implement quality management plans using industry-standard tools and methodologies to drive quality improvements. 
 - Conduct end-to-end audits of PCBA manufacturing processes, including SMT, wave soldering, and selective soldering, to ensure compliance with quality standards. 
 - Assess and qualify suppliers based on technical capability, quality systems, and production capacity. 
 - Conduct capability assessments and risk evaluations for new and existing suppliers. 
 - Maintain AVL (approved vendor list) by conducting regular audits, monitoring KPI's, organizing and driving supplier QBR's, and recommending qualification/disqualification. 
 - Provide regular reporting and visibility into AVL mix used in production. 
 - Work with the supplier to troubleshoot and resolve manufacturing issues, including root cause analysis and corrective action implementation. 
 - Collaborate with the supplier and the R&D design teams to ensure Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles are applied to the designs. 
 - Lead efforts to optimize thermal profiling, soldering processes, and ESD controls in PCBA manufacturing. 
 - Drive the adoption of Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies to reduce waste and improve efficiency. 
 - Ensure compliance with environmental regulations and promote sustainability practices in PCBA manufacturing. 
 - Support the implementation of Industry 4. 0 (smart manufacturing) initiatives, including process automation, real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance and process improvements to increase efficiency and responsiveness. 
 - Collect, maintain and analyze CM quality data including IQC, QC, OQC, FPY, FYR, FAI, RCCA to identify opportunities for improvement or needed corrective actions. 
 - Regularly visit key component suppliers, when not working in the CM, to validate the collected quality data in person. 
 - Work closely at the CM to ensure that the CM's IQC, QC, OQC, FPY, FYR align as expected with Inseego requirements and industry standards. . 
 - Work with the CM's to identify process improvements to drive continuous improvement and quality KPI's above the established Inseego targets. 
 - Travel regular between CM's and key Suppliers to provide on site support to resolve quality issues based on defined priorities, KPI's, quality data and production demand. 
 - This role is expected to spend most of their time embedded in the CM's and Key Component Suppliers. 
 - Work closely with Quality, RL, Repair to align CM KPI's with expected field quality. 
 - Ensure adequate inspection (examination) process of incoming materials is in place at CM/ODM to ensure that they meet requirements. 
 - Work with the CM/ODM to ensure that their team of Quality engineers, inspectors, auditors, analysts, and technicians are performing their duties as required. 
 - Work closely with Manufacturing Engineering team on production/process improvements. 
 - Analyze factory and field failure data, recommend corrective action(s) and support or lead efforts to improve product quality. 
 - Conduct failure analysis/correction actions with suppliers utilizing industry-standard failure analysis (FMEA) techniques such as 8D analysis. 

Required Qualifications

- Minimum of 5 ~ 7 years of hands-on manufacturing quality experience preferably in the telecom or consumer electronics industry, high-mix, high-volume environments. 
 - Advanced knowledge of SMT (Surface Mount Technology), wave soldering, and selective soldering processes. 
 - Familiarity with PCBA testing methods, including ICT (In-Circuit Testing), flying probe testing, and functional testing. 
 - Familiarity with PCBA manufacturing processes and equipment, including: 
 - ESD/MSD controls
 - Calibration of test equipment
 - Fixture setup
 - Handling of sensitive components
 - Familiarity with industry standards, including: 
 - ISO 9001: 2015
 - IEC 60812 (FMEA)
 - IEC 61000 (EMC)
 - IPC-2221 (PCB design rules)
 - IPC-A-610 (Acceptability of Electronic Assemblies)
 - IPC-J-STD-001 (Solderability)
 - Proficiency in quality tools and methodologies, including PFMEA, Control Plans, Process Flow Diagrams, and Statistical Process Control (SPC). 
 - Expertise in root cause analysis techniques, such as 5 Whys, Fishbone diagrams, and Fault-Tree Analysis. 
 - Strong understanding of DFM (Design for Manufacturability) and DFA (Design for Assembly) principles. 
 - Knowledge of process automation tools and MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems). 
 - Familiarity with Industry 4. 0 concepts, such as predictive maintenance and real-time production monitoring. 
 - Proficiency in Lean Manufacturing principles (VSM, Kaizen, . . . ) to reduce waste and improve efficiency. 
 - Experience with Six Sigma methodologies (DMAIC, statistical tools, . . . ) for process improvement and defect reduction. 
 - Understanding of sustainability practices in PCBA manufacturing. 
 - Proven ability to work with ODM/CM's with regards to design, supplier, manufacturing quality
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and tasks; proven strong organizational, problem solving and project management skills in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Track record of driving continuous improvement and ensuring quality targets are met in fast growth organizations by working cross-functionally with Engineering, ODM/CM's, Operations. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, English fluency, including presenting to senior management, suppliers and customers. 
 - Agile self-starter with an international mindset, with a passion for quality and continuous improvement, who can work independently and collaboratively
 - Ability to travel regularly (up to 50%) locally and internationally, as well as to the US 2-3+ times annually. 
 - Position to be based in Noida, India. Proficiency in the local language required. 

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in electrical/electronic, mechanical or industrial engineering or relevant commensurate experience. 
 - Desirable certifications in Lean Six Sigma Black belt, ASQ CQE, ISO auditor. 
 - Proficiency in Chinese is a plus. 

Location: Onsite from Gurgaon, Haryana

Role Objective

To lead and direct a team of scientists in downstream process development for recombinant therapeutic proteins. The incumbent will oversee multiple candidate product projects, drive technology transfer to manufacturing facilities, ensure strict regulatory compliance.

- Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and supervise scientists executing downstream process development activities, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning. 
 - Project Oversight: Manage and oversee projects in the process development pipeline for candidate recombinant therapeutic proteins from conceptualization to execution. 
 - Process Engineering: Guide and execute scale-up, scale-down model validation, and comprehensive process characterization activities. 
 - Technology Transfer: Lead the seamless technology transfer of developed downstream processes to commercial manufacturing facilities. 
 - Documentation & Compliance: Author, review, and approve critical process development reports, technology transfer dossiers, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). 
 - Infrastructure & Resource Management: Maintain departmental infrastructure, plan equipment lifecycle, and contribute to optimal resource allocation and budgeting.

Type of Interaction: External

- Interaction with: External vendors, technology partners, Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs), and equipment suppliers. 
 - Nature of Interaction: Sourcing advanced downstream technologies, managing external development projects, and evaluating state-of-the-art purification infrastructure. 

Job Requirements

Professional Experience and Relevant Skills

- Experience: Ph. D. with 8 to 12 years of relevant industrial experience in biomanufacturing/biotech R&D.

Technical Expertise

- Deep understanding of protein purification techniques (Chromatography: Affinity, IEX, HIC, SEC, Filtration: TFF, Depth filtration, Nanofiltration).

 - Strong knowledge of tech transfer methodologies into cGMP environments. 

Skills

- Excellent technical writing skills (protocols, reports, SOPs, and regulatory filings). 
 - Strong project management and resource allocation capabilities. 
 - Adept at troubleshooting complex downstream process deviations. 

Academic Qualifications & Certifications

- Educational Qualification: Ph. D. or Master's degree (M. Tech / M. Sc. ) in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Biochemistry, or a closely related Life Sciences discipline.

Bring more to life. 

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology?

At Radiometer, one of Danaher's operating companies, our work saves lives, and we're all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact. You'll thrive in a culture of belonging where your unique viewpoint matters, and where continuous improvement helps turn ideas into real-world impact. 

At Radiometer, life comes first. Our vision is to improve global healthcare with reliable, fast, and easy patient diagnoses-and cybersecurity plays a critical role in ensuring safe and secure products for patients and customers worldwide. 

About The Role

In this role, you will provide technical leadership and architectural direction for the development of diagnostic instrumentation. You will be responsible for defining, evolving, and governing embedded software and system architectures that enable scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable products. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Product Management, Systems Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Software/Firmware Engineering, Verification & Validation, Quality, and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate product and platform strategies into robust technical solutions that enable confident diagnostic decisions, and improve patient outcomes. You will drive architectural decisions, establish engineering standards, resolve complex technical challenges, and guide teams through the successful delivery of high-quality products. 

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To

- Define and drive the architecture, design, and evolution of embedded software systems and platforms for medical diagnostic instruments. 
 - Lead the development of secure, scalable, reliable, and maintainable software architectures spanning firmware, real-time processing, device control, communication, diagnostics, and system integration. 
 - Translate product requirements into well-defined architectural solutions, including component decomposition, interface definitions, technology selection, and dependency management. 
 - Lead architecture, design, and code reviews to ensure technical quality, consistency, and compliance with organizational and product objectives. 
 - Collaborate with Hardware, Firmware, Systems, Mechanical, Verification & Validation, Quality, Regulatory, and Product teams to deliver integrated instrument solutions. 
 - Collaborate with global R&D teams and stakeholders to influence technical direction, align architectural roadmaps, and support long-term product and platform strategies. 

The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field, with 14+ years of experience in embedded software development, firmware engineering, systems architecture, or related technical roles. 
 - Proven expertise in architecting and developing complex embedded systems using C/C++, with strong knowledge of software architecture, object-oriented design, design patterns, system-level engineering, interface design, and architectural trade-off analysis. 
 - Deep understanding of embedded and real-time systems, including RTOS, multithreading, synchronization, interrupt handling, memory management, performance optimization, and deterministic system behavior. 
 - Hands-on experience with embedded communication and networking technologies, including UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, USB, Ethernet, TCP/IP, and similar protocols. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership in cross-functional product development teams, including mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, influencing technical direction, and exhibiting strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. 

It would be a plus if you also possess experience in: 

- Experience architecting embedded systems for medical devices, IVD platforms, laboratory automation, scientific instrumentation, or other regulated industries, with knowledge of applicable compliance and quality requirements. 
 - Expertise in designing high-reliability, safety-critical instrument control systems involving sensors, motors, pumps, valves, measurement systems, diagnostics, fault-tolerant architectures, risk controls, and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Experience with medical device standards and cybersecurity requirements (e. g. , IEC 62304, ISO 14971), as well as modernization of legacy embedded systems and migration to next-generation architectures and platforms. 

Why Join Us

Radiometer, a Danaher operating company, offers a collaborative and purpose-driven environment where your work contributes directly to improving patient outcomes globally. 

Join our winning team today. Together, we'll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow's science and technology, shaping the architecture and innovation behind next-generation healthcare solutions that advance patient care around the world. 

Join our winning team today. Together, we'll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow's science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life. 

For more information, visit www. danaher. com.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer I - Confluent
data.description:
Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world's leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM's product and technology landscape. Here, you'll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

Confluent Platform

The Confluent Platform team is dedicated to delivering an industry-leading, enterprise-grade data streaming platform for any BYOI (Bring Your Own Infrastructure) environment-ranging from local developer setups to private cloud infrastructure. 

CP Charter

To make rapid, data-driven decisions at scale, modern enterprises depend on real-time streaming infrastructure. Confluent stands as the leader in data-in-motion, powered by the Confluent Platform. Our mission is to extend this streaming platform and domain expertise to every environment and audience-from private cloud deployments to the broader open-source developer community. 

- Deliver the "Confluent" Experience in Private Cloud: CP accounts for 45% of total Confluent revenue. We empower customers to maximize their private data center investments across all data-in-motion initiatives by offering an ambitious product roadmap, prompt security patches, and reliable support. 
 - Bridge Hybrid Environments: We build connected cloud capabilities that allow customers to seamlessly integrate Confluent Cloud innovations into their existing private cloud infrastructure. 
 - Expand Tech Community Engagement: We actively capture mindshare within the technical community through the reach and adoption of Confluent Platform. 
 - Elevate Developer Experience: We continuously refine and improve the end-to-end developer experience for Apache Kafka and Confluent products. 

Confluent Platform Team

CP Team is fully based out of India - started in 2023. CP team consists of the following sub teams

Hybrid Observability and Management Pillar

This pillar addresses the Confluent Platform's observability and management needs. The products support fully air-gapped enterprise deployments and provide centralized, Confluent Cloud-based monitoring and management across multiple environments. 

- Confluent Control Center (C3) - C3 is a control plane for monitoring fully air-gapped Confluent Platform deployments. Designed for enterprise teams that provide Kafka as a service, it helps operators assess deployment health, configure cluster alerts and notifications, and maintain data-plane SLAs. It also supports security and access management, along with developer debugging and troubleshooting. 
 - Unified Stream Manager (USM) - A hybrid monitoring and management solution that enables Confluent Platform customers to use Confluent Cloud capabilities, including data governance, stream lineage, and cost-effective monitoring and management. It provides centralized monitoring for multiple edge deployments, creating a single control plane for stream products across cloud and self-hosted data centers. 

About The Role

You will serve as the lead Staff Engineer for the Hybrid Observability pillar. 

The CP team's charter has continued to expand since its inception. In this role, you will provide technical leadership across emerging priorities, including managing and monitoring large, geographically distributed CP clusters; strengthening security to address evolving global data-protection regulations; and improving tools and processes that help on-call engineers resolve customer issues within committed SLAs. Success requires navigating open-ended strategy, exploring and testing customer-focused ideas, and shaping solutions beyond a predefined list of requirements. 

As a leading technologist in the Hybrid Observability pillar, you will apply deep expertise in Confluent Platform and Confluent Cloud to deliver hybrid observability capabilities to customers. You will design solutions, review architecture and code, and implement complex system components by yourself. You will also diagnose customer escalations, recommend mitigations, and work across the full Confluent Platform technology stack. 

This role requires you to drive operational and engineering excellence, help shape the roadmap, and evolve the team's vision and direction. You will collaborate across the organization to advance the roadmap and turn that vision into reality. 

What You Will Do

- Collaborate with engineers and architects to advance Confluent Platform's hybrid observability products, C3 and USM. 
 - Partner with product management, engineering leadership, and key stakeholders across Confluent and Confluent Cloud to shape and drive the roadmap, while serving as a strong technical voice for CP across the company. 
 - ChampionC3/USM healthand operational excellence by influencing technical direction and reviewing code, designs, and proposed improvements. 
 - Architect and design hybrid USM solutions, applying strongexpertisein building andoperatingdistributed systems across cloud and on-premises environments. 
 - Mentor high-performing engineers and technical leads, helping them grow their skills through hands-on guidance and experience. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

What We're Looking For

- At least 13+years of hands-on software development experience, with a proven ability toanticipatefuture product needs, create technical plans, and deliver ideas into production. 
 - Experience building andoperatinglarge-scale systems, with a strong understanding of core infrastructure-including storage, networking, and operating systems and running production services in the cloud. 
 - Strong foundations in distributed systems design and development, concurrent programming, and multithreading. 
 - A proactive, collaborative self-starter who canidentifysigns of technical issues, determinetheir causes, and implement lasting fixes. 
 - A track recordof delivering on time while balancing short-term technical choices with long-term goals. Able to move quickly, build incrementally, iterate, prioritize effectively, andmaintaina strong results-oriented sense of urgency. 
 - Ability to influence technical decisions across the team, peers, and senior leadership through clear communication and effective collaboration. 
 - A degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent experience, with knowledge of diverse technologies, programming paradigms, and frameworks. The ability to evaluate trade-offs and apply them pragmatically in production is essential. 
 - Ability to handle critical production issues while on call by methodically analyzing logs and metrics, identifyingroot causes, and implementing effective mitigations. 

What is a deal breaker for us

- Architecture and designexpertisealone is insufficient for success on the CP team. Because this role involves building a platform product, candidates must have a strong engineering foundation, enthusiasm for technology, and the ability to implement solutions hands-on. 
 - Candidates must collaborate effectively and prioritize Confluent Platform's goals over individual interests. We value a mindset that measures personal success by the success of CP and Confluent. 
 - Ability to help shape the team's vision and strategy, clearly communicate the path forward, and build support for its evolution. Delivering assigned features is a baseline expectation, not the ultimate goal. 
 - Candidates whose experience is limited to using LLM-based tools, such as Claude, Codex, or equivalents, to analyze code and relay generated output will not be considered. This role requires demonstrated hands-on engineering expertise beyond AI-assisted analysisand implementation. 
 - We offer flexibility to manage personal needs rather than adhering to rigid 9-to-6workinghours. In return, candidates mustdemonstrateownership and accountability, delivercommitments, step up when needed without repeated follow-ups, communicate promptly through asynchronous channels such as Slack, andparticipateactively in meetings.

data.description:

Job Description: Principal Software Engineer - Platform

F5 is the global leader in delivering and securing every app and API. Trusted by Global Fortune 500 companies, F5 keeps applications and APIs fast, available, and secure across the complex hybrid multicloud environments where modern digital business operates. Through the F5 Application Delivery and Security Platform (ADSP), F5 converges application delivery and security - spanning data centers, private clouds, public clouds, SaaS platforms, edge environments, and emerging AI architectures - to reduce complexity, strengthen resilience, and protect digital experiences at scale. 

About the Position: 

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our ADSP- F5 Connector program team in Bangalore. The F5 Connector is a critical architectural component of the ADSP - it provides the bridge between customer on-premises and cloud-deployed infrastructure (BIG-IP, Kubernetes clusters, edge sites) and F5's cloud-native SaaS services. 

As a Principal Engineer, you will own the architecture, performance, and reliability of the connector's data plane and control plane. This is a high-performance, systems-level role requiring deep expertise in Rust / C++ to build software that operates at massive scale. Your work includes, but not limited to, Research, design and build highly reliable, available and scalable platforms, API definition, implementation, deployment, operational management, and debugging

Roles and Responsibilities: 

- 12+ years of experience in software engineering in a fast-paced environment with most recent 3+ years as Architect or Principal Engineer with ability to architect & design large scale enterprise class platforms in microservice based solution and architectural style. 
 - Hands-on coding in Rust / C++, be able to conceptualize and develop prototype quickly - Drive technical roadmap of the team in collaboration with Engineering and Product. Leverage AI to write code that adheres to the requirements, is cost-effective and maintainable. 
 - Familiarity with the OpenTelemetry Arrow Protocol (OTAP) for efficient, columnar-encoded transport of telemetry data, including schema negotiation and stream lifecycle management
 - Grasp of bi-directional (bidi) streaming via gRPC, including flow control, multiplexed streams, back-pressure handling, and long-lived connection management in distributed collector topologies
 - Added plus: Experience with Apache Arrow columnar memory format and its application to high-throughput, zero-copy data interchange across analytics and observability workloads
 - Own the end-to-end architecture of the F5 Connector, encompassing the data plane (high-throughput packet/request processing, traffic inspection, telemetry collection) and control plane (policy synchronization, configuration management, service registration with F5 Distributed Cloud). 
 - Mentor senior and junior engineers across Bangalore and global teams; Perform code reviews, set coding practices and guidelines within the team
 - Experience working with all the phases of a development cycle for a software product from understanding requirements, going through design, development, deploy phases and maintenance. 
 - Work with geographically distributed teams

Please note that F5 only contacts candidates through F5 email address (ending with @f5. com) or auto email notification from Workday (ending with f5. com or @myworkday. com).

This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, discipline, and termination. We are looking for a skilled, analytical and performance-driven Landing Page & Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Developer to join our Performance Advertising Team.

What You Bring

- 5+ years of full-stack or backend software engineering experience (Python, TypeScript/Node. js) with a proven track record of shipping production code. 
 - Hands-on experience building generative AI applications; connecting systems and providing intelligence or automation of specific tasks and goals through agents 
 - Direct familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or building custom API integrations/connectors between LLMs and enterprise tools (REST APIs, GraphQL, Webhooks). 
 - Proficiency in modern web development frameworks (e. g. , React, Next. js) for building clean internal apps and agent dashboards. 
 - Familiarity with enterprise SaaS business architectures, systems and processes associated with go-to-market: Sales, Customer Success, Retention (Salesforce, Gainsight, PSA). 
 - Strong product sense: Ability to evaluate business workflows, quantify released capacity, and translate frontline needs into clean software specs. 

Preferred Experience

- Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Pgvector) and LLM observability tools (LangSmith, Phoenix). 
 - Experience with serverless and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Vercel, Modal) for deploying lightweight microservices and AI endpoints. 
 - Background working directly with or within Customer Success, Professional Services, or CX Operations teams in B2B SaaS.

Why This Role Matters

AI is central to Kantata's vision for delivering exceptional customer outcomes without linear headcount growth. This role offers the opportunity to shape how AI transforms post-sales operations, with executive sponsorship and broad cross-functional partnership. 

Kantata offers competitive compensation and benefits, flexible time off, a remote-first environment, and professional-development support. Benefits are based on location and applicable local programs.

data.title: GESTC - Senior Playwright Test Automation Architect - Tax Senior
data.description:
Summary

Position Summary

This is a senior-level, architecture-focused position responsible for designing, building, and leading an enterprise-grade Playwright test automation framework for the GESTC QA Engineering practice. You will lead a team of QA Automation Engineers and drive the adoption of BDD/Gherkin-based testing, AI-assisted automation, and agentic AI platforms such as Cursor, Kiro, and similar tools. You will be the technical authority for test automation strategy and will be responsible for upskilling the team toward intelligent, AI-augmented quality engineering. 

The successful candidate will combine deep Playwright expertise with hands-on experience using agentic AI tools to generate, manage, and govern test automation at scale. Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills are essential, as this role interfaces with QA leadership, engineering managers, product owners, and Agile delivery teams. 

Key Job Responsibilities: 

- Architect, design, and lead the implementation of an enterprise-grade Playwright test automation framework, including folder structures, reusable libraries, Page Object Models (POM), and test utilities for both UI and API testing
 - Define and lead a BDD-first testing strategy using Gherkin syntax, integrated with Playwright via Cucumber-JS or Playwright BDD frameworks
 - Lead the adoption of agentic AI platforms (Cursor, Kiro, GitHub Copilot, Claude Agents, or equivalents) to automate test case generation, feature file creation, locator self-healing, and root cause analysis
 - Build agentic test automation workflows where AI agents autonomously generate BDD feature files from user stories, scaffold page objects from UI/API schemas, and suggesting fixes for failing tests
 - Design and maintain CI/CD-integrated test pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins, ensuring reliable and parallelized test execution across environments
 - Lead, mentor, and upskill a team of QA Automation Engineers - building capability in Playwright, BDD, and AI-assisted development through structured coaching, code reviews, and training programs
 - Define and enforce QA automation standards: naming conventions, test tagging, assertion patterns, reporting formats, and framework governance documentation
 - Establish test quality KPIs: automation coverage, flakiness rates, time-to-feedback metrics, and automation ROI dashboards for QA leadership
 - Collaborate with Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and Developers in a SAFe Agile environment to shift quality left and integrate testing into PI Planning cycles
 - Create and maintain a prompt engineering library and reusable AI workflow templates so QA engineers can consistently leverage AI tooling in their daily work
 - Perform test data management strategy design, including fixtures, factories, and environment-specific data handling
 - Detect, log, track, and report application defects; assist in troubleshooting and retesting across multiple applications
 - Evaluate emerging agentic QA tools and recommend adoption based on team needs, governance requirements, and toolchain fit

Location: Hyderabad

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

 - Complete knowledge of SDLC with strong emphasis on Scaled Agile (SAFe) framework
 - Strong experience integrating Playwright into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins)
 - Experience with Playwright API testing (request context) for REST and GraphQL automation
 - Intermediate to advanced knowledge of SQL for data validation and test setup
 - Intermediate to advanced knowledge of Python for scripting, utility tooling, or AI integrations. 
 - Experience with test management tools, preferably Azure DevOps (ADO)
 - Excellent written and oral communication skills - able to present technical strategy to non-technical stakeholders
 - Comfortable working in a dynamic, multi-tasking team environment with flexible deadlines

data.title: Principal Infrastructure Automation & AI Ops Engineer
data.description:
Who is Forcepoint?

Forcepoint simplifies security for global businesses and governments. Forcepoint's all-in-one, truly cloud-native platform makes it easy to adopt Zero Trust and prevent the theft or loss of sensitive data and intellectual property no matter where people are working. 20+ years in business. 2. 7k employees. 150 countries. 11k+ customers. 300+ patents. If our mission excites you, you're in the right place; we want you to bring your own energy to help us create a safer world. All we're missing is you!

About The Role

We are seeking a Staff/Principal Infrastructure Automation & AI Ops Engineer to modernize enterprise infrastructure operations across endpoint, identity, Microsoft 365, network, cloud, and IT service management. This is not a traditional systems administration role. The successful candidate will establish an automation-first, API-driven, AI-assisted operating model that replaces manual administration with policy-as-code, automated remediation, and intelligent operational workflows, extending the governance and security foundation already built across the environment. 

The engineer will act as a technical authority and architecture leader, unifying Intune, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, CrowdStrike Falcon, CyberArk, Freshservice, AWS, Commvault, and Juniper NGFW infrastructure into a single automation and telemetry architecture. The ideal candidate moves fluidly between writing Python, PowerShell, and Bash, troubleshooting a production authentication issue, reviewing architecture, and defining an AI-driven remediation strategy. 

The organization operates as customer zero for Forcepoint's Data Security Everywhere (DSE) / DLP platform, piloting AI-assisted data security and remediation workflows ahead of general availability. This engineer will help shape how that integration extends into the broader automation and AI Ops corporate architecture. 

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Engineering & Automation

Own the architecture and standards for the Windows endpoint platform in Intune. Design lifecycle automation covering provisioning, configuration, compliance, patching, and retirement, and sustain current patch and compliance rates as the fleet scales. Engineer Windows Autopilot workflows that enforce standard-user deployment and close local-admin exposure. Build automated software inventory auditing by reconciling Intune with CrowdStrike Falcon Discover, and design self-healing remediation for common failures. 

Identity, Zero Trust & Access Automation

Serve as a technical authority for Entra ID identity architecture. Automate Joiner, Mover, and Leaver workflows across Entra ID, M365, and Freshservice. Mature Conditional Access from audit mode into full enforcement. Develop AI-assisted entitlement and RBAC analysis that surfaces excessive privilege, stale access, and segregation-of-duties risk. Partner on Beyond Trust privileged-access automation, including onboarding, credential rotation, and session monitoring. 

Microsoft 365 Platform Engineering

Architect and automate Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and Conditional Access administration through Microsoft Graph and PowerShell. Establish configuration baselines and drift detection, and carry forward the SharePoint governance and versioning cleanup already underway. 

Infrastructure-as-Code & Automation Engineering

Own the automation engineering practice enterprise-wide. Set standards for Terraform, Bicep, and scripting frameworks in place of one-off scripts. Build CI/CD pipelines and API-driven integrations across Intune, Entra ID, Freshservice, AWS, and Juniper, and deliver reusable automation modules other engineers can build on. Convert high-volume manual processes into automated Freshservice service catalog workflows. 

AI Ops & Intelligent Automation

Deliver production AI-assisted capabilities, not pilots, across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and Service Desk. Implement anomaly detection and event correlation, intelligent ticket classification and routing in Freshservice, and predictive models for certificate expiration, patch compliance, and firewall licensing. Ensure every automated action carries authentication, authorization, logging, approval, and rollback controls, with human approval gates on high-risk changes. 

Serve as a technical partner on the organization's customer-zero engagement with Forcepoint DSE/DLP, helping define how AI-assisted data security detection and remediation workflows integrate with the broader endpoint, identity, and ITSM automation architecture. 

Observability & Security Guardrails

Build a unified telemetry view spanning endpoint, identity, network, cloud, M365, and ITSM. Implement secrets management through Key Vault, Secrets Manager, or Vault, eliminate hardcoded credentials and standing privileged access, and enforce least-privilege RBAC with full audit trails for every automated action. 

Technical Leadership

Define the architecture standards adopted across Infrastructure & Operations. Lead design reviews, mentor engineers, and partner with Network, Cloud, Security, Identity, and Service Desk leaders, shaping standards across teams without relying on direct reporting authority. 

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years in infrastructure, systems, or platform engineering, with demonstrated experience designing automation (not just executing predefined procedures) in large enterprise environments. 
 - Expert-level Microsoft Intune and Windows endpoint management, including Autopilot and local-admin/LAPS enforcement. 
 - Strong hands-on Entra ID experience: SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, Zero Trust, identity lifecycle, SCIM/API-based provisioning. 
 - Advanced PowerShell, Python, and/or Bash; strong REST API/webhook integration and Git experience; experience with Terraform, Bicep, or Ansible and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Deep Microsoft 365 administration, including Microsoft Graph API and SharePoint governance. 
 - Experience with EDR platforms (CrowdStrike Falcon preferred) and vulnerability/patch management reporting. 
 - Understanding of 802. 1X, enterprise PKI/CA, certificate deployment via MDM, and NAC/authentication troubleshooting. 
 - Demonstrated experience with AI-assisted or event-driven production automation, including anomaly detection and automated remediation with appropriate security guardrails. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with AWS platform engineering and account hygiene. 
 - Direct Freshservice (or ServiceNow/Jira Service Management) administration and API integration experience. 
 - Experience with CyberArk or equivalent PAM platforms, and Commvault or equivalent backup platforms. 
 - Network automation using Python/Ansible; experience with observability/telemetry pipelines. 
 - Experience with LLM/AI agent frameworks and enterprise AI governance. 
 - Familiarity with Forcepoint DSE/DLP or Claude-based AI security tooling, or interest in shaping an early customer-zero AI/data-security integration. 
 - Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert; Terraform Associate; AWS/Azure professional certification. 

Success Metrics (6-12 Months)

- 60-80%+ of repeatable endpoint tasks automated; patch/compliance rates sustained or improved. 
 - Automated Joiner/Mover/Leaver workflows live; Conditional Access moved from audit to full enforcement. 
 - Infrastructure changes delivered through Git/CI/CD with reusable modules adopted across teams. 
 - Proactive certificate, firewall, and endpoint compliance monitoring in place. 
 - Multiple AI Ops use cases in production (ticket classification, automated low-risk remediation) with measurable reduction in mean time to detect/resolve. 

Role Positioning

This role is measured by outcomes, not ticket volume: tickets eliminated, processes automated, incidents prevented, risk reduced, engineering capacity created. 

The right candidate can architect a solution, build the automation, secure it, measure it, and roll it back if needed. This is an automation and platform architect who codes fluently, not an administrator who happens to know Intune and Freshservice. 

Don't meet every single qualification? Studies show people are hesitant to apply if they don't meet all requirements listed in a job posting. Forcepoint is focused on building an inclusive and diverse workplace - so if there is something slightly different about your previous experience, but it otherwise aligns and you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply. You could be a great candidate for this or other roles on our team. 

The policy of Forcepoint is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to affirmatively seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity. 

Forcepoint is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers, including job seekers with disabilities. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Company's career webpage as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by sending an email to recruiting@forcepoint. com. 

Applicants must have the right to work in the location to which you have applied.

Work on backend platform software that powers advanced scientific instruments used in semiconductors, life sciences, and materials research. data.title: Associate Director - Application Development
data.description:
About The Company

Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners. 

Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U. S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130, 000 reload points and over 100, 000 distributing locations. 

Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide. 

I. The Mission

You will lead a world-class engineering organization responsible for our core Fintech and Banking portfolios. You aren't just a leader; you are a technical visionary who ensures our systems are as reliable and fast. You will bridge the gap between complex business requirements and elite engineering execution, pioneering an AI-first development culture (AIDLC) to set a new industry standard for productivity. 

As the Associate Director of Application Development, you will function as a high-impact technical executive. This role is designed for a technologist who can manage large-scale portfolios, lead multi-disciplinary teams (Front-end & Back-end), and navigate the complexities of the Fintech and Banking sectors. 

You are expected to be a "technologist first"- a leader who can sit in an architectural review or a deep-dive debugging session and add immediate value, while simultaneously presenting digital transformation roadmaps for your portfolios. 

The Associate Director of Application Development will serve as a pivotal leader within the Netspend Product & Technology organization, reporting directly to the Engineering Leader. This highly visible Senior leadership role requires an accomplished engineering leader with deep expertise in building and scaling consumers products. 

The Associate Director of Application development will shape the long-term technology vision, drive SaaS-first engineering excellence, and ensure our product's solutions remain in the industry benchmark for innovation, reliability, and customer value. This leader will inspire high-performing global teams, foster strong cross-functional partnerships. 

The Core Mandate

- Strategic Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Management
 - The Bridge: Act as the primary interface between business units and engineering. You will translate high-level commercial objectives into executable technical strategies. 
 - Portfolio Oversight: Manage a comprehensive portfolio of applications, ensuring that cross-functional teams are aligned, unblocked, and delivering high-value features. 
 - Agile Transformation: Lead the evolution of the engineering org into a high-performing, fast-paced Agile environment, optimizing for both speed-to-market and system stability. 
 - Technical Depth & Innovation (AIDLC)
 - Hands-on Guidance: While not required to write daily production code, you must possess the technical depth of a former Solution Architect or Dev Lead. You will guide teams through complex technical hurdles and ensure code quality standards. 
 - AI-Augmented Engineering: A core focus will be the AIDLC (AI-driven Development Life Cycle). You will be expected to implement AI tools and frameworks to drastically enhance team productivity and developer experience. 
 - Cloud Strategy: Direct the architecture and migration initiatives within the AWS ecosystem, ensuring cost-efficiency, scalability, and security. 
 - Move Fast with Stability: Transition teams into high-performing, autonomous units that ship code daily without compromising the integrity of financial transactions. 
 - Metric-Driven Results: Define and track KPIs that correlate engineering output with actual business revenue and user engagement. 
 - Organizational Mentorship
 - Leader of Leaders: Provide direct mentorship and career development for Senior Leaders. 
 - Culture of Excellence: Foster an environment of continuous learning, psychological safety, and technical curiosity. 
 - Bottom-Up Leadership: Empower Senior Leaders to take extreme ownership. Foster a culture where the best ideas win, regardless of hierarchy. 

Candidate Requirements

Education (Mandatory)

Educational & Foundation (Mandatory)

- Academic Excellence: B. Tech / B. E. from a reputed, top-tier institute or a Master of Computer Applications (MCA). 

Experience & Skills

- Years of Experience: 12+ years in Software Development with a progressive track record of leadership. 
 - Domain Expertise: Deep experience in Fintech and Banking (High-volume transactions, security protocols, regulatory compliance). 
 - Full-Stack Vision: Proven experience leading both Front-end and Back-end initiatives simultaneously. 
 - Technical Stack: Strong foundational knowledge in modern microservices, distributed systems, and AWS Migration. 
 - Communication: Elite communication skills; able to influence senior business stakeholders and inspire junior engineers. 

High-Weightage Qualifications

- Demonstrated success in using AI to enhance team efficiency (e. g. , LLM-integrated workflows, automated code synthesis, or AI-driven testing). 
 - Experience transitioning legacy banking systems into modern, cloud-native architectures. 
 - A "Consultative Mindset": The ability to analyze problems from a first-principles perspective and drive data-backed decisions. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Operational Efficiency: 30% improvement in development velocity via AIDLC tools. 
 - System Reliability: Maintaining 99. 99% uptime for critical banking portfolios. 
 - Talent Retention: Reducing attrition among high-potential Senior Managers and Directors. 
 - Stakeholder Satisfaction: High NPS from business partners on the "transparency and predictability" of the delivery pipeline. 

V. Why This Role?

This is a rare opportunity to build a engineering org within the high-stakes world of Finance. You will have the budget of a Tier-1 firm and the autonomy to rewrite the rules of how software is built using AI.
