Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals - serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics - who support our offices globally. Our mantra of "shared innovation, seamless execution, " underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally. 

What Makes Us a Great Place To Work

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. 

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. 

Who You'll Work With

This position works as a member of software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain's most strategic internal data. Team members work collaboratively to design, build and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain's global users and supporting key business initiatives. 

WHERE YOU'LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

This position works as a member of Bain's internal Software Development group directly supervising and supporting the Data engineers on a team. Individuals in this role would also be responsible for defining the on-going technical roadmap for the team and influencing the choice of technologies and frameworks implemented by the engineers. 

What You'll Do

Technical Delivery (50%)

- Lead a scrum team developing and updating applications
 - Lead the planning, testing and implementation of all production releases. Coordinate production releases between scrum teams across the product. Work with System Architect, Data Architect and engineering team members for the configuration and implementation of DevOps and Continues Integration. 
 - Encourage DevOps mindset within the engineering team and facilitates lean production, continuous integration and continuous deployment while working with the System Architect and engineering team members. 
 - Support the team in the evaluation and selection process of the 3rd part components/libraries/ tools together with the Systems Architect and Data Architect. 
 - Provide ongoing support for applications already in use. This includes problem diagnosis and resolution, ad hoc reporting support and database administration. 
 - Provide frequent updates regarding development issues to the TSG leadership and other groups as appropriate. 
 - Participate in product level Steering Committee meetings as appropriate. 
 - Provide technical leadership and facilitate cross-team communication across multiple product scrum teams. 
 - Ensure the proposed technical approaches meet the functional requirements and are in coordination with similar activities across the other product scrum teams. Provide guidance to the scrum team determining the need for new technologies based on the product backlog. 

Team management (25%)

- Manage and supervise between 3-6 direct reports within the development team. These individuals are typically working on the team they directly support. Responsible for the individuals' PD and career development. 
 - Participate in hiring of developers/ engineering team members. 
 - Support individual team members and provide technical input and mentorship to help the team deliver current work in the sprint. Assess and help them improve their engineering practices. 
 - Coach teams and individuals on their understanding of Agile methodologies and Agile practices improving their interactions and ensuring they have the right process and tools for their success. 
 - Promote practices which help with incremental delivery and continuous integration and remove any blockers from achieving incremental delivery. 
 - Work with the Scrum Master to identify teaching and learning opportunities for their direct reports and help the scrum team members to be more T-Shaped. 

Strategy, planning and technology leadership (25%)

- Support the Scrum Master in improving delivery metrics like velocity, responsiveness, predictability, quality, etc. 
 - Advise business and technology partners on technology solutions leveraging emerging technologies and on mitigation of disruption risk. 
 - Prepare and maintain the long-term technology roadmap for the product based on the product vision. Work with the Product Owner, System Architect, Data Architect and engineering team members for its implementation. 

About You

- Experience in software development including work on all aspects of the development life cycle. 
 - Solid understanding of Agile Methodology with experience in managing sprints/ scrums and user stories while using tools such as VSTS, Jira, etc. 
 - Experience architecting applications and working on enterprise-wide systems. 
 - Experience leading technical teams on small to medium size projects. 
 - Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) – Clinical Intelligence
data.description:
Truveta is the world's first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta' s ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values. 

Truveta was born in the Pacific Northwest in the USA and has employees who live across the country. As we expand our global footprint with a new presence in Hyderabad, India, we're building a world-class team to help us scale this mission and Clinical Intelligence and AI Evaluation is at the heart of everything we do. This job requires daily onsite work at our headquarters in Hyderabad, India. 

This Opportunity

Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center (IDC) and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the initial members, you'll help build and scale a high-impact organization while contributing to products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is a unique opportunity to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub. This highly visible position will report to our Director of Clinical Intelligence and AI Evaluation team directly and will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and ML teams across geographies. 

Who We Need

Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex healthcare domain data and technical challenges. Beyond core capabilities, we are seeking problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you. 

This role is ideal for an experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer who can design and deliver our critical internal annotation and administrative platforms to enable high-quality data modelling, clinical note annotation and normalization, LLM-based labelling, concept mapping, operational workflows and model evaluation frameworks across the company. We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex full stack, i. e. , UX, front end, backend and data problems and want to build tools used daily by internal clinical domain and technical experts. 

You will work closely with product managers, architects, security teams, and other engineers to build services that power Truveta's healthcare data platform. As a senior engineer, you will also help shape technical direction, drive engineering best practices, mentor other engineers, and contribute to the long-term reliability, scalability, and maintainability of Truveta's services. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the design, build, and maintain full-stack features for clinical data annotation and internal tooling platforms. 
 - Partner with product managers, architects, security teams, and other engineers to define and deliver reliable platform capabilities. 
 - Make sound technical decisions that balance scalability, performance, security, reliability, and delivery speed. 
 - Participate in and lead design reviews, architecture discussions, code reviews, debugging, on-call rotation and production issue resolution. 
 - Implement advanced UI interactions such as text highlighting, tagging, categorization, and review workflows. 
 - Build backend services that support high-quality data modelling, clinical note annotation and normalization, LLM-based labelling, concept mapping, operational workflows and model evaluation frameworks. 
 - Collaborate with ML engineers to translate annotation requirements into scalable solutions for LLM based model development and improve model performance. 
 - Optimize UX performance for high-volume data and concurrent users. 
 - Mentor engineers, provide technical guidance, and help improve team practices. 
 - Communicate on the status of various projects and collaborate with multidisciplinary stakeholders to ensure that clinical data projects are successfully executed and delivered. 

Required Skills

- Graduate or Masters level educational degree in computer science, data science, clinical informatics, health information management, clinical research, data analysis or related fields. 
 - 5+ years of demonstrated professional software development experience, including, 
 - Hands-on programming experience with C# and . Net/. Net Core, 
 - Front end development experience with React and TypeScript, 
 - State management frameworks such as Redux, 
 - Backend experience using NestJS (Node. js) and/or C#/. NET 
 - Familiarity with RESTful API design and modern service architectures. 
 - Strong proficiency in SQL, data structures, at least one statistical programming language (R or Python), familiar with Spark bigdata analytics environments, GenAI tools, for data wrangling, analysis, and reproducible research workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of software engineering practices including unit testing, code reviews, debugging, source control, CI/CD, and production service ownership. 
 - Solid understanding of security concepts such as authentication, authorization, secrets management, secure API design, and data protection. 
 - working with customers or research teams to translate their asks into executable analytical code, rigorous quality analytical datasets, deliver high quality research analyses. 
 - Strong hands-on problem-solving skills, troubleshoot and identify data or methodological issues early and communicate them effectively. Have ownership, accountability and reliability mindset. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain analytical approaches and findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Ability to learn and adapt quickly in a dynamic start-up environment and a good team-player. 
 - Willingness to learn new analytical tools, programming languages, and proprietary platforms used to analyze real-world data. 

Preferred Qualifications

These qualifications are preferred but not required, please do not let them stop you from applying for this role. You will likely get the opportunity to learn how to do these more advanced analyses if you don't already have experience with them. 

- Hands-on experience with Azure services. 
 - Experience building scalable services using ASP. NET Core, Web API, or similar frameworks. 
 - Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, queues, messaging, or data pipelines. 
 - Experience with large-scale data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized application deployment. 
 - Experience with observability tools and practices, including logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and service health monitoring. 
 - Experience improving service reliability, performance, scalability, and operational excellence. 
 - Experience working with healthcare, data platforms, analytics platforms, or regulated environments. 
 - Interest in building reliable software that improves healthcare outcomes and helps save lives with data. 
 - Experience working with unstructured clinical data or natural language processing outputs 
 - conducting analyses using large healthcare datasets (e. g. , electronic health records, clinical notes or other real-world data sources consisting of millions of patients' data. ) optimized to handle large volumes of text, structured and unstructured data and complex review workflows. 

Why Truveta?

Be a part of building something special. Now is the perfect time to join Truveta. We have strong, established leadership with decades of success. We are well-funded. We are building a culture that prioritizes people and their passions across personal, professional and everything in between. We are expanding our global footprint. Join us as we build an amazing company together. 

Truveta is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and empowering workplace. We believe that having employees, interns, and contractors with diverse backgrounds enables Truveta to better meet our mission and serve patients and health communities around the world. We recognize that opportunities in technology historically excluded and continue to disproportionately exclude people from some sections, people of color, people from working class backgrounds, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people. We strongly encourage individuals with these identities to apply even if you don't meet all of the requirements.

data.description:
The Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst is an intermediate level position responsible for participation in the establishment and implementation of new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to applications systems analysis and programming activities. 

Job Specification: 

We are seeking a Java Engineer to fill the role of 'Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst' on the XiNG large scale distributed calculation platform (XiP). 

In this role you will design, build, and maintain the software that manages and controls the XiP platform. This engine is responsible for 1. 5 billion risk & suitability calculations at Citi every day. The calculation engine at the core of XiP is both highly performant and rapidly changing to support new scenarios, technologies, and infrastructure. 

As an engineer working on XiP, you will work on a platform which daily; coordinates hundreds of thousands of pods, consumes tens of thousands of compute cores, utilizes hundreds of TB of memory, and distributes hundreds of millions of calculations. 

You will work closely with software engineers, DevOps, and our customers to ensure reliable, secure, and scalable operations of the platform. 

Responsibilities: 

Take part of the shared responsibility for the long-term strategic direction of the XiP Platform: 

Apply your experience and skills to develop the future versions of the calculation engine. This means making it faster, utilize resources better, and scale to even greater sizes. This means adding new features without impacting performance of the platform in undesirable manner, small changes multiplied by millions of calculations have a high cost. This means solving hard problems like transferring small amounts of data to a huge number of machines. 

Collaborate and innovate within the team: 

Work as a key member of the development team responsible for the next generation of XiP. Participate actively in the team's Agile/Scrum ceremonies, contribute to technical discussions, and share your knowledge with peers to solve complex challenges and drive the project forward. 

Implement changes and improvements to Citi's Risk Calculation Engine, including analyzing and designing improvements to the distribution mechanisms of the engine which regularly parallelizes 250, 000 hours of compute into a single 90-minute execution: 

Lead the design, development, and implementation of enhancements to the Risk Calculation Engine, focusing on optimizing its distribution mechanisms. Analyze current parallelization strategies and identify opportunities to further improve efficiency, scalability, and throughput. 

Plan, coordinate, and execute strategic changes to the engine to reach the next scaling milestone: 

Develop and manage strategic initiatives aimed at scaling the Risk Calculation Engine to meet future business demands. Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure that all scaling efforts are aligned with customer needs. 

Qualifications: 

- 7+ years of professional software development experience with Java. 
 - Solid experience with Java frameworks (e. g. , Spring, Spring Boot, Quarkus). 
 - Exposure to cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization (e. g. , Docker, Kubernetes).

 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices is a plus.

Role Description

We are looking for an experienced QA Engineer - Generative AI & Agentic AI to lead quality assurance activities for GenAI and Agentic AI solutions. 

This role goes beyond traditional functional testing. The successful candidate will be responsible for validating the correctness, reliability, quality, and production-readiness of AI-generated outputs, including multi-step agent workflows, Text-to-SQL pipelines, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, and LLM-based applications. 

The ideal candidate will have hands-on, production-grade experience testing GenAI/Agentic AI applications end-to-end and should have successfully supported at least one production release of a GenAI or Agentic AI solution. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test strategies for GenAI and Agentic AI applications, covering functional, non-functional, integration, and AI output-quality testing. 
 - Test multi-step agentic workflows, validating agent orchestration, tool/function calls, task completion, chained decision-making, reasoning consistency, and outputs across individual agent hops. 
 - Evaluate AI-generated outputs for correctness, relevance, coherence, hallucination, consistency, and reliability.

 - Natural language to SQL generation accuracy
 - SQL syntax and logic
 - Schema/table/column alignment
 - Query execution

 - Retrieval relevance

About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

The Ping Identity Data Platform team is building the next generation of enterprise AI governance capabilities to enable secure, scalable, and responsible adoption of AI agents. The team is evolving governance frameworks, platforms, and operational processes to manage AI agents across the enterprise, addressing key areas such as security, compliance, identity, risk management, and responsible AI. 

As part of our Data Platform team, you will help define and implement next-generation QA automation and AI-driven testing capabilities across our platform. You will build intelligent test automation frameworks, leverage AI to improve test coverage and accelerate defect detection, and automate validation across APIs, services, workflows, and end-to-end customer scenarios. You will work closely with engineering, product, security, and other cross-functional teams to drive quality from design through delivery, while exploring innovative AI-driven approaches to make our testing more intelligent, scalable, and efficient. 

You Will: 

- Design, develop, and maintain QA automation frameworks and automated test suites covering Identity Governance capabilities such as certifications, lifecycle management, workflows, and Separation of Duties (SoD), ensuring high-quality and reliable product releases. 
 - Build and enhance AI-driven test automation capabilities that leverage AI/LLMs to generate test scenarios, expand test coverage, identify potential defects, analyze failures, and accelerate the overall software testing lifecycle. 
 - Create automated validation for AI agents, tools, MCP servers, workflows, APIs, and enterprise integrations, including functional, integration, regression, performance, security, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Contribute to rapid prototyping and iteration of AI-powered testing solutions, while learning and adopting evolving AI frameworks, testing tools, agentic technologies, and industry best practices. 
 - Leverage AI coding assistants and agentic development tools to improve test automation productivity, accelerate test development, generate meaningful test data and scenarios, and improve test coverage while maintaining modularity, maintainability, observability, and code quality. 
 - Develop intelligent automation for test failure analysis, defect detection, root-cause identification, and regression analysis, reducing manual investigation and improving feedback cycles. 
 - Collaborate with Engineering, Support, Product, Security, and customer-facing teams to troubleshoot issues, reproduce customer scenarios, identify root causes, and deliver automated regression coverage to prevent recurring issues. 
 - Develop automated tests to validate AI agent performance, usage, operational health, security, and reliability across supported AI platforms and integrations. 
 - Contribute to automated logging, metrics, monitoring, and observability validation, ensuring AI agents and governance capabilities meet operational and compliance requirements. 
 - Explore and evaluate emerging AI testing and agentic automation frameworks, interoperability standards such as MCP and Agent-to-Agent communication, and technologies that can enable autonomous or intelligent QA automation. 
 - Continuously identify opportunities to replace manual testing with scalable, reliable, and AI-driven automation, improving release confidence, test coverage, execution speed, and overall engineering efficiency. 
 - Document technical designs, automation frameworks, test strategies, implementation details, operational procedures, and QA engineering best practices. 

You Have: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8+ years of experience in software engineering, QA automation, test engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Strong programming experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Java. 
 - Strong proficiency with Google Cloud, AWS, and other cloud infrastructure technologies, including testing and troubleshooting cloud-based distributed systems. 
 - Strong experience designing, building, adapting, and maintaining scalable QA automation frameworks and test harnesses using tools such as Jest, Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Demonstrated ability to rapidly create new test harnesses, adapt existing automation to new architectures and product requirements, and continuously improve test coverage and execution efficiency. 
 - Strong experience owning test strategy and test inventory, including exploratory testing, functional testing, regression testing, mini-regression testing, end-to-end testing, and release validation. 
 - Strong ability to analyze failures, establish reproducible test scenarios, collaborate closely with Engineering on root-cause analysis and verification, report test/release status, and drive efficient, high-quality releases. 

Life at Ping: 

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We're growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that's who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special: 

- A company culture that empowers you to do your best work. 
 - Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone. 
 - Regular company and team bonding events. 
 - Competitive benefits and perks. 
 - Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits: 

- Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule 
 - Parental Leave
 - Progressive Healthcare Options
 - Retirement Programs
 - Opportunity for Education Reimbursement 
 - Commuter Offset (Specific locations)

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone's individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self. 

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

data.title: Risk User Acceptance Testing Senior Associate
data.description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We're committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve. 

Pay And Benefits

- Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
 - Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
 - Pension / Retirement benefits
 - Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. 
 - DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee). 

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

As a member of the Financial Risk & Governance (FR&G) Testing Team, the Senior Associate will lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) across FR&G functions. This role plays a critical part in validating system enhancements, risk tooling, regulatory‐driven changes, and new technology solutions prior to production deployment. 

The Senior Associate will lead UAT planning and execution for releases, including defining UAT scope/approach, coordinating stakeholder engagement, ensuring audit-ready sign-off. This role will work closely with Risk Users, Product Owners, Technology Delivery Teams, and Business Analysts to ensure new capabilities meet the expectations and control needs of the Financial Risk & Governance organization prior to production release. Testing is performed in a controlled non‐production environment designed to simulate production as closely as possible. 

Success in this role requires a strongly inquisitive mindset, an ability to understand a day‐in‐the‐life of Risk users, and a passion for improving both processes and systems. The Senior Associate will also contribute to the automation of UAT and help increase testing efficiency and repeatability across the organization. 

Your Primary Responsibilities

Integration, Collaboration, and Discovery

- Support an environment that ensures employees understand how their efforts contribute to overall business strategy
 - Manage assigned book of work, partnering with leadership to plan the future supply and demand of resources required
 - Evaluate the testing status of assigned projects while identifying and escalating critical risks
 - Partner closely with Financial Risk and Governance teams to understand functional workflows, risk processes, and control expectations. 
 - Collaborate with Product Owners and Delivery Teams to shape epic‐level acceptance criteria, ensuring they properly reflect FR&G user needs and regulatory considerations. 
 - Develop a strong understanding of end‐to‐end risk processes, including how users interact with systems, data, and controls. 
 - Partner with team to ensure maintenance of UAT templates and test logs in approved repositories in accordance with record‐retention standards. 
 - Maintain UAT templates and test logs in approved repositories in accordance with record‐retention standards. 

UAT Planning, Execution and Governance

- Drive UAT status governance (daily/regular reporting, risk/issues escalation, defect triage coordination) within Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) or similar lifecycle tools, ensuring all acceptance criteria are validated. 
 - Mentor testers; standardize templates, evidence expectations, and execution discipline. 
 - Define UAT approach/plan for assigned projects and oversee execution across testers/workstreams
 - Lead UAT scope definition, user acceptance validation, and support change/release readiness decisions. 
 - Ensure final UAT package is complete (templates, statistics, evidence) and stored appropriately at end of UAT. 
 - Analyze and interpret business requirements, risk policies, and control objectives to develop comprehensive user test plans and test cases. 
 - Review test plans and cases with business partners and obtain sign‐off to confirm comprehensive test coverage aligns with approved UAT scope and established entry criteria. 
 - Execute UAT in representative non‐production environments, ensuring functional behavior aligns with expectations and supports control effectiveness. 
 - Discover, report, and track defects using JIRA, collaborating with delivery teams on resolution and retesting. 
 - Validate system behavior not only for "happy path" (ideal, expected flow) scenarios but also for risk‐sensitive, exception‐mode, and control‐triggering scenarios. 
 - Contribute to the automation of UAT test cases, partnering with QA, engineering, or automation teams as needed. 

**NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. **

Qualifications

- Minimum 6 years of related experience leading SIT/UAT planning and execution and supporting signoffs in a controlled environment
 - Bachelor's degree (preferred) or equivalent experience

Talents Needed For Success

- Understanding of distributed and/or mainframe test environments. 
 - Familiarity with SDLC/SILC, Agile, Kanban, ALM, and JIRA. 
 - Strong curiosity and desire to understand complex risk workflows. 
 - Experience in Financial Risk, Operational Risk, Model Risk, or Governance preferred. 
 - Experience in estimating, prioritizing, and planning testing activities
 - Experience presenting to business users/stakeholders
 - Experience with Intermediate MS Excel

Willingness to build and expand skills in automation and quality assurance. 

- High attention to detail and strong documentation discipline. 
 - Ability to think critically, ask insightful questions, and challenge assumptions. 

Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced and technically accomplished Technical Director to technically lead our Geotechnics & Tunnelling capability. The role will provide technical leadership across major infrastructure projects, oversee the delivery of complex geotechnical and tunnelling assignments, mentor technical teams, and contribute to the strategic growth of the business. 

The successful candidate will be recognised as a trusted technical authority, capable of influencing project outcomes, developing technical excellence within the team, and strengthening client relationships across the UK, Middle East, and global markets. 

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

- Act as a Technical Director and Subject Matter Expert for geotechnical and tunnelling projects. 
 - Provide technical oversight and assurance on complex geotechnical designs, assessments, reports, and technical deliverables. 
 - Lead the technical delivery of major infrastructure projects, ensuring quality, consistency, and compliance with industry standards. 
 - Review and authorise high-value and high-risk technical outputs. 
 - Drive technical excellence, innovation, and best practice across the geotechnical and tunnelling disciplines. 
 - Develop and implement technical standards, procedures, and design guidance. 

Project Delivery

- Lead multidisciplinary project teams in the delivery of complex geotechnical and tunnelling projects. 
 - Support project directors and project managers in managing technical risks, programme delivery, and commercial performance.

Program Execution & Stakeholder Management; 

Partner with business, product, and architecture teams to define roadmaps and prioritiesManage multiple concurrent initiatives and cross-team dependenciesDrive execution visibility, manage risks, and communicate effectively with leadership

Continuous Improvement & Strategy;

Qualifications

12-15+ years of experience in software engineering5+ years of experience leading engineering teams Proven experience in large-scale, distributed enterprise systems Strong experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery models Experience managing onshore/offshore and vendor teams

data.description:
Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world's leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM's product and technology landscape. Here, you'll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

Backend engineers at Confluent work on a set of diverse and complex challenges such as building foundational cloud frameworks and services that power all components of the platform in the Cloud. We are building a new multi-tenant, multi-cloud, polyglot, cloud native compute substrate to enable new business opportunities across Confluent Cloud (including Connect, Apache Flink, Kafka and more) . 

As a Senior Software Engineer, you think strategically and you help drive end-to-end technical delivery from customer experience to scaling internal operations. You are not confined to the status quo and you leverage your expertise in Cloud-native, large-scale distributed systems to help take our platform to the next level. You worry about key operational aspects (availability, reliability, performance, monitoring, emergency response, capacity planning, disaster recovery) of our new Compute Platform, and you make sure that we have a highly-available, resilient and secure offering that our largest customers can rely on. 

What You Will Do

- Build mission-critical backend services that deliver value to our customers. You will play a crucial role in architecting, designing, developing and operationalizing high performance, scalable, reliable and resilient services
 - Design, develop, and maintain Kafka Connect connectors for integrating with databases and data warehouses (e. g. , PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake). 
 - Work with open source technologies like Debezium and Kafka Connect to implement Change Data Capture (CDC) connectors. 
 - Troubleshoot and debug technical issues inside a deep and complex technical stack that includes microservices, containers, and virtualization
 - Ensure operational readiness of the services and meet the availability and performance SLA commitments to our customers
 - A strategic engineer who constantly thinks of process and operational improvements

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

5+ years industry experience designing, building, scaling and supporting backend systems in production with a solid grasp on good software engineering practices such as code reviews, deep focus on quality, and documentation. 

Strong programming and algorithmic skills. 

Proficiency in a major programming language, e. g. Java, Go, C / C++, Python, etc. 

Experience configuring and deploying distributed systems and microservices using modern tools, e. g. Kubernetes, Helm, etc. 

Strong focus on project delivery and communication skills. 

Experience in driving operational excellence for large, production services. 

A strong sense of customer centricity, teamwork, technical leadership and mentorship and are excited about team and company success. BS, MS, or PhD in computer science or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Proven track record of delivering large-scale, highly available, low latency, high quality systems. 

Hands-on technical expertise in large scale systems engineering or distributed systems.

Agile Dev Team Members have collective responsibility for the design, development, testing and/or deployment of system functionality. Execute Test-Driven (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) to build in quality. Performs broad and detailed impact assessments relating people, processes and/or technology to evaluate work. Identify and raise issues and risks with functional design and offer alternative solutions. Works with the Product Owner to confirm the code and acceptance tests reflect the desired functionality. Analyzes and documents the requirements and approaches to data conversion and data modeling. Quality checks program code, related objects and documentation. Delivers working code each sprint. Identifies complex errors that occur in application testing and analyzing results to trouble shoot and execute root cause analysis. Conducts ongoing assessment of current state and seeks out opportunities for improvement. Offers and implements innovative ideas within multiple areas of focus. data.title: Senior Quality Engineer
data.description:
About StarRez

StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1, 400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user-friendly, all-in-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner. 

Role: 

As a Senior Quality Engineer - you will play a pivotal role in elevating our quality practices across StarRez communication, Marketplace, System Administration and Maintenance systems. You will be an expert within our product engineering organization, deeply understanding user and product behaviour, customer journeys, business rules, and the systems that support StarRez personas. This role will balance hands-on individual contributor responsibilities with leading, influencing, and coaching your peers. 

This individual contributor role is for someone who is passionate about seeing systems holistically, has a strong vision for product quality, and is eager to drive the highest standards of customer experience, functional correctness, usability, accessibility, reliability, performance, and release confidence. You will leverage your deep understanding of SaaS product behaviour, end-to-end workflows, integrations, environments, and customer operations to guide and influence our development process. 

Your role is not to manage a team, but to be a quality champion who partners directly with developers, product managers, designers, support, implementation, and customer-facing teams. You will help teams anticipate risk, clarify expected behaviour, validate business logic, protect the customer experience, and build more robust, scalable, and reliable conference and event products. At the core of this role is a strong focus on the customer experience; success means our platform behaves predictably, is easy to use, and enables our resident communities to thrive. 

What You Will Own: 

- Own and drive end-to-end quality for the StarRez Foundations product team. 
 - Champion StarRez's quality standards by establishing, maintaining, and advocating for quality gates and rapid feedback loops throughout the software delivery lifecycle. 
 - Design and execute testing, validation and risk mitigation strategies for feature related initiatives. 
 - Partner with Product, Design and Engineering from ideation through delivery to ensure acceptance criteria, personas, customer journeys, test data, edge cases, non-functional expectations, and quality gates reflect real customer operations and the intended product experience. 
 - Champion shift-left quality culture by mentoring developers, product managers, and design partners on testing principles, behavioural specifications, clear acceptance criteria, early validation, fast feedback loops, and production-quality observability. 
 - Work effectively with ambiguity, proactively designing quality solutions based on evidence when clear requirements, behaviour definitions, customer workflow expectations, or quality baselines do not yet exist. 
 - Champion test automation best practices, create clear testing standards, and coach engineers to take shared ownership of building and maintaining automated tests. 
 - Apply AI tools and techniques to improve product quality and enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of quality engineering practices and processes. 
 - Own production defect triage for your product domain, partnering with Engineering, Product, and Support to assess impact, prioritise fixes, identify root causes, and drive preventative quality improvements. 

Required Qualifications: 

- 5+ years of progressive software engineering or quality engineering with deep focus on quality in complex, distributed systems environments
 - SQL. Required for test data setup, backend validation, data integrity checks across integrations, and root cause analysis. 
 - Tech stack context (. NET/C#, SQL Server, Azure). 
 - API testing tooling (Postman, REST Assured, or similar). 
 - Cloud platform exposure (Azure/AWS). 
 - Proven track record advocating for quality and ability to influence technical direction through innovative, pragmatic, and evidence-based approaches. 
 - Hands-on experience working with web-based products, including front-end behaviour, API, service integration and functional end-to-end testing. 
 - Experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium. 
 - Practical experience integrating automated tests and quality checks into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub, Build-kite, or similar platforms. 
 - Experience contributing to deployment and release quality gates, including test suite selection, environment readiness checks. 
 - Genuine curiosity and passion for understanding product architecture, user experience flows, customer workflows, analytics use cases, and the business impact of engineering and data decisions. 
 - Experience utilising AI in modern software development. 

Reasons to join our team: 

- Opportunity to be a part of a well-established, high-performance company that has been in business for over 30+ years
 - Full benefits including health care, paid time off, and others
 - A supportive team environment with emphasis on learning and development opportunities
 - Our Promise: You will learn, grow, and be appreciated for your impact and contributions. 
 - Z-Factor: Our most celebrated value, you will work with a team of caring, high-performing, and passionate people who have fun supporting our vision, innovation, and continuous improvement. 

Even if you don't have all of the Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!

StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

- Lead the Engineering, Maintenance, Utilities, Instrumentation, Electrical, Civil, and Projects teams to deliver operational excellence. 
 - Establish and enforce engineering standards, systems, and best practices across the site. 
 - Drive a culture of safety, reliability, accountability, and continuous improvement throughout the engineering function.

 - Shape a high-performing, multi-disciplinary team in a dynamic chemical production environment.

The Life Sciences R&D department consists of around 200 engineers developing Electron Microscopy (EM) solutions and applications that help our customers make the world cleaner, healthier, and safer. As a Software Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of software engineers responsible for the design, development, and lifecycle of a key application within the cryo-EM workflow. This application plays a critical role in enabling scientists to process, analyze, and interpret microscopy data. 

This is a hands-on leadership role combining people management with technical leadership. You will guide the team's day-to-day execution while actively shaping architecture, engineering practices, and technical direction. 

You will work closely with product owners, scientists, and other engineering teams across sites to deliver high-quality software and continuously improve the way we build and operate our systems.

Collaboration & Impact

- Work closely with cross-functional teams, including scientists, application specialists, and other engineering groups

Education And Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

 - Experience managing or mentoring engineers (formal or informal leadership) 
 - Strong understanding of software architecture, design principles, and development practices 
 - Hands-on experience with modern development tools and practices (e. g. , version control, CI/CD, automated testing)

Nice to Have

- Experience with scientific software, imaging, or data-intensive applications 
 - Familiarity with Python, C++, or similar languages used in high-performance or scientific computing

Join us in advancing cryo-electron microscopy technologies that enable groundbreaking discoveries in structural biology and drug development. You will work in a collaborative, international environment where your contributions directly impact scientific innovation and real-world outcomes.

The role will provide technical leadership, people management and client-facing governance across the complete commissioning lifecycle from L0-L6, with a strong focus on L4 Functional Performance Testing (FPT) and L5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST). 

This position is site-centric and requires hands-on leadership through Integrated Systems Testing, including failure mode and fault tolerance validation, ensuring systems meet design intent, availability objectives and operational readiness requirements in line with Uptime Institute, IEC, IEEE, and NFPA standards. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of 15-20+ leads and commissioning engineers.

data.title: Manager- Quality
data.description:
ABOUT EURONICS

Euronics Industries Pvt. Ltd. is India's #1 washroom automation brand. Since 2002, we have built hand dryers, sensor taps, urinal sensors, soap dispensers, washroom panels and allied hygiene solutions trusted by 5, 00, 000+ customers. With a 2. 5 lakh sq ft manufacturing facility in Gurugram, 750+ SKUs and 70-80% of our products Made in India, our solutions are installed at landmark sites including the New Parliament Building, the Supreme Court of India and 18+ airports. 

ROLE PURPOSE

The Deputy Manager - Quality ensures every product leaving Euronics Industries and Techwork meets specification, certification and customer expectations. You will build one common, data-driven quality system across both entities, reduce the cost of poor quality, and keep ISO 9001 and BIS/ISI compliance audit-ready at all times. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Multi-Entity Quality Governance (Euronics + Techwork)

- Own and harmonise quality policies, SOPs, inspection standards and acceptance criteria across both entities. 
 - Run a single monthly Quality Review for both entities with shared KPIs, defect Pareto and action tracker. 
 - Allocate QC manpower and inspection capacity between entities based on production plans and risk. 

2. Quality Management System & Certifications

- Maintain the ISO 9001 QMS: document control, internal audits, management reviews and surveillance audit readiness. 
 - Ensure continuous compliance with BIS/ISI licence conditions, including product testing, marking and records. 
 - Support other product and green certifications held by the company and new certification projects. 
 - Act as the main point of contact for external auditors and certification bodies. 

3. Incoming, In-Process & Final Quality Control

- Define inspection plans, AQL sampling plans and checklists for bought-out parts, sub-assemblies and finished goods. 
 - Oversee incoming inspection of electrical, electronic, stainless steel, plastic and PVD-finished components. 
 - Drive in-process controls on assembly lines, including electrical safety, functional and endurance testing. 
 - Approve final product release (PDI) and block non-conforming lots. 

4. Supplier Quality Management

- Qualify new vendors through audits, PPAP / first article inspection and sample approval. 
 - Monitor supplier PPM and rating; run SCAR and development plans for poor performers. 
 - Coordinate quality checks for imported components with Purchase. 

5. Problem Solving, CAPA & Customer Complaints

- Lead root cause analysis using 8D, 5-Why, Fishbone and FMEA for internal defects, field failures and complaints. 
 - Close CAPA within agreed timelines and verify effectiveness. 
 - Partner with Service and Projects teams on site failure analysis and warranty return trends. 

6. Continuous Improvement & Cost of Poor Quality

- Track and reduce rework, scrap, rejections and warranty cost (COPQ). 
 - Deploy SPC, Poka-Yoke, 7 QC tools and Kaizen on critical processes. 
 - Support New Product Development with design reviews, DFMEA / PFMEA and pilot lot validation. 

7. Digital Quality & Reporting

- Move inspection records, NCRs and CAPA from paper to a digital system (dashboards, QMS software or ERP module). 
 - Publish a weekly quality MIS and a monthly dashboard for leadership. 
 - Identify automation opportunities: digital checklists, test-data capture and auto-alerts for repeat defects. 

8. Team Leadership & Calibration

- Lead, coach and evaluate QC engineers and inspectors across both entities; maintain a quality skill matrix. 
 - Train production operators on quality standards, first-time-right and defect awareness; drive 5S discipline. 
 - Maintain calibration schedule and traceability for all gauges, instruments and test equipment.

The successful candidate will play a key role in validating, characterizing, and optimizing RF performance of Bluetooth and IEEE 802. 15. 4 products across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) variations. This role provides a unique opportunity to influence product performance from early silicon through production by driving RF tuning, performance closure, calibration optimization, and characterization activities in close collaboration with RFIC, modem, firmware, and systems engineering teams. 

Your role

Key responsibilities in your new role

- Lead end-to-end RF validation activities for Bluetooth and IEEE 802. 15. 4 wireless connectivity solutions, ensuring high-performance and standards-compliant products. 
 - Define and execute comprehensive RF validation strategies, test plans, and coverage for performance, protocol compliance, and interoperability requirements. 
 - Drive RF characterization and optimization across Process, Voltage, and Temperature (PVT) variations to ensure robust product performance. 
 - Evaluate RF sensitivity to silicon process variations and implement improvements to enhance performance margins and reliability. 
 - Collaborate closely with RFIC and modem design teams to optimize RF performance and achieve specification compliance across all operating conditions. 
 - Conduct performance closure activities and establish production guard bands through detailed characterization and statistical analysis. 
 - Investigate and resolve complex RF, silicon, firmware, and system-level issues using data-driven debugging methodologies. 
 - Develop, automate, and maintain RF validation, characterization, and regression test frameworks to improve efficiency and scalability.

 - Solid understanding of RF transceiver architectures, wireless communication protocols, and system-level interactions. 
 - Proven experience using industry-standard RF test and measurement equipment for characterization and validation activities.

data.title: Software Engineering Manager — Funded Development
data.description:
Department: Engineering

Location: Ahmedabad/GiftCity

Description

We are looking for a hands-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD - the cross-functional team accountable for delivering customer-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements. 

This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code - reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems - while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD's core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require. 

Key Responsibilities

- Delivery & stakeholder ownership - Own end-to-end delivery of customer-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership. 
 - Hands-on technical leadership & design - Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non-trivial customer-funded features and review designs produced by the team - ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C++, and be the escalation-of-last-resort on hard issues. 
 - Cross-component versatility & engineering excellence - Deliver across a broad surface - Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements - as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C++ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer-funded work as first-class product code, not throwaway one-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them. 
 - AI-assisted engineering - Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e. g. , Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use - quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code - and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org. 
 - SE + SQE leadership - Lead a cross-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness. 
 - People management & culture - Line-manage the POD: 1: 1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip. 

Skills, Knowledge And Expertise

Essential Skills & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2+ years managing a mid-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers. 
 - Expert-level hands-on proficiency in modern C++ (C++11 through C++20) - able to review and write production-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance. 
 - Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high-performance, mission-critical, low-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks. 
 - Proven track record delivering complex, customer-committed software projects in an Agile environment - working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows - and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e. g. , Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery - with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don't, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control. 
 - Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar). 
 - Demonstrated success as a people manager - growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations - with excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers. 

Desirable Skills & Experience

- Prior experience leading customer-funded, professional services, or bespoke-delivery engineering teams in a financial-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI. 
 - Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc. ) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation). 
 - Working knowledge of Python for tooling, automation, and test scaffolding; familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containerisation, and cloud technologies as applied to trading-system delivery; background in kernel-bypass / low-latency networking (Solarflare, Onload) or lock-free data structures. 
 - Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team - e. g. , accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage - including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics. 

Benefits

Competitive Benefits & Perks in India We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. 

- Health & Financial Security: 
 - Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
 - Time Off & Flexibility: 
 - Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture. 
 - 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days. 
 - One dedicated day per year for volunteering. 
 - Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development. 
 - An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years. 
 - Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal. 
 - Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents). 
 - Work-Life Support & Resources: 
 - Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment. 
 - Milestone anniversary bonuses. 
 - Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: 
 - Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives. 
 - Our Culture: 
 - Forward-thinking, culture-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion. Trading Technologies (www. tradingtechnologies. com) is a global capital markets platform services company providing market-leading technology for the end-to-end trading operations of Tier 1 banks, brokerages, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company delivers "multi-X" solutions, with "X" representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. This multi-X approach features trade execution services across futures and options, fixed income, foreign exchange (FX), and cryptocurrencies, augmented by solutions for data and analytics, including transaction cost analysis (TCA); quantitative trading; compliance and trade surveillance; clearing and post-trade allocation; and infrastructure services. data.title: Senior Test Analyst
data.description:
Summary of This Role

Carry out procedures to ensure that all applications under test (AUT) meet organizational standards and end-user requirements. Thoroughly test software to ensure proper operation and freedom from defects. Document and work to identify all problems to ensure resolution. Report progress on testing and problem resolution to appropriate parties. Devise improvements to current procedures and develops models of possible future configurations. Perform work flow analysis and recommends quality improvements. 

What Part Will You Play?

- Conducts online, batch and data verification testing (checked for accuracy and inconsistencies after data migration is done) and validates test results. Creates test designs and performs test analysis on complex project requirements (as defined by the client). Coordinates with technical and business resources to identify and resolve complex issues or system defects discovered during the testing and design contingency plans as needed. 
 - Analyzes requirements necessary to design complex testing strategies (testing objective, methods of testing new functions, total time and resources required for the project, and the testing environment) for internal/external clients (i. e. technical and functional designs). Demonstrates extensive knowledge and understanding of structured analysis and design (define user needs) as it relates to the test design. Recognizes the interrelationships between the various functional components of the system (i. e. collections, posting, authorizations) and the business, technical and project requirements in order to determine the appropriate testing methodology to use during test execution and validation. Performs risk analysis requirements for integrated testing (combined and tested as a group). 
 - Identifies and recommends design processes aimed at increased efficiency, performance and reliability (automation, load and performance). Demonstrates a strong working knowledge of automated testing tools used to create test designs and execute test plans. 
 - Works with stakeholders, business, developers and test analysts to develop more intricate test plans, conditions and cases (set of inputs, execution preconditions, and expected outcomes developed for a particular objective, such as to exercise a particular program path or to verify compliance with a specific requirement) to be used in testing. Develops and administers best practices to perform test data conditioning and execution of test sets. Works with programming to create certain account conditions and execute special testing requirements for test validation. Demonstrates a broad knowledge of the multiple environments by evaluating, interpreting and communicating an understanding of the various components of systems and applications to leadership. 
 - Compiles, develops and documents test/defect reports and follows all defects through to resolution and closure. Occasionally reviews documentation such as business and technical specifications in order to ensure that the documentation is updated and accurate. 
 - Maintains and administers procedures, methodology and/or application standards to include payment card industry and security related compliance according to how they are applied in testing activities. 
 - Acts as a single point of contact for assigned moderately complex client projects with regard to test activities. Coordinates the test activities assigned to the test team to include, reviewing of client test plans cases and scripts, prioritizing test execution when necessary and providing feedback to internal and external clients. 

What Are We Looking For in This Role?

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree
 - Relevant Experience or Degree in: Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Business or related field; additional experience in lieu of degree will be considered
 - Typically Minimum 4 Years Relevant Exp
 - Relational databases, Bankcard industry knowledge and IBM Rational tools

Preferred Qualifications

- Typically Minimum 6 Years Relevant Exp
 - Relational databases, Bankcard industry knowledge and IBM Rational tools
 - International Software Testing Qualifications Board (ISTQB) Certification

What Are Our Desired Skills and Capabilities?

- Skills / Knowledge - A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of area of specialization; resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is the fully qualified, career-oriented, journey-level position. 
 - Job Complexity - Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in own area of expertise. 
 - Supervision - Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments. 
 - IBM Mainframe Systems - TSO, JHS, CICS

data.title: Engineering Manager — Advanced Manufacturing Systems (Mechanical)
data.description:
Company Overview - Leumas

Leumas is a venture-funded deep-tech company based in Bengaluru, building modular robotic factories and software-defined manufacturing systems for healthcare products. 

Our R&D ambition is to build the future of drug manufacturing across emerging therapeutic modalities. We are developing new manufacturing modules and technologies for peptide synthesis, oncology applications and other advanced drug-production processes, while exploring Physical AI to make manufacturing systems more capable, adaptive and autonomous. 

This work brings together mechanical engineering, chemistry, process development, electronics, firmware, AI and quality systems. Our engineers translate scientific and process requirements into machines, test them through experiments and develop them toward scalable manufacturing platforms. 

We're looking for a hands-on technical leader who wants to tackle unfamiliar engineering problems, build a strong multidisciplinary team and help define how future medicines will be manufactured. 

Industry Context

Our equipment must combine process performance, flexible configurations, hygienic design and practical manufacturing economics. Development succeeds when new mechanisms work repeatedly across realistic operating conditions. 

The Role

You will lead mechanical and manufacturing-system R&D for Leumas' next generation of technology modules, spanning peptides, oncology applications, Physical AI and emerging drug-manufacturing processes. 

Working closely with scientific, process, electrical, firmware and AI teams, you will translate new process requirements into equipment architectures, experimental systems and deployable manufacturing modules. You will guide development from early feasibility through prototypes, performance verification and transfer toward production. 

This role requires strong mechanical engineering depth, systems thinking and the ability to learn unfamiliar domains quickly. You will build and mentor the engineering team while remaining personally involved in critical designs, experiments and technical decisions. 

What You'll Own

1. Technology roadmap - Translate manufacturing needs into development requirements, technical priorities and measurable acceptance criteria. Plan projects, resources and design milestones with leadership. 

2. Architecture & design - Lead mechanisms, motion systems, product-contact assemblies and modular interfaces. Review materials, tolerances, cleanability, maintainability and cost before releasing designs. 

3. Prototype learning - Plan experiments and instrumented trials; quantify dosing accuracy, throughput, repeatability or other relevant performance. Resolve failure modes through evidence and controlled design iterations. 

4. Cross-functional integration - Agree mechanical, electrical and software interfaces early. Coordinate process constraints, sensors, actuation, guarding and service access through complete-machine trials. 

5. Industrialisation - Own drawing and BOM quality, design-for-manufacture reviews and engineering change discipline. Transfer designs to build teams with assembly, test and operating documentation. 

6. Team & knowledge - Coach engineers, run technical reviews and maintain reusable design knowledge. Support invention documentation and protect confidential engineering information. 

7. New Manufacturing Technologies & Module Architecture - Work with scientists and process experts to understand the manufacturing requirements of new therapeutic modalities. Translate these into equipment concepts, module architectures and development plans. Evaluate technical feasibility, identify critical unknowns and build experiments that establish whether an approach can work. 

8. Physical AI & Adaptive Manufacturing - Collaborate with AI, robotics and controls teams to develop machines that can sense, interpret and respond to physical process conditions. Own the mechanical systems, actuation, sensing provisions and interfaces needed to test these capabilities. Establish measurable performance targets and appropriate safeguards with the responsible teams. 

You're a Fit If

·            BE/BTech, ME/Mtech, PHD in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related discipline; typically 8-12 years in machine design and product development, including technical team leadership. A strong academic foundation from a leading engineering institution such as IITs, IISc, BITS or leading NITs is preferred. 

·            Track record delivering machines from requirements through prototypes, testing and manufacturing release. 

·            Strong fundamentals in mechanisms, machine elements, tolerances, materials and engineering analysis, with practical CAD proficiency. 

·            Ability to balance experimentation with schedules and lead cross-functional decisions using test evidence. 

·            You have developed novel machines or complex hardware where the solution was not fully defined at the outset. 

·            You can translate scientific or process requirements into engineering problems and work effectively with experts outside your discipline. 

·            You understand how mechanical design, sensing, actuation and software interact in a complete system. 

·            You can distinguish early technical feasibility from equipment ready for reliable manufacturing.
