data.title: Associate Director, PC and Logistics Quality
data.description:
We are Licious and we are a Bengaluru based meat and seafood company founded in 2015 by Abhay Hanjura and Vivek Gupta, our founders, foodies and friends. We pride ourselves on being India's most successful D2C food-tech brand operating in 20 cities across the country delighting over 32 lac customers with our de-licious fresh meat and seafood!

Think you have what it takes to be the magic ingredient in the recipe that is Licious? Read on. . . 

What makes the role meaty?

We are looking for a Quality, Processing Centres to lead Quality across our 5 Processing Centres and build a robust, scalable quality framework across the processing value chain. 

This is a central quality leadership role, based out of the Corporate Office and reporting directly to the Chief Quality Officer. The Factory Quality Heads will report into this role. 

The starting point will be the journey of cut chicken entering the Processing Centre through cutting, packing, storage and dispatch. Over time, the role will have the opportunity to expand its scope across categories, processes and the broader fresh supply chain. 

The role will require someone who can operate at both strategic and ground level-setting the right standards while being comfortable going into factories, understanding the reality on the floor and driving change. 

What will you own?

1. Build the next level of Quality maturity

- Define and drive a consistent Quality framework across all Processing Centres. 
 - Standardise processes, quality benchmarks, controls and ways of working across factories. 
 - Identify gaps in the current Quality maturity and build a roadmap to move the function to the next level. 
 - Ensure quality systems are scalable as the business grows in volume, categories and complexity. 
 - Build a culture where Quality is embedded into operations rather than being a final checkpoint. 2. Own quality across the processing journey

Starting with cut chicken, drive quality across: 

Raw Material Receipt → Cutting → Processing → Packing → Storage → Dispatch

- Define what should be accepted, rejected or held at every critical stage. 
 - Build clear decision-making frameworks and specifications for quality teams. 
 - Strengthen in-process controls and ensure consistent execution across factories. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions for recurring quality issues. 
 - Partner closely with Operations to balance quality, availability, cost and customer expectations. 3. Build end-to-end traceability

Fresh sourcing comes with unique challenges. The quality of the final product starts much before it reaches the factory. 

The opportunity is to build a robust traceability model covering: 

Farm / Source → Procurement → Processing Centre → Processing → Packing → Storage → Customer

- Build stronger visibility of where raw material comes from and how it moves through the network. 
 - Work with Sourcing, Operations, Technology and other stakeholders to create an integrated traceability framework. 
 - Move from fragmented traceability systems to a more end-to-end model. 
 - Explore opportunities to make product-level information available to consumers through digital/QR-led solutions. 
 - Support pilots that can eventually allow customers to understand the history and source of the product they purchase. 4. Quality of Fresh Raw Material

Fresh sourcing is one of the biggest quality challenges in the business. 

The role will work closely with Sourcing and Operations to answer critical questions such as: 

- What raw material should we accept?
 - What should be rejected?
 - What deviations can be managed and how?
 - How do we make these decisions consistently across locations?
 - How do we ensure the quality standard at source translates into the quality of the final product?Build strong quality specifications, acceptance criteria and escalation mechanisms that can be consistently applied across the network. 

5. Lead the Factory Quality organisation

- Lead and coach the 5 Factory Quality Heads. 
 - Build capability across the wider 70-80 member Quality team. 
 - Ensure the right structure, talent and capability are in place as the network scales. 
 - Develop succession plans and a strong talent pipeline for Quality leadership roles. 
 - Create clear accountability and performance metrics across factory Quality teams. 
 - Build a high-performing Quality organisation that can operate effectively at greater scale and complexity. 6. Drive Quality through data and technology

- Build meaningful Quality dashboards and leading indicators across factories. 
 - Move from reactive quality reporting to early identification of quality risks. 
 - Use data to identify recurring issues, factory-level trends and systemic gaps. 
 - Partner with Technology/Data teams to improve visibility, traceability and quality reporting. 
 - Explore digital quality checks and real-time reporting mechanisms wherever relevant. 7. Cross-functional leadership

Work closely with: 

Sourcing | Operations | Production | Supply Chain | Technology | Category | Customer Experience

to ensure Quality is considered across the entire product journey. 

The role will need to influence stakeholders beyond the Quality function and drive decisions that improve both customer experience and operational outcomes. 

What success looks like

Over time, you will help Licious build: 

- A consistent Quality standard across all Processing Centres
 - Stronger source-to-factory quality controls
 - Clear and data-backed accept/reject decision frameworks
 - End-to-end traceability across the fresh supply chain
 - Stronger visibility into quality risks before they reach the customer
 - A scalable Quality organisation and leadership pipeline
 - Better factory-level quality maturity and accountability
 - A foundation that can scale with the business as categories, volumes and complexity grow

We hope that you have

- 10-15 years of experience in Quality, preferably in food manufacturing, fresh food, FMCG, meat/seafood, dairy or other high-volume food processing environments. 
 - Strong experience managing Quality across multiple factories/plants. 
 - Experience leading Quality Heads/Managers and larger quality teams. 
 - Strong understanding of food processing, HACCP, GMP, food safety and quality systems. 
 - Experience building or improving Quality systems in a growing/scale-up environment. 
 - Strong understanding of raw material quality and supplier/source-level quality. 
 - Experience with traceability, quality data and process standardisation will be an advantage. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills. 
 - Ability to work comfortably between strategy, factory floors and execution. 
 - Willingness to travel extensively across Processing Centres, particularly during the first 6 months.

data.title: Vehicle Test Integration-ADAS
data.description: Business Unit: EPSMobilityRole: Vehicle Integration Engineer - ADASThe Vehicle Integration Engineer - ADAS is responsible for ensuring seamless integration of ADAS functions into the vehicle platform. This role involves coordination between hardware, software, and systems teams to ensure sensors, ECUs, and control algorithms work correctly in real-world conditions. You will be responsible for vehicle-level testing, calibration, and validation of ADAS functions. Key ResponsibilitiesLead the vehicle-level integration of ADAS systems including cameras, radar, ultrasonic sensors, ECUs (steering, brakes etc. ) and HMI components. Define integration strategy and interfaces between ADAS modules, vehicle networks (CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet), and powertrain/vehicle systems. Collaborate with system architects, software, and hardware teams to ensure ADAS features meet functional and performance requirements. Support vehicle-level testing, calibration, and validation of ADAS features such as AEB, ACC, LKA, Parking Assist, and Traffic Jam Assist. Conduct diagnostics, fault analysis, and troubleshooting for system-level issues during integration and road testing. Define and implement calibration strategies for sensor fusion, perception, and control systems. Ensure compliance with Functional Safety (ISO 26262) and SOTIF (ISO 21448) standards at the vehicle level. Support prototype and pre-production vehicle integration, including wiring harness validation, sensor placement and ECU configuration. Develop test plans, vehicle-level requirements, and verification reports. Coordinate with OEM, Tier-1 suppliers, and internal teams for program milestones and release planning. . Qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering or related field. 8-15 years of experience in ADAS vehicle integration or embedded automotive systems. Strong knowledge of ADAS sensors (camera, radar, ultrasonic) and ECU systems. Experience with vehicle communication networks (CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet). Familiarity with functional safety (ISO 26262) and SOTIF standards. Hands-on experience in vehicle testing, calibration, and validation. Knowledge of data logging, diagnostics, and fault analysis tools. Strong understanding of vehicle electrical architecture and wiring harnesses. Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink, Python, or C/C++ for algorithm testing and validation. Experience with ADAS system calibration and sensor fusion tuning. Exposure to Level 2+ ADAS or autonomous driving systems. Experience in road testing and on-track validation of ADAS functions. Familiarity with simulation environments (e. g. CarMaker) for system validation. Understanding of HIL/SIL testing methods for ADAS integration. Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities. Strong communication and teamwork skills to work across multiple functional teams. Ability to manage multiple vehicle programs and integration tasks simultaneously. Detail-oriented with a focus on safety, reliability, and performance. Passion for automotive technology and autonomous mobility solutions. L&T Company Overview / About Us: L&T is a USD 30 billion Indian multinational engaged in EPC Projects, Hi-Tech Manufacturing, and Services, operating across multiple geographies. A strong, customer-focussed approach and the constant quest for top-class quality have enabled L&T to attain and sustain leadership in its major lines of business for eight decades. Given L&T's capability in strategic electronics and leveraging its foray into semiconductor design and well-established capabilities in L&T Technology Services, the business is expanding its offerings to cover industrial electronic modules, products and systems in critical sectors of Power Electronics, Automotive Electronics, Industrial Robotics & Automation, Communication Platforms and Electronic Systems Design & Manufacturing (ESDM). The focus products under Automotive Electronics are ADAS, Electrification & Connectivity related products.

Domain: Land Defence Systems

Role Overview

We are seeking an accomplished Technical Leader - Embedded Software, RTOS & Mission-Critical Systems to provide technology leadership for the development of advanced software platforms and mission-critical embedded applications for land-based defence systems. 

The role will provide technical ownership across the complete software product lifecycle-from software architecture, technology strategy and requirements definition through detailed design, development, integration, verification, qualification, deployment and lifecycle support. 

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in embedded software, real-time operating systems, VxWorks, Linux, Qt/QML, C/C++, distributed systems and software architecture, combined with proven experience leading multidisciplinary software engineering teams and delivering complex, safety- and mission-critical systems. 

The candidate should be capable of operating across low-level embedded software, BSP/device drivers, RTOS, middleware, application software, graphical user interfaces and system-level software architecture, while providing technical leadership and building a high-performing software organization.

Preferred

The candidate should be comfortable operating across the complete software stack-from device drivers, BSPs, RTOS and VxWorks through middleware, Linux, C/C++, Qt/QML and application software, while maintaining a strong understanding of system-level requirements and hardware/software integration.

data.title: Sustainability Engineering Capability
data.description:
Role Description

We are seeking a leader to consolidate, strengthen and scale our sustainability capabilities into a cohesive, customer-facing engineering practice. 

This role brings together practice development, customer engagement, technical governance, people leadership and commercial growth. The successful candidate will connect expertise that already exists across the company, shape differentiated offerings, establish consistent delivery methods, guide multidisciplinary teams and help customers respond to rapidly evolving product-compliance and sustainability requirements. 

This is an opportunity to shape an important growth area with direct customer visibility and meaningful engineering impact. The right person for the job would be a credible and collaborative leader who can move comfortably between customers, engineers and executives. This leader would bring people together across organizational boundaries, create clarity from ambiguity and combine technical curiosity with commercial judgment. 

Practice Charter

The Sustainability Engineering practice will focus on four connected areas: 

- Product and Material Compliance: REACH, SVHC, SCIP, RoHS, restricted substances, material declarations, supplier compliance data, CDX, IMDS, California Proposition 65, Safer Consumer Products, PFAS and emerging chemical requirements. 
 - Carbon and Life-Cycle Engineering: Life-cycle assessment, product carbon footprints, life-cycle inventories, embodied carbon, supplier-emissions data and carbon-reduction opportunities. 
 - Sustainable Product Engineering and Circularity: Material substitution, lightweighting, energy efficiency, durability, repairability, reuse, remanufacturing, recycled content and end-of-life considerations. 
 - Sustainability Data and Digital Enablement: BOM-level traceability, integration with PLM, ERP, MES and supplier platforms, workflow automation, dashboards, analytics and audit-ready evidence management. 

What You Will Lead

Practice Development

- Define the vision, service portfolio, operating model and roadmap for Sustainability Engineering. 
 - Identify and connect relevant expertise, customer experience, tools, methods and delivery capacity across the company. 
 - Convert distributed capabilities into clear, repeatable and scalable customer offerings. 
 - Develop methodologies, assessment frameworks, templates, quality gates, reference materials and proposal assets. 
 - Establish competency frameworks, training priorities, communities of practice and knowledge-sharing mechanisms. 
 - Build a global delivery model that brings together customer-facing leaders, domain specialists, engineers, analysts and digital teams. 

Customer and Market Leadership

- Serve as the primary customer-facing leader for the Sustainability Engineering practice. 
 - Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across engineering, sustainability, compliance, supply chain, quality, manufacturing and executive leadership. 
 - Understand customer products, regulatory exposure, sustainability goals and operational constraints, and translate them into practical engineering programs. 
 - Lead discovery workshops, maturity assessments, solution development, proposals, technical presentations and executive reviews. 
 - Help customers connect product compliance and sustainability priorities with cost, risk, supply-chain resilience, product performance and business outcomes. 
 - Partner with business-development and account teams to create opportunities, expand customer relationships and develop repeatable market propositions. 

Technical Governance and Delivery Assurance

- Establish technical methods, evidence requirements, review mechanisms, quality controls and escalation paths across the practice. 
 - Review and validate engineering methodologies and deliverables, including: 
 - BOM and component-level material analysis
 - Material and substance identification
 - Weight-by-weight calculations
 - Supplier declarations and supporting evidence
 - Regulatory thresholds and compliance conclusions
 - LCA goals, scope, functional units and system boundaries
 - Data quality, allocation methods and emission factors
 - Product-carbon-footprint calculations and assumptions
 - Challenge incomplete evidence, weak assumptions and unsupported conclusions. 
 - Guide teams through technically complex or ambiguous situations. 
 - Ensure that deliverables are consistent, traceable, configuration-controlled and supported by audit-ready evidence. 
 - Engage the appropriate legal, regulatory, toxicology, certification or technical specialists when additional interpretation is required. 
 - Lead corrective action and continuous improvement when delivery, quality or customer-confidence concerns arise. 
Regulatory and Standards Leadership

- Maintain a structured view of emerging product, material, carbon, circularity and sustainability requirements. 
 - Assess their implications for customers, current programs and future offerings. 
 - Guide the practice's response to requirements such as REACH, SCIP, RoHS, PFAS restrictions, battery and end-of-life regulations, California Proposition 65, California Safer Consumer Products requirements and relevant climate and vehicle programs. 
 - Promote the appropriate use of recognized frameworks, including ISO 14040, ISO 14044, ISO 14067 and GHG Protocol principles. 
 - Translate regulatory developments into customer conversations, delivery methods, capability requirements and new service opportunities. 

People and Ecosystem Leadership

- Establish a connected network of subject-matter experts across functions, business units and geographies. 
 - Bring together capabilities from engineering, materials, manufacturing, supply chain, digital, software, quality and compliance. 
 - Coach team members, develop emerging leaders and support recruitment and deployment. 
 - Create a collaborative culture grounded in engineering rigor, intellectual honesty and continuous learning. 
 - Develop relationships with laboratories, software providers, data providers, specialist consultancies, universities and technology partners. 

Commercial and Operational Leadership

- Support the practice pipeline, capability investments, staffing plans, utilization, delivery health and financial performance. 
 - Define appropriate delivery and commercial models for advisory, project-based and managed-service engagements. 
 - Establish measures for technical quality, customer satisfaction, delivery performance, capability development, revenue growth and margin. 
 - Develop customer case studies and referenceable outcomes while protecting confidentiality and avoiding unsupported sustainability claims. 
 - Identify opportunities to use digital technologies and automation to improve efficiency and scalability without compromising technical judgment or data quality. 

What You Bring

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in engineering, materials, environmental science, sustainability or a related discipline. 
 - Significant experience leading engineering, product-compliance, sustainability, certification, transformation or other technically complex customer programs. 
 - Demonstrated success in establishing or scaling a capability, center of excellence, service line or multidisciplinary technical team. 
 - Strong knowledge in at least one of the following areas: 
 - Product and material compliance
 - Carbon and life-cycle assessment
 - Sustainable product engineering or circularity
 - Sufficient breadth across the other practice areas to review methodologies, challenge technical work and mobilize the right specialists. 
 - Experience establishing technical governance, delivery methods, quality controls and performance measures. 
 - Strong customer-facing experience, including discovery, solution development, proposals, presentations and issue resolution. 
 - Proven ability to lead and influence across functions, business units, cultures and geographies. 
 - Commercial acumen and experience supporting business growth, resource planning and capability investments. 
 - Clear and persuasive communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex subjects without compromising technical accuracy. 
Preferred Experience

- Experience supporting aerospace, automotive, industrial manufacturing or other regulated product industries. 
 - Familiarity with CDX, IMDS, PLM, ERP, supplier-compliance platforms, LCA software, emission-factor databases or sustainability-data solutions. 
 - Exposure to REACH, SCIP, RoHS, Proposition 65, PFAS, battery, circularity or end-of-life requirements. 
 - Exposure to ISO 14040, ISO 14044, ISO 14067, GHG Protocol or related sustainability frameworks. 
 - Experience working with laboratories, technology providers, specialist consultancies or academic institutions. 
 - Relevant credentials in program management, sustainability, LCA, carbon accounting, environmental management or product compliance.

data.title: Sr. Principal Firmware Engineer
data.description:
If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates. 

Requisition ID: 78601

Description

Are you looking for the next step to advance your career in the world of audio technology? Skyworks is seeking team members to help innovate market-specific mixed-signal system on chips (SoCs) for audio and voice applications spanning smart speakers and microphones, wired/wireless headsets, virtual assistants and intelligent gaming controllers. Our advanced audio, voice, speech and artificial intelligent solutions combine breakthrough ultra-low power analog circuits, highly efficient power management systems and custom hardware accelerators to enable smart acoustic signal processing and AI functionality. Come be part of a team that is changing the way the world communicates and who is at the forefront of audio and voice technology innovation! Our proprietary technology achieves the highest level of integration in the industry and sets a new performance standard for low power consumption and minimal footprint. 

Responsibilities

- Create mixed signal ASICs targeted at audio and wireless audio applications. 
 - These are highly integrated designs incorporating audio codecs, amplifiers, battery chargers, DSP processors, peripherals, and power control systems that support a wide range of communication interfaces. 
 - The Firmware group works with the hardware team to help specify these custom systems. From there, we create the core operating system and driver components and follow this through to finished silicon and SDK packages that we provide to application teams. 
 - Our goal is to address all the elements the processor controls and simplify the task of using these parts in a wide range of designs.

Our engineering team works closely to solve difficult problems, and your ability to collaborate with others will be important to the success of the projects to which you contribute.

 - Experience with Security/Secure boot/Cryptographical algorithms and methods preferred.

 - Experience working with electrical hardware interfacing preferred
 - Working knowledge of JTAG debug interface
 - Experience with ARC architecture desirable
 - Understanding of RTL/simulation tools a plus

data.title: Technical Electrical Commissioning Manager – (CxA) Datacenter
data.description:
FPC Global are the world's leading digital building experts, we offer full-service integrated technology consultancy and professional services to the built environment. 

We partner with clients to improve asset performance, operational efficiency, sustainability outcomes, and digital maturity across complex portfolios. 

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Commissioning Technical Team Leader to lead the commissioning delivery team of hyperscale and colocation AI data-centre projects. 

The role will provide technical leadership, people management and client-facing governance across the complete commissioning lifecycle from L0-L6, with a strong focus on L4 Functional Performance Testing (FPT) and L5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST). 

This position is site-centric and requires hands-on leadership through Integrated Systems Testing, including failure mode and fault tolerance validation, ensuring systems meet design intent, availability objectives and operational readiness requirements in line with Uptime Institute, IEC, IEEE, and NFPA standards. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of 15-20+ leads and commissioning engineers. 

- Own mechanical commissioning strategy, planning, execution and technical governance. 

- Lead L4/L5 commissioning, including FPT, IST, failure-mode and concurrent-maintainability testing. 

- Provide technical oversight across HVAC, chilled-water systems, chillers, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC, AHUs, DX/In-Row cooling, containment and high-density liquid/immersion cooling systems. 

- Lead commissioning of HSD/fuel systems, including bulk/day tanks, transfer systems, filtration, leak detection and generator auto-fuelling interfaces. 

- Oversee fire protection and life-safety systems, including fire pumps, wet/dry/pre-action systems, clean-agent systems, VESDA, dampers and smoke-control systems. 

- Oversee plumbing and utility systems, including water storage, makeup water, drainage, sump systems, leak detection and associated utilities. 

- Review P&IDs, equipment submittals, control sequences, Sequence of Operations (SOO), cause & effect and commissioning test scripts. 

- Lead TAB/hydronic balancing, equipment performance testing, controls/BMS integration and functional testing. 

- Validate mechanical integration with BMS, EPMS, electrical systems, fire/life-safety and data-center controls. 

- Manage commissioning issues, RCA, risk registers, punch lists and technical close-out. 

- Act as senior technical interface with hyperscale clients, CxA teams, MEP contractors, consultants and OEMs. 

- Drive commissioning quality, safety and readiness for operational handover. 

Requirements

- 15+ years overall mechanical engineering, testing and commissioning experience. 

- 8+ years data-center or mission-critical mechanical commissioning experience. 

- Proven leadership of at least 2 complete L2 to L5 commissioning cycles. 

- Proven experience of leading at least 2 ISTs of hyperscale datacenter projects. 

- Experience managing 15-20+ Cx engineers. 

- Strong hands-on knowledge of HVAC, chilled-water systems, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC, BMS/controls, fuel systems, fire protection and utilities. 

- Experience with high-density/liquid cooling is highly desirable. 

- Strong understanding of Uptime Institute, ASHRAE, NFPA and applicable local codes/standards. 

- Strong knowledge of Sequence of Operations, controls integration, TAB, hydronic balancing and failure-mode testing. 

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. 

- Strong client-facing communication and technical leadership skills.

Powered by backup vaults, the service provides immutable, tamper-proof backup storage. data.title: Sustainability Engineering Capability Lead
data.description:
We are seeking a leader to consolidate, strengthen and scale our sustainability capabilities into a cohesive, customer-facing engineering practice. 

This role brings together practice development, customer engagement, technical governance, people leadership and commercial growth. The successful candidate will connect expertise that already exists across the company, shape differentiated offerings, establish consistent delivery methods, guide multidisciplinary teams and help customers respond to rapidly evolving product-compliance and sustainability requirements. 

This is an opportunity to shape an important growth area with direct customer visibility and meaningful engineering impact. The right person for the job would be a credible and collaborative leader who can move comfortably between customers, engineers and executives. This leader would bring people together across organizational boundaries, create clarity from ambiguity and combine technical curiosity with commercial judgment. 

Practice Charter

The Sustainability Engineering practice will focus on four connected areas: 

- Product and Material Compliance: REACH, SVHC, SCIP, RoHS, restricted substances, material declarations, supplier compliance data, CDX, IMDS, California Proposition 65, Safer Consumer Products, PFAS and emerging chemical requirements. 
 - Carbon and Life-Cycle Engineering: Life-cycle assessment, product carbon footprints, life-cycle inventories, embodied carbon, supplier-emissions data and carbon-reduction opportunities. 
 - Sustainable Product Engineering and Circularity: Material substitution, lightweighting, energy efficiency, durability, repairability, reuse, remanufacturing, recycled content and end-of-life considerations. 
 - Sustainability Data and Digital Enablement: BOM-level traceability, integration with PLM, ERP, MES and supplier platforms, workflow automation, dashboards, analytics and audit-ready evidence management. 

What You Will Lead

Practice Development

- Define the vision, service portfolio, operating model and roadmap for Sustainability Engineering. 
 - Identify and connect relevant expertise, customer experience, tools, methods and delivery capacity across the company. 
 - Convert distributed capabilities into clear, repeatable and scalable customer offerings. 
 - Develop methodologies, assessment frameworks, templates, quality gates, reference materials and proposal assets. 
 - Establish competency frameworks, training priorities, communities of practice and knowledge-sharing mechanisms. 
 - Build a global delivery model that brings together customer-facing leaders, domain specialists, engineers, analysts and digital teams. Customer and Market Leadership

- Serve as the primary customer-facing leader for the Sustainability Engineering practice. 
 - Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across engineering, sustainability, compliance, supply chain, quality, manufacturing and executive leadership. 
 - Understand customer products, regulatory exposure, sustainability goals and operational constraints, and translate them into practical engineering programs. 
 - Lead discovery workshops, maturity assessments, solution development, proposals, technical presentations and executive reviews. 
 - Help customers connect product compliance and sustainability priorities with cost, risk, supply-chain resilience, product performance and business outcomes. 
 - Partner with business-development and account teams to create opportunities, expand customer relationships and develop repeatable market propositions. 

Technical Governance and Delivery Assurance

- Establish technical methods, evidence requirements, review mechanisms, quality controls and escalation paths across the practice. 
 - Review and validate engineering methodologies and deliverables, including: 
 - BOM and component-level material analysis
 - Material and substance identification
 - Weight-by-weight calculations
 - Supplier declarations and supporting evidence
 - Regulatory thresholds and compliance conclusions
 - LCA goals, scope, functional units and system boundaries
 - Data quality, allocation methods and emission factors
 - Product-carbon-footprint calculations and assumptions
 - Challenge incomplete evidence, weak assumptions and unsupported conclusions. 
 - Guide teams through technically complex or ambiguous situations. 
 - Ensure that deliverables are consistent, traceable, configuration-controlled and supported by audit-ready evidence. 
 - Engage the appropriate legal, regulatory, toxicology, certification or technical specialists when additional interpretation is required. 
 - Lead corrective action and continuous improvement when delivery, quality or customer-confidence concerns arise. 

Regulatory and Standards Leadership

- Maintain a structured view of emerging product, material, carbon, circularity and sustainability requirements. 
 - Assess their implications for customers, current programs and future offerings. 
 - Guide the practice's response to requirements such as REACH, SCIP, RoHS, PFAS restrictions, battery and end-of-life regulations, California Proposition 65, California Safer Consumer Products requirements and relevant climate and vehicle programs. 
 - Promote the appropriate use of recognized frameworks, including ISO 14040, ISO 14044, ISO 14067 and GHG Protocol principles. 
 - Translate regulatory developments into customer conversations, delivery methods, capability requirements and new service opportunities. 

People and Ecosystem Leadership

- Establish a connected network of subject-matter experts across functions, business units and geographies. 
 - Bring together capabilities from engineering, materials, manufacturing, supply chain, digital, software, quality and compliance. 
 - Coach team members, develop emerging leaders and support recruitment and deployment. 
 - Create a collaborative culture grounded in engineering rigor, intellectual honesty and continuous learning. 
 - Develop relationships with laboratories, software providers, data providers, specialist consultancies, universities and technology partners. 

Commercial and Operational Leadership

- Support the practice pipeline, capability investments, staffing plans, utilization, delivery health and financial performance. 
 - Define appropriate delivery and commercial models for advisory, project-based and managed-service engagements. 
 - Establish measures for technical quality, customer satisfaction, delivery performance, capability development, revenue growth and margin. 
 - Develop customer case studies and referenceable outcomes while protecting confidentiality and avoiding unsupported sustainability claims. 
 - Identify opportunities to use digital technologies and automation to improve efficiency and scalability without compromising technical judgment or data quality. 

What You Bring

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in engineering, materials, environmental science, sustainability or a related discipline. 
 - Significant experience leading engineering, product-compliance, sustainability, certification, transformation or other technically complex customer programs. 
 - Demonstrated success in establishing or scaling a capability, center of excellence, service line or multidisciplinary technical team. 
 - Strong knowledge in at least one of the following areas: 
 - Product and material compliance
 - Carbon and life-cycle assessment
 - Sustainable product engineering or circularity
 - Sufficient breadth across the other practice areas to review methodologies, challenge technical work and mobilize the right specialists. 
 - Experience establishing technical governance, delivery methods, quality controls and performance measures. 
 - Strong customer-facing experience, including discovery, solution development, proposals, presentations and issue resolution. 
 - Proven ability to lead and influence across functions, business units, cultures and geographies. 
 - Commercial acumen and experience supporting business growth, resource planning and capability investments. 
 - Clear and persuasive communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex subjects without compromising technical accuracy.

data.description:
ChartRequest is looking to add to our Engineering organization with a qualified, self-driven software engineer and development management professional who is looking to make a splash with a growing company. - Lead, oversee, and provide support to the Engineering team encompassing Development, DevOps, and QA functions. 
 - Lead, oversee, and support the Product Development team in prioritizing, developing, and delivering impactful features for our Requestor and Healthcare Provider community.

 - Experience in the design and development of APIs. 
 - Comfortable collaborating with senior stakeholders, including those at the Director level and above, both in technical and non-technical capacities. 
 - Successful history of building and expanding teams of engineers throughout your career. 
 - Dedication and passion for maintaining quality, achieving technical excellence, and delivering results. 
 - Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to non-technical audiences. 
 - Willingness to undertake other related responsibilities as assigned. 
 - Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Strong organizational abilities are essential. 
 - Availability for occasional light travel (5-10%). 

What we look for: 

- 7 to 10 years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and managing large-scale public-facing web applications deployed within the AWS ecosystem. 
 - Minimum 3 years of managing an Engineering team of about 10 to 15 members. 
 - Proven track record in mentoring engineers and influencing engineering methodologies. 
 - Preferably, a background in Computer Science or Computer Information Systems. 
 - Proficient as a full-stack engineer, adept in both frontend and backend development as well as database management. 
 - Strong dedication to test-driven development, with tangible examples of its integration into recent projects. 
 - Demonstrated interest and documented experience in dynamic web languages, emerging frameworks, AWS/serverless platforms, and other innovative technologies that can enhance the Custom Ink web experience. 
 - Preferred qualifications include expertise in AWS, Ruby, Rails (or similar MVC frameworks), SQL, JavaScript (specifically React/Redux), and Git. Comparable experience with alternative web frameworks will also be considered. 
 - Our technology stack comprises AWS, Ruby, Rails, Node. js, JavaScript, React/Redux, MySQL, Linux, and Git. 

ChartRequest is an Equal Opportunity Employer

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

The ChartRequest PATH. 

Great expectations between ChartRequestors. Every ChartRequestor is on the ChartRequest PATH. When you are on the ChartRequest PATH you must be a team player that is a polite and respectful problem solver. Being Accountable for your work and actions, as well as being a trustworthy team player is paramount to success on this PATH. If you are on the ChartRequest PATH, you must strive to be helpful at all times to your teammates, clients, and all end-users in the ChartRequest ecosystem.

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Dev Platform
data.description:
About The Team

The Systems Engineering team in Rubrik's Developer Platform organization owns the reliability of Rubrik Cloud Data Management (CDM) and RSC-P products. Our customers trust Rubrik to recover their data on the worst day of their year. We make sure the software holds up under that pressure, at scale, over months of continuous operation, and in the face of failure. 

We build the infrastructure and pipelines that let product teams validate stress, scale, longevity and resilience, and we own the call on whether a release is reliable enough to ship. We work with component teams, product management and release managers to build reliability early, rather than inspect for it at the end. 

What We Own

- Release reliability certification. We own the reliability decision behind every CDM and RSC-P release, based on evidence from the platforms and pipelines we build. 
 - Stress, scale and chaos platforms. We build the infrastructure and pipelines for these validations, and give product teams self-service tools so they can validate their own work without waiting on us. 
 - Extreme-scale simulation. We build simulators that reproduce very large customer environments cost-efficiently. 
 - Long-running, customer-like environments. We operate and evolve clusters that run for months and mirror real customer deployments, so we find longevity problems before customers do. 
 - AI-driven triage and reliability. We build triage agents that investigate bugs, incidents and alerts, and we apply AI across our own workflows to speed up detection, diagnosis and certification. 

What You'll Do

As Senior Manager of Systems Engineering, you will own how Rubrik proves its products are reliable before customers depend on them. 

- Own release reliability. Be accountable for the reliability call behind every CDM release, and make ship-or-hold decisions with release managers and component leaders. 
 - Drive the qualification roadmap. Set one roadmap for release workflows and fast build qualification, improving both quality and speed. 
 - Build self-service platforms. Lead the engineers building our stress, scale, chaos and longevity infrastructure, simulators and long-running environments, so component teams can validate their own work. 
 - Lead and grow a high-performing team. Build a culture of transparency, innovation and security-first thinking in a fast-paced environment. Hire, coach and retain engineers across geographies. 
 - Run the team with operational rigor. Set a clear operating rhythm (sprint planning, stand-ups, regular reviews), keep the bar high, give direct feedback and hold the team accountable for delivery. 
 - Run on metrics. Track certification cycle time, customer-found escapes, triage time and infrastructure cost, and act on them. 
 - Reimagine reliability in the AI era. Use and promote AI and emerging technologies in the team, in line with the Company and Engineering vision, including AI-driven triage and automation, and measure the results. 
 - Partner broadly. Align priorities with component leaders, product managers and program managers, and communicate with stakeholders at every level. 

About You

You are a results-oriented leader who cares about enterprise software quality and about building strong teams. 

- 12+ years in the software industry, with hands-on experience building and delivering enterprise-grade products as both an individual contributor and a manager. 
 - 3+ years leading teams of software or systems engineers, with a track record of delivering high-quality enterprise releases. 
 - Technical depth in distributed systems, test infrastructure, or release and reliability engineering. 
 - Experience hiring and building top-tier teams, including teams spread across geographies. 
 - Experience building engineering practices, processes and operational rigor. 
 - Track record of communicating clearly and influencing across engineering, product and executive leadership. 
 - Ability to execute in ambiguous, fast-paced environments. 
 - AI-forward leadership: proven use of AI to improve your own work and your team's, for example by building or adopting AI agents and tooling that measurably cut triage time, speed up infrastructure and pipeline delivery, or automate release workflows. 

Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation

Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes. 

Linkedin | X (formerly Twitter) | Instagram | Rubrik. com

Inclusion @ Rubrik

At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world's data. 

Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential. 

Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture: 

- Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here. 
 - Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries. 
 - Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities. 

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled

Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants in all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, promotion, compensation, training, leave, and termination. 

Rubrik provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. data.description:
Overview

We are looking for a Senior Lead - Databricks & Data Modernization to lead the design and implementation of a data modernization program involving both new data feature development in Databricks and the migration of existing capabilities from Palantir Foundry to Databricks. 

The role requires a strong combination of Databricks engineering, data architecture, technical leadership and program execution skills. The candidate will be responsible for translating business and technical requirements into scalable Databricks solutions, guiding the engineering team, driving the Palantir-to-Databricks migration, and ensuring high-quality delivery. 

The Senior Lead will work closely with customer stakeholders, enterprise/data architects, product owners, engineering teams and AI/ML teams and will be expected to take ownership of technical decisions and end-to-end delivery. 

Responsibilities

- Technical Leadership & Solution Design
 - Lead the design and development of scalable Databricks-based data solutions. 
 - Translate business requirements into technical architecture, data models and implementation plans. 
 - Define appropriate patterns for data ingestion, transformation, processing, storage and serving. 
 - Establish engineering standards, coding standards and reusable frameworks for the Databricks development team. 
 - Make technology and design decisions balancing performance, scalability, maintainability, security and cost. 
 - Review technical designs and code produced by the engineering team. 
 - Identify opportunities to modernize and simplify existing solutions. 
 - Palantir Foundry → Databricks Migration
 - Lead the technical assessment and migration of existing Palantir Foundry capabilities to Databricks. 
 - Analyze existing Foundry pipelines, datasets, transformations, business rules and dependencies. 
 - Develop migration strategies and target-state architectures for different Foundry capabilities. 
 - Define appropriate Databricks-native replacements rather than simply performing a one-to-one migration. 
 - Identify migration complexity, dependencies, risks and technical gaps. 
 - Develop migration plans covering: 
 - Data ingestion
 - Data transformation
 - Data quality
 - Data comparison/reconciliation
 - Data models
 - APIs/integrations
 - Downstream analytics and applications
 - Lead source-to-target mapping and functional/data validation. 
 - Establish approaches for achieving data and functional parity between Palantir and Databricks. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve performance, scalability and maintainability during migration. 
 - Databricks Engineering
 - Provide hands-on technical leadership using: 
 - Databricks
 - Apache Spark
 - PySpark
 - Spark SQL
 - Python
 - Delta Lake
 - Unity Catalog
 - Lakeflow / Spark Declarative Pipelines
 - Databricks Workflows
 - Design and implement batch and near-real-time data pipelines. 
 - Implement incremental processing, CDC and SCD patterns. 
 - Design and optimize Medallion Architecture implementations. 
 - Implement data quality, validation, reconciliation and error-handling frameworks. 
 - Optimize Spark workloads and Delta tables for performance and cost. 
 - Ensure production-grade engineering practices across the team. 
 - Data Architecture & Governance
 - Work with enterprise architects to define the target Databricks data architecture. 
 - Define appropriate Bronze, Silver and Gold data layers. 
 - Establish data modelling and data integration standards. 
 - Ensure appropriate use of Unity Catalog for governance, access control and lineage. 
 - Define standards for data quality, metadata, lineage and observability. 
 - Ensure solutions comply with enterprise security and governance requirements. 
 - Team Leadership & Mentoring
 - Lead and mentor a team of Databricks/data engineers. 
 - Break down requirements into technical tasks and assign work across the team. 
 - Provide technical guidance and unblock engineers on complex issues. 
 - Conduct design and code reviews. 
 - Establish engineering best practices and reusable components. 
 - Support capability development and knowledge sharing within the team. 
 - Act as the primary technical escalation point for the engineering team. 
 - Customer & Stakeholder Management
 - Work directly with customer technical and business stakeholders. 
 - Lead technical discussions, requirement clarification and solution workshops. 
 - Present architecture, migration approaches and technical recommendations to senior stakeholders. 
 - Translate complex technical issues into clear business implications. 
 - Manage technical dependencies and communicate risks proactively. 
 - Work with customer teams to prioritize migration and new feature development. 
 - Build strong working relationships with customer architecture, data and application teams. 
 - Delivery & Program Execution
 - Own technical delivery for assigned workstreams. 
 - Develop technical delivery plans, estimates and milestones. 
 - Identify technical risks, dependencies and mitigation strategies. 
 - Track progress against technical deliverables. 
 - Ensure solutions meet agreed quality, performance and security standards. 
 - Coordinate with project/program managers to ensure successful delivery. 
 - Support release planning, production deployment and transition to operations. 
 - DevOps & Production Engineering
 - Establish CI/CD practices for Databricks solutions. 
 - Implement Git-based development and deployment processes. 
 - Use Databricks Asset Bundles and appropriate deployment automation. 
 - Define automated testing strategies for data pipelines. 
 - Establish monitoring, logging and alerting standards. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis of production issues. 
 - Drive performance and cost optimization of Databricks workloads. 

Requirements

Databricks - Mandatory

- Strong hands-on experience with Databricks
 - Apache Spark / PySpark
 - Spark SQL
 - Delta Lake
 - Unity Catalog
 - Databricks Workflows / Jobs
 - Lakeflow / Spark Declarative Pipelines
 - Databricks Asset Bundles
 - Databricks performance optimization
 - Medallion Architecture

Data Engineering

- Large-scale data processing
 - ETL/ELT architecture
 - Data modelling
 - Batch and incremental processing
 - CDC
 - SCD Type 1 / Type 2
 - Data quality and reconciliation
 - Data integration
 - Structured and unstructured data processing

Programming

- Strong Python
 - Strong SQL
 - Good understanding of software engineering principles
 - Experience developing reusable and production-grade frameworks

Cloud

Strong experience in Azure Cloud

Experience with cloud storage, networking, security and cloud data services is preferred. 

DevOps

- Git
 - CI/CD
 - Automated testing
 - Databricks deployment automation
 - Infrastructure-as-code concepts
 - Production monitoring and operational support

Hands-on experience with Palantir Foundry will be strongly preferred because the project involves migration of existing Foundry capabilities.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust's mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn't slow teams down-it should accelerate what's possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‐Ready Governance PlatformTM, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer with a passion for solving problems to join our agile Product Engineering team at OneTrust. Senior Software Engineers own the delivery of complex features end-to-end and are a go-to technical resource for their immediate team. 

Your Mission

Execution & Delivery

- Independently own delivery of complex features or components from design through production, requiring evaluation of multiple interacting factors. 
 - Drive system architecture and component-design discussions for your area of ownership. 

Collaboration & Influence

- Partner closely with Product, UX, and other engineers to shape solutions during planning, not just execution. 
 - Network with senior engineers across the org to align on shared technical decisions. 
 - Stays curious and has the ability to ideate, innovate & improve by identifying patterns that can bring quality and velocity improvements

Quality & Craft

- Conduct peer code reviews and help set the quality bar for your team. 
 - Champion testing practices, including exploratory and AI-assisted testing approaches. 

Mentorship

- Support the ramp-up and growth of Associate and Software Engineers on your team. 

You Are

A seasoned, fully-capable engineer who requires minimal day-to-day direction and only needs general guidance on genuinely new assignments. You proactively surface risks and ambiguity rather than waiting to be asked. You work independently on established types of work, taking ownership from design through delivery with limited need for oversight. You're not afraid to ask for input mainly when facing unfamiliar or ambiguous problems, where the right approach isn't yet obvious. Your passionate about flagging risks and open questions during planning or design, before they turn into issues later in the process

Your Experience Includes

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field 
 - 8+ years of professional software engineering experience on Core Java, Spring, Spring boot, hibernate, microservices and Kafka messaging. Also looking at experience on agentic platforms like Microsoft foundry, agent core, google vertex, Bedrock. 
 - Demonstrated experience owning complex features end-to-end in either frontend or backend systems 
 - Familiarity with a public cloud provider (Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS) 
 - Experience informally mentoring or supporting the growth of junior engineers is a plus 
 - Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , Claude Code, Devin, Windsurf, or similar) in a professional setting, with genuine enthusiasm for applying AI to accelerate and elevate day-to-day engineering work. 

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person. 

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview. 

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you'll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust. com/careers. 

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

- OneTrust Careers on YouTube
 - @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form. 

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust. com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us. greenhouse-mail. io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign. net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust. com. 

Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad - the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career. 

OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

data.description:
Company Description

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies-like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion-have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. 

We're a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. 

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful-because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. 

If you're ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you'll find your purpose here. 

Job Description

Primary Function: 

In this role, a Sr. Supplier Engineer is responsible for ensuring suppliers meet ISI requirements for quality, service, delivery, and cost. Drive suppliers to continuously improve business and manufacturing processes. Evaluate and select suppliers. Guide Engineering in choosing suppliers for new products and provide DFM input to new designs to support NPI projects. Executes detailed projects with suppliers to ensure excellence across quality, cost, capacity, risk management, and sub-supplier management. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Drive PCBA manufacturing qualification at contract manufacturers, including readiness requirements and milestone reviews. 
 - Provide PCB/PCBA DFM feedback and escalate manufacturability risks early in product development. 
 - Complete project/ part qualification deliverables including: Supplier pFMEA, Process Validations (IQ/OQ/PQ), Inspection Reports, Gage R&R, and Process Capability Analysis
 - Develop and implement manufacturing technologies and process improvements to enhance quality, reliability, throughput, and cost. 
 - Work with suppliers to execute cost reductions, capacity improvements, and risk mitigation
 - Select the right process and supplier for the part, considering long term fit and total ownership cost
 - Manage supplier changes including manufacturing process changes, production optimization, facility changes, new equipment qualification, and new line validations
 - Drive changes to ISI requirements as necessary by initiating and managing changes to specifications and drawings through the engineering change order process
 - Own and drive to closure supplier variances from symptom through root cause analysis to corrective action, including careful CAPA documentation
 - Effectively prioritize and advance multiple concurrent projects and tasks
 - Clearly communicate project status to key stakeholders
 - Build, own, and relentlessly pursue a vision for developing suppliers
 - Understand proper level of documentation detail for tracking of actions and justification of decisions
 - Generate key metrics for the team and suppliers, and continually drive for timely achievement of those metrics
 - Drive suppliers to continually improve their business and manufacturing process performance to meet Intuitive's requirements for supplier excellence using a collection of best practices in project management, Six Sigma, Lean, SPC and negotiation. Lead these efforts without managerial guidance at several suppliers simultaneously
 - Implement corrective and preventive actions for supplier process by driving supplier's investigations and root cause analysis
 - Provide effective and timely supply base health information and recommendation to management by creating and delivering data-driven supply base information to any level of management at ISI with little or no guidance
 - Prepare and deliver supplier communications as required by independently working with suppliers on scorecard creation
 - Work with suppliers and ISI design engineering for the new product introduction to: 
 - Create product supplier landscapes to determine launch readiness and report to management
 - Develop supplier ramp readiness plans by judging business risk based on forecast, supplier capacity, quality performance, and process capability. 
 - DFM by engaging suppliers early in development cycle to feedback manufacturability improvements in the designs prior to production
 - Influence and guide Design Engineering in choosing suppliers by determining selection criteria for preferred suppliers and leading the team effort to evaluate preferred suppliers
 - Review, analyze and close customer complaints, manufacturing variance requests, and first article inspections by judging risk analyses and justifications
 - Evaluate corrective and preventive actions at suppliers, looks for opportunities with suppliers to eliminate recurrence

Qualifications

Skills/Job Requirements: 

- Minimum 5 yrs related experience in engineering/manufacturing of Electronics (PCBA, PCA, cable assemblies, wiring harnesses, etc. ) preferred. 
 - Experience with board assembly processes and equipment, including stencil, paste print, SPI, pick and place, SMT reflow, AOI, AXI, selective solder, flying probe, wash, and conformal coating. 
 - PCBA DFM experience
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills including presentations to executive level management
 - Excellent Interpersonal, team building and project management skills
 - Demonstrable knowledge in evaluating and challenging supplier technical, quality, and business capabilities
 - Demonstrable knowledge of a wide range of manufacturing processes including understanding of key input variables for quality, cost, and capacity
 - Excellent knowledge of 21 CFR part 820 and ISO 13485
 - Significant computer experience using Windows, Word, Excel, Project, Access, and ERP Information Systems, preferably SAP or Agile

Required Education And Training

- Minimum Education: BS degree in Engineering or equivalent experience, advanced degree preferred
 - Experience with SMT/PCBA manufacturing and process development
 - Experience in a high-volume medical device company is a plus

Working Conditions

- Ability to travel to suppliers on an as-needed basis - domestic and international. 

Preferred Skills And Experience

- Medical Device experience is a plus
 - Supplier management experience is a plus
 - Advanced degree preferred
 - DFM tools experience, such as Valor or Allegro, is a plus. 
 - Experience with statistical analysis software such as Minitab is a plus
 - Experience in a high-volume medical device company is a plus

Additional Information

Intuitive is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws. 

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws. 

U. S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U. S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR

- 743. 13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U. S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status. 

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U. S. Government on your behalf (note: the government's licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan ("TCP") (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process). 

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee's start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes. 

This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on

business need and/or on the selected candidate's experience, knowledge and skills. 

Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the

Candidate's Qualifications, Consistent With Applicable Law.

Job Title: Quality Assurance Engineer - AI Agentic Applications

Location: Pune, India

Corporate Title: AVP

Role Description

Quality Assurance Engineer to validate AI agentic applications across development and production. The position combines specialized AI testing, automation, safety evaluation, and continuous quality measurement. The engineer is responsible to design, build and execute the test strategy for LLM accuracy, RAG ingestion and attribution, agent planning and tool use, recovery behavior, and production failure patterns

What We'll Offer You

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you'll enjoy

- Best in class leave policy

 - Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
 - Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
 - Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents

Your Key Responsibilities

- Design, execute, and maintain test strategies and automation frameworks for AI-powered agentic workflows
 - Develop and implement specialized testing approaches for LLM-powered applications, validating response accuracy, relevance, and grounding, while identifying hallucinations and edge-case behaviours
 - Test and evaluate the behaviour of autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents, ensuring proper planning, tool selection/sequencing, agent-to-agent interactions, and graceful error/timeout recovery

Add On Experience (Nice to Have): 

- Experience testing API and data integrations, including REST APIs, JSON, SQL, databases, and messaging systems like Kafka
 - Good understanding of CI/CD integration and establishing automated quality gates
 - Experience working in the financial services industry, with knowledge of regulatory reporting, trade lifecycles, transaction reporting, reconciliations, and regulatory controls
 - Experience with AI/LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Vertex AI, OpenAI, or similar technologies
 - Hands-on experience with advanced AI testing capabilities such as prompt injection testing, AI evaluation/evals, and AI observability
 - Experience testing distributed systems

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs. 

How We'll Support You

- Training and development to help you excel in your career

data.title: Engineer, SDET - AccelQ [T500-30006]
data.description:
About T-Mobile: 

T-Mobile US, Inc. (NASDAQ: TMUS), headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, is America's supercharged Un-carrier, connecting millions through its strong nationwide network and flagship brands, T-Mobile and Metro by T-Mobile. Customers benefit from an unmatched combination of value, quality, and exceptional service experience. 

About TMUS Global Solutions: 

TMUS Global Solutions is a world-class technology powerhouse accelerating the company's global digital transformation. With a culture built on growth, inclusivity, and global collaboration, the teams here drive innovation at scale, powered by bold thinking. 

TMUS India Private Limited operates as TMUS Global Solutions. 

T-Mobile is expanding its TfB capabilities and is seeking a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to own quality engineering for Salesforce-based B2B and enterprise solutions. This role designs and builds automated test frameworks, drives test strategy across the delivery lifecycle, and partners with developers, business analysts, and product owners to ensure Salesforce releases are reliable, secure, and defect-free. 

The SDET combines strong software-engineering skills with deep testing expertise to shift quality left, reduce production risk, and build durable automation that scales with the platform. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design, build, and maintain automated test frameworks and suites for Salesforce applications, covering UI, API, and data-layer testing. 
 - Develop Apex test classes and ensure meaningful code coverage, adherence to bulkification, and validation of governor-limit behavior. 
 - Build and maintain automated regression, functional, and integration test suites using tools such as ACCELQ, Selenium, TOSCA, Copado, or similar Salesforce test-automation platforms. 
 - Define and execute test strategy and test plans for new features, integrations, and platform enhancements, including risk-based test prioritization. 
 - Validate integrations between Salesforce and external systems (REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, Platform Events) for functional correctness, data integrity, and error handling. 
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, performance, and exploratory testing across Salesforce releases and sandboxes. 
 - Identify, document, and track defects; perform root-cause analysis in partnership with development teams; verify fixes. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and safe, frequent deployments. 
 - Collaborate with developers and architects during design reviews to build testability into features from the start. 
 - Monitor test results, coverage metrics, and quality KPIs; report on release readiness and quality risk to stakeholders. 
 - Maintain test-data management strategies and environment/sandbox readiness for testing needs. 
 - Mentor other QA/testing team members on automation practices, tools, and Salesforce-specific testing techniques. 

Minimum Required Qualifications: 

- 3-5 years of experience in software quality engineering / test automation, including experience testing Salesforce applications. 
 - Hands-on experience writing Apex test classes and validating Salesforce configuration, automation, and integrations. 
 - Experience building and maintaining automated test frameworks/scripts (e. g. , ACCELQ, Selenium, TOSCA, Copado, or similar tools) using a programming or scripting language such as Java, JavaScript, or Apex. 
 - Strong understanding of basic software design principles and the ability to apply them in automation framework and test suite development. Candidate should be able to build reusable, maintainable, scalable, and customizable automation solutions. 
 - Solid understanding of the Salesforce data model, security model (profiles, permission sets, sharing), and platform limits as they relate to testing. 
 - Experience testing REST/SOAP API integrations, including using tools such as Postman or SoapUI. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and working with source control (Git). 
 - Strong understanding of QA methodologies, including test planning, test-case design, defect management, and risk-based testing. 
 - Ability to analyze requirements and designs to identify test scenarios, edge cases, and quality risks. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly report quality status and risk to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices and collaboration across Product, Development, Architecture, and Release Management teams. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II, Administrator, or a testing-focused Salesforce credential. 
 - Experience with performance and load testing tools for Salesforce or integrated systems. 
 - Experience with data-migration validation, master-data quality checks, or synchronization testing involving Salesforce. 
 - Experience in telecommunications, wireless, IoT, enterprise connectivity, quoting, contracting, order management, or related B2B domains. 
 - Experience with observability/monitoring tools for tracking test and release quality trends. 
 - Experience working with distributed onshore and offshore engineering and QA teams.
