Job Description: 

We are looking for an exceptional Director Data Science & Machine Learning to build and lead a world-class Data Science team that drives meaningful business outcomes at scale

. This is not a pure people-management role. This is a high-ownership, player-coach role for someone who can think strategically, execute aggressively, and lead from the front. You will be expected to identify the highest-leverage opportunities across the business, shape the ML roadmap, drive rapid experimentation, and ship production-grade ML systems that materially move core metrics

. You should have a strong track record of building and deploying machine learning systems in production, leading high-performing teams, and solving ambiguous, high-impact business problems. You should be comfortable switching between leadership, architecture, hands-on debugging, stakeholder alignment, and execution review - sometimes on the same day

. If you're excited by messy real-world problems, high scale, fast decisions, and building with intensity, this role is for you. 

What our team owns

At Rebel, the Data Science & Analytics team owns the intelligence layer for the company. 

We build and maintain the AI based solutions, ML models, optimization systems, rule engines, and decision frameworks that power critical business outcomes across the organization. This includes: 

- Demand and inventory forecasting
 - Order volume prediction
 - Marketing spend optimization and attribution
 - Delivery time prediction and logistics intelligence
 - Personalization and recommendation systems
 - Capacity planning and operational optimization
 - Pricing and assortment intelligence
 - Automated business reporting and decision supportWe work across nearly every major business function - Supply, Operations, Demand Generation, D2C, Finance, Brands, Customer Delight, Central Planning, and more. 

The problems are real, large-scale, cross-functional, and deeply operational. The impact is visible. The feedback loops are fast. The opportunity to create leverage is massive. 

We're looking for someone who can

- Set the bar for what great looks like in applied Data Science and ML execution across the organization. 
 - Define and drive the Data Science roadmap by identifying the highest-impact problems worth solving, not just the loudest asks. 
 - Lead, hire, and grow a high-caliber team of Data Scientists / ML Engineers with a culture of ownership, urgency, and technical excellence. 
 - Own end-to-end delivery of ML initiatives - from business framing and experimentation to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. 
 - Act as a player-coach: unblock teams, review modeling approaches, challenge assumptions, and go hands-on when the situation demands it. 
 - Partner deeply with Product, Engineering, and Business leaders to align on priorities, define success metrics, and drive adoption of solutions. 
 - Build production-grade, scalable, and reusable ML systems with strong engineering rigor and long-term maintainability. 
 - Drive a high-velocity experimentation culture with clear hypotheses, measurable outcomes, and ruthless focus on business impact. 
 - Establish best practices across the ML lifecycle - feature engineering, validation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, governance, and documentation. 
 - Push the team beyond dashboards and incremental models into decision automation, optimization, and durable intelligence systems. 
 - Communicate clearly and influence decisively, especially in ambiguous or high-stakes cross-functional situations. 
 - Raise the organization's ML maturity by improving trust, adoption, and understanding of Data Science across teams. 

Specific Qualifications

- 9+ years of experience in Data Science / Machine Learning, with 2+ years of leading teams or managing high-performing DS/ML groups. 
 - Proven track record of shipping ML systems to production that delivered measurable business impact at scale. 
 - Strong experience in applied machine learning, statistical modeling, and optimization, especially in fast-moving business environments. 
 - Deep hands-on expertise with ML frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, Scikit-learn. 
 - Strong understanding of core ML methods including: 
 - Regression
 - Classification
 - Tree-based / Gradient Boosting models
 - Time-Series Forecasting
 - Ranking / Recommendation systems
 - NLP
 - Optimization and decision systems
 - Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, Pandas, NumPy, and data analysis / visualization libraries such as Matplotlib, Plotly, etc. 
 - Experience building robust ML workflows including: 
 - Feature engineering pipelines
 - Offline / online evaluation
 - Experiment design and A/B testing
 - Model deployment and serving
 - Monitoring and retraining strategies
 - Strong understanding of MLOps and production engineering, including: 
 - Dockerization
 - REST APIs
 - CI/CD for ML workflows
 - Version control and reproducibility
 - Scalable inference and model lifecycle management
 - Experience with optimization frameworks (e. g. Google OR-Tools) is a strong plus. 
 - Strong intuition for balancing speed vs rigor, and the judgment to know when each matters. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to challenge, influence, and align senior cross-functional leaders. 

Good-to-have

- Experience in Time-Series Forecasting, Market Mix Modeling (MMM), Causal Inference, or Experimentation Platforms. 
 - Experience in personalization, recommendation systems, pricing, logistics, supply chain, or operational optimization. 
 - Experience building ML platforms, reusable modeling frameworks, or internal DS productivity tooling. 
 - Prior experience in consumer internet, e-commerce, food-tech, logistics, mobility, or other high-scale operational businesses. 
 - Strong bias toward building systems that create compounding leverage, not one-off analyses. 
 - Passion for raising the technical bar and building teams that attract top-tier talent. 

If you find this intriguing, we should meet. 

Please reach out to kavya. guwalani@rebelfoods. com with your background and a few lines on why you want to help build the future of internet restaurants.

Location - Gurugram (On-site)

We are seeking a highly autonomous and technically profound Senior Site Reliability Engineer to own our observability strategy and critical platform services. In this role, you will not just monitor systems; you will engineer their reliability, performance, and security. You will serve as the primary authority for our monitoring stack and the operational lead for our core middleware layers. 

This position demands a proactive problem-solver who thrives in complex, regulated environments. You must be comfortable working independently, making high-stakes technical decisions, and leading incident resolution efforts from detection to post-mortem. 

Responsibilities

- Observability Leadership: Architect, maintain, and optimize our end-to-end observability platform using Grafana, Prometheus and Elasticsearch. You will define the standards for logging, metrics, and tracing. 
 - Platform Engineering: Operate and engineer critical surrounding systems including MongoDB, Kafka, Redis, HashiCorp Vault, and WSO2 API Manager. You are responsible for their stability, scaling, and security within our OpenShift environment. 
 - Incident Command: Lead L3 support and Major Incident Management. You will diagnose complex cross-layer issues (application to infrastructure) and drive permanent resolutions. 
 - Automation: Build self-healing systems and automated recovery workflows using Python and Bash to reduce manual toil and improve system resilience. 
 - Proactive Reliability: Identify potential failure modes before they occur and implement architectural improvements to prevent outages. 
 - Reliability Engineering: Define and track service reliability objectives (SLIs/SLOs) and help engineering teams improve platform reliability through measurable outcomes and error budget management. 

Your Profile

- 7+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, or Platform Engineering. 
 - Proven expertise in Grafana and the Prometheus ecosystem. 
 - Experience defining and operating SLOs, SLIs, Error Budgets, and availability targets for production services. 
 - Deep operational experience with Statefulset applications in production Kubernetes/OpenShift environments. 
 - Proven track record of owning the full Incident Management lifecycle, including Root Cause Analysis and implementation of preventive measures. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python and Bash for automation and tooling development. 
 - Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to work independently and solve ambiguous technical challenges without constant supervision. 
 - Experience in the banking or highly regulated sectors is a strong plus. 

What We Offer

- The opportunity to work on a critical, large-scale digital banking platform. 
 - A culture that values engineering excellence, ownership, and proactive innovation. 
 - A collaborative international team environment with a focus on high-quality delivery.

This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Posting Title: Sr Engineer II - Testing, Front Line Care

Your Role At Baxter

Baxter's Front Line Care business is a 1. 1B$ business comprising of Connected monitoring, Respiratory health, Cardiology, Intelligent diagnostic groups. The products, used by clinicians in acute and ambulatory care settings globally. 

Position Overview

A Senior Engineer, Testing (V&V) will be responsible for formulating Test Analysis, Test strategy , Automation framework, Drive Test quality improvements Across Platforms, New Product development and sustaining engineering catering to our portfolio. The successful candidate will possess solid "hands-on" technical abilities, an excitement and energy for product development, and a passion for their work and the impact it has on meeting the needs of patients. 

This position does not have any direct reports. You will need to work collaboratively with R&D and cross functions. 

The role is located in the BRD facility in Bangalore India

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

- 8-12 years of experience in Test / V&V Activities for a medical product
 - Responsible for the Test analysis, Test design , Design of automation framework, Develop automation scripts, make design choices for new product development, sustenance activities, field issue resolution etc. 
 - Takes complete ownership of testing a product or release and ensures high quality deliverables. This covers both Manual testing & automation testing
 - Solid understanding and implementation of TDD & BDD
 - Proven experience in delivering medical devices to meet IEC/FDA/ISO standards and working closely with the regulatory bodies and affiliated labs. 
 - Develop automation strategy and framework for the Software and System level testing. 
 - Installation/Operational/Performance Qualification Protocols, Traceability Matrices and Final Reports. 
 - Pair up with design & development team to start the testing early in the design cycle (Sprints) to ensure the requirements testability, design traceability & test coverage. 
 - Identify and report any quality or compliance concerns and take immediate corrective/ preventive action as needed. 
 - Review work products and ensure the quality of deliverables. 
 - Participates in continuous improvement activities by identifying and appropriately escalating process and product quality gaps. 
 - Lead the qualification of lab area, drive productivity improvement efforts, including testing, building fixtures, calibration, and data collection. 
 - Ensures good documentation and good manufacturing practices are followed in the Test Process. 
 - Leads the investigations by identifying the root cause and drive solutions. 
 - Mentor peers/engineers in the stream of their expertise and on the processes. 

Qualifications / Experience And/or Background

- Bachelor's Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Bio-Medical or related field. 
 - 8-12 years of experience in testing of Software. 
 - Experience in design verification and validation of medical devices; and understanding of and adherence to FDA, ISO and IEC design control procedures, regulations, and standards. 
 - Deep hands on expertise in manual and automation testing using tools such as SQUISH, Java, Python. 
 - Experience in writing system, subsystem-level and module level verification and validation plans, procedures, test execution and test report generation. 
 - Familiarity with reliability theory and analysis. 
 - Experience in technically leading a team of test engineers. 

Personal Characteristics

- Excellent communication, inter-personal and leadership skills
 - Openness to collaborate in interest of project/organization. 
 - Proactive and self-driven, possesses due sense of urgency
 - Shall possess systems mindset and good problem-solving abilities. 
 - Working with multisite teams, Quality conscious and Process & customer Oriented
 - Worked in Global environment

A Career That Matters

Baxter's employees are united in a mission to save and sustain lives. We are passionate about applying scientific innovation to meet the needs of the millions of people worldwide who depend on our medically necessary therapies and technologies. We focus on increasing access to healthcare, innovating in crucial areas of unmet need, and pursuing creative collaborations that bring our mission to life for patients every day.

Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.

Bachelor's/master's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent relevant technical degree. 

10 to 16years of relevant Experience in Systems & Component level Verification & Validation activities.

Own and drive change control activities by ensuring accountability for all technical aspects of development, sustaining projects, and design controls.

Demonstrate the ability to achieve objectives and deliver multiple projects simultaneously.

Lead audit nonconformances or findings to closure by defining and implementing appropriate corrective actions. 

Lead and execute IQ, OQ, and PQ for equipment and instruments in accordance with QMS site policies. 

Ensure lab requirements are validated, and laboratories are qualified for intended use; coordinate shared equipment usage when needed. 

Qualify vendors and add them to the approved vendor list by coordinating with the sourcing team to ensure quick turnaround.

Exposure to regulatory standards, medical device manufacturing processes and procedures, RF welding, and solvent bonding would be an added benefit.

Lead and execute assigned testing with minimal dependency on project owners by managing timelines, providing regular result updates, and owning final report preparation, review, sign-off, and release.

data.title: Principal Software Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
Job Title: Principal Engineer, Software Quality Assurance, Versa Messaging Service (VMS) Platform

Job Code: 

Location: Bangalore

About Us: 

Versa Networks, Inc. is a vendor of a unified Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) platform. 

Versa's goal is to provide unprecedented business advantages through a software-based approach that allows for unmatched agility, cost savings and flexibility. We have created a platform that is feature-rich, scalable and easy to use for both enterprise and service provider use cases. 

Job Summary: 

We are looking for an experienced Quality Assurance leader to build and own the quality engineering function for the Versa Messaging Service (VMS), a platform that distributes identity, posture, and threat-context data. 

VMS is a Kubernetes-based appliance built from a Go microservices data plane, a Java/Spring Boot control plane, and a gRPC/Protobuf streaming contract consumed by other Versa products. 

You will define the quality strategy for the platform, build automated test coverage across the Go data path, establish integration and performance testing capabilities from first principles, embed quality gates into CI/CD, and lead a team of SDETs. You will work across engineering, DevOps, security, and release management, and coordinate with other product teams to ensure cross-product compatibility. 

Educational Qualification: 

B. E. /B. Tech. or higher degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication or equivalent. 

Professional Qualification: 

15+ years of experience in software quality engineering, test automation and quality leadership, including a minimum of 5 years leading QA or SDET teams. 

Job Responsibilities: 

Strategy and Leadership

- Define the quality strategy, test architecture, and release-readiness criteria for VMS. 
 - Hire, build, and lead a team of SDETs; set technical standards and review their work. 
 - Own the release go/no-go signal across concurrent branches; report coverage, escaped-defect, and cycle-time metrics to leadership. Test Automation

- Build the integration and end-to-end test harness for the publish/subscribe path across record types, services, and tenants. 
 - Define contract and schema-evolution testing for the gRPC/Protobuf interface to protect backward compatibility for deployed VOS clients. 
 - Drive shift-left practice by making developers accountable for testing their own changes. Platform and Lifecycle

- Own the installation and upgrade test matrix across install methods (ISO, package), topologies (single-node, multi-node), build variants (FIPS, non-FIPS), and lifecycle operations (in-place upgrade, rollback, database migration). Performance and Resilience

- Build the capacity model from first principles; publish supported limits for throughput, record count, and tenants. 
 - Own soak and memory-growth testing; measure and document failover behavior, including RTO and RPO. 

Essential Skills: 

- Strong programming skills in Go or Java, plus Python or a similar scripting language, for building test frameworks and tooling. 
 - Strong knowledge of Kubernetes (kubeadm clusters, networking, ingress, storage, operators) and Docker. 
 - Experience testing on-premises or appliance software, including ISO/package installation, in-place upgrade and rollback, and hardened or certified build variants. 
 - Working knowledge of gRPC and Protocol Buffers, including streaming APIs. 
 - Strong Linux systems knowledge and shell scripting skills, including testing shell-based installation and lifecycle automation. 
 - Working knowledge of Kafka, TCP/IP, TLS/mTLS, HTTP, syslog, RADIUS, SCIM, and PKI. 
 - Experience with performance engineering, including load model design, load generation, and profiling. 
 - Experience owning security and compliance testing in a certified product context (FIPS, STIG, Common Criteria, or equivalent). 
 - Experience designing and maintaining test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines (for example, Jenkins or GitLab CI) with automated quality gates. 

Desirable Skills: 

- Familiarity with identity and access protocols (SAML, OAuth2/OIDC). 
 - Experience with endpoint posture and threat-intelligence integrations. 
 - Familiarity with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana). 
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP).

About The Business

At Cirium, our goal is to keep the world connected. We are the industry leader in aviation analytics; helping our customers understand the past, present, and predicting what will happen tomorrow. Our mission is to transform the aviation industry by enabling airlines, airports, travel companies, tech giants, aircraft manufacturers, financial institutions, and many more accelerate their own digital transformation. You can learn more about Cirium at https: //www. cirium. com. 

About The Team

We organize our engineering teams into collaborative Squads that bring together Software Engineers, Quality Engineers, Product Managers, and Engineering Leaders to build and deliver customer-focused solutions. 

Our teams value continuous learning, innovation, inclusivity, and shared ownership. We encourage engineers to contribute ideas, challenge assumptions, mentor others, and help shape the future of our products and platforms. 

About The Role

As a Quality Test Engineer III, you will play a key role in transforming manual testing processes into scalable automated testing solutions for a Cirium project. You will work closely with cross-functional engineering teams to drive quality, improve reliability, and support the delivery of high-quality customer-focused products. This position offers the opportunity to lead testing initiatives, contribute to engineering excellence, and adopt modern technologies and AI tools in day-to-day work. 

Responsibilities

- Take ownership of testing activities and work independently. Adopt and use AI tools in day-to-day work. Lead testing efforts with limited QA support within the team and drive automation initiatives. 
 - Help convert manual testing processes into automated testing solutions and support the reduction of dependency on manual testing. 
 - Participate in technical design discussions, architecture reviews, and solution planning activities, Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, secure, and well-tested code following engineering standards and best practices. 
 - Contribute to the development and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and cloud-native deployment solutions. Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement sustainable solutions to improve system reliability and performance. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on code quality, operational excellence, security, scalability, and developer productivity. 
 - Review code changes, provide constructive feedback, and support engineering best practices across the team and mentor junior engineers and contribute to knowledge sharing, technical coaching, and team development. 
 - Stay current with emerging technologies, industry trends, and engineering practices, recommending improvements where appropriate. 

Requirements

- Strong proficiency in . NET/C# knowledge, because the development team primarily works in . NET. 
 - Experience with automation frameworks preferably Playwright or alternative Experience Selenium, Cypress, or similar automation experience who is willing to work with Playwright. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform and Adopt to use AI tools in day-to-day work. 
 - Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience working with CI/CD practices and tools such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and engineering best practices. 
 - Experience with automated testing, code quality tools, application monitoring, and operational support with strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across distributed teams. 

Our Commitment to Inclusion

We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including underrepresented groups, people with disabilities, career changers, and candidates with non-traditional education or experience. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We are committed to supporting your success. 

Learn more about the LexisNexis Risk Solutions team and how we work

We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.

QA Engineer- Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript). Position Overview - QA Engineer specializing in Playwright with TypeScript/JavaScript

Primary Responsibilities Include: 

- Designing, implementing, and maintaining advanced automation frameworks using Playwright with TypeScript and JavaScript, employing best practices like the Page Object Model to ensure maintainability and scalability. 
 - Developing and executing comprehensive test suites encompassing functional, regression, integration, smoke, and end-to-end testing for both web applications and RESTful APIs. 
 - Creating reusable and modular test automation scripts that facilitate efficient continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) processes. 
 - Formulating clear and detailed manual test cases to supplement automation efforts and support thorough validation where automation is not feasible. 
 - Collaborating closely with product owners, developers, platform managers, and stakeholders to establish clear acceptance criteria and align testing efforts with business goals. 
 - Conducting meticulous root-cause analysis for identified defects and partnering with development teams for swift resolution and debugging assistance. 
 - Engaging in continuous process improvements, knowledge sharing, and mentoring colleagues to elevate the overall maturity of QA practices within the organization. 
 - Utilizing tools such as Postman for API testing and integrating results into comprehensive reporting platforms including Allure and HTML reports. 
 -   Technical Competencies and Skills: 

- Proven mastery of Playwright automation framework, alongside solid hands-on experience with Selenium WebDriver and developing automation frameworks in TypeScript and JavaScript. 
 - Strong capability in API testing including RESTful services, with proficiency in JSON and XML validation, API test automation framework development, and use of tools like Postman. 
 - Expertise in applying testing methodologies such as Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) using Cucumber or analogous frameworks to improve collaboration and clarity of test scenarios. 
 - Experience working within Agile Scrum teams, actively contributing to sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives to enhance product quality and delivery. 
 -   Qualifications and Experience: 

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 - A minimum of 7 years of overall experience in software quality assurance, with at least 3 years dedicated to automation testing using Playwright. 
 - Demonstrated ability to independently lead testing efforts, troubleshoot complex issues, and deliver quality solutions in fast-paced environments. 
 - Exceptional communication skills for articulating complex testing issues and collaborating with multi-disciplinary teams effectively. 
 - Preferred certifications in Playwright or relevant testing frameworks as well as experience with cloud platforms like AWS or Azure and container technologies such as Docker.   

  

Mandatory Skills: Product Test Automation
. 

  

Experience: 3-5 Years

data.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an accomplished Guidewire Rating Developer / Architect with deep expertise in Guidewire PolicyCenter Rating and P&C insurance. The role requires strong hands-on experience in designing and implementing complex rating solutions, combined with the ability to provide technical leadership across Guidewire implementations. 

The ideal candidate will be responsible for translating business and actuarial requirements into scalable, maintainable rating solutions and will work closely with architects, business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the technical architecture and solution design for Guidewire PolicyCenter Rating capabilities. 
 - Design and implement complex rating models, rate books, rate tables, factors, modifiers, eligibility rules, and premium calculations. 
 - Analyze business and actuarial requirements and translate them into robust Guidewire Rating solutions. 
 - Develop and customize Gosu-based rating logic and PolicyCenter configurations. 
 - Design solutions for complex P&C insurance products, pricing structures, underwriting rules, discounts, surcharges, and eligibility criteria. 
 - Define technical approaches for rating enhancements, product changes, and regulatory/business-driven pricing changes.

Required Technical Expertise

- Strong hands-on experience with Guidewire PolicyCenter Rating. 
 - Extensive knowledge of Guidewire Product Model and Rating architecture. 
 - Strong proficiency in Gosu and Guidewire configuration. 
 - Expertise in rate books, rate tables, rating factors, modifiers, rules, and premium calculations. 
 - Strong understanding of P&C insurance products, rating methodologies, underwriting, and policy lifecycle. 
 - Experience with Guidewire integrations, APIs, web services, and external systems. 
 - Strong understanding of PolicyCenter architecture and implementation patterns. 
 - Experience with Guidewire Cloud and cloud-based implementations is highly preferred. 
 - Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Ability to lead technical discussions and mentor Guidewire development teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Guidewire ACE Certification in PolicyCenter / Rating. 
 - Experience working as a Rating Lead, Technical Lead, or Guidewire Architect. 
 - Experience across multiple end-to-end Guidewire PolicyCenter implementations. 
 - Exposure to Guidewire Cloud Platform and cloud-native architecture. 
 - Experience with rating modernization, migration, or integration with external rating engines. 
 - Strong client-facing communication and stakeholder management skills. 

What You Bring

- Strong ownership of technical delivery and solution quality. 
 - Ability to balance business requirements, technical feasibility, performance, and scalability. 
 - Strong architectural thinking with hands-on development capability. 
 - Experience working in Agile / Scrum delivery environments. 
 - Excellent communication, collaboration, and technical leadership skills.

data.title: Senior Agentic AI Solution Architect
data.description:
Job Location: Remote - Hyderabad, Indore . Ahmedabad

Experience: 10+ Years

Role Type: Hands-on technical architect - not a delivery or engagement management role

About the Role: 

We are looking for an experienced Senior Agentic AI Solution Architect to serve as technical design

partner for a strategic enterprise client building a greenfield, production-grade multi-agent AI platform. 

You will define the architecture from first principles, working directly with the client's senior engineering

leadership. 

The platform has two layers: an advisory layer that turns enterprise signals into root-cause analysis, 

backlog mapping, and next-best-action recommendations; and an execution layer that models

requirements, self-validates solutions pre-deployment, and orchestrates readiness and go-live. 

The defining constraint is governed autonomy - the client operates in a regulated trust-and-

compliance domain, so every autonomous decision must be auditable, factually grounded, and safe. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Architecture Ownership

- Own end-to-end architecture: ingestion, knowledge/retrieval, agent reasoning, tool access, and governance. 
 - Design the knowledge lake across telemetry, voice-of-customer signals, CRM, backlog systems, documents, and repositories. 
 - Architect the MCP gateway, registry, servers, and connectors for governed tool and data access. Multi-Agent System Design

- Design the multi-agent reasoning core: planner/re-planner, reasoning loops, memory, and agent collaboration. 
 - Architect solutions utilizing LLMs, RAG, knowledge systems, vector databases, and semantic search. Governance & Evaluation

- Build governance as a first-class layer: audit trails, grounding, guardrails, human-in-the-loop, and graceful degradation. 
 - Establish AI governance, security, explainability, observability, and Responsible AI standards. 
 - Define the evaluation harness, quality metrics, and measurable baselines. Delivery & Technical Direction

- Drive an end-to-end pilot on a real use case before scaling. 
 - Set technical direction for the offshore delivery pod. 
 - Create architecture blueprints, reference implementations, and reusable frameworks; guide engineering teams through implementation and technology decisions. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 10+ years in software engineering/architecture, including 3+ years hands-on with agentic or multi-agent LLM systems in production. 
 - Proven greenfield architecture ownership on a complex, ambiguous system. 
 - Deep multi-agent orchestration expertise: planning, reasoning loops, tool use, memory, and agent collaboration. 
 - Strong RAG and knowledge architecture: embedding strategy, hybrid/semantic retrieval, vector stores, and grounding. 
 - Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent) and MCP or comparable tool-access layers. 
 - Demonstrated AI safety and evaluation work: hallucination mitigation, guardrails, and evaluation harnesses. 
 - Strong Python and/or Java development experience, with API-first and microservices-based architecture background. 
 - Exceptional client-facing communication - able to hold your own with a senior technical executive. 
 - Still hands-on: writes code, builds prototypes, debugs real systems. 

Education

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field

RSM is seeking an Application Development Director to lead and grow our India-based software engineering teams. This is a hybrid technical and people-leadership role: the Director will build and scale a multi-disciplinary engineering organization spanning Microsoft technologies, custom application development, integration, data engineering, and NetSuite/cloud native applications, while directly owning the hiring, development, and retention of engineering talent in India. The Director will also own team utilization and financial performance, ensuring the practice delivers high-quality client outcomes as a sustainable, well-run business.

People Leadership, Hiring & Retention

- Own the hiring strategy and execution for engineering roles in India, building a strong pipeline of software engineering talent across disciplines. 
 - Mentor, coach, and grow developers, technical leads, and project managers on technical skills, delivery best practices, and career progression. 
 - Build a culture and set of practices that drive employee engagement and retention, reducing attrition across the India engineering organization. 
 - Collaborate and work effectively with consultants, engineers, and peer leaders across other regions and practices to support a unified, global delivery model. 
 - Identify and develop future leaders within the team, creating clear growth paths for high performers. 

Multi-Discipline Engineering Leadership

- Lead delivery and staffing across a multi-discipline engineering portfolio: Microsoft (Dynamics 365 and Power Platform), custom application development, integration, data engineering, and NetSuite/cloud native applications. 
 - Ensure consistent engineering standards, delivery methodology, and technical best practices are applied across all disciplines. 
 - Champion cross-discipline collaboration so that Microsoft, custom apps, integration, data engineering, and cloud native teams work from a shared playbook rather than in silos.

Client & Solution Delivery

 - Conduct end-user training and produce knowledge-transfer documentation as needed to support client enablement. 

Team Financial Performance & Utilization

NET, JavaScript, Angular or React), integration, data engineering (SQL Server, ETL, data warehousing), and NetSuite or other cloud native platforms.

data.title: Principal Engineer, Systems Architecture [T500-29934]
data.description:
About T-Mobile: 

T-Mobile US, Inc. (NASDAQ: TMUS), headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, is America's supercharged Un-carrier, connecting millions through its strong nationwide network and flagship brands, T-Mobile and Metro by T-Mobile. Customers benefit from an unmatched combination of value, quality, and exceptional service experience. 

About TMUS Global Solutions: 

TMUS Global Solutions is a world-class technology powerhouse accelerating the company's global digital transformation. With a culture built on growth, inclusivity, and global collaboration, the teams here drive innovation at scale, powered by bold thinking. 

TMUS India Private Limited operates as TMUS Global Solutions. 

About the Role: 

This role is a hands-on technical leadership position that owns the architecture, automation, and reliability of a core infrastructure domain across on-premise compute and other bare-metal, virtualized and containerized platforms at both the edge and the datacenter. The Principal Engineer is the accountable technical owner for that space: setting direction, defining standards, making and defending design decisions, and answering for outcomes such as availability, delivery speed, and operational quality. The role involves building scalable, self-service platforms, leveraging tools such as Ansible Automation Platform, agentic AI solutions, and open source bare-metal automation tools, enabling teams to provision, patch, and manage infrastructure on demand. The Principal Engineer is a mentor and technical anchor for the team, raising the capability of other engineers through design reviews, hands-on guidance, incident leadership, and shared standards. The engineer will collaborate with infrastructure, cybersecurity, and platform teams, including counterparts across time zones, to streamline operations, automate security and compliance workflows, and drive the migration from legacy tools to modern automation frameworks. This role will champion operational excellence and developer enablement, ensuring our automation ecosystems are secure, efficient, and continuously evolving to support traditional workloads, AI workloads (training, inference), and agent-driven operations. 

What You'll Do: 

- Own the technical strategy, roadmap, and health of a core infrastructure domain, and be the accountable technical lead for its design, reliability, and lifecycle. 
 - Lead the design, development, and deployment of end-to-end automation solutions that meet business and technical requirements. 
 - Mentor engineers and senior engineers through design reviews, code and automation reviews, pairing, and onboarding, and actively develop their technical depth and independence. 
 - Provide technical leadership during critical P1/P2 production incidents, drive root cause analysis, and ensure corrective actions are completed and shared across the team. 
 - Define infrastructure standards, reference architectures, and operational documentation, and evaluate designs for availability, resiliency, scalability, security, and supportability. 
 - Drive innovation by evaluating, recommending, and adopting new technologies and tools, including AI-enabled automation capabilities. 
 - Enable development and operational teams through robust self-service platforms and targeted support, reducing friction while accelerating delivery. 
 - Design automation with a self-service-first mindset, abstracting complexity behind APIs, workflows, portals, and MCP servers that expose capabilities to AI agents, while enforcing guardrails. 
 - Collaborate with platform, SRE, cybersecurity, and application teams, including US-based counterparts, to translate manual processes into scalable automation patterns. 
 - Support and evolve on-premise AI compute and GPU-as-a-Service platforms, enabling teams to provision, manage, and consume accelerated compute through standardized, automated workflows. 
 - Deliver self-service capabilities for deploying and serving LLM models on GPU enabled infrastructure, with standardized, automated workflows for model rollout, scaling, and observability. 
 - Build and maintain Ansible Automation Platform-driven workflows for bare-metal configuration, OS patching, and rapid deployment of environments at both the edge and the datacenter. 
 - Use, build, and manage AI agents as a core part of day-to-day engineering, leveraging them to accelerate automation work and helping define how the team operates, governs, and scales agent-driven workflows safely and reliably. 
 - Ensure automation solutions are observable, supportable, and resilient, with clear logging, error handling, and operational documentation. 

What You'll Bring: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or related field. 
 - Proven experience owning an infrastructure platform or domain end to end and delivering scalable, reliable, and secure automation solutions. 
 - Demonstrated track record of mentoring and developing engineers, such as leading design reviews, coaching through incidents, or growing team members into larger roles. 
 - Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e. g. , Java, Python, Go, JavaScript) applied to automation, tooling, or platform integrations. 
 - Familiarity with on-premise AI compute, bare-metal, and storage solutions across edge and datacenter deployments. 
 - Strong analytical thinking and collaborative problem-solving skills, with the judgment to make and defend architecture decisions. 
 - Excellent communication and technical documentation abilities. 

Must Have Skills: 

- 10+ years technical engineering experience, preferably in multiple technology focus areas. 
 - Deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain (for example Linux platforms, virtualization, OpenShift/Kubernetes, or enterprise storage), with broad working knowledge across the others. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop engineers and to act as the technical authority and escalation point for a team.

Plan, conduct and monitor quality of a product line including incoming, in-process and final inspection of parts and shall be accountable for on-time inspection of parts to meet the customer demand with almost focus on quality objectives. 

Job Description

Site Overview: 

Our Multi-modal Manufacturing Facility (MMF) in Pune plays a crucial role in manufacturing key aerospace components, supporting not only India's defense and commercial sectors but also global aviation supply chains. Our relationships with Indian suppliers, combined with our world-class local facilities and global reach, continue to shape India's aerospace ecosystem. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Approve in-process production by confirming required specifications, conducting visual and measurement tests, and communicating the required adjustments to the production supervisor
 - Qualified NDT level 2 as per EN ISO 9712 in MT and VT
 - Approve all finished products by confirming specifications and conducting required tests
 - Document and update inspection results by completing reports and logs
 - Investigate customer complaints and non-conformance issues
 - Develop, recommend and monitor corrective and preventive actions
 - Responsible for Driving Quality in products and processes and establishing process for ensuring meeting the Customer expectations
 - Responsible for collect and compile statistical quality data
 - Document internal audits and other quality assurance activities
 - Evaluate audit findings and implement appropriate corrective actions
 - Marinate reports to communicate outcomes of quality activities
 - Proactively identifying areas of obstruction / breakdowns and take steps to rectify the problem at early stage
 - Assist Manufacturing in investigations of process related quality issues
 - Tracking and controlling the rejection by raising alarm/ NC with immediate effect and maintaining CoQ as per organizational requirements
 - Involved in Kaizen and other process improvements like suggestion activities
 - Proficient in computer skills, including MS Office 
 - Calibration activity of all Measuring and testing instruments at in-house and sub-contracting. 
 - Manage MRB & RTV and ensure on-time disposition / drive supplier recovery as applicable; also maintain critical supplier score card
 - Participate in HPT Team discussions (HPT = High Performance Teams) and provide insights on quality, quality escapes and issue resolution, RCA, CAPA etc. 
 - Shall be familiar with manufacturing processes including assembly, torqueing, wiring harness assembly, electronic component handling etc
 - Shall be responsible for total compliance to Quality Management System and Lead key initiatives; align the function with business goals to support 2x growth of the business Year-Over-Year
 - Use experience and expertise to perform the assigned tasks himself and provide leadership to quality inspectors, mentor & train them and ensure their skill enhancement continuously. 
 - Own Quality Metrics including COQ, FPY, DPU, Escaping Defects, Customer Issue Resolution, On-Time Qualification etc. for the product line
 - Work closely with AME Team to manage digitization of key quality metrics, deployment of Quality module in MES etc. and also support Lean initiatives (re-layout/ resource optimization/ automation etc. )
 - Calibration Management of all gauges / instruments / fixtures; deploy smart gauges (blue tooth enabled) to help accelerate digitization of manufacturing operations

The Ideal Candidate

The Ideal candidate will ensure the quality of the entire product line, manage internal audits, and drive corrective actions. They will lead quality initiatives, mentor quality inspectors, and ensure compliance with the Quality Management System. 

Required Qualification

- Diploma in in Mechanical, Electrical or Production Engineering from a reputed college /university
 - 2-5 years of experience in Quality Function mainly for inspection of welded parts
 - Shall be willing to work in shifts to meet the organizational goals. 
 - Strong oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate across levels
 - The candidate shall be highly energetic and passionate with positive attitude. He shall be able to explain clearly business drivers and organizational objectives to team

Preferred Qualifications

- Ability to diverse activities simultaneously. Knowledge of 5S, Lean and Six Sigma Methodology. 
 - Experience in Documenting internal audits and other quality assurance activities, evaluate audit findings, and implement appropriate corrective actions

Closing

Whether we are manufacturing components for our engines, driving innovation in fuel and noise reduction, or unlocking new opportunities to grow and deliver more productivity, our GE Aerospace teams are dedicated and making a global impact. Join us and help move the aerospace industry forward.

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.description:
About Snapmint

Founded by IIT Bombay alumni (Nalin Agrawal, Anil Gelra, Abhineet Sawa), Snapmint is building India's most loved payment brand. We pioneered Pay in 3 through UPI and are also home to India's leading 0% EMI e-commerce app - giving millions of Indians the freedom to shop now and pay in monthly instalments, with noextra cost and no credit card required. We're on a mission to makefair, transparent credit accessible to Young India - and make payments simple, enjoyable and worry-free. Headquartered in Mumbai, with offices across major metros including Bengaluru, Gurugram, Delhi andJaipur, we're building at the intersection of commerce, credit, technology and culture. If you want to work on aproduct used by millions, build a brand people genuinely love, and help redefine how the next generation of Indiapays and spends you'll fit right in. Come build Snapmint and help us change how India pays. 

The Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Architect - Performance Engineering to drive performance engineering initiatives across the application, database, infrastructure, and network layers. The role requires deep expertise in diagnosing bottlenecks, optimizing system performance, and building scalable architectures capable of supporting high transaction volumes and rapid business growth. This is not a purely advisory architecture role. You will be expected to lead and, where required, independently execute performance improvements end-to-end. 

Role Details

- Role Title: Principal Engineer / Architect - Performance Engineering
 - Department: Technology
 - Employment Type: Full-time
 - Experience: 10-15 Years
 - Location: Gurugram
 - Working Model: Work from Office - 5 Days per Week

What You Own

Performance Engineering

- Own end-to-end performance of critical systems across latency, throughput, concurrency, scalability, and resource utilization. 
 - Diagnose complex performance bottlenecks using profiling, benchmarking, load testing, distributedtracing, and system-level analysis. 
 - Identify performance issues across application code, runtime, databases, network, and infrastructure, and drive them to resolution. 
 - Establish performance engineering practices covering capacity planning, performance testing, profiling, and production optimization. 
 - Partner with engineering teams to design systems that scale predictably under increasing load. 

Infrastructure, Database & Network Optimization

- Optimize compute, memory, storage, networking, and cloud infrastructure for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. 
 - Tune PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, and other data systems through query optimization, indexing, schema design, caching, connection management, and capacity planning. 
 - Analyse network behaviour including DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP, TLS, connection pooling, load balancing, routing, and payload optimization. 
 - Investigate production incidents and perform deep root-cause analysis across the full technology stack. 
 - Build and improve observability required to understand system behaviour and proactively identify performance degradation. 

Infrastructure & Operational Excellence Architecture & Technical Leadership

- Define architectural patterns and engineering standards for high-performance distributed systems. 
 - Identify systemic performance problems across services and drive cross-team remediation. 
 - Work closely with Backend, Platform, DevOps, SRE, and Data teams on high-impact performance initiatives. 
 - Establish measurable performance goals and use data to validate improvements. 

Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in Performance Engineering, Platform Engineering, Backend Engineering, or Solution Architecture. 

What You Bring

- Deep expertise in application performance tuning and distributed systems. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, and caching technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of networking concepts including DNS, connection pooling, compression, load balancing, TCP/IP, and HTTP protocols. 
 - Experience with performance testing and observability tools such as JMeter, k6, Gatling, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar. 
 - Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a proven track record of solving large-scale performance bottlenecks. 

Why Snapmint

- Be Part of a 10X-100X Journey - Help build and scale and be part of a high-growth story. 
 - Raise the Bar - Learn from people who raise the bar. 
 - Solve Hard Problems - Work on meaningful, high-impact challenges. 
 - Own the Outcome - Take ownership and make things happen. 
 - Move Fast, Build Fast - Turn ideas into action, not backlogs. 
 - Make Real Impact - See your work reach millions of customers. 
 - Grow with Snapmint - Take on bigger challenges as we scale. 

Explore Snapmint

• Life at Snapmint - https: //www. linkedin. com/company/snapmintfinserv/life

About Us

Graphcore is one of the world's leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. 

It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

Graphcore's teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation. 

About The Role

We are looking for Staff System Software Engineer in Test to join our team. 

In this role, you will be responsible for design, development, automation and reporting of Integration and system tests spanning across firmware and device drivers. 

This role requires you to have significant technical breadth and deep understanding of low-level system software specifically in server class systems. 

You will be part of a new team responsible for integration of different system software deliverables and development of system tests spanning all the components. You will

contribute to shaping the test strategy , guide best practices and solve complex problems while maintaining a strong hands-on focus. You will partner with development and other QA teams to deliver high quality scalable

and reliable solutions.

Decisions are shaped by evidence, clear technical reasoning and ownership. You will be expected to speak up, act fast and raise standards through hands-on leadership.

Today, Snapmint has crossed 50M+ app downloads and is the preferred payment partner for 2, 000+ leadingconsumer brands, including Zepto, ixigo, Adani, District Store, Titan and many more. We're on a mission to makefair, transparent credit accessible to Young India - and make payments simple, enjoyable and worry-free. Headquartered in Mumbai, with offices across major metros including Bengaluru, Gurugram, Delhi andJaipur, we're building at the intersection of commerce, credit, technology and culture. If you want to work on aproduct used by millions, build a brand people genuinely love, and help redefine how the next generation of Indiapays and spends you'll fit right in. Come build Snapmint and help us change how India pays. 

The Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Architect - Performance Engineering to drive performance engineering initiatives across the application, database, infrastructure, and network layers. The role requires deep expertise in diagnosing bottlenecks, optimizing system performance, and building scalable architectures capable of supporting high transaction volumes and rapid business growth. This is not a purely advisory architecture role. You will be expected to lead and, where required, independently execute performance improvements end-to-end. 

Role Details

- Role Title: Principal Engineer / Architect - Performance Engineering

 - Employment Type: Full-time

What You Own

Performance Engineering

- Own end-to-end performance of critical systems across latency, throughput, concurrency, scalability, and resource utilization.

 - Identify performance issues across application code, runtime, databases, network, and infrastructure, and drive them to resolution. 
 - Establish performance engineering practices covering capacity planning, performance testing, profiling, and production optimization. 
 - Partner with engineering teams to design systems that scale predictably under increasing load. 

Infrastructure, Database & Network Optimization

data.title: CFD & Simulation Engineer
data.description:
Role overview

We are looking for an experienced CFD & Simulation Engineer to run aerodynamics and CFD studies, build and validate simulation environments, and support SITL and HITL testing. The role covers aerodynamic and thermal analysis, simulation model development, virtual testing, and correlation of predictions with field test data. 

What you'll do

Aerodynamics & CFD

- Run parametric CFD studies (OpenFOAM, ANSYS Fluent or Star-CCM+) on body geometry, fairing profiles and structural cross-sections to minimise drag while preserving structural margins
 - Characterise propulsion-body interactions: wake interference in compact layouts, asymmetric loading at steep angles of attack, and performance variation across operating speed ranges
 - Model altitude-dependent aerodynamic performance, including air density variation from sea level to 5, 000 m and its effect on drag, propulsive efficiency and range
 - Perform thermal CFD analysis for onboard electronics and power source cooling under sustained high-power operation in compact, sealed enclosures
 - Validate CFD predictions against field test data by correlating predicted vs measured drag, power draw and energy consumption
 - Drive aerodynamic shape optimisation using adjoint methods, surrogate models or parametric sweepsSimulation & Virtual Testing

- Build and validate Gazebo simulation environments with accurate aerodynamic models, propulsion dynamics and sensor noise models
 - Integrate SITL frameworks so guidance and control engineers can test autonomous algorithms without field tests
 - Develop scenario libraries covering engagement geometries, speeds, altitudes and environmental conditions (wind, turbulence, density variation)
 - Design HITL test bench specifications that connect real embedded hardware to the simulation physics engine
 - Create automated regression test pipelines that run algorithm changes against the scenario library and flag performance regressions
 - Keep simulation fidelity high by continuously updating aerodynamic and propulsion models as new test data arrivesWhat you'll need

- Demonstrated experience with ROS 2 and Gazebo (Classic or Harmonic), including custom plugin development for aerodynamic and propulsion models
 - Strong Python and C++ skills for simulation scripting, data analysis, post-processing and plugin development
 - Understanding of propulsive aerodynamics: blade element theory, performance variation with operating conditions, wake interaction effects
 - Ability to process and interpret test data: sensor logs, power telemetry and position traces

Design and hands-on build core microservices in Golang - gRPC and REST APIs, secure HTTPS / TLS and mutual TLS between services.

Microservices at scale - gRPC / Protocol Buffers, REST, API versioning, backward-compatible schema evolution and resilience patterns.

You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components

 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)

data.title: Emulation Prototyping Engineer
data.description:
CScale is building the interconnect for gigawatt-scale AI. As AI scale-up moves toward deployments spanning thousands of accelerators and dozens of racks, the network needs to deliver high bandwidth, predictable low latency, and continuous communication. CScale is building integrated optical interconnect designed for this new scale, enabling accelerators to work together like a single, much larger computer. But at this scale, performance is only part of the challenge. Optical failures are inevitable, and the system needs to keep running. CScale is designing the interconnect for continuity. Lasers will fail. Compute shouldn't. The ambition is simple: Build AI interconnect you can take for granted. CScale came out of stealth in September 2026 with $145 million in Series C funding, bringing total funding to $188 million. 

Role Summary

The Emulation Lead is responsible for driving pre-silicon validation and performance analysis of complex Data Center SoCs using hardware emulation platforms. This role ensures early software bring-up, system-level validation, and debug of critical features before tape-out. The position involves architecting emulation strategies, building scalable environments, integrating IPs and subsystems, and enabling workloads representative of real data center use cases. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define emulation methodology for data center SoCs with CPU, NOC/Crossbar, Ethernet and high-speed IOs. 
 - Develop partitioning strategies& set up emulation environments (Palladium, Veloce, ZeBu) and partition RTL for hardware-based platforms. 
 - Port large-scale SoCs/IPs onto emulators, bring up the platform, and debug interface/functional issues involving firmware/hardware. 
 - Integrate and develop synthesizable monitors/checkers, VIP transactors, NOC bridges (MAC/PHY DDR) 
 - Emulation prototyping forboot loader bring-up, SoC configuration, first power-on sequences, clock/reset validation, strap/fuse programming 
 - Own stress testing and completeness of data path includingEthernet PHY/MAC link bring-up, loopback tests; validate DMA descriptors, interrupts 
 - Automate emulation regression flows using scripting (TCL, Python, Perl) andoptimize for coverage and debug time. 
 - Collaborate closely with verification, firmware, software, architecture teams for pre-silicon validation and bring-up. 

Required Skills

- Strong exposure of emulation platformCadence Palladium, Synopsys ZeBu, Mentor Veloce 
 - Strongproficiency in C/C++ and RTL partitioning for emulation platforms. 
 - Drive validation activitiesex: bootloader bring-up and executing real-world workloads. 
 - Waveform analysis, transaction-level debug, log parsing 
 - Emulation + virtual models, FPGA prototyping. 

Added Advantage

- Understanding of System Verilog/UVM, SVA, coverage-driven verification 
 - Python/TCL scripting experience and post-silicon bring-up

In this critical role, you will be instrumental in designing and building the foundational risk platform that underpins our industry-leading cybersecurity solutions. You will work with cutting-edge technologies such as Golang, microservices architecture, and diverse database ecosystems to deliver comprehensive visibility into organizational risks, management features, and prioritization workflows. Your work will contribute to a globally distributed, fault-tolerant, and highly scalable cloud ecosystem that integrates risk data from CrowdStrike's internal providers and third-party sources. As a technical leader, you will drive end-to-end product delivery, architect scalable solutions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to define priorities and scope. This role offers an exciting opportunity to influence the cybersecurity landscape by developing innovative exposure management solutions that safeguard organizations from complex threats. If you are passionate about operating at scale and eager to learn Golang, we welcome your application. 

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess over 10 years of experience in building, delivering, and maintaining large-scale distributed systems processing high-volume data. Strong expertise in object-oriented programming languages such as Golang or Python is essential, along with proven experience in designing scalable microservices and REST APIs. Candidates should have a solid background in developing data platforms involving distributed ETLs and data ingestion pipelines, along with comprehensive knowledge of cloud infrastructure providers like AWS, Azure, or GCP. A deep understanding of distributed systems concepts, including concurrency and scalability patterns, is required. Proficiency with message queues such as Kafka, and database versatility across RDBMS, NoSQL, and distributed caches like Redis, is necessary. Candidates should demonstrate excellent troubleshooting skills for complex architectures, adherence to engineering best practices, and the ability to mentor junior engineers. A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent professional background is expected. Bonus qualifications include experience with machine learning, AI technologies, cybersecurity, graph databases, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and open-source contributions. 

Responsibilities

As a Senior Engineer at CrowdStrike, your responsibilities will include designing and developing scalable backend services that power both internal and customer-facing applications, ensuring high performance, security, and reliability. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify requirements and develop APIs, microservices, and data pipelines that support platform growth. Working closely with the DevOps team, you will design and implement cloud infrastructure solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP, automating deployment and monitoring processes while ensuring compliance with security standards. You will design and optimize database solutions, including RDBMS, NoSQL, and distributed data stores, to support data integrity and performance. Troubleshooting complex distributed architectures to resolve performance bottlenecks and reliability issues will be a key aspect of your role, along with developing monitoring and logging solutions to enhance system visibility. You will provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement. Additionally, you will lead operational excellence initiatives, including configuring monitoring, alerting, incident response, and ensuring high availability of production services. Your work will directly impact the security posture of our clients by enabling robust risk management and exposure analysis capabilities. 

Benefits

CrowdStrike offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of its employees. Benefits include competitive compensation and equity awards, physical and mental wellness programs, and generous paid time off, including holidays and vacation days. The company provides paid parental and adoption leave to support work-life balance. Employees have access to ongoing professional development opportunities, fostering continuous learning and career advancement. CrowdStrike promotes a vibrant workplace culture with employee networks, community groups, and volunteer opportunities that encourage connection and engagement. The company's offices feature world-class amenities, creating an inspiring environment for collaboration. Recognized as a Great Place to WorkTM, CrowdStrike is committed to creating an inclusive, supportive, and innovative workplace where employees can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the company's mission. 

Equal Opportunity

CrowdStrike is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances our innovation and effectiveness, and we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action programs and are committed to creating a culture of belonging where everyone is valued and empowered to succeed. If you require assistance accessing our website or submitting an application, please contact us at recruiting@crowdstrike. com for support.

data.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

Education Qualification

Bachelor's/master's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent relevant technical degree. 

10 to 16years of relevant Experience in Systems & Component level Verification & Validation activities. 

Deep domain knowledge in design verification and validation of medical devices. 

Relevant technical testing/reliability experience in Plastic/Connectors/Products/electro-mechanical. 

Understanding of hardware methodologies and test best practices. 

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Own and drive change control activities by ensuring accountability for all technical aspects of development, sustaining projects, and design controls. 

Lead the design and execution of R&D studies, provide manufacturing support as needed, and contribute to product specifications. 

Drive the development, improvement, and troubleshooting of disposable manufacturing processes. 

Lead and implement changes through creative solutions, adapting to new product test methods and technologies while driving test automation to improve quality assurance and productivity in test deliverables. 

Partner with R&D and cross-functional teams to coordinate product integration and system testing, including automated testing. 

Plan, build, and maintain test infrastructure, including lab budget planning and management. 

Demonstrate the ability to achieve objectives and deliver multiple projects simultaneously. 

Develop and maintain effective, collaborative working relationships with internal and external stakeholders across levels and cultures. 

Lead V&V activities to meet customer requirements, safety, regulatory, and quality expectations within committed timelines. 

Support corporate, internal, ISO, and regulatory audits by ensuring adherence to Vantive QMS requirements. 

Lead audit nonconformances or findings to closure by defining and implementing appropriate corrective actions. 

Lead and execute IQ, OQ, and PQ for equipment and instruments in accordance with QMS site policies. 

Ensure lab requirements are validated, and laboratories are qualified for intended use; coordinate shared equipment usage when needed. 

Qualify vendors and add them to the approved vendor list by coordinating with the sourcing team to ensure quick turnaround. 

Be self-motivated with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to analyze and solve complex problems through innovative thinking and experience. 

Hands-on experience with mechanical equipment such as UTM, leak testers, torque testers, and other instruments or equipment would be an added advantage.

Exposure to regulatory standards, medical device manufacturing processes and procedures, RF welding, and solvent bonding would be an added benefit.

Description

Amazon Flex Investigation and Offboarding (Flex I&O) is looking for a Training and Quality Manager to lead and develop our training and quality assurance functions. The Flex I&O team's mission is to protect the Amazon Flex Brand and Customers by adjudicating Delivery Partner incidents that warrant offboarding after a single offense. This role is responsible for designing and delivering training programs, building and maintaining quality assurance frameworks, and driving continuous improvement initiatives to ensure the highest standards of performance, compliance, and operational readiness are maintained across all queues and geographies. 

The ideal candidate is an experienced leader who is passionate about raising the quality and training bar, building scalable audit and learning frameworks, and coaching analysts and trainers to deliver consistent, data-driven insights that strengthen the Flex I&O operation. You will work closely with Program Managers, Team Managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate audit findings and training needs into actionable improvements. 

Key job responsibilities

- Serve as a subject matter expert across training and quality assurance for the Flex I&O team, providing guidance and support to specialists
 - Design, develop, and deliver comprehensive training programs for new hires and existing team members, ensuring alignment with Flex I&O SOPs, policies, and standards
 - Develop and maintain QA processes, methodologies, and best practices aligned with Flex I&O standards
 - Establish and monitor quality metrics and KPIs to measure case accuracy, compliance trends, and training effectiveness across all queues and markets
 - Conduct regular audits and calibration sessions to ensure consistent scoring, adherence to SOPs, translating findings into targeted training plans and process improvements
 - Collaborate with Program Managers, Team Managers, and stakeholders to identify knowledge gaps, process changes, and training needs, and develop content to address them
 - Manage personal workload and priorities to meet audit volume targets and training delivery schedules in a fast-paced environment
 - Drive automation initiatives and implement tools to improve audit efficiency, training delivery, and reporting
 - Report on quality metrics, training effectiveness, and trends to senior leadership, highlighting risk areas and recommending solutions
 - Support onboarding by creating and maintaining onboarding materials, facilitating new-hire training sessions, and ensuring readiness assessments are completed before go-live

Basic Qualifications

- 1+ years of work experience
 - Experience developing and delivering training programs with strong analytical skills to identify trends and drive data-informed decisions
 - Experience developing or managing quality assurance programs, audit frameworks, or root cause analysis to drive improvements

Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with process improvement methodologies (Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma) or instructional design and e-learning platforms
 - Bilingual (Spanish, Japanese, Portuguese, French)
