Position Team Lead, Delphi Development

Summary

APRO develops invoice processing and banking integration software for organisations operating Oracle E-Business Suite. Our on-premise products, APRO Imaging and APRO Banking Gateway, have been in continuous production for more than 25 years at enterprise customers throughout the world. We are seeking a team lead to assume technical ownership of both products. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership position. The role combines senior development work with responsibility for the quality standard, release decisions and production incident management. It is not a people management position and does not represent a transition away from development. 

The products

- APRO Imaging provides document management and invoice processing for Oracle E-Business Suite. The application captures invoices by scanning, email or import, extracts the invoice data using OCR, matches invoices against purchase orders in Oracle E-Business Suite, routes them through approval workflows and posts them to Oracle Payables
 - APRO Banking Gateway provides banking integration for Oracle E-Business Suite. The application transmits SEPA payments to banks over EBICS, receives and processes bank statements in MT940 and CAMT. 053 formats, reconciles transactions against Oracle Receivables and manages SEPA direct debit mandates

Both applications operate directly against the customer's own Oracle database within their Oracle E-Business Suite environment. Each is maintained across two concurrent code lines: a development line on Delphi 12 and a customer release line on Delphi XE5. 

Technology Delphi 12 and Delphi XE5, VCL, DevExpress, ODAC; Oracle 11g to current; Oracle E-Business Suite. 

Areas of responsibility

- Quality standard. Coding standards, review policy and technical direction for both products, with approval authority over what is delivered to customers
 - Release management. Determination of the code line on which each correction is delivered, and whether a backport to a customer release branch is warranted
 - Production incidents. Classification of reported errors as software defects, data issues or configuration problems, and management of these through to resolution with the customer
 - Engineering practice. Definition and implementation of engineering practice for the Delphi codebase, including build automation and test strategy
 - Technical guidance. Support and development of the team, and active distribution of knowledge of the codebases
 - International coordination. Acting as the technical point of reference for departments in the Netherlands, India and the United States

Requirements

- 6+ years hands-on Delphi development experience, across both a legacy version (XE5 generation) and a current version (10. x, 11 or 12), with the intention of remaining technically active
 - A detailed understanding of the Delphi technology stack, Oracle databases, and SQL in Oracle's dialect. The team lead is the final reviewer of both the application and the database components
 - Working knowledge of Oracle E-Business Suite, in particular the Payables (AP) and Receivables (AR) data models
 - Experience leading a small development team while continuing to contribute technically
 - A demonstrable record of ownership of release decisions, production incidents and the associated customer communication
 - The judgement to establish a shared technical standard rather than to apply personal preference, including the assessment of when established code should be left unchanged
 - Fluent written and spoken English, and the ability to communicate clearly with departments across several time zones

Preferred Qualifications

- Oracle PL/SQL package development. A substantial proportion of the business logic resides in the database
 - Experience of introducing engineering practice into an environment with limited existing process: documented standards, automated builds and a test practice
 - Experience of supporting multiple concurrent customer versions of a single product
 - Domain experience in European payment processing (SEPA, MT940, CAMT. 053, EBICS) or in accounts payable invoice processing with OCR and purchase order matching

Candidates who meet the principal requirements but not every preferred qualification are encouraged to apply.

data.description:
Why Verifone

For more than 30 years Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide. 

Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. Whether it's developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives each one of our employees for personal and professional success. 

Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located. 

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Java Developer Lead to lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable, high-performance backend applications. This role combines hands-on engineering with team leadership, overseeing a team of 4-8 developers while actively contributing to coding, architecture, and technical decision-making. The ideal candidate will drive engineering best practices, conduct code reviews, mentor team members, and ensure the delivery of high-quality software. Working closely with Product, QA, and DevOps teams, you will help define technical strategy, solve complex challenges, and deliver reliable, secure, and maintainable solutions that support business growth and operational excellence. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical leadership

- Own the architecture and design of Java-based microservices and backend applications. 
 - Define coding standards, design patterns, and best practices, and enforce them through code reviews. 
 - Evaluate and recommend tools, frameworks, and technologies; drive modernization and technical-debt reduction. 
 - Make sound trade-offs between performance, scalability, security, and maintainability. 

Team leadership and mentoring

- Lead, guide, and mentor a team of developers; run regular 1: 1s and support career growth. 
 - Break down requirements into technical tasks, estimate effort, and assign work. 
 - Take part in hiring: interviews, technical assessments, and onboarding of new engineers. 
 - Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning. 

Hands-on development

- Write clean, efficient, well-tested code using Java 17+ and Spring Boot. 
 - Design and build RESTful APIs and event-driven services (Kafka or similar). 
 - Optimize application and database performance; troubleshoot complex production issues. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with the DevOps team. 

Delivery and collaboration

- Work with product owners and business analysts to refine requirements and define acceptance criteria. 
 - Lead Agile ceremonies with the Scrum Master: sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives. 
 - Track delivery, flag risks early, and keep stakeholders informed of progress. 
 - Ensure releases meet quality, security, and compliance standards. 

What qualifications will you need to be successful?

Required Skills & Experience

- Candidates need a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
 - 8+ years of Java development, and 2+ years leading or mentoring a development team
 - Technical Expertise
 - Core Java: Java 11/17+, OOP, collections, multithreading and concurrency, JVM tuning, garbage collection
 - Frameworks: Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate
 - Architecture: Microservices, REST API design, design patterns, domain-driven design basics
 - Messaging: Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or ActiveMQ
 - Databases: SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle) and at least one NoSQL store (MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra)
 - Cloud and DevOps: AWS, Azure, or GCP; Docker; Kubernetes; Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions
 - Testing: JUnit 5, Mockito, integration testing; TDD mindset
 - Tools: Git, Maven or Gradle, Jira, Confluence
 - Practices: Agile/Scrum, code reviews, secure coding (OWASP Top 10). 
Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in payments, fintech, banking, or other high-volume transaction systems. 
 - Knowledge of reactive programming (Spring WebFlux, Project Reactor). 
 - Experience with observability tools: New Relic, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or the ELK stack. 
 - Infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation. 
 - Cloud certification (AWS Certified Developer or Solutions Architect, or equivalent). 
 - Exposure to frontend frameworks (React or Angular) for full-stack collaboration. 

Soft Skills

- Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking under pressure. 
 - Ability to coach, give constructive feedback, and resolve conflicts within the team. 
 - Ownership mindset: accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. 
 - Comfortable balancing hands-on coding with leadership responsibilities. 

Our Commitment

Verifone is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Verifone is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

Burckhardt Compression is seeking a technically strong and innovative engineering leader to drive product improvement initiatives across reciprocating compressor products and related rotating equipment. - Lead and drive Product Improvement Cell with end-to-end ownership of strategic improvement initiatives. 
 - Develop and maintain a structured pipeline of product improvement opportunities based on customer feedback, field issues, workshop observations, testing results, quality data, value engineering inputs, and technological advancements. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve product reliability, performance, manufacturability, maintainability, safety, and lifecycle cost. 
 - Drive standardization and modularization initiatives to improve engineering efficiency and reduce complexity. 
 - Generate innovative concepts for product enhancement and next-generation solutions.

Digitalization & Engineering Productivity

Education, Experience And Languages

Preferred Skills

 - Patent filings and R&D innovation output.

Role: Quality Manager/Engineer - Motor

The Quality Manager/Engineer is responsible for establishing, implementing, and maintaining world?class quality systems for EV traction motors -covering stator, rotor, and motor assembly processes. The role ensures IATF 16949 compliance, drives APQP/PPAP , leads problem solving and customer quality , manages SQE , and ensures all products meet safety, reliability, and performance standards. You will champion a culture of zero?defect, customer obsession, and continuous improvement , while guiding cross?functional teams to deliver high first?pass yields, low PPM, robust validation, and stable production. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Systems, Compliance & Audits

- Ensure full compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and customer?specific requirements. 
 - Lead internal and external audits (IATF, customer, regulatory) and close findings with sustainable actions. 
 - Maintain quality manuals, SOPs, Control Plans, PFMEA, inspection standards, traceability, and document control. 

NPI / APQP / PPAP Ownership

- Lead APQP from concept → DV → PV → PPAP → SOP. 
 - Approve design validation (DV) and production validation (PV) plans including durability, thermal, dielectric, vibration/NVH, and EOL performance.

In?Process Quality & Plant Performance

 - Monitor and improve EOL test signatures: electrical performance, torque ripple, partial discharge, hipot, run?in vibration/noise. 
 - Lead Layered Process Audits (LPA), gemba walks, and containment for non?conformance issues. 

Supplier Quality Management (SQE)

- Manage supplier quality for magnets, laminations, copper, machined parts, castings, adhesives/resins, sensors, and electronics. 
 - Conduct supplier audits (VDA 6. 3 preferred), approve PPAPs, ensure incoming quality checks, and track supplier PPM/OTD. 
 - Drive supplier corrective actions (8D), dual?sourcing risk plans, and cost?of?poor?quality reduction. 

Customer Quality & Issue Resolution

- Act as the primary interface for OEM/Tier?1 customers for all quality matters. 
 - Lead customer complaint resolution with 8D, root cause analysis, and permanent corrective actions. 
 - Manage warranty data, reliability growth, field returns (tear?down analysis), and customer scorecards. 
 - Own customer audits, QBRs, and new program readiness reviews. 

Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement

- Lead structured problem-solving (8D, A3, 5?Why, Fishbone) for line issues and customer complaints.

Leadership & Team Management

Qualifications

 - Strong data analysis experience (Minitab, Power BI, SPC tools)

L&T is a USD 30 billion Indian multinational engaged in EPC Projects, Hi-Tech Manufacturing, and Services, operating across multiple geographies. A strong, customer-focussed approach and the constant quest for top-class quality have enabled L&T to attain and sustain leadership in its major lines of business for eight decades. 

Given L&T's capability in strategic electronics and leveraging its foray into semiconductor design and well-established capabilities in L&T Technology Services, the business is expanding its offerings to cover industrial electronic modules, products and systems in critical sectors of Power Electronics, Automotive Electronics, Industrial Robotics & Automation, Communication Platforms and Electronic Systems Design & Manufacturing (ESDM). Expo is Walmart's in-house A/B testing and experimentation platform, developed and supported by Walmart Global Tech Data Platforms to meet the scale and unique requirements of Walmart's web and mobile applications. It enables teams to run statistically sound, experimentally valid tests with low lifecycle cost, allowing for data-driven evaluation of new features and changes. 

Expo is used across multiple Walmart customer-facing sites and apps, including walmart. com and international markets. The platform supports incremental rollout, risk reduction, and rapid iteration by letting teams preview, ramp up, or pause experiments as needed. The platform also supports real-time monitoring and provides exhaustive reports for tests. 

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead our experimentation and feature flag engineering team - a high-impact group responsible for building and maintaining the UI and control plane for multiple platform applications within Runtime Platforms. In this role, you will combine deep technical credibility with strong leadership instincts to guide a talented team of engineers, drive architectural excellence, and deliver impactful products in close partnership with Product, UX, and cross-functional stakeholders. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will be expected to engage deeply with the codebase - conducting code and design reviews, contributing to architectural decisions, and setting the technical bar for the team - while also owning the roadmap, planning cycles, and people development agenda. 

What You'll Bring

- Strong foundational understanding of JavaScript and TypeScript, including language internals, async patterns, and ecosystem tooling. 
 - Solid grasp of CSS, accessibility standards, and web fundamentals (browser rendering, performance, security).

 - Strong understanding of backend systems and services, including microservices architecture, RESTful and event-driven APIs.

 - Solid experience with both SQL (e. g. , MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (e. g. , Cassandra, MongoDB, Redis) databases - schema design, query optimization, and operational considerations. 

Cloud & Infrastructure

- Exposure to at least one major cloud platform - Azure or GCP preferred - including compute, storage, networking, and managed services. 
 - Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines. Architecture & Design
 - Strong command of Design Patterns (GoF, distributed systems patterns) and the ability to apply them pragmatically. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead System Design - decomposing complex problems into scalable, reliable, and maintainable architectures. 
 - Experience writing and reviewing Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) or equivalent design artifacts. 

Leadership & Soft Skills

- Proven track record of managing and growing engineering teams of 6-15 engineers. 
 - Strong communication skills - able to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Experience operating in an agile delivery model with cross-functional squads. 
 - Comfortable with ambiguity and capable of setting clear direction in fast-moving environments. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and build strong relationships across organizational boundaries. 

What You'll Do

Technical Leadership

- Lead and participate in code reviews and design reviews, upholding high standards for code quality, maintainability, and security. 
 - Develop and present technical design proposals for new features, platform capabilities, and architectural improvements. 
 - Drive adoption of sound design patterns and system design principles across all team deliverables. 
 - Champion engineering and operational excellence - improving build pipelines, test coverage, observability, and incident response practices. 

Product & Roadmap Ownership

- Collaborate closely with Product Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business goals into well-scoped engineering initiatives.

data.title: Principal Digital Engineer (DFT Design)
data.description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

This is an opportunity to join a top-notch Power Management IC Team with Renesas leading Automotive Business Unit. You will be part of a very skilled group of engineers who are helping build world-class automotive PMIC products that will power tomorrow's automobiles. You will design complex chips that includes various analog and digital control circuitry and work very closely with all aspects of chip design - from writing specifications to developing tests for mass production. You will be a key contributor to the digital DFT design team and work closely with the digital design team for meeting TEST requirements for Automobile and work closely with test engineering teams for validating the test patterns and meeting ASIL-B/D requirements. You will have an opportunity to work on new designs, insert Lbist and shape the company's pathway for success. Your responsibilities, depending on your level of experience and skill level, will be a mix of the following: 

- Inserting DFT/Scan on digital logic, ATPG, validating test patterns on pre and post layout gate level netlist. 
 - Delivering test patterns to TEST engineering team and validating them on silicon. 
 - Inserting Logicbist with industry standard tools. 
 - Improving scan coverage and modifying RTL for scan. 
 - Reduce ATE tester time by reducing scan patterns while achieving the required coverage. 
 - Participate in all aspects of digital design flow - Micro-architecture, Design partitioning, RTL Verilog / System Verilog coding, DFT insertion, generating Timing Constraints, Synthesis, Interaction with P&R Team, Timing Analysis, LINT, CDC. 
 - Working closely with Architects, Design, P&R, Test and Silicon validation teams. 
 - Assisting with top level test-bench creation for scan and running gate level simulations. 
 - Debug scan pattern fails on ATE and fix the scan patterns. 
 - Writing detailed design documents and help writing DFT specifications, reviewing the specs with different stake holders and own the design to meet the spec. 
 - Organizing and participating in key design reviews and completion of various checklists. Working on-site for 3 days a week is a must. 

Qualifications

Following are rough guidelines for the qualifications (if you feel you have much more or somewhat less, let that not stop you from applying): 

Required

- Masters plus 12+ years or Bachelors plus 15+ years experience in digital design and DFT implementation. 
 - Must be a team player and yet be an independent thinker with strong digital design and DFT fundamentals
 - Hands on experience in Scan insertion, improving scan coverage, ATPG, experience in Logicbist insertion during synthesis or rtl. 
 - Gate level simulations with test patterns, delivering test patterns to Test engineering team and work closely with them to get the patterns validated. 
 - Must have basic digital RTL coding experience besides synthesis exposure. 
 - Must have experience with at least 8 tapeouts with hands on experience with DFT/Scan. 
 - Ideal candidate will have solid understanding of synthesizable design, timing constraints and exceptions. 
 - Must have experience with industry standard Synopsys, Cadence, Mentor, Siemens for scan, Lbist insertion and ATPG. Tetramax experience is a huge plus. 
 - Attention to detail, accuracy and expertise in DFT required. 
 - Must have good written and verbal cross-functional communication skills
 - Have an analytical mind - be open to new ideas and have capability to persuade others in convincing and implementing better flows and processes. Desirable

- Mixed signal experience highly preferred. 
 - Exposure to automotive test requirements, ASIL, is highly preferred. Education

• BSEE required (MSEE preferred)

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21, 000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‐leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. 

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. 

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. 

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

S. government export license prior to release of technology to certain persons. The decision whether or not to file or pursue an export license application is at the sole discretion of Renesas.

Calibration & Validation

Benchmarking

Documentation

Compliance

data.description:

ENERPAC - Who we are?

Enerpac Tool Group is a premier industrial tools and services company serving a broad and diverse set of customers in more than 25 countries. The Company's businesses are global leaders in high pressure hydraulic tools, controlled force products and solutions for precise positioning of heavy loads that help customers safely and reliably tackle some of the most challenging jobs around the world. The Company was founded in 1910 and is headquartered in Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin. Enerpac Tool Group trades on the NYSE under the symbol "EPAC". 

Our vision is to be our customer's preferred partner through relentless innovation of industrial tools and services that help them safely and reliably tackle their toughest jobs around the world. 

For further information on Enerpac Tool Group and its businesses, visit the Company's website at https: //www. enerpactoolgroup. com/. 

Summary - Basic Function Of The Role

The QA Engineer - Web & Middleware is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of Enerpac's global digital platforms through comprehensive manual and automated testing. This role partners closely with the Sr. Global eCommerce Marketing Manager, Lead Web Developer, ERP and middleware developers, and global business stakeholders to validate website functionality, integrations, and end-to-end business processes across Enerpac's global web properties. The QA Engineer is responsible for establishing testing standards, developing automated regression testing, and ensuring production-ready releases that minimize customer-impacting defects. 

Shift: Monday - Friday, evenings and weekends may be required

Job Duties And Responsibilities

- Develop and execute comprehensive test strategies, test plans, test cases, and regression test suites for website functionality, middleware integrations, and end-to-end business processes. 
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, usability, cross-browser, cross-device, accessibility, and performance testing for global websites and ecommerce platforms. 
 - Validate end-to-end ecommerce workflows including product discovery, pricing, inventory availability, promotions, cart, checkout, payments, taxation, shipping, order creation, and customer account functionality.

 - Perform API testing using tools such as Postman or similar platforms to validate REST and GraphQL services and middleware functionality. 
 - Work closely with web development lead, ERP developers, and third-party vendors to coordinate testing activities and ensure successful delivery of global digital initiatives. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve QA processes, automation coverage, release quality, and overall software development practices through continuous improvement initiatives. 

Skills And Competencies

- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify root causes of functional and integration issues. 
 - Excellent attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality software. 
 - Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple testing efforts across concurrent projects. 
 - Effective verbal and written communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Ability to collaborate across development, business, ERP, infrastructure, and marketing teams. 
 - Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile/SCRUM methodologies, and DevOps practices. 
 - Experience creating comprehensive testing documentation, test strategies, defect reporting, and release validation processes. 
 - Knowledge of ecommerce business processes and customer purchase journeys. 
 - Familiarity with browser developer tools, logging, debugging, and API inspection tools. 
 - Ability to identify process improvements and drive adoption of QA best practices across development teams. 

Education And Experience

- 5-8 years of progressive experience in software quality assurance with demonstrated ownership of testing strategy, test automation, and release validation for enterprise web applications and ecommerce platforms 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related field. 
 - Experience testing modern web applications built using React or similar JavaScript frameworks. 
 - Experience testing ecommerce platforms such as Kibo Commerce, Oracle Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, or equivalent enterprise platforms. 
 - Experience creating and maintaining automated testing frameworks using Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar automation tools. 
 - Experience testing REST APIs, GraphQL services, and middleware integrations using tools such as Postman or equivalent. 
 - Experience with automated UI, API, regression, smoke, and integration testing. 
 - Experience validating ERP integrations involving pricing, inventory, customer, order, payment, and shipping data. 
 - Experience using defect tracking and Agile project management tools such as Trello, Azure DevOps, or equivalent. 
 - Experience working within CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes. 
 - Experience testing cross-browser, responsive, and mobile web applications. 
 - Experience supporting global, multilingual, and multi-currency ecommerce implementations is preferred. 

Physical Demands

Employee may have to lift documents/work materials up to 30 pounds in weight. Employee will have to be able to walk/climb to a variety of primary work locations, including traveling by air/auto to remote sites. Employee will need to listen, understand, and speak with team members in person, telephonically, and electronically at all levels within a diverse workforce and with supported organizations. Employee is able to work in front of a personal computer and telephone for long periods of time.

Primary work environment is temperature controlled office setting but may also be visiting different manufacturing facilities where following appropriate safety protocols at the location would be required. Occasional regional offices travel to factories, worksites and customer locations.

data.description:
Job Title

Supplier Quality Engineer - BP MR

Job Description

Job Title : Supplier Quality Engineer - BP MR

Job Responsibilities

- Evaluates potential new suppliers through technical capability assessments, ensuring they meet the company's rigorous standards and can deliver high-quality components and assists in the supplier selection. 
 - Executes DFMAT (Design for Manufacturing and Assembly Technique), SAF (Supplier Approval Form), MSA (Measurement System Analysis), PFMEA (Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis), Control Plan, SPC (Statistical Process Control), PV&V (Process Validation and Verification), FAI (First Article Inspection), LRA (Logistics Risk Assessment), and SICR (Supplier Initiated Change Request). 
 - Executes, monitors, and controls APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) processes during NPI projects to maintain consistent quality and adherence to project timelines. 
 - Contributes to the Supplier Project Book by documenting detailed quality requirements and expectations for suppliers, ensuring clear communication and compliance. 
 - Facilitates Design for Excellence (DfX) collaboration between R&D and suppliers to enhance product design quality, leveraging supplier expertise for better design outcomes. 
 - Ensures Critical to Quality (CtQ) characteristics are clearly communicated to suppliers and rigorously maintained throughout the production process, securing consistent product quality. 
 - Executes Part Submission Warrant plans, deliverables, line releases, and completion, ensuring that all parts meet specified quality standards before they are approved for use. 
 - Supports supplier improvement and development on APQP, providing guidance and resources to help suppliers enhance their quality processes and achieve compliance. 
 - Reviews Supplier Agreements, conducts thorough analysis of defects to determine if they are supplier-caused, and coordinates Supplier Corrective Action Requests to address and resolve quality issues effectively. 

Minimum Required Education

Bachelor's Degree Electrical Engineering/Electronic Engineering

Minimum Required Experience

Minimum 5-7 years of experience in Quality Engineering, Supplier Quality Engineering, Process Engineering, Continuous Improvement Techniques

Preferred Skills

- Supplier Quality Management - Mandatory
 - Quality Management Procedures and Methodologies - mandatory
 - Supplier Evaluation Methodologies - mandatory
 - Data Analysis & Interpretation
 - DfX Methodology
 - Supply Chain Management (SCM)
 - Quality Specifications
 - CAPA Methodologies
 - Statistical Process Control (SPC) - mandatory
 - Measurement Systems Analysis (MSA) - mandatory
 - Process Validation and Verification (PV&V) - mandatory
 - First Article Inspections - mandatory
 - Documentation & Reporting
 - Continuous Improvement

How We Work Together

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company's facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company's main facilities, generally at the customers' or suppliers' locations. 

About Philips

Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business, discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose. 

If you're interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer — Backend & Infrastructure - Noida / Bengaluru
data.description:
About Level AI

Level AI is a Series C conversational intelligence company headquartered in Mountain View, CA, backed by top-tier VCs and Silicon Valley operators. We help enterprise contact centers understand every customer conversation - using speech AI, NLP/NLU, and retrieval systems to turn millions of unstructured interactions into decisions businesses can act on. 

Why this role exists

We're at the scaling inflection point. The systems that carried us from Series A to Series C won't carry us to the next stage, and we need someone to own that transition - not just build inside it. 

This is a Principal role: you'll set technical direction for backend and ML infrastructure across multiple teams, make the architectural calls that are expensive to reverse, and raise the engineering bar through design reviews, mentorship, and the standards you set by example. You'll report to the VP of Engineering and partner directly with our ML, Product, and Infrastructure leads across both sites. 

You'll work alongside engineers from Amazon, Google, and Meta who chose to build here because the problems are unsolved and the ownership is real. 

What You'll Do

- Own the architecture for real-time data processing at scale. Design and evolve distributed messaging systems that handle high-throughput streaming workloads with strict latency requirements. 
 - Build the ML platform that lets us ship models faster. Define and execute the technical roadmap for training and serving infrastructure as our models grow in size, complexity, and inference cost. 
 - Scale our GPU infrastructure. Own capacity planning, scheduling, and utilization across training and inference fleets - deciding what runs where, how we handle burst demand, and how we keep spend tied to actual throughput rather than idle reservations. 
 - Scale inference. Drive down latency and cost per request as model complexity and traffic grow: batching and routing strategies, quantization and compilation, autoscaling, and caching - without degrading output quality. 
 - Make reliability a property of the system, not a heroic effort. Drive uptime, observability, and incident response for serving systems that enterprise customers depend on in production. 
 - Turn ambiguous business problems into executable technical plans. Partner with Product and GTM to scope large cross-functional initiatives, then break them into work other teams can run with. 
 - Multiply the team. Lead design reviews, mentor senior engineers, and shape the engineering practices that outlast any single project. 
 - Bring the outside in. Evaluate emerging tools and techniques with judgment - adopt what earns its complexity, skip what doesn't. 
 - Security and Compliance - Comply with Level AI's information security, privacy, data protection, and acceptable-use policies. Protect company, customer, and confidential information; use only approved systems and access information strictly based on business need. Complete required security and privacy training and promptly report any suspected security incident, data exposure, or policy violation. 

What Success Looks Like In Your First Year

- 90 days: You've mapped our critical paths and failure modes, shipped a meaningful improvement to a serving or pipeline bottleneck, and earned trust across both sites. 
 - 6 months: You own a published technical roadmap for [messaging / ML infra], with at least one major migration or redesign underway. GPU utilization and inference cost per request are measured, and trending the right way. 
 - 12 months: Our infrastructure scales predictably with customer growth, inference cost stays flat or falls as volume rises, on-call load is down, and other engineers are making better architectural decisions because of standards you established. 

What You'll Bring

- [9-12] years building backend and infrastructure systems, with a track record of owning architecture and design at scale - not just implementing it. 
 - Deep, hands-on experience with large-scale databases, high-throughput messaging systems, and real-time job queues. 
 - Proven ability to navigate large, complex codebases and reason clearly about architectural tradeoffs in systems you didn't build. 
 - Experience mentoring senior engineers and driving technical decisions through influence rather than authority. 
 - Strong written communication-you'll be making technical cases to engineers in two time zones and business cases to executives. 
 - BTech/MTech/PhD in Computer Science or equivalent. At this level we weigh track record well above pedigree. 

Bonus points for

- Production experience with our stack: Django, Celery, Redis, PostgreSQL, and Google Cloud. 
 - Hands-on experience scaling GPU infrastructure and model inference in production - capacity planning, scheduling and utilization, autoscaling, and latency/cost optimization under real traffic. 
 - Depth in specific inference tooling - vLLM, TensorRT, Triton, Ray Serve, or equivalents - and experience benchmarking tradeoffs between them. 
 - Experience scaling a platform through a comparable growth stage (Series C → D, or equivalent), especially at a global product company's India site. 
 - Background in speech, NLP, or information retrieval systems. 

Compensation & Benefits

- Health coverage for you, your spouse, children, and parents. 
 - [home-office and connectivity allowance / annual learning budget / parental leave - trim to what's accurate]. 
 - Real ownership over systems used by enterprises worldwide, with the autonomy to decide how they're built. 

How We Hire

- [4] stages, typically [2] weeks end to end: recruiter screen → technical deep dive → system design → team and leadership conversations → offer. Interviews are conducted from our India team with [one/two] conversations with US-based leadership. We'll tell you where you stand at every step. 

Level AI is an equal opportunity employer. We hire and promote on merit and evaluate all applicants without regard to caste, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital or parental status, disability, or any other personal characteristic unrelated to the job. We maintain a zero-tolerance policy on harassment in line with the POSH Act, 2013. If you need any accommodation during the interview process, tell us - we'll arrange it.

data.title: Lead AI Ops Engineer
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead AI Ops Engineer

AI Ops

Overview

Mastercard's Operational Intelligence team is building the next generation of data products and AI solutions that help customers access and use operational insights in new ways. As AI agents move from POC to production, their behavior keeps changing in real time: the context they retrieve, the skills they select, how they resolve exceptions. These agents are never really "finished. " They keep learning from production outcomes, so their reliability, safety, and trustworthiness need to be actively operated, not just monitored. That is the job of AI Ops: making sure each agent's reasoning stays correct, its context stays current, and its behavior stays governed as it learns. 

Role

- Own end to end production monitoring for one or more AI agents, tracking key metrics, KPIs, accuracy, latency, SLA breaches, guardrail triggers, and out of scope rates through dedicated observability dashboards
 - Serve as L1/L2 production support, providing first response monitoring, triage, and escalation to tech teams as new agentic services go live
 - Identify and diagnose issues by monitoring eval scores and drift alerts, inspecting failing traces and patterns, and classifying root causes such as intent, tool, parameter, or hallucination errors
 - Evaluate whether the agent's reasoning remains correct in production, checking whether context retrieval stays current, whether resolutions match ground truth, and whether the learning loop is drifting
 - Monitor and manage post production reliability, including API and authentication failures and issues originating from external AI endpoints, to protect revenue generating, client facing agents
 - Partner with AI Engineering to prioritize fixes, run experiments on prompts, context, and routing in Dev, and validate improvements via evals before handing off proven changes for deployment
 - Embed governance within the agent's learning loop so that approval workflows and audit logging travel with every production change, rather than being added after the fact

All About You

- Experience monitoring or operating production AI/ML or agentic systems, including observability, evaluation, and drift detection practices
 - Strong analytical skills to diagnose root causes across intent classification, tool selection, parameter errors, and hallucination patterns
 - Understanding of AI/LLM observability concepts such as tracing, telemetry, guardrails, and evaluation engineering including benchmarks, automated evals, human review, and regression testing
 - Familiarity with governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices such as PII detection, access control, audit logging, and policy enforcement is a plus
 - Ability to work independently alongside existing Tech teams while owning a dedicated agent's post launch health
 - Excellent communication skills to translate production signals into clear, prioritized asks for AI Product and AI Engineering teams

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
We are seeking a skilled SRE or DevOps Engineer to lead the migration and replacement of our legacy Moogsoft AIOps platform with PagerDuty. The ideal candidate will be responsible for redesigning our incident management workflow, setting up event orchestration, and ensuring a seamless transition with zero downtime to our live production monitoring. 

Key Responsibilities

- Platform Migration: Decommission Moogsoft and fully implement PagerDuty as our primary incident intelligence and alerting platform. 
 - Event Integration: Connect existing monitoring tools (e. g. , Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, AWS CloudWatch) directly into PagerDuty. 
 - Noise Reduction: Configure PagerDuty Event Orchestration, deduplication rules, and alert suppression to minimize alert fatigue. 
 - Workflow Automation: Build automated incident response workflows, on-call schedules, escalation policies, and bidirectional chatops integrations (Slack/Teams). 
 - Documentation & Training: Create runbooks for the new system and train engineering teams on PagerDuty best practices. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- PagerDuty Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience architectural design, event routing, and advanced configurations in PagerDuty. 
 - Moogsoft Knowledge: Familiarity with Moogsoft's clustering, situation room, and ingestion logic to translate legacy rules into the new system. 
 - Observability Ecosystems: Strong understanding of how monitoring tools feed into incident management platforms. 
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience managing PagerDuty configurations using Terraform is highly preferred. 
 - Scripting: Proficiency in Python, Bash, or Go to utilize PagerDuty APIs for custom integrations.

data.title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Job Purpose

To lead the reliability, availability, performance, and continuous improvement of Air Arabia's mission-critical Java-based applications and airline reservation systems by implementing Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) best practices. Responsible for driving operational excellence through proactive monitoring, automation, incident management, scalability improvements, and collaboration with cross-functional teams, while ensuring compliance with organizational policies, industry standards, and applicable regulatory requirements. 

Key Result Responsibilities

- Lead Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) initiatives for Java-based microservices and monolithic applications supporting mission-critical airline operations and Passenger Service Systems (PSS). 
 - Establish, monitor, and continuously improve system reliability by defining and managing Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and error budgets. 
 - Lead and facilitate root cause analysis (RCA) for complex production incidents, ensuring timely resolution and implementation of preventive measures to minimize recurrence. 
 - Drive architectural enhancements to improve system performance, scalability, resilience, availability, and operational efficiency through optimization techniques such as caching and distributed system design. 
 - Mentor and provide technical guidance to team members by promoting best practices in incident management, production support, troubleshooting, and operational excellence. 

Key Result Responsibilities-Continued

- Collaborate closely with software engineering, infrastructure, and cross-functional teams to enhance application design, improve system reliability, and ensure production readiness. 
 - Own and define CI/CD pipeline standards, GitOps practices, and infrastructure automation strategy, setting the framework that engineers across the team execute against. 
 - Set the containerization and orchestration strategy (Docker, Kubernetes) for the team, defining standards for scalability, resilience, and high availability that other engineers implement. 
 - Own the on-call escalation framework, ensuring adequate coverage and clear escalation paths, and lead post-incident reviews. 
 - Evaluate new tools and technologies to strengthen reliability and represent SRE in capacity planning and release readiness reviews. 
 - Own reliability reporting to management, translating SLA/SLO performance and incident trends into clear business updates. 

Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering/ Computer Science/ Information Technology. 
 - Fluent in English Language. 
 - Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, and troubleshooting complex production issues within enterprise environments. 
 - Airline, aviation, or travel industry experience, particularly with Passenger Service Systems (PSS), is preferred. 
 - Proficiency in MS Office. 
 - Strong knowledge of SQL with experience in database design, optimization, and performance tuning; experience with Oracle Database is an advantage. 
 - Solid understanding of distributed systems, system architecture, scalability, high availability, and resilient application design. 
 - Proficiency in monitoring, logging, and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch, or Datadog, used to drive proactive incident detection and reliability strategy. 
 - Exposure to Node. js and Next. js is an advantage

Work Experience

- With 6-8 years of experience in Software Engineering, SRE, or Production Support (Java Applications). 
 - Hands-on experience designing, developing, and supporting both microservices and monolithic application architectures. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes for containerization, orchestration, and production deployment (mandatory). 
 - Experience with JBoss Application Server or similar enterprise Java application servers is an added advantage. 
 - Proven experience designing and governing CI/CD pipeline standards, GitOps practices, and Git-based workflows across multiple teams. 
 - Hands-on experience with caching technologies (e. g. , Redis) and messaging platforms to improve application performance and reliability.

data.description:
Head of Diagnostic Systems

About The Role

Location: India

Company: Siemens Energy

Organization: Monitoring & Diagnostics Applications (MDA)

Full / Part Time: Full-time

Experience Level: Senior Professional / Leadership

A Snapshot of Your Day

As the Head of Diagnostic Systems, you will establish and lead a newly created department responsible for developing and delivering diagnostic software solutions that support Siemens Energy's global fleet applications. Your day will involve engaging with engineering teams across India and Denmark, guiding strategic decisions, enabling Agile transformation, and ensuring alignment between business objectives and technology roadmaps. 

You will mentor highly skilled software professionals, foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement, and oversee the delivery of reliable, secure, and scalable diagnostic solutions. By collaborating closely with global stakeholders and Agile Release Trains, you will drive technical excellence while ensuring teams operate efficiently and deliver value to customers. 

Working at the intersection of people leadership, software engineering, and strategic planning, you will play a key role in shaping the future of diagnostic applications within Siemens Energy's digital portfolio. 

How You'll Make An Impact

Departmental Leadership & People Management (40%)

- Establish and lead the newly formed Diagnostic Systems department, creating a high-performing and collaborative engineering organization. 
 - Lead, mentor, and develop a team of highly qualified software professionals while supporting career growth and development programs. 
 - Manage departmental operations, workforce planning, resource allocation, performance management, and talent development across teams in India and Denmark. 
 - Foster an inclusive culture focused on innovation, accountability, continuous learning, and engineering excellence. 
 - Champion Agile values and cultivate a relentless continuous improvement mindset throughout the department. 
 - Coach and educate teams on Agile methodologies including SAFe, Scrum, Kanban, Flow, and Built-in Quality practices. 

Diagnostic Systems Engineering & Product Delivery (30%)

- Support the definition and execution of the Vibration Diagnostic product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business priorities. 
 - Lead the end-to-end software development lifecycle, ensuring high-quality, secure, scalable, and reliable software solutions. 
 - Ensure compliance with Siemens Energy standards, policies, engineering processes, and governance requirements. 
 - Drive the adoption of modern software engineering practices, cloud technologies, data analytics, and digital product development methodologies. 
 - Enable high-performing Agile Release Trains that consistently deliver customer value and business outcomes. 
 - Promote engineering excellence through quality assurance, automation, and continuous delivery practices. 

Strategic Stakeholder & Cross-Regional Collaboration (30%)

- Collaborate with global leaders across Digital Products & Solutions (DPS) to align diagnostic software initiatives with broader business objectives. 
 - Act as the primary leadership contact for Diagnostic Systems Engineering, translating business needs into executable technical solutions. 
 - Manage interfaces and coordination between engineering organizations in India and Denmark to ensure successful delivery and integration. 
 - Build strong partnerships with product management, architecture, business stakeholders, and engineering leaders. 
 - Facilitate strategic discussions, roadmap reviews, and portfolio planning activities. 
 - Drive alignment across teams, functions, and regions to support long-term growth and innovation objectives. 

What You Bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - 10-12 years of software engineering experience with a strong track record of delivering complex software products. 
 - Minimum 5 years of experience leading software development teams, engineering organizations, or product delivery groups. 
 - Proven experience managing software development for industrial diagnostic systems, monitoring platforms, or large-scale fleet management applications. 
 - Strong understanding of modern software development methodologies and digital product engineering. 
 - Experience leading global, cross-functional, and multicultural teams. 
 - Demonstrated success in Agile transformation, organizational leadership, and strategic execution. 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, coaching, and leadership capabilities. 

Certifications

- SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) Certification
 - Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent
 - Certified Scrum Professional (CSP) or Agile Leadership Certification

Technical & Professional Skills

Leadership & Strategic Management

- People Leadership & Team Development
 - Organizational Management
 - Strategic Planning & Roadmap Execution
 - Change Management
 - Talent Development & Coaching
 - Budget & Resource Management
 - Stakeholder Engagement

Software Engineering & Agile Delivery

- Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
 - Agile Software Development
 - Scrum, Kanban & Flow Practices
 - Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)
 - Agile Release Train (ART) Leadership
 - Built-in Quality Principles
 - Continuous Integration & Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)
 - Software Architecture & Engineering Governance

Digital Products & Technology

- Cloud Technologies
 - Data Analytics & Digital Solutions
 - Software Product Development
 - Enterprise Application Development
 - Monitoring & Diagnostics Applications
 - Software Security & Compliance

Domain Expertise & Collaboration

- Vibration Diagnostics Domain Knowledge
 - Fleet Operations & Monitoring Solutions
 - Cross-functional Collaboration
 - Cross-regional Team Leadership
 - Business & Technology Alignment
 - Product Strategy Execution
 - Global Stakeholder Management

About The Team

The Monitoring & Diagnostics Applications (MDA) organization develops advanced digital solutions that help monitor, analyze, and optimize the performance of energy assets across the Siemens Energy fleet. The newly established Diagnostic Systems department will play a critical role in advancing diagnostic capabilities, improving operational reliability, and supporting data-driven decision-making through innovative software solutions. 

Working in a highly collaborative global environment, the team brings together software engineers, product leaders, architects, and domain experts to deliver cutting-edge digital products that support the energy transition and operational excellence. 

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across more than 90 countries while helping our customers transition toward a more sustainable future. Our global workforce is committed to making reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy a reality through innovation, collaboration, and technological excellence. 

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by people from different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Siemens Energy is committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to shaping the future of energy. 

Rewards / Benefits

- Comprehensive medical insurance coverage for employees and eligible dependents. 
 - Flexible compensation and tax optimization programs. 
 - Opportunity to lead a global engineering organization and shape a strategic technology function. 
 - Exposure to cutting-edge digital products, diagnostics platforms, cloud technologies, and data-driven innovation. 
 - Access to world-class learning and leadership development programs. 
 - Collaboration with global teams across India, Denmark, and other international locations. 
 - Career growth opportunities within a global leader in energy technology and digital transformation.

WHO YOU ARE

Education & Experience

Technical Skills

 - Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA clean-core principles and extension model (SAP BTP, RAP, CAP).

Functional & Domain Knowledge

Soft Skills & Leadership

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Java Developer & Team Lead with 8+ years of experience to lead a small development team while remaining hands-on across the full technology stack supporting Ithos's enterprise applications. These applications manage complex product, regulatory, and customer data. 

The ideal candidate combines deep Java 8 / Java EE expertise, front-end development ability, and enterprise application architecture experience with the technical leadership skills to mentor developers, drive design decisions, and partner with product and QA to deliver reliable, secure software. 

Experience with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), regulated industries, manufacturing, life sciences, or formula-based product environments is highly desirable. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

- Lead and mentor a small team of developers, providing hands-on code review, technical guidance, and career development support. 
 - Own technical delivery across the full stack - Java 8 / Java EE backend and jQuery / Bootstrap / DataTables front end. 
 - Drive technical decisions, balancing modernization with the stability required by established enterprise systems. 
 - Partner with product, architecture, and QA to plan and prioritize work, break down requirements, and estimate effort. 
 - Ensure the team follows appropriate security and data-handling practices when working with customer, product, and regulatory information. 

Hands-On Development

- Develop, maintain, and enhance enterprise applications using Java 8 and Java EE/J2EE. 
 - Work within an existing MVC-based architecture, including Servlets, EJBs, DAOs, DTOs, and persistence layers. 
 - Develop and maintain database integrations using JPA, Hibernate, JDBC, and SQL. 
 - Build and support RESTful web services using Jersey / JAX-RS. 
 - Support applications deployed on WildFly and Apache TomEE. 
 - Work with multiple databases and data platforms, including MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, DocumentDB, and Neo4j. 
 - Maintain and enhance existing web interfaces using jQuery, Bootstrap, and DataTables. 
 - Troubleshoot application, database, integration, and performance issues across the stack. 

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years of hands-on experience with Java 8 and Java EE / J2EE application development. 
 - Experience leading, mentoring, or providing technical direction to a team of developers. 
 - Experience with MVC architecture and enterprise application design. 
 - Working knowledge of EJBs, Servlets, JPA / Hibernate, JDBC, and DAO/DTO patterns. 
 - Strong front-end experience with jQuery, Bootstrap, and DataTables. 
 - Strong experience with SQL and relational databases, preferably MySQL and/or Microsoft SQL Server. 
 - Experience building and consuming REST APIs. 
 - Experience with Java application servers such as WildFly, JBoss, TomEE, or similar. 
 - Experience with Maven and/or ANT, and Git / GitHub. 
 - Strong analytical skills and the ability to quickly learn complex business and technical domains. 
 - Comfortable balancing individual contribution with team leadership responsibilities. 

Good to Have

- Prior experience as a tech lead or team lead within an enterprise Java environment. 
 - Experience with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems. 
 - Experience in regulated industries - life sciences, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, food & beverage, cosmetics, or manufacturing. 
 - Experience with formula, recipe, ingredient, product specification, or regulatory data. 
 - Exposure to AWS RDS, DocumentDB, Neo4j, or OpenText Discovery Server/BRS. 
 - Experience integrating Java applications with C#/. NET services. 
 - Experience with BIRT Reports. 
 - Experience working with applications hosted on AWS. 
 - Experience maintaining or modernizing mature enterprise Java applications. 

Success in This Role

Success in this role requires more than strong Java development skills. The successful candidate will be able to: 

- Lead a small team while staying hands-on across the full stack. 
 - Quickly understand an existing enterprise architecture and contribute effectively without unnecessary disruption. 
 - Work comfortably across application, database, API, and integration layers. 
 - Understand complex product, regulatory, and customer-data requirements. 
 - Balance modernization with the stability and reliability required by established enterprise systems. 
 - Adapt quickly to new industries and business domains. 
 - Translate complex business requirements into practical, secure, and maintainable technical solutions, and unblock the team technically when needed.

The Windows + Devices Fundamentals team is responsible for the reliability, compatibility, performance, battery life, and sustainability of Windows devices. Our work spans hardware and OEM partners, the operating system, and application layers - helping protect, manage, and enhance the fundamentals of the Windows ecosystem. 

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineering Manager to lead a team developing the next generation of Windows device optimizations. As advances in AI, silicon, and software create new opportunities, you will guide technical direction, develop engineering talent, and drive execution that helps make exceptional device fundamentals a defining feature of Windows PCs. 

This role is ideal for an engineering leader who combines strong systems expertise with a passion for developing people, solving complex technical problems, and delivering innovations that improve how people live, work, and play. 

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

Responsibilities

- Guide the team in using telemetry, experimentation, and trace analysis to understand software and hardware behavior, identify opportunities, and measure impact at scale. 
 - Lead complex, cross-stack investigations involving low-level debugging, performance analysis, reliability, and power optimization. 
 - Own the team's technical roadmap for Windows Fundamentals improvements, contribute to architecture, and align priorities with customer and business needs. 
 - Manage the design and delivery of well-defined solutions spanning hardware, firmware, operating-system, service, and application layers. 
 - Maintain a high engineering bar for quality, security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and operational excellence while driving predictable execution. 
 - Use data and customer insights to evaluate tradeoffs, manage risk, prioritize the team's work, and deliver measurable outcomes. 
 - Hire, coach, and retain a diverse team of engineers while collaborating with Windows teams, OEMs, silicon vendors, and hardware partners across the ecosystem. 

Technologies

The Team Works With Technologies Including

- C, C++, C#, Python, scripting and automation tools
 - WinDbg, Windows Performance Analyzer, and ETW tracing
 - Cosmos, Kusto, Asimov, and Azure-based trace-processing systems
 - Power BI, statistics, and large-scale telemetry analysis
 - Machine learning and AI models

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 10+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
 - OR equivalent experience. 
 - 2+ years of people-management experience leading software engineers, including coaching, performance management, and career development. 
 - Experience leading the design, development, and optimization of complex system software or platform capabilities. 
 - Demonstrated success leading a team and delivering reliable products or services at scale. 
 - Solid technical judgment in software architecture, systems design, debugging, and engineering tradeoffs. 
 - Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize work using data, and influence technical and product decisions across teams. 
 - Experience managing a team responsible for operating-system architecture, system-level development, or platform engineering. 
 - Solid knowledge of Windows internals, performance, reliability, or power optimization. 
 - Experience coordinating initiatives across hardware, firmware, operating-system, service, and application boundaries. 
 - Experience using large-scale telemetry, experimentation, statistical analysis, or Azure data platforms to guide engineering decisions. 
 - Track record of contributing to architecture and product direction while collaborating with multiple teams and senior stakeholders.
