data.description:
Job Title - UI/UX & Front-End Engineer Consultant - S&C GN

Management Level : 09 - Consultant

Location: Bengaluru | Gurugram | Mumbai | Kolkata | Pune | Chennai | Hyderabad

Must have skills: UI/UX Design, Figma/Adobe XD/Sketch, React/Next. js/Angular/Vue, WebRTC, JavaScript/TypeScript, Component Libraries

Good to have skills: SFU/MCU Architectures (Janus, LiveKit), AI-assisted UX Tools, Conversational UI Design, Usability Testing, DataOps

Experience: Minimum 4 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification: B. Tech/BE or M. Tech/ME or PhD in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

Job Summary: 

As a UI/UX Consultant within the S&C GN Customer Service Analytics & Contact Center AI practice, you will be responsible for designing, prototyping, and implementing intuitive, high-performance user interfaces that power enterprise Contact Center AI platform implementations. Your typical day will involve translating complex business requirements into user-centered design solutions using Figma or Adobe XD, building production-ready frontend components using React/Next. js, integrating real-time WebRTC communication features, collaborating with backend and CCaaS integration teams, and advising clients on design systems, accessibility standards, and UX strategy across all phases of delivery. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

- Design and deliver end-to-end UX solutions - from user research, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes in Figma/Adobe XD/Sketch to production-ready frontend implementations - for Contact Center AI dashboards, agent workspaces, and supervisor monitoring interfaces. 
 - Build scalable, reusable frontend components and design systems using React/Angular/Vue/Next. js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, and component libraries (Material UI, Tailwind, Storybook) that are consumed across multiple product teams and client engagements. 
 - Design and implement real-time communication UX for video/audio/data channels using WebRTC - covering peer-to-peer media streams, signaling server integration (WebSocket/SIP), STUN/TURN/ICE configuration, and SFU/MCU architectures (e. g. , Janus, LiveKit) - with robust connection state management and graceful degradation patterns. 
 - Integrate REST/GraphQL APIs and implement authentication/authorization flows (OAuth2, JWT, SSO) within frontend applications, ensuring secure, token-refresh-aware, and optimistic-update-driven user experiences. 
 - Ensure cross-browser compatibility and WCAG 2. 1 accessibility compliance across all deliverables; conduct and act on usability testing, A/B testing, and user research sessions to continuously improve experience quality. 
 - Optimize frontend performance through code splitting, lazy loading, virtual scrolling, SSR/SSG strategies, and Core Web Vitals monitoring; advise clients on responsive, mobile-first design principles and progressive enhancement. 
 - Collaborate with CI/CD pipeline teams to integrate frontend build, lint, test (Jest, Playwright/Cypress), visual regression (Chromatic), and deployment stages into GitHub Actions/GitLab CI workflows; support cloud deployments on AWS/GCP/Azure (S3, CloudFront, Vercel). 
 - Lead client-facing UX discovery workshops and design reviews; advise on design system governance, component library strategy, and UX toolchain selection prior to and during engagement onboarding. 
 - Design conversational UI patterns and integrate real-time AI features - including streaming AI responses, transcription overlays, AI confidence indicators, and RAG-powered search UX - into contact center communication platforms. 
 - Mentor analysts and junior designers/developers; conduct design and code reviews across frontend workstreams; present UX and architecture decisions to senior client stakeholders and maintain documentation for knowledge transfer. 

Professional & Technical Skills: 

Must To Have Skills: 

- UI/UX design and prototyping using Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch - covering wireframing, interactive prototyping, design tokens, and design system governance
 - Frontend development using React/Angular/Vue/Next. js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, and component libraries (Material UI, Tailwind CSS, Storybook)
 - Deep WebRTC expertise - peer-to-peer media streams, signaling servers (WebSocket/SIP), STUN/TURN/ICE configuration, SFU/MCU architectures (e. g. , Janus, LiveKit), and real-time communication UX patterns for video/audio/data channels
 - REST/GraphQL API integration with authentication/authorization implementation (OAuth2, JWT, SSO, MFA, RBAC) within single-page and server-rendered applications
 - Cross-browser compatibility and accessibility compliance (WCAG 2. 1) - including semantic HTML, ARIA, keyboard navigation, screen reader testing, and automated auditing (axe-core, Lighthouse)
 - Performance optimization - code splitting, lazy loading, virtual scrolling, SSR/SSG/ISR, bundle analysis, CDN strategy, and Core Web Vitals improvement
 - Responsive and mobile-first design; user research, usability testing, and A/B testing methodologies
 - Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI), Git branching strategies, and cloud deployment for frontend applications (AWS S3/CloudFront, GCP, Azure, Vercel/Netlify)

Additional Information: 

- The ideal candidate will possess a strong educational background in Computer Science or a related field, along with a proven track record of delivering design systems and production-grade frontend applications within enterprise cloud and Contact Center AI environments.

data.title: Head of Global USP MS&T CoE
data.description:
Position Purpose

Lead the global USP Manufacturing Science & Technology Center of Excellence responsible for technology transfers, process lifecycle management, manufacturing support, validation support, and technical governance across Sandoz manufacturing sites and external partners. 

- Provide scientific leadership and scalable technical solutions that enable robust manufacturing, uninterrupted supply, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence across the global biologics network. 

Your Key Responsibilities

Your responsibilities include, but not limited to: 

Technical Leadership

- Own technical oversight of upstream manufacturing processes across commercial products. 
 - Serve as SME for fed-batch, intensified fed-batch, and continuous perfusion upstream process control strategies. 
 - Lead resolution of complex technical manufacturing issues and investigations. 

Innovation & Emerging Technologies

- Continuously evaluate emerging upstream processing technologies, digital solutions, advanced analytics, automation platforms, single-use technologies, and manufacturing innovations for applicability across the biologics network. 
 - Assess technical feasibility, business value, implementation risks, and potential impact on product quality, process robustness, cost of goods, and supply reliability. 
 - Develop business cases and implementation roadmaps for adoption of state-of-the-art manufacturing technologies. 
 - Partner with Manufacturing, Process Development, Engineering, Digital, and external technology providers to pilot and industrialize innovative solutions. 
 - Drive implementation of approved technologies and ensure effective knowledge transfer across manufacturing sites and CMOs. 
 - Represent MS&T in external industry forums, scientific conferences, and technology networks to identify emerging best practices and innovation opportunities. 

Manufacturing Support

- Ensure timely scientific support for routine manufacturing operations. 
 - Provide expert support for investigations related to process deviations, atypical results, and process performance excursions to in-house facilities as well as CMOs as needed. 
 - Support root cause analysis and implementation of effective CAPAs. 

Process Lifecycle Management

- Lead continued process verification (CPV) programs across commercial products. 
 - Support Annual Product Reviews (APR/PQR) and trend evaluations. 
 - Lead technical risk assessments associated with process changes, deviations, investigations, and technology transfers. 
 - Support change control assessments and implementation of post-approval manufacturing changes. 
 - Ensure technical oversight of process validation lifecycle activities. 
 - Drive robust documentation and knowledge management practices. 

Technology Transfer

- Support/lead upstream process scale-up and transfer activities into and out of the site as well as into and out of the External partners. 
 - Ensure effective transfer of process knowledge, process characterization data, and control strategies. 
 - Assess technical risks associated with process transfers and scale-up activities. 

Validation Activities

- Support PPQ planning, execution, review and closure. 
 - Support process characterization and validation strategy development. 
 - Provide technical oversight for validation exceptions and deviations. 
 - Support ongoing process validation activities throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Collaborate with Validation, Quality and Manufacturing organizations to maintain validated state. 
 - Review and approve validation protocols, reports, and technical documentation. 

Continuous Improvement

- Drive initiatives to improve yield, throughput, process capability, and cost efficiency. 
 - Promote application of advanced analytics, PAT, digital tools, and data-driven process monitoring. 
 - Identify and implement innovative manufacturing solutions. 

People Leadership

- Lead and develop Technical Managers and scientists within the upstream MS&T organization. 
 - Build technical capabilities and ensure succession planning. 
 - Foster a culture of scientific excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement. 

Key Performance Indicators

Quality & Compliance

- Critical/Major inspection observations
 - Recurring deviation rate
 - Overdue deviations and CAPAs
 - Upstream processes maintained in validated state

Operational Excellence

- Right First Time (RFT) manufacturing
 - Upstream process yield achievement
 - Upstream process CpK/PpK performance
 - Process robustness indicators

Delivery

- Technology transfers delivered OTIF
 - Validation/CPV milestones achieved
 - Technical investigations completed on time

Continuous Improvement

- Yield/productivity improvement realization
 - Successful implementation of process improvements

People

- Employee engagement
 - Talent development and succession readiness
 - Training compliance

Essential Requirements

What you'll bring to the role: 

- PhD in Biotechnology, Bioprocess Engineering, or related field (Preferred) / MSc in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Life Sciences, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related discipline. 
 - 10 years experience in Biologics MS&T, Process Development, Technical Operations, or Manufacturing, 3-5 years leadership experience
 - Strong expertise in upstream processing and commercial biologics manufacturing
 - Experience in technology transfer and process validation
 - Experience supporting regulatory inspections. 
 - Continuous manufacturing experience
 - Multi-product commercial manufacturing support
 - Advanced process analytics/PAT experience

Why Sandoz?

Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world's medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more, so that everyone can achieve the basic human right of access to good healthcare. 

With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low-cost, high-quality medicines, sustainably. 

Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!

Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster. 

Commitment To Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

data.title: QA Engineer 2 -Mobile Apps
data.description:
We're reinventing the market research industry. Let's reinvent it together. 

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow's success starts with today's market intelligence. We empower the world's leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it. 

Role overview

This role combines hands-on manual and exploratory testing with native mobile application automation for PanelSmart. You will assess Android and iOS app changes on representative devices, exercise survey and account workflows, and maintain Appium tests that provide dependable feedback. You will also validate mobile-to-service integration scenarios with the web and backend teams. 

Core technology stack

Core: Appium, Java, Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, Maven, and Allure. Supporting integration testing: REST-Assured for selected API interactions. 

What you will do

Manual and exploratory mobile testing

- Perform functional and exploratory testing of the PanelSmart mobile app on Android and iOS devices or simulators, as the team's supported matrix requires. 
 - Investigate platform-specific behavior, device and OS differences, permissions, notifications, interruptions, orientation, connectivity, and app lifecycle where relevant. 
 - Test login, password recovery, menus, settings, survey navigation and pause/resume, and questionnaire types and validation rules. 
 - Report reproducible defects with device, OS, app build, setup, steps, expected and actual results, and screenshots or logs; retest fixes. 

Mobile automation

- Build and maintain Appium end-to-end tests in Java using the team's TestNG and Maven framework. 
 - Keep shared driver setup, platform-specific locators, page objects, test data, and utilities readable and reusable. 
 - Automate agreed Android and iOS smoke, sanity, and regression scenarios, including login, menus, survey questions, notifications, and logout. 
 - Use Allure results and captured evidence to diagnose failures and distinguish application defects from device, environment, and test issues. 

Integration and CI

- Validate mobile workflows that depend on backend services, using REST-Assured helpers or API checks where they support the test scenario. 
 - Maintain test data and environment configuration for supported platforms, and coordinate app builds and test readiness with development teams. 
 - Run and maintain the Android and iOS automation workflows, review results, and improve stability, evidence, and feedback. 

Collaboration and quality practices

- Review stories and acceptance criteria for mobile-specific risks, accessibility of controls, and testability across supported platforms. 
 - Use manual and exploratory findings to prioritize new regression automation and focus coverage on high-impact user journeys. 
 - Contribute automation code through Git-based review workflows and communicate quality risks clearly to product and engineering. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Required Experience And Skills

- 3-5 years of hands-on experience with manual functional and exploratory testing of mobile applications. 
 - Experience with Appium-based mobile automation; Java is the primary language in this framework. 
 - Understanding of Android and iOS app behavior, device or simulator testing, and platform-specific test considerations. 
 - Experience with TestNG or a comparable test runner, reusable automation design, and debugging test failures. 
 - Working knowledge of Maven, Git, and collaborative code review practices. 
 - Experience validating API-backed mobile workflows; familiarity with REST-Assured for selected integration tests is useful. 
 - Clear defect reporting and effective collaboration with product, mobile, web, and backend engineering teams. 

Helpful Additional Experience

Experience with device farms, broader mobile CI operations, or approved AI tools for test design and log analysis may be useful as team needs evolve. 

How success is measured

- Manual and exploratory testing identifies platform-specific risks before release. 
 - Agreed critical mobile journeys run reliably on supported Android and iOS targets. 
 - Failures include actionable logs, screenshots, and device and environment details. 
 - Defects and automation failures are triaged promptly, with avoidable flakiness reduced. 
 - Regression automation reflects product changes and priorities across supported platforms.

Overview: Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced Salesforce Technical Lead with mandatory hands-on expertise in Salesforce Commerce Cloud for B2B ecommerce and proven experience building custom websites using Salesforce Experience Cloud. In this role, you will own the technical direction for enterprise B2B ecommerce storefronts and customer-facing digital experiences on the Salesforce platform, leading solution design, development, integration, performance optimization, and delivery across commerce capabilities such as catalogs, pricing, buyer groups, cart, checkout, account management, order workflows, and self-service experiences. You will partner with Product Owners, Technical Architects, UI/UX Leads, and onshore/offshore engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, maintainable commerce and Experience Cloud solutions while mentoring developers and enforcing Salesforce engineering best practices. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the technical design, development, and delivery of scalable Salesforce Commerce Cloud B2B ecommerce solutions and Experience Cloud-based customer portals. 
 - Build and customize Salesforce Experience Cloud websites, storefronts, portals, and self-service experiences using Experience Builder, custom themes, page templates, branding, navigation, and reusable components. 
 - Own solution architecture for B2B commerce capabilities, including product catalogs, pricing, buyer groups, entitlements, cart, checkout, account management, order workflows, and personalized buyer experiences. 
 - Develop and customize commerce and Experience Cloud experiences using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Lightning Web Runtime (LWR), Flow, SOQL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SLDS, and Experience Builder. 
 - Integrate Salesforce Commerce Cloud with ERP, payment, tax, search, shipping, inventory, product information, and order management systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, middleware, and event-driven architecture. 
 - Collaborate with Product Owners, Technical Architects, UI/UX Leads, Delivery Leads, QA, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into well-architected commerce and Experience Cloud solutions. 
 - Provide technical leadership to onshore and offshore developers through design reviews, code reviews, estimation, troubleshooting, coaching, and delivery planning. 
 - Establish and enforce Salesforce development standards for code quality, security, performance, governor-limit awareness, accessibility, release readiness, and platform governance. 
 - Analyze existing commerce and Experience Cloud implementations and optimize performance, scalability, usability, accessibility, and maintainability across storefront, portal, and backend components. 
 - Create and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, integration specifications, data models, deployment notes, website configuration details, and operational support guides. 
 - Stay current with Salesforce Commerce Cloud, B2B Commerce, Experience Cloud, Experience Builder, LWR, and platform release updates, recommending improvements that reduce technical debt and improve customer experience. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Minimum of 7+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, including experience leading technical delivery for enterprise Salesforce implementations. 
 - Must have hands-on experience with Salesforce Commerce Cloud for B2B ecommerce, including storefront configuration, catalog, pricing, cart, checkout, buyer groups, entitlements, and order-related workflows. 
 - Must have proven experience building custom websites, portals, and self-service experiences using Salesforce Experience Cloud, including Experience Builder, custom themes, templates, branding, navigation, and reusable components. 
 - Strong expertise in Salesforce B2B Commerce on Lightning Experience, Experience Cloud, Lightning Web Runtime (LWR), and Commerce storefront development. 
 - Proven experience designing and implementing B2B ecommerce capabilities such as catalogs, price books, buyer groups, entitlements, cart, checkout, reorder, account hierarchy, purchase workflows, and order management integrations. 
 - Advanced proficiency with Apex, LWC, Flow, SOQL, SOSL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SLDS, Salesforce data models, security, sharing, and governor limits. 
 - Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise systems such as ERP, PIM, OMS, tax, payment, shipping, inventory, search, identity providers, and middleware platforms using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, JSON/XML, and event-driven patterns. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead developers, run technical design discussions, perform code reviews, estimate work, resolve escalated issues, and guide onshore/offshore teams in Agile delivery. 
 - Strong understanding of scalable architecture, reusable component design, website performance tuning, accessibility, secure coding practices, release management, and Salesforce DevOps. 
 - Proficiency with version control and CI/CD tools such as GitHub, Azure Repos, Salesforce DX, Azure Pipelines, or equivalent DevOps tooling. 
 - Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and tools such as Azure Boards or Jira. 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II, Salesforce B2B Commerce Developer, Experience Cloud Consultant, Application Architect, or System Architect are highly preferred.

Your role will be focused on building the country-specific capabilities that connect invoices, credit notes and purchase orders to government tax portals and clearance networks, using the latest technologies and AI-assisted ways of working to deliver large-scale, high-performance, enterprise-grade solutions. 

This is a hands-on technology role, ideal for candidates seeking opportunities to both build on their existing experience and research new knowledge areas, with a significant share of design and exploratory elements to their day-to-day tasks. Every country mandate brings a different set of rules, formats and deadlines, so no two modules look the same. 

You will be working alongside engineers and developers from the Invoice Lifecycle Management (ILM) Teams, assisted by our AI Engineering team, and in integration with other Basware solutions. The product you will be contributing to is targeted at large, well-known enterprises. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and implement country extension modules against the platform's shared frameworks and architectural conventions. 
 - Build and maintain REST APIs and service layers that carry compliance traffic to and from government portals. 
 - Implement compliance logic: XML and JSON schema validation, digital signature handling, submission to and status polling from government portals.

 - Participate actively in code and design reviews, and help hold the quality bar across the team. 
 - Work with the Lead Developer and QA to harden the performance, security and resilience of compliance flows. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements and help diagnose and fix production issues.

,

 - Strong Java (17+) and Spring Boot experience building production REST services.

 - Familiarity with XML processing, XSD schema validation and secure XML parsing practices. 
 - Practical experience with MongoDB or another NoSQL document database. 
 - Working knowledge of authentication and authorization mechanisms in web APIs. 
 - Experience deploying and operating applications on AWS cloud infrastructure. 
 - Solid understanding of software design principles and the ability to apply them in day-to-day coding. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Test-Driven Development as a working practice. 
 - Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally with product, QA and compliance stakeholders. 
 - Strong sense of ownership, collaborative attitude, and willingness to learn new domains and regulations quickly. 
 - Familiarity with e-invoicing standards and networks such as Peppol and EN 16931, or with national clearance models such as Italy's SDI, Poland's KSeF or the French PPF and PDP model.

 - Exposure to microservices architecture and distributed systems concepts. 
 - Experience with spec-driven AI development, where a written specification drives implementation and tests, and with AI agents and agent skills.

Join phData, a remote-first data and AI consultancy company with employees across the United States, Latin America, and India. We partner with industry leaders, including Snowflake, AWS, Anthropic, Glean, and dbt, to solve the complex data and AI challenges that slow large enterprises.

About PhData

At phData, the Product Engineering team develops a suite of tools, known as the Toolkit, to automate and simplify essential data engineering and AI/ML engineering tasks. We focus on producing high-quality, reliable, and effective tools. Our tools are used both internally by our own engineers and externally by our clients. 

We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead our India Product Engineering team members and Platform Operations, driving the execution of delivery goals, developing tools and automation under the phData Toolkit, and ensuring operational excellence across AWS, GCP, Azure, and Snowflake. This role requires hands-on technical leadership through development, code reviews, and user support for our products, while collaborating closely with US leadership and partnering with the IT team to achieve security and compliance objectives. The Engineering Manager will play a critical role in building and retaining a high-performing team in India, balancing technical depth, people leadership, and compliance responsibilities in support of Information Security and compliance audits. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Technical Oversight and Hands-on Leadership: Oversee delivery and provide technical guidance to the product engineering team while collaborating with US leadership on roadmap and priorities, occasionally contributing hands-on to drive execution. 
 - Cloud and data platform oversight and leadership (AWS, GCP, Azure, Snowflake): Lead architecture, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, access management, approvals, and cost optimization across multi-cloud and Snowflake environments. Oversee RBAC on Snowflake and other internal environments, define policies, and build and maintain internal infrastructure. Provide advice and best practices to teams building internal cloud infrastructure as well as customer environments. 
 - IT collaboration on processes and access: Collaborate closely with the IT team on access control, cloud environment changes, and access approval workflows, provisioning / deprovisioning guardrails. Assist with customer security questionnaires, co-author and maintain platform and security policies/ standards, and participate in periodic infrastructure reviews, patching, and vulnerability management. Ensure that all processes and changes align with the organization's information security requirements. 
 - Security and Compliance: Ensure security and compliance by following standards, improving security posture, and managing vulnerabilities, access, and privacy according to Information Security policies and SOC 2 controls. Collaborate with teams to identify and resolve security issues across cloud environments, applications, databases, code, domains, and email settings. 
 - Product and Project Management: Identify opportunities to deepen cross-department partnerships and expand joint solution offerings. Able to gather and synthesize feedback from internal teams and track and drive projects to completion. 
 - Cross-Functional Leadership and Tooling Initiatives: Lead and support tool integrations, if any, and POCs, contribute to company-wide initiatives, and drive activities such as documentation, automation, cleanups, and training. Collaborate closely with US-based leadership, Product, Security, IT, and Customer teams, as well as India practice leaders, to gather feedback, improve products 
 - Team Leadership and Mentorship (India): Mentor and manage a team of engineers in India, ensuring high engagement, defining career paths, and helping with skill development. Hire and onboard team members as needed and maintain low attrition while building a strong, effective team. 

Core Competencies: 

- Ownership and execution: Bias to action, high accountability, and an end-to-end delivery mindset 
 - Technical depth: Ability to dive into architecture while guiding and setting direction for the team 
 - People leadership: Coaching, career growth advocacy, and building an inclusive, strong team culture 
 - Security mindset: Security mindset with pragmatic risk management and focus on controls 
 - Communication and collaboration: Strong written and verbal communication skills and experience; ability to deliver presentations tailored to the target audience, from technical stakeholders through to executive teams. 

Required Qualifications: 

- 20+ years of software engineering and platform operations experience with hands-on coding and code reviews in modern languages and frameworks. 
 - 5+ years leading engineering teams, driving product and tools development and automation, including hiring, performance management, and career development, while collaborating with US stakeholders. 
 - Expertise in AWS is required, and it is good to have experience in at least one other cloud platform, such as GCP orAzure, with a strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, AWS ECS Fargate, security and compliance, RBAC, and overall infrastructure governance and management. 
 - Familiarity with data platform technology such as Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, and Sigma Computing. 
 - Good understanding of security and compliance, including control frameworks, SOC 2 audit support, evidence collection, and remediation. 
 - Demonstrated success delivering against long-term and short-term department goals, roadmaps, and OKRs through collaboration with US leadership. 
 - Excellent English communication (verbal & written) and stakeholder management skills across different functions. 
 - Good experience with AWS, Java-based applications, and security practices.

About Song - Data & AI

Accenture Song uses AI, proprietary customer data, and product platforms to help clients improve customer experience and drive measurable growth across marketing, sales, commerce, and service. From strategy through execution, Song Data & AI helps organizations build and operationalize advanced capabilities - covering customer data unification, predictive analytics, and Generative AI (including agentic use cases) - to enable smarter decisioning like personalization and "next best action, " faster content and experience delivery, and more effective commerce and customer engagement. 

What's In It For You?

- Join a worldwide network of data scientists, ML/AI engineers, and lifecycle engineering practitioners building practical, trusted, and production-grade AI solutions. 
 - Access world-class training, mentorship, and certifications across machine learning, deep learning, Generative AI, Agentic AI, MLOps, LLMOps, AgentOps, and cloud AI platforms. 
 - Work on high-visibility engagements across Marketing, Sales, Commerce, Customer Service, and Digital Products - taking AI solutions from experimentation through enterprise deployment and continuous improvement. 
 - Contribute to Accenture's internal accelerators, reusable model and agent components, evaluation frameworks, engineering standards, and lifecycle playbooks. 

What You Will Do

As an ML/AI Engineering Manager, you will lead the design, development, deployment, and continuous improvement of machine learning, Generative AI, and agentic solutions, combining computational science, software engineering, lifecycle engineering, and consulting leadership. 

- Translate business decisions and user needs into AI/ML problem statements, experimentation plans, solution architectures, success metrics, and prioritized delivery roadmaps. 
 - Architect and lead development of predictive, forecasting, recommendation, optimization, NLP, computer vision, Generative AI, and agentic solutions aligned to the problem context. 
 - Guide feature engineering, algorithm and model selection, training, tuning, experimentation, evaluation, explainability, error analysis, and champion-challenger decisions. 
 - Design foundation-model applications using prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, structured outputs, model adaptation, evaluation, and guardrails. 
 - Architect agentic systems using tool and function calling, planning, memory and context, orchestration, multi-agent patterns, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Define AI lifecycle pipelines covering experiment tracking, data and model versioning, registries, CI/CD and continuous training, promotion, rollback, retraining, and end-of-life controls. 
 - Lead production engineering for modular APIs and services, batch and real-time inference, containers, scalable compute, enterprise integration, and resilient deployment patterns. 
 - Implement monitoring and observability for model quality, drift, safety, latency, reliability, cost, adoption, and business outcomes, with governed learning and improvement loops. 
 - Embed Responsible AI, security, privacy, testing, reproducibility, auditability, and human oversight into model and agent development and operations. 
 - Engage with senior client stakeholders to shape AI strategies, platform roadmaps, operating models, business cases, solution demonstrations, and value realization plans. 
 - Manage delivery governance, resource planning, risk, quality, project economics, and partner coordination across multi-disciplinary AI engagements. 
 - Mentor Consultants and Analysts, and shape internal accelerators, reusable components, evaluation assets, engineering standards, and playbooks across the practice. 

Domain Focus

Candidates should bring hands-on ML/AI solution-building and productionization experience in one or more of the following domains: 

- Marketing - customer propensity, segmentation, personalization, next-best action, content intelligence, media effectiveness, and campaign optimization
 - Sales - demand forecasting, recommendations, revenue intelligence, sales productivity, outlet or customer prioritization, and decision support
 - Commerce - search, recommendations, pricing, promotion, demand and inventory intelligence, and digital commerce optimization
 - Service - conversational AI, contact center intelligence, knowledge assistance, case routing, quality monitoring, and operations automation
 - Design & Digital Products - AI-powered product features, product intelligence, experimentation, personalization, and agile digital product delivery

Who We Are Looking For

Mandatory

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. Advanced degree or MBA from a top institution is advantageous. 
 - 8-12 years of progressive experience in machine learning, AI engineering, data science, and/or digital consulting, with significant consulting or enterprise leadership experience. 
 - Strong expertise in Python and SQL, production-quality software engineering, version control, testing, and modular API or service development. 
 - Strong foundations in supervised and unsupervised learning, statistics, feature engineering, model evaluation, experimentation, and selection of fit-for-purpose techniques. 
 - Hands-on experience with common ML and deep learning libraries such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or equivalent. 
 - Demonstrated success leading ML/AI solutions from problem framing and experimentation through enterprise deployment, adoption, monitoring, and continuous improvement. 
 - Hands-on Generative AI experience with prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, structured outputs, evaluation, guardrails, and model adaptation. 
 - Agentic AI experience with tool and function calling, planning, memory and context, orchestration, and multi-agent patterns using LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, and/or AgentOps practices, including experiment tracking, versioning, model registries, CI/CD, continuous training, promotion, rollback, retraining, and lifecycle governance. 
 - Solid experience with at least one major cloud or AI platform - AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, or Anthropic - and its relevant services for AI development and deployment. 
 - Experience deploying AI through APIs, containers, Kubernetes or managed services, and batch or real-time inference patterns; familiarity with FastAPI, Docker, or equivalent. 
 - Working knowledge of data platforms and pipelines; familiarity with Spark or Databricks, relational and vector databases, unstructured data, and API-based integrations. 
 - Experience defining evaluation and monitoring across accuracy, drift, robustness, safety, latency, reliability, cost, user adoption, and business KPIs. 
 - Awareness of Responsible AI, security, privacy, observability, testing, reproducibility, auditability, and human oversight required for enterprise production. 
 - Proven project leadership capability: solution architecture, estimation, delivery governance, resource planning, project economics, risk management, and partner coordination. 
 - Exceptional stakeholder engagement and communication skills - ability to translate complex AI choices into business strategy, measurable value, and executive decisions. 

What We Are NOT Looking For

- Pure Data Scientists or researchers without production engineering, deployment, monitoring, or lifecycle ownership. 
 - MLOps, DevOps, or infrastructure-only profiles without substantive model development, experimentation, and evaluation capability. 
 - Prompt-engineering-only or LLM-only profiles without strong foundations in statistics, machine learning, and rigorous evaluation. 
 - Pure Delivery or Program Managers with no technical AI architecture, solutioning, or build experience. 
 - Profiles focused purely on presales or platform consulting without demonstrable end-to-end enterprise AI delivery depth. 

Accenture is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all sections of society and does not discriminate on grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

data.title: QA Engineer 2 -Mobile Apps
data.description:
We're reinventing the market research industry. Let's reinvent it together. 

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow's success starts with today's market intelligence. We empower the world's leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it. 

Role overview

This role combines hands-on manual and exploratory testing with native mobile application automation for PanelSmart. You will assess Android and iOS app changes on representative devices, exercise survey and account workflows, and maintain Appium tests that provide dependable feedback. You will also validate mobile-to-service integration scenarios with the web and backend teams. 

Core technology stack

Core: Appium, Java, Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, Maven, and Allure. Supporting integration testing: REST-Assured for selected API interactions. 

What you will do

Manual and exploratory mobile testing

- Perform functional and exploratory testing of the PanelSmart mobile app on Android and iOS devices or simulators, as the team's supported matrix requires. 
 - Investigate platform-specific behavior, device and OS differences, permissions, notifications, interruptions, orientation, connectivity, and app lifecycle where relevant. 
 - Test login, password recovery, menus, settings, survey navigation and pause/resume, and questionnaire types and validation rules. 
 - Report reproducible defects with device, OS, app build, setup, steps, expected and actual results, and screenshots or logs; retest fixes. 

Mobile automation

- Build and maintain Appium end-to-end tests in Java using the team's TestNG and Maven framework. 
 - Keep shared driver setup, platform-specific locators, page objects, test data, and utilities readable and reusable. 
 - Automate agreed Android and iOS smoke, sanity, and regression scenarios, including login, menus, survey questions, notifications, and logout. 
 - Use Allure results and captured evidence to diagnose failures and distinguish application defects from device, environment, and test issues. 

Integration and CI

- Validate mobile workflows that depend on backend services, using REST-Assured helpers or API checks where they support the test scenario. 
 - Maintain test data and environment configuration for supported platforms, and coordinate app builds and test readiness with development teams. 
 - Run and maintain the Android and iOS automation workflows, review results, and improve stability, evidence, and feedback. 

Collaboration and quality practices

- Review stories and acceptance criteria for mobile-specific risks, accessibility of controls, and testability across supported platforms. 
 - Use manual and exploratory findings to prioritize new regression automation and focus coverage on high-impact user journeys. 
 - Contribute automation code through Git-based review workflows and communicate quality risks clearly to product and engineering. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Required Experience And Skills

- 3-5 years of hands-on experience with manual functional and exploratory testing of mobile applications. 
 - Experience with Appium-based mobile automation; Java is the primary language in this framework. 
 - Understanding of Android and iOS app behavior, device or simulator testing, and platform-specific test considerations. 
 - Experience with TestNG or a comparable test runner, reusable automation design, and debugging test failures. 
 - Working knowledge of Maven, Git, and collaborative code review practices. 
 - Experience validating API-backed mobile workflows; familiarity with REST-Assured for selected integration tests is useful. 
 - Clear defect reporting and effective collaboration with product, mobile, web, and backend engineering teams. 

Helpful Additional Experience

Experience with device farms, broader mobile CI operations, or approved AI tools for test design and log analysis may be useful as team needs evolve. 

How success is measured

- Manual and exploratory testing identifies platform-specific risks before release. 
 - Agreed critical mobile journeys run reliably on supported Android and iOS targets. 
 - Failures include actionable logs, screenshots, and device and environment details. 
 - Defects and automation failures are triaged promptly, with avoidable flakiness reduced. 
 - Regression automation reflects product changes and priorities across supported platforms.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

About Soar and how we build

Soar is building an AI-native home-financing platform for Saudi Arabia, and the AI-driven engineering system that builds it. Our product spans origination, credit decisioning, loan management, collections and investor products, all under SAMA regulation. 

We build differently. Our engineers don't hand-write code; they specify, direct and review AI agents that do. If that sounds like where engineering is going, you'll fit here. 

How we work : 

Agents write the code. Engineers own the spec, the context, the tests and the review. DevOps doesn't hand-manage servers either. 

Context engineering is the core skill. Agents work from a shared knowledge graph of business rules, architecture principles and money-movement rules that we keep current. 

We build our own agents. Requirements, DevOps, PM and self-testing agents run on our MCP/A2A framework to automate the SDLC end to end. 

Full stack by default. AI closes skill gaps, so engineers work across backend, frontend and infrastructure, with cross-domain reviewers. 

Regulated means rigorous. Money-movement logic gets human review, every time. KSA data residency shapes which models and tools we use and where they run. 

What every role here needs: you already use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) as your main way of working, not as autocomplete. You can show us real workflows you've built, where they broke, and what you changed. 

Role Summary: We rely heavily on AI throughout engineering and are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who treats AI agents as a core part of how they build software. You will own complex features from design through production, direct agents effectively, and apply strong engineering judgment to everything you ship. You should be equally comfortable accelerating implementation with AI and investigating difficult problems yourself. Key Responsibilities: 

- Design, build, and maintain production features and services, taking ownership of correctness, performance, security, and maintainability. 
 - Use AI agents across planning, coding, refactoring, debugging, test generation, and documentation to accelerate end-to-end delivery. 
 - Provide agents with clear requirements, architecture context, constraints, and acceptance criteria; break complex work into verifiable steps. 
 - Inspect and refine AI-generated code. Detect incorrect assumptions, insecure patterns, unnecessary complexity, and missing edge cases. 
 - Build automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; validate actual user journeys and failure paths before declaring work complete. 
 - Create reusable workflows and tool integrations that help agents access the right context and perform tasks within appropriate permissions. 
 - Own changes through review, deployment, observability, and production troubleshooting; investigate root causes and prevent repeat failures. 
 - Collaborate with Product, QA, and other engineers; mentor teammates and document decisions and validation evidence in pull requests. 

Requirements

Requirements: 

- Typically 5+ years building and shipping production software, or equivalent demonstrated engineering depth and ownership. 
 - Strong proficiency in at least one production programming language and experience with application design, APIs, databases, version control, and automated testing. 
 - Substantial hands-on experience delivering software with AI coding tools or agents, supported by concrete examples of shipped work. 
 - Ability to reason about, debug, and explain code independently, including code generated by AI. 
 - Practical understanding of context management, tool use, agent limitations, and the trade-offs between model capability, speed, and cost. 
 - Strong ownership and collaboration, including careful handling of credentials, sensitive data, and permissions in AI workflows. 

Nice to have: Experience with agent orchestration, MCP or API integrations, retrieval systems, evaluation suites, cloud platforms, or financial systems. What success looks like: You ship reliable features with clear validation evidence, catch defects in generated code, improve delivery speed, and create reusable practices that raise the effectiveness of the wider team.

What You'll Do

As Firmware Engineering Manager, you will lead a global team responsible for embedded firmware and platform software for Critical Power Solutions technology and product-development programs, including uninterruptible power supplies, energy storage, power distribution, and energy metering. You will own people leadership, technical direction, execution, quality, and lifecycle delivery across real-time operating system (RTOS) and embedded Linux platforms. You will partner with product management, systems, hardware, validation, cybersecurity, manufacturing, and global engineering teams to translate business needs into scalable architectures and predictable releases. The role balances hands-on technical leadership with coaching, talent development, resource planning, risk management, and continuous improvement. 

"

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of firmware engineers and technical leads; set clear objectives, provide regular feedback, conduct performance and development discussions, and build succession plans. 
 - Own delivery of embedded firmware for technology development and new product programs across RTOS and embedded Linux platforms while meeting scope, schedule, cost, quality, cybersecurity, and product-performance commitments. 
 - Establish firmware strategy, platform roadmaps, software architecture, requirements, and reuse plans for products including uninterruptible power supplies, energy storage, power distribution, and energy metering. 
 - Translate business and system requirements into executable plans; prioritize the portfolio, allocate resources, manage dependencies, and make transparent trade-off decisions. 
 - Provide technical oversight for board support packages, device drivers, bootloaders, middleware, inter-process communication, networking, diagnostics, and application-layer software. 
 - Guide RTOS design for deterministic behavior, scheduling, synchronization, interrupt handling, memory constraints, safety, and reliability; guide embedded Linux development using Yocto-based distributions, kernel and driver integration, and system services. 
 - Drive disciplined engineering practices including design reviews, code reviews, static analysis, unit and integration testing, continuous integration, configuration management, release governance, and defect prevention. 
 - Monitor program execution using meaningful metrics, identify technical and delivery risks early, remove obstacles, and communicate status and recovery plans to stakeholders. 
 - Partner with systems, hardware, power electronics, validation, cybersecurity, manufacturing, quality, and product teams to deliver robust end-to-end solutions. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable product-development processes, functional-safety expectations, cybersecurity requirements, open-source obligations, and company release procedures. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of complex field, lab, and production issues; ensure corrective actions are systemic and lessons learned are reused. 
 - Build capability through hiring, onboarding, mentoring, technical communities of practice, knowledge sharing, and targeted learning plans. 
 - Foster an inclusive, accountable, and innovative team culture that encourages constructive challenge, collaboration, ownership, and continuous learning. 
 - Manage suppliers and engineering partners where applicable, including technical scope, deliverables, reviews, quality, and integration. 
 - Champion process improvement, automation, platform reuse, and engineering productivity across global firmware teams. "

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Computer, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline; master's degree preferred
 - 9+ years of embedded software or firmware development experience, including substantial experience with embedded Linux and/or RTOS-based products. 
 - 3+ years of experience leading engineers through direct people management, technical leadership, or program leadership in a global environment. 

Skills

- Strong C and C++ skills, object-oriented design, software architecture, algorithms, data structures, concurrency, and multi-threading. 
 - Practical RTOS expertise, including task scheduling, synchronization, interrupt handling, memory management, timing analysis, debugging, and real-time performance optimization. 
 - Strong embedded Linux expertise, including Yocto Project, Linux kernel concepts, device trees, board support packages, device drivers, bootloaders, system services, and cross-compilation toolchains. 
 - Experience with software lifecycle practices and tools such as Git, Jira, continuous integration, automated testing, static analysis, requirements traceability, and release management. 
 - Working knowledge of embedded cybersecurity, secure boot, cryptography, vulnerability management, and secure development practices. 
 - Demonstrated ability to make architecture and delivery trade-offs, resolve complex technical issues, and communicate decisions clearly to technical and business stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Yocto releases such as Dunfell and Kirkstone, open-source software governance, and upstream contribution. 
 - Familiarity with power conversion, uninterruptible power supplies, energy storage, power distribution, metering, or other high-reliability industrial products. 
 - Familiarity with functional safety, product certification, model-based design, test automation, and Agile product development. 
 - Experience managing external engineering partners, suppliers, budgets, or multi-site resource plans. "

"Embodies Eaton leadership attributes-ethical, passionate, accountable, efficient, transparent, and learning-with demonstrated capability in: 

- People leadership - sets direction and expectations, delegates effectively, coaches for performance, recognizes contributions, and addresses performance issues promptly and fairly. 
 - Talent development - identifies strengths and gaps, creates development opportunities, supports career growth, and builds succession and hiring plans. 
 - Inclusive leadership - creates psychological safety, values diverse perspectives, and builds an environment where people can contribute at their best. 
 - Strategic thinking - connects technology and platform choices to customer needs, product roadmaps, business priorities, and long-term capability. 
 - Execution and accountability - converts strategy into clear plans, uses metrics to manage commitments, removes barriers, and delivers results. 
 - Decision quality - makes timely, fact-based decisions under uncertainty and explains trade-offs, risks, and rationale. 
 - Influence and stakeholder management - aligns global and cross-functional teams, manages conflict constructively, and communicates effectively at all levels. 
 - Change leadership - leads teams through ambiguity, drives adoption of improved practices, and sustains organizational change. 
 - Customer and business acumen - understands customer outcomes, commercial priorities, competitive technologies, and quality expectations. 
 - Innovation leadership - creates space for experimentation, facilitates effective problem solving, and converts promising ideas into scalable solutions. 
 - Learning agility and resilience - adapts quickly, seeks feedback, remains composed under pressure, and helps the team recover from setbacks. 
 - Integrity and judgment - models ethical behavior, protects confidential information, and makes decisions consistent with company values. "

data.description:
An Introduction to Codal

We are a large team that spans across three global offices, but we collaborate and integrate front- and back-end components and interfaces to provide a user-centered experience through web and mobile platforms. 

We expect this role to embody Codal's principles of mindful excellence, insatiable expertise, diverse intuition, data-led curiosity, and candid leadership in how you lead technically, mentor your team, and engage with clients. 

What you'll be doing

We are looking for an experienced DevOps Manager to lead our DevOps engineering team, drive delivery excellence, and provide technical leadership across multiple client engagements. 

The ideal candidate will combine strong expertise in cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, automation, and security with proven people-management and client relationship skills. This role requires the ability to make sound technical and staffing decisions, guide cloud and DevOps architecture, and ensure reliable, automated, secure, and scalable infrastructure solutions across projects. 

The Manager will own team delivery outcomes, development, performance management, and team growth, while actively contributing to project execution, client discussions, and presales solutioning.

Partner with cross-functional teams to make sound technical decisions, mitigate risks, and ensure the delivery of reliable, scalable, and automated solutions. 
 - CI/CD, Automation & Engineering Excellence
 - Establish, automate, and optimize CI/CD pipelines, release processes, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC), mainly Terraform and AWS CDK, to enhance deployment reliability and engineering productivity. Drive continuous improvement across observability, incident response, and operational readiness to maintain robust, scalable infrastructure. 
 - Develop and operationalize Codal's DevOps methodology, standardization, and work with engineering leadership to drive it across the organization. 
 - Cloud Security & Governance
 - Drive cloud security, IAM, and governance across all environments while ensuring full compliance and risk mitigation. Integrate robust security controls, secrets management, and access governance seamlessly into deployment workflows and architecture. 
 - Backup & Disaster Recovery Cloud Infrastructure
 - Design and build out multi-cloud, multi-premise, cloud, and backup systems based upon requirements. Be able to provide recommendations on the appropriate backup and disaster recovery for engagements. 
 - Client Relationship - Technical Leader 
 - Act as a trusted technical partner across assigned client accounts, leading discussions on infrastructure, deployment, cloud strategy, and risk management. Own DevOps delivery commitments, communicate project progress and mitigation plans clearly, and provide hands-on leadership during critical delivery milestones. 
 - Solutioning, Presales 
 - Define the approach for DevOps architecture, estimates, and delivery plans in collaboration with cross-functional teams. Identify opportunities for cloud optimization and modernization, while advancing Codal's DevOps practice. 
 - You will identify risks, scope considerations, and opportunities for modernization to drive successful client solutions and expand engineering capabilities. 
What you'll need to be successful (Requirements)

Must-Have Skills

- Demonstrated experience managing and developing DevOps engineering teams. 
 - Strong practical expertise in a major cloud platform: AWS, Microsoft Azure, or GCP. 
 - Strong understanding of CI/CD pipeline design, implementation, and optimization. 
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation/CDK. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM, secrets management, networking, and secure deployment practices. 
 - Experience working with cloud architects and cross-functional engineering teams on infrastructure and deployment architecture. 
 - Strong client-facing communication, stakeholder management, and technical decision-making skills. 
 - Experience contributing to technical proposals, presales solutioning, effort estimation, and infrastructure assessments. 
 - Experience with monitoring, observability, and incident management tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or cloud-native monitoring services.

 - Experience with Agile delivery methodologies and project management tools such as Jira. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted software engineering tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent tools to improve engineering productivity and quality. 

Nice-to-Have Skills

- Relevant cloud certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or equivalent DevOps certifications. 
 - Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud architectures. 
 - Experience building internal DevOps accelerators, reusable infrastructure modules, and engineering standards. 

Need another reason to hit the "apply" button?

Good-to-Have

Work in a way that works for you

data.description:
Job Description

At NI IP Routing SW, we believe in fostering a flat and non-hierarchical work environment. We are obsessed about delivering high-quality products and ensure the utmost level of excellence in everything we do. We are a passionate bunch and strive to be technological leaders in our industry. You will be integral to a close-knit team to engineer best-in-class products for the most critical networks - data centers for web/hyper-scalers, telcos and enterprises (including AI fabrics), and communication service provider networks. 

We are looking for SW engineers who wish to be a part of developing and evolving the current and next generation of routers that form the core of anything internet. These routers are at the heart of Nokia's IP product offerings, from data centers (including AI fabrics) to providing strong, resilient low latency and dependable IP backhaul for service providers and mission critical networks. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with one of the best engineering teams in the industry. We value your expertise and offer an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally. There are more customers we want to win, more networks to penetrate, more technologies to enable and more applications to support. We want to make smaller products, and we want to make bigger products. We want to build products based on newer standards and newer ASICS in the market. 

You will play a critical role in designing and implementing high-performance data path solutions on both custom and merchant silicon. You will be responsible for writing efficient and modular code that is well-tested and robust, ensuring that it meets the high standards required for the most critical networks. Your role will involve working on advanced packet forwarding techniques in IP, MPLS, Segment Routing, VxLANs. You will also contribute into Traffic Management technologies - QoS (Policers, Schedulers, Shapers), ACLs, TCAM Management, and Packet Extractions to CPU. DCN2026. 

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

data.title: Fullstack AI Quality Engineer – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
data.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. 

The Position

External Job Ad Text

Job Description
We are seeking a highly skilled AI Quality Engineer specializing in testing Generative (and non-Generative) AI applications and agentic systems to join our team. The ideal candidate will have expertise in both traditional software testing and specialized testing methodologies for Large Language Models (LLMs)-based and AI-based systems. 

As a fullstack Quality Engineer within a lean, agentic software team, you will cover the entire spectrum of quality assurance. You will span manual exploratory testing, traditional automated UI/API/MCP testing (across our Python and TypeScript stack), classical machine learning validation, and cutting-edge generative and agentic AI evaluation. This role requires a deep understanding of LLM, agentic and ML systems behaviors, and testing frameworks to ensure the reliability, fairness, and effectiveness of our AI-powered solutions. 

Description Of The Area
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Engineering Team focuses on architecting, building, and operating high-value AI solutions and services to solve complex business challenges in healthcare. 

In the 2026 tech landscape, we operate in small, highly autonomous agile teams (e. g. , ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before. In this highly regulated environment, quality cannot be an afterthought. You will be the foundational pillar ensuring our rapidly developed agentic workflows and AI, GenAI, and agentic applications are safe, compliant, and robust before they reach the clinical or enterprise user. 

Job Responsibilities

- Generative & Agentic AI Testing Strategy: Design and implement comprehensive testing strategies specifically tailored for LLM-based applications and agentic systems, including evaluation of model responses, RAG pipelines accuracy, and overall system reliability. You will expand this to evaluate autonomous multi-agent behaviors and tool-use accuracy
 - Full-Stack Test Automation: Design and implement automated testing solutions for continuous evaluation of LLM applications, including integration tests, performance tests, and specialized AI behavior tests. This spans both our Python backend services and modern TypeScript/React/Angular frontends
 - Quality Assurance Framework & Compliance: Utilize Roche's testing frameworks that address both traditional software quality aspects and AI-specific concerns such as output consistency, contextual accuracy, and ethical compliance; co-create and maintain such frameworks when required. Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation testing strategy, test cases, and testing guidelines specific to AI applications and compliant with Roche practices
 - Edge Case, Bias, and Fairness Testing: Identify and develop test scenarios for edge cases in LLM behavior, including handling of ambiguous inputs, potential biases, and unexpected response patterns. Design and execute tests to identify potential biases in model outputs and ensure fair treatment across different user groups and use cases
 - Security & Performance Testing: Collaborate within development teams to test for potential vulnerabilities specific to LLM applications, including prompt injection, data leakage, and other AI-specific security concerns. Collaborate with other engineers to conduct thorough performance testing of GenAI applications, including response time analysis, load testing, and resource utilization monitoring

Qualifications

- Hold B. Sc. , B. Eng. , M. Sc. , M. Eng. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent degree with strong background in testing methodologies
 - Be passionate about quality assurance and testing, particularly in the context of AI and GenAI applications and agents
 - Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
 - Utilize critical thinking and problem-solving when using AI prompts (in e. g. NLP, data distributions and edge cases)
 - Be proactive in identifying potential issues and suggesting improvements

Education / Experience

- Experience: 7+ years of experience in software testing, with at least 1 year focused on genAI and/or agentic applications
 - Regulated Environments: Be ready to work in a regulated environment with qualified infrastructure and validated applications, understand the difference between GxP and non-GxP products and the importance of CSV and ITSM processes in the delivery
 - Agile Integration: Be experienced in working with Agile development teams

Skills
Must-have: 

- Comprehensive Full-Stack Testing Mastery
 - Core Languages & Testing Frameworks: Advanced command of Python and standard testing frameworks (e. g. , pytest, allure), alongside practical familiarity with specialized AI evaluation tools. High competence in TypeScript-driven test frameworks (such as Playwright, Jest, and Cypress) for thoroughly verifying dynamic generative user interfaces
 - End-to-End Automation & CI/CD: Proven expertise in architecting and maintaining end-to-end automated testing suites that bridge traditional UI/API validation with complex, asynchronous AI/LLM evaluation pipelines
 - Pipeline Integration: Hands-on experience integrating these comprehensive suites within GitHub Actions or modern CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous, reliable quality checks throughout the entire development lifecycle
 - Advanced AI Quality & Evaluation Mastery
 - AI Evaluation Frameworks: Expertise in implementing evaluation harnesses (e. g. , RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo) to quantify LLM performance, hallucination rates, and answer relevancy
 - Agentic Workflow Validation: Ability to test autonomous agentic loops, including tool-use accuracy, step-by-step reasoning verification, and goal-directed performance metrics
 - Evaluation Datasets: Experience in curating, managing, and versioning 'Golden Datasets' for benchmarking model responses against ground truth in both development and production environments
 - Observability & Feedback Loops: Leveraging tracing (e. g. , LangSmith, Arize Phoenix) to monitor production inputs/outputs, identify drift, and capture user feedback for continuous improvement
 - Basic broad AI knowledge: Understanding of LLM architectures, RAG systems, agents, and common failure modes in AI applications
 - Python Expertise: Advanced proficiency in writing robust, maintainable Python code for test automation (e. g. , pytest). Experience using Python to orchestrate complex AI evaluation workflows, process large datasets for benchmarking, and automate interactions with LLM/AI services. Ability to integrate Python scripts into CI/CD pipelines for automated quality checks and performance observability in agentic systems

Should-have: 

- Cloud: Practical experience with testing applications on cloud platforms (AWS) and working with cloud-based AI services
 - Observability & ALM: Experience with monitoring and observability tools, log analysis, and performance metrics tracking (Grafana). Experienced in Roche mandatory ALM tools (Jira, GitHub)
 - Agentic SDLC & Engineering Excellence: Leverage AI coding assistants and autonomous agents (e. g. , Claude Code, Ona) daily to accelerate full-stack development and testing cycles. Conduct rigorous code reviews for both human-written and AI-generated code
 - Security: Understanding of security testing methodologies, particularly in the context of AI applications

Could-have: 

- Regulatory Compliance: Proven understanding of AI quality assurance and testing standards within highly regulated industries

Additional Qualifications

- Stay current with the latest developments in AI and GenAI testing methodologies and best practices
 - Have excellent communication skills and the ability to clearly document findings and recommendations
 - Be able to communicate in English at the level of C1+
 - Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening)

Shift: CET time zone

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100'000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

You will define the enterprise standards for multi-domain monitoring (infrastructure, cloud, application, network, batch, and mainframe) while actively designing and configuring our Event Management platforms-specifically Oracle Unified Assurance (Assure1) and IBM Netcool. The ideal candidate will leverage data insights, machine learning, and automation to transform massive "event storms" into high-fidelity, actionable signals. 

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Governance

- Drive Enterprise Initiatives: Own and lead cross-functional, enterprise-wide initiatives focused on improving monitoring effectiveness, optimizing alert quality, and reducing incident volumes. 
 - Define Standards: Establish corporate standards, approaches, and best practices for alert optimization across infrastructure, application, batch, network, and mainframe environments. 
 - Culture & Mentorship: Mentor, guide, and evangelize a strong observability and optimization mindset across engineering and operations teams. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Identify systemic gaps in monitoring design and lead long-term, architectural improvements to eliminate redundant or low-value alerts. 

Platform Engineering & Administration

- Infrastructure Design: Implement, maintain, and scale Oracle Assure1 / Unified Assurance servers and architectures for high-availability (HA) enterprise environments. 
 - Event Correlation & Enrichment: Develop advanced Object-Server configurations, triggers, and correlation rules to distinguish isolated anomalies from critical root causes. 
 - Multi-Vendor Integration: Integrate multi-vendor telemetry, logs, faults, and data from disparate monitoring domains into a single, unified Event Management UI. 
 - Operations & Backend Support: Manage backend databases (e. g. , MySQL, OpenSearch), maintain platform availability, and troubleshoot complex backend issues. 

Automation, AIOps & Incident Response

- Incident Automation: Write robust automation scripts and workflows to bridge monitoring tools with ITSM platforms (such as ServiceNow) to accelerate incident response times. 
 - AIOps & Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Apply Machine Learning (ML) algorithms, topological discovery, and data-driven approaches to enhance event correlation, suppress noise, and automate self-healing or ticket generation. 

Basic Requirements

Required Qualifications & Skills

Experience & Education

- Total Experience: 5+ years of dedicated experience in enterprise Event Management, Fault Management, Service Level Management, or production environments. 
 - Initiative Leadership: 3+ years of proven experience leading large-scale, cross-functional improvements in monitoring effectiveness, alert optimization, or incident reduction. 

Technical Expertise

- Platform Expertise: Hands-on, deep technical experience with Oracle Unified Assurance / Assure1 and/or IBM Netcool suites (OMNIbus, Netcool Impact, ITM). 
 - OS & Scripting: Strong proficiency in Linux Administration (RHEL) and expert-level scripting skills (Python, Bash, Perl, or Shell) for building event parsers and API integrations. 
 - Databases & APIs: Solid understanding of backend database management, SQL queries, REST APIs, and tool customization using rule files and OpenSearch. 
 - Domain Knowledge: Strong exposure to multi-domain infrastructure (Cloud, Network, Telecommunications, Mainframe) paired with a solid understanding of ITIL Event Management principles. 

Travel Requirements

None

Experienced

No
