data.title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer
data.description:
The salary range for this role is $5, 000 - $9, 500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle: 

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a technically strong, hands-on Senior Database Reliability Engineer to help design, build, and scale the database platform used across Sezzle's applications. 

This is not a traditional DBA role. This role is for an engineer who can combine deep database knowledge with software engineering, infrastructure engineering, and platform thinking. You will help build the systems, libraries, automation, standards, and guardrails that make database usage across Sezzle reliable, secure, scalable, and easy for developers to adopt correctly. 

As a Senior Database Reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for improving how Sezzle applications connect to, migrate, operate, observe, and scale their databases. You will work across application teams, infrastructure, security, and engineering leadership to define patterns that improve database reliability by design - not just by operational response. 

You should be comfortable owning problems end-to-end: understanding application behavior, reading code, reviewing database access patterns, building shared tooling, improving connection management, designing migration safety checks, analyzing production performance, and helping developers use databases in safer and more scalable ways. 

You should consider yourself a DOer to be a good fit for this role. We are looking for someone who can ship production-quality engineering work, not just advise from the sidelines. With AI tooling and automation, you should be a force multiplier for database reliability, developer productivity, and operational excellence across Sezzle. 

Compensation: 

For this senior development role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5, 000 - $9, 500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience. 

What You'll Do: 

- Design, build, and maintain shared database platform components used by Sezzle applications, such as database connection packages, database client libraries, migration tooling, safety checks, query standards, and developer-facing abstractions. 
 - Establish reliable, scalable patterns for how Sezzle services connect to and interact with relational databases across production, staging, and development environments. 
 - Partner with backend engineering teams to improve database usage in application code, including connection lifecycle, transaction handling, retries, timeouts, pooling, query patterns, and migration workflows. 
 - Build automation and internal tooling that makes database operations safer, more repeatable, and less dependent on manual intervention. 
 - Define and enforce engineering standards for database access, schema design, migrations, indexing, query performance, connection management, and operational readiness. 
 - Architect and improve database infrastructure across AWS RDS/Aurora MySQL, PostgreSQL, RDS Proxy, read replicas, backups, failover, parameter groups, monitoring, and capacity planning. 
 - Lead database reliability initiatives that reduce operational risk, improve performance, and help Sezzle scale safely. 
 - Review application designs and database changes early in the development lifecycle to ensure reliability, scalability, maintainability, and security are built in from the start. 
 - Build guardrails for database migrations, including automated checks, rollback expectations, schema review workflows, migration observability, and production safety controls. 
 - Improve developer self-service for database provisioning, access, schema management, local development, testing, and observability. 
 - Investigate production database issues by combining application telemetry, database metrics, logs, query plans, traces, and cloud infrastructure data. 
 - Identify and fix systemic database problems, not just symptoms - including bad access patterns, unsafe migrations, inefficient queries, connection storms, lock contention, replication lag, and capacity bottlenecks. 
 - Create and maintain high-signal dashboards, alerts, SLOs, SLIs, runbooks, and operational readiness checks for database-backed services. 
 - Drive improvements in database backup validation, restore testing, disaster recovery, failover readiness, and business continuity. 
 - Work with security and compliance teams to improve database access controls, auditability, encryption, secrets management, least privilege, and PCI/SOC 2 aligned controls. 
 - Mentor engineers on database design, query performance, safe migrations, operational readiness, and production debugging. 
 - Use automation and AI tooling where appropriate to improve migration review, query analysis, incident investigation, documentation, and developer productivity. 

What We look for: 

- 6+ years of professional software engineering, infrastructure engineering, database engineering, SRE, or platform engineering experience. 
 - Strong software engineering ability in at least one production programming language such as Go, Python, or TypeScript. 
 - Proven ability to build production-quality internal tools, libraries, frameworks, services, or platform components used by other engineers. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with relational databases, especially MySQL and/or PostgreSQL, in high-availability production environments. 
 - Strong understanding of how application code interacts with databases, including connection pooling, transactions, isolation levels, retries, timeouts, deadlocks, locking, migrations, and query execution. 
 - Experience designing or improving shared database access patterns, internal database packages, ORM wrappers, migration frameworks, or developer-facing database tooling. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS RDS/Aurora, including provisioning, upgrades, replicas, backups, failover, monitoring, parameter tuning, and production troubleshooting. 
 - Experience with database connection management technologies such as RDS Proxy, PgBouncer, ProxySQL, or application-level pooling. 
 - Strong ability to analyze database performance using query plans, indexes, slow query logs, wait events, locks, metrics, and application traces. 
 - Experience designing safe database migration processes for production systems. 
 - Strong understanding of observability for database-backed applications, including metrics, logs, traces, SLOs, alerting, and incident response. 
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD systems such as Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, Kubernetes, Helm, or similar tooling. 
 - Ability to influence engineering teams through clear design reviews, documentation, technical standards, and practical implementation. 
 - Ability to operate independently, identify high-impact problems, propose pragmatic solutions, and drive them to completion. 
 - Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science. 

Preferred Knowledge and Skills: 

- Experience building platform capabilities for a microservices environment. 
 - Experience with Golang application development and database access patterns. 
 - Experience creating database libraries, SDKs, service templates, migration frameworks, or paved-road developer tooling. 
 - Experience improving database reliability across many services or teams, not just one application. 
 - Experience with fintech, payments, banking, e-commerce, or other high-volume transactional systems. 
 - Experience with compliance-sensitive environments such as PCI DSS, SOC 2, or SOX. 
 - Experience with database access governance, audit logging, secrets management, encryption, IAM authentication, and least-privilege access models. 
 - Experience with large-scale operational automation for provisioning, patching, failover testing, backup validation, access management, or schema review. 
 - Experience with distributed systems patterns such as transactional outbox, event-driven architecture, idempotency, queues, eventual consistency, and data consistency tradeoffs. 
 - Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, Performance Insights, OpenTelemetry, or New Relic. 
 - Familiarity with Elasticsearch or other supporting data stores. 
 - Familiarity with AI developer tooling such as Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cursor, and using it to be a more productive engineer. 

About You: 

- You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. 
 - You're not bound by convention - your success-and much of the fun-lies in developing new ways to do things
 - You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. 
 - You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. 
 - You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. 
 - You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. 

Sezzle's Technology Stack: 

- Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
 - Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
 - Backend: Golang
 - Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
 - DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
 - Version Control: Git
 - CI/CD: Gitlab
 - Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
 - Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Posting Title: Sr Engineer II - Testing, Front Line Care

Your Role At Baxter

Baxter's Front Line Care business is a 1. 1B$ business comprising of Connected monitoring, Respiratory health, Cardiology, Intelligent diagnostic groups. The products, used by clinicians in acute and ambulatory care settings globally. 

Position Overview

A Senior Engineer, Testing (V&V) will be responsible for formulating Test Analysis, Test strategy , Automation framework, Drive Test quality improvements Across Platforms, New Product development and sustaining engineering catering to our portfolio. The successful candidate will possess solid "hands-on" technical abilities, an excitement and energy for product development, and a passion for their work and the impact it has on meeting the needs of patients. 

This position does not have any direct reports. You will need to work collaboratively with R&D and cross functions. 

The role is located in the BRD facility in Bangalore India

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

- 8-12 years of experience in Test / V&V Activities for a medical product
 - Responsible for the Test analysis, Test design , Design of automation framework, Develop automation scripts, make design choices for new product development, sustenance activities, field issue resolution etc. 
 - Takes complete ownership of testing a product or release and ensures high quality deliverables. This covers both Manual testing & automation testing
 - Solid understanding and implementation of TDD & BDD
 - Proven experience in delivering medical devices to meet IEC/FDA/ISO standards and working closely with the regulatory bodies and affiliated labs. 
 - Develop automation strategy and framework for the Software and System level testing. 
 - Installation/Operational/Performance Qualification Protocols, Traceability Matrices and Final Reports. 
 - Pair up with design & development team to start the testing early in the design cycle (Sprints) to ensure the requirements testability, design traceability & test coverage. 
 - Identify and report any quality or compliance concerns and take immediate corrective/ preventive action as needed. 
 - Review work products and ensure the quality of deliverables. 
 - Participates in continuous improvement activities by identifying and appropriately escalating process and product quality gaps. 
 - Lead the qualification of lab area, drive productivity improvement efforts, including testing, building fixtures, calibration, and data collection. 
 - Ensures good documentation and good manufacturing practices are followed in the Test Process. 
 - Leads the investigations by identifying the root cause and drive solutions. 
 - Mentor peers/engineers in the stream of their expertise and on the processes. 

Qualifications / Experience And/or Background

- Bachelor's Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Bio-Medical or related field. 
 - 8-12 years of experience in testing of Software. 
 - Experience in design verification and validation of medical devices; and understanding of and adherence to FDA, ISO and IEC design control procedures, regulations, and standards. 
 - Deep hands on expertise in manual and automation testing using tools such as SQUISH, Java, Python. 
 - Experience in writing system, subsystem-level and module level verification and validation plans, procedures, test execution and test report generation. 
 - Familiarity with reliability theory and analysis. 
 - Experience in technically leading a team of test engineers. 

Personal Characteristics

- Excellent communication, inter-personal and leadership skills
 - Openness to collaborate in interest of project/organization. 
 - Proactive and self-driven, possesses due sense of urgency
 - Shall possess systems mindset and good problem-solving abilities. 
 - Working with multisite teams, Quality conscious and Process & customer Oriented
 - Worked in Global environment

A Career That Matters

Baxter's employees are united in a mission to save and sustain lives. We are passionate about applying scientific innovation to meet the needs of the millions of people worldwide who depend on our medically necessary therapies and technologies. We focus on increasing access to healthcare, innovating in crucial areas of unmet need, and pursuing creative collaborations that bring our mission to life for patients every day. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic. 

Reasonable Accommodations

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information.

The engineer will contribute to building scalable automation frameworks and ensuring high-quality delivery across releases.

- Strong hands-on experience with Playwright with Python or similar modern web automation frameworks, with the ability to design and implement scalable UI automation solutions for complex applications. 
 - Proficiency in Python for test automation scripting, with experience in writing clean, maintainable, and reusable code. 
 - Experience working with BDD frameworks (e. g. , Cucumber / Behave) and integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins). 
 - Strong experience in designing and enhancing UI automation frameworks, including reusable components, test data management, and reporting. 
 - Familiarity with test management tools such as JIRA and XRay (or similar), including test planning, execution, and defect tracking.

- Design, develop, and maintain UI automation test scripts using Playwright with Python

 - Contribute to the automation framework architecture, enhancing scalability, stability, and reporting capabilities
 - Execute automated and manual tests aligned with sprint timelines and release cycles
 - Develop test scenarios and validate workflows, particularly for Front Office and Fixed Income trading systems
 - Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and QA teams to ensure quality across the SDLC

data.title: Senior SDET Analyst- API Testing
data.description:
Ready to take your career global?

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We're looking for a Senior SDET Analyst to join our ever evolving Global Test Engineering team and help shape the future of global commerce. 

What you'll own

- End-to-End Automation & Framework Development: Design, build, and maintain moderately complex test automation frameworks and tools, integrating them with Continuous Integration (CI) infrastructure for automated web, API, and RESTful service testing. 
 - White Box & Lifecycle Testing: Write and execute application tests at the source code level (unit, component, TDD/BDD), identifying improper coding structures and deficiencies to prevent hidden errors early in the development lifecycle. 
 - Performance, Load & Security Validation: Develop test scripts and analyze application performance, load, and security, utilizing service virtualization tools to emulate dependent system components and prevent performance bottlenecks. 
 - Test Strategy & Environment Management: Build and deploy testing environments, manage test data conditioning, and collaborate with business and development stakeholders to construct intricate test cases and ensure Payment Card Industry (PCI) compliance. 
 - Project Coordination: Act as the single point of contact for assigned client projects, coordinating test team activities, reviewing client test plans, and prioritizing execution to deliver high-quality outcomes. 

What you'll bring

- Educational Background: Bachelor's Degree in Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline (equivalent experience considered). 
 - Core Professional Experience: Minimum of 4 years of professional experience in software testing, coding, designing, and automated tool development. 
 - Technical Engineering Skills: Proven proficiency in white box testing, CI/CD pipeline integration, service virtualization tools, and scripting against non-UI components like APIs and RESTful web services. 
 - Analytical Problem Solving: A seasoned, experienced professional capability with a full understanding of software testing specializations, showing a track record of resolving a wide range of structural and functional code issues. 

It's a bonus if you have

- Extended Domain Expertise: 6+ years of experience developing automated testing strategies across a wide variety of infrastructure environments and frameworks. 
 - Think like a client: We care deeply about our clients' success. We ask, listen and learn - curious to understand first. Our passion drives excellence in everything we set out to do. 
 - Act like an owner: We take accountability - working at pace to own our outcomes. We empower each other to make decisions. We're innovative - always finding better ways to deliver impact. 
 - Win as one team: We value personal connections - moving forward together with clarity. We build inclusive and global teams - embracing different perspectives and ideas. It's always 'we, ' never 'me. ' We're determined to succeed together. 

About The Team

Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We're proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections - it's unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders. 

What makes a Globalpayer?

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We're curious and innovative - always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it's our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.

data.title: Lead Engineer
data.description:
Role Overview

Carrier is seeking an Application Engineer to join the Application Engineering team supporting HVAC controls and building automation solutions. This role is responsible for developing, testing, and delivering control applications, graphics, and technical documentation for factory and field-deployed systems. 

The ideal candidate will combine strong HVAC knowledge with controls programming expertise and will play a key role in enabling successful product releases and sustaining existing solutions across multiple product platforms. 

Key Responsibilities

Controls Application Development

• Develop and maintain control programs using Automated Logic tools (Eikon, EQBuilder, SiteBuilder ViewBuilder, WebCTRL and iVu)

• Implement and validate sequences of operation for HVAC equipment including Chiller Plant, RTUs, VAV systems, fan coil units, and heat pumps

Graphics & Visualization Development

• Build and maintain equipment graphics using ViewBuilder and EQBuilder

• Support large-scale graphics library updates, including standardization and migration efforts

• Ensure consistency and usability of graphics across multiple products and platforms

Product Development & Support

• Contribute to development and delivery of key initiatives such as: 

o Multi-zone VAV systems

o RTU Open and field replacement solutions

o TruVu platform applications (RTU, FCU, WSHP, VAV)

o ClimaVision / TFCU products

• Support alignment between controls software and factory equipment releases

Protocol Integration & Communication

Develop and implement applications using industry-standard communication protocols Ensure seamless interoperability between systems, devices, and platforms Configure, integrate, and troubleshoot communication protocols in application environments Validate data exchange, system connectivity, and performance across networks Support integration of devices and systems using field-level and enterprise-level protocols

Relevant Protocols (example): 

BACnet, MSTP, Arc Net Modbus, Lon Works, CCN (Building Automation Systems)

Testing & Validation

• Perform hands-on testing of applications and graphics using lab hardware and simulation environments

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues identified during testing and validation

• Support field readiness by ensuring robust and configurable application behavior

Documentation & Requirements

• Develop and maintain: 

o Sequence of operation documents

o Installation and startup guides

o Technical documentation and user-facing content

Sustaining Engineering

• Support ongoing product maintenance and continuous improvement efforts, including: 

o Bug fixes and defect resolution

o Graphics updates and library enhancements

o Product obsolescence and sustaining support

Basic Qualifications

Description

Selling Partner Identity Verification (SPIV) ensures that Amazon is a safe and trustworthy place to shop and an amazing place to build a successful business selling products. Our mission is to build trust with our Customers and Selling Partners as we scale through technology, analytics, and science. We're committed to service as a center of excellence for Amazon. 

As part of SPIV, Seller Verification owns variety of products which enables us to collect data from WW Sellers in order to let them sell on Amazon marketplace. Our mission is to: (a) make it simple and fast for Sellers to register globally, (b) verify the identity of every person and business selling on Amazon through the Seller lifecycle, and (c) use automation to achieve accuracy, speed, and scale. Registration Systems receive ~1. 5M hits per week and strive towards providing a seamless experience that cannot be exploited by bad actors. We are looking for a Software Development Manager with a strong sense of ownership and a passion for delivering creative solutions for complex problems on an unprecedented scale. As part of leading a team of engineers, you will have the opportunity to create significant impact on our systems, our business and most importantly, our customers as we take on challenges that can reshape the e-commerce industry.

The Ideal Candidate

Must be technically credible to lead teams of world-class software engineers and technical program managers. Must be able to make the right design decisions related to product features and technology choices. 

Deep understanding of overall systems development life cycle including various methodologies (agile, waterfall, iterative)

Experienced in building and managing teams that design and deliver scalable and extensible distributed systems to address complex business challenges.

Consistent focus on operational excellence and security of systems. 

Experience with open source technologies, object-oriented design, and agile development methodologies

data.title: Sr. Application Architect
data.description:
Description

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries. 

We are looking for a Senior Application Architect to design and deliver modern, cloud-native applications for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India customers. In this role, you will own the technical architecture of complex customer engagements, from application assessment and modernization strategy through design, build, and production go-live. You will advise senior customer engineering leaders on how to re-architect, migrate, and modernize their application portfolios on AWS. 

The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect with deep software engineering and IT consulting experience and a proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed applications for enterprise customers. You can work through ambiguous problems with limited guidance and make sound architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, security, and resilience. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on the highest standards, and enjoy mentoring engineers and turning proven patterns into reusable assets for the wider team. 

You will lead technical workstreams made up of AWS consultants, partners, and customer developers, and set the architecture direction across microservices, containers, serverless, APIs, data integration, and DevOps practices. You are expected to write and review code, produce architecture artifacts, run design reviews, and resolve technical risks before they affect delivery. You will also support pre-sales by shaping solution designs and estimates, earn customer trust through technical credibility, and use AI/GenAI (including AI-assisted development tools) to speed up how applications are designed and built. 

In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Application Architecture Delivery Practice Manager. 

Key job responsibilities

We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about: 

- Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
 - Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
 - Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
 - Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC)/ AI-assisted software engineering, from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
 - Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
 - Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
 - Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
 - Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
 - Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. 

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud. 

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. 

Mentorship and Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Basic Qualifications

- 10+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
 - 10+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
 - 10+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
 - 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
 - Travel up to 30% of the time

Preferred Qualifications

- 6+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
 - Experience with designing and building application using AWS services such as Lambda, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Kubernetes
 - Experience in one of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Ruby, Node. js, C#, or C
 - Experience in professional, non-internship software development, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
 - Experience with CloudFormation, Chef, Puppet, Salt, or Ansible in production environments
 - Familiarity with AI-DLC / AI-assisted software engineering, data preparation, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and deploying Generative/Agentic AI solutions

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

This is a rare opportunity to join us in shaping the technical roadmap of a leading trading platform-driving how we scale, evolve, and deliver capabilities that elevate both the advisor and client experience, with real world impact from day one.

Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that's as ambitious as it is authentic. Let's transform the future of fitness-together!

Our Values

Best Life

We believe great work begins with great people. That's why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work-because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact. 

Growth Mindset

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights-personally and professionally. 

One Team

From day one, you'll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive. 

What You'll Do

- Architect, build, and evolve the MCP / ACP ecosystem that exposes ABC Fitness capabilities as standardized, agent-consumable tools. 
 - Design schemas, tool definitions, and abstraction layers that shield AI agents from the complexity and inconsistency of underlying systems while providing clean, structured, hallucination-resistant interfaces. 
 - Define and implement reusable orchestration patterns for multi-step AI workflows, including tool use, validation, retries, state management, fallback handling, and long-running execution flows. 
 - Build for deterministic execution by ensuring AI-driven tool interactions are predictable, safe, observable, auditable, and reversible where necessary. 
 - Establish company-wide standards for AI interaction patterns, structured outputs, input/output validation, schema governance, and agent orchestration workflows. 
 - Design and implement security, permissions, and access control patterns specifically for non-human actors and autonomous systems, including auditability, rate controls, and operational boundaries. 
 - Build instrumentation and observability capabilities that trace agent interactions, identify schema friction, measure execution quality, and improve orchestration success rates over time. 
 - Partner closely with API modernization, platform engineering, infrastructure, security, and SRE teams to define AI-ready integration patterns and ensure scalable production operations. 
 - Lead technical design reviews and influence architecture decisions across teams building AI-native systems on the platform. 
 - Define and document reusable patterns, reference implementations, SDKs, and paved paths that accelerate safe AI adoption across ABC Fitness. 

What You'll Need

- Typically 10+ years of software engineering experience, including deep expertise building distributed backend systems, APIs, orchestration layers, or platform infrastructure; experience in the broader 8-14 year principal range is most aligned for this level. 
 - Proven experience designing and operating high-scale backend systems with strong understanding of state management, concurrency, reliability, and distributed execution patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of how LLMs interact with tools and workflows, including schema design, structured outputs, predictable execution patterns, and orchestration reliability. 
 - Deep expertise in abstraction design and wrapping legacy or complex systems with clean, scalable, and reusable interfaces. 
 - Experience building workflow orchestration systems handling retries, failure states, long-running processes, and multi-step execution logic. 
 - Demonstrated ability to define technical standards and influence engineering direction across multiple teams through architecture, design review, and strong engineering judgment. 
 - Strong production mindset, including experience designing for observability, operational resilience, auditability, scalability, and performance optimization. 
 - Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with Engineering, Product, Platform, Infrastructure, Security, and SRE teams.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. 

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

Position Summary: 

- Kaseya is looking for a Platform Backend Engineer to build and operate the core platform services powering Fleet, connecting the execution runtime, identity layer, event routing, secret management, and audit infrastructure. This role focuses on high-reliability backend and platform engineering, where correctness, security, scalability, and operational clarity are critical. 
 - Build and operate the platform services that underpin Fleet: API gateway, Kafka-based event routing (PSA webhooks and RMM alerts → Temporal workflow triggers), Zitadel integration for machine identity and capability grant management, and ClickHouse-backed immutable audit ledger writes
 - Implement the Secret Management and KMS abstraction layer: pluggable KEK backends (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP Cloud KMS, BYOK), envelope encryption via AWS Encryption SDK, per-client cryptographic isolation
 - Build the capability grant enforcement pipeline: per-workflow, per-client, per-operation grants issued by Zitadel and validated by the sidecar Identity and Capability Engine on every inbound request
 - Own the GitOps-based automation catalog deployment pipeline: workflow definitions versioned in Git, deployed to per-client Temporal namespaces via CI/CD
 - Build operational tooling for MSP onboarding: Zitadel org provisioning, compliance tier configuration per client org, and per-client KMS setup
 - Contribute to the Safe Connector Layer: vendor API wrapper services (ConnectWise, NinjaOne, M365/CIPP, Datto, IT Glue, CrowdStrike, Huntress) that enforce scope, inject platform-managed credentials, and log every call before execution. 

Required Qualification: 

- Strong backend engineering in Go or Rust; we are moving away from Java-heavy backgrounds for new platform work
 - Experience building event-driven systems: Kafka, event sourcing patterns, at-least-once delivery guarantees
 - Familiarity with Temporal or another durable workflow engine
 - Experience with identity and access management systems: OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, token lifecycle management, fine-grained authorization models
 - Solid understanding of encryption patterns: envelope encryption, key hierarchy design, KMS integrations
 - Comfort operating in multi-tenant, regulated environments where correctness and audit evidence are non-negotiable
 - Strong observability instincts: structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics : you instrument what you build

Preferred Qualification: 

- Experience with Zitadel, Keycloak, or similar identity providers
 - ClickHouse or other columnar/append-only store experience
 - Prior work in MSP tooling, PSA/RMM API integrations, or compliance-adjacent infrastructure (CMMC, HIPAA, SOC 2)

You will own features end to end, collaborate across engineering, product, and applied science teams, and use data and engineering rigor to deliver consistent experiences across devices, configurations, and release channels.

You will have full engineering leadership responsibility for a product within Quest's data management portfolio while serving as Site Leader for our Hyderabad development center of approximately 150 employees. 

The Priorities Are Clear

- Development Management : Deliver exceptional product outcomes through high-quality engineering execution. 
 - Site Leadership : Grow Hyderabad's capability, culture, and strategic importance within Quest. 
 - A third, critical responsibility cuts across both mandates: leading the Hyderabad organization toward an AI-first software delivery model , transforming how engineering teams design, build, test, and deliver software. 

Responsibilities

Priority 1: Development Management

You will lead a Hyderabad-based engineering organization responsible for a product within Quest's data management portfolio. 

Delivery & Execution

- Own end-to-end product delivery, including roadmap execution, release commitments, quality, security, performance, and supportability. 
 - Translate product strategy into achievable engineering plans and ensure predictable execution. 
 - Partner with architects and senior engineers on key technical and architectural decisions. 
 - Balance innovation with operational excellence, including technical debt, supportability, and customer-reported issues. 
 - Communicate delivery status, risks, and dependencies effectively to senior leadership. 

Customer & Business Partnership

- Partner closely with Product Management and go-to-market teams on customer engagements, evaluations, and proofs of concept. 
 - Bring customer insights into product planning and prioritization. 
 - Support Sales, Professional Services, and Customer Support on strategic customer opportunities. 

Team Leadership

- Lead through engineering managers and senior technical leaders. 
 - Hire, develop, and retain high-performing teams. 
 - Build leadership depth, succession plans, and future engineering leaders. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, growth, and continuous improvement. 

Data Management Expertise

Experience in the data management domain is strongly preferred, including areas such as: 

- Data architecture and modeling 
 - Data lineage, metadata management, and governance 
 - Data quality, integration, and intelligence solutions 
 - Enterprise data platforms, cloud data warehouses, lakehouses , relational and NoSQL technologies

Priority 2: Hyderabad Site Leadership

As Site Leader, you will be accountable for the growth, culture, and reputation of the Hyderabad engineering organization. 

Site Growth & Capability

- Drive Hyderabad's growth strategy in partnership with HR, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Facilities, and IT. 
 - Expand engineering capability and increase strategic product ownership within the site. 
 - Develop career paths, technical communities, and learning opportunities that strengthen engagement and retention. 

Culture & Communication

- Lead regular town halls and site-wide communications. 
 - Promote a high-performance culture focused on customer value, engineering excellence, accountability, and collaboration. 
 - Serve as the primary bridge between Hyderabad and Quest's global engineering and business teams. 

External Leadership

- Represent Quest within the Hyderabad technology ecosystem. 
 - Build relationships with universities and academic institutions to strengthen graduate hiring and talent pipelines. 
 - Participate in industry forums, technology communities, and employer-branding initiatives. 

AI-First Software Delivery

A core expectation of this role is to lead Hyderabad's transition to AI-first engineering. 

You Will

- Define and implement an AI-first software delivery strategy. 
 - Embed AI-assisted practices across development, testing, code review, documentation, and support. 
 - Establish governance for quality, security, intellectual property, and responsible AI usage. 
 - Measure outcomes through productivity, quality, delivery, and employee experience metrics. 
 - Lead the organizational change required to drive adoption. 
 - Share best practices across Quest and position Hyderabad as a center of excellence for AI-enabled engineering. 

Qualifications

Essential

- 5+ years of second-line engineering leadership experience managing organizations of 30-50+ engineers through managers. 
 - Proven record of delivering enterprise software products to market. 
 - Experience partnering with customer-facing and go-to-market teams. 
 - Demonstrated success building high-performing engineering organizations. 
 - Strong technical credibility and ability to influence architecture and engineering decisions. 
 - Excellent communication skills with experience engaging executives, large employee audiences, and external stakeholders. 
 - Experience operating in global organizations across multiple time zones. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 

Preferred

- Experience in data management, governance, metadata, lineage, or related enterprise software markets. 
 - Experience leading AI-assisted engineering transformation initiatives. 
 - Site leadership experience in India. 
 - SaaS and cloud platform experience. 
 - Expertise in modern engineering practices, including cloud-native architectures, DevOps, CI/CD, quality engineering, and secure software development. 
 - Experience scaling engineering organizations. 
 - Strong network within the Hyderabad technology community. 
 - Advanced degree in engineering, technology, or business. 

What Success Looks Li Ke

Within your first 12 months: 

- Deliver product commitments with high quality and clear customer value. 
 - Build a strong leadership team with healthy engagement, retention, and succession plans. 
 - Establish measurable adoption of AI-assisted software delivery. 
 - Successfully scale the Hyderabad site while strengthening culture and communication. 
 - Increase Quest's visibility and reputation within the Hyderabad technology ecosystem. 

Leadership Attribut es

We Are Looking For a Leader Who

- Maintains a strong bias for delivery and results. 
 - Builds leaders and develops talent. 
 - Can effectively balance multiple strategic responsibilities. 
 - Communicates with clarity, candor , and consistency. 
 - Remains focused on customer outcomes. 
 - Embraces change and innovation, particularly AI-driven transformation. 

Why Quest Software

Quest Software helps organizations manage, secure, and maximize the value of their data and IT environments. This role offers a unique opportunity to own product delivery, lead a 150-person engineering organization, and shape how software is built through AI-first practices at one of Quest's most strategic engineering locations.

data.description:
Company: Eau Labs

Website: Visit Website

LinkedIn: Visit LinkedIn

Business Type: Startup

Company Type: Service

Business Model: B2B

Funding Stage: Bootstrapped

Industry: Water Resource Management

Salary Range: ₹ 9-12 Lacs PA

Job Description

QA/QC Manager (Civil)

Role Overview

The QA/QC Manager directs the project quality management system, establishing audit protocols, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and non-conformance resolution frameworks, with a particular focus on high-durability marine concrete and water-retaining structures. 

Key Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering; certified Lead Auditor (ISO 9001) or equivalent quality certification is preferable. 
 - 10+ years of quality assurance and quality control management experience in complex civil EPC infrastructure, marine intake/outfall structures, or water treatment plants. 

Key Responsibilities

- Project Quality Plan (PQP) Governance: Author, update, and enforce the Project Quality Plan in full compliance with international standards (ISO/ASTM/IS) and client specifications. 
 - ITP Development & Hold-Point Oversight: Review and approve Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) across all civil stages, including deep foundations, marine shafts, intake structures, and water-retaining concrete basins. 
 - Quality Audits & Vendor Surveillance: Plan and execute scheduled and unannounced audits across work fronts, concrete batching plants, testing laboratories, and precast production yards. 
 - Non-Conformance (NCR) Management: Supervise the issuance, root cause analysis, corrective/preventive action (CAPA) tracking, and final sign-off for Non-Conformance Reports. 
 - Durability & Marine Standards: Enforce strict mix-design criteria for marine-grade, low-permeability concrete exposed to saline environments, verifying cover, crack limits, and specialized waterproofing systems.

- Own and drive ATE test solutions and hardware development for wafer-level and package-level testing of SoC, RF, and IoT products. 
 - Develop, debug, and maintain characterization and production test programs for wireless connectivity, PSoC Edge, and microcontroller devices. 
 - Design and support multi-site ATE hardware solutions on Teradyne UltraFLEX and UltraFLEX Plus platforms. 
 - Apply strong expertise in DFT, circuit analysis, process-design-test integration, DOE, and SPC to improve product quality and test effectiveness. 
 - Lead the resolution of customer application issues and RMA investigations, ensuring timely root-cause analysis and closure.

Your profile

Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed

 - Hands-on experience with Teradyne UltraFLEX, UltraFLEX Plus, and/or Advantest V93K platforms. 
 - Strong expertise in Digital, Analog, Mixed-Signal, and RF testing. 
 - Sound knowledge of DFT, ATPG, PMU, DOE, SPC, and semiconductor test methodologies. 
 - Proficiency in C, C++, Java, Visual Basic, Perl, Python, MATLAB, or similar programming languages. 
 - Experience with IG-XL (v10+) and lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, signal generators, and SMUs.

 - Proven ability to mentor teams and drive manufacturing and test process improvements.

Company Description Inorbii is building orbital data center infrastructure, creating a new compute tier engineered to operate above Earth's atmosphere. The company focuses on workloads such as frontier AI training, batch inference, scientific simulation, and archival compute that benefit from near-continuous solar power, radiative cooling, and zero terrestrial footprint. Its modular payload integrates solar generation, compute, and radiative cooling into a single, serviceable platform deployed in low-Earth orbit and operated from the ground. Inorbii emphasizes engineering realism, explicitly addressing launch economics, radiation, in-orbit servicing, latency, and debris through modularity, graceful degradation, and radiation-hardened design. The roadmap spans foundational subsystem and mission engineering, an on-orbit demonstrator, and scaling to a production orbital compute fleet with deep collaboration across aerospace, HPC, and infrastructure partners.

This full-time, on-site role in Bengaluru involves owning system architecture for integrated payloads, defining interfaces between solar generation, compute, thermal management, and communications subsystems, and guiding hardware and firmware design decisions. You will oversee engineering teams across aerospace, mechanical, electrical, and embedded domains; review detailed designs, simulations, and test plans; and ensure that reliability, safety, and mission-critical performance requirements are met. Day-to-day responsibilities include coordinating with launch and satellite partners, managing technology roadmaps from subsystem prototypes to orbital demonstrators, and building processes for design validation, environmental testing, and in-orbit operations. data.title: Embedded Software Architect
data.description:
Job Title

Embedded Software Architect

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Embedded Software Architect to own the technical architecture for regulated medical device software across the Sleep & Respiratory Care portfolio. This role sits at the center of our engineering organization - defining architecture and design for therapy devices, ventilators and connected-care platforms, and ensuring that what we build is safe, secure, compliant and sustainable. 

You will operate as a hands-on technical authority: making design decisions, resolving complex technical risks, mentoring engineers, and representing software architecture in cross-functional and regulatory forums. This is a role for someone who wants deep technical ownership of products that directly improve patients' ability to breathe and sleep. 

Your Role

Technical Skills

- Deep expertise in C++(preferred) / C / Embedded C; strong grasp of real-time and resource-constrained design. 
 - RTOS concepts, scheduling, concurrency, task frameworks, memory and power optimisation. 
 - Microcontroller/SoC platforms (e. g. ARM Cortex-M / STM32 class), board bring-up and hardware-software integration. 
 - Communication protocols and connectivity - BLE/Bluetooth, cellular/modem, UART/SPI/I2C, and secure firmware update mechanisms. 
 - Software architecture practice - modelling, design patterns, interface design, modularity and platform thinking. 
 - Verification fundamentals: unit verification, static analysis, code coverage, test automation and CI/CD (ADO / GitHub). 
 - Cybersecurity for embedded/connected devices: threat modelling, cryptography fundamentals, secure boot and signed updates. 

Architecture & Technical Design

- Define, document and govern the software architecture for assigned products and platforms, including decomposition, interfaces, data flows and deployment topology. 
 - Produce and maintain architecture artefacts - SAD, SDD, interface specifications and design rationale - to regulated standards. 
 - Drive architectural decisions on real-time behaviour, memory and power constraints, connectivity (BLE/cellular/modem), and hardware-software integration. 
 - Lead design reviews, technical risk assessments and trade-off analyses; ensure decisions are recorded with clear rationale. 
 - Evaluate and drive modernisation, refactoring and reuse across platforms to reduce duplication and improve maintainability. 

Regulated Product Development & Quality

- Ensure architecture and design comply with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971 (risk management) and applicable EU MDR / FDA requirements. 
 - Own end-to-end requirement-to-test traceability for assigned areas, ensuring design elements trace to requirements and verification evidence. 
 - Contribute to software safety classification, hazard analysis, FMEA and risk-control design. 
 - Support CAPA, CAP and DCR activities with root-cause analysis, impact assessment and design remediation. 
 - Ensure adherence to internal QMS processes and design-history-file completeness. 

Security & Secure SDLC

- Embed secure-by-design principles into architecture; support threat modelling and security risk assessment. 
 - Own architecture-level inputs to SBOM, SOUP/OTS assessment, VAR and vulnerability remediation. 
 - Champion secure SDLC adoption within the engineering teams. 

Execution & Cross-Functional Leadership

- Partner with Engineering Managers on technical feasibility, effort estimation, sequencing and resource planning. 
 - Represent software architecture with cross-functional partners - Systems, Quality, Regulatory, Product, PMO, Security, Operations and Manufacturing. 
 - Surface technical risks, dependencies and decision points early, with proposed solutions rather than escalations alone. 
 - Provide technical input into release planning, Release Train cadence and sprint execution within an Agile/ADO way of working. 

Capability Building & Technical Leadership

- Mentor and coach engineers; act as buddy/mentor within the competency ramp-up framework and support progression toward independent (L2) execution. 
 - Lead knowledge-transfer for products transitioning ownership into the India organisation. 
 - Drive engineering excellence: code quality, design standards, review discipline, static analysis and unit-verification rigour. 
 - Champion AI-assisted engineering (e. g. GitHub Copilot across the V-model) to improve productivity without compromising quality or compliance. 
 - Contribute to knowledge-sharing sessions, technical forums and reusable engineering assets. 

You're The Right Fit If

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline. 
 - 10+ years in embedded software development, with a minimum of 5 years in an architect or lead-architect capacity. 
 - Proven track record architecting embedded products in a regulated domain - medical devices strongly preferred (aerospace, automotive safety or industrial safety-critical also considered). 
 - Demonstrated ownership of a product or platform architecture through full lifecycle, from concept to release and sustaining. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication; can explain complex trade-offs to non-software audiences. 
 - Strong technical influence without authority - able to align cross-functional stakeholders on architecture decisions. 

How We Work Together

We believe that we are better together than apart. This is an office-based role, which means working in person at least 3 days per week. 

About Philips

Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business, discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose. 

If you're interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care. 

#ConnectedCare

1. Role Purpose

The Manager - CAM owns the complete CAM function: converting approved CAD designs into accurate, machine-ready output (3D-printed resin/wax patterns) on time, at the right quality and at the lowest sustainable cost. The role is accountable for department-level delivery to production, machine capacity and utilisation, CAM-related quality, tooling and consumables cost, process standardisation and building a capable, multi-skilled team. 

2. Key Responsibilities

2. 1 Department Leadership & Capacity Planning

- Lead the CAM department and set daily, weekly and monthly output plans aligned to the PPC and order-delivery schedule. 
 - Plan machine and manpower capacity; flag capacity gaps early and propose shift, outsourcing or investment options. 
 - Allocate jobs across programmers and machines based on complexity, priority and skill; own the department's job-priority board. 
 - Establish clear information flow with CAD, PPC and production so that every job has a committed date, status and owner at all times. 2. 2 Delivery & Production Support

- Own on-time delivery of CAM output to casting and production; track WIP and ageing jobs daily. 
 - Define and enforce turnaround-time (TAT) standards by job category (standard, complex, urgent, sample). 
 - Handle escalations and critical / priority orders; resolve bottlenecks within defined response times. 
 - Conduct daily production review with the team and a weekly performance review with the Production Head. 2. 3 Quality & Accuracy

- Own first-time-right performance and CAM-attributable rejection and rework. 
 - Establish design-for-manufacturability (DFM) checks at the CAD → CAM handover to catch issues before programming. 
 - Ensure weight and dimensional conformance of models against design; work with QC and Casting on root-cause analysis (RCA) and CAPA. 
 - Build first-piece approval and in-process checks for new and complex designs. 2. 4 Machine, Technology & Asset Management

- Maximise utilisation of CNC machines and 3D printers; monitor downtime, failed prints and machine-wise productivity. 
 - Drive preventive maintenance and calibration with the Maintenance team; minimise unplanned breakdowns. 
 - Evaluate and recommend new CAM software modules, machines, resins, cutters and automation; prepare cost-benefit justification for capex. 
 - Ensure licences, software updates and post-processors are current and controlled. 2. 5 Tooling, Consumables & Cost Control

- Prepare and manage the department budget for tooling, resin, wax and consumables; track cost per unit of output. 
 - Standardise parameters, tool libraries and print settings to improve tool life and reduce wastage. 
 - Coordinate with Purchase on vendor evaluation, pricing and lead times for critical consumables. 2. 6 Process Standardisation & New Product Development

- Create and maintain SOPs, standard machining strategies and template programs for recurring design families. 
 - Lead CAM input for NPD, samples and customer approvals; commit and deliver realistic timelines. 
 - Run a structured improvement programme (Kaizen, RCA, cycle-time studies) with measurable savings. 2. 7 People Management

- Recruit, onboard, train and appraise team members; maintain a skill matrix and succession cover for every critical machine and software. 
 - Set individual KPIs for team members that cascade from the department scorecard in this JD. 
 - Build a culture of accountability, safety, discipline and continuous learning. 2. 8 Documentation, MIS & Compliance

- Maintain a controlled program library with version control, revision history and traceability to design and order numbers. 
 - Publish monthly department MIS: output, OTD, TAT, FTR, rejection, utilisation, cost and wastage. 
 - Ensure compliance with company SOPs, EHS norms, machine safety, and internal and external audit requirements; close audit findings within timelines. 3. Decision Authority

- Job allocation, sequencing and priority within the CAM department (in line with PPC commitments). 
 - Machining strategy, parameters, tool selection and program release approval. 
 - Recommend hiring, training, performance ratings and incentive payouts for team members. 
 - Recommend purchase of tooling and consumables within approved budget; recommend capex for approval. 4. Required Skills & Competencies

Technical

- Expert-level CAM programming & Strong working knowledge for jewellery: Chituboax, B9 Creater, OneSlicer, Wax Jet printer, Materialise Magics, 3D Sprint 2025, PowerMill, Mastercam, WorkNC, RhinoCAM or equivalent. 
 - Strong working knowledge of 3D printing (resin/wax) set-up, orientation, supports and print-failure analysis. 
 - Understanding of the full jewellery process chain: CAD, CAM, casting, stone setting, finishing, polishing, and how CAM decisions affect metal weight and downstream yield. 
 - Tooling, cutting parameters, tolerances, surface finish and precious-metal machining. Managerial

- Capacity planning, scheduling and production control; comfort with ERP / MES data and Excel-based MIS. 
 - Problem solving using RCA, 5-Why, Pareto and CAPA. 
 - Team leadership, coaching, conflict resolution and cross-functional coordination. 
 - Cost awareness, budgeting and data-driven decision making. 5. Educational Qualification

- Diploma / B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical, Production or Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - Certification in CAD/CAM/CNC programming preferred; Lean / Six Sigma exposure an advantage. 6. Preferred Background

Gold / precious-metal jewellery manufacturing (strongly preferred), CNC jewellery manufacturing, precision engineering, tool & die, or high-precision CNC machining, with demonstrated team leadership.

data.description:
Role: Tech Lead - Full-Stack AI Platform

Function: Engineering / Technology

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Hybrid)

Type: Full-time

Industry: Accounting, AI/ML, SaaS, Fintech

About Company

An AI technology company building the accounting firm of the future. The company's platform acts as a specialized junior accountant within a human-in-the-loop model. 

It targets independent accounting firms in North America, delivering productivity gains exceeding five times in key workflows. Operating in a $150B+ accounting market that still runs largely on manual effort, the company automates routine delivery and administrative tasks so accountants can focus on higher-value advisory work. 

Backed by $6M in seed funding, the company is a lean, high-ownership team of eight, scaling fast from its Bengaluru base. 

Position Overview

As Tech Lead, you will own a full engineering pod - setting technical direction, driving high-quality execution, and engaging directly with accounting firm customers to close the feedback loop. This is a 0-to-1 role at a seed-stage company: you will architect scalable AI agent and automation systems, hold the bar for your pod's engineering standards, and translate ambiguous customer problems into production-grade solutions. Your decisions will directly determine how fast the company can scale its platform across North America. 

Role & Responsibilities

- Own the full technical lifecycle of a pod - architecture, execution, code quality, and delivery - with direct accountability for timelines and outcomes
 - Engage directly with accounting firm customers to understand workflow pain points, validate solutions, and translate requirements into technical decisions
 - Architect and scale agentic AI systems and RAG pipelines built on LangChain/LangGraph, with full observability into agent behavior, latency, and failure modes in production
 - Drive 0-to-1 feature development: take ambiguous problem statements from first principles to production-ready, explainable code - no black-box vibe-coding
 - Design and operate pipelines that process large volumes of unstructured data - documents, receipts, financial records - with reliable parsing and structured output extraction
 - Set and enforce engineering standards within the pod - API design, test coverage for AI pipeline logic, model deployment hygiene, and incident ownership
 - Collaborate with founders and PMs on roadmap prioritization, proactively surfacing technical constraints and challenging requirements when the path doesn't make sense
 - Mentor and grow engineers within the pod, establishing a high-performance execution culture

Must Have Criteria

- 5-7 years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in a tech lead or equivalent pod ownership role
 - Demonstrated 0-to-1 experience: has built and shipped a core product or system from scratch in a startup or early-stage environment
 - Has owned and resolved scalability challenges in production - throughput, reliability, or multi-tenant data volume at scale
 - 3+ years building and shipping production software as a full-stack engineer using Django/DRF, ReactJS, PostgreSQL, and REST APIs
 - Strong hands-on experience with agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, and model deployment in production - using LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, and structured outputs
 - Has implemented observability for AI systems in production - tracing agent runs, monitoring model outputs, and debugging multi-step pipeline failures
 - Has worked extensively with unstructured data - documents, free-form text, or financial records - at production scale
 - Experience building B2B SaaS products with multi-tenant data models, RBAC, and audit trails
 - Track record of direct customer or stakeholder engagement - has translated customer requirements into technical decisions

Nice to Have

- Has built or contributed to recommendation systems in a production environment
 - Familiarity with document OCR or financial document processing
 - Exposure to AWS or GCP, Docker, and workflow orchestration tools such as Temporal or Prefect
 - Prior domain exposure to tax, accounting, or financial document workflows
 - Experience at a seed or Series A startup with an engineering team of fewer than 15 people

What We Offer

- End-to-end pod ownership from day one - technical, product, and customer dimensions
 - Direct collaboration with founders and PMs in a high-trust, low-bureaucracy environment
 - Ship to real users and see the impact of your work in weeks, not quarters
 - Hybrid work setup based out of Bengaluru, with exposure to North American customers and partners

data.description:
Senior Manager- Technology, Learning Futures Lab, CLTE

Function: Leading the technology and AI-enabled tool development for CLTE's Learning Futures Lab pillar

Location: Hyderabad

Reports to: Director, CLTE

Band: A2

Reportees to Position: Developers / Technical Associates (internal and contracted)

Job Outline

The Senior Manager - Technology, Learning Futures Lab is responsible for leading the hands-on design, architecture, and delivery of AI-enabled and other technology tools that support CLTE's mandate to pioneer the future of learning at ISB. Working closely with the Teaching & Learning Design pillar, which engages directly with faculty to surface needs and define requirements, the incumbent translates these requirements into technical specifications, rapidly prototypes and validates solutions, and leads internal developers and external consultants through build, pilot, and scaled deployment. The role combines strong individual technical execution with the ability to architect, direct, and quality-control the work of a small technical team, while partnering with CLTE's other pillars - particularly Learning Analytics & Insights - on data, privacy, and compliance considerations. 

Job Specification

Knowledge / Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Strong, demonstrable technical foundation across modern software engineering and AI/ML systems. 
 - Exposure to education, ed-tech, or learning environments is desirable but not required - the Teaching & Learning Design pillar leads on pedagogical requirement-gathering. 

Specific Skills

- Systems architecture & integration: REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, enterprise databases and legacy systems. 
 - AI/LLM engineering: prompt design, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, model and vendor evaluation. 
 - Data engineering: ETL design, data warehousing, stream processing. 
 - Cloud & deployment: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/GCP/Azure, CI/CD, security and compliance (e. g. , SOC2, data privacy). 
 - Full-stack development: Python, Java, TypeScript/Go/C++. 
 - Rapid prototyping, including fast feasibility-testing of AI/LLM approaches before committing to a full build. 
 - Root-cause debugging across unfamiliar, third-party, and integrated systems. 
 - Translating ambiguous requirements into precise technical specifications and milestones. 
 - Clear communication of technical trade-offs to faculty, engineers, and leadership. 
 - Pragmatic judgment on build-vs-buy and "80% solution" vs. long-term architecture decisions. 
 - Composure and ownership under pressure, including live pilots and production issues. 

Desirable Experience

- 7-10 years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, or technical leadership roles. 
 - Proven experience leading a team of engineers and/or managing external consultants or vendors. 
 - Hands-on experience building and shipping AI/LLM-based products or features. 
 - Prior exposure to ed-tech, e-learning platforms, or academic/research environments is a plus, not a prerequisite. 

Job Interface & Relationships

Internal

- Director, CLTE
 - Teaching & Learning Design pillar
 - Learning Analytics & Insights pillar
 - Faculty (periodic, during pilots and reviews)
 - Internal developers / technical associates

External

- AI and ed-tech vendors / platform providers
 - Technical consultants and contracted developers
 - Cloud and infrastructure providers

Key Result Areas

1. AI & Technology Development - Weightage: 30%

Key Performance Indicators

- Lead design, prototyping, and delivery of AI-enabled and other technology tools across CLTE's curriculum and faculty initiatives. 
 - Translate requirements developed with the Teaching & Learning Design pillar into technical architecture and working solutions. 
 - Rapidly validate AI/LLM approaches through proofs-of-concept before committing to full builds. Measures

- Number and quality of tools/features delivered
 - Time from requirement handoff to working prototype
 - Faculty/stakeholder satisfaction with delivered tools

2. Pilot-to-Scale Execution - Weightage: 20%

Key Performance Indicators

- Run structured pilots for new AI/technology tools with clear success criteria. 
 - Own the transition of successful pilots into scaled, production-grade deployments. 
 - Ensure sustainable architecture that avoids unsustainable technical debt. Measures

- Number of pilots successfully scaled
 - Post-scale system reliability/uptime
 - Incidence of rework due to technical debt

3. Team & Vendor Management - Weightage: 20%

Key Performance Indicators

- Lead and mentor internal developers; manage external consultants and contractors engaged for development work. 
 - Establish clear technical workflows, milestones, and accountability across the build pipeline. 
 - Make sound build-vs-buy decisions, evaluating vendor and platform options against internal capacity. Measures

- On-time, on-quality delivery across team- and consultant-led workstreams
 - Quality and rigor of vendor evaluations

4. Cross-Pillar & Stakeholder Collaboration - Weightage: 15%

Key Performance Indicators

- Partner closely with the Teaching & Learning Design pillar to ensure technical builds reflect faculty and pedagogical intent. 
 - Coordinate with the Learning Analytics & Insights pillar on data architecture, privacy, and compliance considerations. 
 - Communicate technical trade-offs clearly to faculty, CLTE leadership, and other non-technical stakeholders. Measures

- Stakeholder feedback on collaboration and clarity
 - Smoothness of cross-pillar handoffs; rework/escalations due to miscommunication

5. Technical Governance & Compliance - Weightage: 15%

Key Performance Indicators

- Ensure deployed systems meet data security, privacy, and compliance requirements (e. g. , student data protection). 
 - Maintain up-to-date documentation of architecture, systems, and integrations for institutional continuity. 
 - Track emerging AI/ed-tech developments relevant to CLTE's mandate and flag adoption opportunities. Measures

- Compliance/audit outcomes
 - Documentation completeness
 - Relevant new capabilities identified and evaluated
