data.title: DGM - QC (Drymix)
data.description:
Department: Quality Control / Quality Assurance

Location: Surat, Gujarat

Industry: Construction Chemicals / Drymix / Building Materials

Reporting To: Head - Quality / Business Head

Experience: 12-18 Years

Qualification: B. E. /B. Tech/M. E. /M. Tech - Civil/Chemical/Materials Science or M. Sc. Chemistry

Preferred Experience: Drymix Mortar, Construction Chemicals, Cement, Building Materials, Tile Adhesives or allied industries

To lead the Quality Control function for the Drymix business and ensure consistent, reliable and compliant quality across raw materials, production processes and finished products. 

The role will be responsible for establishing robust quality systems, strengthening laboratory and testing capabilities, reducing quality deviations and customer complaints, driving CAPA and continuous improvement, and building a strong quality culture across manufacturing operations. 

The incumbent will act as the key quality interface between R&D, Production, Procurement, Technical Services, Sales and Management. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1. Quality Control Leadership
 - Lead end-to-end QC activities for the Drymix product portfolio. 
 - Establish and maintain quality standards, specifications, inspection plans and testing protocols. 
 - Ensure effective control of incoming raw materials, in-process materials and finished products. 
 - Ensure batch-wise quality clearance and release as per approved specifications. 
 - Monitor quality trends and proactively identify potential quality risks. 2. Drymix Product QualityEnsure consistent quality and performance of products including: 

- Tile Adhesives
 - Block Jointing Mortars
 - Wall Putty
 - Plasters
 - Grouts
 - Repair Mortars
 - Flooring Products
 - Cementitious Waterproofing
 - Other Drymix Construction Chemical ProductsMonitor critical parameters such as consistency, workability, density, moisture, setting time, water retention, adhesion strength, open time, slip, compressive/flexural strength and other product-specific performance parameters. 

3. Raw Material Quality Management
 - Establish specifications for cement, sand, fillers, polymers, additives, pigments and other critical raw materials. 
 - Develop supplier quality parameters and incoming inspection standards. 
 - Review supplier COAs and test results. 
 - Drive alternate raw-material evaluation in coordination with R&D and Procurement. 
 - Establish supplier quality improvement and rejection-reduction initiatives. 4. Process Quality & Manufacturing Excellence
 - Establish effective in-process quality controls at every critical stage of manufacturing. 
 - Ensure adherence to approved formulations, SOPs and process parameters. 
 - Identify process variation and implement corrective measures. 
 - Work closely with Production to reduce batch rejection, rework and process deviations. 
 - Drive process capability and quality consistency across batches. 5. Quality Systems & Compliance
 - Develop and implement SOPs, inspection plans, control plans and quality manuals. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable IS/BIS, ASTM, EN and ISO standards. 
 - Maintain proper documentation, traceability and quality records. 
 - Lead internal quality audits and support external/customer audits. 
 - Ensure calibration and preventive maintenance of laboratory equipment. 
 - Strengthen laboratory safety, housekeeping and testing discipline. 6. Customer Complaint & CAPA Management
 - Lead investigation of product-quality complaints. 
 - Conduct structured Root Cause Analysis (RCA) using appropriate quality tools. 
 - Implement CAPA and monitor effectiveness. 
 - Coordinate with Technical, Sales, Production and R&D teams for complaint closure. 
 - Analyse recurring complaints and develop preventive quality measures. 
 - Drive reduction in customer complaints and market returns. 7. Quality Improvement & Cost Reduction
 - Drive continuous improvement projects to reduce: 
 - Batch rejection
 - Rework
 - Material wastage
 - Customer complaints
 - Quality-related cost
 - Identify opportunities for process optimization without compromising product performance. 
 - Develop quality dashboards and trend analysis for management review. 
 - Benchmark product quality against competitors and industry standards. 8. R&D & New Product Development Support
 - Work closely with R&D during formulation development and product validation. 
 - Support laboratory trials, pilot batches and commercial-scale validation. 
 - Establish quality specifications for new products. 
 - Participate in product benchmarking and performance evaluation. 
 - Ensure smooth transition of new products from R&D to commercial production. 9. Laboratory & Testing Infrastructure
 - Lead the development and modernization of the Drymix QC laboratory. 
 - Ensure availability and suitability of testing equipment. 
 - Establish testing frequency, methods and acceptance criteria. 
 - Ensure instrument calibration and validation. 
 - Develop laboratory competency and testing reliability. 10. Team Leadership
 - Lead and develop the QC team comprising Managers, Executives, Chemists, Engineers and Lab Technicians. 
 - Define KRAs, KPIs and performance objectives for the team. 
 - Build technical capability through regular training and knowledge sharing. 
 - Promote a culture of ownership, discipline, accuracy and continuous improvement. 
 - Ensure adequate manpower planning for laboratory and plant QC operations. 11. Cross-Functional CollaborationWork closely with: 

R&D: Formulation, trials, product development and validation

Production: Process control, batch quality and deviations

Procurement: Supplier quality and raw-material specifications

Technical Services: Application performance and field complaints

Sales & Marketing: Customer feedback and market quality requirements

Management: Quality dashboard, risks, improvement plans and strategic initiatives

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)
 - Reduction in batch rejection and rework
 - Reduction in customer complaints
 - First-time-right batch percentage
 - Raw-material rejection percentage
 - Finished-product compliance percentage
 - CAPA closure within defined timelines
 - Reduction in quality-related cost
 - Improvement in process consistency
 - Laboratory testing accuracy and turnaround time
 - Audit compliance score
 - Calibration compliance
 - Supplier quality improvement
 - Successful validation of new products
 - Team productivity and technical capability developmentREQUIRED COMPETENCIESTechnical Competencies
 - Strong knowledge of Drymix Mortar and Construction Chemicals
 - Cement chemistry and polymer-modified formulations
 - Tile adhesives, grouts, mortars, putty and waterproofing products
 - Raw-material and finished-product testing
 - Quality systems and process control
 - IS/BIS, ASTM, EN and ISO standards
 - RCA, CAPA, 7 QC Tools and problem-solving methodologies
 - Laboratory management and calibration systems
 - Quality documentation and audit managementLeadership Competencies
 - Strategic quality leadership
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
 - Cross-functional collaboration
 - Team building and mentoring
 - Decision-making and ownership
 - Data-driven approach
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management
 - Continuous improvement mindsetCANDIDATE PROFILEThe ideal candidate should be a quality leader with strong hands-on experience in Drymix/Construction Chemicals or Building Materials, capable of moving the function from routine inspection to a proactive, data-driven quality-management system. 

The candidate should demonstrate experience in quality improvement, process standardization, customer complaint reduction, laboratory management, team leadership and cross-functional problem solving. 

Preferred Experience: 12-18 years, with at least 4-5 years in a managerial/leadership position within Drymix, Construction Chemicals, Cement, Mortar or Building Materials. 

Location: Surat, Gujarat

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically strong Staff Engineer to drive end-to-end verification of next-generation CPU Co-Processor (CPUCP/PDP) Power Management firmware and hardware features. This role requires deep expertise in SystemVerilog-based verification, power management validation, and cross-functional leadership across Firmware, RTL Design and Post-Silicon teams.

This role is central to setting the technical direction and engineering standards for secure, scalable, production-grade AI capabilities that improve how enterprise processes are delivered. By leading the architecture and delivery of intelligent agents, multi-agent workflows, enterprise integrations, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and cloud-native deployment patterns, the Lead AI Engineer will accelerate reliable AI adoption and measurable operational outcomes. data.description:
Summary

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) brings together software and systems engineering to design and operate large-scale, highly distributed, and fault-tolerant systems. As a Site Reliability Engineer III, on the Platform team, you will play a key role in designing, building, and operating the foundational infrastructure that powers Guidewire's SaaS platform. You will focus on automation, reliability, scalability, and operability - ensuring our multi-tenant cloud platform consistently meets both functional and non-functional requirements. You will work closely with product development teams to influence system design, improve resilience, and ensure production readiness, while building the tools and frameworks that enable efficient, global, follow-the-sun operations. 

Job Description

What You'll Do

Drive Reliability, Automation & Scale: 

- Design, build, and operate highly reliable, scalable infrastructure for a multi-tenant SaaS platform. 
 - Automate deployment, provisioning, and operational workflows across cloud infrastructure and applications. 
 - Develop internal tools, services, and frameworks to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort. 
 - Participate in a 24x7 follow-the-sun on-call rotation to support critical production systems. 

Improve Platform & Infrastructure: 

- Contribute to core platform systems by building features, resolving issues, and enhancing reliability. 
 - Partner with development teams to ensure systems meet availability, performance, and scalability requirements. 
 - Proactively identify risks, bottlenecks, and failure modes, and implement solutions before they impact customers. 

Observability, Incident Management & Resilience: 

- Build and maintain observability systems (metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards). 
 - Define and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and reliability metrics. 
 - Lead or contribute to incident response, root cause analysis, and blameless postmortems. 
 - Drive improvements toward self-healing systems and reduced operational toil. 

Security & Identity: 

- Design and support secure access patterns, including SSO, SAML, and OAuth-based authentication systems. 
 - Ensure platform services meet security and compliance standards. 

Enablement & Collaboration: 

- Collaborate across engineering teams, providing guidance, feedback, and hands-on contributions. 
 - Create and maintain documentation, runbooks, and training materials. 
 - Mentor engineers and promote best practices in reliability engineering and automation. 

Who You Are

Infrastructure Development: 

- 8-12 years of hands-on experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, or a related platform engineering role, with a proven track record of designing, building, and operating highly available, scalable, and reliable production systems. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python or Go (Java/Spring Boot is a plus). 
 - Deep experience with AWS and building/operating production systems at scale. 
 - Hands-on expertise with Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, Helm, CNI, and Ingress networking. 
 - Strong understanding of Kubernetes primitives and patterns (deployments, services, operators, etc. ). 
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Terragrunt, or similar). 
 - Solid understanding of Linux systems and networking fundamentals. 

Observability & Operations: 

- Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, or CloudWatch. 
 - Familiarity with incident management practices and production support in a microservices environment. 
 - Experience with messaging/streaming systems (e. g. , Kafka, SQS) and relational databases (e. g. , Aurora, RDS) is a plus. 

Security & Identity: 

- Working knowledge of SSO, SAML, OAuth, and identity providers (Okta is a plus). 
 - Experience with AWS IAM (roles, policies, IRSA), VPC security groups, and Kubernetes security primitives (RBAC, network policies, pod security standards, secrets management). 

DevOps & Delivery: 

- Experience with CI/CD and GitOps tools such as GitHub Actions, TeamCity, Jenkins, FluxCD, or Bitbucket. 
 - Comfortable working in agile environments (Scrum, Kanban). 

Mindset & Collaboration: 

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with a proactive, systems-thinking mindset. 
 - Passion for automation: "If you have to do it more than once, automate it. "
 - Excellent communication skills and ability to work across distributed teams. 
 - A collaborative team player who can influence, mentor, and lead through technical expertise. 
 - Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and data-driven insights to improve productivity and outcomes. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience
 - Experience supporting large-scale SaaS platforms
 - AWS or Kubernetes certifications
 - Exposure to modern platform frameworks such as KubeVela (OAM) or Crossplane
 - Contributions to open-source projects

Why Guidewire?

- Work on a mission-critical global platform used by leading P&C insurers worldwide
 - Solve complex, real-world infrastructure problems at genuine scale
 - Be part of a collaborative, high-impact engineering culture grounded in integrity, rationality, and collegiality
 - Opportunity to shape the future of a rapidly evolving cloud platform
 - A culture of curiosity and innovation where engineers are empowered to leverage AI and emerging technologies. 

About Guidewire

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire. 

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation. 

For more information, please visit www. guidewire. com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer – AI Systems for Engineering Workflows
data.description:
Job Description

This role owns the technical vision and execution for applying AI at scale across DevOps and productization workflows, with a mandate to fundamentally improve how software and firmware are built, tested, released, and operated. The position sits at the intersection of AI systems, developer platforms, and operational excellence, driving the design and rollout of intelligent, automated pipelines that move beyond static CI/CD toward predictive, self-healing, and data-driven execution. The focus is on replacing high-cost manual processes with scalable AI-powered mechanisms, improving end-to-end quality and velocity, and enabling reliable delivery across large, multi-team engineering environments. Success in this role requires operating at platform and ecosystem scale, setting architectural direction, and ensuring AI-enabled systems are secure, observable, governable, and resilient in long-lived production environments. 

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: 

- Lead the design and delivery of AI-enabled solutions for building, test, and release workflows of software products using approved enterprise technologies and enterprise-ready solution patterns. 
 - Identify engineering workflows that can be fully or partially offloaded to AI systems, reducing or eliminating repeated manual engineering effort. 
 - Design and implement scalable AI-powered solutions in engineering workflows such as build and test triage, failure analysis, flaky test intelligence, debugging assistance, and release decision support. 
 - Work hands-on with engineering teams to turn ideas into working solutions that can be rolled out in production. 
 - Own key initiatives from concept and architecture through development, rollout, validation, adoption, and ongoing improvement. 
 - Help define technical direction, propose practical architecture improvements, and influence how AI is introduced into critical engineering systems. 
 - Develop tools, supporting systems, and infrastructure that improve engineering productivity and enable sustainable AI adoption. 
 - Review technical designs and implementations, provide strong feedback, and mentor junior engineers. 
 - Establish practical approaches for evaluation, telemetry, monitoring, observability, and continuous improvement of AI-enabled systems. 
 - Design solutions that account for operational constraints such as rate limits, retry behavior, error handling, and production supportability. 
 - Collaborate with internal teams, domain experts, and junior talent to build solutions that can scale across the organization. 
 - Ensure all automation and intelligence align with Emerson's reliability, safety, and regulatory commitments
 - Act as a key technical leader, shaping the long-term roadmap for AI driven DevOps transformation across T&M. 
 - Partner with engineering leaders, architects, and operational teams to drive adoption of intelligent automation and data driven decision-making. 
 - Mentor teams on AI/ML fundamentals, emerging practices, and how to leverage automation to enhance product quality and operational performance. 

Who You Are: 

- You are an application-focused AI engineering leader who enjoys solving real workflow and engineering problems. 
 - You are comfortable operating as both an architect and a builder. 
 - You can take an ambiguous problem, create a practical solution approach, and drive it through execution. 
 - You understand what it takes to deploy systems at an organizational scale, including rollout, adoption, governance, observability, and long-term maintainability. 
 - You work well across teams, influence technical direction, and help raise the capability of the engineers around you. 
 - You are self-driven, pragmatic, and able to make sound trade-offs in evolving situations. 

For This Role, You Will Need: 

- B. E / B. Tech / M. Tech / MCA in Computer Science / Electronics / Electrical / Instrumentation / Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning / related technical discipline. 
 - 8+ years of proven experience in software engineering, systems design, AI application engineering, or related technical roles. Minimum 3+ yearsexperience developing AI based applications. 
 - Hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation architectures, workflow automation, evaluation methods, platform integration, agentic systems, cost-aware AI design, and operationalizing AI-enabled systems in production, including monitoring, observability, feedback loops, and lifecycle management. 
 - Strong understanding of AI training fundamentals, including how models are developed, adapted, evaluated, and improved, even if your primary industry experience has been in building and deploying AI-enabled applications rather than training foundation models directly. 
 - Strong experience building AI-enabled applications or workflow solutions in enterprise environments. 
 - Strong understanding of DevOps and modern software delivery systems, including CI/CD pipelines, build and release workflows, automation, observability, and production operational considerations. 
 - Proven experience designing, deploying, and operating systems or workflow solutions on an organizational scale, including rollout across multiple teams or large engineering groups. 
 - Strong problem-solving ability, including diagnosing technical issues and proposing practical, high-quality solutions. 
 - Good understanding of enterprise constraints such as governance, approved technologies, security, observability, and production-readiness. 
 - Ability to work effectively with engineering teams that have deep domain expertise but limited AI maturity. 

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart: 

- Experience applying AI to build systems, test systems, CI/CD workflows, release engineering, software delivery, and engineering productivity workflows. 
 - Experience with enterprise AI platforms, internal developer platforms, or similar shared engineering platforms used to operationalize AI solutions at scale. 
 - Familiarity with Agile software development practices, CI pipelines, and workflow automation. 
 - Understanding of NI software tools or related internal engineering ecosystems. 
 - Exposure to fine-tuning, model adaptation, data preparation, evaluation pipelines, or other AI training-related workflows. 
 - A strong track record of driving large, ambiguous technical initiatives to successful completion. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a diverse, multi-cultural engineering environment and communicate well with both engineering teams and management. 

Why This Role Is Important: 

- This role is intended to bring external AI expertise into the organization and apply it in practical, high-value engineering workflows. 
 - The focus is not on research alone, but on delivering enterprise-ready AI systems that save developer time, improve decision-making, and create reusable internal capability. 
 - This is a Principal-level individual contributor role for someone who can influence architecture, build solutions hands-on, and help scale AI adoption responsibly. 

Our Culture & Commitment to You: 

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives-because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave. 

About Us

WHY EMERSON

Our Commitment to Our People

At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.

You'll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. data.title: Senior RF System Engineering Expert
data.description:
Job Description

Serve as the technical focal point for advanced RF and physical layer (PHY) modem systems, driving the definition, analysis, and hands-on performance verification of next-generation wireless architectures. In this role, you bridge baseband signal processing and analog RF hardware, taking architectural and technical ownership of link performance, system behavior, and end-to-end functionality. 

Job Requirements

Must Have

- Experience: 12+ years of hands-on engineering experience in RF and physical layer (PHY) system design, analysis, or performance engineering for wireless communications. 
 - System & Performance Scope: Proven track record defining and executing system evaluations associated with RF, baseband, PHY, and modem performance. 
 - Programming & Data Analysis: Advanced proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for algorithm validation, data analysis, instrument automation, and custom test script development. 
 - RF Test & Measurement Expertise: Deep practical knowledge in operating high-frequency RF test equipment, including spectrum analyzers, signal generators, power meters, and vector network analyzers (VNAs). 
 - System Debugging Intuition: Exceptional deep-dive debugging skills capable of isolating issues across the boundaries of RF, digital hardware, and physical layer software. 
 - RF Principles: Solid understanding of RF chains and parameters, including Noise Figure (NF), third-order intercept point (IP3), return loss (RL), and receiver architectures (Superheterodyne / Zero-IF). 
 - Communication & Documentation: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with a proven ability to author technical system documents and specifications. 

Nice to have

- Digital Communications & Impairments: Practical knowledge of I/Q modulation (QAM, PSK), Digital Predistortion (DPD), Automatic Gain Control (AGC), and Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) characterization. 
 - Cross-Functional Interface: Experience acting as a technical bridge or focal point communicating directly with RFIC design, algorithm, software, and firmware teams. 
 - Engineering Mindset: Strong pragmatic problem-solving skills, broad system-level perspective, and a collaborative approach in multidisciplinary engineering environments.

data.title: Quality Engineering - Professional 3 (DEX & Horizon Interoperability)
data.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

Omnissa helps organisations deliver and manage secure digital workspaces. Horizon is our virtual desktop and application platform; our Digital Employee Experience (DEX) products give IT and employees visibility into the quality of that experience and provides monitoring and analytics across that stack. 

We are looking for a skilled Automation Engineer with 3 to 8 years of experience to own interoperability testing between DEX and Horizon along with second & third-party integrations. You will design and automate tests that span these products, catch integration issues before they reach customers, and keep that coverage current as Horizon, DEX, and Monitoring solutions evolve. 

This is a hands-on role. You will play a key role in developing scalable and efficient automation frameworks, driving automation strategy, and collaborating with developers and product teams working across. You will write Python test automation, own GitHub Actions and Jenkins pipelines, and partner with development teams across Horizon, DEX and other second and third-party integrations. As part of a modern engineering workflow, you will use AI-assisted tools to improve productivity in test development and debugging, while maintaining high standards for reliability, determinism, and long-term maintainability. 

Core Responsibilities

- Define and drive the automation testing approach for Horizon and DEX interoperability, aligned with product and program needs
 - Identify areas for automation and prioritise work based on risk, complexity, and business value
 - Design, build, and maintain automated interoperability, integration, and end-to-end tests across Horizon and DEX, primarily in Python
 - Plan and execute compatibility testing across current and previously supported product versions
 - Partner with feature teams from the design phase so new Horizon and DEX work is testable, and automated coverage is in place before it ships into the integrated stack
 - Build and maintain reusable, scalable test frameworks and shared libraries across supported platforms (Windows, Linux, and other supported clients)
 - Standardise processes, tools, and frameworks for automated testing, CI/CD, and quality gates
 - Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions and Jenkins), including pipeline templates, so component, integration, and end-to-end stages are automated, stable, and properly integrated
 - Implement and refine quality gates and reporting dashboards; track coverage, execution stability, and pipeline health
 - Implement and maintain scalable test infrastructure (on-premises, virtualised, and cloud) so environments stay stable, accessible, and usable for automated runs
 - Extend coverage across supported deployment platforms and real-world topologies, including hypervisors and gateway or proxy network paths
 - Work closely with developers so automation is integrated early and tests catch issues at unit, integration, functional, and UI levels where applicable
 - Review test suites for consistency, maintainability, and best practices; refactor scripts and optimise execution time as the suite grows
 - Investigate failures that span Horizon and DEX and drive them to root cause with engineering
 - Engage cross-functionally on end-to-end and interoperability scenarios to improve automation
 - Provide documentation and support so developers can understand and, where appropriate, self-manage test environments
 - Continuously evaluate new tools and technologies to improve automation efficiency and reliability
 - Leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate test scaffolding, mock generation, refactoring, and debugging, and apply engineering judgment to review, validate, and harden the output for reliability, security, and maintainability

Qualifications

Required

- 3 to 8 years of experience in test automation for enterprise and/or cloud-hosted platforms (or equivalent experience). 
 - Strong Python skills for test automation (frameworks such as pytest); additional languages (Java, Go, PowerShell) are useful. 
 - Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins (or equivalent: Azure DevOps, GitLab CI). 
 - Experience owning automated tests end to end - not only manual test execution. 
 - Experience with upgrade testing and backward compatibility (mixed-version environments, upgrade paths, agent/client coexistence). 
 - Experience testing cloud deployment and lifecycle scenarios (onboarding, configuration, upgrades), not only API-level functional tests. 
 - Hands-on experience using a major public cloud (Azure preferred) to create and tear down test environments. 
 - Ability to debug issues across multiple layers (on-premises components, cloud service, gateway/edge, network, endpoint) and communicate findings clearly in writing. 

Preferred

- Experience with Omnissa Horizon Suite of products or similar end user computing products/solutions. 
 - Experience with monitoring solutions or telemetry products. 
 - Familiarity working with Hypervisors and Cloud platforms (vSphere, Azure, AWS or other clouds). 
 - Infrastructure-as-code or environment automation (Terraform, Ansible, or similar). 
 - Experience extending an automation framework across new clouds or topologies rather than rewriting it each time.

data.description:
About MoEngage

MoEngage is an insights-led customer engagement platform trusted by 1, 350+ global consumer brands, including McAfee, Flipkart, Domino's, Nestle, Deutsche Telekom, and OYO. MoEngage combines data from multiple sources to help brands gain a 360-degree view of their customers. 

MoEngage Analytics arms marketers and product owners with insights into customer behavior. Brands can leverage MoEngage Personalize to orchestrate journeys and build 1: 1 conversations across the website, mobile, email, social, and messaging channels. MoEngage Inform, the transactional messaging infrastructure, helps unify promotional and transactional communication to a single platform for better insights and lower costs. MoEngage's AI Suite helps marketers develop winning copies and creatives, optimize campaigns and channels that boost engagement, and help with faster execution. 

For over a decade, consumer brands in 60+ countries have been using MoEngage to power digital experiences for over a billion monthly customers. With offices in 15 countries, MoEngage is backed by Goldman Sachs Asset Management, B Capital, Steadview Capital, Multiples Private Equity, Eight Roads, F-Prime Capital, Matrix Partners, Ventureast, and Helion Ventures. 

MoEngage was named a Contender in The Forrester WaveTM: Real-Time Interaction Management, Q1 2024 report, and Strong Performer in The Forrester WaveTM 2023 report. MoEngage was also featured as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Omni-Channel Marketing Platforms for B2C Enterprises 2023. 

About the Role: 

As a Lead Software Engineer, you are a strong systems thinker who can be hands-on with critical designs but primarily multiplies your impact by ensuring abstractions and standards stick across the organization. You will be at the forefront of integrating Generative AI into our core product, leading a micro-team to build scalable, resilient, and highly autonomous agentic workflows that solve real-world problems. 

Roles and Responsibilities: 

- System Design & Execution: Think big but execute with great focus. Adopt a milestone-based approach over "big bang" releases to ship high-impact features iteratively. 
 - Design for Scale & AI: Design and code with scale, high availability, and cost-efficiency in mind-carefully balancing traditional cloud compute costs with LLM latency and token economics. 
 - Agentic Orchestration: Own problem statements from end to end, building abstractions that allow LLM agents to plan, call tools, and complete complex tasks safely in production. 
 - Leadership & Mentorship: Lead a micro-team, driving the adoption of excellent tech processes, evaluation frameworks, and deployment tools. Mentor fellow colleagues and elevate the team's code quality through rigorous reviews. 
 - Tech Stack Agility: Remain open and adaptable to working across a polyglot tech stack, bridging the gap between standard backend systems and AI ecosystems. 

Requirements: 

Core Engineering & Tech Stack: 

- 6-8 years of proven experience building scalable distributed systems and RESTful Web Services. 
 - Languages: Expertise in the Java programming language and frameworks, alongside a strong familiarity with Python and its related frameworks. 
 - Data & Messaging: Hands-on experience with MongoDB, ElasticSearch, Scylla, Redis, and Kafka. 
 - Big Data & Analytics: Experience with data processing frameworks and query engines like Apache Spark or AWS Athena. 
 - Orchestration & Task Frameworks: Familiarity with workflow orchestration and task queue frameworks like Apache Airflow or Celery
 - Infrastructure: Familiarity with Linux environments and at least one major cloud computing infrastructure (GCP / Azure / AWS). 
 - Security: Strong awareness of Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) processes and Information Security best practices (including AI-specific security like mitigating prompt injection). 
 - Ownership: High accountability and a proven track record of taking total ownership of the modules and microservices you build. 

Agentic & AI Expertise: 

- Agentic Workflows: Proven track record of building and shipping agentic systems that do real work (multi-step planning, dynamic tool calling, autonomous task completion) in production environments. 
 - Tooling Protocols: Experience designing and managing a "tool-bus" or integrating with protocols like the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to safely and securely expose product skills to an LLM runtime. 
 - LLMOps & Evaluation: Mastery in setting up evaluation harnesses (golden sets, regressions), tracing tool failures, and strictly tracking LLM cost/latency under real-world traffic constraints. 
 - Model Tuning & Safety: Hands-on experience deciding when to fine-tune vs. prompt engineer, safely building domain training data, and monitoring tuned models in production for quality and safety regressions. 

At MoEngage, we respect and value differences. We believe that when people from diverse backgrounds and perspectives collaborate, we create the most value - for our clients, our employees, and society. We embrace diversity and uphold a strong set of values. We are committed to inclusivity and take pride in providing equal opportunities for success and growth. 

Employment at MoEngage is based solely on professional competence, skills, and experience. We stand firmly against all forms of discrimination and support equal rights and opportunities regardless of gender, ethnicity, abilities, age, identity, orientation or expression, marital status (including pregnancy), religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by law. 

It is our policy to comply with all applicable national, state, and local laws related to non-discrimination and equal opportunity. MoEngage is truly a place where everyone can bring their passions, authentic selves, and talents to work, collaborating to drive progress and solve meaningful challenges. 

Why Join Us!

At MoEngage, we are passionate about our team and technology - see below to know more about us. 

Life@MoEngage

Tech@MoEngage

Scale @MoEngage

We handle more than a billion messages every day. Rest assured, you will be surrounded by really smart and passionate people as we scale much more to build a world-class technology team.

data.description:
Director, Data Science & AI Engineering

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5, 000+ employees and 24, 000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we're transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection. 

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections. 

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we're committed to continuous learning and adaptation-AI isn't just a tool for us, it's part of our DNA. We're looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you'll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation. 

Throughout our interview process, you'll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you're excited to be part of a team that's leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we'd love to meet you. 

Disclaimer: Beware of Recruitment Scams - Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will always come from an official 'name@cvent. com' email. We never request any payments or ask for sensitive personal or financial information via chat or social media platforms. For more information, please visit: https: //www. cvent. com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud. 

About the Role: 

Cvent's AI Engineering & Data Science function is the engine that translates data into production intelligence - commercial models, agentic workflows, NLQ interfaces, and AI systems operating at scale across a B+ global SaaS business. We are hiring a Director to own it. 

This is an enterprise leadership role with a dual mandate: operational excellence and strategic thought leadership. You own the corporate AI portfolio end-to-end - delivery, architecture governance, cross-functional stakeholder relationships, and long-term direction. You lead the AI Centre of Excellence, shaping how Cvent thinks about, builds, and governs AI as a business-critical capability. 

The right person is a decisive, dynamic leader with 15+ years in AI and data science - operationally rigorous enough to run a complex multi-workstream function, and commercially credible enough to influence C-suite and board-level conversations. As comfortable in a strategy session as in an architecture review. 

In This Role, you will: 

Operations & Enterprise-Grade Delivery

- Run a multi-workstream AI and data science function with the discipline a $B+ enterprise demands - predictable delivery, zero stakeholder surprises, quality as the baseline. 
 - Bring deep domain expertise to GTM projects and corporate use cases across Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, Finance, and Tech/IT - ensuring AI/ML solutions are designed with the business context they will operate in, not just the data available. 
 - Partner actively with business leaders and function heads to shape the future AI agenda - co-developing roadmaps, surfacing high-leverage opportunities, and ensuring the team's work is connected to Cvent's most important growth and operational priorities. 
 - Own the operating model: delivery cadences, capacity management, cross-functional dependencies, intake and prioritization, and executive reporting. 
 - Set and enforce engineering standards across the portfolio: experiment tracking, model versioning, ML CI/CD, observability, and documentation - across internal teams and external partners. 

Corporate AI Portfolio Ownership

- Own Cvent's enterprise AI portfolio - spanning commercial AI, marketing intelligence, operational automation, financial governance, and agentic systems - accountable for roadmap, delivery, and measurable business outcomes. 
 - Set AI investment priorities at the corporate level: allocate capacity, sequence initiatives by strategic value, and make explicit trade-offs across competing demands in partnership with senior leadership. 
 - Govern the AI technology stac k: model registry, orchestration layer, observability infrastructure, and data contracts. All production systems meet enterprise-grade standards for reliability, explainability, and auditability. 

AI Centre of Excellence - Charter, Paved Road & Core Capability

- Define and evolve the AI CoE charter - establishing its mandate as an enterprise capability function focused on continuously improving the team's core AI and data science capabilities, strengthening data strategy, and raising the security posture of all AI systems in production. 
 - Define the paved road for AI - reusable patterns, approved tooling, and delivery standards that enable teams to build with speed and confidence while maintaining a reach-oriented posture: scanning the external AI landscape and updating guidance before the business asks for it. 
 - Translate the CoE's work into executive narratives for C-suite and board - connecting capability investment to business value and help position Cvent as an AI-native enterprise. 

People Leadership & Organizational Development

- Lead a team of Data scientists, and AI engineers - owning hiring, performance management, career architecture, and succession planning at Director level. 
 - Set a high-performance standard and hold it. Develop strong leaders within the team. Address under performance directly, constructively, and decisively. 
 - Build institutional resilience: reduce key-person dependency through structured knowledge transfer, role design, and a talent pipeline that scales with Cvent's AI ambitions. 

Executive Stakeholder Leadership

- Serve as Cvent's senior AI voice across Marketing, Sales, RevOps, CS, Product, Finance, and Technology - owning the relationship between AI capability and business demand at the most senior level. 
 - Engage C-suite and business function heads as a strategic partner: presenting portfolio outcomes, advising on competitive AI strategy, and translating the function's work into language that drives decisions. 
 - Communicate proactively on strategy, delivery status, risks, and results. Credibility is built on consistency of delivery and sharpness of insight. 

Here's What You Need: 

Experience

- 15+ years in AI/ML engineering, data science, or enterprise analytics - with a sustained Director-level track record owning large-scale, multi-workstream AI portfolios. 
 - Demonstrated experience building or leading an AI Centre of Excellence or enterprise-wide AI capability in a complex, global B2B or SaaS environment. 
 - Proven ability to engage C-suite and board-level stakeholders on AI strategy and investment - with the executive presence to influence without authority. 
 - Deep experience delivering commercial AI across GTM and corporate functions at enterprise scale: NLQ, personalization, propensity modelling, intelligent automation, and production-grade AI systems. 

Technical Depth

- Authoritative in LLM architecture, RAG/NLQ design, ML lifecycle governance, and enterprise AI observability. Engages as a peer with principal engineers on design decisions and platform trade-offs. 
 - Strong command of Snowflake, Databricks, and Python-based AI engineering. Understands how data architecture and security choices shape the reliability and scalability of AI systems downstream. 

Leadership Profile

- Operationally exceptional: runs complex, multi-team functions with clarity, discipline, and predictability at enterprise scale. 
 - Executive communicator: translates AI complexity into business value for C-suite audiences and business strategy into engineering direction for technical teams. Crisp, direct, proactive. 
 - Dynamic and high-conviction: shapes the agenda rather than responds to it, decides with incomplete information, holds the organization to a high standard of both ambition and execution. 
 - Reach-oriented thought leader: monitors the external AI landscape continuously, forms a point of view fast, and brings it into the organization before the business asks for it. 

What Success Looks Like (12-24 MONTHS)

- Enterprise-grade AI delivery across GTM and corporate functions - commercially impactful, architecturally sound, and trusted by senior leadership as a strategic asset.

Atlassians can choose where they work - whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. 

Responsibilities

As a Principal Engineer in Search Platform, you will serve as a technical leader driving the core indexing engines and enterprise-grade trust capabilities that power Atlassian Search and Rovo. 

You will lead the technical vision, architecture and delivery for planetary-scale data ingestion and indexing platforms while ensuring Search meets strict enterprise commitments across multi-cloud (GCP/AWS), isolated cloud, compliance, and encryption. 

Responsibilities

- Lead Enterprise Trust & Compliance: Own technical strategy and delivery for enterprise requirements - multi-cloud (GCP/AWS), Isolated Cloud, FedRAMP, BYOK encryption, and data residency - making Search a platform enterprises can trust. Proactively simplifying architecture and removing
 - Shape the Indexing Platform for AI-era Workloads: Evolve high-throughput, low-latency distributed indexing pipelines to meet the retrieval demands of agentic and AI use cases - freshness, context relevance, and scale across billions of events. 
 - Connect Across Teams and Systems: Work fluidly across ML, Data, Cloud Infrastructure, and product teams - aligning technical direction, unblocking dependencies, and building shared platform capabilities that multiply the impact of teams beyond your own. Help improve support for building and operating systems that deliver true Enterprise Trust through Atlassian-wide platforms, while actively simplifying the architecture and eliminating accumulated complexity. 
 - Drive System Efficiency at Scale: Improve ingestion throughput, data freshness, and reliability while optimizing for unit economics through smarter sharding, disaggregated storage, and compute efficiency. 
 - Capitalize on Agentic Development Advances: Stay ahead of the curve on retrieval architectures, vector/hybrid indexing, and agentic memory patterns - bringing external advances in to accelerate Atlassian's platform and product roadmap. 

Qualifications

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range. 

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity. 

Requirements

- Enterprise Platform Experience: 12+ years of demonstrated experience delivering enterprise-grade requirements - tenant isolation, multi-cloud deployments, compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, BYOK, data residency), and zero-downtime migrations at scale. 
 - Distributed Systems Depth: Proven experience designing and operating large-scale distributed data pipelines, search/indexing systems, or streaming platforms (e. g. , Kafka, Flink, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, object-store-backed indexing, vector search). 
 - Cross-functional Influence: Experience driving alignment and delivery across multiple teams and systems - someone who is just as effective collaborating and influencing as they are executing independently. 
 - Speed with Judgment: A track record of making fast, pragmatic trade-offs that deliver near-term value without accumulating long-term technical debt. 
 - Agentic & AI-Aware Engineering: Familiarity with systems that support AI agents and pragmatic approaches to integrate safe agentic engineering practices for building robust Enterprise grade systems.

To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them. 

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go. atlassian. com/crh .

data.title: Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer III
data.description:
Summary

Position Summary

Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer III

Role Overview: As an Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer III , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to the reliability, performance, and operational integrity of high-visibility products and platforms and the environments they run in. Your expertise will be pivotal in keeping production safe, performant, and cost-effective, while driving tangible value for Deloitte's engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship across cloud platform engineering, observability, and performance and reliability engineering-together with applied AI fluency that lets you reliably operate AI and agentic workloads alongside the rest of the portfolio-consistently demonstrating your strong track record in operating high-quality, resilient systems at scale. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to uphold production standards, safeguard environments, and admit systems into production with confidence. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for reliability, performance, and cost outcomes, measured in service-level objectives and error budgets, not raw uptime. Operate the products, platforms, and environments you support to meet their SLOs within budget, and track incident trends and toil to prioritize the work that most improves reliability-ensuring high-quality, lean operational designs that keep production safe and resilient. 
 - Serve as the technical advocate for production reliability and operability, ensuring systems are admissible, performant, safe to run, and able to degrade gracefully when failure occurs. Uphold production standards, lead the design of observability, performance and resilience testing, and operational tooling, and own the admission of systems into production-gating release on error budgets and automated reliability checks, and owning the readiness verification, environment integrity, and operational support that follow. 
 - Maintain accountability for the operational integrity of production and pre-production environments, and for the production standards that systems are admitted against. Own SLOs and error budgets; build and operate production observability-codified, version-controlled dashboards and SLO-driven, actionable alerting that detects before impact, plus the feedback loop into engineering; run performance, ambient-noise, and chaos testing to verify readiness; and guard environments against drift. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks-operating as an infrastructure-focused engineer, not a tool operator. Create technical specifications, runbooks, and shared playbooks; lead blameless postmortems that turn incidents into learning and systemic fixes; write high-quality, supportable automation to ensure all reliability KPIs (availability, performance, and cost) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams. 
 - Develop lean operational solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to meet the reliability needs of the engineering teams and the business. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery, co-defining service-level objectives and operational readiness so the right safeguards are in place at the right time, without becoming a bottleneck to delivery. 
 - Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, hardening reliability through incremental, measurable improvements-progressive resilience testing and SLO refinement-rather than big-bang interventions, and keeping operations supportable and maintainable. 
 - Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, platform engineering, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Uphold production standards and integrate their constraints so that the reliable, performant, and compliant path is the operative path. Co-define service-level objectives with the teams you support, verify readiness, and own the admission decision into production-holding the segregation-of-duties line as a dedicated, embedded function while partnering with security and risk on the control objectives you enforce. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation. 
 - Possess expertise in site reliability and modern production engineering-cloud platform ownership, observability (metrics, tracing, logging), performance and capacity engineering, chaos engineering, and cloud/AI cost engineering-together with applied AI fluency to operate AI and agentic workloads reliably, including AI and Agentic SSDLC, delivering production operations with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize reliability, performance, and operational delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning. 
 - Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the products and platforms you operate-and, where they are AI-infused, their distinct production failure modes such as drift, train/serve skew, latency and output variance, and token/GPU cost anomalies. Translate reliability needs, reference architectures, and operational requirements into service-level objectives, runbooks, and production tooling. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff. 
 - Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives. 
 - Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions. 

The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte's primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence. 

The successful candidate will possess: 

- Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care. 

Required Qualifications: 

- A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor. 
 - 5+ years of software engineering and site reliability engineering experience operating large-scale, distributed, cloud-native systems in production, with experience in most of the following: Python, Go, Bash, Java, C#/. NET, SQL/NoSQL, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, as well as CI/CD and observability stacks. 
 - 3+ years of experience in site reliability or production engineering for large-scale systems-defining and owning SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs; error budgets; incident command and on-call; building and operating production observability (metrics, tracing, logging-e. g. , OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Dynatrace, Amazon CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, SolarWinds, Splunk); environment integrity and drift prevention across pre-production and production; and segregation-of-duties controls (least-privilege/RBAC, deploy approvals, secrets management) in partnership with security and risk. 
 - 3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering and cloud platform ownership on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure-including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI-plus container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), infrastructure-as-code, networking, and multi-environment management. 
 - Prior experience operating AI/ML and agentic workloads in production-their reliability failure modes (drift, train/serve skew, output variance), MLOps/LLMOps, and the AI control plane (model/LLM gateway, guardrails) from the operability and performance side. 
 - Prior experience with load and performance testing under simulated production traffic (e. g. , LoadRunner, k6, or JMeter), chaos engineering (e. g. , Azure Chaos Studio, AWS Fault Injector), capacity planning, autoscaling, and cloud/AI cost engineering (FinOps tooling/dashboards, including GPU/inference and token cost attribution). 
 - Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development. 
 - Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e. g. LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi-agent orchestration tools) etc. to operate high-quality, resilient platforms and products at scale. 

Other: 

- Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build. 
 - Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India . 

Benefits To Help You Thrive

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Senior Software Engineer, Go, Python, AWS, & Cloud Services

Location: Hyderabad, India - Hybrid, three days per week at Nasuni's India Innovation Center

Nasuni is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and operate cloud services that support global file access, telemetry, analytics, and secure enterprise data workflows. You will join a global team that owns production services used by enterprise customers and develops new AWS capabilities. 

This role combines backend engineering, infrastructure as code, and production ownership. It is for an engineer who enjoys moving between Go development, AWS, Terraform, data pipelines, observability, and incident investigation. It is not a pure DevOps or ML research role; production ownership is essential. 

Level and Scope

You will independently design, implement, test, deploy, and operate complex features and service components within established platform architecture. You will make decisions about implementation, APIs, data flow, testing, observability, and deployment; identify risks early; and escalate broader architecture choices appropriately. The role is primarily hands-on and includes code reviews, technical guidance, and collaboration across Hyderabad and U. S. -based teams. 

What You'll Do

- Design and deliver production backend services and APIs in Go, with opportunities to contribute to Python services and automation. 
 - Build event-driven and serverless systems on AWS using services such as Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, Kinesis, IoT Core, S3, DynamoDB, IAM, and CloudWatch. 
 - Define secure, repeatable cloud infrastructure and deployments through Terraform. 
 - Build and improve telemetry, ingestion, and analytics pipelines, including time-series data flows. 
 - Own features from technical design through release, monitoring, and post-production follow-through. 
 - Investigate customer escalations and incidents across application, infrastructure, data, and network layers; drive root-cause analysis and preventive improvements. 
 - Improve CI/CD, observability, runbooks, and shared on-call practices.

data.title: Assistant Manager - Training & Quality (Merchant Onboarding & Customer Success)
data.description:
About Job: 

Own the quality and training engine for Merchant Onboarding (KYC, due diligence, activation) and Customer Success (email, ticket, voice). This is not audit administration - it's finding why errors happen, fixing the process or capability behind them, and proving the fix in next month's numbers. A hands-on role: run audits yourself, coach agents directly, and lead a small team of quality analysts and trainers. 

Key Responsibilities: 

● Quality & Governance: Own the audit cycle across both functions - sampling, calibration, QMS scorecards, RCAs on escalations and defects, and audit-the-auditor checks - plus the SOP library and its compliance with KYC/AML/PMLA and RBI guidelines, escalating systemic gaps to Risk & Compliance. 

● Training & Capability: Run the full learning lifecycle - induction, certification, refresher and remedial coaching - and build/maintain training content and the knowledge base; track effectiveness via pass rates, time-to-productivity, and pre-/post-training quality scores. 

● AI & Process Improvement: Identify automation opportunities (auto-QA, speech/text analytics, LLM-assisted drafting, agent-assist) and govern the quality of AI-assisted output; convert audit/RCA data into prioritised process and product fixes, running improvement projects end to end. 

● People & Stakeholders: Manage a team of quality analysts and trainers; partner with Ops, Risk, Compliance, Product and Engineering; represent quality findings in business reviews with evidence and a recommendation. 

What We're Looking For: 

● 4-6 years in quality, training or process excellence, including 1-2 years leading a team or workstream, ideally in merchant onboarding, KYC/AML and customer support (fintech, payments, banking, NBFC or marketplace). 

● Demonstrated ownership of a QMS/audit framework (scorecard design, weightage decisions) and working knowledge of KYC/AML and relevant regulatory expectations. 

● Strong data skills (advanced Excel/Sheets, dashboarding) and excellent written English, since you'll be auditing merchant-facing communication. 

● Structured problem-solving (RCA, five-whys, CAPA) and comfort holding a defensible, data-backed position. 

● Good to have: Six Sigma Green Belt or a training/facilitation certification; hands-on exposure to AI/automation in quality or support (auto-QA, conversation analytics, LLM agent-assist); familiarity with Freshdesk/JIRA/Salesforce and screening tools; SQL or BI tools; experience supporting internal or regulatory audits. 

Success Metrics: 

● Audit coverage and TAT held within defined SLAs across both functions. 

● Month-on-month reduction in error rate and fatal/zero-tolerance defects by parameter and process stage. 

● Training effectiveness: certification pass rate, time-to-productivity for new hires, and measurable pre- vs post-training quality-score uplift. 

● RCA-to-closure rate - corrective actions closed on time, with recurrence trending down. 

● Delivery of improvement projects with a documented, measurable delta in CSAT, TAT, first-contact-resolution or rejection rate. 

● Zero critical compliance/regulatory findings attributable to onboarding quality gaps.

data.description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world's most important health challenges. Together, we're improving health and improving lives. 

Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives. 

Labcorp is seeking a QA Engineer - Salesforce & Enterprise Applications to support quality assurance across Salesforce and integrated enterprise applications to join our team!

Work Schedule: This is an initial one-year contract position, and the role is assigned to a second-shift schedule. with standard business hours of Monday through Friday, 12. 30 PM IST - 9. 30 PM IST in your local time zone. Business needs may occasionally require flexibility in work hours, including earlier, later, or additional hours, with reasonable notice provided when possible. 

Job Responsibilities

- Analyze user stories, business requirements, solution designs, and acceptance criteria from a QA perspective to ensure requirements are complete, consistent, and testable. 
 - Identify requirement gaps, edge cases, dependencies, and quality risks early in the software development lifecycle and work with Business Analysts, Product Owners, and Developers to clarify expected behavior. 

Technical Oversight

- Develop and maintain test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test data, and test execution documentation. 
 - Perform rigorous functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, and negative testing for Salesforce applications and related enterprise systems. 
 - Test Salesforce functionality including business processes, Flows, validation rules, objects, fields, permissions, profiles, record types, and other configuration and customization. 
 - Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test cases using Copado Robotic Testing, with a focus on reusable and maintainable regression automation. 
 - Evaluate existing and new test cases to identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, regression coverage, and overall testing effectiveness. 
 - Test integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise applications, including APIs, middleware, scheduled processes, and inbound/outbound interfaces. 
 - Perform data migration and data validation testing, including field mapping, record counts, data completeness, accuracy, transformation, synchronization, and exception handling. 
 - Identify, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, severity, supporting evidence, and business impact; retest fixes and perform appropriate regression testing. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, and retrospectives, and provide QA estimates, status updates, and quality risks. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to continuously improve QA processes, test automation, regression coverage, defect prevention, and overall software quality. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 8 years or more experience as a Software Quality Assurance Engineer. 
 - 3 years or more experience testing Salesforce platform applications on Sales Cloud or Service Cloud. 
 - 2 years or more experience in Salesforce, Copado, or related QA/test automation certifications. 
 - 2 years or more experience performing functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, and negative testing. 
 - 2 years or more experience with test automation, preferably Copado Robotic Testing, or similar enterprise test automation tools. 
 - 2 years or more experience with data migration, data conversion, or large-scale data validation testing. 
 - 2 years or more experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- 1 year or more experience testing REST/SOAP APIs and integration platforms
 - 1 year or more experience with Jira, Salesforce DevOps processes, and version-control practices. 

Certifications

- Salesforce certifications. Professional certifications such as ISTQB, ASTQB, CSTE, CSQA, CQSE

Additional Job Standards

- Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with attention to detail. 
 - Strong experience analyzing user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria and translating them into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, defect-management, and communication skills. 
 - Strong command of the English language. Fluent in speaking and writing English. 
 - Ability to independently analyze requirements and identify quality risks before testing begins. 
 - Strong ownership of testing outcomes and commitment to delivering high-quality solutions. 
 - Ability to effectively balance comprehensive testing with Agile delivery timelines. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills across business and technical teams. 
 - Ability to continuously identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency, automation coverage, and quality processes. 

About The Role

- The QA Engineer will be responsible for analyzing requirements from a quality perspective, developing and executing comprehensive test scenarios, and building and maintaining automated tests using Copado Robotic Testing. The role requires strong Salesforce testing experience and the ability to test complex business processes involving integrations, data migration, and multiple enterprise systems.

Description

Job Title: MTS, Factory Board Test

Job Location: Bangalore, India (This position requires a full-time, on-site presence in our Bangalore, India Office)

Job ID: AI2503

About SiMa. ai: SiMa. aiTM is scaling Physical AI in Robotics, Automotive, Industrial, Aerospace and Defense, and Medical markets. We have created the industry's best purpose-built, software centric Physical AI HW/SW platform that leads the industry in Ease of use, performance, and power efficiency. SiMa. ai is led by technologists and business veterans backed by a set of top investors committed to helping customers bring ML on their platforms. SiMa. ai was founded in 2018, has raised $355M and is backed by Fidelity Management & Research Company, Maverick Capital, Point72, MSD Partners, VentureTech Alliance and more. For more information, visit https: //sima. ai/

Description: As MTS, Factory Board Test, you will be a key technical leader within the Engineering team responsible for defining and driving the board-level test strategy for SiMa's MLSoCTM platform and associated printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs). You will architect end-to-end test solutions spanning Design for Testability (DfT), In-Circuit Test (ICT), and functional board test, ensuring robust manufacturing quality and accelerating hardware bring-up. Your work will directly impact product quality, time-to-market, and the long-term testability of SiMa's embedded edge AI platforms. 

Areas Of Focus

Define, implement and maintain comprehensive PCB board test architectures for current functional test strategies. Develop automated test programs and fixtures, drive DfT guidelines with hardware design teams, and own test coverage analysis from prototype through high-volume manufacturing. Create a roadmap for ICT and DfT for higher volume manufacturing across multiple Contract Manufacturers (CMs). 

Key Responsibilities (including But Not Limited To)

- Board Test Architecture: Define and own the full board test strategy for complex, high-speed PCBAs, including selection and integration of ICT, flying-probe, and functional test methodologies where applicable. 
 - ICT & Flying-Probe Programs: Develop fixture and probe-card specifications in collaboration with test equipment vendors as needed to support future high volume manufacturing tests. 
 - DfT Collaboration: Partner with PCB layout and digital/analog hardware design teams early in the design cycle to embed testability features: test points, bed-of-nails access planning, and test pad placement rules. 
 - Functional Board Test: Architect, implement and maintain functional test sequences (FT) executed via bench instruments and/or custom test fixtures to validate power delivery networks, clock domains, memory interfaces, high-speed I/O (PCIe, USB, Ethernet, MIPI), and SoC boot. 
 - Test Fixture Design: Define electrical and mechanical requirements for bed-of-nails and/or custom functional test fixtures; work with fixture fabrication vendors through bring-up and qualification. 
 - Test Software Development: Develop and maintain test software in Python and/or C/C++ for automated test execution, data logging, and analysis; integrate with manufacturing execution systems (MES) and test data management platforms. 
 - Failure Analysis & Debug: Lead board-level failure analysis using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG debuggers, and network analyzers; produce detailed failure reports and drive root-cause and corrective action (RCCA) with hardware and layout teams. 
 - Test Coverage & Metrics: Define fault coverage targets, track test escapes, and continuously improve test coverage; produce yield and defect rate reports for manufacturing reviews. 
 - NPI & Sustaining Support: Drive test readiness from prototype (EVT/DVT/PVT) through mass production; support contract manufacturers (CMs) with test program transfers, training, and ongoing sustaining engineering. 

Required Background

- Education & Experience: BS/MS in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering with 15+ years of hardware engineering experience, including 7+ years dedicated to working with Contract Manufacturers, PCB board test development and architecture. 
 - Manufacturing Environment: Experience deploying and supporting test programs at contract manufacturers (CMs); knowledge of IPC standards (IPC-A-610, IPC-7711) and SMT/PCB assembly processes is a plus. 
 - Test Methodology Expertise: Hands-on experience with In-Circuit Test (ICT), flying-probe, and functional board test across complex, high-layer-count PCBAs. 
 - High-Speed Digital Interfaces: Strong understanding of high-speed interfaces (PCIe Gen 3/4/5, DDR4/5, USB 3. x, Ethernet, MIPI CSI-2/D-PHY) and their test challenges at the board level. 
 - Power Integrity & Signal Integrity: Experience testing and validating power delivery networks (PDN) and high-speed signal integrity on complex SoC-based boards. 
 - DfT Skills: Demonstrated ability to drive DfT guidelines into PCB designs early in the design cycle
 - Test Software: Proficiency in Python (preferred) and/or C/C++ for automated test scripting, instrument control (SCPI/VISA), data analysis, and integration with MES/TDM systems. 
 - Lab Instrumentation: Hands-on skill with bench instruments including oscilloscopes, signal/spectrum analyzers, power supplies, DMMs, logic analyzers, and JTAG debug probes. 
 - Test Equipment Proficiency: Practical experience programming and maintaining ATE platforms such as Teradyne TestStation/ICT, Keysight (Agilent) 3070, GenRad, or equivalent is a plus. 

Personal Attributes

Can-do attitude. Strong team player who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment. Curious, creative, and systematic in solving complex hardware problems. Execution and results-oriented with a strong sense of ownership across the full test lifecycle. Self-driven, thinks strategically about long-term testability, and is highly accountable. Excellent communication skills with the ability to work across hardware, software, and manufacturing teams.
