data.description:
Job Description - Proto/Pilot Senior Manager (Mechanical & Electrical) - BESS

Role Summary

The Proto/Pilot Senior Manager - Mechanical & Electrical (BESS) will lead prototype development, pilot production, mechanical and electrical integration, validation support, and manufacturing readiness for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) products at a 5 GWh / 6. 25 GWh manufacturing facility. 

The role will act as a critical bridge between Engineering, Validation, Quality, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing to ensure successful transition from prototype development to pilot production and scalable mass manufacturing. 

Key Job Responsibilities

Prototype & Pilot Build Leadership

- Lead end-to-end prototype and pilot build activities for BESS products. 
 - Manage engineering builds, design validation builds, pre-production builds, and pilot production builds. 
 - Develop and execute prototype build plans, schedules, resource requirements, and milestones. 
 - Drive rapid problem-solving and design iterations during prototype and pilot stages. 
 - Ensure prototype builds are completed within defined timelines, quality, safety, and cost targets. 
 - Lead teams of engineers, technicians, and manufacturing personnel involved in prototype and pilot builds. Mechanical Prototype & System Integration

- Lead mechanical integration of battery modules, packs, racks, enclosures, and containerized BESS systems. 
 - Oversee assembly of structural frames, battery housings, cooling systems, mechanical interfaces, and related components. 
 - Identify and resolve mechanical fitment, tolerance, interference, fastening, sealing, and structural issues. 
 - Ensure proper mechanical integration across the complete BESS architecture. 
 - Support thermal and cooling system integration, including interfaces between mechanical and thermal components. 
 - Drive Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) improvements. 
 - Work with mechanical design teams to incorporate prototype and pilot build learnings into future product revisions. 
 - Support tooling, fixture, jig, and assembly process development for mechanical manufacturing. Electrical Prototype & System Integration

- Lead electrical prototype and pilot builds for battery modules, packs, racks, and complete BESS systems. 
 - Oversee integration of high-voltage and low-voltage electrical systems. 
 - Manage assembly and integration of busbars, cables, connectors, contactors, fuses, relays, sensors, and wiring harnesses. 
 - Ensure proper electrical integration from Cell → Module → Pack → Rack → System → Container. 
 - Coordinate BMS, communication, control, auxiliary power, grounding, and bonding interfaces. 
 - Support integration with power electronics and external system interfaces. 
 - Identify and resolve electrical interconnect, wiring, insulation, grounding, communication, and BMS-related issues. 
 - Ensure compliance with electrical safety and HV assembly requirements. 
 - Support development of electrical work instructions, assembly standards, inspection criteria, and testing procedures. Pilot Production Management

- Lead pilot-scale manufacturing activities and ensure pilot line readiness. 
 - Develop and optimize assembly sequences and production processes. 
 - Support pilot line setup, station design, material flow, and operator readiness. 
 - Develop standard work instructions and operating procedures. 
 - Drive cycle time reduction and throughput improvement. 
 - Support line balancing and manpower optimization. 
 - Improve first-pass yield and reduce scrap, rework, and process variation. 
 - Identify manufacturing bottlenecks and implement corrective actions. 
 - Ensure pilot processes are stable and repeatable before mass production transfer. 
 - Support production ramp-up for the 5 GWh / 6. 25 GWh BESS manufacturing facility. Issue Resolution & Root Cause Analysis

- Lead troubleshooting of prototype, pilot, mechanical, electrical, thermal, and manufacturing issues. 
 - Investigate failures related to mechanical fitment, electrical connections, thermal performance, assembly quality, and process variation. 
 - Conduct structured root cause analysis using tools such as: 
 - 5 Why Analysis
 - Fishbone Diagram
 - 8D Problem Solving
 - FMEA
 - Drive corrective and preventive actions with Engineering, Quality, and Manufacturing teams. 
 - Track critical issues until permanent resolution and closure. 
 - Develop lessons learned from prototype and pilot builds. Validation & Design Improvement

- Work closely with validation and reliability teams during prototype and pilot testing. 
 - Support functional, performance, safety, and reliability validation. 
 - Coordinate mechanical, electrical, thermal, and system-level validation activities. 
 - Support electrical safety testing, insulation resistance, continuity, grounding, and BMS functionality testing. 
 - Support mechanical durability, vibration, structural, and thermal performance assessments. 
 - Analyze validation failures and provide manufacturing and engineering feedback. 
 - Ensure prototype learnings are incorporated into product design improvements. 
 - Support engineering changes and product design releases. Manufacturing Process Development

- Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering to develop scalable assembly processes. 
 - Support development of tooling, fixtures, jigs, and error-proofing solutions. 
 - Establish process controls and quality checkpoints. 
 - Develop manufacturing work instructions and standard operating procedures. 
 - Improve assembly ergonomics, material presentation, and workstation efficiency. 
 - Support automation and semi-automation opportunities where applicable. 
 - Ensure prototype and pilot processes are suitable for high-volume manufacturing. 
 - Drive improvements in yield, cycle time, productivity, and manufacturing efficiency. Cross-Functional Coordination

- Work closely with Mechanical Design Engineering. 
 - Coordinate with Electrical and HV/LV Engineering teams. 
 - Partner with BMS and Controls Engineering teams. 
 - Collaborate with Thermal Management Engineering. 
 - Interface with Testing, Validation, Quality, and Reliability teams. 
 - Coordinate with Manufacturing Engineering and Operations. 
 - Work with Supply Chain and Sourcing for prototype and pilot material availability. 
 - Support supplier issue resolution and component quality improvement. 
 - Participate in cross-functional design reviews and manufacturing readiness reviews. Team & Program Management

- Lead and mentor prototype and pilot engineers, technicians, and build teams. 
 - Manage multiple prototype and pilot programs simultaneously. 
 - Develop build schedules and resource plans. 
 - Track program milestones, deliverables, and technical risks. 
 - Ensure effective communication between engineering and manufacturing functions. 
 - Escalate critical program, technical, quality, and manufacturing risks. 
 - Drive a strong culture of safety, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement. Required Qualifications

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in: 
 - Mechanical Engineering
 - Electrical Engineering
 - Electronics Engineering
 - Mechatronics Engineering
 - Manufacturing Engineering
 - Energy Systems
 - Related Engineering DisciplineExperience

- 8-15+ years of relevant experience in BESS, lithium-ion batteries, EV, automotive, power electronics, renewable energy, or advanced manufacturing. 
 - Strong experience in prototype and pilot build management. 
 - Experience in battery pack, battery rack, or complete BESS system integration.

With over 30 years of experience, the company delivers Sandwich PUF/PIR/Rockwool Panels, uPVC Roofing Sheets, Self-Drilling Screws, Polycarbonate Sheets, and Pre-Engineered Buildings under one roof. The company serves sectors such as warehousing, manufacturing, logistics, pharmaceuticals, food processing, cold storage, clean rooms, infrastructure, renewable energy, and commercial construction. Role Description The Telesales Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Pune City, responsible for leading and optimizing the telesales function. This role involves managing a team of telesales representatives, setting daily and weekly targets, monitoring performance, and ensuring consistent achievement of sales goals. The Telesales Manager will oversee calling campaigns, build and maintain customer pipelines, follow up on leads, and drive conversions for Mount's products and solutions. data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

About Baxter

Baxter provides a broad portfolio of essential renal and hospital products, including home, acute and in-center dialysis; sterile IV solutions; infusion systems and devices; parenteral nutrition; surgery products and anesthetics; and pharmacy automation, software and services. The company's global footprint and the critical nature of its products and services play a key role in expanding access to healthcare in emerging and developed countries. Baxter's employees worldwide

are building upon the company's rich heritage of medical breakthroughs to advance the next generation of healthcare innovations that enable patient care. 

Job Summary

- Job Title - Principal Eng, Test
 - Location - Whitefield, Bangalore

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

- Lead the verification team to understand fully the design specification; design a verification environment and interact with design engineers to identify important verification scenarios. 
 - Lead the development of tests and the creation of top-level and block-level test-benches, stimulus and coverage metrics. 
 - Coordinate the debug process of failing test cases along with the design team. 
 - Ensure delivery of verified design blocks for sign-off, meeting defined functionality, performance and coverage requirements. Drive improvements in test execution, quality and delivery. 
 - Lead the development and documentation of product test case. 
 - Identifying Testing Risks and own the Risk Mitigation Plans. 
 - Work within Agile team to deliver quality products as one team
 - Guide the team on proper verification approach
 - Assist/guide in authoring, reviewing and execution of verification test cases
 - Provide input to Trace Matrix to ensure the traceability of the requirements to tests is intact
 - Co-ordinate the verification activities during SDLC
 - Compile Verification Test Summary Report at conclusion of formal verification phase for submission

Qualifications

- Ability to lead small to medium sized team technically and raising his/her own performance and others from time to time
 - A demonstrated track record in regulated software development, preferably medical devices or other highly regulated products such as aviation software. 
 - Experience in executing verification strategies including and not limited to functional, non-functional, reliability, performance. 
 - Experience in re-defining test architecture and test automation frameworks
 - Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development process
 - Experienced and demonstrated superior global collaboration
 - Demonstrates spirit of innovation
 - Demonstrated risk taking ability and challenging status quo

Desired Characteristics

- Hand's on experience on defining the test strategy and test architecture for software applications
 - Minimum 3+ years practical software QA experience (
 - Excellent planning and organization skills, and committed to delivering on aggressive deadlines
 - Expertise in ALM and JIRA tool
 - Knowledge of Clear Quest, Team Center is preferred
 - Strong communication skills - written & verbal
 - Strong interpersonal skills with ability to work in a collaborative environment as well as independently with minimal supervision
 - Experience in Test Automation with Selenium is preferred
 - Knowledge of medical device software development is highly preferred including knowledge of standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 14971

Background And/or Experience

Bachelors / Masters in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering or related field and 10+ years of related experience.

data.title: Principal Engineer, Test Automation
data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

We are seeking a Principal Automation Engineer with 10+ years of experience defining automation architecture, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards for API, UI, integration, and end-to-end testing. The ideal candidate is a systems-oriented Quality Engineer who understands how products and services interconnect, sees the broader product architecture, and can decompose requirements to capture use cases holistically. This hands-on role will lead the development of scalable C#/. NET frameworks, establish CI/CD quality gates, guide cross-team adoption, and resolve complex automation and testability challenges across distributed products. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the enterprise-grade automation architecture and roadmap for C#-based REST API, UI, integration, and workflow testing. 
 - Design modular frameworks with reusable libraries for configuration, service clients, page or component objects, test data, parallel execution, retries, logging, reporting, and environment management. 
 - Define coding standards, branching and review practices, framework governance, versioning, documentation, and contribution models. 
 - Establish pipeline strategy for pull-request validation, daily smoke tests, staged regression, release qualification, and automated quality gates. 
 - Guide teams on automation suitability, testability, coverage modelling, risk-based selection, and reduction of flaky or low-value tests. 
 - Lead technical reviews, proofs of concept, framework migrations, tool evaluations, and resolution of complex cross-service failures. 
 - Define dashboards and metrics for coverage, reliability, execution time, defect containment, failure causes, and productivity gains. 
 - Partner with architecture, software, DevOps, cybersecurity, systems, and verification leaders to embed quality throughout delivery. 
 - Mentor automation engineers and build engineering capability through reusable assets, coaching, and technical communities of practice. 

Required Skills And Qualifications

- Mandatory: Systems-oriented Quality Engineer with a strong understanding of how products, services, and components interconnect; able to see the broader product architecture and decompose requirements to capture use cases holistically. 
 - Mandatory: Hands-on Automation Architect with advanced C# and . NET skills and a strong understanding of software design principles, dependency injection, concurrency, asynchronous execution, and extensible architecture. 
 - Mandatory: Hands-on experience architecting and developing REST API automation frameworks using RestSharp. 
 - Mandatory: Strong hands-on experience with NUnit or Selenium or playwright for test automation. 
 - Mandatory: Working knowledge of GraphQL (GQL) and experience validating GraphQL APIs. 
 - Mandatory: Solid understanding of test data management principles, strategies, and reusable data provisioning approaches. 
 - Mandatory: Strong awareness of Kubernetes and containerized test environments. 
 - Good understanding of communication protocols, particularly SIP, and hands-on exposure to SIPp for protocol-level testing. 
 - Expertise in API contracts, distributed systems, microservices, event-driven integrations, databases, authentication, authorization, and service virtualization. 
 - Deep experience with Git, CI/CD architecture, parallel execution, automated reporting, and quality gates. 
 - Proven ability to improve framework reliability, diagnose flaky tests, optimize execution, and drive adoption across multiple teams. 
 - Strong technical leadership, stakeholder communication, mentoring, and architecture decision-making skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with Allure reporting is preferred. 
 - Experience with Postman is good to have. 
 - Experience with Azure, Docker, infrastructure-as-code, message brokers, observability platforms, and cloud-native test environments. 
 - Experience validating healthcare platforms, HL7/FHIR integrations, connected devices, or regulated software products. 
 - Knowledge of security, accessibility, performance, reliability, and resilience testing within a unified automation strategy. 
 - Relevant Microsoft, cloud, architecture, or testing certification is advantageous. 
 - Knowledge of SIP infrastructure and media components such as Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, SBCs, registrars, RTP, and WebRTC. 
 - Experience with Azure Key Vault, Azure App Configuration, Azure Cache for Redis, Azure Web PubSub, Terraform, KEDA, and container security tooling.

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer - JL5
data.description:
Roles and Responsibilities: 

- Design and implement the lifecycle of services from conception to inception, including system design, build, and deployment
 - Develop software solutions to enable operability of large-scale distributed systems capable of handling millions of transactions and petabytes of data
 - Manage capacity and performance to help scale the infrastructure both on public and private clouds around the world
 - Define and implement standards and best practices related to: System Architecture, Deployment, metrics, operational tasks
 - Support services through activities such as monitoring availability, system health, and incident response
 - Improve system performance, application delivery and efficiency through automation, process refinement, postmortem reviews, and in-depth configuration analysis
 - Engage in Communications across all areas of the organization
 - Troubleshooting and monitoring production systems to ensure the highest uptimes are maintained
 - Support and improve upon existing high-availability architecture solutions as well as manage the operational activity. 
 - Integrate Generative AI (GenAI) and AIOps tools to automate incident detection, root cause analysis, and resolution workflows (e. g. , self-healing scripts, intelligent runbooks), reducing manual toil and accelerating response times. 
 - Apply Prompt Engineering techniques to enhance interactions with AI-based observability and automation platforms improving accuracy and efficiency of AI responses. 
 - Leverage platform-specific AI capabilities (e. g. , AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI) to architect intelligent SRE solutions tailored to cloud environments. 
 - Design, implement, and maintain AI/ML driven monitoring and alerting systems to proactively detect anomalies and predict potential failures, enabling preemptive remediation. 
 - Develop and train machine learning models using operational telemetry (logs, metrics, events, traces) to support predictive analytics and intelligent automation. 
 - Evaluate and deploy AIOps platforms (e. g. , Moogsoft, Dynatrace, Splunk, BigPanda, Datadog, Elastic) to enhance observability, reduce noise, and accelerate incident resolution. 
 - Experience in one or more high level programming languages like Python or Ruby or GoLang and familiar with Object Oriented Programming.

data.title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
data.description:
About KontexIQ

KontexIQ is an AI-powered software delivery intelligence platform that helps teams understand and use the context already present across their software projects. 

KontexIQ connects information such as requirements, acceptance criteria, dependencies, bugs, test coverage, discussions, and delivery history to help teams identify gaps earlier, understand quality risks, and make more informed testing decisions. 

We are building AI-powered workflows for software delivery teams, and we're looking for a Test Automation Engineer who is excited about combining strong automation engineering practices with emerging AI-assisted testing capabilities. 

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Test Automation Engineer to design, build, and maintain reliable automation frameworks and quality engineering workflows. 

You will work across UI and API automation, test framework development, integration testing, regression testing, and CI/CD. You will also contribute to how project context can be used to identify testing gaps, generate meaningful test scenarios, and improve software quality. 

This role is suited for someone who goes beyond simply executing test cases and enjoys building automation frameworks, testing standards, and scalable quality engineering practices. 

What You'll Do

Design, develop, and maintain scalable UI and API test automation frameworks. 

Build automated test scenarios for web applications and REST APIs. 

Develop reusable automation components, utilities, and test libraries. 

Define and improve automation standards, best practices, and quality engineering processes. 

Create and maintain automated regression, integration, and functional test suites. 

Collaborate with developers, product managers, architects, and QA engineers throughout the software development lifecycle. 

Analyze requirements and acceptance criteria to identify potential gaps, ambiguities, dependencies, and quality risks. 

Validate application functionality across UI, APIs, integrations, and backend processes. 

Investigate automation failures and improve test reliability and maintainability. 

Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 

Contribute to test strategies, automation roadmaps, and quality standards. 

Participate in proof-of-concept initiatives involving modern testing approaches and AI-assisted quality engineering. 

Evaluate AI-generated test scenarios and identify opportunities to improve their accuracy, relevance, and coverage. 

Help establish processes for connecting project context with testing and quality decisions. 

What You'll Bring

2+ years of professional experience in software testing or test automation. 

Strong programming experience with TypeScript. 

Hands-on experience developing and maintaining UI automation frameworks. 

Strong experience with API automation testing. 

Experience with Java and API testing frameworks such as Rest Assured. 

Experience testing modern web applications. 

Strong understanding of REST APIs, integration testing, and backend validation. 

Experience designing automation frameworks and reusable testing components. 

Experience defining test strategies, automation approaches, or quality standards. 

Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. 

Experience working in Agile software development environments. 

Strong debugging and problem-solving skills. 

Ability to understand requirements and identify potential testing gaps and risks. 

Strong communication and collaboration skills. 

Good to Have

Experience with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar automation frameworks. 

Experience with Azure DevOps or Jira. 

Experience working on large-scale application migration or modernization projects. 

Experience with specification-driven or behavior-driven development approaches. 

Exposure to backend processing or batch-processing systems. 

Experience with test data management and environment management. 

Exposure to AI-assisted testing, LLMs, RAG, or AI agents. 

Experience evaluating AI-generated test cases or test scenarios. 

Experience with cloud platforms, containers, or modern DevOps tooling. 

Experience building evaluation frameworks for AI-powered applications. 

Why KontexIQ

At KontexIQ, you'll work on more than traditional test automation. 

Our platform uses project context - including requirements, dependencies, existing tests, bugs, and delivery history - to help teams understand what needs to be tested, where the risks are, and what may be missing. 

You'll have the opportunity to combine your expertise in test automation and quality engineering with emerging AI technologies to solve practical problems in software delivery. 

How We Work

Context over assumptions: We use the information already available in the project to make better decisions. 

Evidence-driven: AI recommendations should be supported by relevant project evidence. 

Engineering-first: We care about reliable, maintainable systems-not just prototypes. 

Continuous experimentation: We test, evaluate, learn, and improve. 

Ownership: We expect engineers to take responsibility for the problems they work on and the systems they build. 

Candidate Familiarization

Please visit the KontexIQ website and explore our product before applying. Familiarizing yourself with KontexIQ is a mandatory part of the application process, as we want candidates to understand the product, the problem we're solving, and the type of AI-powered software delivery systems you'll be working on. 

How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief description of your experience with UI/API automation, automation framework development, and software quality engineering

Rowe Price, Adobe, Amazon, Visa and Zoom, are using the Responsive platform to manage business critical responses - including bids, questionnaires, assessments, and trust centers - that impact nearly half of a company's revenue.

Customers have used Responsive to close more than $750B in transactions to-date. 

To learn more, visit responsive. io. 

About The Role

Responsive is looking for a Technical Lead who combines strong technical expertise with leadership skills to drive complex projects and mentor a team of engineers. 

In this role, you will take ownership of architecting scalable solutions, optimizing system performance, and ensuring engineering excellence. 

You will play a crucial role in guiding technical decisions, fostering innovation, and contributing to the growth of a top-tier SaaS company in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. 

We welcome candidates who thrive on ownership and accountability, and are driven to deliver results and make a meaningful impact. 

Essential Functions

- Technical Leadership & Mentorship : Guide a team of engineers, provide technical direction, and establish best practices to drive high-quality software development. 
 - Solution Architecture & Design : Own the architecture and design of complex, distributed systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance.

 - Performance Optimization : Identify and resolve system bottlenecks, ensuring efficient resource utilization and low-latency responses.

 - Continuous Innovation : Stay updated with emerging technologies, evaluate new tools/frameworks, and drive adoption where beneficial. 

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 

Experience

8+ years of experience in software development, including designing and building large-scale distributed systems. 

Knowledge & Skills

- Strong expertise in Java programming, Java design patterns, and high-performance backend development. 
 - Proficiency in React for frontend development, with experience in state management (Redux, React Query, or Context API). 
 - Proven experience in designing and implementing scalable, fault-tolerant architectures. 
 - Proficiency in multiple technologies such as Spring Boot, React, MongoDB, etc. 
 - Experience leading and mentoring engineering teams, conducting code reviews, and setting technical standards. 
 - Deep understanding of cloud-native architecture, with hands-on experience in platforms like GCP, Azure, or AWS.

 - Proficiency in Test Driven Development (TDD) and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills, with experience handling production-level challenges, performance tuning, and system optimization.

data.title: Senior Lead UAV Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Marut Drones is seeking an experienced Senior Lead UAV Engineer to lead the design, development, integration, testing, and deployment of advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) systems. The role involves leading a team of UAV engineers, driving R&D and product innovation, and ensuring the technical performance, safety, reliability, and scalability of drone systems throughout the product lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in the UAV/Drone industry, along with proven expertise in UAV system architecture, flight controls, avionics, propulsion, system integration, testing, and technical leadership. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead UAV Development: Lead the design, development, and integration of UAV systems and subsystems, ensuring performance, safety, reliability, and scalability. Provide technical direction across propulsion, flight control, power, avionics, communication, and payload systems. 
 - Team Leadership: Lead, manage, and mentor a team of UAV engineers. Provide technical guidance, establish engineering best practices, review designs, and foster a collaborative and high-performance engineering environment. 
 - UAV System Integration: Oversee the integration of mechanical, electrical, avionics, software, propulsion, power, communication, flight-control, and payload systems to develop fully functional UAV platforms. 
 - R&D and Innovation: Drive UAV R&D and product innovation by evaluating emerging technologies, developing new features, improving existing systems, and identifying opportunities to enhance UAV performance and capabilities. 
 - Testing and Validation: Lead UAV system testing, ground testing, flight testing, validation, and performance evaluation. Identify technical issues, conduct failure analysis, and implement corrective actions. 
 - Design Optimization: Continuously evaluate and optimize UAV designs to improve flight performance, payload capacity, endurance, reliability, efficiency, and overall system performance using engineering analysis and simulation tools. 
 - Quality, Safety & Compliance: Ensure UAV designs and systems meet applicable safety, quality, regulatory, and certification requirements. Participate in design reviews, technical audits, risk assessments, and safety evaluations. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with R&D, manufacturing, production, testing, operations, sales, and other cross-functional teams to ensure UAV products meet technical, production, customer, and business requirements. 
 - Product Lifecycle Management: Oversee engineering activities throughout the product lifecycle, from concept development and prototyping to testing, validation, production, deployment, and continuous improvement. 
 - Technical Documentation & Reporting: Maintain technical documentation including design specifications, engineering reports, test plans, test results, design reviews, and failure analysis reports. Present technical updates and recommendations to senior management. 

Mandatory Skills & Experience

- Mandatory UAV/Drone Industry Experience: 7+ years of professional experience specifically in the UAV/Drone industry, with hands-on experience in UAV design, development, system integration, testing, and deployment. 
 - UAV Design & Development: Strong experience designing and developing multirotor, fixed-wing, or hybrid UAV systems. 
 - UAV System Integration: Proven experience integrating mechanical, electrical, avionics, propulsion, power, communication, flight-control, navigation, and payload systems. 
 - Flight Control & Dynamics: Strong understanding of UAV flight dynamics, stability, navigation, flight-control systems, and autopilot systems. 
 - Avionics & UAV Components: Strong knowledge of flight controllers, motors, ESCs, batteries, GPS/GNSS, sensors, telemetry, communication systems, and other UAV components. 
 - Hardware & Software Integration: Hands-on experience integrating UAV hardware with flight-control software, firmware, sensors, and onboard systems. 
 - Flight Testing & Validation: Practical experience in UAV flight testing, system validation, performance evaluation, troubleshooting, and failure analysis. 
 - R&D and Product Development: Proven experience taking UAV products from concept and prototyping through testing, validation, and deployment. 
 - Technical Leadership: Minimum 2 years of experience leading UAV engineering teams or technical projects, with the ability to mentor engineers and provide technical direction. 
 - Regulatory & Safety Compliance: Working knowledge of applicable UAV regulations, safety standards, certification requirements, and compliance processes. 
 - Engineering & Simulation Tools: Experience with relevant UAV engineering tools such as CAD, MATLAB/Simulink, simulation, analysis, CAM, and PLM tools. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline. 
 - 4- 6 years of professional experience in the UAV/drone industry is mandatory. 
 - 2+ years of experience in a technical leadership role within UAV/Drone engineering is mandatory. 
 - Proven track record of designing, developing, integrating, testing, and deploying UAV systems. 
 - Strong hands-on experience across UAV hardware, avionics, flight control, propulsion, power, navigation, communication, and payload systems. 
 - Experience working with cross-functional teams including R&D, manufacturing, testing, production, and operations. 
 - Experience with UAV regulatory compliance, certification, quality assurance, and safety processes is highly preferred. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with agricultural, industrial, commercial, or other application-specific UAV platforms. 
 - Experience with UAV autopilot platforms and flight-control systems. 
 - Experience with MATLAB/Simulink or other UAV simulation and modelling tools. 
 - Experience with UAV certification and regulatory processes. 
 - Experience with product development, prototyping, and design-for-manufacturing. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and technical communication skills. 

Compensation

Competitive compensation, open to discussion based on experience, technical expertise, and role fit.

data.title: Engineering Manager - Software
data.description:
Quin | About the Company

Quin is a safety-technology company. Our technology ships inside products from leading global brands across motorcycling, cycling, sport and industrial PPE. We are becoming the primary source of real-world crash data across every protective gear category, and we build the data tools that manufacturers and testing bodies use to engineer safer products and standards. Our engineering and product centre is in Hyderabad, with helmet testing labs in Hyderabad and London, and teams across India, the UK and the US. 

Why this role exists

Our software team builds the apps, cloud services and web tools that turn sensor data from a helmet into a crash alert, a simple NFC tag into a data operations platform for global brands and more. The team has shipped a lot, fast. We are looking to strengthen this team with a leader who will make it consistently excellent: stronger engineers, higher standards and processes that deliver outcomes end to end. 

You will lead the people and the work. You will hire, grow and hold the bar for every software engineer at Quin, and stay hands-on and close to the code. 

What You'll Own

People and performance

- Lead the software team day to day
 - Grow engineers. 
 - Build a culture where everyone owns their work from start to finish, where problem-solving is an obsession, and people and achievements are celebrated. 

Hiring

- Own software hiring with senior leadership: plan the roles, run the technical assessments and make the call. 
 - Raise the bar with every hire. 

Engineering quality

- Set and enforce standards for code review, testing, CI/CD and documentation across mobile, backend and web. 
 - Improve quality aggressively. Move the team from manual testing at the end towards automated testing built in from the start. 
 - Remove single points of failure. Every critical system has a second owner and documentation that someone else can use. 

Hands-on engineering

- Review code and designs every week. Know the codebase well enough to spot risk early. 
 - Step in on hard problems: debug a production issue, unblock a stuck feature, or pair with an engineer on a tricky design. 

Working across Quin

- Work with the TPM on realistic estimates and capacity, so delivery dates are consistently hit. 
 - Work with Product and Design on requirements, playing a key role on what & why, not just how. 
 - Work with the Embedded / Platform Lead where app and cloud meet firmware and BLE. 

Who You Are

- You're a builder of people. 
 - You have grit. 
 - You're optimistic and honest. 
 - You know and can communicate the why. 
 - You're still an engineer. (eg You review code every week and would rather work on a hard bug than write a status report. )
 - You're present. (eg You lead from the floor in Hyderabad, and your team always knows where to find you. )

This role isn't for you if you want to stop being hands-on, you measure success by headcount, or you need a settled, process-heavy environment to do your best work. 

Must-haves

- 7+ years in software engineering, with 3+ years managing engineers directly in a product company. 
 - Strong hands-on background in at least one of: mobile (iOS or Android), backend/cloud, or web. Working knowledge of the others. 
 - A track record of growing engineers, with people you can name who moved up under your leadership. 
 - Experience introducing engineering standards from an early stage: code review, automated testing, CI/CD and documentation. 
 - Hiring experience: you have designed technical assessments and built a team. 
 - Clear, direct written and spoken communication skills without depending on AI polish. You can explain a technical decision to an engineer, a product manager and/or a client. 
 - You use AI tools heavily in your own work and know how to make a team faster with them, but you could do the job without it. 

Strong pluses

- Apps that work with connected hardware: BLE, IoT, wearables or automotive. 
 - Real-time or safety-critical systems, where a missed event matters. 
 - Data-heavy products: streaming sensor data, analytics or ML pipelines. 
 - Moving a team from manual QA to automated testing. 
 - Platforms serving enterprise customers with security and compliance needs (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR). 

How We Work

We are a small team of senior doers who move fast with excellence. Our managers lead by example, not by layers. You will have real ownership of your team and its standards, with very little bureaucracy, and we expect you to use it. 

Our hiring process & AI use

Use AI tools freely on any exercise. The only rule: declare what you used and be ready to defend every decision live. The recruitment process will involve at least 2 interviews and 1 assignment with live debrief.

data.title: Vice President, Software Engineering
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Vice President, Software Engineering

Consumer Data Management (CDM) is a strategic enterprise platform that manages consumer identity, consent, and engagement across Mastercard's ecosystem. As Mastercard advances toward a modern, AI- and data-centric architecture, CDM enables trusted, compliant, and scalable consumer experiences. 

We are seeking a Vice President, Engineering to lead the technology strategy, engineering execution, and operational readiness of CDM across identity, consent lifecycle management, and consumer engagement services. This leader will be accountable for building and scaling secure, resilient, compliant, and reusable platform capabilities that enable Mastercard teams to activate consumer data responsibly and deliver personalized, trusted experiences across channels. 

Role

Engineering Strategy & Platform Modernization

- Define and execute the CDM engineering strategy, evolving identity, consent, consumer data, and engagement services from point solutions into a cohesive, scalable, reusable enterprise platform. 
 - Establish architectural direction, engineering standards, and platform guardrails that improve scalability, reliability, security, developer experience, speed of delivery, and reuse. 
 - Partner with product, architecture, data, security, privacy, and regional stakeholders to translate business priorities into executable engineering roadmaps with KPIs tied to adoption, resilience, quality, cost efficiency, and platform value. 

Architecture, Delivery & Operational Excellence

- Own end-to-end engineering execution across CDM services, including design, development, testing, release management, production readiness, and ongoing operational support. 
 - Ensure CDM platforms are architected and operated for high availability, performance, observability, disaster recovery, security, privacy, regulatory compliance, and SLA commitments. 
 - Strengthen engineering practices across API design, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, data governance, automation, CI/CD, quality engineering, incident management, and vulnerability planning/remediation. 
 - Lead technical engagement with internal platform consumers, regional teams, enterprise architecture, risk, compliance, and third-party providers to manage dependencies, adoption, service quality, and reliable delivery. 
 - Embed privacy-by-design and security-by-design principles across identity, consent, messaging, and consumer data capabilities while building a culture of engineering accountability, operational discipline, and proactive risk management. 

All About You

Engineering Leadership & Domain Expertise

- Extensive experience leading large-scale software engineering organizations, with proven VP/Director+ leadership of distributed, global teams and mission-critical platforms. 
 - Deep technical understanding of distributed systems, APIs, data platforms, event-driven architecture, cloud-native engineering, identity systems, consent management, secure consumer data platforms, and third-party platform integrations. 
 - Experience operating platforms that require strong privacy, security, compliance, vulnerability management, resilience, observability, SLA management, and production support disciplines. 
 - Desirable: experience with customer data platforms, identity resolution, consent and preference management, omnichannel messaging, or engagement platforms such as SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, email, and emerging channels. 

Technical Strategy & Execution

- Ability to translate business, regulatory, and platform strategy into clear engineering priorities, architecture decisions, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Strong judgment in balancing modernization, feature delivery, technical debt, platform reuse, control requirements, operational risk, cost pressure, and SLA commitments. 
 - Experience improving engineering maturity through automation, quality practices, developer productivity, reusable frameworks, technical governance, operational metrics, and familiarity with agentic AI-powered PDLC/SDLC practices. 

Leadership & Influence

- Proven ability to lead in highly matrixed, global organizations while building alignment across engineering, product, architecture, security, privacy, compliance, operations, business stakeholders, and third-party providers. 
 - Strong executive presence and ability to communicate technology strategy, risks, trade-offs, delivery progress, cost implications, and SLA impacts clearly to senior leaders and internal customers, including under pressure. 
 - Demonstrated success hiring, developing, mentoring, and retaining senior engineering talent while aligning teams around shared outcomes, quality, resilience, security, customer impact, and continuous improvement. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

Identify opportunities to improve platform scalability, reliability, developer productivity, operational readiness, and speed of delivery through modernization, automation, reusable patterns, and engineering best practices. 

Provide technical mentorship to junior and mid-level engineers through design guidance, code review, pairing, knowledge sharing, and modeling strong engineering judgment. 

Navigate ambiguity in complex initiatives by clarifying technical direction, decomposing large problems, identifying risks, and driving alignment across stakeholders. 

Champion a culture of engineering excellence, continuous improvement, ownership, collaboration, and high-quality delivery across the team and partner organizations.

10+ years of software engineering experience delivering scalable, high-performance, and reliable software in an agile environment. 

Strong hands-on experience designing and building distributed systems, microservices, RESTful APIs, and cloud-native applications. 

Strong experience with data-intensive applications and analytics platforms; experience with Databricks is highly desirable. 

Proven expertise leading system architecture, high-level design, detailed design, and end-to-end technical delivery of complex software solutions. 

Experience driving technology modernization initiatives, including cloud adoption, platform transformation, and modernization of legacy applications. 

Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, CI/CD, containerization, Kubernetes, observability, and modern software delivery practices. 

Demonstrated technical leadership as an individual contributor, influencing architecture decisions, driving technical strategy, and leading large cross-team initiatives. 

Ability to translate business and product requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions. 

Proven ability to effectively leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools and technologies to enhance software development productivity, code quality, operational efficiency, decision-making, and engineering outcomes, while applying sound technical judgment, security considerations, and responsible AI practices. 

Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a proven ability to work effectively across engineering, product, architecture, data science, QA, and operations teams. 

Experience leading and coordinating technical initiatives across globally distributed teams spanning multiple regions and time zones. 

Passion for mentoring and developing engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, and knowledge sharing. 

Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work through ambiguity, make sound technical decisions, and drive results through hands-on execution. 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field; advanced degree is a plus. 

Mastercard is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. data.title: Sr. AI Engineering Manager
data.description:
Manager/Team Lead - Agentic AI, ML

Location: Bangalore (Hybrid)

Role Summary

As Manager - AI Engineering, you will lead a multidisciplinary team of AI Engineers and Data Scientists delivering GenAI-powered solutions, agentic AI systems, LLM-integrated applications, machine learning models, and retrieval-enabled intelligent products. This role combines technical leadership, people management, delivery accountability, and product ownership. You will be responsible for ensuring that the team delivers scalable, secure, supportable, and business-relevant AI and ML solutions from discovery through production operation and continuous improvement. 

This is not a lightweight line-management role. The successful candidate must be technically strong enough to guide senior engineers, data scientists, and technical leads, make sound architectural and implementation trade-offs, and raise the engineering bar of the team. You are expected to provide hands-on technical direction across LLM-powered systems, agent orchestration, RAG, ML model development, MLOps, cloud-native application delivery, integrations, observability, and SDLC discipline, while also building a culture of accountability, ownership, experimentation rigor, and engineering excellence. 

You will work closely with Product Managers, Solution Architects, Lead AI Engineers, Lead Data Scientists, Platform teams, DevOps, Security, and business stakeholders to translate business goals into implementable engineering work and durable product outcomes. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of AI Engineers and Data Scientists across varying experience levels, including senior engineers and technical leads, ensuring strong delivery quality, modeling rigor, engineering discipline, and technical growth
 - Own end-to-end delivery of GenAI, agentic AI, and ML-enabled solutions - from discovery, design, and backlog shaping through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement
 - Guide architectural and design decisions across LLM-powered systems, embeddings pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent orchestration, tool-enabled workflows, ML model pipelines, APIs, and cloud-native application services
 - Oversee the design, development, evaluation, and operationalization of machine learning models for predictive, classification, recommendation, anomaly detection, forecasting, optimization, or other business use cases where applicable
 - Ensure strong practices across feature engineering, experimentation, validation, model performance assessment, explainability, drift awareness, and MLOps readiness
 - Translate business and product priorities into executable engineering and data science plans, technical workstreams, model delivery milestones, and sustainable release outcomes
 - Review and challenge implementation choices to ensure systems and models are scalable, secure, observable, cost-aware, and maintainable
 - Partner with Product Managers and engineering leadership to prioritize work, manage technical dependencies, and align delivery with roadmap goals
 - Establish strong SDLC and build-own-operate practices within the team, including design reviews, code reviews, model reviews, automated testing, release readiness, production support, reliability improvement, and technical debt management
 - Drive reuse and productivity by scaling frameworks, shared components, prompt templates, orchestration patterns, feature templates, modeling utilities, evaluation frameworks, and internal accelerators across the team
 - Promote a culture of responsible AI and operational excellence, emphasizing security, token and cost governance, model safety, quality, observability, reproducibility, and supportability
 - Coordinate with cloud platform, DevOps, Security, Integration, Architecture, and data teams to ensure enterprise readiness of all deployments
 - Own hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance development, and growth plans for both the AI Engineering and Data Science team members
 - Track and communicate KPIs related to delivery, GenAI adoption, model quality, latency, business impact, reliability, experimentation outcomes, and production performance
 - Act as the primary technical and delivery escalation point for the team, helping remove blockers and resolve design, modeling, execution, and operational issues

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in software engineering, AI / ML engineering, data science, solution engineering, or technology delivery, including strong experience building and operating production-grade intelligent systems
 - 4 to 5 + years of experience delivering or leading AI / ML / GenAI / LLM-powered solutions in enterprise or product environments
 - Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams or technical pods delivering LLM-powered products, agentic AI workflows, machine learning models, or AI-enabled application capabilities, with accountability for both technical quality and delivery outcomes
 - Strong technical depth in Python, modern backend engineering, machine learning solution delivery, API-first architectures, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud-native application delivery
 - Strong hands-on or design-level experience with LLM platforms and orchestration frameworks such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, AutoGen, or equivalent platforms used for enterprise GenAI delivery
 - Strong experience designing or guiding implementations involving retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings pipelines, vector search, grounding strategies, and retrieval optimization using platforms such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, or equivalent
 - Strong understanding of machine learning model development, including feature engineering, model training, validation, tuning, evaluation, performance interpretation, and production-readiness considerations
 - Practical experience guiding or reviewing MLOps practices, including experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment automation, CI/CD for ML, monitoring, drift detection, retraining readiness, and reproducibility
 - Experience building and deploying AI- and ML-enabled cloud-native services using technologies such as Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, FastAPI, Docker, Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes / AKS, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, MLflow, or equivalent engineering and deployment platforms
 - Strong understanding of CI/CD, containerization, deployment automation, secure delivery practices, and operational readiness for AI-driven and ML-enabled systems
 - Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent-to-agent (A2A) interaction models, memory / context management approaches, and other distributed AI coordination patterns
 - Practical experience with observability and operational tooling such as Application Insights, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry, Log Analytics, Datadog, New Relic, or equivalent platforms, including monitoring of reliability, latency, cost, runtime behavior, and model / workflow health
 - Strong understanding of agentic AI implementation patterns, including multi-step orchestration, tool calling, context management, and workflow decomposition
 - Experience integrating AI- and ML-enabled solutions with REST APIs, enterprise systems, workflow platforms, event-driven services, or downstream business applications
 - Demonstrated ability to translate business and product needs into scalable, secure, and maintainable AI / ML engineering solutions, while guiding teams on implementation trade-offs, experimentation choices, and delivery sequencing
 - Strong SDLC ownership mindset across design, build, testing, deployment, support, reliability improvement, model lifecycle management, and long-term maintainability
 - Proven ability to raise engineering and data science quality through code reviews, model reviews, design guidance, architectural mentoring, coaching of senior engineers and data scientists, and reinforcement of reusable patterns and standards
 - Strong people leadership capability, including coaching, feedback, performance management, capability development, and fostering accountability and engineering excellence
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, data science, product, platform, architecture, DevOps, and business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading implementations involving agentic AI workflows, multi-agent coordination, tool-enabled automation, reusable orchestration abstractions, or structured task delegation patterns
 - Experience with AI observability, prompt safety, runtime guardrails, hallucination mitigation, evaluation frameworks, quality monitoring, and enterprise governance practices for GenAI systems
 - Familiarity with broader enterprise AI and ML platforms such as Microsoft AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, PromptFlow, MLflow, Databricks, or equivalent AI / ML lifecycle and experimentation ecosystems
 - Experience leading or supporting teams working on forecasting, optimization, recommender systems, anomaly detection, classification, NLP, or hybrid ML + GenAI solutions
 - Experience contributing to reusable GenAI accelerators, internal SDKs, orchestration templates, prompt frameworks, feature templates, evaluation patterns, modeling utilities, or shared engineering utilities
 - Familiarity with enterprise integration landscapes involving SAP, ServiceNow, API management layers, workflow systems, event buses, and business process platforms
 - Experience with cost-aware AI and ML delivery, including token usage visibility, model selection trade-offs, compute efficiency, scaling considerations, and engineering productivity optimization
 - Ability to communicate complex technical and analytical decisions clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, and to represent team direction confidently in leadership forums
 - Experience operating in a build-own-operate product environment
 - Knowledge of responsible AI, AI quality engineering, governance-by-design, model risk awareness, and compliance-aware delivery in enterprise environments

Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion & Belonging

Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. data.title: Head of Engineering, Commerce Platform
data.description:
Overview

As the Head of Engineering for the Core Commerce Platform, you will be the primary architect and leader of Atlassian's next-generation monetization engine. This is a high-stakes leadership role at the intersection of engineering excellence, financial integrity, and business transformation. You will lead a department of 50-70 engineers in India, tasked with evolving our legacy billing systems into a world-class, enterprise-scale platform that powers Atlassian's multi-billion dollar revenue stream. 

Your mission is to build a unified, multi-modal billing platform that seamlessly integrates traditional seat-based models with modern, value-based consumption models. This platform is the "monetization backbone" that converts every customer interaction-from a Jira seat to an AI-powered Rovo credit-into accurate, transparent, and compliant revenue. 

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work - whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. 

Responsibilities

- Platform Modernization: Transition the Commerce Cloud Platform (CCP) from a seat-centric system to a flexible, meter-agnostic engine capable of handling high-concurrency usage events and complex financial settlements. 
 - Enterprise Readiness: Deliver "hardened" commerce capabilities for our largest customers, including aggregate quoting, threshold-based invoicing, and advanced credit management. 
 - Financial Integrity & Compliance: Ensure 100% accuracy in revenue recognition (MRR/ARR) and downstream finance integrations. You will own the systems that interface with Stripe and internal financial reporting tools. 
 - AI-Native Transformation: Drive the adoption of AI within the platform itself-leveraging AI for automated testing of complex commerce scenarios, anomaly detection in billing, and optimizing the "Usage Event → Invoice" pipeline. 
 - Operational Excellence: Manage Tier 1 external-facing services where downtime directly impacts Atlassian's ability to transact. You will instill a culture of "zero-error" engineering and high-availability architecture. 
 - Executive Influencing: As a key leader in Commerce organization, you will represent the platform's roadmap to C-level stakeholders, ensuring engineering capacity aligns with Atlassian's strategic monetization goals. 

Qualifications

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range. 

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity. 

- Global Scale Leadership: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5+ years in a senior leadership role at a global, hyper-scale technology organization. You have successfully led large, multi-layered engineering departments (50+ people) through managers and senior technical leaders. 
 - Monetization & Billing Expertise: Deep domain expertise in building and scaling Enterprise-grade Billing, Payments, or Commerce Platforms. You have a proven track record of architecting systems that support diverse pricing models, including Seat-based, Usage/Consumption-based, Ramp, and Flex models. 
 - High-Stakes Execution: Experience managing Tier 1, business-critical services where system reliability and financial accuracy are paramount. You understand the rigor required to manage platforms that power billions in annual revenue with "zero-error" tolerance. 
 - Strategic Platform Transformation: Demonstrated success in leading major organizational and technical shifts, such as transitioning a company's core business model or modernizing legacy monetization infrastructure into a flexible, multi-modal engine. 
 - Education: BS/MS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. 

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go. atlassian. com/perksandbenefits . 

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. 

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them. 

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go. atlassian. com/crh . 

In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

data.title: Director, Engineering
data.description:
About The Team

Zillow's Enterprise Platforms & Technology (EP&T) organization runs the third-party SaaS platforms that power our business: Workday, ServiceNow, Salesforce, and the AI infrastructure that increasingly mediates how Zillow employees experience these systems. Workday powers our HR and Finance operations. ServiceNow runs IT and HR service delivery. The agentic AI layer we're building on top of these platforms is reshaping how employees get help, complete tasks, and navigate their work day. 

We are building a new India-based engineering team to take end-to-end ownership of Workday HR and ServiceNow in 2026, with potential expansion to other enterprise SaaS platforms in the future. This team will own its platform stacks completely - production access, change ownership, on-call rotation, direct stakeholder relationships - not as remote staffing for US-led work, but as a peer engineering organization with its own architectural authority. 

EP&T operates with an AI-native engineering culture. Modern AI coding and agent tooling is baseline practice across our existing US teams. For your India team, that means AI-augmented configuration is the daily reality: designing Workday business processes, generating ServiceNow flows, and writing platform-bounded code with AI as a partner, at a pace that traditional methods can't match. Your team's success proves and scales this operating model. 

This is a team where your technical credibility matters. We are building it from scratch, and the leader who joins now will lay the engineering foundation for Zillow's enterprise-wide shift to invisible, agent-mediated platforms, and define what excellence looks like in this space for years to come. 

Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow's mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India. 

About The Role

As Director of Engineering for Enterprise SaaS Platforms (India), you'll build Zillow's India platform engineering organization from the ground up. 

You will report directly to the global leader of Enterprise Platforms & Technology and be one of the first engineering directors based in India. As the sole engineering director in EP&T based in India, you'll partner with your US-based peer leaders in Engineering, Product, and Design, but will have broad latitude to shape culture, hiring practices, and operating norms for the team you build. 

You will personally recruit the senior bench, allowing you to pull talent from your network. You will hold the bar on AI-native engineering practices, partner closely with US-based domain experts and product managers to translate design intent into production reality, and work with Zillow's US-based platform and agentic engineering team to deliver the integration and AI infrastructure that connects your work into the broader enterprise. 

Responsibilities: 

Build the team

- Recruit, hire, and develop an India engineering team and management team
 - Recruit your senior bench, leveraging your network and your reputation to bring in the talent you need to deliver our vision
 - Coach the next layer of India leadership - managers and senior engineers who will be key to the success of your organization
 - Represent Zillow's India engineering presence externally; recruit actively from the Workday and ServiceNow ecosystems

Own the Workday platform

- Drive end-to-end Workday HR delivery: business process configuration, EIB integrations, scripted custom logic, security model, reporting, and production operations
 - Own and execute SOX-compliant change management across Workday in partnership with Zillow's People, Finance, and Audit organizations
 - Champion AI-augmented configuration patterns as the productivity multiplier on platform engineering and configuration work
 - Directly manage the Workday team and partner with the US-based platform and agentic engineering team on MCP integration and agent capabilities

Own the ServiceNow platform

- Drive end-to-end ServiceNow delivery: HR Service Delivery, IT Service Management, scoped applications, scripted REST endpoints, Integration Hub flows
 - Directly manage the ServiceNow team and partner with the US-based platform and agentic engineering team on MCP integration and agent capabilities

Establish operating norms

- Set the operating cadence with US-based domain experts, product managers, and platform engineering peers, maintaining end-to-end ownership and a tight feedback loop between US-based stakeholders, design partners, and engineering build teams. 
 - Build an engineering culture where AI is the engine of daily work: your team uses AI tooling to design and validate Workday business processes, generate ServiceNow flows, write and review platform-bounded code, and automate documentation and change evidence faster than traditional methods allow
 - Set multi-year strategic direction for India's platform scope, tightly coupled to Zillow's broader business and AI roadmap
 - Own budget, planning, vendor relationships, tooling, and talent decisions for the India organization

Partner across Zillow

- Engage as a peer technical voice with Zillow's HR business partners, IT customers, and engineering leadership
 - Represent the India team in EP&T leadership rituals - staff meetings, planning, monthly business reviews
 - Bridge time zones, cultures, and operating styles so the US-India model works as a single distributed engineering org

This role has been categorized as an Office position. "Office" employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute. 

Who you are

We are looking for a builder, a leader, and a talent magnet. You bring: 

- Team builder and talent magnet: you've built engineering teams from scratch. You recruit senior engineers from your network and selectively from outside, develop them into top performers, and set culture and operating norms early to grow a high-performing team from a blank page. 
 - AI-native posture: you actively use modern AI coding and agent tooling in your own work, and you have championed AI-tooling adoption in teams you've led. You're not someone who's "open to AI", you're already practicing it. 
 - Deep platform expertise with multi-platform breadth: deep expertise in at least one major enterprise SaaS platform (Workday HR strongly preferred), with proven breadth across two or more others (ServiceNow, Workday Financials, Salesforce, or similar). You know what excellence looks like in SaaS platform engineering and have built it more than once. 
 - Distributed engineering leadership: you have led offshore or distributed engineering centers, you have worked closely with US-based companies and leadership teams across the US-India time gap, and you understand how to keep distributed teams in sync on culture, operations excellence, and engineering practices. 
 - Multi-domain leadership: you have run engineering for multiple business domains simultaneously (HR, Support, Finance, Sales) and can context-switch credibly across stakeholder groups. 
 - Engineering leadership across software development and systems administration: you have led both application engineering and platform configuration/administration functions; you understand the differences, the interfaces between them, and how to staff and manage each. Sufficient hands-on background (programming, configuration, or platform certification) to engage credibly with senior individual contributors on architectural decisions. 
 - 15+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS platform engineering, with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles managing managers and multi-functional engineering teams. 
 - Exceptional written and verbal English communication: you will be in rooms with senior US leadership regularly. 

Additional differentiating qualifications: 

- Workday Studio, EIB, or scripted integration depth (5+ years)
 - Experience partnering closely with a US-based VP or senior executive (5+ years)
 - ServiceNow platform experience (2+ years)
 - SOX or compliance-driven environment experience (2+ years)
 - Workday Financials experience (1-year or more preferred)
 - Active in the Workday or ServiceNow ecosystem (community, conferences, certifications)

Location

This role will be based in Bangalore, India. The role will require in-person presence at our Zillow Bangalore office and period travel to the US may be required for partnership, planning and leadership offsites. 

Get to know us

At Zillow, we're reimagining how people move-through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U. S. , we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you'll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. 

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U. S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME's America's Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. 

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry-and your career-forward, together. 

Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment. 

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly. 

Qualified applicants will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law.

data.description:
Summary

In this key role, The Operations Area Quality Manager is responsible for the overall coordination of the Quality processes with the customer and within the production facilities in their areas of responsibility. Responsible for developing, implementing and administering policies and procedures to achieve the Customer Satisfaction and ensure Quality company objectives. A strong emphasis will be on the continuation of development in Supplier, Internal Process and Customer quality programs.
