data.title: Sr Principal Controls Engineer
data.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced and innovative Controls Engineer to lead the design, development, optimization, and implementation of advanced control systems across critical infrastructure platforms. This role is responsible for ensuring the performance, reliability, and scalability of automation systems, with a strong focus on data center infrastructure, power/energy management, and industrial automation. 

The ideal candidate will serve as a technical leader, driving system architecture, integration, and execution across PLC, IPC-based controls, SCADA/HMI platforms, and enterprise systems including BMS and EPMS. 

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

- Define and own the control system architecture across multiple platforms including PLCs, IPC-based systems, SCADA, BMS, EPMS, and MES, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability. 
 - Lead development and implementation of PLC and IPC-based control systems using platforms such as Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider, Beckhoff, and Codesys. 
 - Design and deploy SCADA and HMI systems across multiple platforms (Ignition, WinCC, FactoryTalk, AVEVA, etc. ). 
 - Develop structured, modular, and reusable control logic using IEC 61131-3 programming standards. 
 - Develop detailed control system documentation including Functional Design Specifications (FDS), Sequence of Operations (SOO), I/O lists, Cause & Effect matrices, Alarm matrices, and interface definitions. 
 - Create and review electrical schematics, control diagrams, and Bills of Materials (BOMs). 
 - Define control logic, sensor integration strategies, and communication protocols such as Modbus, BACnet, OPC UA, Ethernet/IP, and SNMP. 
 - Integrate control systems with BMS, EPMS, SCADA, MES, and cloud-based platforms to ensure seamless data flow and interoperability. 
 - Lead Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), ensuring system reliability, safety, and performance. 
 - Support commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization of control systems in operational environments. 
 - Design and support control systems for mission-critical infrastructure including UPS, generators, switchgear, chillers, liquid cooling systems, CRAC/CRAH units, and fire protection systems. 
 - Establish design standards, best practices, and reusable frameworks for scalable and consistent implementation. 
 - Lead root cause analysis and resolution of complex control system issues during commissioning and operations. 
 - Drive development and validation of system-level simulations and digital twin models. 
 - Evaluate emerging technologies and automation trends to improve system efficiency and performance. 
 - Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, software, and facilities teams to ensure seamless integration with physical infrastructure. 
 - Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to align control system designs with business requirements, schedules, and operational constraints. 
 - Facilitate technical reviews, workshops, and planning sessions to ensure alignment across engineering disciplines. 

Knowledge & Skills

- Excellent interpersonal, communication, and leadership skills. 
 - Self-motivated, accountable, and able to work independently within a global team. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities. 
 - Ability to interpret technical documents, standards, and regulations. 
 - Skilled in writing reports, business correspondence, and procedural guides. 
 - Ability to influence stakeholders and mentor engineering teams. 
 - Familiarity with PLM/design tools (EPLAN, AutoCAD, Windchill, SolidWorks) and DevOps practices is a plus. 
 - Understanding of low and medium voltage electrical systems. 

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, or related field. 
 - 8+ years of experience in control system design and implementation. 
 - Deep expertise in PLC/IPC programming (Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Schneider, Beckhoff). 
 - Experience with SCADA/HMI development across multiple platforms. 
 - Experience with BMS integration and optimization. 
 - Experience with EPMS systems for real-time energy monitoring and analytics. 
 - Experience with industrial communication protocols (Modbus, BACnet, OPC UA, Ethernet/IP). 
 - Familiarity with NFPA, IEC, and ISO standards related to control systems and safety. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline. 
 - Active Professional Engineer (PE) license. 
 - Experience in hyperscale or colocation data center environments. 
 - Experience with digital twin technologies and predictive maintenance strategies.

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 

You will be a Principal Engineer (PMTS) leading the Monitoring Cloud Events team in Hyderabad, India. Our team builds systems that handle huge amounts of data for Salesforce. We make sure everything in our cloud runs the way it should. In this role, your job is to guide the team, build great software, and own the services we create from start to finish. 

What You'll Actually Be Doing

- Day-to-day work: You will build and maintain an Observability stack using in-house, open source and cloud managed services and run data pipelines (ETL) and use big data tools. You will check system health and fix problems quickly so our services stay online. 
 - Leading the way: You will teach and mentor other engineers to help them grow and do their best work. 
 - Working together: You will talk to partners and customers all over the world to make sure they get what they need. 
 - Long-term goals & impact: You will make our cloud faster, safer, and easier to use for millions of people. You will learn how to run big, global systems and become a top leader in the tech world. 

Tech Stack: 

- Cloud & Compute: AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) for stateless, scalable multi-cloud orchestration. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Terraform for resilient, automated platform provisioning across environments. 
 - Edge Ingestion: OpenTelemetry (OTel) for standardized instrumentation, and Vector/Fluent Bit for high-throughput log routing. 
 - Message Buffering: Apache Kafka to ingest billions of telemetry events, ensuring durable, decoupled data pipelines. 
 - Stream Processing: Apache Flink for real-time log parsing, rolling aggregations, and anomaly detection before storage. 
 - Backend Languages: Java for building heavy stream-processing applications, supplemented by Go and Python for operators and tooling. 
 - Ad-Hoc OLAP Analytics: Apache Druid to power sub-second, interactive dashboard queries over massive historical datasets. 
 - Log & Trace Storage: ClickHouse for fast columnar event storage, natively tiered to AWS S3 / GCP Cloud Storage for cost-effective cold storage. 
 - Time-Series Metrics: VictoriaMetrics, M3DB, or Prometheus to ingest and compress millions of high-cardinality metric rollups. 
 - Visualization & Alerting: Grafana and Apache Superset for single-pane-of-glass UI, paired with Prometheus Alertmanager for incident routing. 

You're Our Person If. . . 

- You have deep experience building software and leading engineering teams. 
 - You know how to move, store, and work with very large amounts of data. 
 - You are highly skilled at building ETL data pipelines. 
 - You have hands-on experience with open-source tools like Kafka, Flink, and Apache Druid. 
 - You are a kind and helpful mentor to other engineers. 
 - You are a great "service owner, " meaning you care deeply about keeping systems online and running smoothly. 

Even Better If. . . 

- You have worked on an Observability stack before (tools that monitor system health and logs). 
 - You have experience working with global teams across different countries and time zones. 
 - You enjoy talking directly to customers to understand and solve their problems. 

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you'll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world. 

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form. 

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates' resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. 

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that's inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications - without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way. 

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. 

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what's possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. 

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

data.description:
Job Purpose

Looking for a Test Lead / Data QA Engineer to drive and oversee data validation, manual testing, and regression testing activities across capital markets data pipelines spanning both legacy and modern platforms. The role is responsible for ensuring data accuracy, completeness, consistency, integrity, and adherence to business rules through source-to-target validation, schema verification, data reconciliation, lineage analysis, and automation-led regression testing. 

The ideal candidate combines strong data QA and testing expertise, hands-on automation skills, capital markets domain knowledge, and a proactive ownership mindset to ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across environments. 

The successful candidate will lead test delivery, manage and coordinate offshore QA resources, and engage closely with business and technology stakeholders to maintain high-quality data across post-trade and enterprise data ecosystems. Key responsibilities include building reusable Python- and SQL-based validation frameworks, supporting batch and cloud-based execution models, identifying data anomalies, validating end-to-end data flows, and embedding robust data quality controls throughout the development lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end test planning, execution, and delivery for data validation and regression testing initiatives, ensuring quality, schedule, and stakeholder expectations are met. 
 - Manage and mentor offshore/onshore QA teams, including resource planning, task allocation, deliverable reviews, and adherence to testing best practices. 
 - Drive test governance, including test strategy, defect management, risk tracking, quality metrics, status reporting, and release readiness assessments. 
 - Collaborate with business, engineering, and product teams to define requirements, resolve issues, ensure test coverage, and embed quality controls across the delivery lifecycle. 
 - Perform source-to-target data validation across legacy and modern systems, including SQL Server and cloud-based data environments. 
 - Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, duplication handling, referential integrity, schema structures, metadata, lineage, and business-rule conformance. 
 - Build and maintain automation-first regression testing frameworks using Python, PySpark, SQL, and reusable validation utilities. 
 - Execute field-level, dataset-level, transformation-level, and aggregate-level data checks across source, staging, warehouse, data lake, and downstream systems. 
 - Validate ETL/ELT pipelines, post-trade data flows, stored procedures, batch jobs, and cloud-based execution workflows. 
 - Design reusable test cases, validation scenarios, reconciliation checks, automated scripts, and regression packs for repeatable data-quality assurance. 
 - Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries and stored procedures across SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar platforms. 
 - Translate business rules, stored procedure logic, and post-trade process flows into automated validation scripts and assertions. 
 - Build Python-based utilities, APIs, CLI tools, and reusable frameworks to support data validation, orchestration, API integrations, and reporting workflows. 
 - Integrate regression tests, data validation checks, SQL deployables, and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, or equivalent tools. 
 - Automate execution of AutoSys jobs, batch processes, stored procedures, and validation scripts across development, UAT, and production environments. 
 - Work with engineering teams to embed data quality controls into pipelines, releases, and operational workflows. 
 - Identify data anomalies, schema mismatches, duplicate records, null-handling issues, transformation failures, reconciliation breaks, and integrity violations. 
 - Log defects with clear evidence, impact analysis, root-cause observations, and business context. 
 - Support capital markets and post-trade validation across allocations, clearing, settlement, confirmations, reconciliations, market data, reference data, and downstream reporting. 

Key competencies

- 8-12 years of hands-on experience in Data QA, Data Engineering QA, or Python-based automation roles and proven experience leading QA teams, test planning, estimation, execution, defect management, and end-to-end test delivery across complex data programs. 
 - Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate test status, risks, quality metrics, and release readiness to business and technology leadership. 
 - Experience establishing test strategies, governance frameworks, quality standards, resource planning, and mentoring distributed QA teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional collaboration, manage competing priorities, mitigate delivery risks, and ensure

successful project outcomes in Agile environments. 

- Strong Python skills for data validation, automation framework development, regression testing, and pipeline verification. 
 - Working knowledge of PySpark for validating large-scale data pipelines and distributed datasets. 
 - Solid SQL skills for source-to-target validation, reconciliation, complex queries, stored procedures, schema checks, and defect analysis. 
 - Experience in data QA, ETL/ELT testing, data pipeline testing, and regression testing across legacy and modern platforms. 
 - Proven experience building automation-first regression frameworks, reusable validation scripts, test cases, and data verification utilities. 
 - Strong understanding of data quality dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, referential integrity, and business-rule conformance. 
 - Experience validating metadata, schema structures, data types, constraints, lineage, transformation logic, and downstream outputs. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitLab, with the ability to integrate automated tests and quality gates into deployment pipelines. 
 - Familiarity with batch orchestration tools such as AutoSys, Control-M, or Airflow. 
 - Good analytical skills to understand post-trade, financial, market data, or reference data and translate them into repeatable validation scenarios. 
 - Experience with JIRA, XRay, agile delivery practices, defect management, and QA process governance. 
 - Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot to accelerate test case generation, SQL development, data validation, defect analysis, documentation, and test data creation.

Nice to Have

 - Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar platforms. 
 - Exposure to Hadoop, Spark, Databricks, cloud data lakes, and Big Data validation.

integrations.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer — Active Directory Internals & Directory Services
data.description:
Cohesity is the leader in AI-powered data security. Over 13, 600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas' enterprise data protection business, the company's solutions secure and protect data on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe. 

We've been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture. 

Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security?

About The Role

We're looking for an engineer who understands Active Directory the way its designers do - not just how to administer it, but how it actually works underneath: how objects replicate, how changes are tracked, how deletions age out, and how identity continuity is preserved across restores. You'll build and harden the core engine that reads, tracks, and safely writes AD state, powering reliable backup, synchronization, and recovery at scale. 

This is a deep-systems role. If you've ever debugged a replication metadata mismatch, reasoned about USN rollback, or cared about SID history surviving a cross-domain restore, you'll be at home here. 

What You'll Do

- Design and implement the directory engine that discovers, tracks, and safely applies changes to Active Directory objects. 
 - Build robust change-tracking pipelines using DirSync, USN cookies, and change notification, handling cursor persistence, catch-up, and re-sync correctly. 
 - Implement correct object lifecycle handling - tombstones, deleted-object lifetime, and Recycle Bin semantics - for accurate backup and recovery. 
 - Guarantee identity continuity across operations: SID, SID history, and GUID preservation and validation. 
 - Implement safe write paths - modify, ModifyDN, and object creation - with idempotency, conflict handling, and integrity guarantees. 
 - Work with AD-integrated DNS and Group Policy internals to ensure complete, consistent capture and restore. 
 - Diagnose and resolve complex replication, consistency, and LDAP edge cases in production environments. 

Required Skills & Experience

You should have hands-on, internals-level expertise across most of the following: 

Schema & Replication

- AD schema, object classes, and linked-value replication
 - Replication metadata, USN semantics, and consistency reasoning

Directory Access

- LDAP search and controls, including paged and persistent search
 - DirSync, USN cookies, and change notification for change tracking

Object Lifecycle

- Tombstones, deleted-object lifetime, and AD Recycle Bin behavior

Identity Continuity

- SID, SID history, and GUID continuity semantics across domains and restores

Group Policy & DNS

- Group Policy internals: GPC / GPT and SYSVOL
 - AD-integrated DNS zones and records

Safe Writes

- Correct and safe modify, ModifyDN, and object-create operations

Nice to Have

- Experience building backup, replication, disaster-recovery, or migration tooling for Active Directory. 
 - Familiarity with Entra ID / Azure AD hybrid environments. 
 - Depth in C/C++, C#, Go; systems-level performance work. 
 - Experience operating against large, multi-domain / multi-forest deployments.

data.title: Director - Front-End Engineering
data.company: BCE Global Tech - A Bell Canada Company
data.description:
Back

Job Description

We are seeking a Director of Front-End Engineering to lead one of the Experience domain groups within Bell's Cornerstones re-platforming program - the federated, module-federation architecture behind bell. ca (the shell, its micro-frontends, and the shared design system and tooling that support them). This is not a staffing or execution role: we are looking for a true engineering partner who takes complete, end-to-end ownership of a business outcome and is accountable for how it is delivered, not just that it is delivered. You will own one or two Experience domains (for example Checkout or Solution Builder) across the program's West, Atlantic, and Central phases, build and run a self-sufficient pod, set the hiring bar for your organization, and represent India as a full partner to the Canada-based Experience leadership with the standing and judgment to disagree, be heard, and then commit. 

Leadership & Management Skills

- Outcome Ownership: Proven ability to take complete ownership of a business outcome end-to-end - understanding the target, debating the technical approach and trade-offs, and once a decision is made, committing to it and being accountable for its delivery, quality, and long-term shelf life in production. 
 - Hiring Accountability: Full accountability for interviewing, vetting, and hiring top engineering talent for your pod(s) - you are personally responsible for the quality of the team you build and the delivery that results from it. 
 - Pod & Delivery Leadership: Ability to stand up and run a pod (or pod of pods) that owns a domain end-to-end: onboarding engineers, running delivery governance that is lightweight rather than bureaucratic, and escalating only the blockers that genuinely need to be bubbled up. 
 - Cross-Geo Partnership: Comfort operating as an extension of the Canada-based team rather than a downstream vendor - attending daily stand-ups, building direct working relationships with Salesforce, integration, and SRE counterparts, and knowing who to call when something crosses a domain boundary. 
 - Architectural Voice: A mandate to bring architectural authority to the table: thought leaders on this team work with delivery so that what is proposed is what actually ships and holds up in production, rather than designs that drift once handed off. 
 - Culture Building: A servant-leader who protects a culture of innovation, delivery, and fun, and who actively resists unnecessary process - the goal is a lean, fast, and simple way of working, not adding heavyweight reporting because "that's how it's always been done. "
 - Talent Magnetism: Ability to attract and retain talent that can compete with Bangalore's startup market - engineers who bring modern technical curiosity and creative problem-solving, not only integration/operations profiles. 

Technical Skills & Acumen

- Module Federation / Micro-Frontend Architecture: Deep working knowledge of federated front-end architecture: a shared shell (navigation, session, layout, analytics) plus independently owned and deployed micro-frontends (MFEs), each mapped to a single business domain (e. g. , Qualification, Product Catalog, Checkout, Billing, Customer Profile). 
 - Stack Fluency: Comfort overseeing modern front-end stacks - React 19, TanStack Router/Query, a shared design system (Brand UI and Product UI), and standardized build/test tooling (Rspack, Vitest browser-mode testing, visual regression) - even without writing the code personally day to day. 
 - Engineering Standards & CI/CD: Understanding of how Guardrails-over-gatekeeping pipelines work (linting, TypeScript, security scanning, live review environments) so standards are enforced by tooling, not by adding process. 
 - Integration & Systems Thinking: Awareness of how the front end integrates with Salesforce, MuleSoft, and other backend/API layers - enough to debate translation and integration approaches with an architectural and cost lens, and to know when a workaround belongs in the API layer rather than the front end. 
 - AI-Assisted Delivery: Experience championing AI-assisted SDLC - planning agents, delivery agents, and AI-assisted testing - to help developers ship faster and with fewer defects. 
 - Observability & Production Readiness: Familiarity with observability and AIOps practices (proactive/reactive tiering, telemetry pipelines, tools such as New Relic and Dynatrace) so your domain's production health is visible and defensible. 
 - Systems Thinking: Ability to look across your domain(s) and adjacent ones to spot reuse opportunities, reduce tech debt, and avoid rebuilding what already exists in the shared platform. 

Qualifications

- 15+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role (Director or equivalent) owning delivery for teams of 50+ engineers. 
 - Demonstrated success building and scaling teams in a GCC, global capability center, or global delivery model - ideally one that has moved from staff augmentation to outcome ownership. 
 - Hands-on or recent front-end engineering background (React or comparable modern framework); experience with micro-frontend or federated architectures is a strong plus. 
 - Experience in telecommunications or large-scale digital/retail platforms is a strong plus. 
 - A track record of building trust with distributed stakeholders and operating with autonomy rather than waiting to be told what to do. 

What We Offer

- Professional development and training opportunities
 - A supportive and inclusive work environment
 - Access to cutting-edge technology and tools.

Overview

The Windows Store team is building the place where customers discover and engage with the apps, games, and experiences that make Windows valuable, and where developers can reach Windows customers and grow their businesses. 

We are looking for an experienced Principal Group Engineer Manager to join the Windows Store team and help shape the next generation of Store experiences. 

This is a role for an engineering leader who enjoys working at the intersection of product, platform, developers, and customers. You will lead a team of software engineers building experiences and services that need to operate with high reliability, security, performance, and quality. You will partner closely with Product Management, Design, Data Science, and engineering teams across Windows to turn ambiguous customer and developer problems into clear technical direction and delivered outcomes. 

We are looking for someone who can combine solid technical judgment with great people leadership. You should be comfortable going deep on architecture and engineering decisions while also building a healthy team, developing engineers, driving execution, and creating an environment where people can do their best work. 

As AI changes how software is discovered, built, distributed, and used, you will also help us rethink what an app store should become in an AI-first world. 

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

Responsibilities

As a Principal Group Engineer Manager on the Windows Store team, you will: 

- Lead and grow a solid engineering team. Hire, coach, mentor, and develop engineers while creating a culture of ownership, inclusion, learning, and engineering excellence. 
 - Provide technical leadership. Work with engineers to make sound architecture and design decisions and build systems that are scalable, reliable, secure, maintainable, and performant. 
 - Own outcomes end to end. Translate product and business goals into engineering plans and drive execution from design through implementation, experimentation, rollout, and operation. 
 - Champion the customer and developer experience. Use customer feedback, developer feedback, product signals, and engineering data to identify problems and continuously improve the Store. 
 - Drive engineering fundamentals. Build a culture where security, privacy, accessibility, quality, performance, telemetry, reliability, and operational excellence are part of how products are engineered from the beginning. 
 - Operate what you build. Establish solid service-health practices, telemetry, incident response, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement. 
 - Lead through ambiguity. Bring structure to complex problems, make thoughtful tradeoffs, establish clear priorities, and help the team move from ideas to measurable outcomes. 
 - Partner across organizational boundaries. Work closely with Product Management, Design, Data Science, partner engineering teams, and other Windows organizations to align architecture, dependencies, and execution. 
 - Embrace AI-native engineering. Help the team use AI effectively throughout the engineering lifecycle and explore how AI and agents can create new value for Windows customers and developers. 
 - Create clarity and energy. Connect the team's engineering work to the broader Windows and Store mission so engineers understand not just what we are building, but why it matters. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python. 
 - OR equivalent experience. 
Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field and significant software engineering experience, or equivalent experience. 
 - Experience designing, developing, and shipping production software. 
 - Experience leading or managing software engineers and helping engineers grow in their careers. 
 - Solid understanding of software architecture, engineering fundamentals, testing, debugging, performance, and operational excellence. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead complex engineering projects involving multiple teams and dependencies. 
 - Solid written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical decisions and tradeoffs clearly. 
 - Track record of working effectively across engineering, product, and other disciplines. 
 - Experience building large-scale cloud services, consumer applications, Windows applications, developer platforms, or commerce/distribution systems. 
 - Experience with Windows development technologies such as C++, C#. 
 - Experience with Azure and building highly available distributed services. 
 - Experience operating large-scale production systems, including telemetry, live-site management, incident response, and reliability engineering. 
 - Experience working with developer ecosystems, app distribution, marketplaces, or developer-facing platforms. 
 - Experience applying generative AI, LLMs, agents, or AI-assisted engineering techniques to real products or engineering workflows. 
 - A solid product mindset and demonstrated ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes. 

#W+DJOBS

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. 

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. What You Will Work On
 - Design intuitive and high-quality interfaces for Sententia's transaction intelligence platform. 
 - Translate complex legal, financial and transaction workflows into simple, usable product experiences. 
 - Design  deal dashboards, transaction workspaces, investment structures, deal diagrams, timelines, risk intelligence interfaces and document-generation workflows. 
 - Develop user journeys, wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity designs. 
 - Build and maintain a consistent  design system and component library. 
 - Work closely with founders and engineers to translate designs into functional frontend experiences. 
 - Contribute to frontend development using modern web technologies. 
 - Create responsive interfaces for desktop and web-based professional workflows. 
 - Design data-dense interfaces without compromising clarity or usability. 
 - Continuously improve the product based on user feedback, testing and founder/product direction. 
 - Help establish Sententia's visual identity across the product and, where required, its website and marketing interfaces. 
 - Work directly with the Founders' Office on new product concepts, experiments and rapid prototypes. What We're Looking ForDesign

- Strong understanding of UI/UX principles and product design. 
 - Ability to design clean, modern and professional interfaces. 
 - Strong understanding of typography, spacing, hierarchy, grids and visual systems. 
 - Experience with  Figma  or equivalent design tools. 
 - Ability to create high-fidelity prototypes and communicate design decisions clearly. 
 - Strong product thinking - you should be able to understand  why  something should be designed a certain way, not just how it should look. Frontend

- Working knowledge of  HTML, CSS and JavaScript/TypeScript. 
 - Experience with  React / Next. js  is strongly preferred. 
 - Understanding of responsive web design and component-based development. 
 - Ability to convert Figma designs into polished, functional frontend interfaces. 
 - Familiarity with Git and modern frontend development workflows is a plus. You Will Be a Strong Fit If You
 - Are obsessed with building products that  look exceptional and work exceptionally well. 
 - Have an eye for detail and care about the smallest aspects of an interface. 
 - Can make complex information feel simple. 
 - Are comfortable working in an early-stage startup where requirements evolve rapidly. 
 - Enjoy working directly with founders and having significant ownership over your work. 
 - Can move quickly from  idea → prototype → product. 
 - Are interested in  AI, legal technology, financial technology, private markets, investment banking or enterprise software. 
 - Think beyond individual screens and understand the product as a complete experience. What You Can Expect at Sententia
 - Direct exposure to the Founders' Office  and senior decision-making. 
 - Significant ownership over the product's UI/UX direction. 
 - Opportunity to work on a product at the intersection of  AI × Law × Finance × Transactions. 
 - Freedom to experiment with new interaction models and product ideas. 
 - Exposure to real-world workflows used in  M&A, PE/VC, investment banking and legal transactions. 
 - A fast-moving environment where your work can directly influence the product. 
 - Opportunity to grow into a broader  Product Design / Product Engineering  role as Sententia scales. The Mindset We ValueWe are not looking for someone who simply executes design tickets. 

We are looking for someone who can sit with the founders, understand a problem, ask the right questions, sketch a solution, build a prototype and ultimately help ship it. 

If you can look at a complex transaction workflow and think, "There has to be a better way to do this, " - we want to hear from you. 

How to ApplyInterested candidates can  apply directly  or send their application and portfolio to: 

connect@sententia. in

Please include: 

- CV / Resume
 - Portfolio or previous work
 - GitHub / relevant projects, if applicable
 - A brief note explaining why you would like to build Sententia with us
 - Subject:   Application - UI/UX & Frontend Designer | Sententia AI

data.title: Senior Network Automation Engineer
data.description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world's money. 

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed. 

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money. 

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. 

For everyone, everywhere. 

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer. 

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer to join our Platform Integrations APAC team, where you'll help expand and maintain direct integrations with payment systems and partners across the region. 

What is the Platform Integrations APAC (PI-APAC) team?

The Platform Integrations squad sits within the Platform tribe, which designs, builds and operates the foundational direct integration infrastructure that power the product that moves billions of dollars every month. The Platform Integrations APAC team within PI leads the direct integrations in the APAC region while also supporting integrations all over the world. 

Here's how you'll be contributing to the Team?

- Design, implement and maintain integrations between Wise and complex financial systems. 
 - Develop and design scalable and repeatable architecture with complex regulatory requirements. 
 - Analyse infrastructure to determine inefficiencies and problems, and create automation and optimisation. 
 - Collaborate with our larger platform engineering team and alongside product engineering on globally impactful projects. 
 - Communicate with various stakeholders throughout Wise, plan roadmaps with your team, and work through challenges to determine scope and realistic delivery. 
 - Work with Leads and Engineers to influence the direction and change current technology implementations, as well as advocate for excellence with third parties. 

This Role Will Give You The Opportunity To

- Work in a modern, cloud heavy environment where remote connectivity is a staple of our tech ecosystem
 - Choose your path to impact - we believe people and teams are most empowered when they can act autonomously. So rather than telling you what to do, you'll work with your team to create a vision of your own. Of course, you can always gather feedback from smart, curious people across Wise but you'll have the freedom to make your own calls
 - Grow as an engineer - understand what problems the business needs to solve and why, then proactively resolve them. We shy away from micro management
 - Approach new challenges with the freedom to develop novel and customised solutions
 - Be part of our mission to make money without borders the new normal

Qualifications

Desirable Skills and Experience

- Strong knowledge of networking fundamentals and experience with supporting complex deployments - TCP/IP, routing and switching, traffic load-balancing/ECMP, configuring firewalls, IPSEC, GRE, security policies, Network ACLs, complex routing with BGP
 - Experience in SRE and Network automation - IaaC, Python, Ansible, Netconf, CI/CD, telemetry
 - Excellent candidates would have JNCIS/CCNP-level knowledge and familiarity with networking on Linux for non-trivial tasks (e. g: running routing protocols on Linux, IPSec tunnels). Strong candidates will also have hands-on-experience with cloud networking concepts, preferably with AWS (e. g. VPCs, transit gateways, direct-connect, VPC peering). We welcome candidates who aspire to this level of knowledge if they don't yet have it. 
 - Experience in developing and documenting network designs
 - Ability to translate business requirements into explainable technical solutions for internal and external stakeholders
 - Leading technical projects or small team of engineers would be a great plus

The following is a list of some of the technologies and vendors we use. It is not an exclusive list nor do we expect you to know everything. But it gives a flavour. 

- AWS Networking: VPC, VGW, Transit-GW, Direct-Connect, VPC Peering, Cloud WAN
 - VPNs (we use IPSec heavily)
 - Vendors: Cisco, Juniper and Checkpoints (both Physical & Cloud version)
 - L2 Switching
 - Routing: BGP
 - ISP Peering, DataCenter integrations, cross-connects
 - IaaC: Terraform, Ansible, Netconf, Python
 - Java Microservices on Kubernetes (Software development experience is nice to have but not essential)
 - Git, with Github

About You

- You're a self starter who can run with projects
 - Reliability and scalability are paramount in your solutions
 - Security and privacy by design mindset
 - You think about risks and compliance 
 - You enjoy looking for where you can have impact and upset the norm
 - You're happy working in a flat organisation structure
 - Technical influencer capable of promoting architectural patterns to internal and external stakeholders
 - You are comfortable facing new challenges and creating novel and customised solutions
 - You're collaborative, charismatic and have the ability to tailor communication to the audience - both to technical and non-technical people as needed. 
 - Effective communication between cross-team stakeholders, peers and leads is key

Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders - without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive. 

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences. 

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers. 

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise. Jobs. 

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

data.description:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O&M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Wind Turbine Generator (WTG): Adani Wind Turbine Generators (WTG) is a leading player in the renewable energy sector, specializing in the design, manufacturing, and installation of high-performance wind turbine systems. With a commitment to sustainability, Adani WTGs deliver efficient and reliable energy solutions, contributing to clean power generation across global markets. 

Job Purpose

The Performance Management Engineer is responsible for analyzing wind turbine operational data to identify areas for performance improvement. This role uses advanced data analytics tools to assess turbine efficiency, power output, and reliability, conducting root cause analysis on performance deviations and implementing corrective actions. The Engineer participates in testing and validation of performance enhancements, such as control system updates and aerodynamic optimizations, and manages SCADA systems to ensure accurate data collection and monitoring. This role also involves supporting predictive maintenance initiatives by analyzing condition-based data and implementing maintenance strategies that reduce downtime. The Performance Management Engineer collaborates with cross-functional teams to align performance enhancement activities with overall product development goals and contributes to continuous improvement by proposing new methodologies and tools to optimize turbine performance. 

Responsibilities

Data Analysis and Performance Monitoring

- Analyze operational data from wind turbines to assess performance against expected benchmarks, including power output, efficiency, and availability. 
 - Use advanced data analytics software (e. g. , MATLAB, Python, R) to identify trends, anomalies, and areas for improvement in turbine performance. 

Performance Optimization and Troubleshooting

- Conduct performance optimization studies, focusing on areas such as blade aerodynamics, control system tuning, and power curve adjustments. 
 - Assist in troubleshooting performance issues on-site, using diagnostic tools to perform root cause analysis and implement corrective measures. 

Testing and Validation of Performance Improvements

- Participate in the testing and validation of performance enhancement initiatives, including prototype testing and field trials. 
 - Collect and analyze test data to validate improvements, providing feedback to engineering teams for further refinement. 

SCADA and Data Acquisition System Management

- Manage SCADA systems and other data acquisition tools, ensuring accurate and reliable data collection for performance analysis. 
 - Set up alarms, thresholds, and monitoring parameters to track key performance indicators in real-time. 

Predictive Maintenance and Condition Monitoring

- Implement predictive maintenance strategies using data analytics to forecast potential failures and schedule proactive maintenance. 
 - Monitor condition-based data, such as vibration and temperature readings, to detect early signs of component wear and prevent performance drops. 

Documentation and Reporting

- Maintain detailed records of performance analysis, tests conducted, and optimization measures implemented. 
 - Prepare performance reports, highlighting key findings, improvement opportunities, and corrective actions taken. 

Compliance with Standards and Procedures

- Ensure all performance management activities comply with relevant industry standards and internal procedures, maintaining high data integrity and accuracy. 
 - Support the preparation of compliance documentation for certification and audits. 

Collaboration with Cross-Functional Teams

- Work closely with product improvement, R&D, and operations teams to align performance enhancement activities with overall product development goals. 
 - Provide technical support and performance insights during the design and testing phases of new turbine components. 

Training and Continuous Learning

- Engage in continuous learning and professional development to stay updated on the latest performance optimization techniques and tools. 
 - Participate in internal training programs and knowledge-sharing sessions to enhance skills and contribute to team development. 

Adherence to Ethical Standards

- Adhere to organizational ethical standards in data handling, analysis, and reporting, ensuring transparency and objectivity in performance assessments. 
 - Participate in training on corporate policies, ethics, and compliance to uphold high professional standards. 

Key Stakeholders - Internal

- Lead - Performance Management
 - QA Teams
 - Manufacturing Teams

Key Stakeholders - External

- Performance Monitoring Equipment Vendors
 - Data Analytics Consultants

Qualifications

Educational Background: 

- BE in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering. 

Work Experience

- 5+ years in performance analysis and optimization, focusing on operational data, efficiency improvements, and maintenance strategy development. 

Industry Knowledge

- Proficient in data analytics, SCADA data interpretation, and applying continuous improvement methodologies to enhance turbine performance.

data.title: Senior Test Process Engineering Manager
data.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. 

Senior Manager, Test Process Engineering

Location: Ahmedabad, India

Organization: Component Test Engineering

Department: CAT

Position Summary

Micron is seeking a highly motivated Senior Manager, Test Process Engineering to lead the Component Test Process Engineering team. This position is responsible for driving manufacturing excellence through the development, optimization, standardization, AI proficiency or AI‐enabled ways of working where applicable, and deployment of semiconductor test processes across global test operations. 

The successful candidate will lead a team of engineers focused on test process control, yield improvement, quality enhancement, new product introduction (NPI), manufacturing readiness, equipment and process qualifications, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role requires close collaboration with Product Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Equipment Engineering, Industrial Engineering, R&D, and global site teams to achieve world-class operational performance as well as leveraging AI to accomplish KPI's. 

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & People Management

- Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing team of Test Process Engineers. 
 - Establish team goals, development plans, and performance objectives aligned with business priorities. 
 - Drive a culture of accountability, innovation, safety, inclusion, and continuous improvement. 
 - Build technical capability within the organization through coaching, training, and succession planning. 
 - Lead cross-functional and global initiatives involving multiple manufacturing sites. 

Test Process Engineering

- Own and drive test process development, optimization, validation, and deployment for Component Test manufacturing operations. 
 - Define and maintain process standards, best practices, and operational controls. 
 - Lead process qualification activities using structured methodologies such as DOE, risk assessment, and statistical analysis. 
 - Ensure robust process controls are established and sustained across manufacturing operations. 
 - Drive process capability improvements to support quality, output, cost, and cycle-time objectives. 

Yield & Quality Improvement

- Champion yield improvement initiatives through systematic root cause analysis and corrective actions. 
 - Lead containment, disposition, and resolution activities for quality excursions and customer-impacting issues. 
 - Utilize statistical tools and data analytics to identify process variation and drive corrective actions. 
 - Partner with Product Engineering and Quality teams to improve outgoing quality and reliability performance. 
 - Drive implementation of preventive measures to eliminate recurring manufacturing issues. 

New Product Introduction (NPI)

- Lead manufacturing process readiness activities for new product introductions. 
 - Ensure successful transfer from product development into high-volume manufacturing. 
 - Partner with Product Engineering and Operations teams to establish manufacturing specifications and process controls. 
 - Coordinate qualification activities and manufacturing risk assessments during NPI execution. 

Manufacturing Excellence

- Drive Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and operational excellence initiatives. 
 - Lead productivity, efficiency, and cost reduction programs. 
 - Establish KPIs and performance dashboards to monitor manufacturing health. 
 - Drive factory automation and digital transformation initiatives where applicable. 
 - Ensure compliance with Micron business processes, quality standards, safety requirements, and operational procedures. 

Equipment & Technology Development

- Partner with Equipment Engineering teams on qualification, upgrades, and process capability improvements. 
 - Support recipe management, process standardization, and technology proliferation across sites. 
 - Evaluate and implement innovative manufacturing solutions to improve productivity and quality. 
 - Lead technical evaluations and mitigation plans for equipment-related process issues. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or related technical discipline. 
 - Minimum 15+ years of semiconductor manufacturing, product engineering, test engineering, or process engineering experience. 
 - Minimum 5+ years of people management experience leading engineering teams. 
 - Strong understanding of semiconductor assembly and test manufacturing processes. 
 - Proven experience driving yield, quality, productivity, and cost improvements. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills utilizing data-driven decision-making. 
 - Experience with statistical analysis tools and methodologies. 
 - Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and leadership skills. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional environment. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in Engineering or related technical discipline. 
 - Experience in Component Test, Memory Test, Burn-In, System Level Test, or semiconductor backend manufacturing. 
 - Knowledge of test equipment platforms, process qualifications, and manufacturing automation. 
 - Experience with reliability methodologies, failure analysis, and quality systems. 
 - Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, or equivalent certification. 
 - Experience leading global manufacturing projects across multiple sites. 

Success Measures

The Successful Candidate Will

- Improve test yield and process capability. 
 - Reduce quality excursions and customer-impacting events. 
 - Accelerate NPI ramp-to-production readiness. 
 - Improve operational efficiency and manufacturing productivity. 
 - Develop a strong and technically capable process engineering organization.

data.description:
Company Description

SOCRoom by Procain consulting, helps businesses strengthen security operations with continuous monitoring, faster response, and expert SOC support. 

  

We work with organisations that need better visibility, alert handling, incident response, and security operations coverage without building a full SOC in-house. 

  

Our services include Managed SOC, SOC as a Service, SOC Staff Augmentation, Cloud Security Monitoring, threat detection, alert triage, and incident response support. 

  

Built on the principle of Detect. Prevent. Prevail. , SOCRoom by Procain consulting, helps teams move from security alerts to real action - faster, sharper, and with greater operational confidence. 

Key responsibilities

Team leadership and shift operations

- Lead, mentor and schedule a team of L1/L2 analysts to maintain 24x7 coverage and consistent  
 - service quality. 
 - Own shift handovers, ensuring every open incident transfers with current status, next action and  
 - owner. 
 - Conduct quality reviews of closed incidents, verifying verdicts (true positive, benign positive,   
 - false positive) and documentation. 
 - Coach analysts on investigation methodology, KQL and tooling; drive onboarding and structured  
 - skills development. 

Incident detection and response

- Act as the escalation point for high-severity incidents, including lateral movement, privileged  
 - account compromise and data exfiltration. 
 - Direct investigations from initial alert through entity analysis, timeline reconstruction,   
 - containment and closure. 
 - Coordinate containment actions with customer IT and security teams, and with L3 / incident  
 - response specialists where needed. 
 - Lead post-incident reviews and translate lessons learned into detection and process  
 - improvements. 

Microsoft Sentinel platform ownership

- Oversee analytics rule lifecycle: design, testing, tuning, alert grouping, suppression and  
 - retirement of noisy rules. 
 - Develop and review KQL queries, hunting queries, workbooks and watchlists. 
 - Guide automation using playbooks (Logic Apps) and automation rules to reduce manual triage  
 - effort. 
 - Work with engineering teams on data connector onboarding, log source health and ingestion  
 - cost optimization. 

Wazuh operations (where deployed)

- Supervise monitoring of Wazuh-managed customer environments, including agent health, rule  
 - and decoder tuning, and alert triage. 
 - Support integration of Wazuh alerts into central SOC workflows and ticketing. 

Customer engagement and reporting

- Serve as a technical point of contact for customers during incidents and in regular service  
 - reviews. 
 - Produce monthly SOC reports covering incident trends, SLA performance, detection coverage  
 - and recommendations. 
 - Ensure adherence to contractual SLAs for time-to-triage, time-to-escalate and time-to-notify. 
 - Maintain and improve runbooks, escalation matrices and standard operating procedures. 

Required qualifications (mandatory)

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security or a related field, or equivalent  professional experience. 
 - 5+ years of experience in a SOC, MSSP or MDR environment, including at least 1-2 years leading  or mentoring analysts. 
 - Hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel (minimum 2 years in production), covering  analytics rules, incidents, entity investigation, workbooks, watchlists, UEBA and playbooks. 
 - Strong proficiency in KQL for detection engineering, threat hunting and investigation. 
 - Working knowledge of the Microsoft security ecosystem: Defender XDR (Endpoint, Identity,   Office 365, Cloud Apps), Entra ID and Azure activity logs. 
 - Solid understanding of the incident response lifecycle, the MITRE ATT&CK framework and  common attack techniques. 
 - Good knowledge of networking, Windows and Linux internals, Active Directory and cloud  security fundamentals. 
 - Experience working to customer SLAs in a multi-tenant or managed services environment. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including incident reporting to technical and  executive audiences. 
 - Willingness to work in a 24x7 rotational environment and to be available for on-call escalations. 

Preferred qualifications

- Hands-on experience with Wazuh: agent deployment, custom rules and decoders, active  response, file integrity monitoring and vulnerability detection. 
 - Microsoft certifications such as SC-200 (Security Operations Analyst), AZ-500 or SC-100. 
 - Industry certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, CySA+, BTL1/BTL2, or equivalent incident response  credentials. 
 - Experience with other SIEM/SOAR platforms (Splunk, QRadar, Elastic) and EDR tools  (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne). 
 - Scripting skills in PowerShell or Python for automation and enrichment. 
 - Exposure to threat intelligence platforms, threat hunting programs and detection-as-code  practices. 
 - Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS or NIST CSF. 

Key competencies

- Leadership: builds a motivated, accountable team and develops analysts into senior  contributors. 
 - Analytical judgment: makes sound, timely decisions under pressure with incomplete  information. 
 - Customer focus: communicates clearly and calmly with customers during active incidents. 
 - Continuous improvement: uses data to reduce false positives, improve detection coverage and  streamline workflows.
