data.description:
FPC Global are the world's leading digital building experts, we offer full-service integrated technology consultancy and professional services to the built environment. 

We partner with clients to improve asset performance, operational efficiency, sustainability outcomes, and digital maturity across complex portfolios. 

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Commissioning Technical Team Leader to lead the commissioning delivery team of hyperscale and colocation AI data-centre projects. 

The role will provide technical leadership, people management and client-facing governance across the complete commissioning lifecycle from L0-L6, with a strong focus on L4 Functional Performance Testing (FPT) and L5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST). 

This position is site-centric and requires hands-on leadership through Integrated Systems Testing, including failure mode and fault tolerance validation, ensuring systems meet design intent, availability objectives and operational readiness requirements in line with Uptime Institute, IEC, IEEE, and NFPA standards. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of 15-20+ leads and commissioning engineers. 

- Own mechanical commissioning strategy, planning, execution and technical governance. 

- Lead L4/L5 commissioning, including FPT, IST, failure-mode and concurrent-maintainability testing. 

- Provide technical oversight across HVAC, chilled-water systems, chillers, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC, AHUs, DX/In-Row cooling, containment and high-density liquid/immersion cooling systems. 

- Lead commissioning of HSD/fuel systems, including bulk/day tanks, transfer systems, filtration, leak detection and generator auto-fuelling interfaces. 

- Oversee fire protection and life-safety systems, including fire pumps, wet/dry/pre-action systems, clean-agent systems, VESDA, dampers and smoke-control systems. 

- Oversee plumbing and utility systems, including water storage, makeup water, drainage, sump systems, leak detection and associated utilities. 

- Review P&IDs, equipment submittals, control sequences, Sequence of Operations (SOO), cause & effect and commissioning test scripts. 

- Lead TAB/hydronic balancing, equipment performance testing, controls/BMS integration and functional testing. 

- Validate mechanical integration with BMS, EPMS, electrical systems, fire/life-safety and data-center controls. 

- Manage commissioning issues, RCA, risk registers, punch lists and technical close-out. 

- Act as senior technical interface with hyperscale clients, CxA teams, MEP contractors, consultants and OEMs. 

- Drive commissioning quality, safety and readiness for operational handover. 

Requirements

- 15+ years overall mechanical engineering, testing and commissioning experience. 

- 8+ years data-center or mission-critical mechanical commissioning experience. 

- Proven leadership of at least 2 complete L2 to L5 commissioning cycles. 

- Proven experience of leading at least 2 ISTs of hyperscale datacenter projects. 

- Experience managing 15-20+ Cx engineers. 

- Strong hands-on knowledge of HVAC, chilled-water systems, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC, BMS/controls, fuel systems, fire protection and utilities. 

- Experience with high-density/liquid cooling is highly desirable. 

- Strong understanding of Uptime Institute, ASHRAE, NFPA and applicable local codes/standards. 

- Strong knowledge of Sequence of Operations, controls integration, TAB, hydronic balancing and failure-mode testing. 

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. 

- Strong client-facing communication and technical leadership skills. 

Qualifications

Preferred Certifications

CxA/CBCP | CDCP/CDCS | Uptime Institute ATD | ASHRAE-related credentials

Additional Information

Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3. 7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem. 

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us. 

THE ROLE

To be a expert performance engineer to define and validate the industry-leading performance of our mission-critical FlashArray portfolio. You will be instrumental in extending our capabilities into the cloud, directly impacting customer adoption and satisfaction by ensuring our products meet the highest benchmarks. This high-visibility role involves close collaboration with Product Management and Solutions Engineering to translate real-world customer needs into engineering goals. 

What You'll Do

- Define and Drive Benchmarking Strategy: Establish comprehensive, next-generation performance benchmarking requirements and metrics for all FlashArray products across diverse platforms, ensuring we maintain a significant competitive edge in the market. 
 - Team Execution and Mentorship: Provide technical direction and leadership to a team of highly motivated engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality, high-impact performance results. 
 - Validate Critical Customer Scenarios: Collaborate with Product Management, Solutions, and Sales Engineering to research and develop performance validation strategies that accurately model and confirm critical customer use cases and requirements, directly enhancing product readiness. 
 - Optimize System Performance: Oversee the deep-dive analysis of performance bottlenecks within the Linux storage and networking stack, identifying optimization opportunities that result in tangible gains in throughput and latency for our users. 

What You Bring

- Deep System-Level Performance Expertise: Proven experience in designing and executing system-level performance testing for enterprise-grade solutions, including servers, storage (SAN protocols like iSCSI, NFS, SMB), and databases. 
 - Strong Linux Systems Mastery: Expert-level proficiency with Linux systems, including in-depth knowledge of the network configuration, storage stack, system settings, and common command-line utilities crucial for performance tuning. 
 - Technical Ownership and Mentoring: Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and provide architectural direction to software and performance engineers, elevating the technical quality and impact of the entire team. 
 - Problem-Solving and Analysis: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of translating complex performance data into actionable engineering improvements that lead to high-quality product releases. 
 - We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Pure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave. 

What You Can Expect From Us

- Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http: //benefits. everpuredata. com/ for more information. 

Accommodations And Accessibility

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage. com if you're invited to an interview. 

Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team

We're forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn't just accepted but embraced. That's why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership. 

Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire. 

Join us and bring your best. 

Bring your bold. 

Pure and simple.

data.description:
Company Overview

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential. 

Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone's best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3, 000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed. 

Job Overview

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and quality-driven Lead Quality Analyst to lead quality assurance and testing activities for large-scale Salesforce-powered Enterprise Service Management (ESM), IT Service Management (ITSM), and Conversational Agentic Platform initiatives. 

The Lead Quality Analyst will be responsible for defining quality strategy, governing testing practices, mentoring Quality Analysts, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet business, functional, security, integration, and user experience expectations. 

This role requires a strong combination of quality leadership, business process understanding, stakeholder management, and hands-on testing expertise. The ideal candidate will work closely with Business Analysts, Architects, Salesforce Leads, Product Owners, and customer stakeholders to establish a quality-first culture across all delivery teams. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Leadership & Governance

- Lead quality assurance activities across multiple Salesforce and ITSM workstreams. 
 - Define quality strategies, test governance processes, standards, and best practices. 
 - Establish testing frameworks, review processes, quality metrics, and release readiness criteria. 
 - Act as the primary quality escalation point for delivery teams. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives across quality engineering practices. 
 - Ensure quality standards are consistently applied across all project phases. 

Test Strategy & Planning

- Define comprehensive testing strategies covering: 
 - Functional Testing
 - Integration Testing
 - End-to-End Testing
 - Regression Testing
 - User Acceptance Testing
 - Release Validation
 - Review and approve test plans, test scenarios, test cases, and test execution results. 
 - Ensure complete traceability between requirements and testing outcomes. 
 - Drive risk-based testing approaches for complex enterprise implementations. 
Salesforce & ITSM Solution Validation

- Lead validation activities for solutions involving: 
 - Salesforce Service Cloud
 - Experience Cloud
 - Agentforce
 - Enterprise Service Management
 - ITSM Platforms
 - Validate business processes including: 
 - Incident Management
 - Service Request Management
 - Change Management
 - Problem Management
 - Knowledge Management
 - CMDB
 - IT Asset Management
 - Service Catalog Management
 - Employee Service Delivery
 - Ensure solutions meet business objectives, customer requirements, and compliance expectations. 
Integration & Enterprise Testing

- Lead testing of enterprise integrations involving Salesforce, MuleSoft, APIs, ERP, HR, Monitoring, and third-party applications. 
 - Establish integration testing standards and validation approaches. 
 - Ensure data integrity, synchronization, security, and business continuity across connected platforms. 
 - Oversee complex end-to-end business process validation. 

Team Leadership & Mentoring

- Lead and mentor Quality Analysts across multiple projects. 
 - Review and approve testing deliverables. 
 - Provide coaching on testing methodologies, automation adoption, and quality best practices. 
 - Support capability development and certification initiatives. 
 - Foster a quality-first mindset across business and technical teams. 

UAT & Release Management

- Guide UAT planning and business validation activities. 
 - Facilitate defect triage, prioritization, and resolution processes. 
 - Participate in release governance and production readiness reviews. 
 - Ensure quality criteria are achieved prior to production deployments. 

AI & Innovation

- Define testing approaches for Agentforce, Conversational AI, and AI-powered service experiences. 
 - Validate intelligent workflows, autonomous service processes, and automation capabilities. 
 - Support adoption of quality engineering and test automation best practices. 

Required Qualifications

Must Have

- 7-10 years of Quality Assurance and Testing experience in enterprise environments. 
 - Minimum 2-3 years leading QA teams or testing workstreams. 
 - Strong experience testing Salesforce and/or Enterprise Service Management platforms. 
 - Experience developing enterprise test strategies and governance frameworks. 
 - Deep understanding of: 
 - Functional Testing
 - Integration Testing
 - End-to-End Testing
 - UAT
 - Defect Management
 - Quality Metrics
 - Root Cause Analysis
 - Experience managing stakeholder expectations and quality reporting. 
 - Experience working within Agile, Scrum, and DevOps delivery models. 
 - Strong communication, leadership, and mentoring skills. 
Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing Salesforce transformation programs. 
 - Experience validating ITSM, CMDB, or IT Asset Management implementations. 
 - Experience with API and MuleSoft integration testing. 
 - Exposure to automated testing frameworks and test automation strategies. 
 - Salesforce, ISTQB, Quality Engineering, or related certifications. 

Added Advantage

- Experience testing Agentforce implementations. 
 - Exposure to Conversational AI and Generative AI platforms. 
 - Knowledge of Enterprise Service Management operating models. 
 - ITIL Foundation Certification. 

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for professionals who: 

- Think beyond defect identification and focus on business outcomes. 
 - Can lead quality governance across enterprise programs. 
 - Enjoy mentoring teams and driving continuous improvement. 
 - Have excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. 
 - Champion quality engineering and innovation. 
 - Are passionate about Salesforce, Agentforce, AI, and Enterprise Service Management. 

Why Join Us?

- Lead quality assurance efforts for strategic Salesforce-powered Conversational ITSM and Enterprise Service Management initiatives. 
 - Work with cutting-edge technologies including Agentforce, AI, MuleSoft, Salesforce, and Enterprise Automation platforms. 
 - Influence testing strategy, governance, and quality engineering practices across projects. 
 - Mentor and develop future quality leaders within the organization. 
 - Collaborate with business leaders, architects, developers, and product teams driving enterprise transformation. 
 - Join a high-growth organization where quality, innovation, and customer experience are central to success. 
 - Enjoy a flexible hybrid work model across Kochi, Bangalore, and Hyderabad. 

Join Us

If you are an experienced Lead Quality Analyst who combines strong testing expertise with leadership, governance, and mentoring capabilities, we would love to hear from you. Join us in delivering next-generation Salesforce-powered Conversational ITSM and Agentic Service Platforms, ensuring exceptional quality, business value, and customer experience at every stage of the delivery lifecycle.

 - Non-functional requirements: Consider non-functional requirements. We produce high-volume, real-time transaction processing systems that support millions of trades every day in investment securities in multiple world markets. You will work with other developers to make sure that solutions developed are secure, reusable, maintainable and performant.

 - Ensure code is designed and built in a reusable manner.

 - Establish yourself as an expert in multiple system/technical areas of the FNZ platform

Quality

Collaboration and Communication

Analyst Developers own non-functional requirements and are responsible for ensuring that their code complies with coding standards, is secure and performs well. At entry-level, you are responsible for learning best-practice in these areas from your senior peers. 

Experience Required

 - Experience of working with different levels of stakeholders within a project environment.

Our culture is what drives us. It's at the heart of who we are and everything we do. It's what inspires, excites and moves us forward. Opportunities

data.description:
About Tide

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting. 

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France. 

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love. 

Tide Facts

- Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
 - Over 2 million members across UK and India
 - Over $300 million raised in funding
 - Over 2, 800 Tideans globally
 - Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India's Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
 - We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Role

Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide. 

You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny. 

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide. 

As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring You Will

- Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms
 - Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London
 - Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you
 - Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering
 - Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows
 - Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring
 - Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework
 - Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member
 - Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap
 - Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated

This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment. 

What We Are Looking For

- Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain
 - Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation
 - Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development 
 - Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators
 - Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality
 - Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities
 - Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus

What You'll Get In Return

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans: 

- Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options. 
 - Time Off - Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays. 
 - Parental Leave - Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey. 
 - Sabbatical - Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide. 
 - Health Insurance - Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options. 
 - Life & Accident Cover - Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection. 
 - Mental Wellbeing - Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops. 
 - Volunteering & Development Days - Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth. 
 - Learning & Development - Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more. 
 - WOO (Work Outside the Office) - Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually. 
 - Home Office Setup - Contribution towards setting up your home office. 
 - Laptop Ownership - Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement. 
 - Snacks & Meals - Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent). 

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community. 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard. 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard. 

Disclaimer

It Has Come To Our Attention That Individuals Or Agencies Are Falsely Claiming To Represent Tide And Are Reaching Out To Candidates Regarding Job Opportunities. Please Be Aware That

- Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. 
 - All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel. 
 - Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide. co email address. 
 - Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf. 

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide. co

Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. 

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy. 

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

data.title: Site Commissioning Manager
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Verantwortlich für Tätigkeiten im Zusammenhang mit dem Bau, der Errichtung und Inbetriebnahme beim Kunden, von der Mobilisierung des Standorts über Bau-, Montage- und Inbetriebnahmearbeiten bis hin zu Managementaktivitäten in diesem Bereich. Beeinflusst den Abteilungsbetrieb und ist verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung. Die Rolle hat eine gewisse Autonomie, konzentriert sich jedoch auf die Ausführung von Aktivitäten innerhalb einer operativen Disziplin, die durch funktionale Standardpraktiken und -verfahren abgedeckt wird. Möglicherweise ist ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen erforderlich, dies erfolgt jedoch in der Regel unter Anleitung. 

Job Description

Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten

- Rollen, die ansonsten technisch nicht auf eine separate Rolle spezialisiert sind oder eine Reihe von Rollen innerhalb der Familie abdecken können. Diese Rollen können einzelne Mitwirkende sein oder Aktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit der Prüfung und Validierung von Geräten, Einrichtungen oder Anlagen in Übereinstimmung mit den Designzielen oder Spezifikationen für den betrieblichen Einsatz beaufsichtigen. Dies umfasst Leistungsdienste und Leistungstests. Kann andere direkt oder indirekt leiten und/oder Subunternehmer mit spezifischem Fachwissen verwalten. 
 - Vertiefung der Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin. Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und erworbenes technisches Fachwissen, um Richtlinien/Strategien umzusetzen. 
 - Fundiertes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten. Vertiefte Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt. 
 - Verwendet ein gewisses Maß an Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, aber mit Anleitung. Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und die Ausbildung am Arbeitsplatz, um einfache Aufgaben zu lösen. Hat Zugriff auf die technischen Fähigkeiten und das analytische Denken, die zur Lösung von Problemen erforderlich sind. Kann mehrere interne Quellen außerhalb des eigenen Teams verwenden, um Entscheidungen zu treffen. 
 - Eine Stelle auf dieser Ebene ist wahrscheinlich ein einzelner Mitarbeiter mit nachgewiesenen zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten oder Führungsnachwuchs, der Talente einstellen und entwickeln kann. Bietet informelle Anleitung für neue Teammitglieder

Grundqualifikationen

- Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung). 

Gewünschte Eigenschaften

- Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen und kleine Teams zu führen. Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten. Hinweis: Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind. Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden. Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern. Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No

data.title: Group Manager - Actuarials (Unify) GGN - WFO
data.description:
Company Description

WNS, part of Capgemini, is an Agentic AI-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence - WNS' core differentiator - with AI-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption. Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66, 000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact. 

Job Description

Purpose

- Lead delivery of actuarial transformation initiatives leveraging the Unify platform. 
 - Act as the primary Business & Functional SME bridging actuarial stakeholders and workflow development teams. 
 - Drive process automation, workflow standardisation, governance and business adoption across actuarial reporting and modelling processes. 
 - Define and execute the future-state operating model for actuarial production and transformation. 

Work Experience

- Minimum 10 years of experience in Life Insurance actuarial functions. 
 - Minimum 4+ years in leadership and stakeholder management roles. 
 - Significant experience across actuarial reporting, valuation, capital modelling, Prophet production, IFRS17 and/or Solvency II processes. 
 - Experience leading actuarial transformation and automation initiatives. 
 - Experience working directly with UK Life Insurance clients and stakeholders. 

People Responsibilities

- Lead and develop a team of actuarial SMEs, business analysts and transformation specialists. 
 - Mentor team members on actuarial process design, workflow automation and business analysis techniques. 
 - Drive capability development in Unify, Python, actuarial production processes and governance frameworks. 
 - Support workforce planning, recruitment and resource allocation. 
 - Conduct performance reviews and development discussions. 
 - Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement and automation. 

Process Responsibilities - Business SME Leadership

- Provide actuarial production expertise and business domain leadership across Unify initiatives. 
 - Translate actuarial business requirements into detailed functional specifications for workflow developers. 
 - Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, actuarial teams and development teams. 
 - Drive solution design decisions ensuring alignment with actuarial processes, controls and governance requirements. 
 - Provide oversight and challenge throughout the development lifecycle. 

Process Responsibilities - Unify Transformation & Workflow Automation

- Lead design and implementation of Unify workflows supporting actuarial reporting and modelling processes. 
 - Drive automation of basis production, model execution, result extraction and reporting activities. 
 - Support migration of legacy Excel/VBA processes into governed Unify and Python-based solutions. 
 - Define reusable workflow frameworks, templates and development standards. 
 - Support multi-basis, multi-risk and multi-scenario actuarial production solutions. 
 - Identify automation opportunities and deliver measurable efficiency improvements. 

Process Responsibilities - Requirements & Solution Design

- Lead workshops to gather, document and validate business requirements. 
 - Develop business process maps, functional specifications and user stories. 
 - Analyse existing actuarial processes to identify inefficiencies, risks and automation opportunities. 
 - Design scalable and sustainable future-state solutions. 
 - Ensure traceability between business requirements and delivered solutions. 

Process Responsibilities - Testing & Business Readiness

- Define and execute SIT, UAT and business readiness strategies. 
 - Coordinate testing activities across actuarial and development teams. 
 - Ensure solutions meet business requirements, controls and timetable expectations. 
 - Manage defect prioritisation and resolution activities. 
 - Support operational readiness and transition into production. 

Process Responsibilities - Governance & Controls

- Establish and maintain governance frameworks for Unify solutions. 
 - Ensure appropriate controls covering input validation, access management, auditability, version control and result validation. 
 - Lead governance forums and Go/No-Go decision processes. 
 - Maintain solution documentation, audit trails and operational procedures. 
 - Support internal audit, regulatory and control reviews. 

Process Responsibilities - Actuarial Domain Expertise

- Strong understanding of actuarial production processes including valuation, IFRS17, Solvency II, capital modelling and reporting. 
 - Experience supporting Prophet model execution and downstream reporting processes. 
 - Understand data flows, assumptions, basis management and results analysis. 
 - Provide guidance on actuarial process optimisation and target operating models. 
 - Support strategic transformation programmes involving actuarial and finance functions. 

Process Responsibilities - Automation & Innovation

- Drive adoption of modern technologies including Python, cloud platforms and workflow automation tools. 
 - Promote standardisation and reusability across actuarial processes. 
 - Develop dashboards and operational monitoring solutions. 
 - Support continuous improvement and process modernization initiatives. 
 - Evaluate emerging technologies and automation capabilities. 

Project Leadership

- Lead large-scale actuarial transformation and Unify implementation programmes. 
 - Manage project plans, milestones, risks and stakeholder communications. 
 - Coordinate with actuarial, finance, risk, technology and operations teams. 
 - Support operating model design and roadmap development. 
 - Drive successful delivery within agreed timelines and quality standards.

Set the bar in pull request review and own the team's conventions for testing, error handling, API design, and secure coding, keeping automated suites, integration harnesses, and CI/CD pipelines strong enough that manual testing is never the safety net. Maintain the architecture specifications, API contracts, and open source developer documentation that go with them.

Equal Opportunity Employer

data.title: QA Lead
data.description:
QA Lead

Location: Indore, Pune

Experience: 8+ years (2+ years leading a QA team)

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced QA Lead to own test strategy, automation and release quality on a large-scale enterprise platform delivered for a global automotive client. 

The QA Lead will lead an offshore QA team within a distributed onsite/offshore model, partnering daily with US-based technical leads, developers and product stakeholders to ensure every release is well-tested, predictable and delivered on sprint commitments. 

What You Will Do

Define and own the test strategy, test plans, estimates and quality gates for platform releases. 

Design, build and maintain UI and API test automation frameworks (Selenium/Playwright, REST Assured) using Java or Python. 

Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines so that regression runs are fast, repeatable and trusted. 

Lead, mentor and allocate work across the offshore QA team; review test cases and automation code to keep the bar high. 

Drive functional, regression, integration, system and UAT test cycles, including backend and data validation using SQL. 

Run defect triage with developers and product, drive root-cause analysis and track fixes through to closure. 

Track and report quality metrics - coverage, defect leakage, pass rates - and provide clear go/no-go recommendations for releases. 

Participate in Agile ceremonies - sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups and reviews - providing realistic QA estimates and flagging risk early. 

Document test approaches, frameworks and QA processes so that knowledge is transferable across the onsite and offshore team. 

Collaborate proactively across time zones with US-based leads, developers and product, communicating quality status and blockers without needing to be chased. 

A Note on Hands-On Leadership

This is a hands-on lead role. The QA Lead is expected to write and maintain automation alongside the team, not only coordinate testing. Candidates should be able to walk through a framework they personally built or maintained, explain the design choices behind it, and write or debug a test live. 

What We Are Looking For

Required Qualifications

8+ years of software QA experience, including 2+ years leading or mentoring a QA team. 

Proven ability to define test strategy, test plans and estimates for enterprise applications. 

Strong hands-on test automation with Selenium WebDriver, Playwright or Cypress using Java or Python. 

Solid API testing experience with Postman and REST Assured, including microservices-based systems. 

Experience with TestNG/JUnit and BDD frameworks such as Cucumber. 

Good SQL skills for backend and data validation against relational databases. 

Experience integrating tests into CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, with Git-based workflows. 

Experience with defect and test management in Jira (Xray, Zephyr or similar). 

Experience delivering in Agile/Scrum teams within a distributed onsite/offshore model. 

Excellent written and verbal English communication, with the ability to work directly with US-based leads and stakeholders across time zones. 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline. 

Preferred / Differentiating Qualifications

Performance and load testing experience with JMeter, Gatling or k6. 

Mobile test automation experience with Appium. 

Contract testing and microservices test approaches; exposure to Docker/Kubernetes. 

Experience testing on cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure. 

Awareness of security testing basics and test data management practices. 

Experience testing large-scale enterprise platforms; ISTQB certification (Foundation or Advanced Test Manager) is a plus. 

Characteristics of the Person We Are Looking For

Genuinely hands-on. Builds and maintains automation, not just test plans. 

A leader. Grows the team, sets standards and holds the quality bar without micromanaging. 

A clear communicator. Explains quality risk plainly in English, in writing and on a call, to onsite leads and non-engineers alike. 

Detail-oriented. Catches the edge cases others miss and insists on evidence before sign-off. 

A strong investigator. Reproduces issues reliably, reasons from logs and data, and pinpoints root cause with developers. 

Proactive across time zones. Surfaces risks and progress early rather than going quiet between stand-ups. 

Pragmatic. Balances test coverage against delivery reality and knows where risk-based testing is the right call. 

What Success Looks Like

A successful QA Lead delivers predictable, well-tested releases with low defect leakage. Automation coverage grows sprint over sprint, regression is fast and trusted, and quality status is clear and credible to onsite leads. The offshore QA team becomes a self-sufficient, high-performing unit rather than a bottleneck.

data.title: Product Development Manager - Bedding
data.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. 

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come - and return - to Quince because they trust us to deliver. 

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way - at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before. 

- We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose - soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price - we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. 
 - Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
 - Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you. 

THE ROLE

We are seeking a Product Development Manager, Bedding to join our growing team at Quince. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring products are launched in a timely manner while achieving the highest quality standards. 

Role Overview

The Product Development Manager is a hands-on, factory-based execution role embedded directly within Quince's vendor ecosystem. Operating primarily on-site at finished-goods and materials factories, this role owns real-time coordination, follow-up, and issue resolution required to keep development moving at speed and with precision. 

The role is accountable for on-the-ground execution-driving accelerated sample development, validating documentation handoffs, expediting approvals, and ensuring development milestones are met without delay. By spending the majority of time in factories, the Product Development Manager enables faster decision-making, strengthens alignment between Quince and its vendors, proactively identifies development risks, and ensures products move efficiently from concept to production while meeting Quince's quality, cost, and timeline expectations. 

What success looks like: 

- Accelerated time-to-market for new products, color/size extensions, and partner transitions. 
 - Reduced product development cycles from 28 weeks to 16 weeks. 
 - Perfect technical hand-offs to both raw material and finished good vendors. 
 - Streamlined sample development with sample rounds dropping from 2. 4 to 2. 0 per product, ensuring high approval rates. 
 - Achieve a 7 day average sample turnaround time
 - Coordinator and manage efficient, robust product testing to uphold high-quality standards. 
 - Seamless and timely coordination across all teams. 
 - Replicate quality execution development for all re-sourcing of existing products to new vendors

Primary Accountabilities

- Development Timeline Ownership & Acceleration Own and actively manage the day-to-day product development timeline across new products, color and size extensions, vendor transitions, and refreshes. Ensure programs progress within the 16-week cycle target by tracking milestones, escalating risks early, and driving timely decision-making across teams. 
 - Cross-Functional Workflow & Orchestration Serve as the central point of coordination across Merchandising, Sourcing, Fit, Technical Development, Materials, QA, Creative, and Vendors. 

Ensure all parties are aligned on development status, next steps, and dependencies at every stage of the lifecycle. 

- Build Sheet Handoff and Coaching Ensure all required product documentation is accurate, complete, and ready prior to vendor handoff. This includes technical specification sheets, build documentation, testing requirements, fit inputs, and any supporting materials needed for vendor execution. Ensure vendors understand and translate it correctly. 
 - Sample Development & Tracking Discipline Coordinate and track all sample requests, shipments, inbound reviews, fit requests, and revisions. Drive efficiency in sample development by maintaining momentum, minimizing rework, and supporting the target of ≤2. 0 sample rounds per product. 
 - Approvals, Feedback Loops & Testing Coordination Facilitate timely product reviews and approvals by Merchandising, Fit, and Technical teams. Track testing requests and results, ensuring products complete required performance or quality testing and that outcomes are clearly communicated to all stakeholders. 
 - In-Country Development Trip Management

Run in-person country development trips with Global Merchants and Global Fit teams to

accelerate decision-making, resolve issues at the source, and strengthen vendor

execution. 

- Production & Launch Readiness Coordination Support timely staging of materials and finished-goods production in partnership with Sourcing. Coordinate on-time delivery of photo samples to Creative teams to ensure marketing readiness and launch timelines are met. 
 - Tools, Systems & Process Hygiene Maintain clean, accurate, real-time data across all product development systems, including the Product Catalog and tracking tools. Ensure systems reflect current status, ownership, and next actions to support transparency and fast execution. Travel Expectations (Core Role Requirement) This role is factory-based with heavy travel and requires consistent presence at vendor sites. 
 - Travel Frequency: Up to 4 days per week on-site at factories
 - Regions: Key sourcing regions, depending on vendor base
 - Duration: Ongoing, embedded travel rather than occasional trips

Work Style: Hands-on, in-person coordination within sample rooms and factory offices

This role is not suited for remote or primarily office-based candidates. 

Required Experience & Skills

- >8 years in product development or factory-facing roles
 - Strong category expertise
 - Strong experience working directly with factories and sample rooms
 - Comfortable operating independently on-site
 - Highly organised, detail-oriented, and execution-focused
 - Clear communicator across language, cultural, and functional boundaries

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike. 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis. 

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. 

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom-never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

data.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
data.description:
About Position: 

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Machine Learning Engineer to own and enhance the product-sizing capability of a cloud-based, cloud-agnostic telecom analytics platform. The platform is designed to support consistent deployments across public, private, and hybrid cloud environments. This role blends machine learning, performance engineering, capacity planning, software development, and telemetry analytics to build accurate sizing models and optimize platform deployments. The ideal candidate will work closely with product, engineering, support, and customer teams to deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that improve infrastructure planning, resource utilization, and customer experience. 

- Role: Senior ML Engineer
 - Location: Pune
 - Experience: 5 to 10 Years
 - Job Type: Full Time Employment

What You'll Do: 

- Design, implement, validate, and maintain sizing models for product components and end-to-end platform deployments. 
 - Model infrastructure requirements including CPU, memory, storage capacity, disk IOPS, throughput, network bandwidth, pod counts, worker threads, Redis shards, and operational headroom based on customer workloads. 
 - Develop and improve data-driven sizing methodologies using statistical analysis and machine learning techniques. 
 - Support telecom workload dimensions such as PPS, EPS, OPS, protocol mix, call rates, active subscribers, concurrent sessions, recording volumes, retention periods, replication requirements, and high-availability topologies. 
 - Enhance existing regression-based sizing approaches using multivariate regression, clustering, time-series forecasting, nonlinear models, and other machine learning techniques where appropriate. 
 - Evaluate model performance using holdout datasets, cross-validation strategies, confidence intervals, prediction intervals, sensitivity analysis, and error metrics. 
 - Detect and investigate outliers, missing data, configuration drift, throttling, system saturation, and non-representative workloads while preserving critical operational evidence. 
 - Define model applicability boundaries, minimum data-quality thresholds, and conservative fallback mechanisms to prevent unsafe extrapolation. 
 - Build and maintain version-controlled Python-based telemetry collectors for Linux and Kubernetes environments. 
 - Modernize legacy collection frameworks by replacing Bash, Perl, and Python 2 based implementations where feasible. 
 - Safely execute approved telemetry collection tools in customer environments, both remotely and on-site, while collaborating with support and operations teams. 
 - Collect workload, infrastructure, network, storage, application, and Redis telemetry with minimal impact on production systems. 
 - Engineer telemetry collectors that are read-only by default and designed with resource limits, timeout controls, retry handling, dry-run capabilities, graceful shutdown, progress indicators, and auditable logging. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product Management, Engineering, Support Services, Professional Services, and Customer Operations. 
 - Contribute to performance analysis, capacity planning recommendations, deployment guidance, and continuous platform improvements. 

Expertise You'll Bring: 

- 5 to 10 years of experience in Machine Learning, Performance Engineering, Capacity Planning, or Solution Sizing. 
 - Strong experience modeling CPU, memory, storage, network, and Kubernetes resource requirements from operational and workload data. 
 - Hands-on experience analyzing distributed systems performance, scalability, latency, throughput, reliability, and high-availability architectures. 
 - Knowledge of telecom workload characteristics including PPS, EPS, OPS, protocol mix, subscriber volumes, call rates, retention requirements, replication, and HA deployments. 
 - Experience defining model applicability limits, uncertainty measurements, confidence intervals, sensitivity analysis, and error-based model validation. 
 - Strong understanding of outlier detection, data quality validation, anomaly identification, and safe model extrapolation practices. 
 - Advanced Python development skills with experience using pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, Jupyter Notebooks, and automated testing frameworks. 
 - Proven experience building, validating, and deploying statistical and machine learning models using operational and production data. 
 - Strong knowledge of multivariate regression, time-series forecasting, clustering techniques, nonlinear modeling approaches, and predictive analytics. 
 - Experience evaluating model quality using cross-validation, holdout testing, performance metrics, and iterative model improvement techniques. 
 - Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting experience. 
 - Hands-on expertise with Kubernetes, including containers, pods, resource allocation, CPU throttling, memory utilization, storage management, networking, and observability tools. 
 - Experience collecting and analyzing production telemetry in cloud-native and distributed environments. 
 - Understanding of secure production diagnostics, customer privacy requirements, least-privilege principles, and change-controlled operational processes. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and drive technical solutions from concept to deployment. 

Benefits: 

- Competitive salary and benefits package
 - Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
 - Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
 - Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
 - Annual health check-ups
 - Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment: 

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds. 

- We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles. 
 - Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities. 
 - If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent - persistent. com/careers

"Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. "

data.title: Technical Lead-Test Automation
data.description:
What We Are Looking For

We are looking for an experienced Test Automation Engineer to lead the planning, design, execution, and delivery of test automation & inspection automation projects implemented across Dover factories worldwide. 

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in driving project execution and technical integrity of test automation solutions delivered by global test automation suppliers with focus on Indian automation suppliers. This includes defining test strategies and excellence playbook, overseeing execution, and ensuring alignment with global quality, safety, and compliance standards. Your leadership will be key to delivering cost-effective and deployment-ready solutions that support Dover's advanced manufacturing goals worldwide. 

What You Will Be Responsible For In This Role

- Collaborate with global teams to align project objectives and test protocols. 
 - Engage with Dover factories across APAC, NA and EMEA regions to understand expectations and ensure test strategies and execution plans are aligned with global manufacturing and deployment requirements. 
 - Lead the planning, definition, and delivery of functional test automation. 
 - Provide technical leadership and project ownership from concept to production deployment for end-of-line testers, leak testers, hydraulic benches, electrical safety rigs, and inspection systems. 
 - Coordinating, preparing, reviewing Statement of Work (SOW) with Global Dover Automation teams. 
 - Schedule meetings onsite, offsite, conferences with dover factories & supplier. 
 - Manage Project plannings, timeline, status, reports, timelines, prepare proposals, projects trackers, etc. 
 - Lead the planning, definition, and delivery of Inspection automation programs. 
 - Provide technical leadership and project ownership from concept to production deployment Inspection systems (Vision, laser, ultrasonic, etc. ) for quality & improvements. 
 - Plan and supervise PoC evaluations for new functional testing approaches. 
 - Oversee the development and field trials of prototype test benches for validating new processes such as digital leak testing, high-pressure validation, electrical failure simulation, or sensor-based measurements. 
 - Oversee the execution of validation and testing for hydraulic, pneumatic, electric, and mechanical systems. 
 - Ensure robust test planning and execution for systems involving pressure decay, burst testing, flow verification, electrical continuity, insulation resistance, and force/displacement measurements. 
 - Identify, develop, and manage automation solution partners for building functional test equipment. 
 - Evaluate and coordinate with vendors specializing in fluid power, electrical panels, test rig fabrication, control systems, and metrology tools-ensuring reliable, safe, and cost-effective solutions. 
 - Review and approve supplier-developed test concepts, quotes, protocols and validation methods. 
 - Assess the adequacy of testing parameters such as test pressure, flow rates, leak limits, electrical load conditions, calibration tolerances, and functional checkpoints based on part requirements and industry benchmarks. 
 - Review the supplier concepts, quotes, prepare Proposals for Dover factories, coordinate with multiple departments for budget reviews & capex controls. 
 - Validate technical proposals, rig designs, control strategies, and sensor integrations. 
 - Conduct engineering reviews of hydraulic and pneumatic circuit layouts, electrical cabinet schematics, DAQ/PLC logic, sensor placements (pressure, flow, current, displacement), and interface controls (HMI/SCADA). 
 - Conduct Proof of Concepts (PoC), Design of Experiments (DoE). 
 - Perform Risk analysis, report preparing, risk mitigation solutions. 
 - Coordinate FAT/SAT of functional test systems with suppliers and Dover factories. 
 - Lead detailed Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) at supplier facilities to verify functionality, safety, electrical compliance, hydraulic/pneumatic integrity, and adherence to cycle time and accuracy benchmarks prior to shipment. 
 - Define FAT checklist covering PLC/DAQ program logic validation, calibration certification, emergency stop functionality, interlock testing, leak and pressure test accuracy, HMI sequences, and GR&R results. 
 - Plan and execute Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) at Dover facilities, ensuring integration with factory utilities, compliance with ergonomic and floor layout constraints, and final verification of performance repeatability in production conditions. 
 - Document all FAT/SAT observations with pass/fail criteria, deviation logs, and corrective actions; involve cross-functional sign-off with engineering, safety, and plant quality teams before system handover. 
 - Ensure test systems meet operational, safety, and compliance requirements. 
 - Deliver solutions that meet critical-to-quality metrics such as pressure stability, leak thresholds, electrical insulation performance, cycle time targets, and traceability. 
 - Ensure adherence to safety and compliance standards (e. g. , CE, ISO 4413/4414, IEC 61010, UL, etc. ). 
 - Monitor compliance throughout the test system lifecycle, including mechanical, fluid power, and electrical safety regulations applicable to industrial testing environments. 
 - Coordinate automation, controls, and data acquisition for functional test equipment. 
 - Ensure robust integration of PLCs, HMIs, industrial PCs, safety relays, and DAQ systems with measurement instrumentation like pressure sensors, flow meters, load cells, CMMs, and voltage/current transducers. 
 - Drive the strategy for data connectivity, SCADA integration, and test traceability. 
 - Define architecture for test result logging, real-time monitoring, and linkage with MES systems to ensure complete digital traceability and analytics-ready test data. 
 - Promote the use of structured validation tools such as PFMEA, control plans, and RCA. 
 - Ensure proactive risk mitigation and fast issue resolution through systematic analysis tools during design, validation, and production handover stages. 
 - Ensure traceable documentation of test results, deviations, and compliance logs. 
 - Maintain structured reporting for each system including pass/fail data, leak rate charts, pressure curves, electrical test logs, deviation records, and root-cause tracking. 
 - Lead continuous improvement efforts in test strategy and partner capabilities. 
 - Benchmark functional test performance, cycle times, cost of testing, and uptime-driving improvements in supplier offerings and in-house standards. 
 - Support knowledge transfer and capability building across sites
 - Enable cross-functional learning by sharing best practices in functional test rig design, performance tuning, maintenance practices, and fault diagnosis. 
 - Schedule webinars, share case studies, introduce dover factories to new & proven industry solutions. 
What are the basic qualifications?

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, electronics engineering, mechanical engineering, mechatronics engineering, manufacturing engineering, industrial technology or equivalent mix of education and experience Test automation coordination or project management experience in manufacturing system testing. 
 - Minimum seven (7) years of production, operation and manufacturing support. 
 - Minimum five (5) experience in testing or validating through robotic systems, vision inspection solutions, or automated machines. 
 - Minimum five (5) years of hands-on experience in testing e. g. Mechanical Testing, functional testing, Hydraulics, Leak, Pneumatic, electric test, inspections, measurements, Pressure, etc. 

What are the preferred qualifications?

- Familiarity with industrial testing like leak, pressure, EOL, endurance, scanning, measurements, etc. etc. and vision-based inspection testing methodologies. 
 - Solid understanding of mechanical devices and automation hardware, including sensors, indexers, pick-and-place mechanisms, PLCs, inverters, and servo systems. 
 - Hands-on technical experience in testing with robotic and Cobot systems, including validation of motion sequences, safety, and repeatability. 
 - Experience conducting and executing FAT/SAT activities and validating automation systems from outsourced vendors. 
 - Exposure to controls validation, test script development, and failure analysis within factory automation environments. 
 - Working knowledge of MES, SCADA, and data acquisition systems used in automated test environments
 - Proficiency in interpreting electrical schematics and mechanical drawings; familiarity with AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or EPLAN
 - Experience with test simulation tools (e. g. , FlexSim, RoboDK, Visual Components, Factory Flow, etc. ) is a plus
 - Understanding of industrial safety standards (e. g. , ISO, CE, UL) and commitment to enforcing safety protocols during test & validation
 - Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to work independently on test development, issue resolution, and documentation
 - Excellent interpersonal and influencing skills to interact with other departments. 
 - Effective cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, working with global engineering, quality, and operations teams
 - Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
 - Exposure to Lean principles, Kaizen, or Six Sigma tools for process improvement in testing and validation
 - Proactive, self-driven, and focused on continuous learning, quality enhancement, and technical excellence
 - Ability to multi-task and perform in a dynamic environment. 
 - Strong sense of urgency, accountability and highly objective oriented
 - Highly organized and efficient in approaching tasks, a self-starter with the ability to solve problems proactively. 
 - Impeccable organization and efficiency skills; strong attention to detail
 - Clear, concise, and articulate communication skills - verbal, written and listening. 

To Be a Great Fit For The Role

- Strong project coordination or management background, with a proven track record of delivering automation and testing systems from ideation to production handover. 
 - Demonstrate hands-on experience in testing and validating industrial automation systems, with a strong focus on robotics, precision mechanisms, control systems, and vision-based inspection. 
 - Prove detail-oriented, structured approach to test planning and execution, ensuring reliable performance, compliance with global standards, and smooth handover to production. 
 - Proven ability to develop and execute test strategies across the project lifecycle - from requirements review and design verification to FAT/SAT, root-cause analysis, and quality assurance. 
 - Able to collaborate cross-functionally with team, solution partners, internal stakeholders, and global engineering teams to ensure test objectives are met effectively and consistently. 
 - Show strong analytical and diagnostic skills to investigate system performance, identify failures, and implement corrective actions that are technically sound and scalable. 
 - You are an effective communicator who can articulate test results, risks, and recommendations to engineering leadership, project teams, and vendor partners. 
 - Demonstrate experience in contributing to successful automation deployments, where rigorous testing improved product quality, machine uptime, operational safety, and production efficiency. 
 - You are passionate about building testing excellence - contributing to test documentation, standardization, and knowledge transfer through structured training and mentoring. 
 - Show deep understanding of industrial safety, quality, and compliance standards, and ensure every validation process adheres to them strictly. 
 - Familiarity with APQP, PFMEA, Control Plans, and test-oriented process development frameworks, with the ability to contribute meaningfully to integrated product quality initiatives. 
 - Able to manage multiple test workstreams across projects while staying organized, focused, and responsive in dynamic, time-bound environments. 
 - Possess a strong work ethic, continuous improvement mindset, and a proactive, solution-driven approach to ensuring the highest standards in automation testing.

Bench High-Speed Interface Validation Engineer

- Location: Coimbatore, Bengaluru, India
 - Work Mode: Onsite

Role Overview

We are looking for a Bench High-Speed Interface Validation Engineer with hands-on experience in silicon validation, characterization, and high-speed interface testing. The role involves developing validation platforms, performing first silicon bring-up, board-level debugging, protocol compliance testing, and automation for next-generation semiconductor devices. The engineer will work closely with Design, Signal Integrity, PCB, Firmware, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams throughout the product development lifecycle.

- Develop, integrate, and debug bench validation setups for high-speed semiconductor interface devices.

 - Design, review, and debug evaluation boards, interface boards, adapter boards, daughter cards, interposers, breakout boards, and custom validation fixtures.

For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients- that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. 

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don't settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients' lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

Job Description

You will be supporting the team responsible for developing solutions to challenging issues associated with the design, development, and sustenance engineering for our new and existing Disposables for the Acute Therapies portfolio focused on Lab testing and administration. You will have an independent responsibility to plan and execute formal V&V testing of Acute Disposables compliant to all the requirements, state-of-the-art methods and standards. Candidate needs to work with R&D engineers to help build Test fixtures/assemblies and assisting with Lab logistics. The candidate will also be a part of Lab Management team to ensure the Laboratory controls are in place in line with applicable international standards and guidelines. You will be expected to support and contribute to the Projects/Initiatives involving Lab testing for Product quality issues, root cause analysis, Test Method development, verification & validation, Design of Experiments testing. 

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

- Supports the R&D development and sustenance activities to execute global cross functional projects relating to Acute Therapies Disposables. 
 - Should have good understanding of principles of mechanics, thermodynamics, hydraulics, heat transfer, and materials to support development and sustenance activities of mechanical and Fluid flow systems involving injection molded components and soft tubing. 
 - Will work with senior members/SME of the team to carry out root cause analyses in case of product failures with minimal supervision
 - Supports the R&D function to execute Lab testing activities relating to Acute Therapies Disposables. 
 - Support R&D engineers in Test fixture creation, Test set up readiness and test method validation
 - Follow instructions and Test protocols with limited guidance from R&D engineers during Test execution. 
 - Support in Developing and Executing Test Procedures/Functional Requirements testing/Performance testing. 
 - Develop and Perform Design Verification & IQ/OQ/PQ where applicable. 
 - Will be responsible for project management activities which includes managing change controls tasks-using Vantive's in-house tools like Trackwise8 and Team Center Unified. 
 - Will work with senior members/SME of the team for writing of verification/validation test, test cases and documenting results in the form of technical reports
 - Able to design Plastic components with inputs from senior team member/SME
 - Follow QMS, ensure good documentation and Good Manufacturing practices are followed in the Verification Process. 
 - Support for Instrument Management and Calibration
 - Support consumable management/Logistics/ Tracking of parts. 
 - Support Project execution support for tests involving Reliability equipment's and Thermal Chambers
 - Follow safety guidelines and monitor the same for Lab operations. 
 - Trouble shoot unfavorable test outcomes and perform RCA. 
 - Works with external vendors for Transport validation, Stability, Sterilization tests, etc, , for Acute Disposables sets & accessories to define the test scope, author the test plans, test procedures, execute & consolidate the reports
 - Collaborate with key stakeholders to resolve tests-related technical issues. 

Education And Experience

- Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical engineering / Biomedical Engineering / Polymer Engineering Related disciplines of Engineering
 - Overall 4 to 8 yrs of experience with minimum 2 years in Medical Device Verification testing [Mechanical Hardware/Disposables]. 
 - Experience in Lab Management and establishing Laboratory controls in line with International Standards regulations [FDA]. 
 - Experience in developing the Procedures and Processes for Engineering labs and Testing facilities. Relevant technical testing/reliability experience in electro-mechanical devices. 
 - Identify and report any quality or compliance concerns and take immediate corrective / Preventive action as needed
 - An understanding of test methods and processes as well as the methods used to verify product in the realms of; mechanical, functional, and environmental testing environments. 
 - Experience in medical device or similar product development, design verification/validation, system integration (involving software & hardware), risk management, reliability engineering, process validation
 - Quality systems Basic understanding of and adherence to FDA, ISO and IEC design control procedures, regulations, and standards. 
 - Experience in facing internal/External Audits. 
 - Self-motivated, Good stakeholder management and effective communication skills.
